column2: 收好行装，饱餐一顿，随后享受八小时的应得睡眠。

column1: Struggling mightily, you pile rock upon rock over the evil spot until it is completely covered with enormous boulders. When you are through, you feel satisfied that no evil thing could penetrate your cairn.
column2: 费尽全力，你将岩石一层层堆砌在那邪恶之地之上，直至用巨大的石块将其完全掩埋。完工之后，你深感安心，确信任何邪恶之物都无法穿透你的石冢。

column1: Success! The iron door creaks open, and you are free to explore deeper into these dwarf-haunted mine shafts. But first a stunted figure steps through the door and confronts you.
column2: 成功！铁门吱呀一声打开，你得以深入这被矮人鬼魂萦绕的矿井。但首先，一个矮小的身影从门后走出，与你对峙。

column1: Suddenly alert, $ChosenOneName senses danger nearby. $He warns you all of a group of cutthroat thieves in ambush. Quickly assessing the situation, you decide to...
column2: 突然警觉，$ChosenOneName 感知到附近有危险。你 警告你们所有人，有一群亡命之徒正在埋伏。迅速评估局势后，你决定……

column1: Suddenly upset, the horseman whines, "I may not take more lives from you. Unlike my brothers, I cannot destroy everyone in a city, everyone in a country. Someone always stays alive, and so must you. You have won." He hands over the balance, and you take it from him. He then vanishes in a puff of dry black dust. You return to the main courtyard.
column2: 突然懊恼，骑士哀鸣道：“我不能再夺走你们的生命。不同于我的兄弟们，我无法毁灭一座城池、一个国家中的所有人。总有人会活下来，你也必须如此。你赢了。”他递出天平，你从他手中接过。随即，他化作一缕干枯的黑尘消散无踪。你回到主庭院。

column1: Surprised, you move through them, exchanging hellos. Nothing happens, and soon they are behind you.
column2: 惊讶之余，你穿过他们，互道问候。并无异状，不久便将他们甩在身后。

column2: 致每一位市民：

column1: The Firewall potion does the trick! The little volcano sputters, flares up momentarily, then goes out completely, snuffed by the mystic power of the alchemical recipe. The monstrous vulcans will not be able to use this entry route again!
column2: 防火药水果然奏效！小火山喷涌几下，瞬间燃起，随即被炼金秘方的神秘力量彻底熄灭。那些可怕的火山怪将再也无法从此处入侵！

column1: The abbot accepts your money. "Be assured, good folk, that the monks of $monastery will chant psalms to your name with all the fervor one could wish for."
column2: 方丈收下了你的钱。“请放心，善人啊，$monastery的僧侣们必将以满腔热忱为你诵念圣咏。”

column1: The aged servant greets you once more. "Welcome back, honored guests. As always, you are expected." Once again, the beautiful magician-astrologer awaits you in the sitting room.
column2: 年迈的仆人再次向你致意：“欢迎归来，尊贵的宾客。一如既往，你已在此恭候。”美丽的魔法师兼占星师再次在客厅中等候着你。

column1: The battle is on.
column2: 战斗已打响。

column1: The best locksmith in your group suddenly leaps up. "Of course, how foolish!" $he cries. "The triple tumbler reverse!" With this cryptic statement, $he attacks the lock with vigor. Soon it opens, with an ominous clang. You quickly exit.
column2: 你队中最出色的锁匠忽地站起。“原来如此，我真愚钝！”你惊呼道。“三重转盘反向法！”言罢，你奋然撬锁。片刻，锁应声而开，发出一声阴森的巨响。众人疾步而出。

column1: The clerk motions to the attendants, who block your path.
column2: 文吏示意侍从上前，拦住汝去路。

column1: The clerks openly snicker at your request.
column2: 文吏们公然对你的请求窃笑。

column1: The creature cackles with laughter. "Your souls, say you? I do not take souls. I can only give you despair and sorrow." When he says this, you are overwhelmed by shooting pains in your gut. As you double up, your mouths go dry and sere. Your teeth feel loose, and your muscles limp. You are suddenly in the last stages of death by starvation. All hope has gone, and depression fills your thoughts.
column2: 那生物咯咯地笑着。“你们的灵魂，你说？我不取灵魂。我只能给予你们绝望与悲伤。”他说这话时，你腹中一阵剧痛袭来。你弯下腰去，口中干涩如焚。牙齿松动，肌肉无力。你仿佛已处于饥饿致死的最后阶段。一切希望尽失，抑郁充斥心头。

column1: The creature responds, "Hungry, hungry, hungry. What do you offer me?"
column2: 那生物应道：“饥哉，饥哉，饥哉。汝能予吾何物？”

column1: The creature's eyes and mouth constrict in sudden anguish. "You have found me out!" he mourns. "I have no power over the wealthy, only the poor. For your money, I shall give you the balance." He hands over his magic balance, the Fifth Key of the Apocalypse, and leaves. You return to the courtyard.
column2: 那生物的眼口骤然紧缩，满面悲痛。“你已识破我！”他哀叹道，“我无力掌控富人，唯有贫民。为你的银钱，我将交出天平。”他递上魔法天平——末日之第五钥——随即离去。你重返庭院。

column1: The dank dungeon chamber smells of death and corruption. Bits of rotted, leathery flesh and withered shards of bone festoon the floor and walls. The message is clear: stay here and you will die.
column2: 潮湿的地下密室弥漫着死亡与腐朽的气息。地板与墙壁上点缀着腐烂的皮革状血肉与干枯的骨片。信息再明白不过：留在这里，必死无疑。

column1: The door slides open. Your way is clear. A stunted figure bars your way. It seems to wish to communicate.
column2: 门缓缓开启。前路已通。一道矮小的身影挡住了去路。它似乎欲与你交谈。

column1: The fighting ends when you drop your weapons in surrender. The guards confiscate them and any possessions of obvious value. In a few minutes a street patrol shows up and escorts you at spearpoint to the dungeon. The patrol leader sneers at you.
column2: 当你放下武器投降时，战斗便告结束。卫兵没收了你的武器及一切显而易见的贵重物品。数分钟后，一队巡街兵至，持矛押送你入地牢。巡逻队长对你嗤之以鼻。

column1: The fighting is over, and you have lost. You are tied up again, and once more led to the place of execution.
column2: 战斗已毕，你已败北。你再次被缚，再度押赴刑场。

column1: The guards' faces are hard and uncaring. $ChosenOneName falls to $his knees and cries, "Oh, blessed $NamedOneName, spare our friend!"
column2: 卫兵面容冷峻，漠然无情。$ChosenOneName跪伏于你的，哭喊道：“哦，至福的$NamedOneName，饶恕吾友吧！”

column1: The guild leader says, "Yes, our guild can teach $Text1 for $Money1 per day. However, our teacher's ability is $Text2, so you cannot progress beyond that under our instruction."
column2: 公会会长道：“不错，本会可授$Text1之术，每日收费$Money1。然吾师之能仅达$Text2，故汝在此难再进阶。”

column1: The heavens have no answer for you. You must find your own way out of this predicament.
column2: 天堂无言以对。汝须自寻脱困之道。

column1: The knight's eyes narrow beneath his helm. "Bide," he says, moving away from the door. Before you can act, the door is flung wide and armed foes stand before you. "Slay the unbelievers!" cries the guard.
column2: 骑士兜鍪之下，双目微眯。“且慢，”他退离门口。未及你有所动作，大门已被猛然推开，持械之敌立于门前。“杀尽异教徒！”卫兵高呼。

column2: 那人令汝等坐于华美软垫长椅之上，并奉上清水与点心。

column1: The master banker continues smiling, a strange and chilling sight.
column2: 主账房依旧微笑，其状诡异而阴森。

column1: The monk immediately shakes his head. "I am sorry, there is no tradition of holy sanctuary here. Please go to $cityChurch, the church around the corner."
column2: 僧侣当即摇头：“抱歉，此处并无圣所庇护的传统。请前往转角的$cityChurch教堂。”

column1: The monk returns and says, "I'm sorry, but the abbess does not feel she can help with your injuries, such as they are."
column2: 僧侣归来，说道：“抱歉，修女院长认为无力医治汝伤，即便如此。”

column2: $ChosenTwoName之祷告甫毕，只见一位睿智老者，戴近视眼镜，身着华丽却陈旧之袍服，步履稳健，自$councilHall一侧缓步而来。

column1: The prayers of $ChosenTwoName apparently have no effect. The clerks and guards are still watching you carefully, and you are no closer to an audience than before.
column2: $ChosenTwoName的祈祷显然毫无效验。文吏与卫兵仍严密监视，汝距觐见仍遥不可及。

column1: The prices the being mentions are mind-numbingly high! Could this be Famine, one of the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse?
column2: 此物所报之价高得令人咋舌！莫非此乃“饥荒”，末日四骑士之一？

column1: The saint seems to whisper into your ear, "Save the harvest. Avert the famine. You must obtain the balance from him. Consider: not everyone dies from a famine equally. Who are least subject to it?"
column2: 圣者似低语于耳：“救收成，避饥荒。汝须向彼求取天平。试思：饥荒之下，并非人人同命。何人受其害最轻？”

column1: The senior clerk introduces you to the master banker of $PlaceName, $NamedOneName, who greets you with warmth and friendliness.
column2: 资深文吏引荐汝与$PlaceName之主账房$NamedOneName相见，彼热情相迎，友善如故。

column1: The stablemaster points out that boarding any animals is part of the inn's service, and therefore part of the regular charge. However, the stables are also a central point for buying and selling mounts in $PlaceName. Before you can protest, he takes you on a complete tour of all his horses and mules available for sale.
column2: 马厩主人指出，寄养牲畜乃客栈服务之一，故属常规收费范围。然马厩亦为 $PlaceName 售买坐骑之要地。未及你抗议，他便带你遍览其可售之马骡。

column1: The way is clear; you travel onward.
column2: 前路已通，你们继续前行。

column2: 此境之下，多有圣徒可助一臂之力。你思忖……

column2: 这是短信01，实属无奈之举。

column2: 为此，你可寻毒贩，“劝”其坦白，并供出雇主。

column1: To prove this you could find the poisoner and convince him to make an appropriate confession, naming his employer. Alternately, you could seek other accomplices or witnesses.
column2: 为此，你可寻毒贩，令其坦白并供出雇主。抑或另觅同谋或证人。

column1: To prove this you need to find where he gets these cheap goods, where he stores them, or steal his "secret ledgers" that document the illegal transactions.
column2: 为此，你须查明其低价货之来源、仓储处，或窃取其记录非法交易之“密账”。

column1: Unconsciousness follows, but apparently you are not as tasty as the spiders' regular diet: you awaken, still wrapped in sticky silk, but as alive as when the battle ended.
column2: 随即昏厥，然蛛群视你不如常食鲜美：你醒时仍被粘丝缠裹，性命却与战罢无异。

column1: Unfortunately, $ChosenOneName simply can't get past the many apprentices and junior journeymen. After spending a couple of hours trying, you realize there is no hope of seeing the leaders today.
column2: 不幸的是，$ChosenOneName 终究难越众学徒与初级工匠之障。费时两小时，方知今日无缘见诸领袖。

column1: Unfortunately, the arcane wording of the university diploma (or whatever it is) surpasses your meager ability to read.
column2: 不幸的是，大学文凭（或类似物）之奥义远超汝浅薄之识。

column1: Unfortunately, there is no answer to $ChosenOneName's prayer. The rain continues coming down, and the water continues to rise!
column2: 不幸的是，$ChosenOneName 之祷告未蒙垂听。雨势不止，水位渐涨！

column1: Unfortunately, you have no chance of escaping from the mounted guard. In minutes they have you surrounded and cornered. You can only...
column2: 不幸的是，汝无逃脱骑卫之机。顷刻间，汝已被围困于隅。汝唯有……

column1: Victory is yours! The human leader of the kobolds is dead, and suddenly dwarfs pour into the hall from behind to take control. One of them turns to you and says,
column2: 胜利归汝！地精首领已死，忽有矮人自后涌入大厅，掌控全局。其中一人转向汝曰：

column1: What the dwarf says in his bad poetry is true. For better or worse, you must hope for a dwarf victory now.
column2: 矮人拙诗所言不虚。无论祸福，汝今惟盼矮人胜矣。

column1: When the dust settles, the entrance to the crypt is closed once more. The rubble now has the unmistakable outline of an old church.
column2: 尘埃落定，墓室入口复又紧闭。瓦砾间依稀可见旧教堂之轮廓。

column1: When the last of you ceases fighting, webs fly in all directions. You're trussed up and then bitten by the giant spiders.
column2: 当你等最后一人止战，蛛网四散纷飞。尔后，你被巨蛛缚住并叮咬。

column1: When you are beaten by the villagers, they cruelly wrench you to your feet and drag you toward a nearby hilltop. They chant raucous paeans of praise to their hellish lord and mock you unmercifully.
column2: 村民殴汝之际，残忍地将汝拽起，拖向近旁山巅。彼等高唱恶主赞歌，肆意嘲弄于汝。

column1: When you pour the Firewall potion into the firespout, it sputters for a moment, then flares up again, but its flame seems weaker. Perhaps if you poured additional Firewall potions into it, you could extinguish it completely.
column2: 当汝将防火药剂倾入火口，其暂且喷溅，旋又燃起，然焰势似弱。若再灌入防火药剂，或可彻底熄灭。

column1: Why is he mentioning kobolds? You shrug and attack, but more dwarfs pour out of the cave walls. You must fight them all!
column2: 何以提及地精？汝耸肩进击，然更多矮人自洞壁涌出。汝须尽敌！

column1: Why is he talking about kobolds? You shrug and go your way.
column2: 何以谈地精？汝耸肩而去。

column1: With a loud crash, fragments of door fly in all directions. As the alarm sounds, you storm through the smoking doorway into the tower keep.
column2: 一声巨响，门扉碎片四散。警铃乍鸣，汝冲入烟雾弥漫之塔楼正厅。

column1: With a loud pop, the street becomes far brighter than normal daylight. Amid cries and exclamations you try to slip in a side door. Unfortunately, a party of apprentices is coming out through the same door. In a comic collision, everybody ends up in a heap.
column2: 一声爆响，街市骤亮逾常日。众人惊呼喧哗，汝欲从侧门潜入。不幸的是，一群学徒正由同门走出。一番闹剧，众人皆成一团。

column1: With a loud pop, the street becomes far brighter than normal daylight. Amid cries of terror you try to slip in a side door. Unfortunately, a party of apprentices is coming out through the same door. In a comic collision, everybody ends up in a heap. By the time you get up, the door is closed again.
column2: 一声爆响，街市骤亮逾常日。惊恐呼喊中，汝欲从侧门潜入。不幸的是，一群学徒正由同门走出。一番闹剧，众人皆成一团。待汝起身，门已复闭。

column1: With care, $ChosenOneName unlocks a door and lets you inside. There you ruin as many tools and goods as you can without make noise. On the master's desk, you leave a note saying, "Your inflexibility has angered the Friends of the Honest Worker. Repent or suffer."
column2: $ChosenOneName 小心开启一扇门，引汝入内。汝于室内悄无声息地毁坏尽可能多的工具与货物。于主人案上，留书曰：“汝之顽固激怒诚实工友会。悔过否，否则受罚。”

column1: With that, he vanishes. You have won!
column2: 说罢，他消失不见。汝胜矣！

column1: With that, the dwarfs depart. You poke around the mines to ensure the dwarfs are truly gone, and find no trace of them. The mine can be reopened! You return to the miners' camp. The miners greet you, cheerful at your success.
column2: 说罢，矮人离去。汝细查矿井，确认矮人确已远去，终无所踪。矿井可重新开采！汝返矿工营地。矿工见汝凯旋，皆喜形于色。

column1: With unerring aim, $ChosenOneName hurls the potion directly into the middle of the ambush. Surprised soldiers flee in all directions.
column2: $ChosenOneName 准确投掷药剂，直入伏击中心。猝不及防之士兵四散奔逃。

column1: You all politely decline.
column2: 你们皆婉拒。

column1: You all successfully scale the outer wall and tower keep. Breathing hard, you rest briefly before drawing weapons and stealing into the sleeping castle.
column2: 你们皆顺利攀上外墙与塔楼。喘息稍歇，拔剑潜入沉睡之城堡。

column1: You all swear a pact as blood-brothers, to seek good and avoid evil, and to bring everlasting honor and glory to your names.
column2: 你们歃血为盟，立誓行善避恶，使姓名永享荣耀。

column1: You are confident that the fear of more devastation, beatings, even assassination will sway them to the cause.
column2: 你深信，对更大破坏、殴打乃至暗杀之恐惧，必能使其倒向汝之阵营。

column1: You are confident that the fear of more devastation, beatings, even assassination will sway them to your cause.
column2: 你深信，对更大破坏、殴打乃至暗杀之恐惧，必能使其倒向汝之阵营。

column1: You are instantly beset by a hail of flaming torches and crossbow quarrels. Quickly you retreat around a nearby building, frustrated.
column2: 顷刻间，汝遭烈火与弩矢齐袭。汝急退至近旁建筑，懊恼不已。

column1: You are lined up before him, and held tightly by guards. In a solemn voice, the headsman formally asks the bailiff, "Who is now to be executed?"
column2: 你列队于其前，被卫兵紧紧挟持。刽子手以庄重之声正式询问执刑官：“今当斩何人？”

column1: You are so elated at successfully getting inside that you scrawl on the walls and floors, "Beware, Friends of the Honest Worker are watching you!"
column2: 你因成功潜入而欣喜若狂，遂于墙地涂鸦：“警惕，诚实工友会正在监视汝！”

column1: You are so elated at successfully getting inside that you use fireplace charcoal to scrawl everywhere, "Loyal citizens of $PlaceName are watching you!" and "Rebels are traitors."
column2: 你因成功潜入而欣喜若狂，遂以炉灰涂画各处：“$PlaceName 忠诚市民正在监视汝！”“叛逆者乃叛徒。”

column1: You are taken to the city church and there you are released. "Folk with such strong religious backgrounds as you should not be subject to such stern penalties." opines the cleric. You thank him profusely.

column2: “啊，我的英雄们！看来你们已凯旋归来。多谢相助。请稍候，我这就将应得的报酬赐予你们。”

column1: Ah, you seek to be of some service to us? he remarks. "Yes, yes, that is possible. First let me show you the rewards possible to those who please us."
column2: “啊，你想为我们效劳？”他说道。“是的，是的，这并非不可能。先让我向你展示那些令我们满意之人所能获得的报酬。”

column1: Ah, says $ChosenOneName to the lord while at dinner, "if only all of the Holy Roman Empire was as peaceful and wisely ruled as these lands."
column2: “啊，”$ChosenOneName在晚宴上对领主说道，“但愿整个神圣罗马帝国都能像这些土地一样太平且英明地治理。”

column1: Ah... he begins. "Actually, to tell the truth, this indulgence has questionable authority, and is now expired. The donations collected I kept for personal gain. I fear my curses are more from Satan than the Lord."
column2: “啊……”他开口道。“其实，说实话，这道赦免状权威可疑，如今已过期。所募捐之款，我皆据为己有。只怕我的诅咒，更多来自撒旦，而非主。”

column1: Alas, I'm afraid that wall is beyond my skill, $he confesses.
column2: “唉，恐怕那堵墙已超乎我之技艺所及，”你坦言道。

column1: Alas, we must press on quickly, says $ChosenOneName , "our tasks do not permit much rest."
column2: “唉，我们必须尽快前行，”$ChosenOneName说道，“我们的任务容不得太多休憩。”

column1: Alas, he says, "we cannot help you in this. Our abbot forbids strangers access to such services. I suggest that you seek elsewhere."
column2: “唉，”他说，“此事我们无能为力。我们的方丈禁止外人享用此类服务。我建议你另寻他处。”

column1: Alas, he says, "we cannot help you in this. Our monks are too busy studying and saying Mass. Please seek elsewhere today."
column2: “唉，”他说，“此事我们无能为力。我等修士正忙于研经与诵弥撒。今日请另寻他处。”

column1: All in the city shall hear of this, promises the prelate. "Not only man but the heavens themselves shall thank you and honor your name."
column2: “城中众人皆将闻此讯，”主教许诺道。“不仅世人，连苍穹亦将感激于你，并尊崇你的名号。”

column1: All in the city shall hear of this. promises the prelate. "Not only man but the heavens themselves shall thank you and honor your name."
column2: “城中之人皆将闻此讯。”主教许诺道。“不仅世人，连苍穹亦将感激于你，并尊汝之名。”

column1: All is well, he announces. Smiling broadly, he excuses himself and calls for his aides. You bow and depart.
column2: “一切安好，”他宣布道。笑容满面地告退，并唤来随从。你行礼后离去。

column1: Although justice is its own reward, we traders honor contracts and rewards. Yours is well-earned.
column2: 虽正义乃其自身之酬，然吾等商人亦重契约与赏赐。汝之所得，实至名归。

column1: Although parting with this grieves me, it was a worthwhile price for the service you rendered us. I will inform other representatives of your bravery and usefulness. You may find some of them eager to employ you.
column2: 虽与君别，心甚戚然，然为酬君之功，此乃值得之代价。吾将告知诸位代表，以彰君之勇武与才用。或有彼等愿聘君也。

column1: An ambush lies ahead, $he says. "They are paid assassins bent upon murder."
column2: “前方有埋伏，”你说道。“他们是受雇的刺客，一心谋杀。”

column1: Ancient magic is my life, she says, "but I am neither witch nor alchemist. Satan is my enemy, the Lord is my shepherd. My arts astrological foretold your coming, and show future paths. Listen well, for you are the right people, at the right time, for the right purpose..."
column2: “古老魔法乃吾之生命，”她言道，“然吾非女巫，亦非炼金术士。撒旦为吾敌，主乃吾牧者。吾之占星术预示汝之降临，并示未来之路。谛听，因汝乃适人、适时、适其所用之人……”

column1: And confidentially, he adds, "the abbess only undertakes to help the truly virtuous and those with serious hurts. I suggest you visit the city physician, in the middle of the guilds district."
column2: “而且，”他低声补充道，“修女院长只肯帮助真正有德之人与身负重伤者。我建议你去公会区中央的城中医馆。”

column1: And don't come back! shouts the watchman.
column2: “不许回来！”守卫喊道。

column1: And we will pray for your safety here, replies $ChosenOneName.
column2: “我们将在此为你祈福平安，”$ChosenOneName答道。

column1: Are those groschen from $NamedOneName?
column2: “那些格罗申是来自$NamedOneName的吗？”

column1: Are you the ones we have prayed for? they ask.
column2: “你们就是我们祈祷的人吗？”他们问道。

column1: Are your arms enchanted with Greatpower or Strongedge? Do they have the blessing of Saint Dunstan, Eligius, George, Longinius, or Maurice? Are you protected by alchemy or holy powers that repel flames?
column2: 汝之双臂是否被大能或强刃所加持？是否蒙圣邓斯坦、埃利吉乌斯、乔治、朗基努斯或莫里斯之祝福？汝是否受炼金术或圣力庇护，以御烈焰？

column1: Aren't we supposed to go in and kill them now? one asks, referring to you. "Nay," says the other. "Lord $NamedOneName told us to wait for another hour, to make sure they are asleep before we cut their throats." You are not surprised -- raubritters are not famous for their hospitality.
column2: “我们不是该进去杀了他们吗？”其中一人指着你问道。“不可，”另一人答道，“$NamedOneName大人吩咐我们再等一小时，待他们熟睡后再割断他们的喉咙。”你并不意外——劫匪骑士素来以好客著称。

column1: As long as I rule here, you will always be welcome. Without your valiant efforts, none of this could have happened. I will post handbills and send letters abroad praising you.
column2: 只要我在此为王，尔等永远受我欢迎。若非尔等英勇奋战，这一切皆不可能实现。我将张贴告示，并遣使海外，以彰尔等之功。

column1: As misguided men worship Satan, so must other men undertake the task of repairing their ravages.
column2: “正如迷途之人崇拜撒旦，亦有贤者肩负修复其祸害之责。”

column1: As visiting students, says the administrator, "we expect you to take up residence at $Inn, and from there select daily the classes you prefer. All fees are payable daily and in advance."
column2: “作为来访学子，”管理员道，“吾等望尔等入住$Inn，并于每日自选所好之课。诸费皆须日结预付。”

column1:
At $Text1 on $Text2, all of our supporters will assemble here, joining the loyal troops being furnished by $Text4, the rightful lord of $PlaceName.	“于$Text2之$Text1，吾等支持者悉数于此集会，与$Text4——$PlaceName之正统领主——所调忠勇之师汇合。”
At $Text1 on $Text2, all of our supporters will assemble here. Then we will march through the city, urging people to join the procession.
column2: “于$Text2之$Text1，吾等支持者悉数于此集会。随后我们将巡城，号召民众加入行列。”

column1:
At $Text1 on $Text2, the city guard will converge on the rebel headquarters. Surprising them with this sudden move, we will arrest the ringleaders and bring them back to $VarString5. They will be held there for trial, on charges of conspiracy and treason.	“于$Text2之$Text1，城卫将齐集叛首巢穴。猝然发难，擒拿首恶，押回$VarString5。彼等将以谋反与叛国之罪受审。”
At last our ancestors can rest peacefully," he mutters.
column2: “终得使先祖安息矣，”他低语道。

column1: August sirs, regretfully, there are no rooms available. He looks about nervously, perhaps for the city guard.
column2: “八月诸君，遗憾也，无房可居。”他四顾张惶，似盼城卫至。

column1: Aye, says another. "He'll miss a fine feast. Let us hurry -- we wouldn't want to disappoint the others by letting the meat spoil." All four laugh with a sick, reedy sound as they continue down the path. You...
column2: “正是，”另一人道，“他将错失佳宴。速行罢——莫令肉腐，徒负众望。”四人阴恻恻地笑作一团，沿路而去。尔……

column1: Bah, all lies by our enemies! And who are you to say such things? shouts another.
column2: “呸，皆敌人口舌耳！汝何人，敢言此？”又一人怒喝。

column1: Bah, all lies conceived by our enemies! And who are you to say such things? shouts another.
column2: “呸，皆敌人口舌耳！汝何人，敢言此？”又一人怒喝。

column1: Bah, all lies concocted by our enemies! And who are you to say such things? shouts another.
column2: “呸，皆敌人口舌耳！汝何人，敢言此？”又一人怒喝。

column1: Bah, begone scum, he hisses, "you haven't enough to interest me. Try some pigsty hamlet where such paltry sums buy more than a week-old breadcrust."
column2: “滚吧，贱民！”他嘶声道，“尔等分文不值，何足挂齿？去那猪圈般的村落，方能以微薄银两换得半饱。”

column1: Be not like barbarous pagans, always fighting and killing. Instead, learn to live with one another, suffering each other's foibles, as Christ suffered for us all.
column2: “勿效蛮夷之俗，终日争斗杀戮。当学彼此相容，容忍过失，如基督为众人受难。”

column1: Beautiful! he mutters. "Thank you again for your help!" Humming a monastic dirge, he excuses himself. You bow and depart.
column2: “美哉！”他低语。“再谢汝助。”吟诵一曲修道院挽歌，告退。尔鞠躬而别。

column1: Beautiful, is it not? he says. "Now none can dispute our claim!" Smiling broadly, he bids you farewell. You bow and depart.
column2: “美乎？”他道。“今无人敢驳我等之名！”粲然一笑，辞别。尔鞠躬而别。

column1: Begone, the watchman growls, "or feel our quarrels." A guardsman beside him cocks and aims a crossbow.
column2: “退下！”守卫咆哮，“否则尝我等利刃。”旁侧甲士扳机上弦，弩箭直指。

column1: Below are ancient tombs, $he says, "and the $NamedOneName . However, the dead are not at rest, for the ground is no longer consecrated. Should we choose to enter the pit below, I urge that we first purify it with an alchemical transformation, or with the aid of a saint."
column2: “下方乃古墓，”你道，“更有$NamedOneName。然亡灵不得安息，因圣地已失圣洁。若欲入坑，吾劝先以炼金术或圣者之力净之。”

column1: Bless you, noble travellers, says an old porter. "These thugs were terrorizing our neighborhood."
column2: “善哉，尊贵旅人，”老搬运工道，“此辈恶棍素扰吾里。”

column1: Blood and gold, now! barks their leader. The rabble surge forward, weapons swinging.
column2: “血与金，即刻！”首领厉喝。乌合之众挥刀扑来。

column1: Brothers and sisters have I none, but that man's father is my father's son. Tell me who that man is, and the door will open.
column2: “吾无兄弟姐妹，然彼父乃吾父之子。试言彼为何人，门自开。”

column1: Brothers of the Sabbat! he cries, embracing you. You are certain that he is a member of the feared witch cult; this gathering in the field must be one of their unholy festivals.
column2: “萨巴特之兄弟！”他呼喊，拥汝而抱。汝确信其乃恐怖巫教成员；此野地聚众，必为其邪诞祭典之一。

column1: But Daddy, why can't I see Hans? He's a nice boy...
column2: “可是爹，为何见不到汉斯？他是个好孩子啊……”

column1: But Hans, his friend replies, "the $CityLordTitle has posted allowed prices!" They drift away, and you hear no more of their familiar complaints.
column2: “然则，”其友答，“$CityLordTitle已定限价！”二人渐行渐远，汝再听不见他们熟悉的抱怨。

column1: But first, let me show you this item. A wrapped parcel appears and is unwrapped, revealing $NamedTwoName. You gasp, realizing that something of this quality is certainly worth at least $Money1. Then it is rewrapped.
column2: “且慢，先观此物。”包裹徐展，现$NamedTwoName。汝惊呼，知此品价值至少$Money1。旋即复裹。

column1: But first, let me show you this item. He unwraps the $ItemName. You all gasp, realizing that something of such quality is certainly to be desired. He carefully rewraps it.
column2: “且慢，先观此物。”他启$ItemName。汝等皆惊，知此质非凡，诚属珍品。他慎重新裹之。

column1: But first, let me show you this modest purse. A small strongbox is opened, displaying $Money1, a princely sum.
column2: “且慢，先观此小囊。”开一小箱，现$Money1，巨资也。

column1: But first, let me show you this modest purse. He opens a strongbox, displaying $Money1, a princely sum.
column2: “且慢，先观此小囊。”他开箱，现$Money1，巨资也。

column1: But perhaps, he continues, "you would have better luck in other cities. Not every physician is as fortunate. Some find themselves short-handed, and might therefore tutor you in exchange for temporary help."
column2: “然则，”他续道，“或许他乡更宜。非每医皆有幸。或缺人手，或愿以临时相助换汝之授。”

column1: But please sir, the men are eager.
column2: “然恳请先生，众皆急切。”

column1: But sir, what about...
column2: “然先生，至于……”

column1: But surely, brother, it would be wiser to take this one for the ceremony on $SabbatTime? says one.
column2: “然则，兄长，持此赴$SabbatTime之礼，岂不更为明智？”一人道。

column1:
But then, we haven't attracted anyone famous or intrepid either. Perhaps my preferences have been incorrect. After all, with you on our side, how can we lose?	“然则，吾等亦未招徕名流或勇者。或吾偏好有误。毕竟，有汝相助，何惧败北？”
But we are all initiated!"
column2: “然吾等皆已受戒！”

column1: But we must make do the best we can. So, kind sirs, hand over the woman.
column2: “然吾等只得勉力为之。诸位仁兄，献出女子。”

column1: But we should always post a guard, and not stay in one place too long, comments $ChosenOneName.
column2: “然吾等当常设守卫，勿久驻一地，”$ChosenOneName评道。

column1: But, but... it burned down a whole village! he cries, and everyone laughs.
column2: “然，然……它烧毁了一整村！”他哭喊，众皆哄笑。

column1: But, the monk continues, "a contribution of $Money1 each day would be received most gratefully. Invitations to appropriate people will be delivered daily to your inn. You are staying at $Inn, are you not? After all, any other residence would be illegal by the laws of $PlaceName."
column2: “然则，”僧侣续道，“每日贡献$Money1，不胜感激。适格人士之邀函将日送汝寓所。汝居于$Inn，对否？盖依$PlaceName之法，他处皆属非法。”

column1: By Mary's Motheaten Mantle, curses one, "the government should prevent all those merchants from charging so much for everything."
column2: “玛利亚霉衣为誓，”一人咒骂，“官府理应禁绝诸商漫天要价。”

column1: By Saint John of Nepolmuchen, why accuse me falsely? Does the sin of slander please you? You hang your heads in shame, knowing that you have spoken unwisely.
column2: “圣约翰·内波穆克为证，何故诬陷于我？汝喜诽谤之罪耶？”汝等羞愧低头，知己言不慎。

column1: By the Holy Mary! That means...
column2: “圣母玛利亚在上！此意谓……”

column1: By the frozen toe of Saint Nikolas, one of your companions grumbles, "we should be in an inn, or at least in the countryside before a warm campfire."
column2: “圣尼古拉斯冻趾为鉴，”同伴嘟囔，“吾等当居客栈，或至少于乡间篝火旁。”

column1: Can we relieve your pain?
column2: “可否减轻你的痛苦？”

column1: Cease and live! They freeze, then see the obvious competence of your group. They look at one another, shrug, and step back.
column2: “住手，饶命！”他们僵立，随即看出你一行人显然身手不凡。彼此对视，耸肩后退。

column1: Certainly, everybody knows $NamedOneName. Born here, you know. Good family, has some business interests, pleasant enough, though a bit tight with money.
column2: “当然，人人都知道 $NamedOneName。他生于此地，家世良好，略有产业，性情尚可，只是稍显吝啬。”

column1: Certainly, paid in full.
column2: 当然，已全数付讫。

column1: Child's play. Not a pfennig of courage among them all! replies the soldier.
column2: 小儿科。他们个个都无半点勇气！士兵答道。

column1: Clearly, we have little time before the traitors strike, he adds. "Please hurry."
column2: “显然，叛徒即将发难，我们时间无多，”他补充道，“请速行。”

column1: Come quickly! Rebel forces are in the streets, marching on the $VarString1!
column2: “快些来！叛军已入街巷，正向 $VarString1 进军！”

column1: Come quickly! The city guards have wrecked our headquarters. They've arrested $NamedOneName and are taking him to the $VarString1!
column2: “快些来！城卫已捣毁我方总部，逮捕了 $NamedOneName，正押解他前往 $VarString1！”

column1: Come then, sirrahs, and face the Preceptor of the Templars.
column2: “来吧，诸位，去面对圣殿骑士团的教务长。”

column1: Come to meet my reaper? $he asks.
column2: “来见我的死神吗？”你 问道。

column1: Come with me, commands the abbess. Some burly servants assist you to unused rooms in the convent. Nuns, young and old, come to dress your wounds and pray for your souls. All are quiet: the nuns here are under a vow of silence. Still, you see from their demeanor they are delighted to aid you.
column2: “随我来，”修女院长下令。几名壮仆引你至修道院内闲置的房室。老少修女前来为你包扎伤口，并为你的灵魂祈祷。众人皆默然：此间修女奉有缄默之誓。然从她们神情可见，她们乐于助人。

column1: Come with us, he says.
column2: “随我们走吧，”他说。

column1: Come ye to help prepare the summoning-place? he asks. You reply...
column2: “来帮忙布置召灵之地吗？”他问道。你答曰……

column1: Contemplation of godly things during the Mass will greatly improve the effect, says the Monk-Cantor as he closes the door.
column2: “弥撒期间冥想神明之事，将大大增强法术效力，”僧侣兼唱诗班领唱边关门边说。

column1: Converge on $Text3, at $Text1, $Text2. Get them back to $Text4 quick, then hold for trial.
column2: “于 $Text1 时 $Text2 分会合于 $Text3，速将他们押回 $Text4，静候审判。”

column1: Counterfeiting. People still try it, despite the death penalty.
column2: 伪造货币。尽管有死刑，仍有人尝试。

column1: Cursed! A potion wasted! you remark, and consider what to do now...
column2: “糟了！药剂竟被浪费！”你感叹道，思忖下一步该如何处置……

column1: Demon, eh? I'll have no truck with that until the ceremony tomorrow! He takes another step back, then turns and flees.
column2: “恶魔？哼！除非明日仪式过后，否则我绝不与你打交道！”他又退一步，转身逃去。

column1: Disperse to your homes, before we disperse you with steel! shouts the lieutenant of the guards.
column2: “散回家中，免得我们以刀剑驱散你们！”卫队副官高声喝道。

column1: Do not tarry o'er long, he adds. "Other collectors may have heard this news, and even now may be dispatching their own expeditions."
column2: “勿久留，”他补充道，“其他收税人或许已闻此讯，此刻正派出自己的队伍。”

column1: Do not tarry, he adds. "Others, equally as interested, must also have heard this news."
column2: “勿久留，”他续道，“同样感兴趣的他人也必已得知此事。”

column1: Doesn't look like much, does it? he says, smiling. "But someday I predict it will wield holy powers. Thank you again for your help."
column2: “看起来不起眼吧？”他笑道，“但我预言它终将拥有神圣之力。再次感谢你的相助。”

column1: Don't worry, says $ChosenTwoName, "as in the conversion of Saint Paul, called Saul, the effect is surely temporary. Who knows, maybe they'll be converted to more honest pursuits too!"
column2: “别担心，”$ChosenTwoName 说道，“正如圣保禄皈依之时，其影响必定短暂。说不定他们也会转而从事更诚实的营生呢！”

column1: Don't you know what time it is? he grumbles. "What shop do you want opened? Oh well, wait a minute."
column2: “不知现在几点了吗？”他嘟囔道，“你想开哪家店铺？罢了，等一等。”

column1: Don't you know? People say he hires peasant wives at slave wages, then puts the guild mark -- and price -- on it, and pockets the difference.
column2: “难道你不知道？人们都说他以奴隶价雇佣农妇，再打上公会印记与标价，从中牟利。”

column1: Dung like you, he snarls from the protection of the soldiers, "aren't allowed in our fair city. Stay aboard, or stay in our dungeons!"
column2: “像你这般粪土之人，”他在士兵护卫下咆哮道，“休想踏入吾等名城。要么留在船上，要么关进地牢！”

column1: Eagerness is no good if you're dead. No, I want to wait until they'll fall like a ripe apple into our hands!
column2: “若已身亡，再急又有何用？不，我要等到他们如熟果般落入我手！”

column1: Empty your packs! says their leader. "We must check them in the name of lord $NamedOneName! Certain of your goods may be escheat to our lord."
column2: “把包袱都倒出来！”首领喝道，“我们要以 $NamedOneName 大人的名义检查！部分货物或将充公归大人所有。”

column1: Enemies within! they cry, drawing weapons.
column2: “内贼！”他们喊着拔出武器。

column1: Enemies within! they cry, readying their weapons.
column2: “内贼！”他们喊着准备兵器。

column1: Enough! roars the demon. "Trial by combat is hallowed by ancient usage. If I defeat you, I get a soul. Defeat me, and the contract is void." He attacks.
column2: “够了！”恶魔怒吼道，“以武力决斗乃古已有之的圣礼。若我胜你，便可得一魂；若你胜我，则契约作废。”他发动攻击。

column1: Escort them to the woods, he declares. "We are good Christians here, and avoid bloodshed, no matter what the insult." Actually, you suspect cowardice rather than charity inspired this action.
column2: “护送他们去林中，”他宣称，“吾等皆虔诚基督徒，无论受何侮辱，皆避流血。”实则你疑此举出于怯懦而非仁慈。

column1: Even a farmer trying to sell rotten vegetables makes more convincing arguments! You, sirs, are nothing but knaves who waste my time. Begone this instant!
column2: “连卖腐菜的农夫都能说得更有理！诸位不过是浪费我时光的小人，立刻滚开！”

column1: Excuse me, I didn't recognize you in that garb. With a small gesture, he motions back the knight. "Please, accept my offer to use this road freely, as some small compensation for this mistake."
column2: “抱歉，我未认出阁下这身装束。”他轻轻示意骑士退后，“请接受我免费通行此路的提议，聊表过失之歉意。”

column1: Excuse me, noble sirs, he apologizes, "I didn't expect to find YOU here. Please, do not let me disturb you." Before you can even reply, he and his men quickly back away and leave. Obviously your reputation has impressed him.
column2: “抱歉，尊贵的诸位，”他致歉道，“没想到在此遇见你。请勿介意。”你尚未回应，他便率部匆匆离去。显然，你的威名令他折服。

column1: Famous heroes, he says, "$PlaceName is delighted by your arrival in its hour of need." You hardly begin to smile when he continues. "Although you have accepted this challenge --"
column2: “著名英雄们，”他说，“$PlaceName 在危急时刻因你们的到来而欣喜若狂。”你刚欲微笑，他便接着说道：“尽管你们已接受此挑战——”

column1: Famous heroes, he says, "$PlaceName is delighted by your arrival in its hour of need." You smile as he continues. "Now that you have accepted this challenge --"
column2: “著名英雄们，”他说，“$PlaceName 在危急时刻因你们的到来而欣喜若狂。”你微笑之际，他续道：“既然你们已接受此挑战——”

column1: Fear not, $he says. "Saint Gregory Thaumaturgus is known for ... creative solutions."
column2: “不必惧怕，”你 说道，“圣格列高利·奇迹行者素以……创意之法著称。”

column1: Fear them not, my witches! it calls, "for you are many. I have weakened them! Avenge me!"
column2: “无须畏惧，我的女巫们！”它呼唤道，“汝等众多，我已削弱彼辈！替我复仇吧！”

column1: Feel free to spread your bedding here. Someone will lead you to the kitchens later, for some supper.
column2: “尽可在斯铺床安寝，稍后自有人引汝赴厨房用膳。”

column1: Finally, we'll finish at the $Text3, where we'll demand the resignation of the $CityLordTitle and his councilors. If they refuse, we'll let ourselves inside and detain them in the dungeons. Then we'll form a new city council, giving $PlaceName the government it really needs!
column2: “最后，我们将在 $Text3 结束行动，届时将要求 $CityLordTitle 及其议员辞职。若拒，我们将强行入内，将其囚于地牢。随后另组市政议会，赋予 $PlaceName 真正所需的政权！”

column1: For the rest of your life, ha, ha, ha! screams the witch as she smears ointment on her legs and rides a fallen branch high into the sky.
column2: “余生无忧，哈哈哈哈哈！”女巫一边往腿上涂抹药膏，一边骑着断枝高飞天际。

column1: Foreign scum, you look like bandits to me. Guards! Arrest them!
column2: “外邦渣滓，我看你们形同盗匪。卫兵！逮捕他们！”

column1: Frankly, he remarks, "parting with this grieves me. However, without your bravery, we'd be even worse off." Then he smiles. "I will inform all Fugger branches of your trustworthiness. Some of them also may be interested in your services."
column2: “坦率地说，”他说道，“与此别离令我痛心。然而，若非尔等英勇，吾等境况更甚。”随即一笑，“吾当告知诸弗格商号，尔等信义无亏。彼等亦或有意延聘尔等。”

column1: Frankly, he remarks, "parting with this wealth grieves me. However, without your bravery, we'd be even worse off." Then he smiles. "I will inform all our branches of your trusthworthiness. Other offices might be interested in your services."
column2: “坦率地说，”他说道，“与此财别离令我痛心。然而，若非尔等英勇，吾等境况更甚。”随即一笑，“吾当告知诸分号，尔等信义无亏。彼等亦或有意延聘尔等。”

column1: Friends! you stammer, and the guard looks at you keenly.
column2: “诸君！”你结巴道，卫兵锐目注视于你。

column1: Friends, I'm afraid our prayers aren't being answered tonight.
column2: “诸君，恐今夜祷告未蒙应允。”

column1: Friends, $he says, "this miracle comes not from me, but from Our Lord on High, who has heard our prayers for deliverance." $He then leads the entire crew in a prayer of thanksgiving.
column2: “诸君，”你言，“此奇迹非出吾手，乃天主垂听救赎之祷所致。”你遂率众同诵感恩之祷。

column1: Friends, $he warns, "these are no merchants, but rapacious bandits led by a devil-man."
column2: “诸君，”你警告，“此非商贾，乃恶徒，为首者乃魔人也。”

column1: Gentle travellers, she says, "our prayers have been answered. You are once again whole, and fairly healthy. I must ask that you leave now."
column2: “善旅之人，”她道，“祷告已蒙应允。尔等复归完好，且体健如初。今请速去。”

column1: Gentles, she whispers, for it is a young maiden with a pure face. "I heard your words, and know that you are good. I have come into the witches' midst to rescue the victims of their feast. Now I am o'erwhelmed with fear. Can you help?"
column2: “诸君，”她低语，因乃一纯颜少女。“闻尔等之言，知尔等善良。吾入巫群之中，欲救其祭宴之受害者。今惶惧难安，可助吾否？”

column1: Gentles, she whispers, for you see that it is a young maiden with a pure face. "I heard your words, and know that you are good people. I came into the witches' gathering to rescue these defenseless ones from the feast. Now I am o'erwhelmed with fear. Can you help me?"
column2: “诸君，”她低语，见乃一纯颜少女。“闻尔等之言，知尔等良善。吾入巫会，欲救此无助者免遭祭宴之祸。今惶惧难安，可助吾否？”

column1: Germans! You're all in league with Satan, just like those evil monks and witches. You may defeat this flesh, but the time of reckoning, the apocalypse, will come.
column2: “德意志人！尔等皆与撒旦勾结，犹似那邪恶僧侣与女巫。尔等或能挫其肉身，然报应之时，末日终至。”

column1: Get rid of these bodies! This isn't an abattoir. The soldiers aren't sure what to do with you, so they haul you to a nearby alleyway and dump you there.
column2: “速弃尸骸！此非屠场。”士兵不知所措，遂将尔等拖至近旁巷弄弃置。

column1: Get rid of those swine at once! screams a wizened clerk in a high-pitched voice.
column2: “立即将此等猪猡驱逐！”一老吏尖声厉喝。

column1: Get them! yells one, while simultaneously the Franciscan cries, "Salvation!" The white-robed monks charge, clearly bent on killing you. In response you...
column2: “擒之！”一人呼喊，同时方济各会修士高呼：“救赎！”白衣僧侣猛冲而来，显欲取尔等性命。尔等则...

column1: Go away. We're closed. It's past curfew! screams a shrew-like voice.
column2: “走开！店已歇业，逾宵禁矣！”一泼妇般嗓音怒吼。

column1: Go away. We're closed. It's past curfew! screams the guild master's wife in a shrew-like voice.
column2: “走开！店已歇业，逾宵禁矣！”公会会长之妻以泼妇嗓音怒吼。

column1: Go talk to the priests, says one wag, "they have plenty of dragons in the Bible."
column2: “去问神父吧，”一戏谑者言，“圣经中多有龙迹。”

column1: Godspeed, whispers the maiden, "fear not, I will find my way back to the village." She disappears into the darkness.
column2: “一路顺风，”少女低语，“勿惧，吾自能返村。”遂隐于暗处。

column1: Godspeed, whispers the maiden, as she disappears into the darkness. "I will find my way back to the village."
column2: “一路顺风，”少女低语，隐于暗处。“吾自能返村。”

column1: Good travellers, oblige me and nobody is hurt, says the cloaked one smoothly. "Give $ChosenOneName into my care and go on your way. Otherwise, I will be forced to use powerful magics!" The cloaked figure motions to the woods, and a burst of sound and light occurs there.
column2: “善旅之人，若肯相从，则无人受害，”披斗篷者从容道，“将$ChosenOneName交予吾手，尔等即可离去。否则，吾将不得不施强法！”披斗篷者遥指林间，忽闻一声爆响，光焰乍现。

column1: Great! exclaims $ChosenOneName. "That wall looked hard. But then, if I could do it, just about anybody could!"
column2: “妙极！”$ChosenOneName惊呼，“那墙看似坚不可摧。然若我能越，几乎人人皆可。”

column1: Greetings, Schulz, he says, addressing $ChosenOneName. "Good to see you. But where is Klaus?" You reply...
column2: “Schulz兄，”他向$ChosenOneName致意，“久仰。然Klaus何在？”尔答...

column1: Gut them, boys! snarls the biggest, and they charge.
column2: “剖腹之，儿郎们！”为首者狞笑，众人遂扑上。

column1: Happy to meet fellow students of the Noble Art, the monk says. "I only wish our laboratory here was sufficient to our aims and purposes." You immediately understand this gentle hint.
column2: “幸遇同研武艺者，”僧侣言，“唯愿吾等实验室足以达乎宗旨。”尔当即领会此温婉之意。

column1: Have some more ale, maybe you'll see two dragons! suggests another.
column2: “再饮些麦酒，或可见双龙！”另一人建议。

column1: Have you heard? $NamedOneName is really a serf's son.
column2: “汝闻否？$NamedOneName实乃农奴之子。”

column1: He had an appointment. Let him go or we call the guard.
column2: “他有约在身，放之则罢，否则召卫兵。”

column1: He is already here.
column2: “他已在矣。”

column1: He's coming tomorrow.
column2: “他明日即至。”

column1: He's ill and cannot come.
column2: “他病重，不能来。”

column1: Heaven has heeded our plea, whispers $ChosenTwoName.
column2: “天已垂听吾等祈求，”$ChosenTwoName低语。

column1: Help! $he calls, struggling to get out, but only sinking deeper. You...
column2: “救命！”你呼喊，奋力挣脱，却愈陷愈深。尔等...

column1: Her ladyship $ChosenOneName could oblige us by accompanying us to yon field. he smirks.
column2: “贵妇$ChosenOneName若能随吾等往彼田，吾等将不胜感激。”他莞尔一笑。

column1: Here's something for your efforts. He winks. "Stop by headquarters when you can. I think we should reconsider when to arrest the leaders of these scum."
column2: “聊表谢意。”他眨眨眼，“暇时可至总部一叙。吾等宜再议何时拘捕此等败类之首。”

column1: Here, friends, is $Text1. This scroll has the formula, and these two vials contain working versions of the potion.
column2: “诸君，此乃$Text1。此卷轴载配方，此二瓶乃药剂之成品。”

column1: Hey! $he exclaims, "we don't have any rope!" You all groan. So much for that plan!
column2: “哎呀！”你惊呼，“竟无绳索！”众人皆叹。计划就此泡汤。

column1: Hmm, I recognize you, he says, "and the reward for your capture is greater than this!" Suddenly he begins to shout. "Alarm! Enemies at the wall!"
column2: “嗯，认得尔等，”他言，“捉尔之赏高于此！”忽而大呼，“警报！敌袭城垣！”

column1: Hmmm. What is your ultimate purpose, Preceptor?
column2: “唔，尊驾究为何意，教务长？”

column1: Hmph! A fine lot you are to claim charity! He makes a quick gesture and a host of burly servants appear, carrying your arms and armor.
column2: “哼！尔等竟敢索要施舍！”他迅疾一挥手，众壮仆现身，抬走尔等之兵甲。

column1: Ho! Wizardry is about! warns a guard. One quickly runs for help, while the others raise their lanterns and carefully scan the area. You back away, but...
column2: “不好了！有巫术！”一卫兵预警。一人急奔求援，余者举灯细察。尔等退避，然...

column1: Ho, the gate! shouts a nearby guard atop the battlements.
column2: “守门者！”一卫兵于垛口高呼。

column1: Ho, wizardry at the wall! cries a guard. You quickly run from the wall and hide in a copse of trees. From there, you watch the guards rush around in excitement and confusion.
column2: “城墙有巫术！”一卫兵惊呼。尔等疾退藏于林间，遥观卫兵忙乱纷扰。

column1: Hold them for questioning. When you get back, alert the troops. These prisoners may have compatriots without the city walls.
column2: “暂押候审。回营后即报军。此等囚犯或有同党潜伏城外。”

column1: Hold, he says slowly, "In all honesty, I must reconsider. Now is the time to show the Church's generosity, and remit all tithes for today. These folk may go free."
column2: “且慢，”他徐徐言，“秉心而论，吾须重新思量。今当彰显教会之仁慈，豁免今日什一税。此辈或可获释。”

column1: Holy Sacraments! he exclaims, "I'll be down to open the postern door directly!"
column2: “圣礼！”他惊呼，“吾即下楼，亲启侧门！”

column1: Hope! he moans, "that is the final key. Alas, you have it. I am undone."
column2: “希望啊！”他哀叹，“那是最后一钥。奈何汝掌之。吾已无力。”

column1: Horrible, says $ChosenOneName, "but they are horrible creatures."
column2: “可怕，”$ChosenOneName言，“然彼等确为可怖之物。”

column1: Horses such as this are prized by Dukes and Kings. In fact, I had been reserving this animal as a fitting gift for one who might become my patron. However, I also consider it a fitting reward for performing a dangerous but valuable service that is quite important to me.
column2: “此类骏马，为公侯王室所珍。吾本拟以此马奉赠未来恩主。然亦视之为酬劳，以谢尔等所担之险而功之役，此役于吾殊为重要。”

column1: Horses such as this are prized by Dukes and Kings. In fact, I had been reserving this as a fitting gift for one who might become my patron. However, I also consider it a just reward for a dangerous but valuable service that is quite important to me.
column2: “此类骏马为公爵与王者所珍视。实则，我本欲将其作为厚礼，赠予有望成为我恩主之人。然亦视为对一项危险而珍贵之功勋的应得酬劳，此功于我甚为紧要。”

column1: Horses such as this one are prized by dukes and kings. In fact, I had been reserving this animal as a fitting gift for one who might become my patron. However, I also consider it a fitting reward for a dangerous but valuable service that is quite important to me.

column1: How dare you imply that I would do such evil things! he exclaims.
column2: “汝竟敢妄言吾行此等恶事！”他怒喝道。

column1: However, she continues, "I do forsee that certain potions may be of benefit in your quest." She hands $ChosenOneName a vial of Raimundus Lullus' Firewall, and one of Avicenna's Essence of Grace. "These may be of aid."
column2: “然而，”她续道，“吾料某些药剂或可助汝一臂之力。”她递予$ChosenOneName一瓶雷蒙·卢尔之防火液，又一瓶阿维森纳之恩宠精华。“此二者或能相佐。”

column2: “然而，”她续道，“吾料某些药剂或可助汝一臂之力。”她递予汝一瓶颈变之灵药。“以此可净除撒旦之邪。”

column1: Hrumph, she says, "I can't believe that you're much of a threat! In fact, I'll bet that as soon as I scream, you'll just disappear!"
column2: “哼，”她说，“岂信汝有何威胁！实则，吾赌汝闻吾一声尖叫，即刻遁去！”

column1: Humrph, remarks the guild leader, "surely your jest!"
column2: “哼，”公会会长评曰，“汝必是戏言！”

column1: I also feel that you deserve some material reward. Allow me to give you this. He hands you a heavy purse containing $Money1.
column2: “吾亦觉汝当获物质之赏。容吾赐汝此物。”他递予汝一沉重钱袋，内含$Money1。

column1: I am $NamedOneName, the head miner. Have you come to help us? says he.
column2: “吾乃$NamedOneName，矿工之首。汝来助我乎？”彼言。

column1: I am Captain Krieg, you say confidently. "Anything untoward occurring?"
column2: “吾乃克里格队长，”汝自信答道。“可有异状发生？”

column1:
I am a member of the Rat of $PlaceName, and represent the $CityLordName here. I seek to stop the activities of spies and traitors in our fair city, who seek to overthrow the government. Unfortunately, they have swayed some citizens, who must be enlightened and shown their errors. Then we can arrest the ringleaders with minimal bloodshed.	“吾乃$PlaceName之鼠党成员，今代表$CityLordName于此。吾欲遏止吾城奸细与叛徒之行，彼等谋倾覆朝政。不幸者，已蛊惑部分市民，须使其醒悟，知其所误。届时，吾方可捕首恶，血刃尽少。”
I am convinced," $he says, "that we can proceed safely. We will be watched and protected by a higher power."
column2: “吾深信，”你言，“吾辈可安然前行。自有上天垂护，佑吾等周全。”

column1: I am disappointed that you failed me. Despite repeated pleas to heed my desires, you have done nothing to further my cause. I know you no longer have the monies I advanced you for this task. So I will take what you have and leave.
column2: “汝令吾失望矣。虽屡次恳求汝顺吾意，汝却未为吾事稍作助力。吾知汝已无吾为此事预支之资。故吾取汝所有，扬长而去。”

column1: I am disappointed that you failed me. Despite repeated pleas to heed my desires, you have done nothing to further my cause. I must ask you, as good Christians, to return those monies advanced to you.
column2: “汝令吾失望矣。虽屡次恳求汝顺吾意，汝却未为吾事稍作助力。吾不得不以基督徒之名，命汝归还所领之款。”

column1: I am disappointed we are not more famous, the Preceptor says weakly. "We are a group once foully persecuted by the Pope. Now we prepare the way for the Master to come to Earth and bring about the apocalypse. Our monasteries train satanic priests to go out into the country and gain converts!" A mad light brightens in his eyes. "You cannot hope to defeat us! Join now, or be doomed. Doomed!" With a loud cry, the Preceptor slumps to the ground, the light fading from his eyes.
column2: “吾憾吾等声名不显，”教务长虚弱言，“吾等曾遭教宗无端迫害。今正为圣主降临人间、降下末日铺路。吾等修院训练撒旦祭司，使之遍行乡野，广收信徒！”其目中忽现狂光。“汝岂能胜吾？速入吾列，否则必亡。必亡！”教务长大呼一声，颓然倒地，双目渐失神采。

column1: I am prepared to offer some tutoring in matters alchemical. Take up residence at the inn, the $Inn. Each day I will make instruction available for the very reasonable price of $Money2 per person.
column2: “吾愿授汝炼金之学。汝可寄寓于旅店，即$Inn。每日吾皆设课，每人仅需$Money2，价廉而易得。”

column1: I am sorry, gentle sirs, appologizes the squire, "but my master seeks glory. There is none in a match with unknown travellers such as you."
column2: “诸位贵人，恕罪，”侍从歉然道，“吾主志在功名。与汝等无名旅客较艺，何足称道？”

column1: I am very sorry, he says, "our library is only available to special guests with renowned scholarly credentials."
column2: “甚为抱歉，”他说，“吾馆仅对具卓著学术资历之贵宾开放。”

column1: I assume you are residing at the $Inn, that well-known inn. Rest there, and each day someone will call upon you.
column2: “想汝必居于$Inn，那闻名遐迩之旅店。汝可安歇，每日自有人来访。”

column1: I assume you are residing at the inn, $Inn. Rest there, and each day someone will call upon you.
column2: “想汝必居于旅店，$Inn。汝可安歇，每日自有人来访。”

column1: I can see that God's grace already shines upon you, he says, "go freely and in peace." He then rides away with his party.
column2: “可见上帝之恩已照拂于汝，”他说，“汝可安心离去，平安无虞。”遂率众而去。

column1: I can't visit my sister any more, complains one guildsman, "travel outside the walls is too dangerous."
column2: “吾再不能探望妹矣，”一帮员抱怨，“出城旅途太险。”

column1: I cannot attend this time next year, bemoans one witch. "When and where is another?"
column2: “明年此时，吾恐难赴会，”一女巫哀叹。“下次何时何地？”

column1: I charge thee with the destruction of the cult, says a heavenly voice. "Attend the Sabbat -- guard your virtue! -- break the seal, and find the location of an evil Templar monastery, wherein is another seal that must be broken. Go with God."
column2: “吾命汝毁此邪教，”天音宣道，“赴萨巴特——守汝贞洁！——破封印，寻一邪恶圣殿骑士修院，其中另有封印，亦须破之。愿上帝与汝同在。”

column1: I fear lest it be stolen or moved again, he adds. "It has a tendency to vanish suddenly. Please make all haste."
column2: “吾恐其再被盗或移走，”他补充道，“此物常忽焉不见。请速速行事。”

column1: I fear lest some thief or adventurer steal this item before you, he adds. "Please hurry to fulfill this commission."
column2: “吾恐汝未至，此物已被窃贼或冒险者夺走，”他补充道，“请速速完成此差使。”

column1: I fear lest the owner sell it to some other collector, he adds. "Please do not tarry overlong."
column2: “吾恐物主将其售予他家收藏者，”他补充道，“请勿久延。”

column1: I fear lest this item be stolen or moved again -- it has a tendency to vanish. Please do not tarry.
column2: “吾恐此物再被盗或移走——其常忽焉不见。请勿耽搁。”

column1: I have collected this treasure as a reward for an uncommon and difficult task. Are you interested?
column2: “此宝乃吾为一项罕有且艰难之任所得之奖。汝可有意？”

column1: I have heard reports that the hermit is ill, he continues. "Please hurry, before death overtakes him."
column2: “闻隐士病重，”他续道，“请速速前往，免其溘然长逝。”

column1: I have pledged guest-right to you all. But please understand that I must ask you to remain in your room until dawn, and then leave immediately.
column2: “吾已许汝宾客之礼。然请谅，汝须留室至黎明，而后即刻离舍。”

column1: I have so far hesitated to pay their exorbitant price, he adds, "but I cannot wait too long. Please hurry."
column2: “迄今吾犹疑未付其高昂之价，”他补充道，“然不可久待。请速速前来。”

column1: I heard Latin! You was speaking Latin, the man cries, shaking with fear.
column2: “吾闻拉丁语！汝言拉丁语也！”那人惊惧不已，浑身战栗。

column1: I joined you, $he says, "because we all shared certain concerns. So far, you are not acting as I had expected. Actions speak louder than words. I look for you to take action soon -- very soon!"
column2: “吾随汝同行，”你言，“因吾等皆怀共同之忧。迄今，汝之举未如吾所期。行动胜于言语。吾盼汝速行——速速行之！”

column1:
I know the way is hard. Travel the land, seeking villagers who have fallen into evil ways. As you travel, look for monks dressed in white with a red cross, look for a lone witch in a hut, look for guildsmen with dark secrets. Wring from them the knowledge you need. Show no restraint or pity for these misguided souls.	“吾知前路艰险。汝当遍行四方，寻陷于邪途之村民。途中，见白衣红十字僧侣，见孤居草庐之女巫，见藏有隐秘之帮员。汝当逼问其所需之识。对这些迷途之魂，毋须怜悯，亦勿手软。”
I must be truthful. Your skills in healing match my own. There is nothing I can teach you. Perhaps someone in another city has greater skill, and a willingness to accomodate students."
column2: “吾不得不直言：汝之医术与吾相当。吾无可授。或许他城有人术更高，且乐于授徒。”

column1: I need help preparing this ... meal, he sighs. "Can I count on you?"
column2: “吾烹此膳，亟需相助，”他叹息道，“汝可援手否？”

column1: I need help preparing this ... meal, he sighs. "Can I count on you?" You reply...
column2: “吾烹此膳，亟需相助，”他叹息道，“汝可援手否？”汝答……

column1: I offer you each wealth, strength, endurance, skill, intelligence, goods, agility, and the good will of all mankind. Then I'll keep working on my plots to end the world. You could, I suppose, return here someday to fight me again.
column2: “吾赐汝财富、力量、耐力、技艺、智识、器物、敏捷，以及万民之善念。此后，吾仍将继续筹划终结世界之策。汝或可某日重返，再与吾争锋。”

column1: I pray for your safe journey, says the monk in farewell.
column2: “祝汝一路平安，”僧人临别道。

column1: I regret to say that the poor abbess sometimes has an extravagent sense of charity, he explains. "This convent can barely afford to buy food in the market, much less dressings for your wounds. Please help us to help you by contributing $Money1 toward our holy tasks."
column2: “遗憾的是，贫苦修女有时过于慷慨，”他解释道，“此修院几难购粮，更遑论疗伤之敷料。请施以$Money1，助吾等济汝。”

column1:
I represent the $VarString1, rightful lord of this city. Soon he will return and reclaim his birthright. We must prepare the ground for this triumphant return.	“吾代表$VarString1，此城之正统君主。不久，他将归来，重掌王权。吾等须为此凯旋做好准备。”
I see a place between here and there, with sevenfold paths not of this world. I see the demon feast, the ravaged land, poisoned and burning seas, a curse of darkness, and Hell's horsemen.
column2: “吾见此间彼处之间，有一处七重天路，非世间所有。吾见恶魔盛宴、满目疮痍之地、毒焰滔滔之海、黑暗之咒，以及地狱之骑卒。”

column1:
I see a witch's hut. I see monks of a proscribed and evil order. I see devil-worshippers in villages, among city guilds, and in decadent monasteries.	我见女巫之屋。我见被禁且邪恶教团之修士。我见村寨、城邑公会及颓废修院中的恶魔崇拜者。
I see an ancient monastery, with monks whose death-white robes are stained with a bloody red cross. I see them practicing bestial rites and worshipping demons. I see within this place one of the Great Seals."
column2: 我见古修院，其死白法衣染血红十字。我见彼等行兽性之礼，拜魔鬼。我见此地藏有大封印之一。

column1: I see little of the old observances here, $he reports, "but neither are the monks evil nor especially cruel. They are taskmasters and businessmen, running this as a business. But even so, I see a library, a few studious copiests, and a small chapel for services."
column2: “此处旧规已鲜见，”你 报道，“然修士既非恶徒，亦不甚残暴。彼等督工经商，视此为业。虽如此，我仍见藏书楼、数名勤勉抄经者，以及一处小堂作礼。”

column1: I see none of the old observances here, $he reports, "just fat, rich men idling away their time, while the novices are taskmasters to the peasants here in the fields."
column2: “此处不见旧规，”你 报道，“唯肥硕富人闲度光阴，而学徒则役使田间农夫。”

column1: I see nothing wrong or dangerous here, $he says. "Of course, there is fear and concern, but only of outside dangers. I believe all is well."
column2: “此处并无不妥或危险，”你 言。“诚然，人心惶惶，然所惧者皆外患。吾以为一切安好。”

column1:
I see the apocalypse of Revelations behind the Great Seals. Satan's visage lies there. I see heroes, standard-bearers of light, passing between broken seals, aiming themselves at the heart of darkness.	我见大封印之后，启示录之末日。撒旦之容隐于其间。我见英雄，光明之旗手，穿破残封，直指黑暗之心。
I seen a fit once," says he. "It were real amusing."
column2: “我曾见癫疾发作，”彼曰，“实为趣事。”

column1: I sense someone up ahead, $he whispers. You decide to...
column2: “前方有人气，”你 低语。尔决意……

column1: I sense you are the answer to our prayers, she whispers. "In one hour I will leave the postern door unlocked, so you can enter and do God's work."
column2: “我觉汝乃我等祷告之应，”彼女低语。“一小时后，我将暗门留开，汝可入内，行上帝之事。”

column1: I suggest, he says carefully, "that you seek the aid of the physician who resides in the guild district. He is a more practical man, one less inclined to consider your reputation or holiness."
column2: “吾建议，”彼谨慎言，“汝宜求助于居于公会区之医师。彼务实，不拘名誉与圣洁。”

column1: I suppose the cantor can add a few lines to the next Mass, he says. "This monk will take you there."
column2: “或可令唱诗班于下一次弥撒添数句，”彼曰，“此僧将引汝前往。”

column1: I suspected as much! he bellows. "These are the unbelievers! I give you all this task: slay them!"
column2: “吾早有所疑！”彼怒吼，“此辈乃不信之人！今命汝等：诛之！”

column1:
I swear I never dreamed the monster could wreak so much woe. I feel sorrow at my former egoism and wish to make amends.	“吾发誓，未曾料巨怪能致如此灾祸。吾悔昔日自负，愿以善行赎罪。”
I think someone, or something, is hidden up ahead," $he whispers.
column2: “前方似有隐者，”你 低语。

column1: I think this is an ambush.
column2: “此乃伏击。”

column1: I think we should go back and investigate that manor, says $ChosenOneName, "I have this funny feeling that it is important to us."
column2: “吾议回访那座庄园，”$ChosenOneName 言，“吾心隐隐觉其与我等攸关。”

column1: I think we should postpone this attempt, $NamedOneName says. "Clearly, now is not the time."
column2: “吾议暂缓此举，”$NamedOneName 言，“显然，时机未至。”

column1: I think you boys are lost, $ChosenOneName remarks.
column2: “汝等迷途矣，”$ChosenOneName 评。

column1: I think you recognize this, says $NamedOneName. "Many have asked about this, but it is reserved as a special reward."
column2: “汝当识此物，”$NamedOneName 言，“多有问津，然此乃特赏，专为殊荣而设。”

column1: I think you should learn more about the value of certain objects, he states. "However, it disposes me to think better of your earlier arguments."
column2: “汝宜详知诸物之价值，”彼云，“此亦令吾更信汝前言。”

column1: I thought only of the glory I could receive as a dragon's slayer. To help the crazed priest, I dug a tunnel into Worm's Hill. $NamedThreeName crept inside as I waited outside with archers.
column2: “吾惟思屠龙之功名。为助狂僧，吾掘虫丘之隧。$NamedThreeName 入内，吾携弓手守候于外。”

column1: I try to be fair, just and Christian, he says, "I pray neither God nor Saint Wenceslaus will forsake us."
column2: “吾力求公正、仁慈、虔诚，”彼言，“祈上帝与圣瓦茨拉夫勿弃我等。”

column1: I urge you to leave the city now. The $CityLordTitle will be most wroth, and will certainly have writs against you.
column2: “吾劝汝即刻离城。$CityLordTitle 必怒不可遏，且必有通缉文书追捕汝等。”

column1: I will give $ChosenThreeName a copy of $Text2, a most illustrious formula, in exchange for one of yours.
column2: “吾将以 $Text2——一则显赫秘方——换汝之一物，赠予 $ChosenThreeName。”

column1: I'd like to believe you are sincere. However, I regret to say that your manner and style are not convincing. In this cause, I cannot afford to take any chances. My men will escort you out.
column2: “吾愿信汝之诚，然惜汝举止文风难服人。此事不容轻忽，吾军将护送汝出城。”

column1: I'll try to settle down here for a bit, $he says, "but you never know. I might find the settled life boring after a while. Stop in whenever you're visiting!"
column2: “吾拟暂居于此，”你 言，“然世事难料，久居或生厌。汝若来访，不妨一叙。”

column1: I'm afraid my prayers have no effect, $he shouts to you.
column2: “恐吾祷告无验，”你 呼汝。

column1: I'm am sorry to go, but you have not fulfilled my expectations. Despite repeated pleas, recently you have done nothing to advance our mutual cause.
column2: “吾愧离去，汝未如吾所期。屡次恳求，汝近来竟无所作为，无助于吾等共业。”

column1: I'm blind! cries one.
column2: “我瞎了！”一人惊呼。

column1: I'm blind! screams one attacker, staggering into a tree. Another moans in panic.
column2: “吾盲矣！”一袭击者踉跄撞树，哀嚎不已。另一惊恐呻吟。

column1: I'm blinded! screams a guard, while others moan and cry. Quickly you dash through the confusion. You're past the portal when you hear, "Ho - wizardry at the Gate! Sound the Alarm!" But it's too late. You're already moving quickly down an alley into the city.
column2: “吾盲矣！”一卫士尖叫，余众哀号哭泣。汝趁乱疾驰，甫越门户，便闻：“嘿——城门有巫术！鸣警！”然为时已晚，汝已沿巷疾入城中。

column1: I'm blinded! screams a guard, while others moan and cry. Quickly you dash through the confusion. You're past the portal when you hear, "Ho -- wizardry at the gate! Sound the alarm!" But it's too late. You're already moving quickly down an alley into the city.
column2: “吾盲矣！”一卫士尖叫，余众哀号哭泣。汝趁乱疾驰，甫越门户，便闻：“嘿——城门有巫术！鸣警！”然为时已晚，汝已沿巷疾入城中。

column1: I'm going, I'm going, $ChosenOneName replies, as $he painfully limps back into the shadows where the rest of you wait.
column2: “吾去矣，吾去矣，”$ChosenOneName 回答，而你 痛楚跛行，退回汝等潜伏之处。

column1: I'm not sure they're all alive, a Templar complains.
column2: “吾不确其皆存，”一名圣殿骑士抱怨。

column1: I'm sorry, but I don't take students. Illustrious men pay large sums for my counsel, while my staff of surgeons attends to the details. I already have $Number1 apprentices, each University educated, learning as they work for me.
column2: “抱歉，吾不收徒。显贵付重金求教，吾外科团队专司细节。吾已有 $Number1 弟子，皆受大学教育，在职习艺。”

column1: I'm sorry, reverend sirs, but the league offices are closed to today. Allow me to escort you back to the marketplace. A squad of guards surrounds you, ready to enforce his polite request.
column2: “抱歉，尊长，联盟办事处今日闭门。容吾护送诸位返市集。”一队卫兵环伺，以示其礼貌之请。

column1: I'm sorry, he says "but $PlaceName needs every possible fighter in its defense. My orders are to send out only useless mouths, not strong arms."
column2: “抱歉，”彼言，“但 $PlaceName 防务亟需每一名战士。吾奉命只遣无用之口，而非壮士之手。”

column1: I'm sorry, she says, halting you, "the rest I must leave in your hands. A magus such as I cannot carry the banner of virtue into battle against the fallen angel. Only true heroes can do so.
column2: “抱歉，”她止住汝，“余事只得托付于汝。如我之术士，难携美德之旗，与堕天使交锋。唯真英雄方能为之。”

column1: I'm sure heroes like you will be staying to help $PlaceName in its time of need, he says. "No need to support me here, I've got plenty of troops to keep things secure."
column2: “吾信英雄如汝，必留助 $PlaceName 于危难之时，”彼言，“毋须在此相助，吾自有大军足以维稳。”

column1: I've been watching you, he whispers hoarsely. "I think you're up to something! Don't think you can get away with it!" You...
column2: “吾久窥汝等，”彼沙哑低语，“汝必有所图！休想瞒过吾！”汝……

column1: If you are still feeling poorly, you may find it wise to take a room at the local inn, to rest and regain your strength.
column2: “若汝仍感不适，宜于当地旅舍暂住，休养恢复。”

column1: If you can't do more to promote our mutual aims, $he says, "I will consider myself released from our arrangement and go elsewhere."
column2: “若汝不能更促吾等共业，”你 言，“吾将视为解除约定，另觅他途。”

column1: If you'd been in tournament armor, like me, you wouldn't have avoided that hit. You all concede the point, which makes the knight feel much better about losing.
column2: “若汝身披战甲，如吾一般，便不会挨那一击。”汝等皆认输，骑士因此稍释败绩之憾。

column1: In a private war (feud), anyone not an ally is the enemy, replies their leader. "But we still follow the codes. Surrendered prisoners are paroled, not slain. You are free to go now, provided you swear not to take up arms against us until this war is done."
column2: “私战中，非盟友皆为敌，”其首领答，“然吾等仍遵规矩。投降者获释，非杀戮。汝可自由离去，但须立誓，直至战毕，不再举兵相向。”

column1: In fact, she confides, "he is extremely wroth. I advise you to not bother him for a least a few days."
column2: “实则，”彼坦言，“彼怒不可遏。吾劝汝至少数日勿扰。”

column1: In penance, I fine you all your wordly goods and wealth! Let this be a lesson to you!
column2: “为赎罪，吾罚没汝等所有世俗财物！以此为戒！”

column1: In the name of the $CityLordTitle and the $CityLordName, I am hear to arrest this list of persons for conspiracy and treason against us all!
column2: “谨以 $CityLordTitle 与 $CityLordName 之名，逮捕此名单上诸人，罪名：密谋叛国，危害吾等全体！”

column1: In this dangerous land, a monk-overseer explains, "we must guard our serfs from attack. Please go to the gate, where you can be properly received."
column2: “此地险恶，”一修士监工解说道，“吾等须护佃农免遭侵袭。请往城门，彼处可妥善接待汝等。”

column1: Insolent scum! We have no use for surly weaklings without weapon skills. Begone.
column2: “无礼贱民！吾等无需无武技之顽劣懦夫。速退！”

column1: Intruders, enemies! yells the guard, suddenly awake. In seconds the kidnappers are leaping for you with naked steel.
column2: “入侵者，敌人！”卫士骤然惊醒，厉声喝道。顷刻之间，绑匪持利刃扑向汝等。

column1: Intruders, the gate! shouts a guard atop the battlements.
column2: “入侵者，城门！”守卒于垛口高呼。

column1: It certainly is, he responds, letting you through at spearpoint while he pockets your coins. "Now be off with you before my sergeant comes!" You quickly nod and trot down a gloomy side street.
column2: “确是如此，”他答道，用长矛逼你通过，同时将你的钱币收入囊中。“快走吧，免得我的军曹赶来！”你连忙点头，小跑进一条阴暗的小巷。

column1: It is for this that we have come!
column2: “我们正是为此而来！”

column1: It is now time for our good Reinhard to begin the feast! the cook cries, and the throng cheers. The innocents, brawling in terror, are brought forth.
column2: “如今该让我们的雷因哈德开宴了！”厨子高呼，众人欢呼。那些无辜者在恐惧中喧闹着被押了上来。

column1: It is time we showed them what to believe. By acting now we end all confusion, all delay. Now is the time to strike!
column2: “是时候让他们明白该信什么了。此刻行动，便能终结一切混乱与拖延。现在正是出手之时！”

column1: It pains me, says $ChosenOneName, "but in our situation, anything but discretion would be pure folly. Still, this is not a virtuous act."
column2: “我甚感痛心，”$ChosenOneName说道，“但在眼下情形下，若不谨慎行事，便是愚不可及。然此非善举。”

column1: It's all in how you do it, explains $ChosenOneName, chuckling.
column2: “关键在于如何为之，”$ChosenOneName笑着解释道。

column1: It's an ambush, $he explains to the rest of you. You decide to...
column2: “这是伏击，”你向你们其余人说明。你们决定……

column1: It's magic, it's devilish, it's -- the friar protests, sputtering, but already his followers are shaking their heads and leaving.
column2: “这是魔法，这是妖邪，这是——”修士结结巴巴地抗议，但他的信徒们已摇头离去。

column1: Just a little joke, you remark, "but next time, we'll get serious. Make sure there isn't a next time."
column2: “不过是小小的玩笑罢了，”你说道，“不过下次我们就当真了。务必确保不会有下次。”

column1: Just desserts for unbelievers. Their goods are forfeit to the Church for attacking men of peace, such as ourselves.
column2: “不信者的应得之报。他们因袭击我等和平之人，其财物已被教会没收。”

column1: Klaus is always with us.
column2: “Klaus常伴吾侧。”

column1: Knaves, wretches, untrustworthy dogs! Take your traitorous smell away before I put an end to it with cold steel!
column2: “无赖、恶徒、不可靠的狗！把你们那叛逆的臭味带走，否则我就用冷刃了断它！”

column1: Leave it at the door and walk back twenty paces in plain sight, he instructs, "perchance while examining this find, I might leave the door ajar for a few minutes."
column2: “把东西留在门口，然后在众目睽睽之下后退二十步，”他吩咐道，“或许我在查验这件发现时，会把门虚掩几分钟。”

column1: Leave this land if you wish to continue living, $ChosenOneName says. They swear to do so this instant, and immediately flee.
column2: “若想活命，就离开此地吧，”$ChosenOneName 说道。他们当即发誓照办，旋即逃遁。

column1: Let me explain... replies $NamedOneName.
