column2: “一颅常谎，一颅恒真。克鲁萨德可说真亦可言伪。答案或有多种。按不可为克鲁萨德之颅，门乃得开。”

column1:
One statue always lies, one speaks only truth and the third speaks both truth and lies. Multiple solutions are possible.	“一像恒妄，一像惟真，第三像真假兼陈。解或多重。”
Only one knob opens the door. Each metal's statements are either both true or both false."
column2: “唯有一钮可开此门。各金属之言，或皆真，或俱伪。”

column1: Open in the name of the $CityLordTitle and the $CityLordName! they shout, clearly intending to arrest $NamedOneName.
column2: “奉$CityLordTitle与$CityLordName之名，开门！”他们 shout，显然意图逮捕$NamedOneName。

column1: Our Master of Novices has few charges at the moment. He can provide instruction in certain scholarly pursuits for deserving persons, perhaps including some of you.
column2: “本堂初学导师眼下无事。凡有德者，皆可授以学问，诸君或在其列。”

column1: Our cause cannot fail, says a deep voice. "Even now our agents are spreading throughout the country, sowing dissent and encouraging satanic worship. You have nothing to fear by joining us, and much to lose if you resist."
column2: “吾等大业必成，”深沉之声曰，“今吾等密使遍行天下，播散离间，鼓吹撒旦崇拜。入吾辈，无所惧；抗吾辈，所失多矣。”

column1: Our friend Klaus is ill! continues the robed fellow. "Join us!" You see no way to refuse without arousing suspicion.
column2: “吾友克劳斯病矣！”袍服之人续道，“加入吾侪！”若拒，恐生疑忌。

column1: Our livelihood is ruined by the robber knight, $NamedTwoName. He stops our wagons to steal the horses. Then he steals the best goods and leaves the rest scattered in the mud. If we are poor, he tortures us in anger. If we are rich, he kidnaps us for ransom. Save us.
column2: “吾等生计尽毁于劫匪骑士，$NamedTwoName。彼拦车夺马，掠良弃余于泥泞。贫则虐之，富则掳以索赎。救吾等。”

column1: Our most sincere apologies, kind sir. You give him $Money1 and a good excuse, which stops him from calling the guard, but doesn't erase the awful stink in your clothes.
column2: “诚挚歉意，阁下。”汝予$Money1并善辞，虽止其召卫，却难去衣上恶臭。

column1: Our saviors! they cry, as the guildmaster himself comes out and shakes your hand, placing a half-florin piece in it as he speaks. He says his political views have changed. Now the guild members $Support changes in the city government.
column2: “吾等救星！”众人 cry，公会首脑亲出握手，并于言时置半弗罗林于汝掌。谓其政见已变，今公会成员 $Support 倡市府变革。

column1: Our thanks, strangers, for stopping these scum. We are finally free of their robberies and beatings!
column2: “谢尔诸客，止此败类。终脱其劫掠殴打！”

column1: Paupers! What a paltry sum! You should know better than to bribe a gateman. Nearby guards begin laughing, too. Your ears burn as you hear, "Yeah, ol' Hans here doesn't come cheap!" and "Here in $PlaceName, manure costs more than that." To reinforce the point, they throw a couple of clots on your heads!
column2: “贫民！何等微薄！岂不知贿赂守门人乎？”旁卫亦笑。汝耳闻“老汉斯岂是便宜货！”“此处$PlaceName，粪肥尚贵于此。”更掷粪团于汝顶，以示嘲讽！

column1: People like me compass land and sea to gather ingredients. We depend on safe travel in our profession. We are gravely threatened by the robber knight $NamedTwoName. He burns our wagons, steals precious ingredients meant for potions, then tortures us to learn our secrets. Can you stop him?
column2: “吾辈跋山涉水，采药为生。旅安系吾业命脉。今受劫匪骑士$NamedTwoName之害。彼焚吾车，窃珍贵药材，复拷问以探秘。能除之否？”

column1: People of $PlaceName, he shouts, "you have been unfairly swayed by the villains hanging above me. Disperse to your homes or forfeit your citizenship!"
column2: “$PlaceName子民，”他 shout，“汝已被悬于吾上之恶徒所惑。速归家，否则褫籍！”

column1: Perfect! he mutters. "The workmanship is exquisite! Thank you again for your help!" Smiling, he excuses himself and begins to read. You bow and depart.
column2: “甚佳！”他 murmur，“工艺精绝！再谢相助！”微笑告退，自阅文书。汝鞠躬而去。

column1: Please accept this key to the city as a token of our esteem, and this Rhinegeld as a more material reward. He hands you a ceremonial key to $PlaceName and a small chest containing $Money1.
column2: “请纳此钥，表敬意；此莱茵税，则酬以实物。”他递汝$PlaceName之礼钥及盛$Money1之小箱。

column1: Please rest here, the monk tells you, "I will send for the abbess of the convent." You lean back under the portico and rest, feeling safe at last.
column2: “请憩于此，”僧侣曰，“吾即遣修女院长来迎。”汝倚廊下，终感安稳。

column1: Please, accept this small gift as a token of my gratitude, the captain says, handing you a gold florin. Bowing, you accept it.
column2: “请纳此薄礼，表谢忱，”舰长曰，并赠金弗罗林。汝鞠躬受之。

column1: Please, he offers, "let us converse in my private office."
column2: “请移步吾私室，”他 offer。

column1: Priceless and princely, he keeps repeating.
column2: “无价且尊贵，”他反复称道。

column1: Professionals, remarks $ChosenOneName. "Our employer has some tough enemies!"
column2: “专业人士，”$ChosenOneName remark，“吾雇主敌手颇强！”

column1:
Protect yourself with the Coals of St. Charity, the Shield or Helm of St. George, the Torture of St. Lawrence, or St. Lucy's Eye.	“以圣慈之炭、圣乔治之盾或头盔、圣劳伦斯之酷刑、圣露西之眼，自护身。”
Prove yourself friend or foe," growls their leader as his men spread out to surround you. In response, you...
column2: “辨尔友仇，”首领 growl，麾下四散围汝。汝应之……

column1: Prove yourself friend or foe, growls their leader. In response, you...
column2: “辨尔友仇，”首领 growl。汝应之……

column1: Psst, Ruta...

Quick, trouble at the $Inn, the watchman pants. "We need all the help we can get." The guards race off, followed by the cleaning lady, who is no doubt indulging her curiosity. In minutes the $marketplace is empty.
column2: “快，$Inn有警！”守望者 pant，“亟需援手。”卫卒疾驰，清洁妇亦随往，显好奇心。顷刻间，$marketplace空无一人。

column1: Rest well in our care, brave warriors, he says. You wonder if he is sincere.
column2: “勇士安息于吾庇，”他说。汝疑其诚。

column1: Retrieve for me the $ItemName from the $MapLocation. You will find it at the $LocName, near $NearestCity. I would value this even more than our greatest relic.
column2: “为我取回$ItemName，自$MapLocation。其在$LocName，近$NearestCity。此物胜吾最珍圣物。”

column1: Reverence! he exclaims to the abbot, "our champions are here!"
column2: “敬礼！”他对方丈 exclaim，“吾等英豪至矣！”

column1: Right! If anybody proves it, he's stripped of everything and must return to the fields, or worse.
column2: “正也！若有证其伪，即褫所有，返田间，或更甚。”

column1: Run rabbits run! You're no match for us!
column2: “兔奔兔奔！汝非吾敌！”

column1: Run rabbits, run! You're no match for us!
column2: “兔奔，兔奔！汝非吾敌！”

column1: Run, you rabbits and traitors! Stay here in $PlaceName and you'll taste our honest steel!
column2: “逃吧，兔与叛徒！留于$PlaceName，尝吾钢锋！”

column1: Schrats, says $ChosenOneName, "unpredictable and often violent forest creatures. However, they are easily charmed by beautiful women."
column2: “施拉茨，”$ChosenOneName曰，“林中异兽，性情难测，常暴戾。然易为美姝所魅。”

column1: Sergeant, escort these misguided souls to the border, the lord commands. As if under a spell, you meekly follow the sergeant. Finally it dawns: the lord's invocation of Saint Genevieve worked this miracle.
column2: “军曹，押送此迷途之魂至边境，”领主 command。如被魇术，汝顺从军曹。终悟：领主祈圣热内维耶夫，竟成此奇效。

column1: Sergeant, escort these misguided souls to the border, the lord commands. As if under a spell, you meekly follow the sergeant. Finally you understand: the lord's invocation of Saint Godfrey worked this miracle.
column2: “军曹，押送此迷途之魂至边境，”领主 command。如被魇术，汝顺从军曹。终悟：领主祈圣戈弗雷，竟成此奇效。

column1: Should you be interested, know that $NamedOneName's evil tower is $Direction from here, $Direction2 of $NearestCity. I can think of no better deed than removing $NamedOneName from the world of the living. Certainly a warm spot must be reserved for him in Hell.
column2: “你若有意，须知 $NamedOneName 的邪恶高塔就在离此 $Direction、距 $NearestCity $Direction2 之处。我想不出比将 $NamedOneName 从活人世界铲除更好的义举了。地狱里必定已为他留了一个热腾腾的位置。”

column1: Shut them up, snarls their leader, "with cold steel!"
column2: “以冷刃封口！”首领 snarl。

column1: Sir, please, we should move now. It's the perfect time to strike.
column2: “大人，请，我们该行动了。正是出击的良机。”

column1: Sirs! A company of knights from the countryside has come to relieve the fortress and rescue the $CityLordName. What should we do? $NamedOneName looks to you, so you...
column2: “诸君！乡间骑士来替防，救$CityLordName。奈何？”$NamedOneName望汝，汝遂……

column1: Sirs! The rebel leaders have been arrested, she breathlessly relates, "but their supporters threaten to rescue them. Your help is needed immediately!"
column2: “诸君！叛首已擒，”她 breathlessly relay，“然其党羽欲劫之。亟需相助！”

column1: Sirs! The revolution has started! she says excitedly. "$NamedOneName asks you to come and help."
column2: “诸君！革命已起！”她 excitedly 说。“$NamedOneName邀尔助阵。”

column1: Sirs, most regrettably, I fear that we have no room.
column2: “诸君，遗憾至极，恐无容身之地。”

column1: Sirs, she squeaks, "your mission remains uncompleted. My master does not wish to be disturbed by you until there is a success to report."
column2: “诸位大人，”她尖声说道，“你的使命尚未完成。我家主人不愿在你有所斩获之前被打扰。”

column1: Sit here and pray during the next mass. The cantor will add one prayer for you.
column2: “下一次弥撒时，请在此祈祷。唱诗班会为你多加一祷。”

column1: Slay them! Slay them all! he exhorts his remaining men.
column2: “杀光他们！统统杀光！”他向残余的部下疾呼。

column1: So what, remarks another. "Their blood is still warm, and that's what counts."
column2: “那又如何？”另一人冷笑道，“他们的血还热着呢，这才是要紧的。”

column1: So, you've got the mob controlled? asks the jailor.
column2: 那么，你把这群暴民控制住了吗？狱卒问道。

column1: Somebody ought to do something...
column2: “总该有人做点什么……”

column1:
Soon, when our support is strongest, we all will march on $VarString1, the $VarString2, to create a new, more representative government.	“不久之后，待我方势力最盛之时，我们必将齐赴$VarString1，攻陷$VarString2，建立一个更为民主的新政权。”
Sorry, guys, you've got the wrong crowd." Using your street smarts, you explain to them that you're really secret agents, working for the "enemy" to uncover his plans. You draw them into conversation, ask some questions, and use their answers to convince them of your story.
column2: “抱歉，诸位，你们找错人了。”你凭借街头智慧，向他们解释自己实为密探，奉“敌方”之命刺探其图谋。你引他们入彀，问以数语，借其答覆自圆其说。

column1: Spare me the sermon, says $NamedOneName. "Yet I see the wisdom in your words. I shall not oppose you again."
column2: “免去说教吧，”$NamedOneName道，“然汝言亦有理。我再不与汝相抗。”

column1: Stop those words! cries the knight, and he and his men step forward, holding each of you. Sudden inspiration takes the party, and as one being you all wriggle free of your cloaks and race out through the now-open door. The guards are so dumfounded that they do not pursue until you are long gone.
column2: “住口！”骑士怒喝，率众上前，将你们一一擒住。众人灵机一动，脱下斗篷，乘隙奔出敞门。守卫惊愕不已，待回神时，你们早已远遁。

column1: Stop, thieves! cries the woman at the window, pointing to you. You dash around a corner, hoping you can't be identified.
column2: “站住，贼子！”窗边妇人指着你们喊道。你们拐过街角，唯盼无人认出。

column1: Strife is all about us here, says the boldest. "Our lord strives for peace, but it is very difficult."
column2: “纷争四伏于此，”最勇者言，“吾主虽求和平，却难如登天。”

column1: Submit your weapons to us, barks the leader. "You cannot hope to escape." You...
column2: “缴械投降！”首领厉声道，“休想逃脱。”你们……

column1: Suddenly I could breathe down there, $he says, "I swam to a solid spot and crawled upwards. Here I am. Quite a miracle, eh?" $He feels around and notices a few items missing, then shrugs. "Well, alive is alive. Thank you, Lord!"
column2: “忽觉身下可呼吸，”你道，“遂游至坚实处，攀爬而出。如今安然无恙，岂非奇迹？”你摸索一番，发现遗失数物，却耸肩一笑：“活着就好。谢主恩典！”

column1: Take your friend and get out of town, he says, not unkindly. "I will find a way to explain to the magistrate."
column2: “携友离城吧，”他和蔼道，“我会设法向官府交代。”

column1: Take your leave now, and receive these at our door.
column2: “即刻告辞，并于门前领取此物。”

column1: Tatzelwurm, says $ChosenOneName in awe. "We're lucky the potion drove them away. They're fast and deadly!"
column2: “塔策尔蠕虫，”$ChosenOneName惊叹道，“幸亏药剂驱散了它们。此物迅捷且致命！”

column1: Tatzelwurm, says $ChosenOneName. "They're fast, dangerous lizard-snakes. Some say they are poisonous and solitary, but I've seen them in packs."
column2: “塔策尔蠕虫，”$ChosenOneName言，“乃迅疾凶险之蜥蛇。或谓其有毒且独居，然我曾见其群聚。”

column1: Thank you for your bravery. I will inform other Medici representatives that we can rely on you. They may have other interesting tasks for you from time to time, should you be interested.
column2: “感谢阁下的英勇。我将告知其他美第奇使者，贵方值得信赖。若有新任务，或可再托付于君。”

column1: Thank you for your kind donation to our mother church. Many good works will now be possible.
column2: “感谢贵方对本堂之善举。诸多善事自此得以施行。”

column1: Thank you for your largess, kind sirs, smirks the bandit leader as he disappears into the brush.
column2: “承蒙慷慨，诸位仁兄，”匪首含笑隐入林间。

column1: Thank you for your largess, kind sirs, smirks their leader as he disappears into the brush.
column2: “承蒙慷慨，诸位仁兄，”匪首含笑隐入林间。

column1: Thanks to you, my family still has a leader, my wife a husband. Another merchant gives you a $NamedOneName.
column2: “多亏诸位，家有主，妻有夫。”另一商贾赠予你一枚$NamedOneName。

column1: Thanks, he chuckles, "now we'll take the rest!" He and his men charge forward, swinging their weapons.
column2: “多谢，”他笑道，“剩下的归我了！”他率众挥刃冲上。

column1:
That evil robber knight, $NamedTwoName, makes it hard for people -- my customers -- to visit $PlaceName. Sometimes he takes their money, sometimes their lives. Even regular visitors, from nearby villages, no longer come here.	“恶名昭彰之盗骑$NamedTwoName，令百姓——我的顾客——难以来往$PlaceName。有时夺财，有时取命。连邻村常客亦不再造访。”
That is the Devil's Bridge," he replies. "Here at the narrows, wooden bridges wash away when the river rises. Yet we have no money nor skill to make a stone bridge. Twenty years ago, the village elders sought to fix this problem. They used their lore to summon a devil."
column2: “那是魔鬼桥，”他答道，“此处河道狭窄，木桥每逢涨水便被冲毁。然我等既乏资亦无技，难建石桥。二十年前，村中长老欲解此困，遂施法召来恶魔。”

column1: That was Saint Dismas himself! whispers $ChosenTwoName.
column2: “那是圣迪斯马斯本人！”$ChosenTwoName低语。

column1: That was a close call, pants $ChosenOneName on the hilltop. "These tidal marshes are more dangerous than we thought!"
column2: “好险！”$ChosenOneName喘息于山顶，“这些潮汐沼泽比想象中更险恶！”

column1: That was a close call, pants $ChosenOneName. "These tidal marshes are more dangerous than we thought!"
column2: “好险！”$ChosenOneName喘息，“这些潮汐沼泽比想象中更险恶！”

column1: That was a heroic stand, he says, clapping you on the back. "Without your loyal support, we would have been surrounded. But together we put taught those traitors a sharp lesson."
column2: “此役堪称壮举，”他拍肩赞道，“若无诸位忠心辅佐，我军必遭围困。然众人同心，终令叛徒尝到苦果。”

column1: That's for the magistrate to decide, the night watch sergeant replies. But from his wink and tone, you see he agrees with the turnkey.
column2: “此事自有法官裁断，”夜巡士长答道，然其眨眼与语气已表赞同。

column1: That's illegal. You can get branded and exiled, at least!
column2: “此举违法。轻则烙印，重则流放！”

column1: That's it! $he exclaims, and you carefully get it down. Flushed with success, you all leave the cave and reorient yourselves.
column2: “成了！”你惊呼，众人小心翼翼将其取出。喜获成功，遂离洞，重新辨明方位。

column1: That's right, my child, pray, pray for forgiveness, the friar says. "The saints will say that a true pardon is possible with my indulgence."
column2: “不错，孩子，祈求宽恕吧，”修士道，“凭吾之赦免，圣徒亦可赐真赦。”

column1: The $CityLordTitle should do something about this! is the common feeling. Some people have heard rumors of rewards posted by merchants. Others think the Church should take a hand.
column2: “$CityLordTitle该管管这事了！”众皆如此认为。有人闻商家悬赏，亦有人以为教会应出手。

column1: The Apocalypse is forming. She sinks back into her chair, dismissing you with a wave of her hand. Suddenly she seems very old and haggard.
column2: “末日将至。”她颓然坐回椅中，挥手示意退下。转瞬之间，她显得苍老憔悴。

column1: The Lord protects us, you say to them. "Would you care to wait for what comes next?" Since your bonds have burned away, you can now step out of the fire.
column2: “主佑我等，”你对他们道，“可愿静候后续？”火绳已燃尽，你们得以走出烈焰。

column1: The abbess is a kindly woman, he explains, "and it is my duty to protect her from folly. You may rest here for the rest of the day and tonight, receiving food, beds, and care for your wounds. However, I must ask that you contribute $Money1 toward our holy tasks."
column2: “修女院长慈祥贤淑，”他解释道，“护其免于妄行，乃吾之责。诸位可在此安歇一日一夜，食宿并疗伤。然请捐助$Money1，以助圣务。”

column1: The alchemical and herbal arts can once again prosper here in $PlaceName. Your names will be remembered, here and throughout the land.
column2: “炼金与草药之术，今得于$PlaceName再兴。诸位之名，将永载史册。”

column1: The contract is void! We demand $ChosenTwoName's soul back!
column2: “契约无效！我等索回$ChosenTwoName之魂！”

column1: The dangerous part will be getting the ringleaders back here to $VarString5. Despite a strong escort by the city guard, we must beware of confused citizens who might try to 'rescue' these scum. Therefore, I count on all of you to help capture and guard these prisoners.
column2: “最难之处，在于押解首犯返抵$VarString5。纵有城卫严护，仍须防备误信‘救人’之愚民。故望诸位协力擒拿并看守囚徒。”

column1: The darkness of this Sabbat conceals a shadowy force of heretics thought to be dead. At this unholy ceremony I see tests to your virtue and courage.
column2: “此萨巴特之夜暗藏一股似已消亡之异端邪力。此不洁仪式考验诸位之德与勇。”

column1: The dragon has been feasting for weeks. If you can prevent it from eating many more maidens, it will become LESS hungry! When it returns to its lair to sleep, we can trap it. Go, rescue maidens and return!
column2: “巨龙已饱食数周。若能阻止其再食少女，则其饥饿程度将减轻！待其归巢沉睡，便可设陷阱捕之。速去救女，速回！”

column1: The experiments within are very dangerous, one monk explains. "Only those familiar with the Noble Art are safe. You, as visitors, might unwittingly do or say something that conjured forth a demon, or worse."
column2: “其中实验甚为危险，”一僧解释道，“惟精通秘术者方可无虞。诸位来访者，或无意间招致恶魔，甚至更甚。”

column1: The government appreciates your efforts, says the sergeant. "However, next time we must let you stand trial. But right now, you escaped from us!"
column2: “政府感念诸位之功，”士长道，“然下次须依法审判。今次，汝等侥幸脱身。”

column1: The merchants of $PlaceName have combined to acquire this relic, $NamedOneName, as a reward to whomever can perform a service that is vital to us all. We agree that anyone who succeeds in our mission will certainly be deserving of it.
column2: “$PlaceName诸商联合购得此圣物$NamedOneName，以酬劳凡能成就利我之事者。凡克此任者，皆当之无愧。”

column1: The merchants of $PlaceName have combined to acquire this relic, $NamedOneName, as a reward to whomever can perform a service that is vital to us all. We agree that anyone who succeeds in our mission will prove himself deserving of $NamedOneName.

column1: We must consider this. Quickly you step around a corner and disappear down a side street. You avoid paying damages, but are now wanted fugitives in $PlaceName.
column2: “此事须斟酌。”你迅速拐过街角，隐入侧巷。虽免于赔偿，却成了$PlaceName通缉的逃犯。

column1: We must move now! The time will never be better! You hear sounds like somebody pounding on the table.
column2: “此刻非动不可！良机难再！”你听见有人拍案之声。

column1: We need to be careful, says $ChosenOneName, "an army this big is sure to have scouts and outriders. To them, we'd seem like enemy scouts!"
column2: “务必谨慎。”$ChosenOneName道，“如此大军，必有斥候与前哨。在彼等眼中，吾等不过敌方斥候！”

column1: We pray daily for deliverance. whispers a bold one. "Our lord, in the keep, is fey and dangerous. One week we must all celebrate a strange feast, then on the next, someone's carcass is hanging from the walls for a trivial offense."
column2: “吾等日日祈求解厄。”一名壮士低语。“堡中之主性情乖戾，险象环生。一周欢宴，次周便有无辜者因琐事被悬尸于墙。”

column1:
We represent the aspirations of honest workmen and merchants here in $PlaceName. We're tired of a few families dictating everything, especially when their unfair regulations make them rich and us poor.	“我们代表$PlaceName诚实工匠与商贾之志。我们厌倦了少数家族一手遮天，尤其当其苛政使彼辈富足而吾等贫寒。”
We seek the shrine of Saint Mary, on the outskirts of $NearestCity," he replies, "and hope our souls may bask in her radiance." You see that the old men and women hobbling along with him could use all the basking the good Lord might provide!
column2: “吾等欲往$NearestCity郊外之圣母玛利亚圣殿，祈求恩光庇佑。”他答道。你见随行老者步履蹒跚，正需主恩抚慰。

column1: We will then march through the city to the $Text3, where we'll chase out the evil $CityLordTitle and his stooges. Then $Text4 will take his rightful place as lord and protector of this fair city!
column2: “随后将率众入城，直捣$Text3，驱逐恶棍$CityLordTitle及其爪牙。尔后$Text4将登基，成为此城之主与守护者！”

column1: We'll be able to intercept them on the street up ahead, before they reach the $VarString1, she pants as you run. "If you can eliminate the guardsmen, I can free $NamedOneName!"
column2: “前方街道之上，吾等必能截住彼等，未及抵达$VarString1。”她喘息着奔行，“若能击溃守卫，我便可救出$NamedOneName！”

column1: We'll be able to intercept them on the street up ahead, before they reach the $VarString1, she pants as you run. "Paid mercenaries lead them. Defeat them and the civilian mob will lose heart. But beware -- priests, monks or alchemists may accompany them!"
column2: “前方街道之上，吾等必能截住彼等，未及抵达$VarString1。”她喘息着奔行，“领队者乃受雇佣兵。击溃之，则民乱自散。但须提防——或有祭司、僧侣、炼药师随行！”

column1: We'll be able to intercept them on the street up ahead, before they reach the $VarString1, she pants as you run. "They are just a civilian mob. Defeat one group and maybe they'll all flee. But beware -- priests, monks or alchemists may accompany them!"
column2: “前方街道之上，吾等必能截住彼等，未及抵达$VarString1。”她喘息着奔行，“彼等不过一介民乱。击溃一队，或许全军皆溃。但须提防——或有祭司、僧侣、炼药师随行！”

column1: We'll gladly pay your damages, tolerant sir; you also apologize profusely.
column2: “宽容的先生，吾等愿赔付汝损失。”你亦诚恳致歉。

column1: We'll take these for our troubles, she snarls, "and give you something to remember us!" Her men begin beating you mercilessly.
column2: “吾等以此酬劳。”她冷笑道，“并留汝些许纪念！”其手下随即痛殴不止。

column1: We're watching the approaches to the fortress, he says. "If any come who do not have the password, we're to warn the lord in the upper tower; the unbelievers must not break the seal."
column2: “吾等把守要塞入口。”他说，“若有未携口令者闯入，须通报塔楼之主；异教徒不得破封。”

column1: Well done! he says. "This will make a fabulous addition to my collection. Humming a little tune, he excuses himself and begins polishing the crown. You bow and depart.
column2: “干得好！”他说，“此物足为吾收藏添彩。”他哼着小曲，告退而去，开始擦拭王冠。你躬身告辞。

column1: Well now, he chuckles, "I recognize you. We've got a nice cozy dungeon cell waiting!" He immediately rings the alarm bell. As guards thunder along the walls toward the gate, you retreat into the darkness. Laughter follows your movements.
column2: “呵呵，”他笑道，“认得汝等。牢房早已备好，温暖舒适。”他当即鸣响警钟。守卫沿墙疾驰而来，你遁入黑暗。笑声随之远去。

column1: Well then, he concludes, "I will call upon you daily while you rest at the $Inn, where I'm sure you are staying."
column2: 那么，他总结道，"我会每日前来探望你们，就在你们歇息的$Inn处，想必你们正居于此。"

column1: Well, I could tell you stories, but I'll just say this: don't ever betray a confidence or reveal a secret of $NamedOneName.
column2: “唉，故事多矣，只一句：切莫泄露$NamedOneName之秘。”

column1: Well, I'd test their weight. Come to think of it, a water test and a scratch test too.
column2: 嗯，我会先称重。想一想，还要做个水试和刮痕测试。

column1: Well, at least mine is better than $NamedOneName!
column2: “至少我的比$NamedOneName强些！”

column1: Well, good travellers, he remarks with a smile, "what can this modest monastery offer you?"
column2: “善哉，诸位旅人，”他微笑道，“此小小修院又能为汝等提供何物？”

column1: Well, it was that or endure his satan-inspired curse, says $ChosenOneName. "Not a pretty choice."
column2: “要么如此，要么承受其撒旦之诅咒。”$ChosenOneName道，“抉择何其艰难。”

column1: Well, noble travellers, what brings you here? he asks. "A mission or message for someone? A delivery, perhaps?"
column2: “尊贵的旅人，”他问道，“汝等来此何事？奉使命、传讯息，抑或送信？”

column1:
Well, normally I dislike people with a mercenary attitude. Most of us serve the cause here, not our purses.	“唔，平常我讨厌那些唯利是图的人。我们大多数人在此是为崇高事业服务，而非为钱袋卖命。
Well, now what?" asked $ChosenOneName. You all consider the possibilities carefully.
column2: “如今如何？”$ChosenOneName问。众人细细权衡。

column1: Well, one cannot expect an answer to every prayer, $he says philosophically.
column2: “并非每祷必应。”你哲思道。

column1: Well, our main entertainment is watching the trees grow.
column2: 唉，我们的主要消遣便是观树生长。

column1: Well, perhaps the guild membership would believe our evidence, you reply.
column2: “或许同业公会会采信吾等之证。”你答道。

column1: Well, there goes our revolution, remarks $NamedOneName.
column2: “革命就此泡汤。”$NamedOneName叹道。

column1: Well, this boat is bound for $NamedOneName, and passage for you all is $Money1. I'll take it to the Captain. He holds out his hand. You...
column2: “此舟驶往$NamedOneName，汝等船票为$Money1。交予船长即可。”他伸出手。你……

column1: Well, travellers, he asks, "what can we do for you? A business arrangement, perhaps?"
column2: “诸位旅人，”他问，“吾等能为汝效何劳？或有生意往来乎？”

column1: Well, you're armed, armored, and not on our side, explains their leader. "But we still follow the codes. You surrendered, and have paid ransom," he gestures to your lost possessions and money. "You are now free to go."
column2: “汝等甲胄加身，持械在手，且非吾辈之友。”首领解释道，“然吾等仍遵规矩。汝等既已投降，并偿付赎金——他指了指汝等失物与钱财——今可自由离去。”

column1: What about him? you demand.
column2: “那他呢？”你质问道。

column1: What ails this place, little brother? you whisper.
column2: “此地何故如此？”你低声问道。

column1: What if the gate were shut?
column2: “若门户关闭呢？”

column1: What is the problem? $ChosenOneName says, stepping out from behind the tree. You see $he is wearing the cap of the man who performed the initiation rites. The old man pales.
column2: “何事困扰？”$ChosenOneName自树后走出。只见你戴着那位主持入门仪式之人的帽饰。老者面色骤变。

column1: What is wrong? asks $ChosenOneName.
column2: “有何不妥？”$ChosenOneName问道。

column1: What think you, fellow Germans, of the local temperament? he asks you, in a worried tone. In the ensuing discussion, you find he is worried about Hussite sentiments, especially among the Slavic peasants. Religious rebellion would be a serious problem for this lord.
column2: “诸位德意志同胞，对此地民情作何观？”他忧心忡忡地问你。经一番交谈，方知他忧虑胡斯派思潮，尤以斯拉夫农人为甚。宗教叛乱于此主君而言，实为大患。

column1: What would you say, he asks, "if I offered you a copy of the formula for $Text1 and added two vials of the potion itself to demonstrate its efficacy?
column2: “如果你给我一份$Text1的配方，并再附赠两瓶药水以示其效用，你会怎么说？”他问道。

column1: What, $NamedOneName has a mistress? Not another one!
column2: “什么？$NamedOneName还有情妇？又一个吗！”

column1: Whip and hang them all, alive or dead, by their heels from the battlements, he orders.
column2: “把他们活生生或死尸都吊起来，用皮鞭抽打，再倒挂在城垛上，”他下令道。

column1: Whip them, then string them up from the battlements, he snarls, "alive or dead, I don't care."
column2: “先抽打他们，再把他们吊在城垛上，”他咆哮道，“不管活的还是死的，我都无所谓。”

column1: Who goes there?
column2: “谁在那里？”

column1: Who is Klaus?
column2: “克劳斯是谁？”

column1: Why do you need me? replies a softer, higher voice.
column2: “你为什么需要我？”一个更为柔和、清亮的声音答道。

column1: Why don't you come around during the daytime, like decent people? Where's your consideration? I slave all day curing the world's ills, and then you won't let me get a decent night's sleep! Rascals! Villains!
column2: “你怎么不能像体面人一样白天来？你考虑过我的感受吗？我整天辛苦医治世间的疾患，可你们连我好好睡一觉都不让！无赖！恶棍！”

column1: Why, our plan does not include genocide, the first voice says persuasively. "We want everyone to join us, not to resist us."
column2: “为何呢？我们的计划并不包括种族灭绝，”第一个声音劝说道，“我们希望所有人都加入我们，而不是与我们为敌。”

column1: With all these at hand, you need not take IT from me. Spare IT. Spare me.
column2: “有了这些在手，你就无需从我这里拿走它了。留着吧，也放过我。”

column1: Within a month I must repay a very important family debt, or terrible things will happen to my siblings. Until then, I could join you, provided you can pay me 6 pfennigs a day!
column2: “一个月内我必须偿还一笔极为重要的家族债务，否则我的兄弟姐妹将遭遇不幸。在此之前，我可以加入你们，只要你们每天能付我六便士！”

column1: Ye here to help? she asks, and you nod.
column2: “你是来帮忙的吗？”她问道，你点了点头。

column1: Ye here to help? she asks. You reply...
column2: “你是来帮忙的吗？”她问道。你回答……

column1: Yes my children, I will pray for you. Please sit in the back and pray yourselves as well.
column2: “是的，孩子们，我会为你们祈祷。请坐在后面，也为自己祈祷吧。”

column1: Yes sir...
column2: “是的，长官……”

column1: Yes, I can think of many goods works possible with this fine gift, he says happily. "And rest assured, the virtue of your cause is also clearer to me now."
column2: “是的，我想到了许多可以用这份厚礼做成的好事，”他愉快地说。“而且请放心，如今我也更清楚你们事业的美德所在。”

column1:
Yes, I fear you are right. We cannot take the $fortress, and our supporters are not good enough to maintain this siege and hold the city walls against trained warriors attacking from without.	“是的，恐怕你说得对。我们无法攻下$fortress，而我们的支持者也不足以维持这场围城，更无法守住城墙抵御外来的精锐战士。”
Yes, SIR!" says the abashed bandit leader. In a flash they are running away down the street, hopping and scratching as they go.
column2: “是的，长官！”那位羞愧的匪首答道。转眼间，他们沿着街道一路狂奔而去，边跑边跳，还不时抓挠着身体。

column1: Yes, but you can get very rich, too.
column2: “是的，不过你也可能变得非常富有。”

column1: Yes, quite, he replies.
column2: “是的，完全正确，”他答道。

column1: Yes, there is indisputable proof that you have fulfilled your commission. He says. "Therefore, I am honor-bound to pay this reward."
column2: “是的，有确凿证据证明你已完成了任务。”他说，“因此，我义不容辞地要支付这笔赏金。”

column1: Yes, there is indisputable proof that you have fulfilled your commission. says $NamedOneName. "Therefore, I am honor-bound to pay this reward."
column2: “是的，有确凿证据证明你已完成了任务。”$NamedOneName说道，“因此，我义不容辞地要支付这笔赏金。”

column1: Yes, yes, he continues, "I know you'd be delighted. Well, in return for that, I have this very simple task, really nothing more than a favor. But listen well, for I won't repeat it."
column2: “是的，是的，”他继续道，“我知道你会很高兴。作为回报，我有个非常简单的任务，不过是个小忙而已。但请仔细听好，因为我不打算再说第二遍。”

column1: You are not initiated, the man in red says dangerously. "Why is this?" You reply...
column2: “你还未受洗入门，”那红衣男子危险地说道，“这是为何？”你回答……

column1: You are right, he confesses. "Requesting money was unbecoming. You have my apologies. Please stay tonight as our honored guests."
column2: “你说得对，”他坦白道，“索要钱财实在不合体统。请接受我的歉意。今晚请留下来，做我们的尊贵客人。”

column1: You are the answer to our prayers, she whispers. "In one hour I will leave the hidden postern unlocked, so you can do God's work."
column2: “你们正是我们祈祷的答案，”她低语道，“一小时后我会把那扇隐秘的小门留开，以便你们行上帝之工。”

column1: You are the ones, he says softly. "These are the betrayers!" he screams, pointing. "Slay them!"
column2: “就是你们，”他轻声说道，“这些就是叛徒！”他指着喊道，“杀了他们！”

column1: You are the ones, he says softly. Then he screams: "These are the betrayers! Slay them!" and the witches attack.
column2: “就是你们，”他轻声说道。随即他怒吼：“这些就是叛徒！杀了他们！”女巫们随即发动袭击。

column1: You better get lost, quick, if you know what's good for you. He fingers his sword-hilt. "Otherwise, you're dead meat."
column2: “若知进退，就赶紧滚吧，否则必死无疑。”他手指剑柄，“不然你就成了刀下亡魂。”

column1: You can help prepare the feast, says the man in red. He turns you over to one of the cooks, who tells you to wait one moment while she finishes a chore. You stand patiently.
column2: “你可以帮忙准备宴席，”红衣男子说道。他把你交给一位厨娘，让她稍等片刻，待她做完手头的活儿。你耐心等候。

column1: You cannot hurt me with these puny magics, he growls. Then he leaps to the attack.
column2: “这些微不足道的法术伤不了我，”他咆哮道。随即跃身上前发起攻击。

column1: You dare too much, the evil priest says softly. "You have ruined the summoning, but we can still destroy you!" With that, the witches scream a battle cry and attack.
column2: “你胆敢太过分了，”邪恶的神父轻声道，“你毁了召唤仪式，但我们仍能置你于死地！”话音刚落，女巫们发出战吼，扑了上来。

column1: You have a foul odor about you, she croaks while banging on your door. "You have the room for the night, but be gone before first dawn tomorrow!"
column2: “你身上散发着一股恶臭，”她在敲打你的房门时嘶哑地说道，“今晚可以留宿，但务必在明日破晓前离开！”

column1: You have seen the reward offered. Rid us of this plague and earn the gratitude of every merchant in the city.
column2: “你已见过悬赏。替我们除掉这瘟疫，赢得全城商贾的感激。”

column1: You insult us! The innkeeper immediately responds in kind by throwing you out!
column2: “你在侮辱我们！”客栈老板当即回敬，把你赶了出去！

column1: You may look German, but I see you have the soul of a Czech. Pass friends, in the name of the one Lord, the cup, and our brotherhood, he says. "But be warned, we have proof that evil German monks plot the end of the world, the apocalypse of Revelations. The millenium will come!"
column2: “你虽貌似德意志人，但我看出你有一颗捷克人的灵魂。朋友们，请奉主之名传递酒杯，共叙兄弟情谊，”他说，“但须警惕，我们掌握证据，邪恶的德意志修士正密谋世界末日，即《启示录》中的天启。千年将至！”

column1: You saved our lives and our fortunes! Please, take this reward! He hands you a weighty purse with $Money1 inside.
column2: “你救了我们的性命与财富！请收下这份酬谢！”他递给你一只沉甸甸的钱袋，里面装着$Money1。

column1: You scoundrels again? Begone, damnable nuisances, before I call the night watch!
column2: “又是你们这些无赖？快滚吧，该死的麻烦精，否则我就叫夜巡队来了！”

column1: You tried, your benefactor whispers, "and we honor you for that." You bless him and quickly stagger into the brush.
column2: “你已经尽力了，”你的恩人低声说道，“我们为此敬重你。”你向他致谢后，踉跄着钻进了灌木丛。

column1: You'll enjoy a nice, dank cell, says the sergeant, "until your fate is sealed!"
column2: “你会享受一间阴冷的地牢，”军士说道，“直到命运被定夺！”

column1: You're a pretty sorry lot. Don't suppose you know weapons, or happen to have any skills in the alchemical?
column2: “你们真是可怜虫。难道连武器都不会用，也没有炼金术方面的本事吗？”

column1: You're called for special duty to his lordship, you growl. "Get moving!" The guards quickly don their helmets and rush into the main building, leaving you free to examine what they've left behind.
column2: “你被召去为领主执行特别任务，”你咆哮道，“快点动身！”卫兵们迅速戴上头盔，冲进主楼，留下你自由察看他们遗下的东西。

column1: You've cursed me so I cannot curse you! he screams.
column2: “你对我下了诅咒，所以我无法对你施咒！”他尖叫道。

column1: You, he sneers, "are simply too slow and too late. Please leave."
column2: “你，”他冷笑道，“只是太慢，也太迟了。请离开。”

column1: Your skill and bravery will be long remembered, he says. "Their trial will be speedy and just. I expect we'll see their bodies on gibbets in the $citySquare by tomorrow night. That will finally break the back of this traitorous conspiracy!
column2: “你的技艺与勇武将被世人长久铭记，”他说。“他们的审判将迅速而公正。我预计明日之夜，便能在$citySquare的绞架上见到他们的尸首。这终将彻底粉碎这场叛逆的阴谋！”

column1: a Letter of Recommendation sent to nearby cities?
column2: “一封寄往附近城市的推荐信？”

column1: a suit of armor fit for a captain-general?
column2: “一套适合总司令的盔甲？”

column1: a truly noble mount from my personal stables?
column2: “一匹出自我私家马厩的真正名贵坐骑？”

column1: armory, a superlative suit of plate armor.
column2: 军械库，一套无与伦比的板甲。

column1: armory, brigandine for all who lack better.
column2: 军械库，为那些无力购置更佳者准备的锁子甲。

column1: armory, our finest handgun.
column2: 军械库，我们最精良的手枪。

column1: my personal priest to tell one of you about a rarely understood Saint, $Text3?
column2: “我的私人神父为你们其中一人讲述一位鲜为人知的圣人，$Text3？”

column1: one of my alchemist's rare and famous formulas, $Text2?
column2: “我炼金师的一份稀有而著名的配方，$Text2？”

column1: special stores in the granary, a selection of rare alchemical materials.
column2: 粮仓中的特藏，精选稀有炼金材料。

column1: stables, adequate mounts for all who lack better.
column2: 马厩，为那些无力购置更佳者提供的坐骑。

column1: stables, one of the finest horses.
column2: 马厩，一匹最上乘的骏马。

column1: $ChosenFourName eats the fruit.
column2: $ChosenFourName 吃了果实。

column1: $ChosenOneName attempts to scale the wall quickly and quietly, but the stone is too smooth and slippery. With a sickening thud, $he falls to the ground.
column2: $ChosenOneName 试图迅速而悄然攀爬城墙，但石面过于光滑湿滑。伴随着一声令人作呕的重响，你 坠落于地。

column1: $ChosenOneName begs Heaven's intervention, but there is no answer. Undeterred, your enemies close!
column2: $ChosenOneName 祈求上天的庇佑，却杳无音信。敌人毫不退缩，步步逼近！

column1: $ChosenOneName bids you all sit quietly, then bows his head in prayer to Saint Christina. First there is a feeling of calmness, then weightlessness. You are high above the ground, veering away from the nearest watchman, heading for the most deserted spot on the wall.
column2: $ChosenOneName 命令众人静坐，随后低头向圣克里斯蒂娜祈祷。先是感到一片宁静，继而身轻如燕。你已高悬于地面之上，避开最近的守卫，朝城墙上最荒僻之处飞去。

column1: $ChosenOneName bows $his head in prayer, and the rest of you follow. Minutes pass and nothing happens. You begin a quiet hymn, then more prayer, but still nothing. Finally $ChosenOneName shakes $his head.
column2: $ChosenOneName 低头祈祷，其余人亦随之。数分钟过去，毫无动静。你轻声吟唱圣歌，继而再行祷告，却依旧无果。最终 $ChosenOneName 摇了摇 你的 的头。

column1: $ChosenOneName bows $his head in prayer, and the rest of you follow. Soon a beam of sunlight seems to illuminate your group. As you pray, you seem to weigh less and less, until the ground drops away and you soar over the wall, landing gently in a small side street.
column2: $ChosenOneName 低下 你的 的头祈祷，其余的人也跟着做。不久，一束阳光似乎照亮了你们一行。随着祈祷，你们的身躯越来越轻，直到脚下的地面消失，你们腾空飞过城墙，轻轻降落在一条小巷中。

column1: $ChosenOneName carefully attaches a fused pot to the door, then lights it. You all duck as thunder and light explode from the doorway. In a second you're racing through the wreckage into the city. Above, guards run along the walls to the scene, shouting the alarm. They arrive just in time to see you disappearing into a city side street.
column2: $ChosenOneName 小心翼翼地将一枚熔合罐缚于门上，随即点燃。众人皆俯身躲避，雷鸣与光芒自门口迸发而出。转瞬之间，你们已穿越废墟，奔入城中。城墙上，守卫疾驰而来，高声报警。他们赶到时，只见你们消失在一条巷弄深处。

column1: $ChosenOneName cautiously says, "What mean you?"
column2: $ChosenOneName 谨慎地说道：“汝意欲何为？”

column1: $ChosenOneName climbs the bookcase, in an unwise attempt to check the top of it. Unfortunately, this causes the entire case to fall over onto the floor with a loud crash. You hear shouts below, and then the running feet of the city guard.
column2: $ChosenOneName 爬上书柜，妄图查看其顶部。不幸的是，此举导致整个书柜轰然倒地。楼下传来呼喊声，随后是城卫队急促的脚步声。

column1: $ChosenOneName creeps through the brush. But $he is not careful enough, and a local man spots $him and sounds the alarm. The villagers come running, weapons in hand.
column2: $ChosenOneName 在灌木丛中潜行。但 $he 不够小心，被一个当地人发现并大声示警。村民们手持武器赶来。

column1: $ChosenOneName creeps through the undergrowth. $He gets to the girl just as a black shadow appears on the horizon. The dragon is coming! You shout to $ChosenOneName to hurry, and $he does, cutting her loose in plenty of time. The frightened villagers see $him, but it is too late.
column2: $ChosenOneName 悄悄穿过灌木丛。你 刚赶到女孩身边，地平线上便出现了一道黑影。巨龙来了！你喊$ChosenOneName快点，你果然及时将她解救出来。惊恐的村民看到了你，但已为时晚矣。

column1: $ChosenOneName does $his best in showing off $his ability with the $NamedOneName. But $he fumbles once and drops $his weapon. In practice combat, one of the lord's guards handily defeats $him.
column2: $ChosenOneName 最擅长用$NamedOneName展示你的本领。但你一不小心，把你的武器掉落了。实战中，领主的一名侍卫轻松击败了你。

column1: $ChosenOneName does not perform these acts -- $he has never heard a priest ask for such tasks before, and doubts their efficacy in purging sin.
column2: $ChosenOneName 并不施行这些仪式——你 从未听闻有神父要求此类任务，且怀疑其能否涤除罪孽。

column1: $ChosenOneName eats the fruit.
column2: $ChosenOneName 吃了果实。

column1: $ChosenOneName eloquently defends your party to the evil alchemist. "Were you not once a poor apprentice, starting your career?" After several minutes of plaintive pleas, even the alchemist's hard heart is touched, and he lets you go.
column2: $ChosenOneName 巧舌如簧地为你的队伍向邪恶的炼金术士辩护。“你难道不是也曾是个贫苦学徒，从零起步吗？”经过数分钟的哀求，连炼金术士那颗冷硬的心也被打动了，他放你们离去。

column1: $ChosenOneName fights heroically and actually kills the dreadful goblin-steed, though its fiery breath scorches $him. In the end, $he fights the lancer to a standstill, but is horribly wounded. The uninjured monster says firmly, "$ChosenOneName has shown valor. We relinquish the Sword of War, but know that its effect is grim. $ChosenOneName's wounds shall never heal."
column2: $ChosenOneName 英勇奋战，竟将那可怕的地精坐骑击杀，然其烈焰之息灼伤了 你。最终，你 与长枪手激战至两败俱伤，自身亦受重伤。未受伤的怪物坚定言道：“$ChosenOneName 已显勇武。吾等愿交出战剑，然其效甚惨。$ChosenOneName 之伤永难愈合。”

column1: $ChosenOneName fights heroically, but is overcome in the end. The uninjured monster says firmly, "$ChosenOneName has shown valor, but not skill. Know that $ChosenOneName's wounds shall never heal."
column2: $ChosenOneName 英勇奋战，终难敌众。未受伤的怪物坚定地说道：“$ChosenOneName 有勇无谋。须知，$ChosenOneName 的伤势永不痊愈。”

column1: $ChosenOneName hurls the Noxious Aroma potion into the thick of the wolves. It shatters, and a choking stench emanates from it. Wolves, of course, have an extremely keen sense of smell. Their reaction is most gratifying: they roll away, barking angrily and sneezing furiously. In minutes they have all disappeared.
column2: $ChosenOneName 将恶臭之香药水掷入狼群之中。药水碎裂，一股令人窒息的恶臭随之弥漫。狼本就嗅觉灵敏，其反应令人称快：它们翻滚着退去，愤怒地吠叫，狂烈地打喷嚏。片刻之间，尽皆遁去。

column1: $ChosenOneName instantly flees, the witches hot on $his heels. You draw your weapons and run to assist $him.
column2: $ChosenOneName 立刻逃走，女巫紧追你的不放。你拔出武器，奔向你相助。

column1: $ChosenOneName is burned badly, but you all successfully cross the flaming water. Soon you climb out on the other side, dripping and steaming.
column2: $ChosenOneName 被严重烧伤，但你们都成功穿过了烈焰之水。不久后，你们湿漉漉、冒着热气地爬到了对岸。

column1: $ChosenOneName is the most virtuous of you all -- if $he cannot withstand the ghost, neither can the rest of you; you all turn and flee back into the comfort of the church.
column2: $ChosenOneName 是你们之中最德高望重的——若你亦不能抵御幽灵，其余诸位亦无能为力；众人只得转身，仓皇逃回教堂的庇护之下。

column1: $ChosenOneName laughs, saying, "He finds clerical honesty difficult, eh?"
column2: $ChosenOneName 笑道：“他觉得神职人员的诚实难能可贵，是吧？”

column1: $ChosenOneName leads everyone in prayer. There is a feeling of weightlessness, then a cool breeze as the party sails over the walls and into $PlaceName.
column2: $ChosenOneName 带领众人祈祷。一阵失重之感，随之而来的是一阵凉风，队伍便飘过城墙，进入了$PlaceName。

column1: $ChosenOneName leaps toward an exposed gear beneath the tilting floor, and jams a metal spike into the works. The floor stops tilting. Carefully, you make you way down the treacherous corridor.
column2: $ChosenOneName 向倾斜地板下露出的齿轮跃去，将一根金属尖钉插入其中。地板停止了倾斜。小心翼翼地，你穿过了这条险恶的走廊。

column1: $ChosenOneName mildly replies, "We seek to end the terror. Who could object?"
column2: $ChosenOneName温和地回答道：“我们欲终结这恐怖。谁会反对呢？”

column1: $ChosenOneName nods sagely, "A trick, eh? Well, yes, I suppose so...." $He winks to you all.
column2: $ChosenOneName 慎重地点了点头，“一个诡计，是吧？嗯，我想也是……”你 向你们眨了眨眼。

column1: $ChosenOneName nods, and the holy symbols are invoked, the saints supplicated. You rush the altar and, with a single blow, $ChosenOneName splits it in half. The witches scream in dismay.
column2: $ChosenOneName 点了点头，圣徽被召唤，诸圣被祈求。你冲向祭坛，一击之下，$ChosenOneName 将其劈成两半。女巫们惊恐地尖叫。

column1: $ChosenOneName picks up the cap the black-robed man wore, and you melt back into the crowd.
column2: $ChosenOneName 捡起那名黑袍男子戴的帽子，你悄然融入人群之中。

column1: $ChosenOneName protests, "But... But... But..."
column2: $ChosenOneName 抗议道：“可是……可是……可是……”

column1: $ChosenOneName reaches the top, only to look down and see that another has fallen. $He climbs back down again to assist $his injured comrade.
column2: $ChosenOneName 抵达顶端，却俯瞰到另一人已坠落。你 再次攀下，以援救受伤的 你的 同伴。

column1: $ChosenOneName realizes he has more in mind than just viewing the moonlight! She decides to...
column2: $ChosenOneName 意识到他心中所想远不止欣赏月色！她决定……

column1: $ChosenOneName realizes she has more in mind than just viewing the moonlight! He decides to...
column2: $ChosenOneName 意识到她的心思远不止于赏月！他决定……

column1: $ChosenOneName realizes that there is no point in lying to the Master of Lies, and grudgingly admits, "That is the total of all the keys we possess. We do not know how to stop the seventh plague."
column2: $ChosenOneName 意识到对谎言之主撒谎毫无意义，只得勉强承认道：“这便是我们所持钥匙的总数。我们不知如何阻止第七灾疫。”

column1: $ChosenOneName responds boldly, "Nay, but we shall overcome you and your foulness. We shall save the world."
column2: $ChosenOneName 大胆回应道：“不，我们将战胜你与你的邪恶。我们将拯救世界。”

column1: $ChosenOneName says, "Fair met, $NamedOneName. Do ye still seek the glory of slaying $NamedTwoName?"
column2: $ChosenOneName 说道：“幸会，$NamedOneName。汝仍欲寻求屠戮$NamedTwoName之荣光乎？”

column1: $ChosenOneName says, "My time in your fellowship has come to an end. I must depart, as other duties await." $He nods goodbye, and you reply in kind.
column2: $ChosenOneName 说道：“我在你们同伴中的时光已尽。我必须离去，另有职责在身。”你 点头告别，你也同样回应。

column1: $ChosenOneName scales the wall quietly, then throws down the rope so the rest of you can follow quickly. In minutes, you're sliding down to a side street inside $PlaceName.
column2: $ChosenOneName 悄然攀上城墙，随即抛下绳索，让其余众人得以迅速跟上。转瞬之间，你们已滑降至$PlaceName内的一条侧街。

column1: $ChosenOneName starts toward the wall, then spins around.
column2: $ChosenOneName 向墙边走去，随即转身。

column1: $ChosenOneName stops bleeding after a time, but all attempts at bandaging $his injuries fail. $He will never be the same.
column2: $ChosenOneName 经时止血，然包扎 你的 之伤皆无效。你 再难如初。

column1: $ChosenOneName strides forth and converses with the foe in Latin. After a minute, the witches lose patience and burst out, "The time for words shall soon be past! No mortal man can survive the dragon's fiery exudation, and your puny arms will bounce from its tough hide."
column2: $ChosenOneName 大步上前，用拉丁语与敌人交谈。片刻之后，女巫们失去耐心，怒喝道：“言语之时将尽！凡人难逃巨龙之烈焰，尔等微弱之臂亦不过弹指于其坚甲之上。”

column1: $ChosenOneName suddenly breaks free. The captors lunge for her with weapons drawn. You ready weapons to defend her and the battle is joined!
column2: $ChosenOneName 突然挣脱束缚。俘虏者拔出武器向她扑来。你已备好武器，准备保护她，战斗一触即发！

column1: $ChosenOneName takes a few hours to discuss healing treatments, trying to determine his skill.
column2: $ChosenOneName 花了几个小时讨论治疗之法，试图探明其技艺。

column1: $ChosenOneName then asks to consult with $his leaders, and returns to the crowd. $His attempt to talk your way past the guards has failed.
column2: $ChosenOneName 随即请求与你的位领袖商议，随后返回人群。你的次试图说服守卫放行的尝试均告失败。

column1: $ChosenOneName turns to the rest of you and asks, "All right, now what?"
column2: $ChosenOneName转向你们其余的人，问道：“好了，现在怎么办？”

column1: $ChosenOneName urges the peasants to remember their better natures. "Look at the land around you," $he says. "You were farmers once; you loved living things. Now you serve the horror that has ruined the land you live on."
column2: $ChosenOneName 劝诫农民们忆起他们本性中的善良。“看看你们脚下的土地，”你 说道，“你们曾是农夫；你们热爱生灵。如今却侍奉那毁灭你们家园的恐怖。”

column1: $ChosenOneName whirls. Behind you, silently approaching, is a huge spider. You shout and draw weapons as it leaps.
column2: $ChosenOneName 旋转。在你身后，一只巨大的蜘蛛正悄然逼近。你高声呼喊，拔出武器，它随即跃起。

column1: $ChosenOneName whispers, "The red hat must be the secret of his power. Can we get it away from him?" You then...
column2: $ChosenOneName低语道：“那顶红帽必定是他力量的源泉。我们能否将其从他手中夺走？”随后你……

column1: $ChosenOneName whispers: "Vulcans! Now I recognize the smell. They are dangerous creatures of earth-fire. They are said to spit flame, and to be able to survive almost any wound."
column2: $ChosenOneName低语道：“火神！如今我认出了这气味。他们是地火之中的危险生灵。据说他们能喷吐火焰，几乎任何伤势都无法致其于死。”

column1: $ChosenOneName winks at the rest of the party, and you all murmur a brief prayer of thanksgiving.
column2: $ChosenOneName 向队伍中的其他人眨了眨眼，你们都低声念诵着简短的感恩祷文。

column1: $ChosenOneName's knowledge of the outdoors and woods enables $him to predict where the thief must be headed. You go there and meet the thief as he arrives. When he comes into view, he is astounded to see you waiting for him.
column2: $ChosenOneName对野外与林间的熟知使你得以推断出盗贼的去向。你前往该处，正遇盗贼现身。他乍见你在此等候，不禁愕然。

column1: $ChosenOneName's prayers fail to open the heavens, and no signs or visions are vouchsafed you.
column2: $ChosenOneName的祈祷未能开启天门，亦无任何征兆或异象降临于你。

column1: $ChosenThreeName eats the fruit.
column2: $ChosenThreeName 吃了果实。

column1: $ChosenThreeName tries to interest him in buying and selling alchemical components.
column2: $ChosenThreeName 试图引他入彀，买卖炼金材料。

column1: $ChosenTwoName eats the fruit.
column2: $ChosenTwoName 吃了果实。

column1: $ChosenTwoName kicks over the cross. There is a detonation of magic power. The cross bursts into smithereens, and the remaining demons vanish in puffs of foul smoke, leaving $NamedThreeName alone. He falls to his knees in abject terror, shrieking in baffled fury, "You know not what you have done!"
column2: $ChosenTwoName 踢翻了十字架。魔法之力轰然爆发。十字架四分五裂，残余的恶魔化作一缕缕恶臭的烟雾消散无踪，只留下$NamedThreeName孤身一人。他惊恐万状，跪倒在地，狂怒地尖叫道：“汝不知所行何事！”

column1: $ChosenTwoName races towards the girl, but $he is not quite fast enough. An alert peasant shouts an alarm, and the villagers corner $ChosenTwoName, weapons drawn. You are forced to charge to the rescue.
column2: $ChosenTwoName 向少女奔去，但 你 还是稍显迟缓。一名警觉的农民高声示警，村民们手持武器将 $ChosenTwoName 围住。你不得不挺身而出，前去营救。

column1: $ChosenTwoName seizes $his chance and races to the girl. The villagers see $him and run to cut him off, but $he is too fast. $He swings past the girl and slashes through her bonds. She wastes no time in making a break for it.
column2: $ChosenTwoName 抓住 你的 机会，飞奔向那少女。村民们见 你 来了，急忙上前阻截，但 你 身手太快。你 挥剑掠过少女身旁，斩断她的束缚。她毫不迟疑，拔腿便逃。

column1: $ChosenTwoName tries to save $ChosenThreeName, but instead falls off too.
column2: $ChosenTwoName 试图拯救 $ChosenThreeName，却也一同坠落。

column1: $CityLordName
column2: $CityLordName

column1: $CityLordName, lord of the city.
column2: $CityLordName, 城之主。

column1: $He pauses a bit, then adds, "Well, a chance to share in the financial rewards doesn't hurt either." You all laugh.
column2: 你 稍作停顿，又补充道：“嗯，能分得些财利也不错。”众人皆笑。

column1: $His curse is frightening and disturbing. You hope it doesn't come true. Then you look at your companions, and realize the awful truth... the curse has already taken effect!
column2: 你的 诅咒令人恐惧且不安。你希望它不会成真。然而当你看向同伴时，才意识到可怕的真相……诅咒已然生效！

column1: $LeaderName pretends to consider the matter carefully, closing $his eyes in concentration.
column2: $LeaderName 假装仔细思量此事，闭上 你的 只眼睛，神情专注。

column1: $NamedOneName and his minions are too much, and you collapse, unconscious. When you awaken, you are outside the mine. You are chagrined; the dwarfs stole all your goods, so you must re-arm with sticks of wood.
column2: $NamedOneName 及其爪牙势不可挡，你力竭倒下，昏厥过去。待你醒来时，已身在矿井之外。你懊恼不已；矮人们夺走了你所有财物，只得重新以木棍武装自己。

column1: $NamedOneName and his minions finally force you to yield. $NamedOneName reappears, calls off his monsters and, excited beyond reason, capers around the room. He cries,
column2: $NamedOneName和他的爪牙终于迫使你屈服。$NamedOneName重新出现，召回了他的怪物，兴奋得难以自持，在房间里跳来跳去。他喊道，

column1: $NamedOneName blesses you with a bluish light, which accompanies your party. As you proceed through the darkness, your progress will be greatly improved by this help.
column2: $NamedOneName 以蓝色光芒庇佑你，伴随你的队伍。在黑暗中前行时，这道光芒将大大助你一臂之力。

column1: $NamedOneName dismisses you from his presence without argument.
column2: $NamedOneName 无言地将你逐出他的面前。

column1: $NamedOneName expects you to thank him profusely for this boon, and you do so quite assiduously.
column2: $NamedOneName 期望你为这份恩惠向他致以万分感谢，你也确实如此勤勉地表达了谢意。

column1: $NamedOneName inclines his head politely. "What can I do for you?" he asks.
column2: $NamedOneName 礼貌地欠身。“我能为你做些什么？”他问道。

column1: $NamedOneName may have been crazy, but in an entirely different way than you thought: there before you is not a mass of small spiders, but gigantic spiders, the size of wolves! They're on you in an instant.
column2: $NamedOneName 可能确实疯了，但与你想象的完全不同：在你面前的并非一群小蜘蛛，而是体型如狼般巨大的蜘蛛！它们瞬间扑向你。

column1: $NamedOneName may have been crazy, but in an entirely different way than you thought: there before you is not a mass of small spiders, but three spiders ... gigantic spiders, the size of wolves! They're on you in an instant.
column2: $NamedOneName 可能确实疯狂，但与你想象的完全不同：在你面前的并非一群小蜘蛛，而是三只……巨大的蜘蛛，其体型堪比狼！它们瞬间扑向你。

column1: $NamedOneName no longer speaks so passionately in favor of tradition.
column2: $NamedOneName 不再如此热烈地拥护传统。

column1: $NamedOneName shakes his huge hammer at you, and roars in a bass growl,
column2: $NamedOneName 向你挥舞着他巨大的铁锤，低沉地咆哮着，

column1: $NamedOneName spots you and calls out, "There you are! Come join me!"
column2: $NamedOneName 发现了你，喊道：“你在这儿！快来加入我！”

column1: $NamedOneName won't fight personally, but he's willing to send his men to do the work for him. You draw weapons and prepare to fight.
column2: $NamedOneName 不会亲自出战，但他愿意派手下代劳。你拔出武器，准备迎战。

column1: $NamedOneName, the leader of the local Fugger bank, $VarPhrase3 change in city government.
column2: $NamedOneName，当地富格银行的领袖，$VarPhrase3市政府的变革。

column1: $NamedOneName, the leader, nods in agreement and rises. "$ChosenOneName speaks the truth. This could be our last chance, before they move against us. Our task may be hard, but we must refuse to be led like a lamb to the slaughter. We must take our fate into our own hands!"
column2: $NamedOneName，首领点头同意，站起身来。“$ChosenOneName说的是实话。这可能是我们的最后机会，在他们对我们下手之前。我们的任务或许艰难，但我们绝不能像羔羊般任人宰割。我们必须掌握自己的命运！”

column1: $NamedTwoName, abbot of $Monastery, the city monastery, $VarPhrase4 change in the city.
column2: $NamedTwoName，$Monastery的方丈，这座城市的修道院，$VarPhrase4城市的变化。

column1: $NamedTwoName, captain of the guard.
column2: $NamedTwoName, 卫队长。

column1: $Text1 for $Money1.

column1: A haunted look comes into $NamedOneName's eyes as he says, "I dread lest it be the end of the world. Prodigies abound. Birds drop dead from the sky. Insects of unnatural size throng the air -- particularly those called 'devil's darning needles'. The moon is red-lit. Mysterious fires rage through woodlands and fields. We fear the future."
column2: $NamedOneName的眼中浮现出一抹幽怨之色，他说道：“我唯恐这是世界末日。异象频仍：鸟儿从天而降，尸横遍地；空气中充斥着体型怪异的昆虫——尤其是那些被称为‘魔鬼缝衣针’的家伙；月亮被染成血红；神秘的火焰在林野间肆虐。我们对前途忧心忡忡。”

column1: A haunted look comes into $NamedOneName's eyes, and he says, "The land is cursed. Mysterious diseases kill herds of cows overnight. Children waken screaming at night. We find strange marks in the ground, filled with a terrible unknown stench. We know not what hellish sending this is."
column2: $NamedOneName的眼中浮现出一抹阴郁之色，他说道：“这片土地被诅咒了。神秘的疾病一夜之间夺走了成群的牛命。孩子们夜里惊醒尖叫。我们在地上发现了奇怪的痕迹，散发着一股令人作呕的恶臭。我们不知这是何等地狱般的妖术。”

column1: A haunted look comes into his eyes as $NamedOneName speaks. "I fear for this city. A nearby village was burnt to charcoal overnight. We know not what dread sending caused this woe. Wells issue ill-smelling water, unfit to drink. Some horror dwells and grows under our land."
column2: 当$NamedOneName开口时，他的眼中浮现出一抹幽魂般的神色。“我为这座城市担忧。附近的一个村庄一夜之间被烧成了焦炭。我们不知是什么可怖的使者带来了这场灾祸。井水散发着恶臭，无法饮用。某种恐怖正潜伏在我们的土地之下，并不断滋长。”

column1: A ray of starlight illuminates the face of $ChosenOneName as $he bows in silent prayer. Time seems to stop, then $ChosenOneName leads everyone toward the wall. You get lighter and lighter as you walk, until the ground drops away. As the night watch exclaims in amazement, you soar over the wall and down into a narrow street inside $PlaceName.
column2: 一缕星光照亮了$ChosenOneName的面容，你默默俯首祈祷。时光仿佛静止，随后$ChosenOneName引领众人走向城墙。你们越走越轻盈，直至脚下地面骤然空旷。夜巡者惊呼不已，你们便凌空越过城墙，落入$PlaceName内一条狭窄的街巷之中。

column1: A richly caparisoned knight, with a colorful entourage, boldly rides toward your party. From the bearing of his retainers, you realize he is going to a tournament. You...
column2: 一位身披华服的骑士，携着一支色彩斑斓的随从队伍，大胆地向你的队伍驰来。从他侍从们的举止中，你意识到他正前往一场比武大会。你...

column1: A ripple runs through the flowing water's surface. There is no other effect that you can see.
column2: 流水的表面泛起一丝涟漪。你未见其他异象。

column1: A rolling cloud of light spreads across the graveyard, driving away darkness. From somewhere, a bird begins to sing.
column2: 一团滚动的光云在墓地间蔓延，驱散了黑暗。不知从何处传来一声鸟鸣。

column1: A rumbling sound begins deep beneath the earth; then, a rolling cloud of light spreads across the graveyard. All gravestones but one are bathed in a pure and holy light. You are sure that the single stone left in darkness is the key to entering this evil place.
column2: 地底深处响起隆隆之声；随即，一团滚动的光芒在墓地间蔓延。除了一块墓碑外，其余皆被纯净圣洁的光辉笼罩。你确信，那唯一未被照亮的石碑正是通往此邪地的关键。

column1: A rumbling sound begins deep beneath the earth; then, a rolling cloud of light spreads across the graveyard. All the gravestones are bathed in a pure light except one. That remains in darkness, filling you with the conviction that this stone is the key to entering this evil place.
column2: 地底深处传来隆隆之声；随即，一团滚动的光芒弥漫墓地。除了一块墓碑外，所有墓石皆被纯净之光笼罩。那块墓碑依旧沉寂于黑暗之中，令你确信此石正是通往此邪之地的关键。

column1: A satanic priest mounts the altar-block, and holds up his arms.
column2: 一名撒旦祭司登上祭坛石块，高举双臂。

column1: A sense of foreboding fills you, and a voice whispers, "Beware $NamedOneName."
column2: 一种不祥之感涌上心头，耳边传来低语：“当心$NamedOneName。”

column1: A sense of panic engulfs you. Everyone bolts down the nearest side street, with just one thought on their mind...
column2: 一股恐慌席卷而来。众人纷纷沿着最近的侧街四散奔逃，心中只有一个念头……

column1: A short while later, $ChosenOneName reports that the bandits have encountered a cloaked hermit. Although the scene is at a distance, $he sees a long discussion ensue. A few bandits storm off, apparently angry, but the majority appeared to follow the hermit, who leads them away into the hills.
column2: 不久之后，$ChosenOneName 报告说，匪徒们遇到了一位披着斗篷的隐士。尽管现场相距甚远，你 仍见一场漫长的交谈。几名匪徒愤然离去，而多数人则跟随那隐士，被他引向山丘深处。

column1: A shovelful of lead is brought to you. $ChosenOneName pours $his Transformation potion over it and fans it for a minute. Then $he lifts up a lump of metal in triumph. Throughout the dull gray lead you can now see streaks of yellow gold. The lord is very impressed. "The land could use more men and women who know how to perform such feats."
column2: 一铲铅被送到你面前。$ChosenOneName将你的转化药水倾注其上，并扇风一分钟。随后你 triumphant 地举起一块金属。在原本黯淡的灰色铅中，如今可见缕缕金黄。领主十分赞赏：“此地正需更多懂得此类技艺的男女。”

column1: A slight wind begins to blow from INSIDE the room. Gradually it increases in intensity, swirling ashes about, though none get in your eyes. Soon the wind is howling at gale force; untouched, you watch as the ashes are swept away into nothingness. In the room, there is now one perfect book resting peacefully on the floor.
column2: 一股微风自房间内部徐徐吹来。渐渐地，风势渐强，灰烬在空中盘旋，却未曾落入你眼中。不久，狂风呼啸而至；你安然无恙，只见灰烬被卷入虚无之中。此刻，房间内仅剩一本完美的书，静静置于地面。

column1: A slight wind stirs the ashes gently, then subsides with a mournful sigh.
column2: 微风轻拂灰烬，随即带着一声哀叹归于寂静。

column1: A small, unassuming gravestone rests in darkness here. You...
column2: 一块不起眼的小墓碑静卧于此，黑暗之中。你……

column1: A smile brightens the old monk's face. "Truly a generous gift for the sake of Our Lady," he says softly. "Please come with me, and I'll try to find what you seek."
column2: 老修士的脸上浮现出微笑。“为圣母之名，这真是一份慷慨的馈赠。”他低声说道，“请随我来，我将尽力为你寻得所需。”

column1: A smile brightens the old monk's face. "Truly a generous gift for the sake of Our Lady," he says softly. Together you pray for a while, then you offer to share some of your provisions with him.
column2: 老修士的脸上浮现出微笑。“为圣母之名，这真是一份慷慨的馈赠。”他低声说道。你们一同祈祷片刻，随后你提出与他分享一些干粮。

column1: A stab of pain awakens you. You have just been dumped onto a cart full of bodies. Squinting, you see battered rebels piling bodies onto other wagons under the watchful eyes of the victorious city guards.
column2: 一阵剧痛将你唤醒。你刚被抛入一辆满载尸体的马车。眯眼望去，只见疲惫的叛军在胜利的城卫严密监视下，将一具具尸体堆上其他马车。

column1: A stone box squats on the floor before you. A huge steel lock closes it tightly. Carved on the front of the box is "$NamedOneName, king of the dwarfs." Perhaps it holds his treasure.
column2: 一只石箱蹲伏在你面前的地面上。一道巨大的钢锁牢牢将其封住。箱体正面刻着：“$NamedOneName，矮人之王”。或许其中藏有他的宝藏。

column1: A storm at sea must be causing high tides that are flooding the marshes. You decide to...
column2: 海上的风暴必定引发了潮汐，淹没了沼泽。你决定……

column1: A strange, echoing laughter comes from everywhere at once as the bony fingers grasp the proffered rib. "Only eleven more to go!" it cackles. It inserts the missing rib into its body with a dry 'snick.' Then the eye-sockets turn your way.
column2: 当那骨瘦如柴的手指抓住递来的肋骨时，一阵奇异而回响的笑声从四面八方传来。“还差十一根！”它咯咯笑道。它将缺失的肋骨“咔嗒”一声嵌入体内，随后空洞的眼窝转向你。

column1: A stream oozes across your path. Clots of filth dot its surface, and a poisonous stench emanates from it. The thing that blasted the landscape has also poisoned the waterways.
column2: 一条溪流缓缓淌过你的前方。水面漂浮着一团团污秽，散发着刺鼻的恶臭。那场摧毁地貌的灾难也污染了水道。

column1: A strong, iron door blocks the path. Above an inscription reads:
column2: 一扇坚固的铁门挡住了去路。门楣上方镌刻着：

column1: A sudden discordant noise, like the jangling of an alarm, echoes throughout the graveyard. In a blast of light and smell, foul creatures appear before you!
column2: 一阵突兀的不和谐声响，宛如警铃般，在墓地间回荡。伴随着一道光与恶臭，一群可怖的生物出现在你面前！

column1: A sudden smell of wild grass fills the room; otherwise there is no discernable effect.
column2: 房间内突然弥漫起一股野草的气息；除此之外并无明显变化。

column1: A sudden sound, like trumpets before a battle, echoes from the battlements of the fortress monastery. In the wall facing the graveyard, a door suddenly appears.
column2: 一阵仿佛战前号角般的声响，从堡垒修道院的垛口处回荡开来。面向墓地的墙上，一扇门骤然显现。

column1: A sweet, high song fills the air, and a liquid voice speaks. "Seek to the graves for guidance, but beware speaking the wrong name out loud in this place. There is only one who can gain you access. Only the witches can tell you that name."
column2: 一首清甜高亢的歌声充盈空中，一个柔润的嗓音响起：“向坟墓寻求指引，但切莫在此地妄呼其名。唯有女巫知晓那唯一能为你开启此门的名字。”

column1: A tatzelwurm still looks formidable, even in death. You clean your weapons and resume your journey, imagining what tales you could tell of this encounter.
column2: 即使死去，塔策尔蠕虫依然令人望而生畏。你擦拭刀剑，继续前行，想象着这段遭遇所能讲述的故事。

column1: A terrible stench soon intrudes, and the gate area quickly empties. Before the odor dissipates, you all clutch wet rags over your mouth and nose and rush out the open gate.
column2: 随即一股恶臭袭来，栅栏周围很快便空无一人。在气味消散之前，你们用湿布捂住口鼻，冲出敞开的栅门。

column1: A thundering explosion fills the tiny room. Even after it has died away, you seem to hear it roaring in your ears. However, temporary deafness is a small price to pay: the door is crumpled outward, and your path of escape is clear.
column2: 一声震耳欲聋的爆炸充斥狭小的房间。即便余音已歇，你仍似觉轰鸣在耳畔回荡。然而，短暂失聪不过是微不足道的代价：房门已被炸开，逃生之路豁然开朗。

column1: A thundering explosion fills the tiny room. Even after it has died away, you seem to hear it roaring in your ears. However, temporary deafness is a small price to pay; the door is crumpled outward, and your path of escape is clear.
column2: 一声震耳欲聋的爆炸充斥狭小的房间。即便余音已歇，你仍似觉轰鸣在耳畔回荡。然而，短暂失聪不过是微不足道的代价：房门已被炸开，逃生之路豁然开朗。

column1: A tinkling voice states, "Strength and Virtue are two different things. Often, to enhance the one you must sacrifice the other. Beware your virtue."
column2: 一个清脆的声音说道：“力量与美德本是两回事。往往，欲增其一，必舍其二。慎守你的美德。”

column1: A trap? Perhaps, but what have you to lose? You exit the cell and make your way back to the main building.
column2: 这是个陷阱吗？也许吧，但你又有什么可失去的呢？你走出牢房，返回主楼。

column1: A tumbling block of stone smashes $ChosenTwoName's leg, but you drag your companion to safety.
column2: 一块滚落的巨石砸断了$ChosenTwoName的腿，但你还是将同伴拖至安全之地。

column1: A variety of twisting cobblestone streets interconnect. Looking down each, you spot picture signs that portray the various guilds and crafts here. You turn toward...
column2: 各种蜿蜒的石板街道彼此交错。沿街望去，可见描绘各公会与行当的图示招牌。你转而走向……

column1: A vision plays itself in the air above you, a vision of your own party examining the gravestones, and then advancing boldly into the forbidding monastery.
column2: 一幅幻象在你头顶浮现：你的队伍正细察墓碑，随后大胆闯入那座阴森的修道院。

column1: A vision plays itself out in the air above you, a vision of your own party examining the gravestones, then fleeing in terror from some nameless horror. A voice speaks: "Only the witches can give you the name."
column2: 一幅幻象在你头顶上演：你的队伍细察墓碑，继而因某种莫名的恐怖惊惶逃窜。一个声音响起：“唯有女巫能告知你那个名字。”

column1: A voice echoes, clear as a bell, from somewhere above you. It says, "Beware $NamedFiveName."
column2: 一个清晰如钟的声音自上方某处传来。它说道：“谨防$NamedFiveName。”

column1: A voice whispers through the room: "The symbol is alchemical in nature," it says. "Further study in the proper manner will yield good results."
column2: 一个低语在室内回荡：“此符号乃炼金之物。”它说道，“若以正当方式深入研究，必将有所收获。”

column1: A voice whispers, "Fear not, for they have not the power to slay the righteous out of hand." This is small comfort for the pain, the wounds, the losses.
column2: 一个低语传来：“勿惧，他们无力当场诛杀义士。”然而，这仅是对疼痛、伤痕与损失的些许慰藉。

column1: A washerwoman in a doorway stares in disbelief while a small child exclaims delightedly, "Mommy, they flew like birds!"
column2: 一位洗衣妇在门口目瞪口呆，而一个小孩子则欣喜地喊道：“妈妈，他们像鸟一样飞起来了！”

column1: A well-known aristocrat, $NamedOneName, is hiring short-term workers. He offers good pay for putting up notices around town. However, you learn that angry craftsmen are tearing down the notices almost as fast as they go up! This explains why $NamedOneName hires sturdy people unafraid of rough situations.
column2: 一位声名显赫的贵族$NamedOneName正在招募短期劳工。他开出优厚报酬，雇人于镇中张贴告示。然而，你得知愤怒的工匠几乎在告示一贴出便将其撕毁！这也解释了为何$NamedOneName偏爱那些身强体壮、不畏险境之人。

column1: A while later you awaken, hurting all over, and look around. The thieves have left you for dead, but not before stripping you of almost every item of obvious value!
column2: 片刻之后，你醒来，遍体酸痛，环顾四周。盗贼们以为你已死，却未忘掠走你身上几乎所有值钱之物！

column1: A workman says, "I hope those nobles kill each other. That's a fit judgement for their endless fighting."
column2: 一名工匠说道：“但愿那些贵族自相残杀。这才是对他们无休止争斗的应有惩罚。”

column1: A young monk shines a lantern into your eyes, grunts, and says, "Come back in the morning." Before you can say or do anything, he closes the door in your face.
column2: 一名年轻修士用手电照向你的眼睛，哼了一声，说道：“明早再来。”你还未来得及开口或行动，他便砰然关上了门。

column2: 脓肿   定义   咯咯笑   捉弄   未启封   至今   节奏   稻茬

column2: 寻求援助

column2: 所有面容皆是谎言——或所有面容皆是真相
