column1: About all you can discover is that some peculiar lights were visible there sometime in the last few months. Now it is quiet again, and the residents of $PlaceName are clearly relieved.
column2: 你所能探知的，不过是在过去数月间那里曾出现过几道奇异的光芒。如今这里重归宁静，$PlaceName的居民显然松了一口气。

column1: Above you, halfway up a rock face, you see a weathered, moss-covered carving on rock over an empty cave. It is ancient and looks quite deserted. You shrug and move on.
column2: 在你头顶，岩壁半腰处，一座空洞之上，有一幅饱经风霜、长满青苔的岩石雕刻。它古老而荒凉。你耸耸肩，继续前行。

column1: Accepting your donation gracefully, the priest states, "It is clear that your hearts are in the right place."
column2: 神父优雅地接受了你的捐赠，说道：“看得出，你们的心意是真诚的。”

column1: Accepting your donation, the priest says, "Even a poor man or woman can gain favor with heaven by giving to help others. The biblical tale of the Widow's Mite demonstrates this to our satisfaction."
column2: 神父接受捐赠后说道：“即便是贫苦之人，只要乐善好施，也能蒙受天恩。圣经中寡妇献钱的故事足以证明这一点。”

column1: Adopting a friendly manner, $ChosenOneName attempts to parlay with the guards. However, their lieutenant barely listens to $his pleas before waving $him away.
column2: $ChosenOneName以友善的态度试图与守卫交涉。然而，他们的副官几乎不听你的恳求，便挥手让你离开。

column1: After $ChosenOneName finishes his prayer, nothing seems to happen. Then a robed person walks out of a small ravine.
column2: $ChosenOneName祈祷完毕后，似乎并无异样。随后，一名身披长袍的人从一处小峡谷中走出。

column1: After $ChosenTwoName finishes the prayer, $ChosenOneName soon sinks below the surface. Sadly, you get up, thinking the prayer a failure and $ChosenOneName lost.
column2: $ChosenTwoName祈祷结束后，$ChosenOneName旋即沉入水面之下。你怅然起身，认为祈祷失败，$ChosenOneName已然逝去。

column1: After $Number1 hours of sleep, you crawl out of the bushes, brushing away the worst of the night's accumulation of dirt and insects. A little less presentable than yesterday, you consider how to greet the new day.
column2: 经过$Number1小时的睡眠，你从灌木丛中爬出，拂去夜间积聚的尘土与虫豸。虽比昨日略显狼狈，你仍在思索如何迎接新的一天。

column1: After $Number1 hours, you find a quiet stretch of shoreline and drag yourselves out of the water, shivering with cold, but beyond the reach of $PlaceName.
column2: 经过$Number1小时，你们觅得一段僻静的海岸线，浑身颤抖地爬上岸，远离了$PlaceName的追捕。

column1: After $Number1 hours, you hear muffled voices and bootsteps behind one of the guild buildings...
column2: 经过$Number1小时，你们听见一间公会建筑后方传来隐约的说话声与脚步声……

column1: After $Number1 hours, you hear muffled voices and bootsteps in a usually quiet alley...
column2: 经过$Number1小时，你听见在一向寂静的小巷中传来低沉的说话声与靴履声……

column1: After a brief discussion at the gate, you are admitted to the monastery and asked to wait for the abbot's clerk, who wishes to greet you personally.
column2: 在门口简短交谈后，你被允许进入修道院，并被要求等待方丈的书记官前来亲自迎接。

column1: After a busy day, darkness falls over the field. The watchfires burn into the night, and new travellers are arriving constantly for the grand ceremony which is to begin tomorrow.
column2: 经过忙碌的一天，黑暗笼罩着原野。守夜的篝火燃烧至深夜，络绎不绝的新旅人正为明日即将开始的盛大仪式而抵达。

column1: After a few casual conversations, you learn that...
column2: 经过几番闲谈，你得知……

column1: After a few conversations, you deduce learn that the Swordsmiths' guild $VarPhrase1 changes in the government of $PlaceName.
column2: 经过几番交谈，你推断出剑匠公会$VarPhrase1正酝酿着对$PlaceName政府的变革。

column1: After a few hours, you indeed feel better in the eyes of your creator. When the monks' chants finally fade to silence, a novice appears and ushers you through a door. You step through and find yourself outside the monastery once more.
column2: 几小时后，你确实在造物主眼中显得好了一些。当修士的吟唱终于归于寂静时，一名见习生现身，引领你穿过一道门。你跨步而过，再次置身于修道院之外。

column1: After a furious battle, you defeat the mob of cultists, although one of them curses you "from now to $SabbatTime, when our master appears $SabbatLocation." You take note of this; it might be important.
column2: 经过一场激战，你击败了那群邪教徒，其中一人却对你施下诅咒：“自今至$SabbatTime，吾主将现于$SabbatLocation。”你记下了这句话；或许事关重大。

column1: After a long and arduous chase, you finally catch up to the thief and $ChosenOneName, the quickest of your number, tackles him. The thief offers no further resistance. In fact, his spirit shatters and tears stream from his eyes, while his quaking lips blubber and hiccup.
column2: 经过漫长而艰辛的追逐，你终于追上了那名窃贼，而$ChosenOneName，你们之中最为迅捷者，将其扑倒。窃贼不再反抗。事实上，他的心神已碎，泪水自眼中涌出，颤抖的嘴唇呜咽抽泣。

column1: After a long argument the majority agree to let you go in peace. But some look enviously after you.
column2: 经过一番长论，多数人同意让你安然离去。但仍有几人嫉妒地望着你。

column1: After a long night of paddling, with only a piece of junk wood for company, $ChosenOneName finally pulls $himself out onto a quiet stretch of shoreline.
column2: 经过漫长一夜的划桨，唯有朽木为伴，$ChosenOneName终于将你自己拖至一片宁静的岸边。

column1: After a mere hour of searching, you find the offices of the professors of Alchemy and Philosophy. The master alchemist is willing to discuss providing information, but points out that schools do not dispense information for free...
column2: 仅仅搜寻了一个时辰，你便找到了炼金术与哲学教授的办公室。炼金大师愿意商议提供情报，却指出学府并非无偿授业……

column1: After a moment of preparation, $ChosenOneName tries to clamber up the pit's walls, but they are too steep and slick for $him. $He almost gets to the top, then slips and comes crashing back down to the rock floor, slightly injuring $himself. You consider what to do next. If $ChosenOneName couldn't climb the wall, certainly no one else in your party could!
column2: 经过片刻准备，$ChosenOneName试图攀爬矿坑的壁面，但其陡峭且湿滑，你难以立足。你几乎攀至顶端，却失足坠回岩地，你自己受了轻伤。你思索下一步该怎么做。若$ChosenOneName亦无法攀上，队伍中更无人能成！

column1: After a moment, armed men come into view. They are clearly in the service of $NamedOneName, the raubritter. They do not see you yet. You choose to ...
column2: 片刻之后，持械之人映入眼帘。他们显然效命于$NamedOneName，那位劫匪骑士。他们尚未发现你。你选择……

column1: After a short wait, you hear the sound of tramping feet and harsh voices coming from the direction of the door. A group of Knights Templar, swarthy and foul-smelling, enter the chamber. "Submit your weapons to us," barks the leader. "You cannot hope to escape." You...
column2: 稍作等待，你听见脚步声与粗哑的嗓音自门的方向传来。一群黝黑且气味难闻的圣殿骑士步入室内。“将武器交予我们，”首领厉声喝道，“你们休想逃脱。”你...

column1: After an agonizing half hour, your best locksmith looks up and announces, "There is nothing I can do. This door is beyond my skill."
column2: 经过痛苦的半个时辰，你最出色的锁匠抬头说道：“我无能为力。此门已超乎我的技艺。”

column1: After an agonizing half-hour, your best locksmith looks up and announces, "There is nothing I can do. This door is beyond my skill."
column2: 经过痛苦的半个时辰，你最出色的锁匠抬起头来宣布：“我无能为力。此门已超乎我的技艺。”

column1: After an hour of discussion on various medical matters, $ChosenOneName is unable to yet determine the competence of this person. Perhaps more discussion would reveal the truth.
column2: 经过一小时关于诸般医事的商议，$ChosenOneName仍未能断定此人之能。或许再加商讨方能明真相。

column1: After an hour of interesting and stimulating discussions about the merits of bleeding patients, use of various potions, etc., $ChosenOneName decides that $NamedOneName has $Text1 skill.
column2: 经过一小时关于放血疗法、各类药水效用等话题的有趣而富有启发性的讨论，$ChosenOneName 认定 $NamedOneName 具有 $Text1 的技艺。

column1: After an hour of searching, you locate the master alchemists teaching here. They have many valuable ingredients, but warn you that prices will be high. They also express some small interest in possibly buying some of your ingredients. You consider this as you look over their inventory...
column2: 寻觅一小时后，你找到了在此授业的炼金术大师们。他们手中珍材颇丰，却告诫你价格不菲。他们亦略表兴趣，欲购你之材料。你审视其货品，心下思量……

column1: After an hour of searching, you locate the master alchemists teaching here. You donate $Money1 to the furtherence of alchemical work at the $university, and in return they help you improve your stone (which now has quality $Number1).
column2: 经过一小时的寻觅，你找到了在此授课的炼金术大师们。你捐献$Money1以资助$university的炼金事业，作为回报，他们助你提升石质（如今其品质为$Number1）。

column1: After an hour of searching, you locate the religious library of the $university. A kindly librarian meets you at the door...
column2: 寻觅一小时后，你找到了$university的宗教图书馆。一位和蔼的馆长在门口迎候你……

column1: After breathing a prayer, $ChosenOneName feels a compelling spirit of peace engulf $him. The saint seems to personally whisper into his ear, "You have naught to fear from these mild folk."
column2: 祈祷之后，$ChosenOneName 感到一股强烈的宁静之气笼罩着 你。圣人仿佛亲自在他耳边低语：“你无需惧怕这些温和的民众。”

column1: After considering the problem, you decide to ...
column2: 经过深思熟虑，你决定……

column1: After crawling through the dank sewers for hours, you come to a sewer grate. $ChosenOneName tries to pry it loose, but it is too tightly fitted. Even using tools, $he cannot open it. You must go back through the sewers the way you came, but now you are drenched in the foul liquid through which you crawled. Passers-by on the street hold their noses as you walk by.
column2: 在潮湿的下水道中爬行数小时后，你来到一处下水道格栅。$ChosenOneName试图将其撬开，但它安装得过于紧密。即便使用工具，你也无法打开它。你只能原路返回，但此时你已被爬过的污秽液体浸透。街上的行人见你经过，纷纷捂住鼻子。

column1: After defeating the alchemist and his guards, you take the spoils of victory -- by carefully going through his wagon and tent! There is less than you'd hoped, but more than you'd expected, so all in all it is a good haul.
column2: 击败炼金术士及其卫兵后，你仔细搜查了他的马车与帐篷，夺得了胜利的战利品。虽不及所望，却胜于所料，总体而言，收获颇丰。

column1: After dinner, the castle lord makes a private visit to your rooms.
column2: 晚餐后，城堡领主私下造访你的居室。

column1: After discussing the possibility for a while, they are uninterested. You suspect they don't completely trust you -- an understandable sentiment in such a dangerous land.
column2: 讨论了一阵子后，他们显得不感兴趣。你怀疑他们并不完全信任你——在这片险恶之地，这种顾虑也情有可原。

column1: After discussing these issues, you decide to...
column2: 讨论过这些问题后，你决定……

column1: After examining a dropped handbill, it is clear that this groups favors a change in the government of $PlaceName. You believe this house is the headquarters of the rebel movement.
column2: 审视一张遗落的传单后，显而易见，此团体倾向于变革$PlaceName的政局。你认定此宅乃叛军之总部。

column1: After further conversation, you learn that the most likely candidate will lead a core group who $Support changes in the city government.
column2: 经过进一步交谈，你得知最有可能的候选人将领导一个核心群体，他们$Support市政府的变革。

column1: After further conversation, you learn that the person most likely to be this new leader leads a faction who $Support changes in the city government.
column2: 经过进一步交谈，你得知这位最有可能成为新领袖的人领导着一个主张$Support市政府变革的派系。

column1: After further conversation, you learn that the person most likely to be this new leader will lead a faction who $Support changes in the city government.
column2: 进一步交谈后，你得知，最有可能成为新领袖的人将带领一个 $Support 市政府变革的派系。

column1: After further conversation, you learn that the person most likely to be this new leader will speak for a group that $Support changes in the city government.
column2: 经过进一步交谈，你得知这位最有可能成为新领袖的人，将代表一个主张$Support市政府变革的群体发言。

column1: After hours of searching, $ChosenOneName says, "This is hopeless. Everyone's mumbling in Latin and laughing behind our backs. We'll never find an alchemist this way!"
column2: 经过数小时的搜寻，$ChosenOneName说道：“这毫无希望。人人都在用拉丁语喃喃自语，还暗地里嘲笑我们。这样下去，我们永远也找不到炼金术士！”

column1: After hours of searching, you are completely frustrated. Everybody is just trying to make you feel stupid.
column2: 经过数小时的搜寻，你已彻底沮丧。人人都在让你觉得自己愚蠢。

column1: After hours of searching, you haven't found anyone who admits to any alchemical knowledge, much less possession of a philosopher's stone. Latin terms, arrogant students, and supercilious staff intimidate and befuddle you. You have never felt more stupid in your life.
column2: 经过数小时的搜寻，你仍未找到任何承认掌握炼金术之人，更遑论持有贤者之石。拉丁术语、傲慢的学生与目中无人的教职人员令你既畏惧又困惑。此生从未如此自感愚钝。

column1: After hours of work, a final liquid fizzes over the stone, changing it to pure, white marble. You have banished the evil forever, replacing it with good.
column2: 经过数小时的劳作，最后一滴液体在石上泛起泡沫，将其化为纯净的白色大理石。你已将邪恶永远驱逐，代之以善。

column1: After judging you for a few moments, $NamedOneName apparently finds you worthy.
column2: 审视你片刻后，$NamedOneName 显然认为你配得上。

column1: After listening to what people consider news here, you wonder what keeps them awake from one day to the next!
column2: 听罢此地的坊间传闻，你不禁疑惑，究竟是什么让他们日复一日、夜不能寐！

column1: After making a brave start, $ChosenOneName suddenly slips and falls. You rush over and find $him injured but alive.
column2: 勇敢起步之后，$ChosenOneName 突然滑倒摔落。你急忙赶去，发现 你 受伤但尚存气息。

column1: After midnight, a cloaked figure comes to the guildhouse rear door and receives an envelope from the guild's leader. When the messenger leaves, you follow and waylay him with naked steel.
column2: 午夜过后，一名披着斗篷的身影来到公会大厅后门，从公会会长手中接过一只信封。待使者离去，你尾随其后，以赤裸的钢刃将其截住。

column1: After nightfall, the sidestreets of $PlaceName are deserted. The fearful citizens are staying indoors. You turn toward...
column2: 夜幕降临后，$PlaceName的侧街空无一人。胆怯的市民都躲在家中。你转向...

column1: After offering a quick prayer, $ChosenOneName is favored by instant enlightenment.
column2: 献上简短祷告后，$ChosenOneName 得到瞬间的启迪。

column1: After robbing you, the men-at-arms roughly march you to the nearest city, where you are unceremoniously dumped into the dungeon.
column2: 抢劫了你之后，那些士兵粗暴地把你押送到最近的城市，在那里你被毫不客气地扔进了地牢。

column1: After shouts of approval, $NamedOneName continues...
column2: 经过一阵喝彩，$NamedOneName继续说道……

column1: After sizing you up, $NamedOneName shows you a heavy purse. When it is opened, you see $Money1 inside.
column2: 打量一番后，$NamedOneName向你展示了一个沉重的钱袋。打开一看，里面装着$Money1。

column1: After some adroit discussion, you convince the local city guardsmen to abandon their guard on the doors and rejoin their neighbors in the crowd.
column2: 经过一番巧妙的交谈，你劝说当地城卫放弃了守门之责，与众人一同融入了人群。

column1: After some careful consideration, $NamedOneName makes his offer:
column2: 经过一番深思熟虑，$NamedOneName提出了他的条件：

column1: After some careful conversations, you arrange for the sergeant and his friends to leave by a small sally port. In return, this port will give you free entry into the fortress. He warns you that the $CityLordTitle is protected by a loyal group of personal guards, who must be overcome.
column2: 经过一番谨慎的交谈，你安排了军曹及其同伴从一处小型突袭门离开。作为回报，此门将为你提供进入要塞的自由通行权。他警告你，$CityLordTitle由一群忠心耿耿的贴身护卫守护，必须将其击败。

column1: After some careful discussion, $NamedOneName ultimately shakes his head. "I'm sorry, but none of your formulas interest me sufficiently to offer an exchange."
column2: 经过一番慎重商议，$NamedOneName终究摇了摇头。“抱歉，阁下的方剂皆不足以令我动心，无法达成交换。”

column1: After some discussion, you discover that the following formulas can be purchased:
column2: 经过一番商议，你发现可购买以下法术：

column1: After some friendly chat in which you convince the guard you are neighbor nobles ready to join his satanic cause, the man points to a window in the guardpost.
column2: 经过一番友好的交谈，你让守卫相信你们是准备加入他那撒旦事业的邻近贵族，于是那人指向岗哨上的一个窗户。

column1: After speaking to traders, you decide that they currently $Support changes in the government of the city.
column2: 与商人交谈后，你得知他们目前支持该市的$Support项政府改革。

column1: After speaking to various merchants and clerks, you decide that the merchants of $PlaceName currently $Support changes in the government of the city.
column2: 与各商贾及职员交谈后，你得知$PlaceName的商人目前正$Support市政府的变革。

column1: After that, the most important man in $PlaceName is $NamedOneName, Captain of the City Guard. Nearly equal to him is $NamedTwoName, spokesman of the burghers, and the $CityLordTitle, $CityLordName. The various local merchants of $PlaceName also have a large voice.
column2: 此后，$PlaceName城中最为重要之人乃$NamedOneName，即城卫队长。与之相埒者有$NamedTwoName，为市民之代言人；另有$CityLordTitle、$CityLordName。$PlaceName诸地商贾亦颇具声望。

column1: After the careful prayers of $ChosenTwoName, you suddenly see the rebel leader in an upstairs window.
column2: 在$ChosenTwoName的虔诚祈祷之后，你突然在楼上的窗户里看到了叛军首领。

column1: After the darkness, you awaken to horrible pain. You lie broken and bleeding in a gully. The assassins didn't quite finish you off, but $ChosenOneName is dead -- cleanly beheaded! Shaken and bleeding, you bind each others' wounds and assess your situation.
column2: 黑暗过后，你于剧痛中醒来。你身负重伤，血流不止，倒在一条沟壑之中。刺客们并未将你彻底杀死，但$ChosenOneName已死——头颅被斩落！惊魂未定、血流不止的你们互相包扎伤口，审视当前处境。

column1: After the darkness, you awaken to horrible pain. You lie broken and bleeding in a gully. The assassins didn't quite finish you off. Shaken and bleeding, you bind each others' wounds and assess your situation.
column2: 黑暗过后，你于剧痛中醒来。你身负重伤，血流不止，躺在一条沟壑之中。刺客们并未将你彻底击倒。惊魂未定、血迹斑斑的你们互相包扎伤口，审视当前处境。

column1: After the last demon falls, the whole area is engulfed in a hideous stink. Despite this, you are satisfied with your triumph over evil.
column2: 最后一个恶魔倒下后，整片区域被一股恶臭笼罩。尽管如此，你仍为战胜邪恶而感到满足。

column1: After the prayer to Saint Reinold by $ChosenTwoName, you all feel a bit strange. Suddenly you see easy handholds and footholds on the $fortress walls. Climbing to the top is mere child's play, as easy as climbing stairs. Awed, the guardsmen shy away from you, but inside, the personal guard of the $CityLordTitle still protect him.
column2: 在向圣莱诺德祈祷后，$ChosenTwoName，你们都感到有些异样。突然间，你看到$fortress的墙壁上出现了许多易于攀爬的把手和脚点。攀登至顶峰不过是小儿科，如同登梯一般轻松。卫兵们惊愕地退避三舍，但内部，$CityLordTitle的亲卫仍守护着他。

column1: After the wounds are examined and dressed, the physician uses leeches to draw out the vile humors, then asks you to swallow a noxious-smelling physick intended to renew your strength and good health.
column2: 伤口检查并包扎完毕后，医师用医蛭吸出恶毒的体液，随后让你吞下一种气味难闻的药剂，以恢复你的体力与健康。

column1: After thinking for quite a stretch of time, the Schulz shakes his head and says, "I can think of nothing we could do to assist such mighty folk. Our poverty and humble surroundings prevent us. Please forgive us."
column2: 沉思良久，舒尔茨摇了摇头，说道：“对于如此强大的诸位，我们实在无能为力。家贫地陋，还望见谅。”

column1: After this disaster, you have no choice but to attend the injured, abandoning any further attempts today.
column2: 此灾之后，你别无选择，只得照料伤者，暂且放弃今日的其他尝试。

column1: After uttering a short prayer under $his breath, $ChosenOneName suddenly receives a vision. The Schulz's appearance changes brutally. His face darkens, and gross tusks protrude from his champing mouth. Enormous horns disfigure his scalp. A calm, clear voice whispers to $ChosenOneName , "This is the true appearance of the devil that controls the Schulz's actions."
column2: 在你的低声念诵完一段祷文后，$ChosenOneName骤然间获得一瞥异象。舒尔茨的容貌骤然狰狞，面容阴沉，粗大的獠牙从他咬合的口中伸出，巨大的犄角扭曲了他的头皮。一个平静而清晰的声音在$ChosenOneName耳边低语：“这才是操控舒尔茨行为的恶魔真容。”

column1: After very little additional discussion, he professes to see the complete justice of your cause. You remark that such views make him your friend, and it would never do if a friend was brought down by such terrible accusations. It is obvious that you have bought his loyalty with something more powerful than mere coinage.
column2: 经过极少的进一步商议，他便宣称完全认同你的正义。你指出，如此见解使他成为你的盟友，而绝不能让一位盟友因这般可怕的指控而身败名裂。显而易见，你以远胜于金钱之物收买了他的忠诚。

column1: After waiting for $Number1 hours, you are finally ushered into the audience chamber.
column2: 等待了$Number1小时后，你终于被引入觐见厅。

column1: After waiting for $Number1 hours, you are finally ushered into the council chamber.
column2: 等待了$Number1小时后，你终于被引入议事厅。

column1: After you leave, you count the money. The Hansards have given you $Money1! A worthwhile sum.
column2: 离开后，你清点银两。汉萨商人给了你$Money1！一笔可观的数目。

column1: After you surrender, the soldiers satisfy themselves with verbal jabs at your expense (after inspecting your pouches for items of interest). They then dutifully march you off to the city dungeon, where other minds than theirs will decide what to do with you.
column2: 你投降后，士兵们在搜查你的囊袋以寻找感兴趣之物时，便用言语嘲讽你以取乐。随后，他们尽职地将你押往城中地牢，由他人来决定如何处置你。

column1: After your defeat, the Wild Hunter arrives. While his savage minions brutally devour the hapless schrat, he chortles. "Today I take the schrat's life and soul. Next time I come for you!"
column2: 战败之后，狂野猎人现身。他那群凶残的爪牙正残忍地吞噬着可怜的施拉特，而他则狞笑着道：“今日我夺走施拉特的性命与灵魂，下次便轮到你了！”

column1: After your defeat, the monsters search your bodies, taking all your gear with cacophonic delight. Then, to your horror, the gargoyles grab $ChosenOneName and fly off with $him. You know $he will never be seen again in this world.
column2: 战败后，怪物们搜刮你的尸体，带着刺耳的欢笑声夺走你所有的装备。随后，令你惊恐的是，石像鬼抓住了$ChosenOneName，并带着你飞走了。你知道你再也不会出现在这个世界上了。

column1: After your fight, you hear a noise, and turn with a start. The Wild Hunt's prey has returned to thank you. But he is not human! He is a schrat, a wild man covered with shaggy hair. Their women, holzfraus, are even rarer to behold.
column2: 战斗之后，你听到一阵声响，猛然回头。狂猎的猎物回来了，要向你道谢。但他并非人类！他乃一名施拉特，一个浑身长满蓬乱毛发的野人。他们的女性，木妇，更是难得一见。

column1: Aha! You must seek out some sort of Hellgate inside the caves ahead.
column2: 啊哈！你必须在前方的洞穴中寻觅某种地狱之门。

column1: Aha! You must seek out some sort of spurting lava cone inside the caves ahead.
column2: 啊哈！你必须在前方的洞穴中寻找某种喷涌的熔岩锥。

column1: Aha! You must seek out some sort of tomb inside the caves ahead.
column2: 啊哈！你必须在前方的洞穴中寻觅某种墓穴。

column1: Ahead of you, down a narrow corridor, is the $NamedOneName. Clearly it is a peace offering from the dwarf, who must be hoping you will take it and leave him alone. Carefully you retrieve it, wait until the mist clears, then climb down and out of the dwarf's lair. You've had enough dealings with such dangerous characters!
column2: 在你前方，一条狭窄的走廊尽头是$NamedOneName。显然，这是矮人献上的和平之礼，他一定希望你收下它后便不再打扰他。你小心翼翼地取回它，待雾气散去，便攀下洞穴，离开了矮人的巢穴。与这般危险之徒打交道，你已受够了！

column1: Ahead you see a few heavy wagons moving slowly along the road, guarded by a small party of soldiers. As you get closer, it appears to be a small merchant caravan. You decide to...
column2: 前方可见数辆沉重的马车沿路缓缓前行，由一小队士兵护卫。待你靠近，方知乃是一支小型商队。你决定……

column1: Ahead you see the pavilion of a traveling alchemist. Frowning guards stand up and pull out weapons. The alchemist steps out of his tent, and hefts a nasty-looking potion in one hand. He speaks. "Halt! Hand over all alchemical materiel. We will give you a fair price, but we need it now."
column2: 前方可见一位游历炼金术士的帐篷。皱眉的卫兵起身拔出武器。炼金术士走出帐幕，一手举起一瓶模样凶恶的药水。他开口道：“站住！交出所有炼金材料。我们会给你一个公道的价格，但我们现在就需要。”

column1: Ahead you see the spires of $PlaceName. A party of mounted officers and delegates are riding out to meet you. $NamedOneName turns to you and says, "Thank you for your assistance. I will report on your helpfulness to the city's rulers."

column1: Ahead, on the road, you see a party of pilgrims. Their leader, a frail old friar, greets you. You ask their destination.
column2: 前方，路上，你看见一队朝圣者。他们的领队，一位瘦弱的老修士，向你致意。你询问他们的目的地。

column1: Alas, because of your poor reputation here, your halting speech and unpleasing countenances, the monks turn you away. In fact, they dispatch a small mounted party to escort you past the limits of the monastery's lands.
column2: 唉，由于你在此地声名狼藉，言语笨拙且相貌不佳，修士们将你拒之门外。事实上，他们还派出一支小队骑马护送你离开修道院的领地边界。

column1: Alas, the boars are unaffected by your attempt to call on $NamedOneName.
column2: 可惜，野猪对你的呼唤 $NamedOneName 无动于衷。

column1: Alas, the kidnappers and $ChosenOneName are long gone. You keenly feel a sense of failure.
column2: 唉，绑匪和$ChosenOneName早已远去。你深切地感受到一种失败的滋味。

column1: Alas, the prayers of $ChosenOneName are not answered. The dark skies, biting wind and rolling thunder continue ominously.
column2: 唉，$ChosenOneName的祈祷未获回应。阴沉的天空、凛冽的寒风与滚滚雷声依旧不祥地持续着。

column1: Alas, the prayers of $ChosenOneName have no effect. However, the people are moved by your efforts and piety. They promise to pray for and bless your names as long as they live. Unfortunately, you suspect this won't be for much longer. Soon it's time to wave goodbye and journey onward.
column2: 唉，$ChosenOneName的祈祷毫无效果。然而，人们被你的努力与虔诚所感动。他们发誓终生为你祈福、祝福。可惜，你怀疑这日子不会太长了。不久便要挥手告别，继续前行。

column1: Alas, the prayers of $ChosenOneName have no effect. The bandits snarl and surge forward, weapons swinging.
column2: 可惜，$ChosenOneName的祈祷毫无作用。匪徒咆哮着扑上前去，刀剑挥舞。

column1: Alas, the saint will not answer your pleas. The Wild Hunt draws ever nearer and the heavens are closed. Was ever man in a worse predicament?
column2: 唉，圣人不会回应你的祈求。狂野猎手愈发逼近，天穹已闭。可曾有人处境更糟？

column1: Alas, the stinging snow whips about $ChosenOneName as $he prays and prays. There is no respite from the storm.
column2: 唉，刺骨的雪在$ChosenOneName中呼啸，而你仍在不停地祈祷。暴风雪丝毫未有停歇之意。

column1: Alas, there is no sign of a door. With the last of your strength, you crawl to the ledge and roll off, falling to the rocks and trees below.
column2: 唉，毫无门的踪迹。你用尽最后的力气，爬到岩缘，翻身落下，坠入下方的岩石与树木之间。

column1: Alas, though the saint did not reply, $NamedOneName noticed your attempt to call for divine aid. His beard bristles.
column2: 唉，虽圣人未答，$NamedOneName却察觉你欲祈求神助。其胡须耸立。

column1: Alas, your attempt at fair speech and a winning manner fail to impress the monks, who turn you away. Disappointed, you wonder about the effect on your reputation in nearby cities.
column2: 唉，你试图以公道之言与得体之态打动修士们，却未能如愿，他们将你拒之门外。失望之余，你不禁忧虑这会对你在附近城市的声誉造成何种影响。

column1: Alas, your manner lacks charm, your speech is far from fair, and neither local reputation nor fame are sufficient to recoup the debacle.
column2: 唉，你的举止乏善可陈，言辞亦不中听，无论地方声望还是世间名望，皆不足以弥补这场败局。

column1: Alas, your skill in casual conversation is not so great. You learn some trivial news, but nothing of consequence you did not already know.
column2: 唉，你在闲谈之道上尚欠火候。虽得知些许琐事，却无一关乎要旨，皆是你早已知晓之事。

column1: All of you, even $ChosenOneName, successfully get across without tripping or falling. You all take a little damage from the fire and are frozen somewhat by the icy hail (numbing your agility).
column2: 你们众人，连同$ChosenOneName在内，皆安然渡过，未有失足跌落。然皆受火焰灼伤，并为冰雹所冻（使敏捷受损）。

column1: All seven heads of the dragon chortle hatefully when you abase yourselves before it. You feel depressed and know that you have failed Heaven. The dragon then gloats, "Now, give me $ChosenOneName as mine chosen."
column2: 当你们向巨龙卑躬屈膝时，其七颗头颅齐声狞笑。你们心生沮丧，深知已令天意蒙羞。巨龙遂得意洋洋道：“如今，将$ChosenOneName献予我，作为我的选民。”

column1: All the guilds are busy with army orders. Soldiers and officers bustle back and forth officiously. Glancing at the picture signs on each street, you turn toward...
column2: 各公会皆忙于军令。士兵与军官往来穿梭，忙碌不已。瞥见各街坊的图示招牌，你转向……

column1: All the swine are dead or fled. You pry out their tusks (they are thought to be good luck charms), then slice off some pork to roast and eat on the way.
column2: 所有野猪或死或逃。你撬出它们的獠牙（据说能带来好运），再割下些猪肉，路上烤来吃。

column1: All the upstairs offices are securely locked. Moving quietly, you head toward...
column2: 楼上的所有办公室都牢牢锁着。你悄然前行，朝...走去。

column1: All the wolves are dead or have fled. You sigh with relief at surviving their ferocious attack.
column2: 狼群尽亡或已逃窜。你因幸免于它们的凶猛袭击而长舒一口气。

column2: 不多时，圣殿骑士便点燃了堆于你双腿之侧的柴束。烟雾与灼热渐渐将你吞噬。

column1: Almost invisibly, $ChosenOneName flicks the potion into the air. You all turn away as a bright light explodes with a loud pop.
column2: 几乎不可见地，$ChosenOneName 将药剂抛向空中。众人皆转过身去，只见一道耀眼的光芒伴随着一声巨响骤然绽放。

column2: 沿着幽暗的街道，你终于发现一块刻有真正炼金术符号的招牌。不幸的是，你也看到门上写着：“凡扰我安眠者，必遭痛苦之险。”在这段文字周围，你能辨认出代表伤害与死亡的炼金术符号。

column1: Alternately, you could pretend to be ordinary wayfarers and wander through the area, hoping to draw the attention of the raubritter's men.

column2: 尽管你竭力尝试，$ChosenTwoName的祈祷却未见任何明显成效。

column2: 虽然忙碌，店员最终还是与你商谈事务。然而，显而易见，你并无任何能令$CityLordTitle感兴趣的能力。店员便将你打发走了。

column1: Although confident he lacks such powers, you decide it's only polite to humor him for the next few days.
column2: 尽管确信自己并无此等法力，你仍决定在接下来的几日里礼数周到地顺其心意。

column1: Although everyone has suffered a little from the experience, nobody is seriously weakened. You now consider how to resume your travels...
column2: 尽管众人皆受此番经历之苦，却无人重伤。尔等如今思忖如何继续前行……

column2: 虽简朴，牢房倒也颇为安全。晚餐不过是些厨余，谈不上高贵，却也能稍稍缓解饥肠辘辘。不久，你便沉沉睡去。

column2: 虽然药剂炸得甚是漂亮，却似乎无从利用。四处皆见人朝你奔来。每当你望向敞开的门或窗，惊愕的住户便回望着你，询问缘由。

column2: 虽然他们的个人兴趣乏味，但你从职员处得知，汉萨同盟成员$Support正在推动$PlaceName的政府变革。

column2: 虽你竭尽全力，可怜的$ChosenOneName仍难跟上步伐，渐落于后。你转身欲救你，而

column1: Although your lives may be sacrificed to evil, your souls still belong to Heaven.
column2: 尽管你们的生命可能献祭于邪恶，但你们的灵魂仍归于天国。

column1: Although your request is uncommon, the jewelers are willing to provide you with a carefully weighed bag of gold dust, taking your $Money1 in exchange.
column2: 虽然你的请求颇为罕见，珠宝商仍愿为你提供一袋精心称重的金粉，并以你的$Money1作为交换。

column1: Amazed by your sudden surrender, the priest makes you kneel before him. Then he sings, "Your energy shall be one with the dragon's lair. My holy cross shall tap you as it did the monster." You feel divine favor draining from you, and try to leap up and escape, but you are too woozy. Soon you fall unconscious.
column2: 你突然屈服，令牧师大为惊异，他让你跪在他面前。随后他唱道：“你的元气将与龙穴融为一体。我的圣十字将如对那怪物一般，汲取你的力量。”你感到神圣的庇佑正从体内流失，试图跃起逃脱，却已头晕目眩。不久便昏厥过去。

column1: Ambush! A well-armed party led by an armored knight charges from concealed positions around you. They say nothing and demand nothing, which means they must be hired assassins. Since you're surrounded, your options are limited:
column2: 伏击！一支由身披重甲的骑士率领的全副武装队伍从你周围的隐蔽处冲出。他们一言不发，也未提出任何要求，这说明他们是受雇的刺客。既然已被包围，你的选择便十分有限：

column1: Amid a pile of dry leaves, you spot the $NamedOneName. As you pick it up, $ChosenOneName hears a dry rustling hiss. A tatzelwurm streaks from the dark interior, striking to kill!
column2: 在一堆枯叶中，你发现了$NamedOneName。当你拾起它时，$ChosenOneName听到了一阵干涩的嘶嘶声。一条塔策尔蠕虫从黑暗深处窜出，直扑而来，意图致命一击！

column1: Amid the broken bodies of the dead witches, you find curious little crude statues made of pottery or stone. Many of these are broken. When you look more closely, you realize they are roughly-formed representations of a winged dragon!
column2: 在那些死去女巫的残骸之中，你发现了用陶土或石头制成的奇特小雕像。许多雕像已破碎。当你仔细端详时，才意识到它们竟是粗陋的飞龙形象！

column1: Amid the confusion of travellers approaching from the path, the fires, and the activity within the ring of guards, you manage to make your way through the rough underbrush and enter the field.
column2: 在旅人自小径而来、火光熊熊、卫兵环列的纷乱之中，你穿行于茂密的灌木丛，终于踏入了那片田野。

column1: Among the leader's letters, you find one from $NamedOneName, a local woman currently living in the $monastery. In it she complains that the leader has failed to keep up the payments for a certain powerful poison. She warns him that this is a dangerous course of action!
column2: 在领袖的信件中，你发现了一封来自$NamedOneName的信，她是一位目前居住在$monastery的当地女子。她在信中抱怨领袖未能按时支付某种剧毒的费用。她警告他，此举极为危险！

column1: Amused at the demon's effective and total defeat, you proceed. The villagers come up to you, laughing. "Thank you for saving our bridge! Thank you! Thank you!" You enter the village.
column2: 见恶魔被彻底击败，你不禁莞尔，继续前行。村民们笑着围上来：“多谢你救了我们的桥！多谢！多谢！”你步入村庄。

column1: An addled farmer is the butt of many jokes. He claims he saw a dragon, but nobody believes him.
column2: 一个头脑糊涂的农夫成了众人的笑柄。他声称看见了一条龙，但无人相信。

column2: 一名相貌凶狠的矮人怒视着你，双眉倒竖。你对他感到不安，于是……

column2: 一位身穿围裙、头戴厨师帽的老妪，咧着无牙的嘴向你走来。

column1: An elderly, clear-eyed monk bows and asks your business. You explain that you...
column2: 一位年迈而目光清澈的僧侣躬身问道，不知阁下有何贵干。你解释道，你...

column1: An enormous clawprint scars the landscape. $ChosenOneName realizes it is the spoor of a dragon.
column2: 一道巨大的爪印划破大地。$ChosenOneName意识到那是龙的足迹。

column1: An old, sharp-eyed monk looks at you through a barred gate.
column2: 一位年迈、目光锐利的僧侣透过带栅栏的门打量着你。

column1: An older monk cracks the door and shines his lantern in your eyes.
column2: 一位年长的僧侣轻轻推开房门，用手中的灯笼照向你的双眼。

column1: An overwhelming sense of importance suddenly strikes $ChosenOneName. $He realizes that something vital lies here, near the spring. $He also senses peace and serenity about this place; there is no immediate danger here.
column2: 一股压倒性的使命感猛然袭来，$ChosenOneName顿悟。你意识到，此处泉边潜藏着至关重要的秘密。你亦觉此地祥和宁谧，暂无危难之虞。

column1: An unbearable stench billows forth. The guards choke and sprawl onto the ground. Holding your breath, you rush past the incapacitated guards.
column2: 一股难忍的恶臭扑面而来。守卫们呛得倒在地上。你屏住呼吸，冲过那些失去行动力的守卫。

column1: And still they attack, wielding their cudgels and pitchforks. The carnage is frightful, but their morale is beginning to waver.
column2: 而他们依旧挥舞着棍棒与叉子发起进攻。杀戮惨烈，但他们的士气已开始动摇。

column1: Angrily, the enemy leader orders $ChosenOneName bound, then strips you of all arms, armor, and valuables.
column2: 敌首怒令将$ChosenOneName缚住，又剥去你所有兵甲与珍宝。

column1: Angrily, the priest storms in, followed by a small crowd of acolytes, altar-boys, and others. "You have stayed long enough! Depart now or face the wrath of the Holy Church!"
column2: 怒气冲冲地，牧师闯入，身后跟着一群小侍者、祭坛童子及其他随从。“你已逗留太久！速速离去，否则将遭圣教会之怒！”

column1: Angry and embarrassed, you leave immediately.
column2: 愤怒而羞愧，你立刻离去。

column1: Angry with your delay in a matter vital to $him, $ChosenOneName warns that $he joined your party with a specific goal in mind.
column2: 对于你在关乎你要事上的拖延，$ChosenOneName怒不可遏，并警告说你加入你的队伍是有特定目的的。

column1: Angry, $NamedOneName curses you long and hard for your perfidious betrayal of the cause. However, $ChosenOneName's charm and soothing words eventually reconcile him. He agrees to employ you once more, on the same terms as before.
column2: $NamedOneName 因你对事业的背信弃义而怒斥你良久。然而，$ChosenOneName 的魅力与温言终使他释怀。他同意再次聘用你，条件如初。

column1: Angry, $NamedThreeName shouts at your retreat, "Your cowardice at the critical hour will be remembered here in $PlaceName!"
column2: 愤怒的$NamedThreeName对着你的退却喊道：“你在关键时刻的怯懦，将在这$PlaceName被铭记！”

column1: Angry, the friar shouts, "True sinners, I knew it! As you waste the charity of Our Lord, so shall I curse you with the wasting disease."
column2: 怒气冲冲的修士高喊道：“果然是罪人！尔等既糟蹋主之恩惠，便当受我诅咒，罹患恶疾！”

column1: Angry, the huntsman shouts, "Ridiculous, eh? Let's see how ridiculous you find this!" He and his men attack immediately.
column2: 愤怒的猎人喊道：“可笑，是吧？且看你是否还觉得可笑！”他与手下立刻发动攻击。

column1: Another voice comments, "the hard part will be marching the prisoners back to $Text4 for trial."
column2: 另一个声音评论道：“最难的将是押解囚犯返回$Text4受审。”

column1: Answering your call, $NamedOneName cracks a hole in the wall big enough to crawl through. You are free at last.
column2: 应你之召，$NamedOneName 在墙上凿出一个足以匍匐而过的洞口。你终得自由。

column1: Any confessions or proof of this would, of course, ruin him. Of course, to prove it, you would either need to convince his mother to confess, or find indisputable proof.
column2: 任何供认或证据，当然都会毁了他。当然，要证明这一点，要么得说服他的母亲招供，要么就得找到无可辩驳的证据。

column1: Apologetically, the nuns refuse your kind offer. "We have so much labor to do, we have no time to train and educate a novice at the work."
column2: 修女们歉然拒绝了你的善意：“我们事务繁重，无暇教导新入门的学徒。”

column1: Appalled, you quickly confer together. It is clear that you cannot defeat this vast host. Perhaps you could not defeat even one of them.
column2: 惊骇之下，你们迅速商议。显而易见，你们无法击败这支庞大的军队。或许，连其中一人也难以战胜。

column1: Apprentices are guarding the guild's buildings like starving hawks. This defeats your best strategems. You curse the earlier blundering that put them on the alert.
column2: 学徒们如饥饿的鹰隼般守卫着公会的建筑。这使得你最好的计策都付诸东流。你诅咒自己早先的鲁莽，竟让他们提高了警惕。

column1: Apprentices are guarding the guild's buildings like starving hawks. This defeats your best strategems. Your curse the earlier blundering that put them on alert.
column2: 学徒们如饥似渴的鹰隼般守卫着公会的建筑。这使你最好的计策都付诸东流。你诅咒自己先前的鲁莽，才让他们警觉起来。

column1: Approaching the weird stump, you see a glint inside. Chopping it open, you find a large seed inside, the size of a man's head. It is clearly some sort of supernatural product, which the demons fought to keep from you. Packing it away carefully, you carry it with you.
column2: 逼近那怪异的树桩，你见其内有微光闪烁。劈开一看，竟有一颗硕大的种子，足有人头般大小。显而易见，此乃超凡之物，众魔竭力争夺，欲将其据为己有。你小心翼翼地收起，随身携带。

column1: Approaching, you see they have a Franciscan friar tied to the stake, and are busy piling faggots and brush around his feet. While the Franciscan prays softly with his eyes closed, the Templars argue.
column2: 你走近时，见他们将一名方济各会修士绑在木桩上，正忙着在他脚下堆起柴草。修士闭目轻声祈祷，而圣殿骑士们却在争论不休。

column1: Around midnight, you see a cloaked woman sneak up to a small back door. Quietly she is let inside. A few hours later, she leaves again. You follow and confront her as she is about to enter another building.
column2: 午夜时分，你见一披斗篷女子悄然潜至一扇后门。她被悄然放了进去。数小时后，她再度离去。你尾随其后，在她即将进入另一栋建筑时将其拦下。

column1: Around midnight, you see a cloaked woman sneak up to a small back door. Quietly she is let inside. A few hours later, she leaves again. You follow her and eventually catch up just as she is about to enter her home.
column2: 午夜时分，你见一披斗篷女子悄然潜至一扇后门。她被悄然放了进去。数小时后，她再度离去。你尾随其后，终在其即将入宅之际追上。

column1: Around midnight, you see a cloaked woman sneak up to a small back door. Quietly she is let inside. A few hours later, she leaves again. You follow her and eventually catch up just as she is entering her home.
column2: 午夜时分，你见一披斗篷女子悄然潜至一扇后门。她被悄然放了进去。数小时后，她又离去。你尾随其后，终在她入宅之际追上。

column1: Around midnight, you see a cloaked woman sneak up to a small back door. Quietly she is let inside. A few hours later, she leaves again. You follow her and eventually catch up.
column2: 午夜时分，你见一披斗篷女子悄然潜至一后门。她被悄然放了进去。数小时后，她又离去。你尾随其后，终追上。

column1: Around midnight, you see a cloaked woman sneak up to a small back door. Quietly, she is let inside. A few hours later, she leaves again. You follow and catch up to her just as she is about to enter her own home.
column2: 午夜时分，你见一披斗篷女子悄然潜至一后门。她被悄然放了进去。数小时后，她又离去。你尾随其后，正赶上她欲入自家门扉之际。

column1: As $ChosenOneName addresses the crowd, the level of tension quickly decreases. With impassioned words, $he pleads with the citizens.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName向人群致辞时，紧张的气氛迅速缓和。你以充满激情的言辞恳求市民们。

column1: As $ChosenOneName addresses the crowd, they become more and more restless. Finally, they begin pelting you with tomatoes and other rotten fruit. You take cover and decide to...
column2: 当$ChosenOneName向人群讲话时，他们变得越来越不安。最终，他们开始向你投掷西红柿和其他腐烂的水果。你找地方躲起来，决定……

column1: As $ChosenOneName drinks, $he feels a chill come over $his body. An evil influence hangs over $him like a cloud, but $his corporeal being is greatly strengthened and toughened. $He feels invulnerable!
column2: 当$ChosenOneName饮酒时，你感到一阵寒意袭遍你的全身。一股邪恶之力如乌云般笼罩着你，但你的肉身却得到了极大的强化与坚韧。你觉得自己刀枪不入！

column1: As $ChosenOneName finishes $his prayer, a great light illuminates the area around you. Bandits leap up from ambush, as if bitten by ants, and dash away. You all shrug, and continue onward safely.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName结束你的祈祷时，一道强光照亮了你周围的区域。伏击的匪徒如被蚂蚁叮咬般猛然跃起，四散奔逃。你们耸耸肩，安然继续前行。

column1: As $ChosenOneName finishes $his prayer, a great light illuminates the area around you. Ragged soldiers leap up from ambush as if stung by ants, and dash away. You shrug and continue safely onward.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName结束你的祈祷时，一道强光照亮了你周围的区域。衣衫褴褛的士兵仿佛被蚂蚁蜇了一下般从埋伏中跃起，飞奔而去。你耸耸肩，继续安然前行。

column1: As $ChosenOneName finishes $his prayer, a sense of peace pervades the area. The bandits lower their weapons and withdraw, looking slightly embarassed by their actions. You nod and go onward, unharmed and in peace.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName结束你的祈祷时，一股宁静笼罩四周。匪徒们放下武器，退去，对自己的行为略显尴尬。你点头示意，安然无恙地继续前行。

column1: As $ChosenOneName finishes $his prayer, a strange sense of peace seems to pervade the area. Around you, ragged men get up, stretch, and clump together in casual conversation. A few give you a friendly wave or smile.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName结束你的祈祷时，一股奇异的宁静似乎弥漫四周。你身旁衣衫褴褛的男子起身伸展，三五成群地闲聊。几人向你友好地挥手或微笑。

column1: As $ChosenOneName finishes $his prayer, a strange sense of peace seems to pervade the area. Around you, ragged mercenary soldiers get up, stretch, and clump together in casual conversation. A few give you a friendly wave or smile.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName结束你的祈祷时，一股奇异的宁静似乎弥漫四周。你身旁衣衫褴褛的雇佣兵士兵起身伸展，三五成群地闲聊。几人向你友好地挥手或微笑。

column1: As $ChosenOneName finishes $his prayer, a strange sense of peace seems to pervade the area. Soldiers get up, come over and wave you forward in a friendly fashion.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName结束你的祈祷时，一股奇异的宁静似乎弥漫于四周。士兵们起身走来，友好地示意你向前。

column1: As $ChosenOneName finishes $his prayer, a strange sense of peace seems to pervade the area. The soldiers amble down the hillside, observing you carefully.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName结束你的祈祷时，一股奇异的宁静似乎弥漫于四周。士兵们沿着山坡缓缓而下，仔细地打量着你。

column1: As $ChosenOneName finishes $his prayer, proper and beautiful lids suddenly appear over each tomb. The crypt seems brighter, the air fresher, and small beams of sunlight filter through from above.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName结束你的祈祷时，每座墓碑上突然出现了端正而精美的盖板。地穴似乎更加明亮，空气也更为清新，几缕阳光从上方洒落下来。

column1: As $ChosenOneName finishes $his prayer, the pirates suddenly stumble, confused.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName结束你的祈祷时，海盗们突然踉跄，显得困惑。

column1: As $ChosenOneName finishes the invocation, there is a faint whisper of sound borne upon the wind. It hardly seems frightening, but to the wolf it must be the most terrifying thing imaginable: it rears back, snarling, and races into the wilderness, yipping plaintively. Your travelling companions stare at you, awe on their faces. Someone mutters, "Such power."
column2: 当$ChosenOneName完成咒语时，风中传来一阵微弱的低语。这声音看似无害，但对那匹狼而言，却是最可怕的：它仰天长啸，狺狺哀鸣，飞奔入林。同行的旅伴们惊愕地望着你，有人低声说道：“如此神力。”

column1: As $ChosenOneName pours the potion, it turns to mist and disappears into the very air. The stone pillars groan and dust sifts down, but there is no other effect.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName倾倒药剂时，它化作雾气，消散于空气中。石柱发出呻吟，尘埃簌簌落下，却并无其他异象。

column1: As $ChosenOneName prays, a quiet descends on the Hussite group. Slowly, they kneel and join $him, as do the rest of you.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName祈祷时，胡斯派众人渐渐安静下来。他们缓缓跪下，与你一同祈祷，你们其他人也如此。

column1: As $ChosenOneName steps up to the door, $he comments in a whisper, "There are some potions that make this easier." You decide to...
column2: 当$ChosenOneName走到门前时，你低声说道：“有些药剂能让这件事更容易。”你决定……

column1: As $ChosenTwoName finishes the prayer, a bright light suffuses the entire area. The alchemist and the soldiers sink to their knees, moaning.
column2: 当$ChosenTwoName结束祷告时，一道耀眼的光芒笼罩了整个区域。炼金术士和士兵们跪倒在地，呻吟不已。

column1: As $ChosenTwoName prays, a man dressed as a beggar climbs onto a cart. In ringing tones he addresses the crowd, saying that God watches all, observes human justice, and then makes his own judgements. The crowd listens to his words, and is soon convinced that rioting against rightful authority is wrong. The beggar jumps down and leads you into the fortress. As he disappears into the crowd, you notice a halo around his head.
column2: 当$ChosenTwoName祈祷时，一名乞丐打扮的男子爬上一辆马车。他以洪亮的声音对众人说道：上帝俯瞰一切，察鉴人间公义，终将自行裁决。众人聆听其言，不久便信服：反抗正当权威乃非正义之举。乞丐跳下马车，引领你进入要塞。当他融入人群之际，你见其头顶环绕着一道光晕。

column1: As $he feels the saint's answer to $his prayer, $ChosenOneName is heartened. All at once, the eyes of $NamedOneName gleam. He orders his warriors away from the table.
column2: 当你感受到圣人你的祈祷的回应时，$ChosenOneName倍感振奋。霎时间，$NamedOneName双目炯炯有神。他命麾下武士离席。

column1: As $he finishes the prayer, $ChosenOneName is quickly convinced that nothing but an honest widow lives here, along with various half-tame, half-wild animals.
column2: 当你祷告完毕，$ChosenOneName旋即确信：此处唯有贞洁寡妇栖居，另有数种半驯半野之兽相伴。

column1: As fast as thought, $ChosenOneName prays for safety.
column2: 念动之间，$ChosenOneName祈求平安。

column1: As he begins a special curse chant, you...
column2: 当他开始诵念特制的诅咒咒文时，你...

column1: As he bends over the paper, writing out the note, the clerk gives you the familiar litany about letters of credit (bank notes). He explains the letter can be redeemed for cash at any Medici office, for a very modest fee. The Fuggers may also redeem Medici notes. But sometimes they refuse, and anyway, the charges are higher.
column2: 当他伏案书写便笺时，柜员向你重述关于信用状（银行票据）的陈词。他说明此券可在任何美第奇分行兑取现金，手续费极微。富格家族亦可兑付美第奇票据，然有时拒收，且收费更高。

column1: As he drones on and on about the value of rules, you reconsider the situation.
column2: 当他喋喋不休地论及规矩之要，你重新审视局势。

column1: As he writes out the note on bank paper, the clerk gives you the familiar litany about letters of credit (bank notes). He explains the letter can be redeemed for cash at any Fugger bank for a very modest fee. The Medici bank may also redeem Fugger notes, but he carefully explains that sometimes they refuse, and anyway, the charges are higher.
column2: 当他于银行专用纸笺上书写便笺时，柜员复述关于信用状（银行票据）的旧例。他指出此券可在任何富格银行兑取现金，手续费甚微。美第奇银行亦可兑付富格票据，然他谨慎说明：有时拒收，且收费更高。

column1: As soon as $ChosenOneName concludes $his prayer, the scene before $him seems to change. The hut becomes an ugly, stinking pile, occupied by a witch-crone and surrounded by slavering hounds from hell. Then $his vision clears and all is as before.
column2: 一旦$ChosenOneName结束你的祈祷，你眼前景象骤变。茅屋化作污秽恶臭之堆，内住女巫老妪，周遭环伺地狱狂犬。随即你的幻象消散，一切如初。

column1: As soon as it is dark enough, you sneak over and scramble up a rough wall. You find an unguarded window. Quickly clambering inside, you are within the tower.
column2: 夜色渐浓，你悄然潜行，攀上一堵粗糙的墙垣。寻得一扇无人把守的窗扉，迅疾入内，已置身塔楼之中。

column1: As the $CityLordTitle is naming the prisoners in his dungeon, a guard spots you. It almost worked -- but now you have a battle on your hands.
column2: 当$CityLordTitle点名地牢囚犯之际，一名卫兵瞥见了你。险些得手——却招来一场激战。

column1: As the Latin words are muttered, the wolf pricks up its ears. It snarls, and begins a strange, coughing bark.
column2: 随着拉丁咒语低诵，狼耳尖竖起。它狺狺咆哮，继而发出怪异的咳声吠叫。

column1: As the castle lord receives you, his eyes sparkle with joy. "I feared lest you were slain by the hideous worm," says the lord. "The nights of fear are over. I would like to make one of you my heir, ruler of my lands. Will one of you accept?"
column2: 当城堡领主接见你时，双目熠熠生辉。“我曾忧惧汝等为那狰狞巨虫所害，”领主道，“恐惧之夜已逝。吾欲择汝等一人为继承人，统御吾土。可有人应允？”

column1: As the castle lord receives you, his eyes sparkle with joy. "I feared lest you were slain by the hideous worm," says the lord. "You have ended the terror. The nights of fear are over. Nothing I can do can repay this debt, but I will never forget you."
column2: 当城堡领主接见你时，双目熠熠生辉。“我曾忧惧汝等为那狰狞巨虫所害，”领主道，“汝等已终结此祸患。恐惧之夜已逝。纵使倾尽所有，亦难偿此恩，然吾永志不忘。”

column1: As the clerk comes up, you...
column2: 当柜员走近，你……

column1: As the contestants close, both lances slide off their opponent's shields. $ChosenOneName staggers in the saddle, regains control, then wheels about to face the knight once more. The knight has done the same, and again they charge toward each other.
column2: 双方骑士逼近，两支长矛皆滑过对方盾牌。$ChosenOneName在鞍上踉跄，稳住身形，旋即回身再战。骑士亦同，二人再度策马相向。

column1: As the contestants close, both lances slide off their opponents' shields. The knight staggers in his saddle, but regains his balance while wheeling about his horse. Meanwhile, $ChosenOneName has pulled up and turned around. Once again the two charge toward each other!
column2: 双方骑士逼近，两支长矛皆滑过对方盾牌。骑士在鞍上摇晃，却借马转身稳住。与此同时，$ChosenOneName勒缰回身。二人再次冲锋！

column1: As the crowd growls its approval, the guardsmen break into the building and drag out the leaders. As they lead the captives away, you rejoin the sergeant, accompanying him once more.
column2: 观众喝彩声起，卫兵破门而入，押出诸领袖。当他们带走俘虏时，你重返军曹身边，随其同行。

column1: As the demon prince vanishes back into Hell, a lightness comes to your souls that you have not felt since you entered the fortress. Far-off howls of pain sound as music to your ears, as the satanic influence is forcibly removed from the monastary.
column2: 当恶魔王子遁回地狱，你们心头顿觉轻快，自入要塞以来从未如此。远处传来痛苦嚎叫，宛若乐音，因邪祟之力已被强行驱逐出修道院。

column1: As the dust settles, the sky clears. Amid pleasant bird-song, you feel a sense of virtuous accomplishment.
column2: 尘埃落定，天朗气清。鸟鸣婉转，你心怀正直之成就感。

column1: As the evil priest reaches for a knife, you realize you must act now to...
column2: 当邪恶祭司伸手取刀，你意识到须当机立断……

column1: As the guard reaches for the money, he takes a closer look at your faces.
column2: 当卫兵伸手取钱，他细察你的面容。

column1: As the last member of the party steps into the corridor, the floor beneath you begins to shift. Thinking quickly, you...
column2: 当队伍最后一名成员踏入走廊，足下地板开始移位。你急中生智……

column1: As the last of you falls to the wolves' attack, you dimly hear a howl of nearly human glee. It must be hours later before you awaken, bloody and sore.
column2: 当你最后一人被群狼噬杀，隐约听见一声几近人性的狂笑。数小时后，你方醒，遍体鳞伤。

column1: As the mists clear, you look around and see yourselves in an unfamiliar inn. You have saved all the world through your courage and daring. Perhaps you should now retire, leaving future adventures to younger folk. Or perhaps ... just maybe ... there are still a few adventures left you'd like to try.
column2: 雾霭散去，你环顾四周，发现自己身处一间陌生客栈。凭勇气与胆识，你拯救了天下。或许该就此隐退，将未来冒险留给后辈。抑或……也许……尚有几桩奇遇，值得一试。

column1: As the muck closes over $ChosenOneName's struggles, with $his last breath $he curses you:
column2: 当污泥掩埋$ChosenOneName的挣扎，随着你的最后一息，你诅咒你：

column1: As the powder descends over the thugs, they begin to wiggle and itch. You all start chuckling. The surprised bandits whirl around, twisting and scratching.
column2: 当粉末洒落匪徒身上，他们开始蠕动瘙痒。众人忍俊不禁。惊愕的盗贼转身扭动，抓挠不已。

column1: As the prayer to Saint Aidan ends, the wolf pricks up its ears; its tongue lolls out of its mouth and it seems to grin. Then it barks happily and returns to the fire.
column2: 圣艾丹祷告既毕，狼耳竖起，舌垂口外，似含笑意。随即欢吠一声，复归火旁。

column1: As the wagon train moves slowly through the back streets, you wake your friends, then quietly drop off and scuttle away down an alley. Your weapons are missing, but nobody has taken the time to completely strip you of armor and valuables.
column2: 当车队徐行于后街，你唤醒同伴，悄然下车，沿小巷潜逃。武器遗失，然无人悉数剥去甲胄与财物。

column1: As the words of the prayer are sounded, a ripple of something like heat passes across the assembled trophies. The stag horns appear to sway and twist as though a sail blown by the wind.
column2: 祷词响起，一股热流掠过陈列的战利品。鹿角仿佛迎风摇曳，宛若帆影。

column1: As the words of the prayer die away, you casually ask, "But is there no method of escape from this prison?"
column2: 祷词渐歇，你漫不经心问道：“然则此狱岂无脱身之道？”

column1: As they close, $ChosenOneName expertly places $his lance-tip in the center of the knight's shield, while leaning aside so the knight's lance glances away. The well-placed lance suddenly arches up like a bow and snaps, as the knight staggers in his saddle.
column2: 双方逼近，$ChosenOneName巧妙地将你的枪尖对准骑士盾心，同时侧身避让，使骑士之枪擦肩而过。精准的一击骤然弓起，随即折断，骑士在鞍上踉跄。

column1: As victor, the dragon $NamedTwoName is far from magnanimous. In fact, with unerring instinct, it seizes upon $ChosenOneName, and begins to eat $him. While it is engaged in gruesome feasting, the rest of you escape from its lair. Once outside and safe, you mourn the awful death of your friend.
column2: 胜者龙$NamedTwoName远非宽宏大量。它凭本能锁定$ChosenOneName，开始吞噬你。趁其暴食之际，余者逃离巢穴。安然出洞，悼念挚友惨死。

column1: As victor, the dragon $NamedTwoName is far from magnanimous. In fact, with unerring instinct, it seizes upon the most virtuous maiden among you, $ChosenOneName, and begins to eat her horribly. While it is busy, the rest of you are able to escape and soon you are outside the lair, mourning the awful death of your friend.
column2: 胜者龙$NamedTwoName远非宽宏大量。它凭本能锁定汝等中最贤淑之少女$ChosenOneName，开始残酷吞食。趁其进食，其余者得以逃脱，终至巢外，哀悼挚友之殇。

column1: As you advance, $NamedOneName's eyes flare with rage, then he claps a red cap onto his head and vanishes from sight. He has turned invisible!
column2: 当你前行，$NamedOneName双目怒焰喷薄，旋即戴上红帽，身影倏忽不见。他已隐身！

column1: As you advance, the air fills with steam. Grates in the stone floor emit bursts of fire. The atmosphere is ominous, charged with tension.
column2: 当你前行，空气中蒸汽弥漫。石板地面栅缝间喷涌火焰。气氛阴森，紧张逼人。

column1: As you and the city guardsmen lead your captives toward the city dungeon, a crowd of citizens follows you. Up ahead a speaker addresses the mob, inciting them to attack and rescue the rebel leaders. You...
column2: 当你与城卫押解俘虏前往市狱，市民尾随其后。前方有演说者煽动民众，号召劫狱救出叛首。你……

column1: As you approach the door, it is flung open and a man in a guard's uniform barks out, "Who is it? What do you want?" Inside, you see several other guards gathered around a table. You...
column2: 当你接近大门，门扉陡然洞开，一身戎装者厉声喝问：“何人？所为何事？”室内数名卫兵围桌而坐。你……

column1: As you approach, $ChosenOneName suddenly gets a funny feeling about this group. $He looks about carefully, then whispers to the rest of you.
column2: 当你靠近，$ChosenOneName忽觉此群可疑。你四下打量，低声告诫众人。

column1: As you approach, you see that the monks are actually armed and armored, and bear whips.
column2: 当你靠近，但见僧侣皆披甲持械，并执鞭在手。

column1: As you are escorted into the library, your guide whispers, "A gift of $Money1, to 'help maintain the library', would be appreciated."
column2: 当你被引入图书馆，导览悄声道：“若能奉上$Money1之礼，以‘助资维持馆务’，不胜感激。”

column1: As you arrive, $NamedOneName is address a group of citizens. Behind him stands a nervous group of mercenaries. The crowd seems uncertain, and only gives your leader a mild cheer when he finishes. You decide to...
column2: 当你抵达，$NamedOneName正对市民演说。其后伫立一群神色不安的雇佣兵。人群犹疑不定，直至他讲毕，方才报以淡淡掌声。你决定……

column1: As you back off, the lost soul howls, "$NamedTwoName yet lives. Slay him. Slay him!"
column2: 当你退后，亡魂哀号：“$NamedTwoName尚存。诛之！诛之！”

column1: As you batter your way through the wrecked door into the $councilHall, the rain of quarrels increases. The crowd behind you starts retreating, leaving you alone to deal with the defenders inside!
column2: 当你破门而入$councilHall，箭雨愈烈。身后人群开始撤退，只余你独自面对守军！

column1: As you begin the prayer, the guard stares at you in horror. "Unbelievers!" he screams. "Attack them!"
column2: 当你启祷，卫兵惊恐凝视：“异教徒！攻之！”

column1: As you brace for battle, you curse yourselves for having no one guard the camp. No wonder the bandits could sneak up and ambush you!
column2: 当你严阵以待，暗自懊悔未设哨卒守营。难怪盗贼能潜袭突袭！

column1: As you carefully move through a back hall, you accidentally knock over a clock. Quickly you duck out a window, using your rope, before you are discovered.
column2: 当你小心翼翼穿过后堂，不慎撞倒一只钟摆。速从窗跃出，借绳索逃生，以免暴露。

column1: As you carefully move through a back hall, you accidentally knock over a clock. You look for an exit, but all you find is the sound of running feet.
column2: 当你小心翼翼穿过后堂，不慎撞倒一只钟摆。你寻找出口，却只闻脚步纷乱。

column1: As you carefully pack the components, your reward, $NamedOneName babbles on happily.
column2: 当你仔细收拾所得，酬劳$NamedOneName欢声笑语，喋喋不休。

column1: As you catch your breath, $ChosenOneName thanks you for rescuing $him.
column2: 当你喘息稍定，$ChosenOneName感谢你救下了你。

column1: As you catch your breath, $ChosenOneName thanks you for saving $him from capture.
column2: 当你喘息稍定，$ChosenOneName感谢你使你免于被捕。

column1: As you catch your breath, common folk come into the street and thank you.
column2: 当你喘息稍定，街上的百姓纷纷涌上街头，向你致谢。

column1: As you continue, you notice that some of the peasants look like they have been whipped repeatedly. Certainly none look very happy.
column2: 继续前行，你发现部分农夫似屡遭鞭笞，神情皆不悦。

column1: As you draw steel, you realize that the guards on both this floor and throughout the other floors of the fortress must be eliminated. Only then can you search for and rescue those imprisoned here.
column2: 当你拔剑出鞘，方知此层乃至整座堡垒各层的守卫皆须尽数除去。唯有如此，方可搜寻并解救被囚于此的人。

column1: As you enter the room, you see a huge man in a flared, winged helm, sitting across from a smaller man wearing the livery of a local noble. When the large man sees you, he cries "Treachery!" and plunges a dagger into the breast of the noble.
column2: 当你步入厅堂，见一魁梧大汉头戴展翼兜鍪，对面坐一着本地贵族服色的小个子。大汉见你，厉声喝道：“叛徒！”随即挥匕首刺入贵族胸膛。

column1: As you examine this damning evidence, the messenger suddenly slips away and bolts down an alley. You shrug and carefully store the incriminating papers.
column2: 当你细察这铁证时，那信使忽地溜走，奔入小巷。你耸耸肩，小心收起这些罪证。

column1: As you examine this damning evidence, the messenger suddenly slips away and bolts down an alley. You shrug and carefully store these papers.
column2: 当你细察这铁证时，那信使忽地溜走，奔入小巷。你耸耸肩，将这些文书妥为保管。

column1: As you examine this damning evidence, the messenger suddenly slips away and bolts down an alley. You shrug off his escape, knowing the papers are far more important.
column2: 当你细察这铁证时，那信使忽地溜走，奔入小巷。你不在意他的逃脱，只觉这些文书更为紧要。

column1: As you examine this damning evidence, the messenger suddenly slips away and bolts down an alley. You shrug off the loss of the conspirator: the evidence is far more important.
column2: 当你细察这铁证时，那信使忽地溜走，奔入小巷。你不在意那密谋者的逃逸，只觉证据已足。

column1: As you examine this damning evidence, the messenger suddenly slips away and bolts down an alley. You shrug off the loss of the conspirator: the papers are evidence enough.
column2: 当你细察这铁证时，那信使忽地溜走，奔入小巷。你不在意那密谋者的逃逸，只觉这些文书便是确凿之证。

column1: As you examine this damning evidence, the messenger suddenly slips away and bolts down an alley. You shrug off the loss of the messenger: the physical evidence is far more important.
column2: 当你细察这铁证时，那信使忽地溜走，奔入小巷。你不在意那信使的失手，只觉实物证据更为重要。

column1: As you examine this damning evidence, the messenger suddenly slips away and bolts down an alley. You shrug off the loss of the spy, and carefully store the papers.
column2: 当你细察这铁证时，那信使忽地溜走，奔入小巷。你不在意那密探的失手，只将文书妥善收存。

column1: As you flee into the brush, the raubritter's men do not pursue. They have had enough, too.
column2: 当你遁入林间，劫骑士的手下并未追击。他们亦已厌战。

column1: As you flee, the guards pursue only halfheartedly. Their sergeant roars at them, "Dummkopfen, how could you let them escape? Keep closer guard."
column2: 当你奔逃，守卫追得甚缓。其什长怒吼道：“蠢货！竟任其逃脱？务必严加看守！”

column1: As you leap aside, the boars charge through your band. None of you are hit, and the boars, discouraged, keep on running.
column2: 当你侧身避让，野猪群冲过你的队伍。无人受伤，野猪见状气馁，径自离去。

column1: As you leap aside, the boars charge through your party, but only one of you is hit. Discouraged by their lack of success, the boars keep running.
column2: 当你侧身避让，野猪群冲过你的队伍，仅一人受创。野猪见成效寥寥，遂气馁而去。

column1: As you leap aside, the boars charge through, slamming into several of you. Enraged, they wheel about and prepare another charge.
column2: 当你侧身避让，野猪群冲过，撞倒数人。野猪恼怒，转身欲再冲锋。

column1: As you leave the lair, you hear a rumble of stones. In a puff of dust the entrance to the dragon's lair vanishes. Your task is accomplished.
column2: 当你离开洞穴，耳畔传来石块轰鸣。尘烟乍起，龙穴入口即隐。汝之使命已成。

column1: As you leave the lair, you hear a rumble of stones. When you turn, the entrance is gone. Your task is accomplished.
column2: 当你离开洞穴，耳畔传来石块轰鸣。回首之际，入口已无踪。汝之使命已成。

column1: As you leave, passers-by smile and nod to you. You are gratified by the warm regard of the citizens.
column2: 当你离去，路人对你微笑颔首。市民的热忱令你欣慰。

column1: As you leave, the final words of his curse echo in your ears. Suddenly, everyone feels weaker. His curse has real power over you! The least virtuous among you suffer the most.
column2: 当你离去，他临终的诅咒犹在耳畔回响。众人顿觉乏力。其诅咒之力非同小可！其中德行最薄者受害尤甚。

column1: As you leave, you suddenly hear a dreadful gobbling howl. You turn to see a hideous shape -- the dragon! It descends upon the pitiful body of the girl, and gulps her down like an oyster. You are sickened by the callousness of the village in so exposing her to save themselves.
column2: 当你离去，忽闻一声骇人的吞咽嚎叫。转头望去，只见狰狞巨影——巨龙！它俯冲而下，将少女惨躯如牡蛎般一口吞下。村民为自救而弃她不顾，其冷酷令你作呕。

column1: As you listen to people debate $PlaceName politics, you discover an interesting pattern. Almost everyone has a very low regard for the spiritual leader of the $ChurchType. You can't tell if it's the usual complaints about venal clergymen, or something more serious.
column2: 当你聆听众人议论$PlaceName政事，发现一个有趣的现象：几乎人人对$ChurchType的精神领袖评价极低。不知这是否只是寻常的教士贪腐之怨，抑或另有隐情。

column1: As you listen to people debate the politics of various guilds, you discover an interesting undercurrent: the senior master of the $GuildName guild has an unsavory reputation.
column2: 当你聆听众人讨论各公会政局，察觉一股暗流：$GuildName公会会长名声不佳。

column1: As you listen to people debating politics, you discover an interesting undercurrent. Almost to a man, people here greatly dislike the leader of the $MerchantType. Many feel that he is especially unwholesome and dangerous.
column2: 当你聆听众人议论政事，察觉一股暗流。当地几乎无人不厌恶$MerchantType的首领。许多人认为此人尤为不端且危险。

column1: As you look at it, you feel a silent prompting within your souls. You kneel reverently and bow your heads in prayer. When you are through, you stand and feel spiritually invigorated. Divine favor is with you.
column2: 当你凝视之时，内心似有无声召唤。汝等虔诚跪拜，低头祈祷。礼毕起身，精神为之一振。神恩庇佑于汝。

column1: As you lower your weapons, $NamedOneName arrives from another side street. He and his followers have battered armor and bloodstained weapons.
column2: 当你放下兵刃，$NamedOneName自另一街巷赶来。他及其随从甲胄残破，刀剑染血。

column1: As you march, you come across a plundered village. Some monstrous force has clearly been at work here -- every house is burst open like an egg, and the contents ransacked. The beds have been ripped open by immense claws, and even trunks and cupboards smashed to pieces. It is almost as if the horror were looking for something.
column2: 当你行军途中，遇一遭劫掠之村。显然有某种巨兽在此肆虐——家家户户如蛋壳般被砸开，财物尽被洗劫。床榻被巨爪撕裂，箱柜亦被打得粉碎。仿佛那恐怖之物正在寻找某物。

column1: As you move away from the altar-site, the man calls out, "Why will ye not help when we need ye?" You hurry to a small stand of trees to get out of sight. Once there, you...
column2: 当你远离祭坛之地，那人喊道：“吾等危难，汝何不援？”汝急趋林间，隐于树后。既至，汝……

column1: As you move through a quiet, remote valley, you see an old, bearded man in ragged leathers tending a fire. You...
column2: 当你穿行于幽静偏僻之谷，见一老者胡须蓬乱，衣衫褴褛，正燃火取暖。汝……

column1: As you moved up the corridor to this room, you noticed a slight smell of ash and burning. Now, you see the reason why: in this dank, musty room, there is a large pile of burned books. Some have been reduced to ashes; an occasional binding or whole page shows in the wreckage. The smell is overpowering. You...
column2: 当你沿走廊步入此室，便嗅到一丝灰烬与焦灼之味。如今方知缘由：此阴湿霉臭之室，堆满焚毁之书。有的已化为灰烬，偶有残页或装帧尚存。气味刺鼻。汝……

column1: As you pass onward, the guards silently watch you go.
column2: 当你前行，守卫默默注视汝去。

column1: As you pass, the saintly image turns around, blesses and dismisses the crowd. They disperse as the white man walks in among them and disappears.
column2: 当你经过，圣像回身，赐福而后遣散众人。白袍男子走入人群，旋即消失，众随之散去。

column1: As you piece together various tales, you suspect that the guild leader may be a secret agent, working to betray the city to an arch enemy. Unfortunately, you'll need letters or similar documents to prove this.
column2: 当你拼凑诸说，疑公会首领或为密探，暗中勾结外敌，出卖城池。可惜，此事须凭书信等文书方能证实。

column1: As you piece together various tales, you suspect that the leader may be a secret agent, working to betray the city to an arch-enemy. Unfortunately, you'll need letters or similar documents to prove this.
column2: 当你拼凑诸说，疑其首领或为密探，暗中勾结宿敌，出卖城池。可惜，此事须凭书信等文书方能证实。

column1: As you ponder this, they speak. The golden statue says, "To open the door, touch the statue which speaks truth." The silver statue says, "To open the door, touch the statue which lies." Which statue is right? The wrong statue may release a trap! You think carefully, then ...
column2: 当你沉思之际，两尊雕像开口：金像曰：“欲启门，触说真之像。”银像曰：“欲启门，触说谎之像。”孰真孰假？误触陷阱立发！汝慎思之后……

column1: As you pray to the heavens, music seems to spring from nowhere, providing accompaniment to your words. At the song's crescendo, the four innocents rise slowly into the air, then speed off in the direction of a nearby village. The witches cry out in dismay and fear, but there is nothing they can do.
column2: 当你仰天祷告，乐声忽自空而降，伴汝诵经。歌至高潮，四名无辜者缓缓升空，继而疾驰往邻村而去。女巫惊呼恐惧，却无力挽回。

column1: As you pray to the heavens, music seems to spring from nowhere, providing accompaniment to your words. At the song's crescendo, the four innocents rise slowly into the air, then speed off toward a nearby village. The witches cry out in dismay and fear, but there is nothing they can do.
column2: 当你仰天祷告，乐声忽自空而降，伴汝诵经。歌至高潮，四名无辜者缓缓升空，继而疾驰往邻村而去。女巫惊呼恐惧，却无力挽回。

column1: As you pray, you spy a man in fine clothes strolling casually in your direction. On your guard, you greet him in a friendly way. He is slightly drunk, and proves to be an easy target for information-gathering. After a while, your "victim" leaves, and you contemplate the information you have received.
column2: 当你祈祷之际，见一华服男子悠然向汝走来。汝戒备，仍友善相迎。彼微醺，易为情报所获。片刻后，“猎物”离去，汝细思所得。
