column2: 当你祈祷之际，见一华服男子悠然向汝走来。汝戒备，仍友善相迎。彼微醺，易为情报所获。片刻后，“猎物”离去，汝细思所得。

column1: As you pray, you spy a serving wench bustling in your direction. On your guard, you greet her in a friendly way. She is young and naive, and proves to be an easy target for information-gathering. After a while, your "victim" leaves and you contemplate the information you have received.
column2: 当你祈祷之际，见一侍女匆匆向汝走来。汝戒备，仍友善相迎。彼年轻懵懂，易为情报所获。片刻后，“猎物”离去，汝细思所得。

column1: As you pray, you spy a serving wench bustling in your direction. On your guard, you greet her in a friendly way. She is young and naive, and proves to be an easy target for information-gathering. After a while, your "victim" leaves, and you contemplate the information you have obtained.
column2: 当你祈祷之际，见一侍女匆匆向汝走来。汝戒备，仍友善相迎。彼年轻懵懂，易为情报所获。片刻后，“猎物”离去，汝细思所得。

column1: As you resume the journey, you wonder if some day an enterprising war leader or noble might return and rebuild this tower, making it once more into a place of power and fear.
column2: 当你续行，不禁遐想：或有朝一日，某位雄心勃勃的武将或贵族重归此地，重建高塔，使之再度成为权势与恐惧之所。

column1: As you resume your journey, you wonder if some day an enterprising war leader or noble might return and rebuild this tower, making it once more into a place of power and fear.
column2: 当你续行，不禁遐想：或有朝一日，某位雄心勃勃的武将或贵族重归此地，重建高塔，使之再度成为权势与恐惧之所。

column1: As you retreat to the outdoors, the stones rumble; with a puff of dust the crack closes. The entrance to the lair is gone. Your task is accomplished.
column2: 当你撤退至户外，石块轰鸣；尘烟一卷，裂缝即合。洞穴入口已无踪。汝之使命已成。

column1: As you retreat, a well-armed band of soldiers springs from the brush. A knight, who must be their leader, gestures toward a wooded streambed. You spy cunningly hidden mounts awaiting their riders. Seeing this, you quicken your pace and flee.
column2: 当你撤退之际，一支全副武装的士兵突袭而出。为首骑士指向林间溪谷。汝见马匹巧妙藏匿，伺机待骑。见此情景，汝加快脚步，仓皇逃离。

column1: As you round a bend in the corridor, you hear the quiet murmur of voices from the dark room up ahead. One of them is a low rumble that makes your blood run cold to hear it. However, you cannot make out any of the words.
column2: 当你转过走廊弯角，前方暗室中隐约传来低语。其中一声低沉，令人毛骨悚然。然汝无法辨其词句。

column1: As you round a bend in the corridor, you hear voices from the room up ahead; they grow clearer as you approach.
column2: 当你转过走廊弯角，前方传来人声，愈近愈清晰。

column1: As you sit by the roadside, suddenly armed men come around the bend. Weapons are drawn on both sides, and you realize they are brigands serving $NamedOneName, the raubritter.
column2: 当你路旁歇息，忽有持械之人自弯角现身。双方拔枪相向，汝方知乃为$NamedOneName效力的劫骑士匪党。

column1: As you sit by the roadside, you hear voices approaching. Using $his wood lore, $ChosenOneName quickly orders you into the best concealment the terrain offers.
column2: 当你坐在路旁，听见有脚步声逼近。凭借你的木之术，$ChosenOneName迅速命你藏入地形所允的最佳隐蔽处。

column1: As you skulk around a corner, $ChosenOneName runs headfirst into a surprised apprentice. Before you can do anything, she runs away, screaming an alarm.
column2: 当你悄然绕过转角，$ChosenOneName一头撞上一名惊愕的学徒。未及反应，她尖叫着逃走，发出警报。

column1: As you sleep, you dream. In your dreams, a saintly figure approaches you and whispers, "You must discover the location of the fortress monastery. This is the next step of your quest."
column2: 当你入梦时，梦见一位圣者走近，低语道：“汝须寻得要塞修道院之所在。此乃汝之使命下一步。”

column1: As you stand back from the now motionless bodies, windows open and people cheer your victory. An old, dignified woman comes up to you.
column2: 当你退立于静止的尸身旁，窗扉洞开，众人欢呼你的胜利。一位年迈而庄重的妇人缓步向你走来。

column1: As you stand over the bloody battlefield, victorious, the clouds above slowly break up. Sunlight bathes the scene, and you feel the true virtue of having defeated an ancient pagan power.
column2: 当你屹立于血染的战场之上，凯旋之际，天际云层渐散。阳光洒落，你方觉击败古老异教势力之真义。

column1: As you steal away into the darkness, you hear a guard say, "Sweet Mary, this doesn't seem natural. I think wizardry or witchcraft is present." They begin to argue the point.
column2: 当你潜入黑暗，忽闻守卫言：“圣母玛利亚啊，此事绝非自然。恐有巫术作祟。”遂争论不休。

column1: As you steal through a back corridor, you pause to overhear a conversation in a money-counting room.
column2: 当你潜行于后廊，驻足偷听一间点钞室中的对话。

column1: As you step through the hamlet of $PlaceName, it is obvious that the people here belong to some sort of witch cult. An unholy altar stands atop a hill, and the villagers issue forth from their homes, carrying weapons and uttering threats against your persons.
column2: 当你踏入$PlaceName村落，显见其民皆属某邪教。山巅设有一座不洁祭坛，村民持械自家中涌出，对你厉声相威胁。

column1: As you stride forward, you hear a vast rustling. Suddenly a blast of flame lights up the air, and you see that you are in an immense amphitheater. All around you is a huge army of gigantic lancers, each at least 8 feet tall, and each mounted on his own huge goblin-beast.
column2: 当你大步前行时，忽闻一阵沙沙之声。骤然间，一道火焰照亮了天空，只见身处一座巨大的圆形竞技场之中。四周尽是浩荡的骑兵大军，个个身高至少八英尺，皆骑乘着巨兽般的地精坐骑。

column1: As you stride toward the chapel, a priest hurries over and politely asks how he can serve you. When you tell him you have come for Holy Communion, he says, "Alas, but the next Mass will not be sung until $NamedOneName. Please come back around that time."
column2: 当你缓步走向小堂，一神父匆匆迎上，礼貌询问有何差遣。汝告以欲领圣餐，彼答曰：“惜哉，下一场弥撒尚需至$NamedOneName始能举行，请届时再来。”

column1: As you stroll onto the main street, you look for places to post your handbills. After all, that is your job these days!
column2: 当你漫步主街，四顾张贴传单之处。毕竟，此乃汝近日之职也！

column1: As you travel a pass between the mountains, you see a cave.  The dark, low opening looks menacing but intriguing.  The ground is covered with a few inches of snow here, but the opening of the cave shows bare rock.  You look at each other expectantly, and decide to...
column2: 当你穿行山间隘口，遥见一洞穴。幽暗低矮的洞口阴森却诱人。地覆薄雪，然洞口裸岩可见。汝等相视而定，决定……

column1: As you walk across the corridor, the floor shifts slightly beneath your feet. After a few moment's wait, nothing untoward happens. You move on.
column2: 当你行经走廊，脚底地面微动。稍候片刻，无异状发生，遂继续前行。

column1: As you walk away, the physician loudly curses you.
column2: 当你离去，医师高声咒骂。

column1: As you walk, you look down each cobble-stoned street. At ground level, signs with pictures portray the various guilds and crafts. You turn toward...
column2: 当你漫步，俯瞰每条石板街。街面标牌绘诸公会与工艺，汝转向……

column1: As you walk, you peer down each cobblestone street. Amid the nighttime gloom you barely see the picture-signs that portray various guilds and crafts. You turn toward...
column2: 当你行走，凝视每条石板街。夜色朦胧，仅依稀辨识各公会与工艺之图示。汝转向……

column1: As you wander through the wilderness here, you notice a darkness over the land that you'd not seen before. The trees aren't dead, but they are twisted and strange. There are birds and animals, but they are black, foul beasts with harsh cries and fearful yellow eyes. Though you see no fires, there are scatterings of ash. The smell of smoke is heavy in the air. You...
column2: 当你徜徉于此荒野，察觉大地笼罩一层前所未见的阴霾。树木虽未枯死，却扭曲怪异。禽兽俱在，然皆黑影恶物，啼鸣刺耳，眸黄可怖。虽不见火光，灰烬遍地。烟味浓烈，汝……

column1: As you watch from outside, a light springs up in one of the castle's windows. It grows stronger until the castle is clearly ablaze! Hoarse screams are heard, and suddenly the gate bursts open and $NamedOneName himself, accompanied by a few men, staggers out coughing. He spots you. "You have destroyed my home and power. But I shall see you in Hell before me!" He attacks you at once.
column2: 当你在外窥视，城堡一窗骤燃灯火。火势愈炽，终致整座城堡烈焰滔天！沙哑惨呼迭起，忽见城门大开，$NamedOneName亲率数人咳嗽踉跄而出。见汝，怒喝：“汝毁吾家业，然地狱先迎汝！”即刻扑杀。

column1: As you watch, a light springs up in one of the castle's windows. Men shout from inside, and you can hear them fighting the fire. Perhaps you should try to set some more fires, to assist the blaze along, or use the distraction to enter the tower yet again.
column2: 当你观望，城堡一窗火光乍现。室内人声鼎沸，似在奋力灭火。或可再添几把火，助其延烧，抑或趁乱再度入塔。

column1: As you watch, it's clear that the villagers are going to leave the young girl to be eaten by the dragon!
column2: 当你注视，村民显然欲任少女被龙吞噬！

column1: As your boat approaches $PlaceName, $PlaceDesc, you discover it surrounded by a besieging army. A storm of stones, arrows and quarrels from the besieger's lines prevent you from reaching the fortified waterfront. You decide to...
column2: 当汝舟驶近$PlaceName，$PlaceDesc，发现其已被大军围困。敌军投石射箭，阻汝抵坚固水岸。汝决意……

column1: As your boat approaches $PlaceName, you examine the city, $PlaceDesc, ruled by the $CityLordTitle. You decide to...
column2: 当汝舟驶近$PlaceName，汝审视由$CityLordTitle统治之城$PlaceDesc。汝决意……

column1: As your call to Saint Reinold ends, your extremities tingle. You stride up to the fortress and easily scale the walls. With saint-aided good luck, you find an unguarded window and enter the fortress.
column2: 当汝祈求圣莱诺尔德之佑告终，四肢微麻。汝昂首攀上要塞，轻松逾墙。蒙圣佑，汝觅得一未锁之窗，潜入其中。

column1: Asking Saint Christina's mercy, $ChosenOneName prays that you may be removed from the presence of the onrushing guards. She answers, and a clear golden light embraces you all. You are lifted high up, far from the seething nest of the city beneath. You are sped through the crisp, clean air until you are deposited gently and safely on a verdant hillside, far from noisome, dangerous $PlaceName.
column2: 汝祈求圣克里斯蒂娜之怜悯，$ChosenOneName祷告使汝远离迫近之卫兵。圣女应允，金光普照，将汝托举高空，远避下方喧嚣污秽之$PlaceName。汝乘清风疾驰，安然降于青翠山坡。

column1: Astrologists' Lane, where the signs have alchemical symbols.
column2: 占星师巷，巷中招牌绘有炼金符号。

column1: Astrologists' Lane, where you spy signs with alchemical symbols.
column2: 占星师巷，汝见招牌绘有炼金符号。

column1: At a glance, you see that "P" equals 1, which makes "H" either 8 or 9. But what are the rest? You consider carefully, then choose the knob marked...
column2: 一眼可知，“P”等于1，则“H”或为8或为9。余者如何？汝细思熟虑，遂选中标记为……之旋钮。

column1: At a quick motion by the office's clerk, guards surround you all. Before you have a chance to protest or draw weapons, they throw you out of the office.
column2: 办公室文吏一挥手，卫兵即围住汝等。未及抗议或拔剑，已被驱逐出室。

column1: At a quick motion by the office's clerk, guards surround you. Before you have a chance to protest or draw weapons, they throw you out of the office.
column2: 办公室文吏一挥手，卫兵即围住汝。未及抗议或拔剑，已被驱逐出室。

column1: At a quiet period during the day, the clerk of the abbess visits you.
column2: 白日闲暇，修道院院长之书记来访。

column1: At dawn everyone cautiously collects beside the emptied boat, boards it, and resumes the journey.
column2: 黎明时分，众人谨慎聚集于空船旁，登船续行。

column1: At dawn everyone collects at the intact boat, feeling glum.
column2: 黎明时分，众人聚集于完好之船，神色黯然。

column1: At dawn you board the boat, which you could see all the time, and depart.
column2: 黎明时分，你登上那艘一直可见的小船，启程离去。

column1: At dawn, everyone collects at the boat and you resume your journey.
column2: 黎明时分，众人登船，汝等续行。

column1: At dawn, you resume the journey.
column2: 黎明时分，汝等续行。

column1: At first he's unfriendly, but eventually you draw him out. He is $NamedOneName, a hermit. You offer to share your food with him, in exchange for his wisdom. You consider imposing by staying just one day so...
column2: 初时他态度冷淡，然汝终使其吐露心声。彼乃隐士$NamedOneName。汝愿以食相赠，换其智慧。汝拟只留一日，以免强人所难……

column1: At first, your progress is peaceful. A few curious citizens watch you and the guardsmen lead the captive rebels away.
column2: 初时汝行平顺。数名好奇市民围观，卫兵押解俘虏离去。

column1: At his quick gesture, you are suddenly surrounded by guards with loaded crossbows. "Show these liars to the door!" commands $NamedOneName.
column2: 他一挥手，汝等猝遭弓弩满弦之卫兵包围。“将此等伪证者驱逐出门！”$NamedOneName下令。

column1: At least he has confidence in your heroism! You nod knowingly and stroll back the way you came.
column2: 至少他对汝之英勇尚有信心！汝颔首，沿来路返去。

column1: At least you still have the cuirass.
column2: 至少汝仍保有胸甲。

column1: At least your sacrifice was not in vain.
column2: 至少汝之牺牲并非徒劳。

column1: At night the main street is empty save for the night patrols. The frightened populace is staying indoors. You try to avoid the night watch as you head for...
column2: 夜间主街空寂，唯巡夜者往来。民众惶恐，皆闭户不出。汝避开夜哨，径往……

column1: At night the monastery is mostly dark, but a few candles light the corridors leading to the chapel, where the monks observe prayers and mass periodically.
column2: 夜间修道院多处昏暗，惟通往小堂之走廊偶有烛光，僧侣定期祈祷并主持弥撒。

column1: At night the side streets are still busy. Poor people, here for the fair, sleep in alcoves and alleys along the street. You turn toward...
column2: 夜间侧街依旧繁忙。赶集贫民于街边壁龛与巷隅歇息。汝转向……

column1: At that instant, his men surge toward you. You have no choice but to stand and fight.
column2: 就在此刻，其随从蜂拥而至。汝别无选择，唯有迎战。

column1: At the $university, the university in $PlaceName, the snobbish staff prefers to speak Latin, and expects a perceptive intelligence from applicants. You try to act intellectual as you inquire about...
column2: 在$university，即位于$PlaceName之大学，傲慢职员惯以拉丁语交谈，且期望考生具备敏锐才智。汝试图装作博学，询问关于……

column1: At the door you give him a closer look at your money, $Money1, saying, "Isn't this sufficient for our toll?"
column2: 于门前，汝将钱币$Money1递予彼，细观道：“此费岂不足乎？”

column1: At the gate a line of people wait to enter $PlaceName. The guards collect a toll from each person, so the overall cost for your party will be $Money1.
column2: 于城门，排队入$PlaceName者络绎不绝。卫兵按人收费，汝一行总费用为$Money1。

column1: At the height of the crowd's frenzy, $ChosenOneName steps forth and bellows, "I command you to stop in the name of the Lord!"
column2: 群众狂热之际，$ChosenOneName挺身而出，高呼：“奉主之名，令汝等止步！”

column1: At the mention of the Lord's name, the light in the monk's eyes changes from fevered madness to keen intellect. "I thought you were my captors come to torment me!" he cries. "But you are friends! Please, confess me that I may die in peace!" You...
column2: 听及主之名，僧侣眼中狂热尽褪，转为睿智。“原以为汝等乃来折磨于我之囚者！”他惊呼，“然汝等竟是友人！请为我做最后告解，使我安详辞世！”汝……

column1: At the other end of the cavern is a dark tunnel. Unwilling to go back the way you came, you stride through it. Past the tunnel is a spacious parkland which has been gruesomely blighted by the hideous rains of fire and hail, though no rain is currently falling. Black clots of crusty blood lie on the ground, and the plants and grass are all brown and dead. Ahead, you hear a crackling noise. Something is advancing toward you. You draw your weapons, prepared for anything.
column2: 洞穴另一端通向一条幽暗隧道。不愿原路折返，汝毅然前行。隧后是一片广袤绿地，曾遭烈火冰雹肆虐，如今虽暂无降水，然地上斑斑黑血凝固，草木尽枯。前方传来噼啪之声，似有异物逼近。汝拔剑戒备，随时应对。

column1: At the prayer of $ChosenOneName, suddenly the mist ceases to bother you! It is no more than an ordinary fog. You give thanks and consider what to do next...
column2: 在$ChosenOneName的祈祷之下，雾气骤然消散！不过是一场寻常的薄雾罢了。你心怀感激，思忖下一步该何去何从……

column1: At the sound of your prayers, the knights growl and reach for their weapons, but the deed is done: with a feeling of elation, your party rises into the air and flies through the now-open door! Dizzily you speed down the corridor, stopping only when you have risen up the stairs and back into the main building.
column2: 听到你的祷告，骑士们低吼着伸手握剑，但事已至此：众人顿觉欣喜若狂，腾空而起，穿过那扇已然敞开的大门！眩晕间，你们疾驰过长廊，直至登上楼梯，重返主楼。

column1: At the village smithy, the brawny blacksmith sweats over glowing coals. When you step in, he looks up and frowns. "What do you want?"
column2: 村庄铁匠铺里，魁梧的铁匠正挥汗于炽热的炉火之上。你踏入屋内，他抬头皱眉道：“汝欲何求？”

column1: At this point, the river narrows to tumultuous rapids, making fording impossible. The small village here boasts a fine stone bridge, but you see folk laboriously walking miles upriver, then crossing on a raft ferry. "What is wrong?" you ask a bystander. "Why do they not use the bridge?"
column2: 此处河面骤窄，激流汹涌，难以徒涉。小村虽有石桥一座，却见众人费力绕行数里至上游，再乘木筏渡河。“何故如此？”你问旁人，“为何不走此桥？”

column1: At your most charming, you strike up a friendly conversation with the wharfmaster and his guards. You are sympathetic to their problems, and the situation in $PlaceName. Soon he regards you as old campaigning friends. In fact, he becomes convinced that you once served with him in a mercenary company.
column2: 你以最动人的风度，与码头主管及其卫士攀谈甚欢。你深表同情他们的困境，亦知悉$PlaceName之情形。不久，他视你如久经沙场的老友。实则，他竟确信你曾与其同为一支雇佣兵团效力。

column1: Authority in a German hamlet is invested in the Schulz, a combination of  mayor, bailiff, and soldier. He is wealthy (for a peasant) and has the power to pass judgment and administer the law, with the help of the village elders. He also has heavy responsibilities. He owns armor and weapons and, in wartime, is required to leave his home and fight for distant masters. Despite his importance, he is willing to talk with you.
column2: 德意志小村的权威集于舒尔茨一身，他是镇长、法官兼士兵。他家境殷实（对农夫而言），有权裁断是非、执掌法度，并有村中长老辅佐。他亦肩负重任。他身披甲胄，手握兵刃，战时须离乡征战，效忠远方主君。虽位高权重，却愿与你交谈。

column1: Avoiding troop detachments and officers, you navigate toward...
column2: 绕开部队与军官，你朝……前行

column1: BAVARIA
column2: 巴伐利亚

column1: BE IT KNOWN:
column2: 特此昭告：

column1: BOHEMIA
column2: 波希米亚

column1: BRAVE MEN NEEDED:
column2: 需要勇士：

column1: BURGUNDY
column2: 勃艮第

column1: BY ORDER OF CITY COUNCIL:
column2: 经市议会之命：

column1: Backed by a group of mercenaries, $NamedOneName steps onto a cart to address the growing cluster of armed citizens. Suddenly squads of city guards erupt from all directions. Some engage the mercenaries, while others charge the crowd.
column2: 在一队雇佣兵的护持下，$NamedOneName 登上一辆马车，向聚集愈多的武装市民发表演说。忽而，各处突现市卫队分队。部分与雇佣兵交锋，其余则冲向人群。

column1: Backing off from the guards, you flee down the street. Behind you, a trumpet blows, summoning reinforcements.
column2: 你后退避让，奔街而逃。身后号角长鸣，召援兵至。

column1: Baltic ports and lands further east.
column2: 波罗的海诸港及更东之地。

column1: Baltic ports further west, and the Skagerrak.
column2: 波罗的海诸港及更西之地，以及斯卡格拉克海峡。

column1: Banefully, the richter stares at you. "There can be but one suitable punishment for those who so violate the laws of God and man." He pulls a black hood over his head. "The sentence is death. You are to be beheaded at once." The bailiff and his men step forward and lead you to the place of execution.
column2: 法官阴沉地凝视汝。“凡违天律人法者，唯有死罪一途。”他罩黑帽于首。“判死刑，即刻斩首。”执刑吏率众上前，押汝赴刑场。

column1: Baphomet cackles, "Now I release the most grievous plague, the locusts of Abaddon. They shall destroy all the world's food and sting all who oppose them." Immediately, a huge cloud of the monstrous insects you met behind the fifth gate rises into the sky. Flourishing the balance you got from the horseman within that gate, you discourage the insects, and they return whence they came. Baphomet roars, "There are but two plagues left, but they are the worst of them all. I care little for losing Hell's locusts now."
column2: 巴风特狞笑：“今放最烈之灾——阿巴顿蝗虫。彼将毁尽天下粮仓，螫刺一切敌对之徒。”顷刻间，汝于第五门后所遇巨虫群腾空而起。汝挥舞自该门骑士所得之权杖，驱散群虫，归其所来。巴风特怒吼：“仅余两灾，然皆最为凶险。今失地狱蝗虫，亦不足惜。”

column1: Baphomet informs you, "Then you have no hope."
column2: 巴风特告知汝：“汝已无望。”

column1: Baphomet leers. "You have ruined my plans and my works, but not my power. The last key lies not in your souls: there is no hope for you, for you have none.
column2: 巴风特狞笑：“汝虽破吾计策与功业，却难撼吾权势。最后之钥不在汝心：汝本无希望，汝亦无希望。”

column1: Baphomet says quietly, "There is but one plague left. It shall break the world to dust. Have you anything to stop me?"
column2: 巴佛墨特低声说道：“尚余一疫。此疫将使世界化为尘土。汝有何法阻我？”

column1: Baphomet shivers in agony.
column2: 巴佛墨特痛苦战栗。

column1: Baphomet utters a second word of power. A great mountain all aflame falls into a lake nearby and the water bursts into flames at once. Baphomet gloats, "All the world's ships shall be destroyed and all fish in the sea shall die."
column2: 巴佛墨特再吐一字之威。一座烈焰熊熊的巨山坠入近旁之湖，湖水顿时燃起熊熊大火。巴佛墨特狞笑道：“天下舟楫尽毁，海中鱼虾皆亡。”

column1: Battling your foe like heroes of old, you soon find the monsters are defeated. You feel a small voice deep within your heart, saying you have done well. The gargoyles are back in Hell, where they belong, and the world is a little better for it.
column2: 你如古之英雄般与敌厮杀，不日便将群魔击溃。心中深处似有细语传来，赞汝功成。石像鬼已归于地狱，其所应归之处，世界亦因此稍显清明。

column1: Be it also known that hoarding of food and excessive price increases are illegal. All price changes must be approved by either the Bailiff of the $marketplace, or the master of the appropriate guild.
column2: 又闻，囤积粮草、哄抬物价皆属非法。一切物价变动，须经由 $marketplace 的执事或相应公会之首批准方可施行。

column1: Be it known that nefarious enemies are threatening war and siege against our good city. Therefore, special precautions shall be taken against spies and traitors, and the city guard has been much expanded. Certain inns, guilds and homes may be required as additional billets.
column2: 须知，恶敌正虎视眈眈，欲兴兵围城，侵我良邑。是以，当严防间谍与叛徒，城卫已大为扩充。某些客栈、公会及民宅，或将被征为额外驻所。

column1: Be it known that the celebration of $NamedOneName has begun. All citizens are urged to enjoy themselves safely and maintain decorum. Be assured that the watch will deal with thieves and pickpockets swiftly. Long live the Emperor!
column2: 须知$NamedOneName之庆典已启。凡我子民，皆当安乐有度，恪守礼节。谨记，巡卫将严惩窃贼与扒手。皇帝万岁！

column1: Beaming with pride at your accomplishment, the $NamedOneName presents $ChosenOneName with the reward.
column2: 满怀自豪地望着你的成就，$NamedOneName将奖励赠予$ChosenOneName。

column1: Beams of radiant glory smite the dragon. It recoils briefly, then recovers and mauls $ChosenOneName. Finally it retreats. Alas! Not even the power of $NamedOneName gives full immunity to the beast from Hell.
column2: 辉煌的光芒击中了巨龙。它短暂地退缩，随即恢复并猛扑向$ChosenOneName。最终它撤退了。唉！即便是$NamedOneName的力量，也无法使这来自地狱的怪物完全免疫。

column1: Beaten, you slump at the raubritter's feet. Giggling with glee, he orders his men to belabor you with logs and stones, while he delivers a few choice kicks. Eventually tiring of this fun, they take your possessions, drag you
column2: 被打得瘫软在劫匪脚下。他得意地咯咯笑着，命手下用木棍和石块狠揍你，自己也补上几脚。玩腻了之后，他们夺走你的财物，把你拖拽

column1: Because $ChosenOneName lacks the special blunted lances and specially shaped shields for jousting, the knight graciously loans $him one of each.
column2: 因为$ChosenOneName缺少用于比武的特制钝矛与特殊造型的盾牌，骑士便礼节性地将二者各借予你。

column1: Before rendering a decision, you examine $his equipment and abilities...
column2: 在作出决定之前，你检视你的装备与能力……

column1: Before rendering a decision, you take a close look at $his abilities...
column2: 在作出决定之前，你仔细审视你的项能力……

column1: Before the Italian can launch into a long discourse on philosophy, you politely and quickly take your leave.
column2: 在意大利人尚未开始长篇大论地谈论哲学之前，你有礼而迅速地告辞了。

column1: Before the demon moves, $ChosenOneName cries, "You cannot harm us. You have no legal authority in this land."
column2: 恶魔尚未行动，$ChosenOneName喊道：“你不能伤害我们。你在这片土地上毫无法律权威。”

column1: Before the demon moves, $ChosenOneName shouts, "Hands off! No contract entered into by a third party -- to wit, the village -- is binding on us."
column2: 在恶魔行动之前，$ChosenOneName喊道：“住手！任何未经我们同意的第三方契约——即村庄——对我们均不具约束力。”

column1: Before the guards can get into action, you decide ...
column2: 在卫兵有所行动之前，你决定……

column1: Before you are teeming kobolds. A man towers over them - it must be the leader that the dwarf spoke of! If you can defeat him, the kobold rebellion will be crushed! The grateful dwarfs will no doubt return the mine to its human owners, and you will win!
column2: 你面前挤满了地精。一名男子高高耸立于他们之上——这必定是矮人所言的首领！若你能击败他，地精叛乱将被镇压！感激的矮人们必将把矿井归还给人类主人，而你也将获胜！

column1: Before you are teeming kobolds. A man towers over them -- it must be the leader that the dwarf spoke of! If you can defeat him, the kobold rebellion will be crushed! The grateful dwarfs will no doubt return the mine to its human owners, and you will win!

column1: Before you can enter the door, a stunted figure steps forth from inside. It apparently wishes to talk with you.
column2: 你尚未踏入门内，一个矮小的身影便自屋中走出。它显然欲与你交谈。

column1: Before you can get a word in, the merchant immediately launches into his tale of woe. You realize that although he may not offer material rewards, your fame and local reputation will certainly benefit if you should solve the problem.
column2: 你尚未开口，商人便迫不及待地倾诉起他的苦衷。你意识到，即便他无法提供物质报酬，若能解此难题，你的声名与地方声誉必将大增。

column1: Before you can protest, he slams the gate closed. Obviously your reputation has preceded you!
column2: 你尚未及抗议，他已砰然关上城门。显然，你的名声早已传开！

column1: Before you can react, a band of dwarfs bowls you over from behind and hurls a volley of thunderbolt potions into the kobolds. Amid the explosions, kobolds squeal and leap at the dwarfs. The shrill squeaks of mortally-wounded kobolds are a terrible counter-point to the clash of weapons. Soon the surviving kobolds flee while the dwarfs gather around you.
column2: 未及你反应，一队矮人自后撞翻你，向地精掷出一串雷击药剂。爆炸声中，地精英叫着扑向矮人。重伤地精的尖啸与刀剑交鸣相映成趣。不久，残存地精四散奔逃，矮人则围拢于你身侧。

column1: Before you is $NamedOneName, the dwarf slavemaster - a giant dwarf! You have entered the dwarfs' inner sanctum. If you can defeat $NamedOneName, you can free the kobolds from dwarf control and end the rebellion! The grateful kobolds will no doubt return the mine to its human owners, and you will win!
column2: 你面前是$NamedOneName，矮人奴隶主——一个巨矮！你已踏入矮人的内殿。若能击败$NamedOneName，便可使地精摆脱矮人控制，平息叛乱！感激的地精必将矿井归还人类主人，而你也将获胜！

column2: 在你面前是$PlaceName，$PlaceDesc。

column2: 你面前是被城墙环绕的$PlaceName城，$PlaceDesc。它是$CityLordTitle所统治之诸地的都城。你料想自己将在此处$PlaceAttitude。因此你...

column1: Before you lies the walled city of $PlaceName, $PlaceDesc. It seethes like an anthill. Soldiers shout orders, horses whinny, wagons of supplies rumble into town. Clearly, the $CityLordTitle is preparing for war. Since you are $PlaceAttitude here, you decide to...
column2: 在你面前是围墙环绕的 $PlaceName，$PlaceDesc。它如蚁丘般沸腾喧嚣。士兵高声喝令，马匹嘶鸣，补给马车隆隆驶入城中。显然，$CityLordTitle 正在备战。既然你在此地的身份是 $PlaceAttitude，你决定……

column2: 门后站着一名神情凶狠的矮人。他双眉倒竖，怒视着你。心中不安，你...

column1: Belatedly you realize that swaggering into the city square of $PlaceName wasn't the best of ideas. No matter what direction you look, there are city guardsmen.
column2: 你迟才意识到，大摇大摆地闯入$PlaceName的城中广场并非明智之举。无论朝哪个方向看，皆是城中卫兵。

column1: Believing combat futile, you present your weapons in surrender. The hellish crew seizes you and holds foul-smelling biscuits under your noses. You fall unconscious.
column2: 认为战斗无益，你呈上武器以示投降。地狱般的船员将你擒住，并把散发着恶臭的饼干凑到你鼻前。你昏厥过去。

column1: Beside an old cemetery, old hags cackle as they stuff carrion into a filthy leather sack. When the leader sees you, her eyes bulge with surprise. She cackles, "Methought all mortals had fled these parts."
column2: 古墓之侧，老巫婆咯咯笑着，将腐肉塞进肮脏的皮囊。首领见你，惊得双眼凸出。她咯咯笑道：“我还道凡人皆已逃离此地。”

column1: Big, black clouds of smoke billow through the street. Amid cries of "Fire!" everybody rushes for the building. The press of excited and concerned citizens prevents you from finding a way to sneak inside.
column2: 浓重的黑烟滚滚穿过街道。在“着火了！”的呼喊声中，众人纷纷奔向那座建筑。激动又担忧的市民们挤成一团，让你无从潜入其中。

column1: Billows of acrid smoke flow through the gate. Horses scream, oxen low frantically, and men shout to one another, groping helplessly. You stride easily past the incapacitated guards. Behind, you hear a cry of "To arms! Demons!"
column2: 刺鼻的浓烟滚滚穿过城门。马匹嘶鸣，牛群惊慌地低吼，人们互相呼喊，徒劳地摸索着。你轻松地越过那些瘫痪的守卫。身后传来一声呼喊：“备战！恶魔！”

column1: Billows of opaque smoke flow from the vial flung down by $ChosenOneName. The guards cannot see you in the murk. You cannot see them either, but that's not your plan. You simply want to escape, and do so easily.
column2: 由$ChosenOneName掷下的药瓶中涌出浓重的烟雾。守卫在迷雾中看不见你。你也看不清他们，但这并非你的计划。你只想轻松逃脱。

column1: Binding your wounds, you realize that in this place, all treasures have their guardians.
column2: 包扎着伤口，你意识到在这片土地上，每一份宝藏都有其守护者。

column1: Bishop $NamedOneName speaks. "The robber knight, $NamedTwoName, commits outrages beyond belief. He kidnaps priests and friars, violates convents, pillages monastic fields and plunders vineyards. Bring him to justice and the Holy Church will be grateful."
column2: 主教 $NamedOneName 开口道：“那盗匪骑士 $NamedTwoName 犯下令人发指的暴行。他绑架神父与修士，亵渎女修道院，劫掠修道院田地与葡萄园。将他绳之以法，圣教会将感激不尽。”

column1: Bits of flaming liquid splash a number of the creatures, whose dirty fur flares up like a torch. All the schrats flee screaming, especially those now burning to death.
column2: 些许燃烧的液体溅到数只生物身上，它们肮脏的皮毛如火炬般燃起。所有地精尖叫着四散奔逃，尤其是那些正在被活活烧死的。

column1: Blackness claims you as you feel rough hands lifting you into the air; you know no more.
column2: 黑暗将你吞噬，只觉粗砺的手掌将你高高举起；此后便再无知觉。

column1: Blam! The explosion nearly deafens you as it goes off in the confined quarters of the pit trap. You are all hurt and bleeding, and you take further damage when the rock sides of the trap crumble down on you. To add insult to injury, you find yourself unable to scramble out, try as you might. Perhaps another Thunderbolt would do the trick. Or perhaps it would finish you off.
column2: 砰！爆炸在狭窄的陷阱深处响起，几乎震聋了你的耳朵。你们全都受伤流血，当陷阱的岩壁崩塌压在身上时，又遭受了进一步的伤害。雪上加霜的是，无论你如何挣扎，都无法爬出陷阱。或许再来一道雷霆术就能奏效。又或许，它会彻底置你于死地。

column1: Blam! The explosion nearly deafens you as it goes off in the confined quarters of the pit trap. You are all hurt and bleeding, and you take further injury when the rock sides of the trap crumble down on you. But you are able to scramble out of the pit. Your wounds are a small price to pay for escape.
column2: 砰！爆炸在狭窄的陷阱中响起，几乎震聋了你的耳朵。你们全都受伤流血，当陷阱的岩壁坍塌下来时，又受了更多伤。但你们还是设法爬出了坑洞。为了逃脱，这些伤痛不过是微不足道的代价。

column1: Blessed Saint Emydius hears the pleas of $ChosenOneName and answers spectacularly. A rumbling sound is heard, and the devilish monsters look around in consternation. Then the ground begins to crack open. The monsters are soon swallowed up and the crack closes. The rumbles fade away. An awesome stillness, a peacefulness, fills the land for a few long seconds. You bow your heads in thanks.
column2: 蒙福的圣埃米迪乌斯听到了$ChosenOneName的祈求，并以惊人的方式回应。一阵隆隆声响起，那些恶魔般的怪物惊慌地四下张望。随后，地面开始裂开。怪物们很快被吞噬，裂缝随即合拢。隆隆声渐渐消散。一时间，天地间充满了令人敬畏的寂静与安宁，持续了数个漫长的瞬间。你们低头致谢。

column1: Blinding fumes pour into the air, engulfing the entire gate area. While guards grope in the mist, you slip quickly out the door and leave the city.
column2: 刺目的浓烟弥漫空中，吞没了整个城门区域。守卫在雾中摸索之际，你悄然溜出门外，离开了这座城市。

column1: Blood pounding in your ears, you dash forward into the city. You run around a corner and down a small alley. Behind you, the gate sergeant gives new orders.
column2: 血脉贲张，你疾步冲入城中。绕过街角，奔入一条小巷。身后，守门的军士正下达新的命令。

column1: Blooding pounding in your ears, you dash forward into the city. You run around a corner and down a small alley. Behind you the gate sergeant gives new orders.
column2: 血脉在耳中奔涌，你疾步冲入城中。你转过一个街角，跑进一条小巷。身后，守门的军士发出新的命令。

column1: Boldly standing forth, $ChosenOneName kneels in prayer, sings hymns, and even grovels in the dust, but nothing avails. $His plea goes unanswered. Meanwhile peasants and travellers uneasily edge around this little scene. Some whisper a brief prayer to St. Vitus, thinking you possessed or cursed. Finally you give up, rest, and reconsider your options...
column2: 勇敢地挺身而出，$ChosenOneName 跪地祈祷，吟唱圣歌，甚至匍匐于尘埃，却毫无所获。你的 的祈求未得回应。与此同时，农夫与旅人不安地绕过这小小的一幕。有人低声向圣维图斯祈祷，以为你被附身或遭诅咒。最终你只得放弃，稍作休憩，重新思量对策……

column1: Boldly, $ChosenOneName steps forth to speak with the loathsome worm, but before $he can utter a word, the monster attacks with a gout of fire. $ChosenOneName staggers; then $NamedTwoName leaps forward and the fight is on!
column2: 勇敢地，$ChosenOneName 走上前去与那可憎的虫怪交谈，但 你 尚未开口，怪物便喷出一股火焰。$ChosenOneName 摇晃着；随即 $NamedTwoName 纵身跃上，战斗就此展开！

column1: Boldly, $ChosenTwoName steps forward and prays.
column2: 勇敢地，$ChosenTwoName 步向前，祈祷。

column1: Bowing $his head, $ChosenOneName utters $his prayer.
column2: 弯腰 你的 颗头颅，$ChosenOneName 念诵 你的 祈祷。

column1: Bowing and thanking you profusely, $NamedOneName says, "Thank you forever for your help. Our village will be grateful always. I must return now to my tasks as Schulz."
column2: 深鞠躬并连声道谢，$NamedOneName 说道：“永世感谢阁下的援手。吾村将永远铭记于心。如今我须返归本职，继续担任施尔茨。”

column1: Bowing low with thanks, the friar is very grateful.
column2: 深鞠躬致谢，修士感激不已。

column1: Bowing low, you thank him for his kind consideration.
column2: 深鞠躬，你答谢其厚意。

column1: Bowing, $NamedOneName says, "Thank you lord, for answering my prayers with these virutous ones. I see this as a sign of your support for our most just cause."
column2: 深鞠躬，$NamedOneName 云：“多谢大人，应我祈愿赐此义士。此乃你护佑吾等正义之举之明证。”

column1: Bowing, the alchemist hands $ChosenOneName the fabled formula, $Text2. $He accepts it, bowing in return. The alchemist also offers a bit of his philosopher's stone, which will improve yours.
column2: 深鞠躬，炼金术士将传说秘方 $Text2 交予 $ChosenOneName。你 接过，亦回礼一躬。炼金术士复献哲人石少许，助汝精进。

column1: Bowing, the priests takes $ChosenOneName to his library, where $he learns about Saint $NamedTwoName. Meanwhile, $NamedOneName escorts the rest of you from the chambers of the $CityLordTitle and thanks you once more.
column2: 深鞠躬，祭司引 $ChosenOneName 至其藏书楼，你 得知圣徒 $NamedTwoName。与此同时，$NamedOneName 护送余众离 $CityLordTitle 寝宫，并再三致谢。

column1: Breaking away from the guards, you run away from the city, evading a few patrols sent after you.
column2: 脱离守卫，你奔逃出城，避过几队追兵。

column1: Breaking past the guards, you race to the wall, and quickly clamber up. You are safe inside the city. You duck down an alley as the guards shout futile curses from behind.
column2: 冲破守卫，你疾驰至城墙，迅即攀上。入城无虞。见守卫在后徒呼咒骂，你潜身小巷。

column1: Breathing forth threats and curses, $NamedOneName strides out of his fortress. "My most trusted retainers shall back me up. Stand and die!"
column2: 呼啸威胁，怒斥诅咒，$NamedOneName 大步走出堡寨。“吾最信之扈从必助我一臂之力。受死吧！”

column1: Breathing hard, you thank the saints for your victory today.
column2: 气喘吁吁，你谢诸圣今日之胜。

column1: Breathing heavily, scratched and bitten, you stand over your fallen foes. Others about the field are running in your direction, to see what all the commotion is about. Escape seems impossible. Thinking quickly, $ChosenOneName cries "Only one choice -- go in! In! Blend with the crowd!"
column2: 气息沉重，遍体鳞伤，你立于败敌之上。四野之人皆向此地奔来，欲探究竟。逃亡已无可能。急中生智，$ChosenOneName 喊道：“唯有此策——入内！混入人群！”

column1: Breathing heavily, you say a blessing over the bones of your enemies. If these are the outer guardians, what must the inner denizens be like?
column2: 气喘吁吁，你为敌尸默祝。若此乃外层守卫，内里之辈又当如何？

column1: Breathing silent thanks for your narrow escape, you enter the field.
column2: 默谢侥幸脱险，你步入战场。

column1: Bremen.
column2: 不来梅。

column1: Briefly, $ChosenOneName utters a prayer and closes $his eyes.
column2: 稍作停顿，$ChosenOneName 念诵一祷，阖上 你的 目。

column1: Broken-hearted, you must flee the guards. They run after you for a short while, taunting, but soon tire of the sport and leave you to escape in peace.
column2: 心碎难忍，你只得逃离守卫。彼等追击片刻，嘲讽不止，终倦而止，任你从容遁去。

column1: Building a fire quickly, $ChosenOneName hands out brands to each of you. When the wolves close in, you wave the flaming brands in their faces, and they withdraw, snarling. After a couple of hours of this treatment, they slink off and do not return.
column2: 迅速燃起篝火，$ChosenOneName 分发火把予众人。狼群逼近时，挥火把逼退之，彼等咆哮退却。如此反复两时许，狼群悄然散去，不再复返。

column1: Burnt timbers and heaps of broken bricks become the frame and walls of your new home. With a little work, you rearrange the debris into an acceptable shanty. It's wet and drafty, but at least you're protected from the worst of the weather.
column2: 焦木与碎砖堆砌成新居之框架与墙垣。稍加修整，残骸便成可居陋室。虽湿冷漏风，总胜风雨侵袭。

column1: Bursting almost in the onrushing guards' faces, the potion blinds them long enough for you to get away scot-free.
column2: 药剂骤然喷涌，直扑守卫面门，使其暂时失明，汝得以安然脱身。

column1: Bursting through the golden door, you see a mob of seething kobolds waving tools and weapons. You try to greet them, but they glibber,
column2: 穿过金门，但见群魔乱舞的地精挥舞工具与兵刃。汝欲致意，彼等却吱吱怪叫，

column1: Bursting through the golden door, you see a seething mob of kobolds waving tools and weapons. Before you can react, a band of dwarfs bowls you over and fires a volley of handguns into the kobolds. The remaining kobolds squeal and leap towards the dwarfs. Severed limbs fly through the air. Blood spouts high. Shrill squeaks from mortally-wounded kobolds pierce through the din. Finally it is over. The surviving kobolds flee while the dwarfs gather around you.
column2: 穿过金门，但见汹涌地精挥舞工具与兵刃。未及反应，一群矮人撞翻汝，随即向地精齐射枪械。残存地精尖叫着扑向矮人。断肢飞舞，鲜血喷涌。濒死地精尖鸣刺破喧嚣。终告平息。幸存地精溃逃，矮人则围汝而立。

column1: Bursting through the golden door, you see a seething mob of kobolds waving tools and weapons. They snarl and charge towards you.
column2: 穿过金门，但见汹涌地精挥舞工具与兵刃。彼等咆哮着向汝冲来。

column1: Bursting through the golden door, you see a small band of dwarfs, weapons lowered. Before you can react, a screaming mass of kobolds rushes up from behind you and engulfs the dwarfs in a howling, hacking frenzy of confusion. The dwarfs stoutly resist. Severed limbs fly through the air. Blood spouts high. Shrill squeaks from mortally-wounded kobolds pierce through the din. Finally it is over. The surviving dwarfs flee while the kobolds mass around you.
column2: 穿过金门，但见一小队矮人，武器低垂。未及反应，身后狂呼的地精蜂拥而至，将矮人卷入一片呼啸砍杀的混乱之中。矮人顽强抵抗。断肢飞舞，鲜血喷涌。濒死地精尖鸣刺破喧嚣。终告平息。幸存矮人溃逃，地精则聚汝身旁。

column1: Bursting through the golden door, you see a small band of dwarfs, weapons lowered. They snarl and charge to the attack. You look over your shoulders, hoping for kobold assistance, but none is forthcoming.
column2: 穿过金门，但见一小队矮人，武器低垂。彼等咆哮着发起冲锋。汝回首望，冀求地精相助，然无果。

column1: Bursting through the golden door, you see a small band of dwarfs, weapons lowered. You greet their leader, but he growls back,
column2: 穿过金门，但见一小队矮人，武器低垂。汝向其首领致意，彼却低吼回应，

Severed limbs fly through the air. Shrill squeaks from mortally-wounded kobolds pierce through the din. Finally it is over. The surviving dwarfs flee while the kobolds mass around you.

column2: 穿过金门，但见一小队矮人，武器蓄势待发。彼等咆哮着发起冲锋。汝回首望，冀求地精相助，然无果。

column2: 穿过金门，但见一小队矮人，武器蓄势待发。汝向其首领致意，彼却低吼回应，

column1: Bursting through the rusty red door, you see a mob of seething kobolds waving tools and weapons. You try to greet them, but they gibber,
column2: 穿过锈红铁门，但见群魔乱舞的地精挥舞工具与兵刃。汝欲致意，彼等却叽叽喳喳，

column1: Bursting through the rusty red iron door, you see a seething mob of kobolds waving tools and weapons.
column2: 冲破锈红铁门，只见一群地精挥舞工具与兵刃，汹涌而来。

column1: Bursting through the rusty red iron door, you see a seething mob of kobolds waving tools and weapons. They snarl and charge toward you.
column2: 穿过锈红铁门，但见汹涌地精挥舞工具与兵刃。彼等咆哮着向汝冲来。

column1: Business out of the way, $NamedOneName gently unrolls the scroll to reveal pages of illuminated handwriting.
column2: 公事既了，$NamedOneName 轻轻展开卷轴，露出满纸彩绘手迹。

column1: But $NamedOneName still lives, standing amidst the rubble. He glares at you and stalks forward. "My power is destroyed, but you'll not live to boast of it!"
column2: 然而 $NamedOneName 尚存，屹立于瓦砾之中。他怒视汝，步步逼近。“吾权虽毁，汝休想得意扬言！”

column1: But as you sink, you are able to breathe! The prayer of $ChosenOneName has wrought a miracle. You struggle ashore, exhausted but alive. In fact, everyone survives the wreck with nothing more than a few broken bones among the crew.
column2: 然而沉没之际，汝竟仍能呼吸！$ChosenOneName 之祈祷竟显神迹。汝挣扎登岸，虽疲惫不堪，却尚存生机。实则，全员皆幸免于难，仅船员偶有骨折而已。

column1: But in the night, when you creep back near the cave, you find them badly wounded yet still alive. Gently you carry them off to safety.
column2: 夜半潜回洞穴附近，汝见彼等重伤犹活。汝轻轻将其救出，安置于安全之地。

column1: But now you have no choice, you must fight the infernal hounds charging you and ignore this strange creature hiding behind you.
column2: 如今别无选择，汝只得迎战扑来的地狱猎犬，暂且无视藏于身后的奇异生灵。

column1: But on the chair, instead of the dwarf, is the $NamedTwoName.
column2: 然而椅上所坐者，并非矮人，而是 $NamedTwoName。

column1: But one of the witches takes a closer look, and realizes that $ChosenOneName is not one of them. She shrieks for help.
column2: 然而其中一女巫细察之下，方知 $ChosenOneName 并非同道。她惊呼求援。

column1: But something is wrong. The girls are tearful. None have made any effort to look nice -- their hair straggles, their dresses are old and stained, some even make faces at you.
column2: 然而情形有异。少女们泪眼婆娑。无人刻意装扮——发丝凌乱，衣衫陈旧污渍斑斑，更有甚者对你皱眉。

column1: But the hounds are not confused and keep chasing the original prey. You run after them, but you reach the scene just as they have cornered their quarry. Suddenly they turn to charge you.
column2: 然而猎犬并未迷失，依旧追逐原定猎物。汝紧随其后，及至现场，彼等已将猎物逼入绝境。忽而转攻汝身。

column1: But the inhabitants of the fortress, alerted by your actions, arrive to punish you for your deeds!
column2: 堡垒居民闻讯赶来，欲惩汝之恶行！

column1: But the leader shouts, "Nay! Let them live. When they reacquire more goods, we'll take them again at our leisure. This is how lord $NamedOneName manages his herd."
column2: 然而首领喝道：“不可！留其性命。待其再积财货，吾等自会从容取之。此乃 $NamedOneName 处理畜群之道。”

column1: But then he becomes hard and suspicious, "Or are you the Devil come to tempt me with false promises? I must test you and see if you are truly fit."
column2: 然而他旋即变得冷峻多疑：“抑或汝乃魔鬼，以虚妄之诺诱我乎？吾须试汝，以辨真伪。”

column1: By dint of hard riding, you manage to stay ahead of the Wild Hunt until morning, when your pursuers fade back into mist. You are saved!
column2: 凭坚毅骑乘，汝得以领先野性猎团直至晨曦，彼等终隐于雾霭。汝得救矣！

column1: By knotting up articles of clothing, $ChosenOneName is able to block the influx of water. You are saved from drowning.
column2: 以衣物打结，$ChosenOneName 成功阻水涌入。汝免于溺亡。

column1: By listening carefully and asking a few leading questions, you discover that the guild leader probably poisoned his predecessor. Rumor says the hired assassin wasn't "taken care of" properly, and now hides somewhere in the city.
column2: 细听并巧问数语，汝发现公会会长极有可能毒害前任。传闻称凶手未被妥善处置，现藏于城中某处。

column1: By listening carefully and asking a few leading questions, you discover that the leader probably poisoned his predecessor. Rumor says the poisoner wasn't "taken care of" properly, and now hides somewhere in the city.
column2: 细听并巧问数语，汝发现会长极有可能毒害前任。传闻称下毒者未被妥善处置，现藏于城中某处。

column1: By listening carefully and asking good questions, you learn that the guild leader may be a secret member of a heretical, satanic cult. Unfortunately, to prove it you must expose the cult's secret worship services, preferably when the leader is present.
column2: 细心倾听并提出恰当的问题，你得知公会会长或许是某个异端邪教的秘密成员。不幸的是，要证明这一点，你必须揭露该教派的秘密祭祀活动，最好是在会长亲临之时。

column1: By listening carefully and asking good questions, you learn that the guild leader may be a secret member of a heretical, satanic cult. Unfortunately, to prove it you must expose the leader's involvement.
column2: 细心倾听并提出恰当的问题，你得知公会会长或许是某个异端邪教的秘密成员。不幸的是，要证明这一点，你必须揭发会长的参与。

column1: By listening carefully and asking good questions, you learn that the leader may be a secret member of a heretical, satanic cult. Unfortunately, to prove it you must expose the cult's secret worship services, preferably when the leader is present.
column2: 细心倾听并提出恰当的问题，你得知会长或许是某个异端邪教的秘密成员。不幸的是，要证明这一点，你必须揭露该教派的秘密祭祀活动，最好是在会长亲临之时。

column1: By listening carefully and asking just the right questions, you learn that the guild leader probably has a secret lover and mistress. Of course, you need some incriminating evidence, such as love letters, before anyone would believe you.
column2: 细心倾听并提出恰到好处的问题，你得知街坊首领很可能有秘密情人和情妇。当然，在任何人相信你之前，你需要一些确凿的证据，比如情书。

column1: By listening carefully and asking just the right questions, you learn that the street leader probably has a secret lover and mistress. Of course, you need some incriminating evidence, such as love letters, before anyone would believe you.
column2: 细心倾听并提出恰到好处的问题，你得知街坊首领很可能有秘密情人和情妇。当然，在任何人相信你之前，你需要一些确凿的证据，比如情书。

column1: By order of the $CityLordName, I, the $CityLordTitle, do hereby rule $PlaceName. Citizens should continue their lawful, peaceful and orderly pursuits. There is no cause for alarm or concern. The time of disorder and uncertainty is now at an end. All hail the $CityLordName!
column2: 依$CityLordName之命，吾，$CityLordTitle，特此统治$PlaceName。市民当继续其合法、和平且有序之事。毋须惊慌或忧虑。混乱与不安之世已告终结。万岁，$CityLordName！

column1: By setting one fire after another, you have overwhelmed the defenders. The flames spread to the roof. Soon the tower is an inferno. People, clothes ablaze, stagger out of the gate.
column2: 你接连纵火，令守军应接不暇。火焰蔓延至屋顶，塔楼旋即化为火海。人披火衣，踉跄而出。

column1: COPPER: At least one of the three of us is a liar.
column2: 铜：三人之中至少有一人说谎。

column1: COPPER: Not so. I am Aubyn.
column2: 铜：非也。吾乃奥宾。

column1: COPPER: Press Gold to open the door.
column2: 铜：按“金”键开门。

column1: COPPER: The son of Mot is silver.
column2: 铜：莫特之子乃银。

column1: Cackling, the witches exult over your defeat. They thrash your helpless bodies until they are convinced you are dead, then steal your possessions.
column2: 咕咕作笑，女巫们欢呼你的败北。她们鞭笞你等无助之躯，直至确信你们已死，然后掠走你们的财物。

column1: Call upon a saint for aid.
column2: 向圣徒求助。

column1: Calling to $NamedOneName , $ChosenOneName feels a brief surge of contentment and peace. "We should be safe here," $he says.
column2: 念诵$NamedOneName，$ChosenOneName顿觉片刻安宁与祥和。“此处当可无虞，”你言。

column1: Calling to the castle garrison, you say "We have come for justice. No man enters or leaves, except by our leave, until $NamedOneName surrenders himself to us!"
column2: 对城堡守军呼曰：“我等为求正义而来。除经我等许可外，任何人不得出入，直至$NamedOneName向我等自首！”

column1: Calling upon $NamedOneName, $ChosenOneName feels $his knees go weak, and $he falls into a fit of uncontrollable trembling. When you ask $him what happened, $he can only say, "I saw the Earth open before me ... their worm dieth not!" When $he finally recovers, $he only remembers that some great evil lay before $him. What could the saint have meant in opening this dire vision to you?
column2: 念诵$NamedOneName，$ChosenOneName但觉你的双膝发软，你则陷入不可遏制之颤抖。问及缘由，你 лишь ответил: «Я видел, как земля открылась передо мной... их червь не умирает!» Когда 你 наконец пришел в себя, он помнил лишь, что перед 你 скрывалось великое зло. Что мог иметь в виду святой, открыв вам это грозное видение?

column1: Calling upon a holy saint, $ChosenOneName invokes the protection of heaven, and the evil rain ceases. Seizing your opportunity, you race across the cavern, hoping to get to the other side before the rain starts up again. And you succeed!
column2: 向圣徒祈求庇佑，$ChosenOneName唤来天恩，恶雨遂止。趁机疾驰穿洞，冀于雨再起前抵达彼岸。果得成功！

column1: Calling upon heaven to witness $his prayer, $ChosenOneName cries out for aid in $his hour of need. But the heavens remain closed. No saint answers $his plea.
column2: 向苍天祷告，$ChosenOneName于你的危难之际呼救。然天门紧闭，圣徒未应。

column1: Calmly, $ChosenOneName leads you all across to the harbor's water steps. The guards and other bystanders watch this with mouths agape. Nobody protests as you walk up the steps and off into the city.
column2: 平静地，$ChosenOneName引领众人渡至港口水阶。守卫与旁观者皆瞠目结舌。无人阻拦，尔等拾级而入城。

column1: Calmly, you wave the hat under $NamedOneName's nose and state that he must vow, in front of Heaven, saints, and these witnesses (gesturing to one another) that he will abandon the mine forever.
column2: 冷静地，你挥帽于$NamedOneName鼻端，命其当着上天、诸圣及众证人（指指彼此）立誓，永弃此矿。

column1: Camp outside the city.
column2: 在城外扎营。

column1: Captain $NamedOneName, leader of the city guard, $VarPhrase3 change in the city.
column2: 城市卫队队长$NamedOneName，$VarPhrase3城市之变。

column1: Carefully $ChosenOneName pours the potion across the rock. Alas, it has absolutely no effect, and runs off onto the ground.
column2: $ChosenOneName小心倾药于岩面。惜乎毫无效用，尽流入地。

column1: Carefully applying the Firewall potion to those parts of your bodies that will be above the water, you are able to avoid the worst effects of the hellish fire, and are soon across, alive but singed.
column2: 将防火药谨慎涂抹于身体高出水面之处，得以免受烈焰之害，虽焦痕犹存，终得生还。

column1: Carefully applying the Firewall potion, you are preserved from the heat. The dwarf has been foiled.
column2: 药敷身，热焰难侵。矮人计谋落空。

column1: Carefully but surely, $ChosenOneName scales the fitted stone of the outer wall, drops the rope, and the rest of you follow. Softly, you steal into the darkest shadow at the base of the central keep, where $ChosenOneName again climbs and throws down the rope once more.
column2: $ChosenOneName稳而慎地攀越外墙石块，放下绳索，余众随之而上。悄然潜入主堡基座最幽暗处，$ChosenOneName复攀，再掷绳索。

column1: Carefully but surely, $ChosenOneName scales the fitted stone of the outer wall, drops the rope, and the rest of you follow. Softly, you steal into the darkest shadow at the base of the central keep, where $ChosenOneName again climbs, and throws down the rope once more.
column2: $ChosenOneName稳而慎地攀越外墙石块，放下绳索，余众随之而上。悄然潜入主堡基座最幽暗处，$ChosenOneName复攀，再掷绳索。

column1: Carefully considering your options, you decide to...
column2: 经慎重权衡，汝等决定……

column1: Carefully laying the holy relic down upon the evil altar, $ChosenOneName lights up with an aureola of glory. You feel holy power surge through you as  the altar is purged of its unholy spirit and cleansed of all evil. You retrieve the relic and go on your way.
column2: 将圣物轻置邪坛之上，$ChosenOneName周身焕发光辉。圣力涌动，坛中邪气尽除，污秽一扫而空。汝等取回圣物，继续前行。

column1: Carefully wielding torches, so as not to burn down the warehouse, you sweep the place clean. It takes almost three hours, and many of you are bitten by spiders, but no one is seriously injured. All in all, you feel you earned your $DieRoll florins!
column2: 手持火把，小心翼翼清扫仓库，以免焚毁。历时近三小时，多人遭蜘蛛咬伤，幸无重伤。总计获$DieRoll弗罗林！

column1: Carefully wielding torches, so as not to burn down the warehouse, you sweep the place clean. It takes almost three hours, and many of you are bitten by spiders, but no one is seriously injured. All in all, you feel you earned your $Number1 florins!
column2: 手持火把，小心翼翼清扫仓库，以免焚毁。历时近三小时，多人遭蜘蛛咬伤，幸无重伤。总计获$Number1弗罗林！

column1: Carefully you sneak through the guild workshops and into the living quarters. Your goal is...
column2: 悄悄潜入公会工坊，直抵居所。汝等目标是……

column1: Carefully, $ChosenOneName approaches the altar and sprinkles the precious potion across the table-rock.
column2: $ChosenOneName缓缓走近祭坛，将珍贵药液洒于台石之上。

column1: Carefully, $ChosenOneName examines the rocks and brush around the mouth of the cave, but discovers nothing of note. The snow muffles all sound and an eerie quiet hovers about the party.
column2: $ChosenOneName细察洞口四周岩石与灌木，未见异状。积雪掩声，四周寂然。

column1: Carefully, $ChosenOneName examines the rocks and brush around the mouth of the cave. $He finds evidence of some large animal having repeatedly broken the twigs off a nearby bush; some branches are freshly cracked showing the animal passed this way less than an hour ago.
column2: $ChosenOneName细察洞口四周岩石与灌木。你发现附近灌木枝条屡被折断，部分新折断枝条显示动物不足一小时前曾从此经过。

column1: Carefully, $ChosenOneName expounds, "It is unjust to confiscate the miners' tunnels. They labored to create this mine, and have the right to a share of its fruits." The dwarf shakes his shaggy head, chanting,
column2: $ChosenOneName娓娓道来：“没收矿工隧道实属不公。此矿乃他们辛勤劳作所成，理应分享其利。”矮人摇晃蓬乱头颅，吟唱道：

column1: Carefully, $ChosenOneName finishes his prayer. You wait.
column2: $ChosenOneName祈祷毕。汝等静候。

column1: Carefully, $ChosenOneName places the potion in a crack in the altar, then stands back at a distance and tosses pebbles at it. When the bottle is finally struck, it explodes with shocking violence. A miasma of flame and smoke billows forth, thoroughly scorching the altar and surrounding area. Any evil that was here has clearly been eliminated.
column2: $ChosenOneName将药液注入坛中裂隙，退后投石击之。瓶破瞬间，爆炸猛烈，火焰烟雾弥漫，坛及周边尽被灼烧。凡此间邪祟，尽皆荡涤。

column1: Carefully, $ChosenOneName places the potion in a deep fissure in the floor. You back away and the potion explodes in a shower of dirt and stone. An easy entrance gapes.
column2: $ChosenOneName将药液注入地面深缝。汝等后撤，药液爆裂，土石纷飞，豁然开路。

column1: Carefully, $ChosenOneName pours the potion on the table-stone. It sputters and sizzles, bleaching some spots, but effects no major changes.
column2: $ChosenOneName将药液泼于台石。石面嘶响，局部褪色，然无大变。

column1: Carefully, $ChosenOneName rubs a small amount of ointment onto $his hands, and you notice that $he sneaks a vial into $his pocket at the same time. Then $he takes a ride into the air on an oaken bough.
column2: $ChosenOneName少许药膏涂于你的双手，汝等忽见你乘机将小瓶塞入你的袋中。随即你乘橡树枝腾空而去。

column1: Carefully, $ChosenOneName sprinkles the potion on the faggots. When the Templars return with a lighted brand, you stare straight into their eyes and roar, "By our Savior, the Lord, I say your flames have no power over us."
column2: $ChosenOneName将药液洒于柴捆之上。当圣殿骑士携火把归来，汝等直视其眼，厉声喝道：“奉吾主救世之名，尔焰无能加诸我等！”

column1: Carefully, $ChosenOneName uses $his artifice skill to unlock a storeroom entrance, then slip the inside bolt. You all quietly steal in behind $him...
column2: $ChosenOneName凭你的巧技开启储藏室门锁，并拨动内栓。汝等随你悄然入内……

column1: Carefully, each of you edge along the steep cliff face. The greenish mist is pouring out of the cave and cascading down the rock face below. Fortunately, it is not blown sideways or upwards, so you are safe from that. Now all you need do is move safely off this cliff!
column2: 各自沿陡崖徐行。青雾自洞中涌出，顺岩壁倾泻而下。幸未横吹或上扬，尚属安全。今唯需安然离崖。

column1: Carefully, from an empty upstairs room you listen at the floor to a conversation below...
column2: 从楼上空室俯听楼下对话……

column1: Carefully, he closes and locks the box. "Now, let me explain our difficulty..."
column2: 他小心合箱锁好。“如今，容我道明困境……”

column1: Casually passing $Money1 to the sergeant, you hope he accepts. With a sly smile he asks, "Who was it you wished to visit?" He gestures down a dark corridor and then calls his men away to an inspection elsewhere. You realize that he just provided a perfect, unguarded escape route. Quickly you hurry down the corridor...
column2: 随意将$Money1递予军曹，盼其收下。军曹狡黠一笑：“阁下欲访何人？”他遥指幽径，唤部下赴别处巡查。汝等方悟，此正是一条绝佳的脱身之路。速沿径而下……

column1: Casually passing $Money1 to the sergeant, you hope he accepts. With a sly smile he asks, "Who was it you wished to visit?" Waiting for your friend to be brought from his cell, you notice the guards casually trying to surround you. Obviously, the guard captain took your money and now plans on taking you. Best to attack now!
column2: 随意将$Money1递予军曹，盼其收下。军曹狡黠一笑：“阁下欲访何人？”等候友人自牢房押来时，汝等察觉守卫悄然围拢。显然，卫队长已收汝钱，今又欲擒汝。不如先发制人！

column1: Casually, $ChosenOneName pulls a small vial from $his pouch and tosses it toward the guards. "Here, catch," $he says.
column2: $ChosenOneName随手自你的囊中取出小瓶，抛向守卫。“接住吧，”你言。

column1: Catching your breath, you stare at the fallen giant. Suddenly, to your horror, it stands up!
column2: 气喘方定，汝等凝视倒地巨人。忽而，骇然见其竟站起！

column1: Cautiously, his friends wade into the sticky ooze and rescue him. In the meantime you are long gone, escaped into the maze of back streets and alleys of $PlaceName.
column2: 谨慎地，他的朋友们趟入黏稠的淤泥中将他救出。与此同时，你早已远去，遁入$PlaceName那错综复杂的后街小巷之中。

column1: Certainly the opposition must have a home or office that serves as their headquarters. A highly destructive raid would make them look like weaklings who can't protect themselves, much less their supporters.
column2: 当然，反对派必定有一个作为总部的住所或办公室。一次极具破坏力的突袭会让他们显得软弱无能，连自身都无法保护，更遑论他们的支持者。

column1: Certainly, these poor pilgrims seem in need of comfort. You are delighted that your gift is appreciated.
column2: 果然，这些可怜的朝圣者亟需慰藉。你欣慰于馈赠得其所用。

column1: Chagrined at your defeat, you run from the gate and the victorious guards. They chortle and mock as you run, not even bothering to follow you.
column2: 因败北而懊恼，你从城门处逃离，那些胜利的守卫们则咯咯笑着嘲讽你，甚至懒得追赶。

column1: Chagrined, the demon returns $ChosenTwoName to you, then vanishes in oily black smoke. $ChosenTwoName seems none the worse for wear.
column2: 恼怒之下，恶魔将$ChosenTwoName归还于你，随即化作一团油腻的黑烟消散。$ChosenTwoName似乎毫发无损。

column1: Chagrined, you run back through the door into the church. Your escape has failed.
column2: 懊恼之余，你奔逃着穿过教堂的门。你的逃脱失败了。

column1: Chanting a brief prayer to $NamedOneName , $ChosenOneName suddenly feels an ominous chill shake $his body. For an instant, you all see a red-eyed cloud of darkness floating over the village, spreading its shadow over the land. $ChosenOneName turns to the rest of you and says, "This is a warning. There is evil deep-rooted in this place. Perhaps we should avoid it."
column2: 念诵着对$NamedOneName的简短祷词，$ChosenOneName忽觉一阵不祥的寒意袭遍你的全身。刹那间，你们皆见一团红眼的黑暗之云漂浮于村庄之上，将阴影笼罩大地。$ChosenOneName转向众人道：“此乃警示。此地深处潜伏着邪恶。或许我们该避而远之。”

column1: Chanting briefly, $ChosenOneName brings forth the might of $NamedOneName. A halo of light engulfs you all, then you are lifted up and over the gate. A faint singing like a choir of angels can be heard in the distance. When you land within the city, no one dares molest you.
column2: 简短吟唱，$ChosenOneName 引发 $NamedOneName 的伟力。一道光晕将你们笼罩，随即你们被托起，越过城门。远处隐约传来如天使合唱般的歌声。当你们降落在城内时，无人敢加害于你。

column1: Chanting lustily, $ChosenOneName invokes the divine $NamedOneName. Beams of light shine down from the sky into the bosoms of the attacking soldiers. They stop, feeling the peaceful spirit, throw down their weapons, and turn to one another in joy. While they are engaged in brotherly camaraderie, your party climbs into the city. Of course, you are forced to leave your horses behind. The soldiers do not even notice your passing.
column2: $ChosenOneName 洪亮地吟唱，召唤神圣的 $NamedOneName。天际垂下光束，洒入攻城士兵的胸膛。他们顿住脚步，心生宁静，弃械相拥，欢欣鼓舞。趁他们彼此友爱之际，你们一行悄然入城。当然，马匹只得暂留原地。士兵们竟未察觉你们的经过。

column1: Charging, you cut your way through the guards and escape into an alley. They do not pursue, since they do not relish more of the punishment you have just administered.
column2: 你奋勇向前，劈开守卫，逃入一条小巷。他们并未追击，因不愿再尝你方才施予的惩罚。

column1: Chattering with rage, $NamedThreeName drives you back with gouts of magic fire. He screams hoarsely, "No mortal can harm me, for my holy cross draws strength from the dragon's den! Thus the power of Hell is turned to Heaven's benefit!"
column2: 怒吼着，$NamedThreeName 以滔天的魔火将你逼退。他嘶哑地喊道：“凡人皆不能伤我，因我圣十字汲取龙穴之力！故而地狱之威反为天恩所用！”

column1: Cheerily, the priest says, "Our village is a happy one. I hold mass every day. Our patron saints are Saint Simon Magus and Saint Elymas."
column2: 牧师欣然道：“吾村甚是安乐。每日皆有弥撒。吾等之守护圣徒乃圣西蒙·马古斯与圣埃利马斯。”

column1: Christina the Astonishing replies to your pleas and you are suddenly enfolded in a divine glow and levitated gently through the air, far from the harsh terror of the dragon.
column2: 惊世的克里斯蒂娜回应了你的祈求，你骤然被神圣的光辉笼罩，轻盈地漂浮于空中，远离那龙的残酷恐怖。

column1: Chuckling, $NamedOneName replies, "You, directed by the Holy Spirit? I'm afraid your reputation precedes you."
column2: 哈哈一笑，$NamedOneName 回道：“你，受圣灵指引？恐怕你的名声早已传开。”

column1: Chuckling, the monk says, "The abbot values his sleep above all other things, save our Lord himself. I, for one, am unwilling to disturb it, no matter how pressing your business. Return tomorrow."
column2: 僧侣轻笑着说道：“方丈最珍视的，除了吾主之外，便是他的睡眠。就我而言，无论你有何要紧之事，我都无意打扰。明日再来吧。”

column1: City barracks, at night.
column2: 城市兵营，夜色中。

column1: City hospice, at night.
column2: 城市的施疗所，夜色中。

column1: Clanging loudly, the cell door swings wide and a band of guards hustle you out of the jail and drag you unceremoniously before the richter (the magistrate).
column2: 铛啷作响，牢门大开，一群卫兵将你从狱中拖出，粗暴地押到法官面前。

column1: Clanging open, the cell door shocks you into alertness. The guards hustle in and unceremoniously haul you all before the richter (the magistrate).
column2: 格格作响，牢门猛然洞开，将你惊醒。狱卒匆匆而入，毫不客气地将你们押至法官面前。

column1: Clawing frantically at the moist stone wall, $ChosenOneName gets partway up, but lacks a firm enough grip to exert leverage on the window's bars. While $he is trying, the turnkey drops by. "Oh, ho!" he chortles. "Not content with a fancy cell? Let's see how you like a windowless one!" And you are unceremoniously dumped into a new cell.
column2: 狂乱地抓挠着潮湿的石墙，$ChosenOneName 攀至半途，却因抓握不牢而无法借力攀上窗栏。正当 你 努力之际，狱卒恰巧路过。“哦，呵！”他狞笑道，“嫌牢房太好？且看你是否喜欢这无窗之地！”于是你被粗暴地扔进了新的囚室。

column1: Clear and strong, $ChosenOneName's voice rings out as $he beseeches $NamedOneName to aid you. The heavens part and rays of light shoot out from behind the clouds, piercing the chests of the onrushing guards. Each stops, puzzled at first. Then they smile, put up their weapons and invite you to go your way in peace. Cheerfully, you do so.
column2: 清亮而有力，$ChosenOneName的声音响起，你恳求$NamedOneName助你一臂之力。天穹裂开，光芒自云层后射出，直贯冲来的卫兵胸膛。他们一时惊疑，随即微笑，放下武器，示意你平安离去。你欣然照办。

column1: Clearly the bull horns are not the right choice.
column2: 显然，牛角并非正解。

column1: Clearly the goat horns are not the right choice.
column2: 显然，山羊角并非合适之选。

column1: Clearly the monster is too strong for you. Perhaps you could return when you are better prepared.
column2: 显然，此怪物过于强大。或许待你准备更充分时再行返回。

column1: Clearly your evil reputation makes you unwelcome guests. You decide to...
column2: 显然，你的恶名使你成为不受欢迎的客人。你决定……

column1: Clearly, this exploit has done nothing to hurt your reputation or fame.
column2: 显然，此番壮举并未损及你的声名与荣耀。

column1: Clearly, you lack sufficient charisma or reputation to impress the Fuggers.
column2: 显然，你缺乏足够的魅力或声誉来打动富格家族。

column1: Clearly, you would be unwelcome within. You decide to...
column2: 显然，你将不被欢迎入内。你决定……

column1: Closing your eyes in rage and sorrow, you wait impotently while $ChosenOneName is led to the block. $ChosenOneName spits on the executioner in one last show of defiance. Seconds later, your friend is dead. In your heart you vow vengeance, should you survive.
column2: 你怒火与悲痛交加地闭上双眼，无助地等待着$ChosenOneName被押赴刑场。$ChosenOneName在最后的抗争中朝刽子手啐了一口。数秒之后，你的挚友已命丧黄泉。若能幸存，你于心中立誓必报此仇。

column1: Closing your eyes, you join hands and advance, through the ghost and toward the grave. You feel an icy chill, but no other discomfort. You hear $ChosenOneName mutter simple prayers beneath $his breath.
column2: 闭上双眼，你携手前行，穿过幽灵，走向坟墓。你感到一阵刺骨的寒意，却无其他不适。你听见$ChosenOneName在你的呼吸间低声诵念着简单的祷词。

column1: Clouds of smoke obscure the route you take. The guards choose a wrong alley to run down, and you soon leave them far behind.
column2: 烟雾遮蔽了你的去路。守卫们选错了小巷奔逃，你很快便将他们远远甩在身后。

column1: Coldly, you take the gold cup from the thief. His theft aroused the dragon from sleep and thus caused the deaths of hundreds. You leave him behind, wailing his loss.
column2: 冷然间，你从窃贼手中夺过金杯。他的偷窃惊醒了沉睡的巨龙，从而导致数百人丧命。你将他弃于身后，任其哀号失物。

column1: Coming up the road is a well-dressed but elderly nobleman, riding a proud steed and surrounded by knights and guardsmen. He stops, looks you over, and says to a knight, "Don't these people owe us the road toll of $Money1?"
column2: 沿路而来，是一位衣着考究的年迈贵族，骑着一匹神骏的战马，身旁簇拥着骑士与侍卫。他勒住缰绳，打量了你一番，对一名骑士说道：“这些人不是该向我们缴纳$Money1的通行税吗？”

column1: Conferring amongst yourselves, you decide to ...
column2: 你们彼此商议，决定……

column1: Confidently, you say "The password is...
column2: 你自信地说道：“密码是……

column1: Considering your options and skills, you decide to...
column2: 综合考量自身之选项与技艺，汝决定……

column1: Considering your request carefully, the physician replies:
column2: 细思汝之请求，医师答曰：

column1: Continue to examine your surroundings.
column2: 继续审视周遭。

column1: Continuing his dissertation, the dwarf says, "When a dragon gets some gold, it thirsts for more, and is never content. When a dragon is angered, it does not calm down upon venting wrath -- it works up into greater and greater frenzy! Yet this supernatural trait is also a weakness, for once a dragon starts sleeping, it can fall into a deeper and deeper sleep till it is comatose for years.
column2: 矮人继续他的论述：“当一条龙得到些许黄金，便贪得无厌，永不满足。龙一旦动怒，发泄愤怒后亦不平息——反而愈发狂躁！然而此等超自然特性亦是其弱点，因龙一旦入眠，便会沉睡愈深，直至昏迷数年。”

column1: Continuing his dissertation, the dwarf says, "You have saved several maidens from the dragon, and so it has become LESS hungry! It has now returned to its lair to sleep, and we can trap it."
column2: 继续他的论述，矮人道：“你已救下数名少女于龙口，故此它已 LESS 饱食！如今归巢沉睡，我们便可设陷阱擒之。”

column1: Continuing his speech, Baphomet says, "I shall take the risk of your return in exchange for being able to accomplish my plans with more time. Should you refuse, I shall simply bring about the Apocalypse today. Choose!"
column2: 巴佛墨特继续说道：“我愿冒你归来的风险，以换取更多时间完成我的计划。若你拒绝，我便今日即刻降下天启。选择吧！”

column1: Continuing your discussions with the merchants, you talk about..
column2: 继续与商人们交谈，你谈及……

column1: Continuing, the $CityLord Title says, "Allow me also to offer you a boon that is within my power. Would you like...
column2: 继续，$CityLord头衔者言道：“亦请容我赠予汝一桩力所能及之恩惠。汝可愿……”

column1: Convinced that you are powerless, the witches depart, cackling with insane glee.
column2: 妖妇们确信你无力反抗，便咯咯笑着离去，狂喜不已。

column1: Copper says, "No. Gold is Gymer."
column2: 铜说：“不。金子是吉默尔的。”

column1: Copper: I am not Hootvin.
column2: 铜：我不是胡特文。

column1: Corroding mists burn your eyes and lungs. Coughing, you finally escape the evil fog. Then you see that your armor is grievously affected; the metal is rusted and corroded, the leather is cracked and dry.
column2: 腐蚀的雾气灼痛你的眼与肺。咳嗽着，你终于逃出了这邪恶的迷雾。随即你发现，你的盔甲已严重受损；金属锈迹斑斑，皮革干裂龟裂。

column1: Coughing seawater, you bandage the worst wounds and shiver over a scratch fire. Taking stock, everyone realizes that many valuable things were abandoned, or destroyed by the seawater, including your armor and extra weapons.
column2: 咳出海水，你为最重的伤口包扎，并在微弱的篝火旁瑟瑟发抖。清点一番后，众人意识到许多贵重之物已被遗弃，或被海水摧毁，其中包括你的盔甲与额外的武器。

column1: Coughing, one of the guards asks "What's that stink?" Soon the entire contingent is choking and retching, while you quietly slip past.
column2: 咳嗽着，一名守卫问道：“那是什么臭味？”很快，整个队伍都呛得直干呕，而你则悄然溜了过去。

column1: Counting carefully, $NamedOneName pushes over $Money1 and says, "This sum should serve as a proper preliminary payment. Use it to equip yourselves, should you have need. We look forward to a speedy ending of $NamedTwoName's reign."
column2: 细数之后，$NamedOneName 推倒了 $Money1，说道：“此数当为妥当之预付。若有需用，可资装备。盼 $NamedTwoName 之统治速告终结。”

column1: Cover your eyes and try to scrape the lime off as best you can.
column2: 用手遮住眼睛，尽力刮去石灰。

column1: Cracking open, your vial flashes like lightning while you shield your faces.
column2: 瓶子裂开，你的药瓶如闪电般闪耀，而你们则掩面躲避。

column1: Crashing against a stone, the bottle breaks and a searing blast of light scorches the eyes of the oncoming guards. They drop their weapons and fall back, crying out in surprise. $ChosenOneName throws up a rope and climbs the wall, then helps everyone else up and into the city.
column2: 瓶子撞上石壁，应声而碎，一道刺目的光芒灼伤了迎面而来的守卫的眼睛。他们丢下武器，惊呼着退后。$ChosenOneName抛出绳索，攀上城墙，随后帮助众人登城入内。

column1: Crashing against a stone, the bottle breaks and searing light scorches the eyes of the oncoming guards. They drop their weapons in shock. Everyone scrambles up the wall and (surprisingly) succeeds, getting into the city.
column2: 瓶子撞上石壁，应声而碎，刺目的光芒灼伤了迎面而来的守卫的眼睛。他们惊愕地丢下了武器。众人奋力攀上城墙，（出乎意料地）成功登城，进入了城内。

column1: Cravenly you cower as the Hunt brings down its prey. Fangs crunch through muscle and bone. The horrible death shriek echoes in your heads long after the forest returns to deadly silence.
column2: 你怯懦地蜷缩着，眼睁睁看着猎杀降临于猎物。獠牙撕裂肌肉与骨骼。那凄厉的临终惨叫在森林重归死寂后仍久久回荡于你的脑海。

column1: Crawling away, you feel lucky that any of you remain alive, even if virtually all your possessions are gone.
column2: 悄然离去，你庆幸自己尚存一线生机，即便几乎身无分文。

column1: Creeping through the tower, you find $NamedOneName's room and enter. The robber knight and his lieutenant look up, startled. Stepping forward, $ChosenOneName holds a blade to the old villain's throat.
column2: 悄然潜入塔楼，你寻得$NamedOneName的居室，推门而入。那名强盗骑士与其副手惊愕抬头。$ChosenOneName上前一步，刀锋抵住老贼咽喉。

column1: Creeping through the tower, you find $NamedOneName's room and enter. The robber knight jumps up, then backs away, drawing his weapon.
column2: 悄然潜入塔楼，你找到了$NamedOneName的房间并走了进去。那名强盗骑士猛然跃起，随即后退，拔出了武器。

column1: Crumbling moss pulls away under $ChosenOneName's fingers. Silently $he falls off the wall, landing with a sickening thud. Carefully you carry $him to a copse of trees.
column2: 蜕落的青苔在$ChosenOneName指下剥落。无声地，你从墙上坠下，重重地摔在地上。你小心翼翼地将你抬到一片树丛旁。

column1: Curious to see a genuine dragon lair, you clamber up and into the hole.
column2: 怀着一探真龙洞府的好奇，你攀援而上，钻入洞穴之中。

column1: Current reputation in $PlaceName is $Number1.
column2: 你在$PlaceName的当前声望为$Number1。

column1: Current test options are...
column2: 当前测试选项如下……

column1: Curses! The pea was under the left-hand shell all the time! "Oh, too bad," says the little man, insincerely. "Let's try again. Maybe this time you'll win. Just one groschen."
column2: 咒骂！豌豆一直藏在左手边的贝壳下！“哎呀，真可惜，”矮人虚情假意地说，“再试一次吧。也许这次你能赢。就一格罗申。”

column1: Curses! The pea was under the middle shell all the time! "Oh, too bad," says the little man, insincerely. "Let's try again. Maybe this time you'll win. Just one groschen."
column2: 咒骂！豌豆一直就在中间的贝壳底下！“哎呀，真可惜，”矮人虚情假意地说，“再试一次吧。也许这次你能赢。只要一枚格罗申。”

column1: Curses! The pea was under the right-hand shell all the time! "Oh, too bad," says the little man, insincerely. "Let's try again. Maybe this time you'll win. Just one groschen."
column2: 咒骂！豌豆一直就在右手边的贝壳下！“哎呀，真可惜，”矮人虚情假意地说，“再试一次吧。也许这次你能赢。只要一枚格罗申。”

column1: Cursing softly, $ChosenOneName struggles with the lock of a side door. Suddenly there is a loud CRACK as something breaks inside the lock mechanism.
column2: 轻声咒骂着，$ChosenOneName费力地拨弄着侧门的锁。突然，“咔嚓”一声巨响，锁芯内某处断裂了。

column1: Cursing, the raubritter calls down from the battlements. "I'll see you fry in Hell." A party of armed men issue forth to attack. You must fight or flee.
column2: 骂骂咧咧地，劫骑士从城垛上喊道：“我要让你在地狱里煎熬。”一队全副武装的士兵冲了出来，准备进攻。你必须迎战或逃走。

column1: Cutting your way through the enemy, you run into the depths of the city, leaving the remaining guards far behind.
column2: 砍杀敌军，你奔入城中深处，将残余守卫远远甩在身后。

column1: Cutting your way through the mob, you make your way to the hill atop which they enact their obscene rites. Cowed, the villagers remain below, screaming curses and promising, "You'll get yours on $SabbatTime, if you dare go $SabbatLocation!" You find this threat interesting, and resolve to remember the time and place.
column2: 穿越人群，你登上那座举行淫秽仪式的山丘。村民畏惧地留在山下，高声咒骂，并誓言：“若敢前往$SabbatTime，定在$SabbatLocation讨你还债！”此言引你注目，你决意记下时日与地点。

column1: DEFINE.
column2: 定义。

column1: Dank tassels of moss festoon the walls, which stink of urine. The bars, though rust-eaten, retain their ancient strength. A tiny window lights the chamber. The turnkey feeds you day-old stew and keeps a pail of slimy drinking water brim-full. Such is the life of luxury in the jail.
column2: 沾满苔藓的流苏垂挂在墙上，空气中弥漫着尿臊味。铁栏虽锈迹斑斑，却仍保有昔日的坚固。一扇小窗为牢室带来微光。狱卒给你一碗隔夜的炖菜，并备着一桶满溢的污浊饮水。这便是牢中奢华的生活。

column1: Danzig.
column2: 格但斯克。

column1: Dark clouds and driving rain engulf your ship in a roaring maelstrom. Sailors frantically take in sail, while the captain triples the men at the helm. From the worried expression on the captain's face, you're not sure the ship will survive. You...
column2: 黑云翻滚，暴雨如注，巨浪吞没了你的船只。水手们慌忙收帆，船长则加倍调派舵手。从船长紧锁的眉头来看，你难以断定此船能否撑过这场风暴。你...

column1: Dark masses of stone loom over you. The footsteps of the guard fade away as he walks out of sight. Now's your chance to...
column2: 森森石影，高耸于你之上。守卫的脚步渐行渐远，直至消失不见。此刻正是你的机会……

column1: Dark windowless corridors stretch before you as you stalk through the robber knight's lair. Sudden a gaggle of armed soldiers burst out of a door ahead, laughing and joking drunkenly with one another. You try to jump into the shadows, but it is too late. They have seen you and suddenly are sober.
column2: 黑暗无窗的走廊在你面前延伸，你悄然潜行于强盗骑士的巢穴之中。突然，一群全副武装的士兵从前方的门中涌出，醉醺醺地谈笑着。你试图跃入阴影，但为时已晚。他们已发现你，瞬间清醒过来。

column1: Darkness blots out the sun. As you blunder through the haze, corruption seeps into your bones. Vile feelings overwhelm you. Before the evil overcomes you, the sun returns, and you shake off the contamination, or nearly so.
column2: 黑暗遮蔽了太阳。当你在迷雾中踉跄前行时，腐朽渗入你的骨髓。邪恶之感席卷而来。在邪念将你吞噬之前，太阳重现，你摆脱了这股污染，或几乎如此。

column1: Darkness covers the main street of $PlaceName. Far off you see the lanterns of the watchmen, enforcing the curfew. Avoiding them, you set off for...
column2: 黑暗笼罩着$PlaceName的主街。远处，你望见守夜人的灯笼，正执行宵禁。避开他们，你启程前往……

column1: Dashing down narrow lanes and alleys, you outdistance the night watch.
column2: 穿梭于狭窄的巷道与小径，你甩开了夜巡队。

column1: Dashing forward, potion in hand, $ChosenOneName is met with a hail of crossbow quarrels. $He dives aside as one grazes $his shoulder. In another second $he gains cover, but the potion lies smashed and ruined on the pavement.
column2: 纵身向前，手中握着药剂，$ChosenOneName 遭遇一束弩箭的齐射。你 向旁一跃，一支箭擦过 你的 的肩头。片刻之后，你 找到掩护，但药剂已在石板路上摔得粉碎，化为乌有。

column1: Dashing off down an alley, you realize $ChosenOneName has fallen behind. Rather than abandon $him to the nightwatch, you all stop and confront the pursuit.
column2: 你飞奔入一条小巷，才发觉$ChosenOneName落在了后面。不愿将你弃于夜巡者之手，你们停下脚步，迎战追兵。

column1: Day-laborers and non-guild workers seem to $VarPhrase5 political change.
column2: 临时工与非公会工人似乎对$VarPhrase5政治变革抱有期待。

column1: Dead, the schrats look like humans wearing dirty, uncured furs. Their stench is almost overpowering. Happy to have survived, you move on quickly.
column2: 死去的史克雷茨看起来像是披着肮脏、未鞣制毛皮的人类。其臭气几乎令人窒息。庆幸自己幸存，你匆匆离去。

column1: Deciding that you may be mistaken for the perpetrators, you too slip away -- down a different side street!
column2: 你认定自己可能被误认为是罪犯，于是也悄然离去——从另一条小巷溜走！

column1: Deep in prayer, $ChosenOneName has a disturbing vision. $He sees an image of the castle lord watching with satisfaction as his men whip the poor peasants. The vision changes, and he sees the lord's men carry off a farmer's beautiful daughter, screaming.
column2: 深入祈祷之中，$ChosenOneName 得到一个令人不安的幻象。你 看见城堡领主满意地注视着他的手下鞭打贫苦农民。幻象一转，他看见领主的手下将一位农夫的美丽女儿拖走，她正在尖叫。

column1: Deep in prayer, $ChosenOneName has a startling vision. He sees the castle lord, dressed in white robes with a red cross, standing before a great bonfire. Around him are the peasant farmers and the troops. Hovering in the air, above the flames, is a horrible demonic head. The lord and his followers all bow to the demon.
column2: 深入祈祷之中，$ChosenOneName 得到一个惊人的异象。他看见城堡领主身着白袍，胸前绣着红十字，立于熊熊篝火之前。其周围是农夫与士兵。火焰之上，悬浮着一颗可怖的恶魔之首。领主及其追随者皆向恶魔俯首。

column1: Deep in prayer, $ChosenOneName has a terrible vision. $He sees the image of a worried lord donning his armor while farmers stream into the castle. Then $he sees marauding armies sweeping over the fields, while a brave lord and his peasants valiantly defend themselves from the castle walls and keep.
column2: 深入祈祷之中，$ChosenOneName 得到一桩骇人之幻象。你 看见一位忧心忡忡的领主披挂甲胄，而农夫们纷纷涌入城堡。继而 你 又见劫掠之军席卷田野，英勇的领主与佃农于城垣堡垒之上奋勇御敌。

column1: Deep in prayer, $ChosenOneName sees and feels a great sense of peace in this land. The people respect their lord, who in turn defends them and justly rules them.
column2: 深入祈祷之中，$ChosenOneName在这片土地上感受到无比的宁静。百姓敬重他们的领主，而领主亦守护他们，公正地治理着这片土地。

column1: Defeated, the demon vanishes in oily black smoke. The villagers rush up to you. "Thank you! Thank you!" they shout. "You are our saviors! Many lives will be saved, now that we need not use the dangerous upriver ford. Thank you! Thank you!"
column2: 恶魔败北，化作油腻的黑烟消散。村民们奔向你，高呼：“感谢！感谢！”“你是我们的救星！如今无须再冒险渡过上游的险滩，许多性命得以保全。感谢！感谢！”

column1: Defeated, you are at the demon's mercy. With painstaking care, he selects $ChosenOneName and vanishes in a puff of oily black smoke. Your friend is gone.
column2: 败北之际，你落入恶魔之手。他小心翼翼地选中$ChosenOneName，随即化作一缕油腻的黑烟消失无踪。你的同伴已逝。

column1: Defeated, you cannot prevent the devil from vanishing, taking your friend with him.
column2: 败北之下，你无法阻止恶魔消失，连同你的朋友一同被带走。

column1: Defeating the guards, you rush to the wall. There is no time to use a rope, so you all climb up individually and, surprisingly, succeed. Shouts of angry soldiers echo behind you, but you vanish down an alley.
column2: 击败守卫，你奔向城墙。无暇使用绳索，众人只得各自攀爬，竟也成功。身后传来士兵的怒吼，而你们已隐入小巷之中。

column1: Deformed shapes prance around the fire. The dancers are witches and their minions. It is a diabolic ceremony! Suddenly one cries out. They've spotted you!
column2: 变形的身形在火边起舞。舞者是女巫及其爪牙。这是一场恶魔般的仪式！突然，一人惊呼。他们发现你了！

column1: Deliberately, $ChosenOneName kneels in the path of the bear and prays to $NamedOneName.  $His deep faith is rewarded!  The bear stops his angry charge and calmly licks $ChosenOneName on the nose.  With the bear tamed, the chest is opened to reveal the spoils of some unfortunate thief.
column2: $ChosenOneName 故意跪于熊之途，向$NamedOneName祈祷。你的虔诚终得回报！熊止其怒冲，温顺舔舐$ChosenOneName之鼻。熊既驯服，宝箱开启，显露出某不幸窃贼之赃物。

column1: Delighted by your submission, the witches confer over what to do with you. Finally the leader says, "We shall free them, disarmed. Lord $NamedTwoName will surely claim them itself, in this, its land."
column2: 女巫们欣喜于你的献身，商议着该如何处置你。最终，首领说道：“我们将让他们无械释放。领主$NamedTwoName必会亲自将其收归麾下，毕竟这是它的领地。”

column1: Delighted to be selected, $ChosenOneName confesses that $he pawned all useful equipment and is now completely out of cash as well.
column2: 欣喜若狂的$ChosenOneName坦言，你已将所有有用装备典当，如今更是身无分文。

column1: Delighted, you begin reorganizing your gear as you are escorted from the armory to the $citySquare, the central square of $PlaceName.
column2: 欣喜之余，你开始整理行装，随侍者从军械库被护送至$citySquare，即$PlaceName的中央广场。

column1: Delighted, you begin reorganizing your gear as you leave the stables for the main street of $PlaceName.
column2: 欣喜之余，你开始整理行装，走出马厩，踏上$PlaceName的主街。

column1: Delighted, you move past, exchanging friendly remarks. Normally participants in a private war (feud) assume that anyone not an ally is automatically an enemy!
column2: 你欣喜地走过，与人寒暄致意。通常而言，在私人战争中，人们会认为非盟友者皆为敌！

column1: Demons have driven the dwarfs up from their homes! If you could drive the devils back to Hell, the dwarfs could leave, and the miners could have their mine again!
column2: 恶魔已将矮人逐出家园！若能将恶鬼驱回地狱，矮人便可离去，矿工亦可重获其矿！

column1: Demonstrating $his superb agility and stealth, $ChosenOneName quickly scales the wall, then tosses down the rope so the rest of you can follow. This is easier than expected because you find the city guardsmen have deserted their posts. Unfortunately, the personal guards of the $CityLordTitle are still inside, guarding their master.
column2: 展现出你的卓越的敏捷与隐秘，$ChosenOneName迅速攀上城墙，随即抛下绳索，让你们其余人跟上。这比预想中要容易得多，因为你们发现城中的守卫已弃岗而去。不幸的是，$CityLordTitle的贴身护卫仍在其中，守护着他们的主人。

column1: Demoralized, the crowd disperses, $NamedOneName disappears, and you are dragged off to the dungeon!
column2: 士气低落，人群四散，$NamedOneName消失不见，你被拖入地牢！

column1: Despite $ChosenOneName's best efforts at rhetoric and pompous disclaiming of your little band's valor, the lord yawns openly. "If this is the sum total of these fellows' adventures," he says, "then I was wrong to interview them at all."
column2: 尽管$ChosenOneName竭力以辞藻铺陈，并故作高傲地否认你们这支小队的英勇，领主却公然打了个哈欠。“若这些人的历险仅止于此，”他道，“那我当初就不该接见他们。”

column1: Despite $ChosenOneName's best efforts, $NamedThreeName does not respond.
column2: 尽管$ChosenOneName竭尽全力，$NamedThreeName仍无回应。

column1: Despite $ChosenOneName's fine words, the villagers place their own safety above that of the poor girl, and shrug off $his arguments.
column2: 尽管$ChosenOneName言辞恳切，村民仍将自身安危置于那可怜少女之上，你的辩驳置若罔闻。

column1: Despite $ChosenOneName's lengthy invocation, there is no response, except that the clouds appear a little gloomier and denser over the sinister Castle of the Apocalypse.
column2: 尽管$ChosenOneName长篇祈诵，仍无回应，唯见阴云愈发低沉，笼罩于那座阴森的末日之堡之上。

column1: Despite $ChosenOneName's most fervent prayers, $NamedOneName does not respond.
column2: 尽管$ChosenOneName虔诚祷告，$NamedOneName仍无回应。

column1: Despite $ChosenOneName's struggles, the villagers manage to restrain her. Even as they work to tie her to a wooden stake, the horrible dragon glides in on barbed wings. The peasants scream and run, but the monster lands atop two of them and crunches their bones. You run to help $ChosenOneName, but it is already too late.
column2: 尽管$ChosenOneName奋力挣扎，村民仍将其制伏。正当他们欲将她缚于木桩之际，那狰狞巨龙携满身利刃般的羽翼悄然降下。农人惊呼四散，然怪物已扑至二人身上，骨断肉裂。你奔向$ChosenOneName相助，却已迟矣。

column1: Despite $his best efforts, $ChosenOneName fails. "I can't handle this without strong alchemy," $he says. "I need something like a Thunderbolt potion!"
column2: 尽管你的竭尽全力，$ChosenOneName仍告失败。“没有强大的炼金术，我无法应对，”你说道，“我需要某种雷霆药水！”

column1: Despite $his best efforts, $ChosenOneName is unable to inspire the crowd to risk a rain of crossbow quarrels. You shrug, and settle down to consider another option...
column2: 尽管你的竭尽全力，$ChosenOneName仍无法激励众人冒着弩箭之雨前行。你耸了耸肩，坐下来另谋他策……

column1: Despite $his best efforts, $ChosenOneName is unable to inspire the crowd.
column2: 尽管你的竭尽全力，$ChosenOneName仍无法振奋人心。

column1: Despite $his best efforts, $ChosenOneName just doesn't have enough speaking skill and raw charisma to overcome doubts. They refuse to believe your allegations.
column2: 尽管你的竭尽全力，$ChosenOneName仍缺乏足够的口才与天然魅力，难以消除疑虑。他们不愿相信你的指控。

column1: Despite $his best efforts, $ChosenOneName just doesn't have enough speaking skill and raw charisma to overcome the doubts of the guildsmen. They refuse to believe your allegations.
column2: 尽管你的竭尽全力，$ChosenOneName仍缺乏足够的口才与天然魅力，难以消除工匠们的疑虑。他们不愿相信你的指控。

column1: Despite $his desperate prayers, $ChosenTwoName neither sees nor feels any help from on high.
column2: 尽管你的苦苦祈求，$ChosenTwoName既未见天降援手，亦无半分感应。

column1: Despite $his fervent attempts, the prayers of $ChosenOneName are not answered.
column2: 尽管你的次热切祈求，$ChosenOneName的祷告仍未得到回应。

column1: Despite $his fervent attempts, the prayers of $ChosenOneName are not answered. The enemy is upon you! You haven't time for anything else, you must stand and fight.
column2: 尽管你的次热切的祈求，$ChosenOneName的祷告仍未得到回应。敌人已至！你已无暇他顾，唯有迎战。

column1: Despite $his impassioned prayers, $ChosenOneName receives no divine aid. Eventually $he gives up, saying, "I'm sorry, my friends, but not all prayers are answered."
column2: 尽管你的满怀热忱地祈祷，$ChosenOneName仍未得到神明的庇佑。最终你只得放弃，说道：“抱歉，诸位朋友，然并非所有祈愿皆能得偿。”

column1: Despite an hour of careful searching and listening, you find nothing new or interesting.
column2: 尽管仔细搜寻并倾听了一个时辰，你仍未发现任何新奇之物。

column1: Despite long and careful prayers, $ChosenTwoName receives no divine aid. You shrug. One's prayers are not always answered.
column2: 纵使祈祷良久且虔诚，$ChosenTwoName仍未能得神佑。你耸了耸肩。人之祷告，未必皆有应。

column1: Despite long and careful prayers, $ChosenTwoName receives no divine aid. You shrug. Prayers are not always answered.
column2: 纵使祈祷良久且虔诚，$ChosenTwoName仍未获神佑。你耸了耸肩。祷告并非总有回响。

column1: Despite long, hard praying, $ChosenOneName gains no visions or information about this situation.
column2: 尽管虔诚苦祷良久，$ChosenOneName 仍未能获知此境之异象与消息。
