column1: Despite long, hard praying, no miracles are forthcoming. "Not every prayer is answered," $ChosenTwoName explains.
column2: 纵使长祷苦祈，亦无奇迹降临。“并非每一声祈祷都能得到回应，”$ChosenTwoName解释道。

column1: Despite the curfew, there are still soldiers and camp-followers about. However, the shops are closed. You...
column2: 尽管宵禁已至，仍有士兵与随营之人徘徊。然商铺皆闭。汝……

column1: Despite your best efforts, the farmers are terrified of talking to anyone, especially a stranger with arms and armor. However, in their scarred faces and haunted eyes, you see signs of hardship and suffering.
column2: 尽管你竭尽全力，农人们仍惧怕与任何人交谈，尤其是身披护甲的陌生人。然而，在他们满是伤痕的面容与幽魂般的眼神中，你看到了艰辛与苦难的印记。

column1: Despite your best efforts, the huntsman remains unmoved. "Leave or pay," he demands.
column2: 尽管你竭尽全力，猎人仍无动于衷。“要么离开，要么付钱。”他厉声说道。

column1: Despite your best efforts, you can discover absolutely nothing new or different about $PlaceName. It seems as if the entire city has gone into a contented slumber.
column2: 尽管你竭尽全力，却对$PlaceName一无所知，毫无新意可言。仿佛整座城池都陷入了安详的沉睡之中。

column1: Despite your best efforts, you can't find anyone to help you enroll in classes. Arrogant students and teachers sneer at you, tossing off incomprehensible Latin phrases.
column2: 尽管你竭尽全力，仍无人肯助你注册课程。傲慢的学子与师者对你嗤之以鼻，随口抛出令人费解的拉丁语句。

column1: Despite your best efforts, you cannot escape the lightly equipped Hussites. You are forced to turn and fight, before they cut you down from behind.
column2: 尽管你竭尽全力，仍无法摆脱装备轻便的胡斯派。在他们从背后将你斩杀之前，你被迫转身迎战。

column1: Despite your efforts, the schrat is dead. At least you have escaped the Hunt yourself.
column2: 尽管你已尽力，那小妖还是死了。至少你自己逃脱了猎杀。

column1: Despite your efforts, you have been beaten and recaptured by the cultists. Soon their sacrifice will continue.
column2: 尽管你已竭尽全力，仍被教徒们击败并重新俘获。不久，他们的献祭将再度延续。

column1: Despite your manifest courage, you are their prisoners. The raubritter's men gloat as they strip you of nearly every possession.
column2: 尽管你勇气卓著，却仍沦为他们的阶下囚。劫匪骑士的部下得意洋洋，剥去了你几乎所有的财物。

column1: Despite your protests, she dismisses you with a wave of her hand. "Fare well, and lose not your hope!"
column2: 尽管你百般辩驳，她仍挥手将你打发走。“一路顺风，莫失希望！”

column1: Despite your screams and pleas, the water flows in on you. Kicking off your armor, you try to swim to the top. Alas, hapless $ChosenOneName sinks helplessly to the bottom and drowns. When the pit drains, you are alarmed to see that your discarded armor has somehow been filched.
column2: 尽管你尖叫呼救，水流仍不断涌入。你踢脱护甲，试图游向水面。无奈，不幸的$ChosenOneName无助地沉入水底，溺亡。当坑洞排空时，你惊恐地发现，你弃置的护甲竟不知所踪。

column1: Dextrously, $ChosenOneName uses a bit of the potion to destroy the ropes that bind you. Before the surprised Templars can react, you leap free, grab your weapons, and flee. The fiendish monks only make a brief chase, then they return to their original business with the unfortunate friar.
column2: 灵巧地，$ChosenOneName用少许药剂斩断缚住你的绳索。惊愕的圣殿骑士尚未反应过来，你已跃身脱困，执起兵刃，仓皇逃窜。那群邪恶的僧侣只略作追击，便又回到他们原本对那位不幸修士的处置之上。

column1: Digging for days, your endless toil finally leads to success. One last scrape by the spoon opens to fresh air. Quickly you scramble through the hole and look around. You are dirty and scabbed, but free, in a back alley.
column2: 多日掘进，终得其果。最后一铲，豁然开朗。你急匆匆钻出洞口，环顾四周。满身污垢，伤痕累累，却已重获自由，置身于一条后巷之中。

column1: Diligently supplicating the saints, $ChosenOneName prays loud and long. The guards stop, puzzled. When the prayer ends, you wait expectantly. Nothing happens. The guards resume their advance.
column2: 勤勉地向诸圣祈求，$ChosenOneName 高声而长久地祈祷。卫兵们停下脚步，感到困惑。祈祷结束时，你满怀期待地等待着。然而，什么也没有发生。卫兵们继续向前推进。

column1: Dirty, ragged bandit-soldiers leap for you, weapons drawn, yelling battle cries. Quickly you draw weapons and brace for battle.
column2: 脏兮兮、衣衫褴褛的土匪士兵挥舞着武器向你扑来，高声喊着战吼。你迅速拔出武器，严阵以待。

column1: Disappointed, you step back into the darkness and reconsider...
column2: 失望地，你退入黑暗之中，重新思量……

column1: Disappointed, you withdraw, close the door, and consider your next move.
column2: 失望之余，你退下，关上门，思索下一步行动。

column1: Disgruntled at the failure of his professional torturers, the richter rails at them for some time. Then he turns to you. "Torture could not make you speak. Since you refuse to plead, the law has no further hold over you. Go."
column2: 对于专业刑讯者的失败感到不满，法官斥责了他们一番。随后他转向你。“酷刑未能让你开口。既然你拒绝认罪，法律对你已无能为力。去吧。”

column1: Dismayed at this sinister response, the guards hesitate. Another of you whines, "Not again? Remember last time in Widdlesheim? Collecting the pieces was so messy!" $ChosenOneName begins to advance ominously.
column2: 听到这阴森的回应，卫兵们犹豫不决。你们中又一人哀嚎道：“又来了？还记得上次在维德尔斯海姆吗？收拾那些残骸可真麻烦！”$ChosenOneName开始阴沉地逼近。

column1: Disturbed by $NamedOneName's response, $ChosenOneName asks him, "Exactly what do you want us to give you to stop the fighting?"
column2: 为$NamedOneName的回应所扰，$ChosenOneName问道：“究竟要我们给你什么，才能停止这场争斗？”

column1: Divine Saint Reinold enables $ChosenOneName to climb the sheer wall easily. $He climbs up, snaps out the bars, and you all climb out of the jail.
column2: 神圣的圣莱诺德使$ChosenOneName能够轻松攀爬陡峭的墙壁。你向上攀爬，掰断栏杆，你们全都从监狱中爬了出来。

column1: Doing your best to look harmless, you approach the $CityLordTitle. He hardly even looks up while answering your queries. The guards around the room chat among themselves, not noticing the wanted criminals in their presence. The city lord says, "I know not the name of every criminal in the dungeons. Go to the turnkeys and ask them about their charges."
column2: 你尽力装作无害，走向$CityLordTitle。他几乎连头都不抬，便回答了你的问题。房间里的守卫们自顾自地闲聊，丝毫未察觉到眼前就有通缉的罪犯。城主说道：“我不知地牢里每个罪犯的名字。去问狱卒他们的罪名吧。”

column1: Doughty $NamedOneName and his minions are too much for you, and you collapse, unconscious. When you awaken, you are outside the mine. You are chagrined; the dwarfs took all your goods.
column2: 勇猛的$NamedOneName及其爪牙非你所能敌，你颓然倒下，昏厥过去。待你醒来时，已身在矿井之外。你懊恼不已；矮人们夺走了你所有的财物。

column1: Dramatically, $ChosenOneName prays for saintly assistance. The cutthroats pause for a bit, amazed by $his piety, then shrug and charge forward, still bent upon profitable murder.
column2: 突然间，$ChosenOneName 祈求圣徒相助。那些亡命之徒因 你的 的虔诚而稍作停顿，随即耸肩继续冲来，仍一心谋取暴利。

column1: Drawing on all $his knowledge of quaint and forgotten lore, $ChosenOneName tries valiantly to impress the lord. But to no avail. The lord's own philosophers out-argue $him on many points, and $ChosenOneName is unable to bring forth any interesting facts that strike the lord's fancy.
column2: 凭借对古朴而遗忘的秘术的全部你的知识，$ChosenOneName竭力欲使领主印象深刻。然终无功。领主之哲人于多处驳倒你，而$ChosenOneName亦未能提出任何令领主称奇之趣闻。

column1: Driven off by Sir $NamedOneName and his men, you flee in frustration. You are beaten today. In fact, you reflect that if the dragon is stronger than the knight, you surely could not stand against it!
column2: 被$NamedOneName爵士及其部下驱逐，你愤然逃窜。今日败北。事实上，你想到，若连龙都胜过骑士，你又岂能与之抗衡！

column1: Driven to desperation, the raubritter's gaunt minions finally attack. They rush out, screaming their battle cry. You calmly draw your own weapons and await the onslaught.
column2: 走投无路之下，劫匪骑士那瘦骨嶙峋的爪牙终于发动了进攻。他们冲出阵地，高声喊着战吼。你从容拔剑，静待来敌。

column1: Drooling hot saliva, their yellow eyes gleaming, the pack closes in on you. It is time to fight or be eaten. This is not a foe that accepts surrender.
column2: 口吐热涎，黄眼闪烁，群狼步步逼近。是战斗，或是被吞噬。此敌不接受投降。

column1: Dropping his sophisticated veneer, $NamedOneName seizes the book and lovingly leafs through its pages of illuminated handwriting.
column2: 放下他那精致的伪装，$NamedOneName 抓起书本，爱怜地翻阅着那些饰有彩绘的手稿。

column1: Dropping your weapons and raising your arms over your heads, you surrender to the guards. They check you over, confiscating articles of obvious value, then march you off to the town dungeon. As you tramp down the street with downcast eyes, you overhear an officer.
column2: 你们放下武器，双手举过头顶，向守卫投降。他们搜查了你们，没收了明显值钱的物品，然后押送你们前往镇上的地牢。当你们低着头沿着街道前行时，无意间听到了一名军官的谈话。

column1: Ducking into an alley, you realize that you could have been leading this, if you had remained loyal to the cause. Now you can only watch and wonder about the outcome. Meanwhile, it is clearly impossible to go anywhere using the main street. You retreat to a side street and reconsider your destination...
column2: 躲进一条小巷，你意识到，若当初忠于大业，如今便可主导一切。如今只能旁观，揣测结局。与此同时，显而易见，主街已无法通行。你退入侧街，重新思量去向……

column1: Due to the temporary inconvenience of a hostile army besieging this city, no citizen may pass the city walls until further notice. All citizens are urged to arm themselves, and to be frugal with their foodstuffs.
column2: 由于敌军暂时围困此城，所有市民在另行通知之前不得越过城墙。务请各位自备武器，并节俭使用粮食。

column1: Dumbfounded, the guards grovel below, too amazed for words. They keep staring after you long after you have disappeared from view and climbed down the building's other side.
column2: 守卫们目瞪口呆，匍匐在地，惊得说不出话来。你消失在视线中，沿着建筑的另一侧攀下后，他们仍久久凝视着你的背影。

column1: During Mass, you feel uneasy, but are not sure why. The priest pronounces certain Latin words in a most strange manner. At first you assume it is mere ignorance on his part. But as the Mass progresses, you begin to suspect that the priest is actually inserting new words into the mass, and replacing some of the old traditional phrases. When you eat the communion wafer, it leaves a bitter aftertaste, as of mold.
column2: 礼拜时，你心中不安，却不知缘由。神父念诵某些拉丁文时，语调异常古怪。起初你以为只是他学识浅薄。然随礼拜渐进，你疑心神父竟在弥撒中添入新词，替换了部分传统经文。食圣餐饼时，余味苦涩，似有霉气。

column1: During an especially busy moment you attempt to slip past the guards, but they notice. A halberd flashes down in front of you. A guard growls, "Halt! Where's your toll?" You grin sheepishly. "Pay up or begone!" demands the guard.
column2: 在一个尤为繁忙的时刻，你试图悄悄从守卫身旁溜过，却被他们察觉。一柄戟在你面前猛然劈下。一名守卫低吼道：“站住！你的通行费呢？”你尴尬地一笑。“要么交钱，要么滚开！”守卫厉声喝道。

column1: During an especially busy moment you attempt to slip past the guards, but they notice. A halberd flashes down in front of you. A guard growls, "Halt!, Where's your toll?" You grin sheepishly. "Pay up or begone!" demands the guard.
column2: 正当你忙得不可开交时，试图从卫兵身旁悄然溜过，却被他们察觉。一柄戟闪电般横于你面前。卫兵低吼道：“站住！通行税呢？”你讪讪一笑。“要么缴税，要么滚蛋！”卫兵厉声喝道。

column1: During the festival, foreign traders are the single most powerful political force in $PlaceName.
column2: 节日期间，外来商贾乃$PlaceName最为强大的政治势力。

column1: During the party, $NamedOneName, the new $CityLordTitle, takes you aside into a private room.
column2: 宴会期间，$NamedOneName，这位新任$CityLordTitle，将你引至一间密室。

column1: During the this critical time, $NamedOneName, Captain of the Guard, is the undisputed leader of $PlaceName is $NamedOneName, Captain of the City Guard.
column2: 此危急关头，$NamedOneName，城卫队长，实为$PlaceName无可争议之领袖。

column1: Dust and flame billow from the door. When it clears, you find the door and its frame twisted into an hopeless maze of half-shattered beams and bent iron bars. You all heave and tug, but it's impossible to get past.
column2: 尘烟与火焰自门后腾起。待其散尽，但见门扉及其框架已扭曲成半碎木梁与弯铁条交织的绝境迷宫。众人齐力推拉，却终难逾越。

column1: Dwarf: "Albech is made of gold."
column2: 矮人：“阿尔贝赫乃黄金所铸。”

column1: E
column2: E

column1: EACH  FACE  MUST  SAY  AT  LEAST  ONE  TRUTH.
column2: 每面必至少说一句真话。

column1: EACH  SPEAKS  EITHER  WHOLLY  TRUE
column2: 每面或全真，或全假。

column1: EACH  STATUE  SPEAKS  EITHER  ALL  TRUTH  OR  ALL  LIES.
column2: 每尊雕像或全真，或全假。

column1: EACH FACE SPEAKS ONLY TRUTH OR ALL LIES.
column2: 每面或全真，或全假。

column1: ENOCH
column2: 以诺

column1: ERSTWHILE.
column2: 昔日

column1: Each drop of potion begins to sparkle like a tiny star. Soon the entire rock is sparkling, as if it were afire. The light becomes blinding. When the light fades, the rocks have subtly changed shape and position. The altar now is a random jumble of stones on a hilltop, and the circle is reduced to a few odd boulders. Overhead, the clouds are gone.
column2: 每滴药液渐如星芒闪烁。不久，整块岩石皆熠熠生辉，宛若燃火。光芒刺目。光息之后，岩块形状位置悄然变幻。祭坛今成山顶乱石堆，圆圈仅余几块怪石。天际云消雾散。

column1: Each guild is fairly influencial, and any two guilds combined are more powerful than any one other group.
column2: 各公会皆颇具影响力，任意两公会联合之力，胜过任何其他单一群体。

column1: Each guild is fairly influencial, and any two guilds combined are usually more potent than any other one other group.
column2: 各公会皆具相当影响力，任意两公会联合之力，往往胜过任何其他单一群体。

column1: Each guild is fairly influencial. Any three guilds combined would be more influencial than the Captain, and two more than anyone else.
column2: 各公会皆具相当影响力。三公会联合之力，远胜队长；两公会亦胜过他人。

column1: Each moment seems like an eternity, but finally the task is done. The ceremony should be very interesting.
column2: 时光仿佛永恒，然终任务告成。仪式定当精彩非凡。

column1: Each moment seems like an eternity, but finally the task is done. The ceremony tomorrow should be very interesting.
column2: 时光仿佛永恒，然终任务告成。明日之仪式定当精彩非凡。

column1: Each name is on a raised knob, which you must press to open the door. Which knob should you press? What Holy significance lies in these names?
column2: 每名皆刻于凸钮之上，须按此钮方能启门。应按何钮？此等圣名蕴何深意？

column1: Each of you in turn mutters a quick prayer as you step to the stream, but you know that Saint Cyprian's powers can only succeed part of the time. Sure enough, $ChosenOneName and $ChosenTwoName report later that a heavy darkness seems to be hanging over them. The others feel no taint, for their ceremony was interrupted in some small way; the saint was able to protect them.
column2: 众人依次临溪默祷，然知圣西普里安之力仅能部分奏效。果然，$ChosenOneName与$ChosenTwoName事后报告称，重霾似罩其身。其余则无异感，盖因仪式曾遭微扰，圣者得以庇护。

column1: Each of you in turn mutters a quick prayer as you step to the stream. Each time, the man in black begins his words, but something interrupts the ceremony at a crucial moment.
column2: 众人依次临溪默祷。每次，黑衣男子甫启口，仪式辄于紧要处中断。

column1: Each word is placed on a raised knob. Which knob should you press? The wrong one may release a terrible trap! You ponder, then press...
column2: 每字皆刻于凸钮之上。应按何钮？误按恐触发凶险机关！你沉思片刻，遂按下……

column1: Easily, you slip by the guards and out the gate. Soon $PlaceName is far behind you.
column2: 你轻巧避过卫兵，出城而去。转瞬，$PlaceName已遥落身后。

column1: Ecstatic at your success, the miners pour out of their shacks and rejoice with you. Their leader comes forth with a number of small leather sacks. "To make our gratitude more tangible, please accept these as our gift." You look inside the sacks, and each contains a different type of valuable mineral from the mines. There are ten sacks in all. You stammer out your thanks, and the miners cheer and wave as you return to the outside world.
column2: 矿工们欣喜若狂，自棚屋蜂拥而出，与你同庆。其首领捧来数袋小皮囊。“为表谢忱，敬请收下此礼。”你掀开囊袋，内皆矿藏珍品，十囊各异。你连声道谢，矿工欢呼挥手，目送你重返尘世。

column1: Eight brass faces speak:
column2: 八面黄铜之面开口言说：

column1: Elburg.
column2: 埃尔堡

column1: Embarassed, you quietly leave.
column2: 你羞赧退去。

column1: Embarassed, you remember that the rebel forces planned to march on the $VarString1 today. You decide to...
column2: 你羞赧忆及叛军本拟今日进袭$VarString1。遂决意……

column1: Embarrassed, you move away. Your purse lacks sufficient silver for a bribe.
column2: 你尴尬移步。囊中银钱不足，难以行贿。

column1: Embossed on the door are five metal knobs, each bearing a number. Doubtless pressing the wrong number releases a trap! You press...
column2: 门上五枚金属旋钮，各镌数字。误按必引机关！你按下……

column1: Embossed on the door are four faces, a gold dwarf, a gold kobold, a silver gnome, and a silver ogre. The faces speak.
column2: 门上浮雕四面：金矮人、金地精、银矮人、银食人魔。诸面开口言说。

column1: Embossed on the door are four metal heads. They speak:
column2: 门上四金属首颅。开口言说：

column1: Embossed on the door are three metal faces: gold, silver, copper. Two of the faces speak.
column2: 门上浮雕三金属面：金、银、铜。其中两面开口。

column1: Embossed on the door are three metal heads. They speak:
column2: 门上三金属首颅。开口言说：

column1: Employing the evil paraphernalia to the best of your abilities, you fashion a crude pentagram, all the while vowing to interrupt this ceremony somehow; you have until tomorrow to think of a plan. After you finish, you return the items and leave. Though it was an odious task, it seems to have allayed any suspicions the witches might have.
column2: 你竭尽所能，利用邪物粗制五芒星，同时暗誓必设法阻断此仪式；尚有明日筹谋。事毕归还器物，悄然离去。虽属恶事，然似已消解女巫疑虑。

column1: Enlightenment suddenly bursts upon you. Although you know clearly the sort of people $NamedOneName desires, you also know that his cause is almost certainly hopeless. Inspired by this insight, you politely take your leave, rather than commit yourself to a disaster.
column2: 忽有所悟。虽明了$NamedOneName所欲之人，亦知其志几近无望。由此顿悟，你礼貌辞别，免陷覆辙。

column1: Enough of the guards are beaten to allow you to get away. Easily evading a patrol or two, you escape back into the wilderness.
column2: 卫兵多被击溃，足使你脱身。避开巡逻数次，遁入荒野。

column1: Enraged at this base treachery, the lieutenant grabs a loaded crossbow and fires a quarrel into his master. As the raubritter falls to the floor, the robbers and their new captain attack you!
column2: 中尉怒极，操弩射杀其主。当劫骑士倒地之际，群盗及其新首长向你扑来！

column1: Enraged by your words, the crowd grows ugly and surrounds you. Then, with a roar, the mob erupts. Most of them running screaming down the streets toward $VarString1. A smaller group charges you, weapons gleaming. You prepare to fight in self-defense.
column2: 众怒因汝言而起，面目狰狞，团团围住。旋即暴动，呼啸奔向$VarString1。一小股持械直逼而来。汝准备自卫反击。

column1: Enraged, the monster crashes through your band, bowling you down. Its powerful tail lashes out, but then it flies off. Perhaps your show of force drove it away. At least it is gone.
column2: 怪兽震怒，冲破汝队，将汝掀翻。其尾猛扫，继而飞离。或许汝之威势令其退却。至少它已离去。

column1: Enter $PlaceName while it's at peace.
column2: 在$PlaceName处于和平时期时进入。

column1: Enter $PlaceName while it's at war.
column2: 在$PlaceName处于战争状态时进入。

column1: Enter $PlaceName while it's preparing for war.
column2: 在$PlaceName准备开战时进入。

column1: Escape is easy. The Templars let you go, knowing you are weaponless and powerless. They turn their attention back to the poor Franciscan friar.
column2: 逃脱易如反掌。圣殿骑士知汝手无寸铁、无力反抗，遂放行，转而对付那可怜的方济各修士。

column1: Escaping into the darkness is easy. The pirates content themselves with plundering those who surrendered or fell earlier, taking from them everything of value. They then pillage the boat of its cargo, and depart.
column2: 溜入黑暗轻而易举。海盗只掠夺先前投降或倒下的船员，尽取其值物。随后洗劫货舱，扬帆而去。

column1: Escaping the angry villagers, you flee into the comparative safety of the surrounding wilderness.
column2: 避开愤怒村民，汝逃入周遭相对安全之荒野。

column1: Evading a patrol, you make your way back to your starting point.
column2: 你避开巡逻，循路返回起点。

column1: Evading the guards, you run into an alley and hide behind a pile of firewood. The guards get reinforcements and search the area for some time, but do not find you. You wait until dark, then leave the alley.
column2: 你避过卫兵，钻入巷弄，藏于柴堆后。卫兵增援，搜查良久，终未寻获。待夜深，你悄然离巷。

column1: Evading the guards, you run into an alley and hide behind a pile of firewood. The guards get reinforcements and search the area for some time, but do not find you. You wait until daybreak, when the guards finally give up, then leave the alley.
column2: 你避过卫兵，钻入巷弄，藏于柴堆后。卫兵增援，搜查良久，终未寻获。待黎明，卫兵放弃，你始离巷。

column1: Even an idiot can see that this guild is at the center of the rebel faction. Men with posters come to and fro, apprentices argue about who will run the new government, and mercenaries loiter, obviously hired for protection.
column2: 即便愚者亦可见，此公会乃叛军核心。张贴海报者往来不绝，学徒争执新政主导者，雇佣兵徘徊，显为护卫而来。

column1: Even an idiot can see that this is the center of the rebel faction. Men with posters stride to and fro, apprentices argue about who will run the new government, and mercenaries loiter everywhere.
column2: 即使是愚人也能看出，此处乃叛军之中心。手持标语者来往不绝，学徒们争论谁将执掌新政权，而雇佣兵则四处游荡。

column1: Even as the villagers finish tying $ChosenOneName to the stake, the dragon $NamedTwoName glides in on barbed wings. The peasants scream and run, but the monster lands atop two of them with a crunch of bones.
column2: 正当村民们将$ChosenOneName绑在木桩上时，巨龙$NamedTwoName携着带刺的双翼悄然滑翔而至。农民们惊叫着四散奔逃，但那怪物却重重地压在其中两人身上，骨裂之声不绝于耳。

column1: Even at night, the streets are busy with fairgoers. The night watch tries vainly to enforce the curfew. You make a token effort to avoid them as you head for...
column2: 即便在夜间，街道上仍熙熙攘攘，尽是赶集之人。夜巡队徒劳地试图执行宵禁。你略作周旋，避开他们，朝……走去。

column1: Even at night, the wagons roll in and out of $PlaceName and guards maintain  vigil. It is clear that the city burghers are frantically preparing for the upcoming war.
column2: 即使在夜间，马车仍进出$PlaceName，守卫亦严加戒备。显然，城中市民正为即将到来的战争紧锣密鼓地筹备。

column1: Even haughty $NamedOneName's eyes brim with tears of joy. "The serpent is gone," he rejoices. "Now I can retire will a clear mind. Both the people and my lord clamor for me to appoint one of you to take my place. Which of you will accept the honor of becoming the new ruler of $PlaceName?"
column2: 即使傲慢的$NamedOneName眼中也盈满了喜悦的泪水。“那条蛇已消失，”他欣喜道，“如今我可心安理得地退隐了。百姓与吾主皆催促我从诸位中择一人继任。诸君之中，谁愿承此荣光，成为$PlaceName的新统治者？”

column1: Even haughty $NamedOneName's eyes brim with tears of joy. "The serpent is gone," he rejoices. "We shall feast in your honor and build a statue, that future generations of $PlaceName will know of this wondrous achievement."
column2: 即使傲慢的$NamedOneName眼中也盈满了喜悦的泪水。“蛇已远去，”他欣喜道，“我们将为你设宴，并立一尊雕像，让未来的$PlaceName世代铭记这奇迹般的功绩。”

column1: Eventually a shrill voice from upstairs yells, "Go away, scum!" The words are followed by a chamberpot's load of offal. You back away, reflecting on the disadvantages of an unfavorable local reputation.
column2: 终于，楼上传来一声尖厉的喝斥：“滚开，贱民！”紧随其后的是夜壶里倾泻而出的秽物。你退避三舍，暗自思量着声名狼藉之苦。

column1: Eventually the rebel forces get organized and begin moving toward the $VarString1.
column2: 最终，叛军整装待发，向$VarString1进发。

column1: Eventually they are convinced and you go on safely.
column2: 最终他们被说服，你得以安然前行。

column1: Eventually they are so close that you must either turn to fight, or let them stab you in the back. Options exhausted, you make your stand, cold steel in hand!
column2: 终于，他们逼近至不得不迎战的地步，否则便会被从背后刺杀。别无选择，你握紧冷冽钢刃，毅然立定！

column1: Eventually you are escorted into the office of $NamedOneName, the Medici representative.
column2: 最终，你被护送至$NamedOneName的办公室，他是美第奇家族的代表。

column1: Eventually you feel the cold stone battlements beneath you once more. $ChosenOneName slowly gets up and motions everyone to quietly descend the nearest stairs into the city.
column2: 终于，你再次感受到脚下冰冷的石墙。$ChosenOneName缓缓起身，示意众人悄然沿最近的阶梯下入城中。

column1: Eventually your knocks are answered by someone at a second story window.
column2: 终于，你的敲门声得到了二楼窗口中某人的回应。

column1: Eventually, you are ushered into the office of $NamedOneName, Master of the Hanseatic League in $PlaceName. You are overwhelmed by the wealth and richness of his surroundings, from the rare wall hangings to the sumptuous rugs.
column2: 最终，你被引入$NamedOneName的办公室，他是$PlaceName汉萨同盟的首领。你为他周遭的富丽堂皇所震撼，从稀有的壁挂到华美的地毯，无一不彰显其奢华。

column1: Eventually, you outdistance their pursuit and hide in a brush-filled gully until dark. In the vast wilderness you are finally safe.
column2: 终于，你甩开了他们的追击，藏身于灌木丛生的沟壑之中，直至夜幕降临。在这广袤的荒野中，你终于安全了。

column1: Everybody talks about the mass rally against the government, but it's unclear whether it will happen today or tomorrow. Many people $Support such a rally.
column2: 众人皆言将举行反政府大集会，然其究竟今日成行抑或明日方至，尚不明朗。众多人$Support此等集会。

column1: Everyone from strong young bravos to crippled old grandfathers seek services and cures from the herbalists, barbers and surgeons. You...
column2: 从身强力壮的年轻勇士到残弱年迈的祖父，无不向草药师、理发师与外科医生寻求医治。你...

column1: Everyone here freely admits that nothing remotely interesting happens, ever. The biggest excitement in the last year was a half-pfennig per tun change in grain prices!
column2: 此地之人皆坦承，从未有过半分趣事。去年最大的热闹，不过是每吨谷价涨了半个便士！

column1: Everyone is excited by the Shrovetide festival, which starts about February 11th this year. It is the biggest celebration of the year in most cities. Large crowds, lots of business, and soaring prices are expected.
column2: 众人皆为今年约于二月十一日开始的忏悔节而欢欣鼓舞。此乃多数城邑一年之中最为盛大的庆典。预计届时人潮汹涌，商贾云集，物价亦将飙升。

column1: Everyone is surprised by the eloquence and logic of your plea. After pointing out various legal precedents, you cinch the argument by telling them that your presence discourages bandits and dangerous animals. In effect, you are helping them! Nodding in agreement, the huntsman says, "Yes, that makes sense. I deputize you as my guardians of this section of forest." You all bow to him and he goes away happy. You realize, however, that this period of grace is unlikely to last forever.
column2: 众人皆为你的雄辩与逻辑所惊。你援引诸般法例，终以自身之在场可慑匪徒、避猛兽收尾，实则助益于彼等！猎人颔首称是：“此言有理。我今委任尔等为本林之守护者。”尔等齐向其行礼，猎人欣然而去。然尔等亦知，此恩宠难永存。

column1: Everyone is talking about how city guards finally broke up the mob of protesters that recently paralyzed the city. The government of the $CityLordTitle appears strong. Many expect the rebel ringleaders to be arrested soon.
column2: 众人皆言，城卫终于驱散了那支近日瘫痪全城的抗议人群。$CityLordTitle的政权显得稳固。许多人预计，叛乱首领们将很快被逮捕。

column1: Everyone is talking about how the Imperial army recaptured the city of $NamedOneName from the Hussites, restoring its rightful ruler. Many of the Hussite leaders were rounded up, imprisoned, and executed.
column2: 众人皆言，帝国大军已从胡斯派手中夺回$NamedOneName城，复立其正统之主。胡斯派首领多被擒获，囚禁并处决。

column1: Everyone is talking about how the city guardsmen have just arrested $NamedTwoName, a respected citizen. Some people talk about getting together and rescuing him from the guardsmen.
column2: 大家都在议论，城里的卫兵刚刚逮捕了$NamedTwoName，一位受人尊敬的市民。有些人谈论着要联合起来，把他从卫兵手中救出来。

column1: Everyone is talking about the Hussite rebellion in Bohemia. Prag, B|irglitz, St. Joachimsthal and Kuttenberg are in revolt and preparing to resist any attack. It is rumored that the Emperor is forming a crusade to put down these heretics. Meanwhile the Hussites under the leadership of Ziska are forming their own armies.
column2: 众人皆言波希米亚的胡斯派叛乱。布拉格、B|伊格尔茨、圣约阿希姆塔尔及库滕贝格均已起义，正严阵以待，抵御来犯之敌。传闻皇帝正组建十字军，欲剿灭此等异端。与此同时，齐兹卡麾下的胡斯派亦在整编己方军队。

column1: Everyone is talking about the failure of the city guardsmen to hold $NamedTwoName after he was arrested. A large group of citizens stopped the guards and their prisoner in the street, then forced them to free him. Most feel that the government of the $CityLordTitle is powerless, and unlikely to last much longer.
column2: 人人都在议论城卫队在他被捕后未能守住$NamedTwoName。一大群市民拦住了卫队和他们的囚犯，随后逼迫他们将其释放。大多数人认为$CityLordTitle的政权已无力维持，恐怕难以再支撑多久。

column1: Everyone is talking about the feuding around $NamedOneName. "These nobles are always declaring feuds; just let them kill each other!" is a popular sentiment. Actually, what worries people most is the way feuding war parties ravage the countryside, assuming anyone who isn't a friend must be an enemy.
column2: 人人都在谈论围绕$NamedOneName的纷争。“这些贵族总是宣战；就让他们自相残杀吧！”这是普遍的看法。其实，最令人担忧的是那些交战的队伍肆意蹂躏乡野，凡非友者皆视作敌。

column1: Everyone is talking about the mines near $NearestCity. It is said the miners have stopped working because of "knocker" attacks within the mines. Blacksmiths and guildsmen are worried about metal supplies, while friars and preachers excite everyone's fears and superstitions. The miners are rumored to offer a reward to anyone who can solve the problem so they can work again.
column2: 众人口中皆传 $NearestCity 附近的矿井。据说矿工因矿内“敲击者”之袭而停工。铁匠与公会之人忧金属之供，修士与布道者则煽众人之惧与迷信。传闻矿工悬赏于能解此难者，以复其业。

column1: Everyone is talking politics. People argue about the abilities of the $CityLordTitle, and people argue whether they should be subject to the $CityLordName. Passions run high over laws and taxes. The fairness of the government is discussed and compared with other cities.
column2: 众人皆议政事。或论$CityLordTitle之能，或辩其是否当受$CityLordName辖制。法度与赋税，激辩不休。官府之公允，亦与他城相较而论。

column1: Everyone is tired and frustrated as you discuss your next step.
column2: 众人皆疲惫而沮丧，正商议下一步行动。

column1: Everyone knows that $NamedTwoName is the ringleader of the anti-government forces, and that he is hiring helpers. The debate is whether $NamedTwoName is a true patriot, or a treacherous traitor to the city.
column2: 众皆知$NamedTwoName乃反政府势力之首，且正招募帮手。然则，$NamedTwoName究为真爱国者，抑或城中之奸佞叛徒？

column1: Everyone nods. "A wise plan," remarks $ChosenThreeName, "but why not take action now? Thieves infest the back streets here at night. We can gain repute, experience, and a bit of plunder by eliminating these scum. Let us also listen to rumors and visit the $marketplace to learn about tasks the merchants may have for us."
column2: 众人皆点头。“此计甚妙，”$ChosenThreeName言道，“何不即刻行动？夜半时分，盗贼遍地。剿灭此辈，既可扬名立万，又可历练身手，还能略得些战利品。且去探听风声，再访$marketplace，看商贾是否有所托付。”

column1: Everyone still talks with pride about the new government of $PlaceName. To listen to some people talk, everyone participated in the popular uprising that rid the city of its old lords. Certainly you've noticed that the city guardsmen walk with a rare sense of pride and belonging.
column2: 众人仍以自豪之情谈论着$PlaceName的新政权。听一些人说，人人都参与了那场驱逐旧主的民众起义。你也不难发现，城中的卫兵们步履间流露出罕见的骄傲与归属感。

column1: Evidently these "Vulcans" have driven the dwarfs up from their homes. If you could defeat the Vulcans, the dwarfs could return, and the miners could have their mine back again!
column2: 显然，这些“火神”已将矮人逐出家园。若能击败火神，矮人便可归来，矿工亦可重获其矿！

column1: Examine the plaque.
column2: 查看铭牌。

column1: Excitement is high; after a successful invocation, the witches are preparing to feast on the innocents. Your blood runs cold when you hear this: you've heard unmentionably horrid tales of witch feasts!
column2: 兴奋之情高涨；成功召唤之后，女巫们正准备以无辜者为宴。你闻此言，不禁毛骨悚然：关于女巫之宴的骇人传闻，你早已耳闻！

column1: Exert yourselves as you might, you cannot break open the box with sheer muscle power. You catch your breath and reconsider the situation.
column2: 即使你竭尽全力，也难以凭蛮力打开此箱。你稍作喘息，重新审视局势。

column1: Exerting $himself to the limits of $his strength, $ChosenOneName applies $himself to the edges of the sewer grating. But try as $he might, $he cannot pry it open. It's just too well-made.
column2: 尽管将你自己力发挥至你的极限，$ChosenOneName仍无法撬开下水道的栅栏。无论你如何努力，都无济于事。这栅栏实在太过坚固。

column1: Exerting $himself to the limits of $his strength, $ChosenOneName applies $his arms to the bars of the sewer grating. With painful slowness, the grate pries loose of its setting, and you all climb into the dark, smelly sewer. After wandering through the pitch-black tunnels for some time, you find an exit and climb to the surface. The muck and stink of the sewer will cling to you for some time, lowering your reputation in $PlaceName.
column2: 尽全力施展你自己，以你的力，$ChosenOneName将你的臂抵于下水道铁栅之上。费力缓慢地，铁栅终于从嵌槽中松动，众人攀入黑暗污秽的下水道。穿行于漆黑如墨的隧洞多时，终觅得出口，爬升至地面。下水道的淤泥与恶臭久久不散，使你在$PlaceName之中的声望有所下降。

column1: Exerting all $his strength, $ChosenOneName cannot break free. You have failed.
column2: 竭尽你的力，$ChosenOneName仍无法挣脱。你失败了。

column1: Exerting all $his strength, $ChosenOneName still cannot break free. You have failed.
column2: 竭尽你的力，$ChosenOneName仍无法挣脱。你失败了。

column1: Exit
column2: 退出

column1: Explaining further, $NamedOneName says, "The rapacity of the robber knight $NamedTwoName knows no bounds. For years we have paid him off, but now he demands more than even we can pay. We refused, so he has cut off travel. He burns bridges, fells trees to block roads, and murders wayfarers. Eliminate him and we would pay you well."
column2: 进一步解释道，$NamedOneName说道：“劫匪骑士$NamedTwoName的贪婪无边无际。多年来我们一直向他进贡，但如今他索要的已超出了我们的承受范围。我们拒绝了，于是他封锁了道路。他焚毁桥梁，砍倒树木阻断通途，并杀害旅人。除掉他，我们将重金酬谢。”

column1: Exploding against the fort's base, the Thunderbolt leaves jagged cracks in the stone. The gate hangs raggedly on its hinges. The entry is open.
column2: 雷霆炸裂于堡垒基座，石壁上留下参差的裂痕。城门摇摇欲坠地挂在铰链上。入口已开。

column1: Exploding in a most gratifying manner, the Thunderbolt shatters the sally port, sending the door careening off its hinges. You rush through before the guard can arrive to investigate, and are soon deep within the city.
column2: 以最令人满意的姿态炸裂，雷霆一击粉碎了突门，将大门震得脱离铰链。你在守卫赶来查看之前冲了进去，很快便深入城内。

column1: Exploding violently, flames belch forth from the broken bottle. But when the smoke clears, you see that the altar is untouched, though a bit blackened. Your attempt has failed.
column2: 瓶子猛然爆裂，火焰喷涌而出。然而烟雾散去，你却发现祭坛虽略显焦黑，却完好无损。你的尝试失败了。

column1: Exploring the lake, you find many dark recesses beneath the jumbled boulder piles, and deep cracks in the cliffs. Most are full of dead leaves.
column2: 探索湖面，你发现乱石堆下有许多幽暗的凹处，峭壁上亦有深邃的裂隙。多为枯叶所填。

column1: Expounding for many minutes, $ChosenOneName speaks about the classics, philosophy, ancient lore, the nature of religion, and science. The lord is impressed in spite of himself. His own advisors debate with $ChosenOneName, who is the clear-cut victor.
column2: 详述良久，$ChosenOneName 谈及经典、哲学、古之秘闻、宗教之本质与科学。领主虽不情愿，亦为之折服。其座下谋士与 $ChosenOneName 辩论，$ChosenOneName 毫无疑问地胜出。

column1: Eyeing you suspiciously, the raubritter's men finger their weapons, but do not attack. They talk with you for a while, clearly unsure what to do. Eventually they depart.
column2: 拉布里特骑士的手下狐疑地盯着你，手指轻抚武器，却并未出手。他们与你交谈片刻，显然不知所措。最终，他们离去。

column1: Eyes and ears open, you...
column2: 眼观六路，耳听八方，你...

column1: FACES SPEAK EITHER WHOLLY LIES OR WHOLLY TRUTH.
column2: 面孔要么全说谎，要么全说实话。

column1: FIVE: Gold opens the door.
column2: 五：黄金开此门。

column1: FIVE: Of the odd-numbered faces, exactly two tell the truth.
column2: 五：奇数号面孔中，恰好有两人说实话。

column1: FIVE: Press an odd-numbered face to open the door.
column2: 五：按动奇数号面孔，即可开门。

column1: FOR  CHRISTIANS,  THE  PATH  LIES  WITH  THE  NAME  THAT  BELONGS  NOT
column2: 对基督徒而言，正道在于那不属于……之名。

column1: FOUR
column2: 四

column1: FOUR: Face Six is Repin.
column2: 四：六号面孔乃雷平。

column1: FOUR: Face Six is a liar. Face Six and myself are the only two liars.
column2: 四：六号面孔是说谎者。六号面孔与我，乃仅有的两名说谎者。

column1: FOUR: If Face Three lies, silver opens the door.
column2: 四：若三号面孔说谎，则银色开此门。

column1: Face Five.
column2: 五号面孔。

column1: Face Four.
column2: 四号面孔。

column1: Face One.
column2: 一号面孔。

column1: Face Six.
column2: 六号面孔。

column1: Face Three.
column2: 三号面孔。

column1: Face Two.
column2: 二号面孔。

column1: Falling to $his knees and raising $his head, $ChosenOneName prays hard for a vision. Alas, $he sees nothing.
column2: 跪于你的膝，抬首你的，$ChosenOneName虔诚祈求神启。奈何，你一无所见。

column1: Falling to his knees, the schulz kisses your boots. "You have saved my people," he sobs in gratitude. "My life and those of my people are at your service. Now that the dragon has been defeated, the land can live again. We will recount your glory to all the surrounding land and cities."
column2: 市长跪地，亲吻汝靴。“汝救吾民，”他涕泣称谢，“吾命及吾民之命，皆听汝驱使。今龙已伏诛，大地可复生矣。吾等将汝之功绩传遍四方城邑。”

column1: Falling to your knees, you ask the villagers to spare you, but they scorn your words. "What cowards!" they call to each other. "The powers of Hell will have but a paltry meal tonight!" You are not released.
column2: 你跪地乞怜，村民却嗤之以鼻。“何等懦夫！”他们相顾低语，“今夜地狱之力只得残羹冷炙！”汝终不得脱身。

column1: Far ahead, a lone horseman gallops along as though mad with fear. Curious, you begin to follow.
column2: 远方，一骑孤行，疾驰如狂，似被恐惧驱使。汝心生好奇，遂尾随其后。

column1: Far from magnanimous, the victorious soldiers inspect your persons for loot, then drag you into an open field and leave you for the vultures.
column2: 胜利者非但不慷慨，反搜汝身以掠夺财物，继而将汝拖至旷野，弃之以饲秃鹫。

column1: Far in the distance, you catch sight of the tattered thief who stole from the dragon. He runs off.
column2: 远处，汝瞥见那名窃龙之贼，衣衫褴褛，仓皇逃去。

column1: Far off in the distance, you see a dark structure, squatting like a toad on the horizon. It must be enormous! Curious, you start walking towards it.
column2: 远方天际，一座黑影矗立，状如踞地蟾蜍，必是巨物无疑！汝心生好奇，遂向其行进。

column1: Far off, you hear the tantara of a hunting horn, followed by the distant baying of hounds. Who would be out hunting with a pack of dogs at night? The sound grows closer, and becomes more eerie, until you realize that they are not mortal hounds, nor is it a mortal trumpet!
column2: 远处传来猎角之声，继而犬吠阵阵。何人竟于夜半携群犬出猎？声愈近愈诡，直至汝悟：非凡尘之犬，亦非凡俗之号角！

column1: Fast as the wind come the gargoyles, but your horses are even faster. Everyone in the party rides like experts, and soon you are away.
column2: 石像鬼风驰电掣而来，然汝马更疾。众人皆娴熟驭马，转瞬已远。

column1: Fast footwork and tough fighting has let you drive off the Hunt and rescue the schrat. The schrat is pleased with his escape, and wants to tell you something.
column2: 你以矫健身手击退猎队，救出小精灵。小精灵欣喜若狂，欲告汝一事。

column1: Fear gives your feet wings, and soon you have left the gargoyles behind.
column2: 恐惧令汝足生双翼，转瞬已甩石像鬼于身后。

column1: Fearing you might lose your way in the dark, you wait till dawn to make your move.
column2: 惧于夜暗迷途，汝待至黎明方举步。

column1: Feebly at first, then with increasing strength, a soft glow forms around your bodies. The power of $NamedOneName lifts you through the air and deposits you gently inside the city. The stunned guards do not lift a weapon. Long before they recover themselves, you are gone.
column2: 初时微弱，渐次增强，一团柔光萦绕汝身。$NamedOneName之力托汝升空，轻置于城内。惊愕守卫未敢发一矢。汝未及他们回神，已悄然离去。

column1: Feeling that further resistance is futile, you lay down your arms. The villagers caper with glee at your surrender. They quickly tie you up and drag you to the top of their evil hill.
column2: 觉再抗无益，汝放下兵刃。村民见汝投降，欢欣雀跃，旋即缚汝，拖至恶丘之巅。

column1: Feigning bored surprise, $ChosenOneName says, "Why, yes, we are 'up to something,' as you so quaintly put it. Would you like us to tell you what it is?"
column2: $ChosenOneName佯作无聊惊讶，言：“正是，吾等确有所图，正如汝所言。汝欲知详情否？”

column1: Few see a schrat even once in a lifetime. Their women, holzfraus, are even rarer to behold.
column2: 一生难遇小精灵，其妻——木妇——更为罕见。

column1: Fighting like dragons, you thrash the cultists easily. However, the curse of one still rings in your ears. "Come $SabbatTime, we will have our revenge $SabbatLocation!" You wonder... this obviously has some significance to them.
column2: 你如龙般奋战，轻易击溃教徒。然一人诅咒犹在耳畔：“来吧，$SabbatTime，吾等必报$SabbatLocation之仇！”汝思忖……此事对他们显然意义非凡。

column1: Fighting your way free of the cultists, you escape into the wilderness.
column2: 你奋力冲破教徒包围，遁入荒野。

column1: Fighting your way past the demon, you get across the bridge and onto the other side. The demon shouts after you, "The issue is still unresolved! I shall remain here for another soul!" Then he disappears with a clap of thunder. Glumly, you resume your journey.
column2: 你闯过恶魔，渡桥至彼岸。恶魔追喊：“恩怨未了！吾尚在此，待另一魂！”随即雷鸣隐去。汝黯然续行。

column1: Finally he says, "I would grant you one other boon currently within my power. Please take from the...
column2: 终，他说：“今吾尚能赐汝一恩。请自……”

column1: Finally it ends. You return to awareness, and find yourself lying in the wilderness, cold and hungry. The Sabbat site is empty. You leave as quickly as you can.
column2: 终告一段落。汝醒转，身卧荒野，饥寒交迫。安息之地空无一人。汝速速离去。

column1: Finally it is over. Many have fled, others are dying or wounded. The horrid enemy is vanquished, and you now know the way to the fortress monastery.
column2: 终结之时至。众皆奔逃，或死或伤。恶敌既灭，汝已知通往堡垒修道院之路。

column1: Finally it is over. Many have fled, others are dying or wounded. Though you did not face the demon of the altar, you feel that you have accomplished your goal of cleansing this area.
column2: 终结之时至。众皆奔逃，或死或伤。虽未直面祭坛之魔，汝觉已达成净化此地之志。

column1: Finally it is over. Many have fled, others are dying or wounded. Though you did not face the demon, you feel that you have accomplished your goal of cleansing this area.
column2: 终结之时至。众皆奔逃，或死或伤。虽未对峙恶魔，汝觉已达成净化此地之志。

column1: Finally it is over. Many have fled, others are dying or wounded. Though you faced no supernatural foes, you feel that you have accomplished your goal of cleansing this area.
column2: 终结之时至。众皆奔逃，或死或伤。虽未遭遇超凡之敌，汝觉已达成净化此地之志。

column1: Finally it is over. Many have fled, some are dying or wounded. Though you did not face the demon of the altar, you feel that you have accomplished your goal of cleansing this area and rescuing the innocents from the witches.
column2: 终结之时至。众皆奔逃，或死或伤。虽未对峙祭坛之魔，汝觉已达成净化此地、解救无辜于女巫之害之志。

column1: Finally the demon rises, grinning a dark grin. $ChosenOneName steps forward and says quietly, "I challenge thee in the name of the Lord."
column2: 终，恶魔现身，狞笑阴森。$ChosenOneName上前，低声曰：“奉主之名，与汝决斗！”

column1: Finally the leader returns...
column2: 终，首领归来……

column1: Finally you defeat all the cultists, although the last one gasps, "We will have our revenge $SabbatLocation on $SabbatTime."
column2: 终，汝尽歼教徒，唯余最后一人喘息：“吾等必报$SabbatLocation之仇于$SabbatTime！”

column1: Finally you discuss the attitudes of the the guildsmen when it comes to changes in the city government.
column2: 终，汝与工匠商议其对市政变革之态度。

column1: Finally your efforts pay off, though everyone is exhausted and utterly filthy. From the pile you pull one perfect, unburned book.
column2: 终，汝之努力得偿，然众人疲惫不堪，污秽满身。汝自废墟中拾得一册完好无损之书。

column1: Finally your party reaches the $citySquare. An ugly crowd fills the square, blocking your path to the $councilHall. You...
column2: 终，汝一行抵$citySquare。广场上乌合之众堵路，阻汝前往$councilHall。汝……

column1: Finally your party reaches the $citySquare. Parties of city guardsmen are posted throughout the square, protecting the various approaches to the $councilHall, the town hall. You decide to...
column2: 终，汝一行抵$citySquare。市卫分列广场各处，守护通往$councilHall——市政厅——之诸路。汝决定……

column1: Finally, $he says, "I'm sorry, my friends, but I feel no answer to this prayer today."
column2: 终，你曰：“诸君，抱歉，今日祷告未蒙应允。”

column1: Finally, inevitably, $ChosenFiveName also falls.
column2: 最终，不可避免地，$ChosenFiveName 也陷落了。

column1: Finally, the Mass is sung. You all take communion and feel a spiritual uplift, as though you have found favor in heaven.
column2: 最终，弥撒唱毕。众人领受圣餐，顿觉精神振奋，仿佛已获天恩眷顾。

column1: Finally, you are ushered into a sunny room full of sumptuous art and comfortable chairs. A very fat clerk greets you politely.
column2: 最终，你被引入一间阳光明媚的房间，室内摆满了华美的艺术品与舒适的座椅。一位肥胖的文吏礼貌地向你致意。

column1: Finally, you can ignore the raubritter, and just move on through.
column2: 终于，你可以无视raubritter，径直前行。

column1: Finally, you curl up in your cloaks beneath the leaky roof and let sleep overtake you.
column2: 最终，你裹着斗篷蜷缩在漏水的屋顶下，任由睡意袭来。

column1: Finally, you decide to ...
column2: 最终，你决定……

column1: Finally, you find the $NamedOneName in a small chest behind a desk. You quickly slip out of the office, close the door, and conceal the damage to the lock.
column2: 终于，你在书桌后的小箱中找到了$NamedOneName。你迅速溜出办公室，关上门，并掩盖了锁上的损坏痕迹。

column1: Finally, you get desperate and try to just dash in. However, somebody spots you coming and yells "Thieves!"
column2: 终于，你心一横，试图直接闯入。然而，有人发现你前来，高喊：“贼人！”

column1: Finally, your party approaches the gate of the $fortress, the fortress in $PlaceName. An ugly crowd blocks your path, angry at the arrest of the rebel leaders. You...
column2: 终于，你的队伍抵达 $PlaceName 中 $fortress 的门前。一群面目可憎的人群挡住去路，他们因叛乱首领被捕而愤怒。你……

column1: Finally, your party approaches the gate of the $fortress, the fortress in $PlaceName. Squads of guardsmen are posted along all the streets approaching the $fortress. You...
column2: 终于，你的队伍抵达 $PlaceName 中 $fortress 的门前。成队的卫兵沿通往 $fortress 的各条街道布岗。你……

column1: Finishing $his silent prayer, $ChosenOneName immediately gets the sense of a strong, powerful creature inhabiting this remote lake. Although not naturally evil, the creature would almost certainly attack intruders.
column2: 完成你的次无声祈祷后，$ChosenOneName立刻感受到一股强大而有力的生物栖息于此偏僻湖泊。虽非天生邪恶，此生物几乎必定会袭击入侵者。

column1: Finishing $his silent prayer, $ChosenOneName immediately smells brimstone and senses the powerful presence of heat and fire. In $his mind's eye $he sees flaming earth, flowing like sluggish water, forming into a vague, erect shape.
column2: 完成你的次无声祈祷，$ChosenOneName立刻闻到硫磺的气息，并感受到炽热与火焰的强大存在。在你的脑海里，你看见燃烧的大地如滞缓的水流般流动，逐渐凝结成一个模糊而挺立的形状。

column1: Finland and Russia.
column2: 芬兰与俄罗斯。

column1: First speaking softly and slowly, then warming to $his subject, $ChosenOneName regales the lord and his courtiers with the tales of your adventures. If at times $he needs to verbally sanitize your deeds, it does not seem to bother the enthralled audience.
column2: 先是轻声慢语，继而渐入佳境，$ChosenOneName 以 你的 为题，向领主及其朝臣娓娓道来你的历险故事。若有时 你 需要对你的事迹略作修饰，亦不致令满座倾心的听众生疑。

column1: First you discuss the attitudes of the influential merchants and bankers toward changes in the city government.
column2: 首先，你与有影响力的商人和银行家商讨他们对市政府变革的态度。

column1: First you see a terrible demon looming over a black and bloody altar stone, while crazed worshippers of Satan dance beside him. Next you see an ancient fortress monastery, whose walls are patrolled by monks, each wearing a white robe decorated with a blood-red cross. Then you see a huge, strange seal. It cracks apart to reveal another behind it. That too cracks, revealing a path that forks in seven different directions.
column2: 首先，你见一狰狞恶魔矗立于黑血祭坛之上，其旁撒旦狂徒起舞。继而，一座古老堡垒修道院映入眼帘，墙头修士身披血红十字白袍巡弋。随后，一道巨大异印裂开，露出其后之印；此印复裂，现出七歧之路。

column1: First, $ChosenOneName scrambles up the pit's walls. Then $he helps the rest of you out. Soon you are safely on your way. It takes more than a simple pit to hold folk of your experience!
column2: 首先，$ChosenOneName 爬上了坑壁。随后 你 帮助你们其余的人脱困。不久，你们便安然上路了。凭一个简单的坑洞，岂能困住你们这些久经世事之人！

column1: First, you can boldly go straight to $NamedOneName's castle.
column2: 首先，你可以大胆直奔$NamedOneName的城堡。

column1: Five knobs are labeled "5" to "9" consecutively. The wrong knob may release a trap. Which numeral does the letter "e" stand for? You select...
column2: 五个旋钮依次标有“5”至“9”。选错旋钮可能触发陷阱。字母“e”代表哪个数字？你选择……

column1: Flames lick upward as the Arabian Fire hits the stone. Frantically, men labor to extinguish it, but the alchemical fury is not easily subdued. Eventually the fire subsides. Perhaps you should set more fires, or sneak inside the tower while they are distracted.
column2: 火焰舔舐着石壁向上蔓延。众人慌乱地扑救，但这种炼金之火岂是轻易可灭？最终，火焰渐渐熄灭。或许你该再放几把火，或趁他们分心时潜入塔内。

column1: Flames lick upward at the wooden sally port after the potion crashes at its base. Before the startled guards dare draw nearer, your group smashes against the weakened door and bursts through. Everyone is scorched by the fire, but you have escaped the guards and gotten into the city.
column2: 火焰沿着木制小门向上蔓延，药剂在门基处炸裂。惊慌的守卫尚未敢靠近，你们一行已撞破脆弱的门扉，冲了进去。众人皆被火焰灼伤，但你们已摆脱守卫，进入城内。

column1: Flames lick upward, burning the door's wooden structure. Guards are attracted by the sight, but soon it is weakened to the point that you can simply burst through. Rushing through the fire, you escape into the city before the guards can get to you. However, everyone is singed a bit by the heat.
column2: 火焰向上舔舐，焚烧着门的木质结构。守卫被这景象吸引而来，但不久门便被烧得脆弱不堪，你只需一撞便可冲破。穿过火海，在守卫赶到之前逃入城中。然而，众人皆被热浪灼伤些许。

column1: Flames lick upwards as the alchemical fire engulfs the dragon. But the dragon luxuriates in the furious heat. Eyes half-closed, it rubs its horny skull on the molten ground. Seizing the chance, you turn and flee.
column2: 火焰向上舔舐，炼金之火吞噬巨龙。然巨龙却沉醉于这炽烈的热浪之中。双目半阖，它用角质头颅在熔岩地面上摩挲。见有机可乘，你转身逃去。

column1: Flensburg.
column2: 弗伦斯堡。

column1: Flexing $his arms, $ChosenOneName gives a mighty heave, splintering the bar holding shut the sally port. The door opens, and you quickly run into the city. Behind you, startled soldiers yell to one another, "Did you see the arms on $him? $He must be as strong as an aurochs!"
column2: 你的挥动着臂膀，$ChosenOneName猛力一推，将闩住突门的横杠撞得粉碎。门开了，你迅速奔入城中。身后，惊慌的士兵们互相喊道：“你看见你臂膀了吗？你力气怕是如野牛一般！”

column1: Flickering torchlight highlights the stone walls of the $fortress, fortress of $PlaceName. The gate is closed and guards pace the battlements. You...
column2: 昏黄的火把映照出$fortress的石墙，那是$PlaceName的堡垒。城门紧闭，守卫在垛口间来回巡视。你...

column1: Following her advice, you slightly alter your path to avoid the Hunt.
column2: 遵循她的建议，你略微改变行径以避开猎杀。

column1: Following the trail with keen eyes, $ChosenOneName unerringly tracks the hapless thief to a hollow tree. You hammer on the tree to make him come out, and he leaps forth, his face streaked with tears.
column2: 眼锐如鹰，$ChosenOneName 追踪那倒霉的窃贼至一空心古树。你猛击树干逼其现身，他泪痕满面，跃然而出。

column1: Food is just as important as sleep. You make the best meal you can in the dark grove; the dinner is not only depressing, but also quite humiliating. You curl up in a dark, soft area beneath some bushes. Eventually you all sleep...
column2: 食物与睡眠同样重要。你在幽暗的林地里尽力烹制了一顿饭；这顿晚餐不仅令人沮丧，而且颇为屈辱。你蜷缩在灌木丛下一处阴暗而柔软的角落。最终，你们都睡着了……

column1: For a few minutes the bears continue to paw and slash. Finally they are satisfied that your motionless, bleeding forms are no longer a threat. Quickly the adults escort the cubs away into the woods.
column2: 几分钟间，熊群仍不停挥爪撕咬。最终，它们确信你那毫无动静、血流不止的躯体已不再构成威胁。成年熊迅速护送幼崽遁入林中。

column1: For a few minutes, the danger is gone. Quickly, you leave the fortress.
column2: 片刻之间，危险已逝。你匆匆离开要塞。

column1: For a moment, as the words of the prayer fill the room, the old man's face seems to glow with a holy light. He smiles, and you smile with him.
column2: 片刻之间，祷词充盈殿堂，老者面容似被圣光笼罩。他微笑，你也随之微笑。

column1: For a while now you have been feeling nervous, like someone was watching you. Sure enough, the little man in the broad-brimmed cap is back, despite your best efforts to avoid him. This time he's brought friends.
column2: 你已有一段时间感到心神不宁，仿佛有人在暗中窥视。果然，那顶宽檐帽的小人又出现了，尽管你竭力避开他。这次他带来了同伴。

column1: For about an hour you admire the bustle and splendor of $PlaceName.
column2: 约莫一个时辰，你观赏着$PlaceName的繁华盛景。

column1: For hours, $ChosenOneName tries to jiggle loose the latch on your cell bars. Eventually, the turnkey strolls by, sees what $ChosenOneName is doing, and calls guards. They burst in upon you, confiscate the lockpicks, and hand out a sound beating.
column2: 数小时来，$ChosenOneName 试图摇晃牢房的门闩。最终，狱卒踱步经过，见 $ChosenOneName 所为，便唤来卫兵。他们破门而入，收缴开锁工具，并狠狠地揍了你一顿。

column1: For sake of public order and harmony, the citizens of $PlaceName are required to avoid unnecessary congregation or meetings in the streets or public places. Those who ignore this order and continue to congregate in large crowds will be subject to arrest and fines.
column2: 为维护公共秩序与和谐，$PlaceName的市民须避免在街道或公共场所进行不必要的聚集或集会。无视此令、继续大规模聚集者，将被逮捕并处以罚款。

column1: For the sake of public safety and decorum, no citizens of $PlaceName shall travel about the streets in darkness, after the hour of Compline, unless required unavoidably by an emergency or their occupation.
column2: 为维护公共安全与礼仪，除因紧急情况或职业所需而不得不外出者外，$PlaceName之市民不得于晚祷时分后在街上游荡。

column1: Foreign traders in the main marketplace, at night.
column2: 夜晚，主集市中的外国商人。

column1: Foreign traders in the main marketplace, in the daytime.
column2: 白天，主集市上的外国商人。

column1: Fortunately for you, $NamedOneName is too busy to notice your departure.
column2: 幸运的是，$NamedOneName 忙得无暇留意你的离去。

column1: Fortunately for you, the watchman isn't very bright. You manage to convince him that you have vital information, and that he'll be recognized as a hero for helping you. He opens a sally port. You congratulate him on his good judgement, then hurry off into the city.
column2: 幸而守卫愚钝。你设法说服他，称自己携有要务，若助你一臂之力，必能名垂青史。他遂开侧门相迎。你赞其明察秋毫，随即匆匆入城。

column1: Fortunately, the battle took place before the main throng arrived. If you move quickly, you know you can probably blend back in with the crowd as they arrive for the ceremony.
column2: 幸运的是，战斗在大队人马抵达之前便已打响。若你动作迅速，定能趁众人前来参加仪式之际悄然混入人群之中。

column1: Fortunately, the witches here are just simple folk, not warriors. You make short work of them, though the commotion must surely have been noticed.
column2: 幸运的是，此地的女巫只是寻常百姓，并非战士。你轻易将她们击败，然喧哗之声必已引人注目。

column1: Fortunately, you are adroit and perceptive enough to also learn a few more interesting facts. For example, $NamedOneName disappears or is otherwise unavailable on certain evenings. In addition, foreign traders frequently visit, while just a few months ago all business contacts were with locals.
column2: 幸运的是，你机敏过人，竟能探得数桩趣闻。譬如，$NamedOneName每逢特定之夜便杳无踪迹，或不可得。此外，外邦商贾频频造访，而数月之前，往来皆为本地之人。

column1: Fortunately, you are adroit and perceptive enough to also learn a few more interesting facts. For example, $NamedOneName has suddenly begun receiving visits from masters of various guilds and leaders of various workmen around town. All these of people have one thing in common: a dislike for the policies of the current government.
column2: 幸运的是，你机敏过人，亦能洞悉数桩趣事。譬如，$NamedOneName 突然频有各公会之魁首与城中诸工头登门造访。此辈皆有一同之处：皆不满今朝政局。

column1: Fortunately, you are adroit and perceptive enough to also learn a few more interesting facts. For example, $NamedOneName has suddenly begun receiving visits from various influential patricians. All these of city leaders have one thing in common: a stake in the policies of the current government.
column2: 幸运的是，你机敏过人，亦能洞悉数桩趣事。譬如，$NamedOneName 突然开始接待诸位显赫的贵族。这些城中领袖皆有一共同点：皆与现政权之策有所牵连。

column1: Fortunately, your horses and riding skill are just enough to outdistance the pursuit. You take a route over rocks and across streams, to make the trail difficult. After spending the night in hiding, you use the entire following day to move by a different, if more difficult, route.
column2: 幸运的是，你的马匹与骑术足以甩开追兵。你择石而行，涉溪渡水，使追踪者难以寻踪。夜宿隐处后，翌日又沿另一条虽艰险却更为隐蔽的路径前行。

column1: Four keys hang by the door. You use...
column2: 门前悬四钥。你使用……

column1: Four keys hang nearby. You ponder, then choose...
column2: 四把钥匙悬于近旁。你沉思片刻，遂择其一……

column1: Four knobs are attached to the door, one each of gold, silver, copper, and lead. Four statements are carved on the wall nearby:
column2: 门上镶嵌着四枚旋钮，分别由金、银、铜和铅制成。墙边刻着四句箴言：

column1: Four metal keys hang nearby. You ponder, then use...
column2: 四枚金属钥匙悬于近旁。你沉思片刻，遂取之……

column1: Four travellers come up the path toward you; they examine you with suspicious eyes as you stand before them. "What would you, travellers?" asks a heavyset man wearing extravagant red robes. You...
column2: 四名旅人沿小径向你走来；他们立于你前，目光疑虑地打量着你。“诸位旅人，有何贵干？”一名身着华服红袍的壮汉问道。你...

column1: Frantically, you climb downward, but the green mist pours over the chamber's lip like a waterfall and flows all around you. Choking and gagging, one by one you succumb and fall into the trees and rocks below.
column2: 你惊慌失措地向下攀爬，然而那绿色雾气如瀑布般倾泻而下，将整个洞室吞没，四面八方皆是。你窒息难耐，逐一倒下，坠入下方的林木与乱石之间。

column1: Fresh paw-prints cross your tracks. $ChosenOneName kneels to inspect them, then looks up with a worried expression. "Wolf spoor!" $he murmurs. "And only a few minutes old!" Suddenly you hear low growls coming from the undergrowth.
column2: 新鲜的爪印横亘于你的足迹之上。$ChosenOneName 跪地细察，随即抬头，神色忧虑。“狼迹！”你 低声道，“且不过数刻之前留下的！”忽闻灌木丛中传来低沉的咆哮声。

column1: From a number of people, you hear the same thing. "Out in the mines, to the $Direction, they're having some real problems. Something about strange creatures in the tunnels, preventing the miners from working."
column2: 你从众人口中听到了同样的消息：“矿井深处，往$Direction方向，近日颇多异状。似有怪兽潜伏于隧洞之中，阻绝矿工采掘。”

column1: From above, you hail the merchants in a friendly voice. Unfortunately, the guards think you are more bandits, and drive you away with a hail of arrows. Your good deed must go unrewarded, except for the knowledge that it was a noble and virtuous act.
column2: 从高处，你以友好的声音向商人们致意。不幸的是，守卫们以为你是强盗，用箭雨将你驱赶。你的善举只得无果而终，唯有知晓这是一桩高尚而有德的举动，聊以自慰。

column1: From behind an old tree stump, up pops a holzfrau, woodwife of the schrat. She smiles and beckons to you, her satin-like fur sparkling in the starlight. When you come over, she steps up to each of you individually and whispers in your ear. Then she vanishes as mysteriously as she came.
column2: 从一棵老树桩后，冒出一位霍尔茨夫人，她是施拉特的木妇。她微笑着向你招手，她那如缎般的皮毛在星光下熠熠生辉。当你走近时，她逐一走到你们面前，在耳边低语。随后，她如来时般神秘地消失了。

column1: From behind an old tree stump, up pops a holzfrau. A holzfrau is a wood-wife, the female counterpart of a schrat. She is more human-looking than her mate, but is still naked and covered with fur, except for her hands, feet, face, and breasts. She beckons to you, her satin-like fur sparkling in the starlight, then steps up to each of you individually and whispers "Learn of $Text1. This will protect you from the Wild Hunt."
column2: 从一棵老树桩后，忽地跃出一位木妇。木妇乃林中女妖，为树精之雌性伴侣。她较其夫更为人形，然仍裸露，遍体生毛，唯手足、面容及双乳不覆。她向你招手，缎般柔滑的毛皮在星光下熠熠生辉，继而逐一走近，低语道：“习得$Text1。此物可护汝免于野猎之厄。”

column1: From behind an outcropping of boulders, a glistening dragon head emerges. It crawls higher, claws clutching and tail whipping.
column2: 从一块巨石后，一颗闪亮的龙首探出。它缓缓爬升，利爪紧握，尾巴猛烈摆动。

column1: From high on the wall, $ChosenOneName watches $his companion fall. Sadly, $he climbs back down to render aid.
column2: 从高墙之上，$ChosenOneName 看着 你的 的同伴坠落。无奈之下，你 只能攀回地面施以援手。

column1: From nowhere a mask appears, floating in the air before you. It mouths the words, "The First Seal is broken. The Apocalypse draws near." Then it fades away. You keep walking towards the dark castle, and are soon at the huge entranceway. Colossal doors stand before you, blocking your way. Carved on the doors are the words, "The Castle of the Apocalypse." On the door hangs a bronze head, with a real beard of hair! The doors magically swing open before you.
column2: 忽然，一具面具凭空浮现，悬浮于你面前。它口吐人言：“第一印已破，末日将至。”随即消散无踪。你继续向那座幽暗的城堡前行，不久便至其宏伟的入口。巨大的门扉矗立眼前，阻挡去路。门上镌刻着“末日之堡”四字。门上悬有一颗青铜铸就的头颅，生有真发须！门竟自行洞开，迎你入内。

column1: From the shadows in a grove of trees, you admire the moonlight on the city roofs...
column2: 从林间阴影中，你凝望着月光洒在城郭之上……

column1: From the top of a low hill, you see a huge clearing in the wilderness ahead, occupied by nearly a hundred people. A small stream runs through the southern end of the clearing, and thin strands of woodsmoke rise from a vast ring of campfires surrounding the open area. From this distance it looks like a country fair, except that a palpable aura of evil hangs over the proceedings. You see a steady trickle of travellers on a well-worn path leading to the clearing. You...
column2: 从一座低矮山丘之巅，你望见前方荒野中有一片广袤空地，近百人聚于此。一条小溪自空地南端蜿蜒而过，四周营火环绕，缕缕炊烟袅袅升起。远观宛如乡间集市，唯其上笼罩着一股挥之不去的邪气。你见一条坦途蜿蜒通向此地，旅人络绎不绝。你...

column1: From what you can tell, the Master is guarded by powerful charms that can only be broken in a place called a fortress monastery, where the Knights Templar train satanic priests. There is to be a great ceremony today; surely a priest will attend.
column2: 据你所知，主人受强大护符守护，唯有在一处名为堡垒修道院之地方可破解，此地乃圣殿骑士训练撒旦祭司之所。今日将有一场盛大的仪式；必有祭司出席。

column1: Frowning ever-so-slightly, the Fugger opines, "It is a pity you were unable to clear the mine. I have lost money. The mine's stockholders have lost money. And, my dear friends, YOU have thus lost money."
column2: 福格尔微微皱眉，说道：“可惜你未能清理矿井。我亏了钱，矿井的股东也亏了钱。而你们，我亲爱的朋友，也因此亏了钱。”

column1: Frowning, the lord says, "Then send these back whence they came. They have no place here!" Guards drag you away.
column2: 领主皱眉道：“那就把这些家伙送回他们来的地方。他们在此无立足之地！”卫兵将你拖走。

column1: Frowning, the monk says, "Please don't bother us with such requests at night. Return in the morning, when we can properly deal with your desires."
column2: 那修士皱眉道：“夜间请勿以如此请求打扰我们。天明再来，我们才好妥善处理你的诉求。”

column1: Frowning, the raubritter refuses your request. "Leaving so soon? I wouldn't hear of it. Please, let's not discuss it any more." He has a suspicious glint in his eye, and you decide not to press the matter.
column2: 那盗匪骑士皱眉拒绝了你的请求。“这么快就走？这我可不能答应。请别再提此事了。”他眼中闪过一丝狐疑，你决定不再追问。

column1: Frowning, the richter questions you and your captors repeatedly. In the end, he sighs and says, "The evidence is in your favor. You are freed, and officially declared innocent in the sight of both God and man."
column2: 那法官皱眉反复盘问你与押送你的人。最终，他叹了口气说道：“证据于你有利。你被释放，并在上帝与众人面前正式宣布无罪。”

column1: Frustrated, you feel like country bumpkins. You decide to either look for something else, or come back some other day. Perhaps then the staff will be more charitable.
column2: 沮丧之余，你觉得自己像个乡巴佬。你决定要么另寻他处，要么改日再来。或许那时店员会更和善些。

column1: Frustrated, you resolve to have somebody learn how to read and write better!
column2: 你愤懑地决心要让某人学会更好地读写！

column1: Fugger banking offices, in the main marketplace, at night.
column2: 富格尔银行办事处，位于主集市广场，夜色中。

column1: Fugger pawnshop, in the main marketplace, at night.
column2: 富格尔当铺，位于主集市，夜色之中。

column1: Fugger pawnshop, in the main marketplace, in the daytime.
column2: 富格尔当铺，位于主集市，白日。

column1: Fumbling frantically in $his pouch, $ChosenOneName tries to pull out a potion, but $his fingers slip and the potion falls to the ground and rolls far away. A capering cultist steps on and smashes it without even noticing, and its fluids run hissing into the earth, uselessly.
column2: 在你的袋中慌乱摸索，$ChosenOneName试图取出一瓶药剂，但你的手指一滑，药剂掉落在地，滚得老远。一个嬉戏的邪教徒毫不在意地踩碎了它，其液体嘶嘶作响地渗入泥土，毫无用处。

column1: Fumes rise as the Breath of Death blankets the area. The monster's eyes glaze with pleasure as it inhales the deadly gas, wagging its head to and fro as it savors the poison. While it is happily engrossed, you turn and flee.
column2: 死亡之息弥漫，毒气笼罩四方。怪物双眼迷离，贪婪地吸入致命毒气，摇头晃脑，尽情享受这剧毒。趁其陶醉之际，你转身逃去。

column1: Fuming and sputtering, the potion consumes the metal structure of the gate. It falls apart. The entryway to the tower is open.
column2: 泡沫翻腾，药剂吞噬了大门的金属结构。它轰然倒塌。通往塔楼的入口已敞开。

column1: Fuming, the acid corrodes the lock, and the door swings open. As you tiptoe down the hall, the stink from the acid alerts the turnkey's keen nose.  Suddenly the guards come charging round the corner.
column2: 酸液怒气冲冲地腐蚀着锁具，门应声而开。你蹑手蹑脚地沿着走廊前行，酸液的恶臭却惊动了狱卒敏锐的嗅觉。突然，卫兵们从拐角处蜂拥而出。

column1: Fuming, the potion spills over the cobblestones, and transmutes the street surface into a gummy ooze. The guards are halted by the mess. Some, more audacious than the rest, venture into it, only to find themselves stuck to the ground. You leave them behind, still pondering this alchemical wonder.
column2: 怒气冲冲，药剂倾泻于鹅卵石路面，将街道化作一团黏稠的胶状物。守卫们被这混乱场面阻滞不前。其中一些胆大者冒险踏入，却发现自己牢牢粘在地面上。你将他们抛在身后，兀自思索着这炼金术的奇迹。

column1: Furious at your audacity, the raubritter's sword flies into his hand. He roars to his men, "Slay me these idiots!"
column2: 你胆敢如此无礼，令这位劫匪骑士大怒，他的剑已握在手中。他向手下咆哮道：“杀了这些蠢货！”

column1: Furious at your lack of response, the richter calls upon the bailiff to enforce compliance, stating, "I cannot pass sentence nor pronounce innocence save yon prisoners admit to guilt or deny same." You are taken to the torture chamber, and subjected to various excruciations. After hours of pain, the richter returns with you to the main courtroom. He repeats, "Are ye guilty?"
column2: 因你拒不回应，法官唤来法警强制执行，言道：“除非囚犯自认有罪或矢口否认，否则我既不能判刑，亦不能宣其无罪。”你被押至刑讯室，饱受种种酷刑。经数小时之苦，法官携你重返主法庭。他复问：“汝可认罪？”

column1: Furious with your excessive delay in vital matters, $ChosenOneName warns that you must do better, or $he will leave shortly.
column2: 因你在要务上耽搁过久，$ChosenOneName 警告你务必改进，否则 你 将不久离去。

column1: Furious, $NamedOneName orders his guards to throw you out.
column2: 愤怒的$NamedOneName命令他的卫兵将你驱逐出去。

column1: Furious, $NamedOneName shouts,
column2: 愤怒地，$NamedOneName 喊道，

column1: GOLD: I am Aubyn.
column2: 黄金：我是奥宾。

column1: GOLD: Narm is not silver. The son of Hod is copper.
column2: 黄金：纳尔姆非银。霍德之子为铜。

column1: GOLD: Silver speaks truth, when he speaks at all.
column2: 金：银若开口，必言真话。

column1: Galloping, you outrace the foul dragon. Your horses tremble, foaming and breathing heavily. Slowly your fears evaporate.
column2: 飞驰之间，你甩开了那条邪恶的巨龙。你的马儿颤抖着，口吐白沫，喘息沉重。渐渐地，恐惧消散了。

column1: Gargoyles leer overhead as you approach the famed $cathedral. Your footsteps echo inside the mighty nave. Ominous statues and glowing stained-glass images loom overhead. You...
column2: 巨石怪在你接近那著名的$cathedral时俯视着。你的脚步声在雄伟的中殿内回响。阴森的雕像与熠熠生辉的彩绘玻璃影像高悬于头顶。你...

column1: Gargoyles leer overhead as you approach. Your footsteps echo as you step inside the nave, where votive candles cast the only light. It is nearly as dark inside as it is outside, in the black night.
column2: 石像鬼在你接近时俯视着。你踏入中殿，脚步声回荡，唯有许愿蜡烛投下微光。殿内几乎与漆黑的夜色无异。

column1: Gathering up your courage, you charge the entrance of the prison. The guards at the gate see you coming and attempt to block the doorway.
column2: 鼓起勇气，你冲向监狱的入口。门口的守卫见你来势汹汹，试图阻挡去路。

column1: Gesturing to one of his guards, $NamedOneName says, "This knight will attend you, to aid in your fight against $NamedTwoName."
column2: 向一名侍卫示意，$NamedOneName说道：“此骑士将随侍左右，助你对抗$NamedTwoName。”

column1: Giant $NamedOneName shakes his huge hammer at you, and roars in a bass growl,
column2: 巨人$NamedOneName挥舞着他巨大的铁锤向你怒吼，低沉的咆哮声震耳欲聋，

column1: Gigantic spider forms emerge from the trees, and barely hesitate as they rush toward you.
column2: 巨大的蜘蛛形体自树丛中浮现，几乎不作停留便向你扑来。

column1: Giggling, you quickly escape into a gully and its concealing brush. By the time the guards can mount a pursuit, you are well hidden. You remain so for the rest of the day, until the angry nobleman finally calls off the hunt and leaves.
column2: 咯咯笑着，你迅速逃入一条沟壑，藏身于掩护的灌木丛中。待守卫追来时，你已深藏不见。你如此潜伏了一整天，直到那位愤怒的贵族终于下令停止搜捕，扬长而去。

column1: Glancing around frantically, you see a doe nearby, listening nervously to the sound of the Wild Hunt's hounds. At any moment, it may flee. $ChosenOneName tries to sneak up on the deer, but it hears him and bounds away.
column2: 疯狂地四下张望，你看见不远处有一只母鹿，正紧张地聆听着野猎队的猎犬声。它随时可能逃走。$ChosenOneName试图悄悄靠近那头鹿，但它听到了动静，一跃而起，飞奔而去。

column1: Glancing around frantically, you see a doe, made nervous by the sound of the Wild Hunt. Using all the skill at $his command, $ChosenOneName sneaks up to the deer. When it finally bolts, $he wounds it with a well-aimed missile.
column2: 疯狂地四下张望，你看见一只因野猎队的声响而惊慌失措的母鹿。凭借你的娴熟掌控，$ChosenOneName悄悄潜近那头鹿。待它终于拔腿奔逃，你以一矢命中，将其击伤。

column1: Glaring at $NamedOneName, $ChosenOneName says you will slay any dwarf trying to steal the mine. He seems impressed, and wheedles you.
column2: 怒视着$NamedOneName，$ChosenOneName说你将杀死任何试图偷矿的矮人。他似乎颇为钦佩，并对你百般奉承。

column1: Glaring at you, the priest shrieks, "You dare?! See the powers I have at my disposal! You shall tremble before the strength of heaven."
column2: 怒目而视，那祭司尖声道：“你竟敢？！看我手中有何等法力！尔等当惧天威！”

column1: Gleefully he takes your purse, then escorts you back to the nave.
column2: 他兴高采烈地拿走你的钱袋，随后护送你回到教堂中殿。

column1: Gleefully the wicked alchemist confiscates your goods. Then he tosses you the relative pittance of $Money1 in return. You go your way, grumbling.
column2: 邪恶的炼金术士兴高采烈地没收了你的财物，然后只扔给你区区$Money1作为回报。你只得愤愤离去。

column1: Gloating, the dwarf leans over the pit again.
column2: 骄傲地，矮人再次俯身于坑边。

column1: Gloating, the guards drag you helplessly back to the dungeon. "What a puny plan!" sniggers the turnkey. "You'll soon be sorry you tried to escape." You are locked within a cell worse than the previous one.
column2: 嘲笑着，狱卒们将你无力地拖回地牢。“多么渺小的计划！”看守嗤笑道：“你会为自己的逃亡后悔的。”你被锁进一间比先前更糟的牢房。

column1: Gloating, the guards expertly check your bodies for valuables. One says, "Let's slit their throats!" Another replies, sneeringly, "Why bother? These fellows are no threat." In the end, your unconscious forms are dragged away and dumped.
column2: 士兵们得意洋洋，熟练地搜查你们的身上是否有贵重物品。一人道：“不如割了他们的喉咙！”另一人冷笑道：“何必？这些人毫无威胁。”最终，你们被拖走，丢弃在一处昏暗之地。

column1: Gloatingly, the raubritter's men search your bodies for items of value. Taking everything they find, they drag you, half-naked and helpless, before $NamedOneName. He scoffs at you, and says, "Take them out and beat them to death!"
column2: 骄傲地，劫匪的手下搜查你们的身上是否有值钱之物。夺走他们找到的一切后，他们将半裸无助的你们拖到$NamedOneName面前。他嘲笑着你们，说道：“把他们带出去，活活打死！”

column1: Gloatingly, the raubritter's men search your bodies for items of value. Taking everything they find, they drag you, half-naked and helpless, before $NamedOneName. He scoffs at you, saying, "Take them out and beat them to death!"
column2: 那些劫匪得意地搜刮你身上的值钱之物。掠尽所有后，他们把你半裸无助地拖到$NamedOneName面前。他嗤笑道：“把他们拖出去，活活打死！”

column1: Glowering threateningly, everyone hefts their weapons. $ChosenOneName 's lip curls, and $he spins $his $NamedOneName easily in one hand. One of you hisses, "I get his boots."
column2: 众人怒目而视，纷纷举起武器。$ChosenOneName嘴角一撇，你则轻松地单手旋转着你的 $NamedOneName。你们中一人嘶声道：“我要他的靴子。”

column1: Glumly, he replies, "The soul of the first person to cross the bridge is forfeit. Such was the devil's fee. So no one has yet dared set foot on it. We can only look longingly at our bridge."
column2: 他黯然答道：“第一个踏上桥的人，灵魂将被夺走。这便是恶魔的代价。因此至今无人敢踏足其上。我们只能遥望那座桥。”

column1: Glumly, you decide to ...
column2: 你黯然决定去……

column1: Glumly, you return to the main courtyard.
column2: 你闷闷不乐地回到主庭院。

column1: Gnashing your teeth in frustration, you are driven off, forced by cruel necessity to abandon $ChosenOneName to the vile villagers. You hide nearby, hoping to learn her fate.
column2: 你咬牙切齿，愤懑不已，被迫离去，因残酷的现实不得不将$ChosenOneName弃于那些卑劣的村民之手。你藏身附近，期盼得知她的命运。

column1: Gnome: "The kobold is neither Gymer nor Albech."
column2: 矮人：“地精既非吉默尔，亦非阿尔贝希。”

column1: Go to the map of Germany.
column2: 前往德意志地图。

column1: Godehard replies to your plea, and the dragon is suddenly baffled. Divine energy enfolds it, and it has no will to attack. While it is temporarily discommoded, you hurry down the slope and seize your chance to escape.
column2: 戈德哈德回应你的恳求，巨龙顿时茫然无措。神圣之力将其笼罩，它已无力再攻。趁其暂时失神，你急下斜坡，抓住时机脱身。

column1: Gold says, "I am Tifsyn. Silver is Hardgrep."
column2: 金说道：“我是蒂夫辛。银是哈德格雷普。”

column1: Gold: Yesterday, Hootvin said that the gold knob opened the door.
column2: 黄金：昨日，胡特文说黄金旋钮能打开那扇门。

column1: Gothic spires are black spikes in the night sky. Moving amid the long shadows to evade the night watch, you move toward...
column2: 哥特式尖塔如黑色利刺，直刺夜空。你穿梭于长长的阴影之间，避开夜巡队的视线，向……走去。

column1: Gothic spires are black spikes in the night sky. Moving amid the long shadows to evade the nightwatch, you move toward...
column2: 哥特式尖塔如黑色利刺，直刺夜空。你穿梭于长长的阴影之间，避开夜巡者，向……走去。

column1: Gradually the crowd drifts away again. Finally it is just $NamedOneName, yourselves, and a few loyal followers.
column2: 众人渐渐又散去了。最终只剩下$NamedOneName、你们，以及几名忠实的追随者。

column1: Gradually the crowd is convinced, letting you pass into the fortress.
column2: 众人渐渐信服，让你得以进入要塞。

column1: Gradually you become aware of an unnatural quiet. A cold wind blows. From the edge of a line of scrub, a pack of uncannily intelligent-looking wolves steps forward. Their leader snarls a challenge and they charge forward!
column2: 你渐渐察觉到一股不自然的寂静。寒风呼啸而过。从灌木丛边缘，一群看似异常聪慧的狼缓缓走出。为首的狼低吼着发出挑战，随即猛扑而来！

column1: Gratefully you slump against the walls.
column2: 你感激地靠在墙上。

column1: Gratefully you these generous gifts. Then everyone returns to the celebrations, which are full of good food, good drink and good cheer. But everything must end in time. Finally you leave.
column2: 你满怀感激地接受了这些慷慨的馈赠。随后，众人重返欢庆之中，盛宴、美酒与欢声笑语充盈其间。然而，一切终有尽时。最终，你们启程离去。

column1: Gratefully, $ChosenOneName accepts the gift in the name of the entire group, knowing it can be given to the most appropriate person later. Everyone returns to the celebrations, which are full of good food, good drink and good cheer. But everything must end in time: finally you leave.
column2: 感激地，$ChosenOneName 代表全体接受此礼，知其可于日后赠予最适之人。众人复归欢庆，酒食丰盛，笑语盈盈。然乐极则终，终究启程离去。

column1: Gratefully, the nuns accept your help. You work for a full 24 hours, stopping only to snatch cat-naps and down gulps of food. $ChosenOneName uses $his healing skills again and again, honing them and saving several lives. The rest of the party also help out, and learn somewhat about healing while they are at it. When you are done, the nuns press $Money1 upon you. When you try to refuse it, they quote scripture: "The laborer is worthy of his hire.", and you are forced to accept.
column2: 修女们感激地接受了你的帮助。你整整工作了24小时，只在打盹和匆匆进食时稍作停歇。$ChosenOneName一再施展你的治疗术，精益求精，救下了数条性命。队伍中的其他人也纷纷相助，在此过程中对治疗术略有所悟。待一切告竣，修女们执意将$Money1赠予你。你欲推辞，她们便援引经文：“劳碌之人，理应得其报酬。”你只得收下。

column1: Gratified, the sergeant preens himself. As you leave, $ChosenOneName encourages him further, "Keep your eyes open. The real thugs are still out there. Bring them in and I'll have your salary doubled." Diligently the sergeant leads his men off, peering intently at passers-by. Once he's around the corner, you burst out laughing and go on your way.
column2: 满意地，中士挺直了腰板。你离开时，$ChosenOneName 又鼓励他道：“睁大眼睛。真正的恶棍还在外面。把他们抓起来，我就把你的薪水翻倍。”中士勤勉地带着手下离去，仔细打量着过往行人。等他转过街角，你忍不住大笑一声，继续前行。

column1: Greed and avarice overcome the Templars. They untie you, then accept your hidden wealth in exchange for your lives. Keeping your weapons, they drive you off and continue their original business with the unfortunate friar. You can do nothing.
column2: 贪婪与贪欲战胜了圣殿骑士。他们解开了你的绳索，继而接受你隐藏的财富以换取你们的性命。留下你们的武器，他们将你们驱逐，并继续与那位不幸的修士进行原本的交易。你无能为力。

column1: Greedily the guard eyes the bribe, then snatches it from your hand. Grinning, he unlocks the sally port and opens it. You leave the city for the cool fresh air outside.
column2: 守卫贪婪地盯着那笔贿赂，随即从你手中夺过。他咧嘴一笑，打开城门的侧门。你走出城去，迎向外面清凉的空气。

column1: Greedily, $NamedOneName locks the phials away in a strongbox.
column2: 贪婪地，$NamedOneName将小瓶锁进一只坚固的箱子。

column1: Gregory Thaumaturgus responds to your desperate situation with a bolt of lightning which shatters the cliffside over the dragon and buries it in a mass of rubble. You can hear the monster roaring with anger, and quickly depart before it can rip its way out.
column2: 格雷戈里·索马图尔古斯以一道闪电回应你的绝境，那闪电击碎了巨龙头顶的崖壁，将其埋于乱石堆中。你听得见怪物愤怒的咆哮，便迅速离去，以免它挣脱而出。

column1: Grimly pondering, the richter at last comes to a decision. "Your crimes, foul as they are, do not warrant the supreme penalty. You are to be taken to the place of punishment, flogged, and freed."
column2: 里希特沉思良久，终于作出裁决：“汝之罪行虽恶，尚不足处以极刑。汝将被押赴刑场，受鞭笞后释放。”

column1: Grimly the guardsmen disarm you and those others who stayed. Local citizens are sent home, but foreigners such as you are taken to the dungeons to await trail.
column2: 卫兵冷酷地解除你及同行者的武装。本地居民被遣返，而像你这样的异乡人则被押入地牢，等待审判。

column1: Grinning broadly, the ruffians ransack your gear, looking for coins. In the end, they take half of your money, stealing $Money1. Then they leave.
column2: 邪徒咧嘴一笑，搜刮你的行囊，寻找金币。最终，他们夺走了你一半的钱财，偷走了$Money1。随后扬长而去。

column1: Grinning sheepishly, the physician confesses:
column2: 医者腼腆一笑，坦白道：

column1: Grinning wolfishly, the raubritter $NamedOneName meets with you inside his crude audience chamber. Chewing on extorted meat and guzzling stolen ale, he feasts heartily with his tough, scarred men-at-arms.
column2: 狡黠地咧嘴笑着，这位劫匪$NamedOneName在简陋的接见室中与你相会。他咀嚼着勒索来的肉食，大口灌饮偷来的麦酒，与手下那些身经百战、满身伤痕的武士一同豪饮畅食。

column1: Grinning, the guard takes your silver, which is worth almost a half year's pay. Quickly he fades into the darkness behind a farmhouse, then heads for the forest. Quietly, you steal inside.
column2: 笑着，守卫收下了你的银币，这几乎相当于他半年的薪水。他迅速消失在农舍后的黑暗中，随后朝森林走去。你悄悄潜入屋内。

column1: Gripped tightly in the dream, you can only let it continue...
column2: 紧紧被梦境束缚，你只能任其继续……

column1: Groaning, you bind your wounds and painfully stumble out of this terrible place.
column2: 呻吟着，你包扎好伤口，艰难地踉跄走出这可怕之地。

column1: Groaning, you discover you've been stripped of your armor, weapons in hand, and some other possessions.
column2: 呻吟着，你发现自己已被剥去甲胄，手中握着武器，还有一些其他财物。

column1: Groping for handholds, $ChosenOneName climbs the slick wall and reaches the window. With strength born of necessity, $he snaps out some iron bars and slips through. $He then helps the rest of you climb out. As the last person is passed through the tiny window, a guard spots you and sounds the alarm. You flee, with the guards close at your heels.
column2: 探索着可借力之处，$ChosenOneName攀上湿滑的墙壁，抵达窗边。凭藉迫不得已而生的力量，你掰断几根铁栏，悄然钻出。你随后协助其余众人攀出。当最后一名同伴被递出狭小窗口时，一名守卫发现了你们，立即拉响警报。你们仓皇逃窜，守卫紧追不舍。

column1: Growling, the alchemist $NamedOneName says, "Begone, bothersome and ignorant fellows, before I turn you into toads!"
column2: 吟游诗人$NamedOneName怒吼道：“滚开，烦人又无知的家伙们，否则我便将你们变成蟾蜍！”

column1: Grudgingly, the guard sergeant inspects your offering. He and his men are mercenaries, after all, and your money is good. Making a quick decision, he and his men divvy up the coins and let you pass.
column2: 守卫长官勉强检查了你的供品。毕竟他和他的部下都是雇佣兵，而你的银币足够打发他们。他当机立断，与手下分了银币，放你通行。

column1: Grumpily, the high lord watches $ChosenOneName fall to $his knees and ask $NamedOneName for assistance. At first, the lord appears unimpressed, but just as he turns to his bailiff to order you out, he stops, thunderstruck. "Did you hear that?" he asks, urgently, but no one else in the room heard or saw anything.
column2: 大领主悻悻然看着 $ChosenOneName 跪倒在 $NamedOneName 面前求援。起初，这领主似乎不以为意，但就在他转身吩咐法警将你们赶出去时，他猛然停住，如遭雷击。“你听到了吗？”他急切地问道，但房中其他人什么都没听到，也没看到。

column1: Grunting "Enjoy yerselves," the guard grabs the silver (worth a few month's pay) and runs quickly for the forest. Quietly, you steal inside.
column2: 吼道：“自个儿玩去吧。”守卫抓起那枚银币（价值数月的薪水），飞快地奔向林中。你们悄然潜入其中。

column1: Grunting with the effort, $ChosenOneName gives it $his all, but $he is not strong enough. This sally port has been built to resist battering rams. You cannot hope to force it open. Behind you, the soldiers hoot derisively and prepare to attack.
column2: $ChosenOneName 使出了浑身力气，但 $he 力气不足。这处侧门本就是为抵御攻城槌而建，你休想撞开它。你身后，士兵们嘲讽地起哄，准备发动进攻。

column1: Grunting, $ChosenOneName drops one side of the chest as it slips out of $his sweaty hands. The bear awakens, then rises menacingly up as it becomes aware of intruders! The chest falls to the floor as you...
column2: 咕哝一声，$ChosenOneName从你的汗湿的手中滑落，一侧的箱子掉落。熊被惊醒，随即警觉地站起身来，察觉到入侵者！箱子重重摔在地上，而你……

column1: Guards and bystanders are amazed as $ChosenOneName loudly prays to $NamedOneName. A glow surrounds you all. Slowly at first, then with increasing speed, you are levitated through the air, over the city wall, and carried far outside the city's limits. The observers cry out and point after you, astounded by this exploit.
column2: 卫兵与旁观者皆惊诧不已，只见$ChosenOneName高声祈祷于$NamedOneName。众人周身环绕着光辉。起初缓慢，继而加速，你们被托举于空中，越过城墙，远赴城外。观者惊呼，指望着你们离去的身影，对这一奇技叹为观止。

column1: Guards curse, wagons smash together, and dogs howl when your potion explodes. Pushing with all your might, you try to shove a path through the crowd, but are not quite agile enough to make it before the potion wears off and the guards are once again alert.
column2: 守卫咒骂，马车相撞，犬吠声四起，当你的药剂爆炸时。你用尽全力试图在人群中挤出一条路，却不够敏捷，在药剂效力消退、守卫重新警觉之前未能成功。

column1: Guild Rumors
column2: 公会传闻

column1: H.
column2: H.

column1: HE
column2: 他

column1: HEAVEN
column2: 天堂

column1: HIJINKS.
column2: 恶作剧。

column1: Ha! You were right! Good-naturedly, the man pays out his two groschen. "Many more wins like that, and I'll have to pack up my kit," says he. "Let's try again. Just one groschen."
column2: 哈！你果然猜对了！那人和善地掏出两枚格罗申。“再赢几把，我就得收拾摊子了，”他说，“再来一局吧，就一格罗申。”

column1: Hamburg.
column2: 汉堡。

column1: Hammering stoutly on the stone box, you finally crack it open, though your weapons suffer from the abuse. Inside you find five objects, each carefully wrapped in salamander wool. There is a golden ring, a silver dagger, a copper orb (much like those held by kings), an iron scepter, and a lead crown. Hmm. Could these be the crown jewels of $NamedOneName?
column2: 你用力敲击石盒，终于将其砸开，只是武器也因此受损。盒中藏有五件物品，每一件都用蝾螈绒仔细包裹。有一枚金戒指、一把银匕首、一个铜球（颇似国王所持之物）、一根铁权杖和一顶铅冠。嗯？这莫非是$NamedOneName的王室珠宝？

column1: Hand over hand, $ChosenOneName swings along the anchor line to the wharf and slinks into the shadows. A few minutes later, you hear $his voice and noises from behind a warehouse. The commotion distracts the guards on the dock. While the guards chase $ChosenOneName, the rest of your party debarks and moves off down a side street.
column2: 一寸一寸地，$ChosenOneName 沿着锚绳荡向码头，悄然隐入阴影之中。数分钟后，你听见 你的 的声音与仓库后方的动静。喧哗声吸引了码头守卫的注意。趁守卫追捕 $ChosenOneName 之际，队伍其余成员已下船，沿小巷离去。

column1: Hanseatic League office, in the main marketplace, at night.
column2: 汉萨同盟办事处，位于主集市，夜色中。

column1: Happily the villagers seem unoffended by your refusal to participate. They invite you to stay at least for the judging. You agree, unwilling to give further cause for offense. They bring you some wine to drink.
column2: 村民们欣然对你拒绝参与并不介意。他们邀请你至少留下观看裁决。你答应了，不愿再招致不快。他们为你奉上美酒。

column1: Happily, $NamedOneName says to you, "At last, $NamedTwoName's power is destroyed. All of $PlaceName will know of your part in this; your deeds shall be remembered."
column2: 高兴地，$NamedOneName对你说：“终于，$NamedTwoName的势力被摧毁了。整个$PlaceName都将知晓你的功绩；你的事迹将被铭记。”

column1: Hard stone steps banging against your head awaken you. You are being dragged  down the dungeon stairs, bleeding from both old and new wounds.
column2: 硬石台阶撞击着你的头颅，将你唤醒。你正被拖下地牢的阶梯，旧伤新创，鲜血淋漓。

column1: Hard stone steps banging against your head awaken you. You are being dragged downstairs to the dungeon, still bleeding from your wounds.
column2: 硬石台阶撞击着你的头颅，将你惊醒。你正被拖下楼梯，进入地牢，伤口仍在流血。

column1: Hardly breaking stride, you draw weapons and charge at the wolves, taking them by surprise. The fight is on!
column2: 你几乎未停步，拔出武器向狼群冲去，令它们猝不及防。战斗打响了！

column1: Harsh word comes from $NamedOneName, captain of the guard. "Swine! Expect no mercy from us."
column2: 严厉的话语出自$NamedOneName，卫队长。“畜生！休想从我们这里得到怜悯。”

column1: Hastily, $ChosenOneName bows $his head, clasps $his hands, and prays with all $his might. Nothing happens. $He continues, but there is no result.
column2: $ChosenOneName 急忙低头，双手合十，竭尽全力祈祷。毫无反应。$He 继续祈祷，却依然无果。

column1: Have $ChosenOneName quietly scale the walls, then throw down a rope so the rest of you can follow.
column2: 让$ChosenOneName悄然攀上城墙，然后抛下绳索，让其余众人跟随。

column1: Have everyone climb the walls using their own, natural abilities.
column2: 让众人凭借自身天赋攀上城墙。

column1: Having gained the ear of the guild's leaders, you...
column2: 得到公会领袖的垂听，你...

column1: Having no choice, you agree not to attack, and he lowers a chain. You climb out. The dwarf grabs his chain and quickly disappears into the darkness.
column2: 无奈之下，你答应不发动攻击，他便放下一根铁链。你攀上铁链，爬了出去。矮人抓住自己的铁链，迅速消失在黑暗之中。

column1: Having now created more of a disturbance than you'd have liked, you quickly leave the area.
column2: 如今你已惹出比预期更大的骚动，便匆匆离开此地。

column1: He also inquires whether any of your mounts are for sale.
column2: 他也询问你们的坐骑是否出售。

column1: He also says that if you come back during the day, the stablemaster will be happy to talk to you about buying and selling mounts. In fact, the inn's stables are the center of local horse-trading in $PlaceName.
