column2: 他还说，若你日间再来，马厩主人自会乐于与你商谈买卖坐骑之事。事实上，这家客栈的马厩正是$PlaceName当地的马匹交易中心。

column1: He and his chosen men move to the attack. You meet them face to face.
column2: 他与麾下精锐将士发起进攻。你与他们正面交锋。

column1: He and his men draw swords. It's an ambush! You barely unsheathe your weapons before they swarm around you, steel singing through the air.
column2: 他与部下拔剑出鞘。这是一场伏击！你尚未及挥刀，他们已如潮水般涌来，刀光划破长空。

column1: He answers, "No. Take them to the dungeon, and we will let the city fathers decide their fate."
column2: 他答道：“不。将他们押入地牢，由城中父老定夺其命运。”

column1: He beats the ground with his fists in his terror and agony. Suddenly an idea comes to him. "You can use holy relics to slay the dragon. The three most puissant objects to defeat the monster are St. George's Sword, St. Michael's Sword, and St. Margaret's Cross. Seek them! Leave IT to me!"
column2: 他惊恐交加，用双拳捶击地面。忽而灵机一动：“可用圣物斩杀巨龙。克敌之至宝有三：圣乔治之剑、圣米迦勒之剑、圣玛格丽特之十字。速去寻之！余自有安排！”

column1: He bows and leaves.
column2: 他鞠躬离去。

column1: He considers further, then adds, "But of course, an army moving past might ignore that detail. We remain watchful, ready to defend ourselves at a moment's notice."
column2: 他沉吟片刻，又道：“然则，行军之师或可不察此细节。吾等仍当警戒，随时准备自卫。”

column1: He continues, "Charity, Erasmus, Pantaleon, Polycarp! These saints alone, plus the Firewall alchemy, protect against the flames of the dragon's heat. Who knows them well but I!"
column2: 他继续道：“慈善、伊拉斯谟、潘塔列昂、波利卡普！唯有此诸圣，加之防火墙之炼金术，方能抵御龙焰之炽热。孰能如我般熟知乎？”

column1: He continues, "Dragons are not as mortals. You humans eat when you are hungry, sleep when you are tired, and are sated when you have enough gold. When a dragon eats, it gets ever more ravenous!"
column2: 他续道：“龙非凡人。汝等人类饥则食，倦则眠，金足则饱。然龙食之愈多，愈觉饥渴难耐！”

column1: He continues, "let me explain a bit more about our problem..."
column2: 他继续说道：“让我再详细解释一下我们的问题……”

column1: He departs on the wind.
column2: 他随风而去。

column1: He excuses himself and reverently carries the garment from the room. You depart.
column2: 他告退，虔诚地将那件衣物携出房间。你离去。

column1: He explains, "I put the dried pea under a shell. See? Then I shuffle the shells." He suits action to words.
column2: 他解释道：“我把干豌豆放在一个贝壳下。看到了吗？然后我洗牌。”他边说边做。

column1: He falls at your feet, thinking $ChosenOneName is actually Saint Dominic. "Mend your ways," says $ChosenOneName. "Repent, and seek absolution in Rome. There is still time to redeem yourself."
column2: 他匍匐于你足下，以为$ChosenOneName竟是圣多明我。“改过自新吧，”$ChosenOneName说道，“忏悔吧，在罗马寻求赦免。你还有时间赎罪。”

column1: He freezes. When you lay the evidence before him, he is quite silent.
column2: 他僵住了。当你将证据摆在面前时，他一言不发。

column1: He gestures and his men converge upon you. There is no other choice: you suddenly attack. The fight is on.
column2: 他一挥手，手下便围了上来。别无选择：你猝然出手。战斗打响。

column1: He gets the parcel and partly unwraps it. "See, it's still here." He rewraps it and hands it to you.
column2: 他接过包裹，略略拆开。“看，还在呢。”他又重新包好，递给你。

column1: He gnashes his teeth and shouts after you, "Stay away from $NamedTwoName! Without me, the dragon might ne'er have been awakened! I deserve the glory!"
column2: 他咬牙切齿地朝你喊道：“远离$NamedTwoName！若非我，那条龙岂会苏醒？这荣耀应归于我！”

column1: He goes on, "Also efficacious are St. Adrian's Sword, St. Arnulf's Broadsword, St. Boniface of Crediton's Axe, St. Eligius's Brooch, the Bolt of St. Gottschalk, the Spear of St. Polycarp, and the Crown of St. Stephen I.
column2: 他继续说道：“此外，圣阿德里安之剑、圣阿尔努夫之阔剑、克雷迪顿的圣博尼法斯之斧、圣埃利吉乌斯之胸针、圣戈茨沙尔克之箭、圣波吕卡普之矛以及圣斯蒂芬一世之冠亦皆具灵效。”

column1: He hands $ChosenOneName a dwarf-forged weapon. It gleams in the torchlight. As you swing it through the air, you can tell it is a weapon of worth. When you look back to the dwarf, he has vanished once more -- no doubt he was nervous about his enemies.
column2: 他将$ChosenOneName递给你一件矮人锻造的武器。它在火把光下熠熠生辉。当你挥动它时，你能感受到这是一件名副其实的利器。回头望去，那矮人已再次消失——想必是忌惮他的仇敌吧。

column1: He hands to you an iron bottle, bound in copper wire. You unseal it and take a sniff. He gestures to your wounded to drink of it, and you do, to find that it kindles a heat that eliminates all your fatigue, and much of your pain. You hand back the bottle, and he hides once more.
column2: 他递给你一只用铜丝缠绕的铁瓶。你启封嗅了嗅。他示意你的伤者饮下，你也照做，只觉一股热流涌起，驱散了所有的疲惫，也减轻了许多疼痛。你将瓶子还回，他再次隐匿身形。

column1: He hesitates, then adds, "Others may also have obtained this information, and I fear lest one of my rivals finds this item. Do not tarry o'erlong."
column2: 他犹豫片刻，又道：“或许还有他人得知此讯，我唯恐敌手先得此物。切莫久留。”

column1: He hobbles back to his hut, while you follow carefully. It takes him only a minute to locate the $NamedOneName.
column2: 他一瘸一拐地回到自己的小屋，你则小心翼翼地跟在后面。他只用了一分钟就找到了$NamedOneName。

column1: He is as good as his word. At daybreak you are escorted to the edge of his lands.
column2: 他信守诺言。黎明时分，你被护送至其领地的边界。

column1: He is impressed by your arguments, so convincingly stated. He promises to reconsider his views. You have achieved some influence, and feel he and his followers now $Support changes in the government.
column2: 他被你言之凿凿的论据所折服。他允诺重新审视自己的观点。你已初具影响力，觉察到他及其追随者如今$Support政府变革。

column1: He is no human! He is a schrat, a wild man covered with shaggy hair.
column2: 他并非凡人！乃一野人，浑身披覆蓬乱毛发。

column1: He is quite spry for such an old man. As you lunge at him he skitters away, bawling for help in an amazingly loud voice. Quickly, several other witches come to his aid, and face you with weapons drawn and determination in their eyes.
column2: 对于如此老者，他竟颇为矫健。你挥剑扑向他时，他却灵巧地闪避而去，以惊人洪亮之声呼救。顷刻间，数名女巫赶来相助，手持武器，目光坚毅。

column1: He leads you to a small alcove room. "Our conversation will be quite private here," the priest remarks. "Now, state your business."
column2: 他引你至一间小壁龛室。“在此，我们谈话当可私密无虞。”神父说道，“且说来由。”

column1: He leans forward. "Now, about this task..."
column2: 他俯身道：“如今，关于此任务……”

column1: He leaves and you sink into a well-deserved sleep.
column2: 他离去，你便沉入一场当之无愧的酣眠。

column1: He looks shamefaced, "My pride is gone. The dragon slew my friends. Now I am poor and homeless. Alas, $NamedThreeName seduced me to the vile act. Perhaps I shall die in seeking vengeance and thus end my anguish."
column2: 他面露愧色：“我之傲气尽失。恶龙屠戮吾友。今我贫无所依。唉，$NamedThreeName诱我犯下此等恶行。或许我将在复仇途中殒命，以此了却心中苦痛。”

column1: He motions for a young novice, who takes you to a very old monk, the cantor, who is dressing for the next liturgy.
column2: 他示意一名年轻修士，后者引你至一位年迈僧侣——唱经师——处，彼正为下一礼仪更衣。

column1: He mutters unintelligibly about the dragon, then giggles again. You are puzzled. Perhaps the dragon has driven him mad.
column2: 他喃喃自语，语意难辨，似在谈论恶龙，旋即又咯咯轻笑。你心生疑惑。莫非恶龙已使其心智失常？

column1: He opens a leather purse and shows you $Money1, then closes it again and carefully locks it away.
column2: 他启开皮囊，示汝$Money1，复又紧闭，小心锁藏。

column1: He passes you a small but weighty purse with $Money1 inside.
column2: 他递过一只小巧而沉重的钱袋，内含$Money1。

column1: He pauses a second, then adds, "There's a physician in town, in the guild district. He might be willing to see you tonight."
column2: 他稍作停顿，续道：“镇上有位医师，在公会区。或愿今夜接诊于汝。”

column1: He pauses to collect himself. "But now my revenge is complete, and so is hers. Perhaps the news will speed her recovery: There IS justice in the world!"
column2: 他敛神片刻：“然则今我之仇已报，彼亦然。或许此讯能助其康复：世间确有公义！”

column1: He pauses to collect himself. "But now my revenge is complete. I shall remember this, and speak of it often. There IS justice in the world!"
column2: 他敛神片刻：“然则今我之仇已报。此事我将铭记，并常加述说。世间确有公义！”

column1: He raises his arms and suddenly everyone's mind is filled with the same thought: "Let there be peace and justice for all here." Quickly you and guards lead the rebels away, while the citizenry disperses.
column2: 他高举双臂，忽而众人心中皆涌起同一念头：“愿此地人人得享和平与公义。”尔后汝与卫士速将叛民押走，市民亦四散而去。

column1: He raises his arms, and there is a flash of light. Some power seems to protect him. Yet surely heaven does not want innocents slain?
column2: 他高举双臂，一道光芒乍现。似有神力护其周身。然天道岂容无辜遭屠？

column1: He replies, "All folk serve Heaven or Hell. There is no middle ground. I labor to bring men to the truth. Now that the Hellborn is free, all must see."
column2: 他答曰：“众生皆侍天庭或地狱，别无中间之道。吾孜孜以求，欲使世人归于真理。今地狱之子既获自由，众人皆当明鉴。”

column1: He replies, "For years we have worked this mine. We knew about the knockers -- elves of the mines -- and often heard them rapping at tunnel walls. We rarely saw them, however."
column2: 他答曰：“多年以来，吾辈于此矿井劳作。知有敲击者——矿中精灵——常闻其叩击巷壁之声，然鲜少得见其形。”

column1: He rummages around a bit, then finally finds a fresh scroll and a small box with two vials.
column2: 他翻找一阵，终觅得一卷新卷轴，及一小盒，内装两瓶药液。

column1: He says, "A hostile family is trying to rob my mother of her inheritance. A document exists to prove her lineage, but it has been stolen and is being held for ransom by the $NamedOneName in $LocName. Please go there, steal it, and bring it back to me.
column2: 他言：“有一敌对家族，欲夺吾母之遗产。本有文书可证其血统，然已被$NamedOneName于$LocName盗取，并索要赎金。烦往彼处，将其偷回交予吾人。”

column1: He says, "At a distant shrine, there lives a holy hermit. No doubt he will be a saint someday. In anticipation of this, I would like you to acquire one of his old habits. The shrine is $Direction2 of $LocName2.
column2: 他言：“远方圣所，住着一位圣洁隐士。迟早必封圣。为此，吾欲得其旧袍一件。该圣所位于$Direction2之$LocName2。”

column1: He says, "For a special new experiment, I am seeking a small amount of $ItemName. I have heard that a certain dwarf, also a sage alchemist, may have some. The best reports indicate that the dwarf is $Direction2 of $LocName2.
column2: 他言：“为一项特殊新实验，吾欲求少量$ItemName。闻某矮人兼贤者炼金术士或有存留。据称，此矮人居于$Direction2之$LocName2。”

column1: He says, "For generations my family has unsuccessfully claimed noble blood. Now, we have finally learned of the ancient place where our noble ancestor was put to rest. If the legends are correct, his crown will still be there, proof of our long-ignored claim. This ancient place is $Direction2 of $LocName2.
column2: 他说：“吾族世代觊觎贵族之血，至今未果。如今终知先祖长眠之地。若传说无误，其王冠犹在，足证我等久被漠视之名分。此地乃$Direction2之$LocName2。”

column1: He says, "For generations our family has treasured a special $ItemName as an heirloom; it was carried by an ancestor to and from the Holy Land during the first crusade. It was lost years ago. Now, a traveller's tale makes me believe that it is at the $NamedOneName, $Direction2 of $LocName2.
column2: 他言：“吾家世代珍藏一物$ItemName，视为传家宝；先祖曾携此物随第一次十字军东征往返圣地。然已遗失多年。今闻旅人传言，谓其现藏于$NamedOneName，位于$Direction2之$LocName2。”

column1: He says, "For generations, our family has treasured a special $ItemName as an heirloom. It was carried by an ancestor when he fought beside Emperor Frederick Barbarossa. It was lost decades ago. Now, a traveller's tale makes me believe that it is at the $NamedOneName, $Direction2 of $LocName2.
column2: 他言：“吾家世代珍藏一物$ItemName，视为传家宝。先祖曾随弗雷德里克·巴巴罗萨皇帝征战，携此物同行。然已失落数十年。今闻旅人传言，谓其现藏于$NamedOneName，位于$Direction2之$LocName2。”

column1: He says, "For years I have sought the fabled Tarnhelm, Seigfried's magic helmet. Now, when I am too sick to travel, I receive word about it! If you can find and bring the Tarnhelm to me, the reward shall be yours. It is reported to have been seen $Direction2 of $LocName2.
column2: 他言：“多年以来，吾一心寻觅传说中的塔恩赫尔姆，齐格弗里德之魔盔。今病重难行之际，竟得其消息！若汝能寻得并送至吾前，酬金归汝。传闻其现藏于$Direction2之$LocName2。”

column1: He says, "I greatly value the ancient prayer books of the old Cluniac monasteries. $NamedOneName the hermit had one, and now word comes that he has died. This hermit was known to live $Direction2 of $LocName2.
column2: 他言：“吾甚珍视古老克吕尼修院之祈祷书。$NamedOneName隐士曾拥有一部，今闻其已逝。此隐士居于$Direction2之$LocName2。”

column1: He says, "I greatly value the illuminated gospels made centuries ago. $NamedOneName the hermit had one, and now word comes that he has died. The hermit was known to live $Direction2 of $LocName2.
column2: 他言：“吾甚珍视数世纪前所绘之彩绘福音书。$NamedOneName隐士曾拥有一部，今闻其已逝。此隐士居于$Direction2之$LocName2。”

column1: He says, "I must recover important debt notes from the $NamedOneName at $LocName. Just ... ah ... 'obtain' them from the $NamedOneName and return them to me, and the rich reward will be yours.
column2: 他言：“吾须从$NamedOneName手中追回重要债务凭证，地点在$LocName。只需……呃……‘取回’这些凭证交还于吾，丰厚酬金自属汝有。”

column1: He says, "My daughter has written some extremely indiscreet love letters. Unless they are recovered, the reputation of our family could be ruined. I believe the letters are being held by the $NamedOneName in $LocName.
column2: 他言：“吾女曾书若干极不谨慎之情书。若不追回，吾家声誉或将毁于一旦。吾信此情书现藏于$NamedOneName，位于$LocName。”

column1: He says, "The Scroll of $NamedOneName is my goal. It relates the history of ancient times. I hear that a monk tending a small shrine has it. The location appears to be $Direction2 of $LocName2.
column2: 他言：“$NamedOneName之卷轴乃吾所求。其记述上古史事。闻一守小圣所之僧侣持有此卷。其所在约在$Direction2之$LocName2。”

column1: He says, "The Scroll of $NamedOneName is my goal. It relates the history of ancient times; I must have it. I believe that a rich collector currently has it, the $NamedTwoName in the city of $LocName.
column2: 他言：“$NamedOneName之卷轴乃吾所求。其记述上古史事，吾亟需此物。闻一富商现藏此卷，乃$NamedTwoName，居于$LocName之城。”

column1: He says, "The Scroll of $NamedOneName is my goal. It relates the history of ancient times; I must have it. I have heard that a small creature living in a cave keeps it, as part of his dirty hoard. Travellers tell me this cave is $Direction2 of $LocName2.
column2: 他言：“$NamedOneName之卷轴乃吾所求。其记述上古史事，吾亟需此物。闻一穴居小兽将其藏于污秽巢穴之中。旅人云此洞穴位于$Direction2之$LocName2。”

column1: He says, "The Scroll of $NamedOneName is my goal. It relates the history of ancient times; I must have it. I have heard that it was buried with an old Duke, centuries ago. His crypt may be $Direction2 of $LocName2. Seek it there.
column2: 他言：“$NamedOneName之卷轴乃吾所求。其记述上古史事，吾亟需此物。闻此卷曾随一古公爵同葬，距今数百年。其墓穴或在$Direction2之$LocName2。汝可于此寻之。”

column1: He says, "There appears to be a plot to take over this city. We have intercepted a secret report going to the $NamedOneName in $LocName. We need you to steal prior reports and bring them back here. From their contents, we can deduce who the traitors are.
column2: 他言：“似有图谋欲夺取此城。吾等截获一份秘密报告，系送往$NamedOneName，位于$LocName。汝须窃取此前诸报告带回此处，据此推断叛徒身份。”

column1: He shows his thanks the only way he knows how -- money. Counting out some florins from the pouch at his waist, he pushes them across his desk to you. You pick them up -- they're good gold, after all! "Now," he says, "Is there further business I can help you with?"
column2: 他以唯一所知之方式致谢——金钱。自腰间钱袋中数出几枚佛罗林，推至案前。汝拾起——果然是纯金！“如今，”他说，“尚有何事吾可助汝？”

column1: He shrugs and begs to disagree. You argue the issues for a while, but he refuses to change his viewpoint. After a while it is clear that the issue is hopeless. You leave, having achieved nothing.
column2: 他耸肩，执意持异见。汝与其争辩良久，然其始终不改立场。久之，显见此事无望。汝空手而归。

column1: He shrugs and begs to disagree. You argue the issues passionately, but he refuses to change his viewpoint. After a while it is clear that further discussion is hopeless.
column2: 他耸肩，执意持异见。汝慷慨陈词，然其仍拒变初衷。久之，显见再议亦无益。

column1: He sits back. "I own several warehouses down in the slum area," he explains. "One of them has become infested with spiders. Normally this would present no problem, but I happen to have an unnatural fear of spiders. Slimy, crawling things with poison-dripping fangs, ugh!" He shudders. "So, for a fine fee of $DieRoll florins, would you like to rid the warehouse of its insect pests?" You reply ...
column2: 他靠坐椅背。“吾在贫民区拥有多座仓库，”他解释道，“其中一座已为蜘蛛所侵。寻常情况下并无大碍，然吾偏偏恐蛛。黏滑爬虫，口吐毒牙，唔！”他不禁战栗。“故而，若付以$DieRoll佛罗林之酬金，汝愿否为吾清理此仓之害虫？”汝答曰……

"So, for a fine fee of $Number1 florins, would you like to rid the warehouse of its insect pests?" You reply ...

column1: He slams the door in your face. Clearly you are not making a positive impression here in $PlaceName.
column2: 他砰然关上门，拒汝于门外。显然，汝在$PlaceName并未留下好印象。

column1: He smiles openly. "After the great deeds you have performed for our benefit, I would be ungrateful indeed not to give you all the help I can. However, there is little to tell you. We are out of the main stream of events. The nearest big town is $NearestCity, where I understand you are $PlaceAttitude."
column2: 他坦然一笑：“汝为吾等立下殊勋，若不全力相助，实为忘恩负义。然吾所知寥寥。吾等置身事外。最近的大镇为$NearestCity，听闻汝已在彼$PlaceAttitude。”

column1: He smiles slyly. "There is but little to tell of our humble lives. We work, live, and try to follow the scriptural sayings, especially '...ye shall be as the gods, knowing good from evil.'"
column2: 他狡黠一笑：“吾等生活平淡无奇。勤勉工作，奉行圣经教诲，尤重‘汝等当如神明，辨善恶。’”

column1: He smiles, "Excellent! Let us leave for $PlaceName at once!"
column2: 他微笑道：“甚好！即刻启程前往$PlaceName！”

column1: He smiles. "Oh, good! Bless you!" he takes $DieRoll florins from his pocket, and puts them on the table before you. "I always pay in advance," he says. "Here are the directions to my warehouse. Good luck."
column2: 他微笑道：“善哉！祝福汝！”自袋中取出$DieRoll佛罗林，置于案前。“吾素来预付酬金。”他说，“兹附吾仓地址，祝汝顺遂。”

column1: He smiles. "Oh, good! Bless you!" he takes $Number1 florins from his pocket, and puts them on the table before you. "I always pay in advance," he says. "Here are the directions to my warehouse. Good luck."
column2: 他微笑道：“善哉！祝福汝！”自袋中取出$Number1佛罗林，置于案前。“吾素来预付酬金。”他说，“兹附吾仓地址，祝汝顺遂。”

column1: He sneers openly when you come to ask the bishop for the promised relic. "You think that after the deeds you have performed here in my city of $PlaceName, you have the right to ask for rewards? Begone! Before I call the guard!" You leave, frustrated.
column2: 当汝前来向主教索要许诺之圣物时，他公然嗤之以鼻：“汝以为，于吾治下之$PlaceName立下功绩，便有权索取报酬？滚吧！否则召卫兵！”汝愤然而去。

column1: He sobs. "You cannot take IT from me? You cannot be so cruel? Take IT not! Use potions to blast and blind the monster. Use saintly blessings to protect against it. Use powerfully-forged weapons to penetrate its cursed armor, or handguns to shoot it dead. But take not IT from me."
column2: 他泣不成声：“汝岂能夺吾 {{ZQPIPE}}？汝岂可如此残忍？切莫夺之！当以药剂轰击，使其目盲；以圣恩庇护，免其侵袭；以神铸利刃，破其诅咒之甲；或以火枪射杀之。然切勿夺吾 {{ZQPIPE}}。”

column1: He speaks. "Ye cannot enter the dragon's lair. Touch the magic boulder and your hands burn off." When you look unsure, he sneers, "Go, try the stone and see." You eye the glowing stone in silence.
column2: 他言道：“尔等不可入龙穴。触此魔石，双手即被灼脱。”见你犹疑，他冷笑：“去罢，试触此石便知。”你默视那熠熠生辉之石。

column1: He stands, then, drawing a huge broadsword. His eyes narrow. "I see that I acted hastily," he says softly. "You are clearly not in league with this unfortunate fellow." He waves his sword invitingly.
column2: 他站起身，拔出一柄巨剑。目光渐厉。“吾方才行事鲁莽，”他低声道，“汝显然与此不幸之人无关。”他招手示意，剑锋指向汝。

column1: He stares at you, but you cannot tell what the richter is thinking. Finally he speaks. "You are to be held until you have paid $Money1 as recompense for your crimes." You are kept in the dungeon another day while the richter obtains the money from your banker. You are then freed.
column2: 他凝视汝，然汝难测其心意。终其开口：“汝须羁押，直至偿付$Money1，以抵罪责。”汝被囚于地牢一日，直待法官从汝之银行家处取回款项，方得释放。

column1: He steps back through a door and bolts it. Disappointed, you take the only other exit, back to the city streets.
column2: 他退入门后，反锁其门。汝失望之余，只得循另一出口，重返市街。

column1: He then gives you the Sword of War, a perfectly-formed miniature sword, only a finger's length. You accept it in trembling hands, then return to the courtyard.
column2: 他遂将战剑赠予你，此剑形制精妙，仅一指之长。汝以颤抖之手接之，复归庭院。

column1: He then leans back and his men return. He has returned to a state of joviality and seems unconcerned about the alarming confession he just made. You realize that the saint's influence may also help you convince him to surrender.
column2: 他随即靠回椅背，手下亦随之归来。他已重归欢愉之态，似乎丝毫不在意方才那番惊人的供述。你意识到，圣者的影响力或许也能助你劝其投降。

column1: He turns around and walks over to his cross. Wrapping his arms around it, he pulls it from the dragon's hoard of gold. But just as it comes free, there is a detonation of magic power. The cross flies from $NamedThreeName's hands and bursts into smithereens. An earthquake shatters the wall of the lair, and the dragon $NamedTwoName itself crawls through the hole!
column2: 他转身走向自己的十字架，双臂环抱将其从巨龙的金库中拽出。然而就在它被拔出的一瞬，一股魔力骤然爆发。十字架自$NamedThreeName手中飞脱，化为碎片。地震震裂了巢穴的墙壁，巨龙$NamedTwoName竟从破洞中爬了出来！

column1: He turns bright red. "Oh, you make an excellent point," he confesses. "Now I see the justice of your cause. You may rely upon me for unswerving support in these noble goals."
column2: 他脸涨得通红。“哦，你说得极是，”他坦言道，“如今我明白了你事业的正义。在这些崇高的目标上，你可以信赖我坚定不移的支持。”

column1: He turns to his men. "Take the prisoners away. The magistrate should deal with them, not us."
column2: 他转向手下。“把俘虏带走。该由地方官处置他们，而非我们。”

column1: He unlocks the small chest, carefully counts out $Money1, then pushes the coins across the table.
column2: 他打开小匣子，仔细数出$Money1枚，然后将金币推到桌面上。

column1: He ushers you into a small sitting room. Soon you are face to face with the most influential prelate in $PlaceName.
column2: 他引领你进入一间小客厅。不久，你便与$PlaceName最有影响力的主教面对面相见。

column1: He waves his hand and puffs of stinking vapor issue from the ground and begin to coalesce. Is this the "strength of heaven" of which he boasted? It looks like he is summoning demons!
column2: 他挥袖一指，地底喷出阵阵恶臭之气，渐渐凝聚成形。这便是他所夸耀的“天威”吗？看来他是在召魔作祟！

column1: He waves you back, then lets a young mother with two children and a baby board the boat.
column2: 他挥手示意你稍等，随后让一位带着两个孩子和一个婴儿的年轻母亲登船。

column1: He's not very friendly, and you just can't seem to draw him out. Eventually, you shrug and continue onward.
column2: 他并不友善，你无论如何也问不出什么来。最终，你耸了耸肩，继续前行。

column1: Head bowed in a long prayer, $ChosenTwoName implores the saint to help $ChosenOneName escape.
column2: 低头长祷，$ChosenTwoName恳求圣者助$ChosenOneName脱困。

column1: Head bowed, $ChosenOneName finishes the prayer and senses peace and contentment here. In $his mind's eye, $he can see the entire cave interior. It has a few wind-blown leaves scattered about, and nothing more.
column2: 低头默祷，$ChosenOneName 于此间顿感安宁与满足。在 你的 心中，你 能见洞穴全貌。唯几片风卷落叶散落其间，别无他物。

column1: Head bowed, $ChosenOneName intones the name of Saint Dismas. Suddenly an ethereal confidence fills you all. In moments you cross the $marketplace, easily eluding the guards.
column2: 低头默念，$ChosenOneName 念诵圣迪斯马斯之名。刹那间，一股超凡的自信充盈于你等心中。转瞬之间，你们便越过 $marketplace，轻易避开了守卫。

column1: Head bowed, $ChosenOneName prays intently. The silent night deepens and $he takes the hands of those next to $him, leading all in a quiet hymn. But it is to no avail. No miracle aids $him tonight.
column2: 低头默祷，$ChosenOneName虔诚祈愿。寂静的夜愈发深沉，你牵起身旁人的手，引领众人低声吟唱圣歌。然而无济于事。今夜并无奇迹降临于你。

column1: Head bowed, $ChosenOneName prays long and hard, but no aid is forthcoming. After an hour, $he stops. "I'm sorry, but my appeals go unanswered tonight."
column2: 低头默祷良久，$ChosenOneName 祈求不已，然无援至。一小时后，你 止步。“抱歉，今夜我之祈请未蒙垂听。”

column1: Hearing giggling behind a bush, you flush out a tattered man, his eyes rolling. "Fear not, my good man," says your leader.
column2: 听闻灌木后有窃笑声，你驱散枝叶，见一褴褛之人，双目翻白。汝之首领言：“勿惧，善人。”

column1: Hearing something suspicious, the turnkey searches your cell. He finds the embryo tunnel and is furious. He and his guards cruelly thrash you, and then you are dragged into another cell.
column2: 听到可疑声响，狱卒搜查你的牢房。他发现了胚胎般的隧道，勃然大怒。他与卫兵残酷地鞭笞你，随后你被拖入另一间牢房。

column1: Heartened, you take the $NamedOneName from its place and leave. Outside the sky is bright, the outlines of the old church walls are clear, and the Christian markings on the stones are legible once more.
column2: 心怀振奋，你从原处取下$NamedOneName，随即离去。室外天色明朗，古教堂墙垣轮廓清晰，石上基督教标记亦复可辨。

column1: Heartened, you take the $NamedOneName from its place and leave. Outside the sun is bright, the outlines of old church walls are clear, and the Christian markings are legible once more.
column2: 心中一振，你从原处取下$NamedOneName，转身离去。门外阳光明媚，古旧教堂的轮廓清晰可见，基督教的标记也再次清晰可辨。

column1: Hearts beating fast, you evade the remaining guards and race through the gate, quickly losing your pursuers in the twisting alleys of $PlaceName. You are safe now, but you can hear the gatehouse bell, signalling the city patrol to be on the lookout for intruders.
column2: 心跳如鼓，你避过余下的守卫，飞奔穿过城门，在$PlaceName错综的巷弄中迅速甩脱追兵。如今已安全无虞，但你仍能听见门楼上的钟声，警示城中巡逻队严加戒备，搜捕入侵者。

column1: Hearts pumping, you run down the street, shouldering aside bystanders and knocking over bales of goods. Dogs bark, cats yowl, and women point and shriek. Behind you, the guards come pounding in hot pursuit.
column2: 心跳如鼓，你沿街疾奔，撞开旁观者，推倒货捆。犬吠猫叫，妇人指指点点，尖声惊呼。身后，卫兵紧追不舍。

column1: Heaven does not respond to your pleas. The raubritter's men look on with interest as $ChosenOneName prays. One such loudly hopes that $ChosenOneName will fall into a fit.
column2: 天堂不回应你的祈求。劫匪的部下饶有兴致地注视着$ChosenOneName祈祷。其中一人更是大声期盼$ChosenOneName会突然发病。

column1: Heaven has blessed you with resistance to fire, enabling you to cross the fiery pool without serious injury. Unfortunately, even your saintly protection cannot give you full protection against the hellish flames of this area, and when you emerge from the other side, you are all a bit singed.
column2: 天恩庇佑，你对火焰有了抵抗力，得以安然渡过火池。可惜，即便圣洁护体，亦难全然抵御此地地狱之焰，待你从彼岸现身，仍不免焦痕点点。

column1: Heaven hears $ChosenOneName's pleas, and answers with great power. The horrors suddenly reel, clutch at their hearts and heads, and disappear into clouds of sulphurous smoke. The holy saint you invoked has sent them to their master in Hell.
column2: 天堂听闻$ChosenOneName的祈求，以伟力回应。那些恐怖之物骤然踉跄，捂住心口与头颅，化作一团团硫磺烟雾消散无踪。你所召唤的圣者已将它们遣返地狱之主。

column1: Heaven protects you from the heat and you feel no pain whatsoever. Not even your hair is singed. After a moment or two, you decide to climb out of the pit. Even the lava does not harm you.
column2: 天堂庇佑，你不受酷热之苦，毫无痛感。连头发也未被灼焦。片刻之后，你决定爬出深坑。即便是岩浆亦无法伤及你。

column1: Heaven will not respond. You're on your own.
column2: 天堂不会回应。你只能靠自己。

column1: Heavily, you get to your feet, sheathe your weapons, and clear your wits...
column2: 你沉重地站起身来，收起武器，理清思绪……

column1: Heedless of burns, you pull yourself up over the red-hot stone walls. Though badly injured, you soon reach the top.
column2: 不顾灼伤，你奋力攀上炽热的石墙。虽身负重伤，却很快抵达顶端。

column1: Her explanation, "In 1307, the king of France found out the truth, and destroyed the power of the Knights Templar throughout his lands. Soon other nations followed suit, until they were expurgated everywhere. Everywhere, that is, except here, in Germany, where they fled with the aborted embryo of Baphomet, their evil oracle.
column2: 她的解释是：“1307年，法国国王查明真相，摧毁了圣殿骑士团在其领地内的势力。不久，其他国家亦步亦趋，直至他们被逐出各地。然而，除却此处——德意志——他们携带着巴佛墨特那未遂的胚胎，即其邪恶的神谕，逃亡至此。”

column1: Her eyes almost seem to glow. "Your deeds illuminate more of the road."
column2: 她的眼眸几乎在发光。“你的功绩照亮了更多的前路。”

column1: Her eyes become dark and luminous. "I see starving villagers worshipping Satan in the hopes of getting food. I see power-hungry prelates invoking demons to aid their conquests. Evil power grows strong in a troubled and changing world.
column2: 她的眼眸变得幽暗而明亮。“我看见饥饿的村民在祭拜撒旦，只求得一餐温饱。我看见权欲熏心的主教召唤恶魔，助其征服四方。邪恶之力在动荡变幻的世界中日益强盛。”

column1: Her eyes close.
column2: 她闭上了眼睛。

column1: Her eyes seem almost to burn. "The final path is clear to me."
column2: 她的眼眸几乎灼烧。“最终之路已在我眼前明晰。”

column1: Her voice becomes a sing-song as she recites the litany of names and dates. You strain to hear and remember. She mumbles something, and you bid her speak loud and clearly.
column2: 她的声音变得抑扬顿挫，吟诵着一连串的名字与日期。你竭力倾听并铭记于心。她低声嘟囔着什么，你便请她大声、清晰地说出来。

column1: Here is a dark iron door. Carved in it are:
column2: 这是一扇黝黑的铁门。门上雕刻着：

column1: Here is a grim iron door inscribed:
column2: 这里有一扇阴森的铁门，上面刻着：

column1: Here you can enjoy the good food and pleasant conversation of the $Inn common-room. However, staying over a month will lead to problems. Meanwhile, you decide to...
column2: 在此，你可享$Inn酒馆的佳肴与畅谈。然若久住逾月，恐生事端。与此同时，你决定……

column1: Here you find the usual block, tackle, and crane to move goods in and out of the top-floor storeroom. You slide down to the tackle into a side street, then dash away as angry guildsmen cry, "Thieves, thieves!"
column2: 此处可见寻常的滑轮组与起重机，用于搬运顶层库房之物。你顺着滑轮降至侧街，随即疾步离去，怒火中烧的公会成员高呼：“贼子，贼子！”

column1: Here you talk to guild leader's mother about his father.
column2: 在此，你与公会会长之母谈及他的父亲。

column1: Heroically, $ChosenOneName kneels on the rolling deck, praying for aid. Suddenly, everyone is filled with the conviction that no matter what happens to the ship, you will not drown. Heartened, they redouble their efforts to see the ship safely through the storm.
column2: 英勇地，$ChosenOneName跪于颠簸的甲板之上，祈求援手。忽而，众人皆深信，无论船只遭遇何事，你必不会溺亡。士气大振，他们加倍努力，誓要护船安然度过风暴。

column1: Hesitantly, $ChosenOneName eats the fruit, which has a piquant, perfumed taste. When $he finishes, $he feels a deep throbbing in $his belly and muscles. Soon $he realizes that the magic fruit has permanently increased $his strength! The schrat, pleased, bobs his head up and down, then suddenly turns and runs off into the brush.
column2: $ChosenOneName 踌躇间，食下此果，味辛而香。你 食毕，腹中及四肢隐隐作痛。须臾，你 意识到此灵果已使你的膂力大增！施拉特喜形于色，连连点头，忽转身遁入林莽。

column1: High on a cliffside is the dragon $NamedTwoName's lair. Blocking the entrance is a red-hot boulder! While you gaze in consternation at this, a dwarf suddenly appears from nowhere, wearing a black iron cap.
column2: 峭壁之巅，乃龙$NamedTwoName之巢穴。入口处横亘一炽红巨石！正当你凝神注视之际，忽有一矮人自虚空中现身，头戴黑铁帽。

column1: High on a hill you see flickering tongues of flame. You draw nearer to see what is happening.
column2: 高岗之上，你见火舌摇曳。你走近一探究竟。

column1: High-pitched chittering noises come from overhead. You look upward in fright to see tattered black creatures sailing through the wind. Strange lightning illumines the horrors' sickly features -- they are witches! Riding pigs, iron stoves, and even three-legged stools, they fly.
column2: 尖锐的吱吱声自头顶传来。你惊恐地仰望，只见破烂不堪的黑色生物在风中翱翔。诡异的闪电映照出它们病态的面容——竟是女巫！她们骑着猪、铁炉，甚至三脚凳，凌空飞舞。

column1: His bandits carry you outside and pound you for some time, then leave you for dead. However, their beating was not completely thorough, You yet live.
column2: 他的手下把你拖到屋外，痛打一阵，便弃你于死地。然而，他们下手并不彻底，你还未断气。

column1: His eyes narrow. "Get them, you idiots!" he roars at the guards. "They're stalling." The guards brandish their weapons and come at you. You must fight.
column2: 他双目微眯。“把他们抓起来，你们这些蠢货！”他对卫兵怒吼道，“他们在拖延时间。”卫兵挥舞着武器向你逼近。你必须迎战。

column1: His eyes widen at the sight of your wounds and injuries. There is something about your look and bearing that causes him to gasp, "Oh, please step inside while I run for the abbess."
column2: 看到你的伤痕与创伤，他双目骤然睁大。你的神情与气度令他惊呼：“哦，请进屋稍候，我去请修女院长。”

column1: His face pales when you accuse his people of sorcery and witchcraft, and he orders you out of the hamlet. His anger is so obviously righteous that you feel quite guilty. You know you have sinned in thus making a false accusation.
column2: 当你指责他的族人施行巫术与妖法时，他面色骤变，并命你离开村庄。他的愤怒显然出于正义，令你深感愧疚。你明白自己因这虚假的指控而犯下了罪过。

column1: His gestures are unmistakable. The guards quickly and efficiently escort you out the door.
column2: 他的手势毋庸置疑。卫兵迅速而利落地将你护送出门。

column1: His guards move forward, trying to encircle your party. You...
column2: 他的卫兵向前逼近，试图包围你的队伍。你……

column1: His party rides off, leaving you poorer but wiser.
column2: 他的队伍离去，留下你身无分文却更加明智。

column1: His political opinions are unknown.
column2: 他的政治见解不为人知。

column1: His praise takes a more tangible form shortly thereafter, when a messenger from the $CityLordTitle arrives, requesting you to wait upon him instantly. You follow him, confident that some reward is in store...
column2: 不久之后，他的嘉奖化为更实在的形式：来自$CityLordTitle的使者到来，命你即刻前往拜见。你随他而去，心中笃定必有赏赐……

column1: His smile broadens, and the robber knight begins to chortle. "Oh, ho! So now you wish to fly the roost. Not so, my pretty ones. I have heard of you and your brave deeds. No doubt someone will pay a great deal of gold to ransom you from my dungeon."
column2: 他的笑容更甚，那名强盗骑士开始咯咯直笑。“哦，哈哈！如今你们想逃离巢穴了？休想，我的小可爱们。我早已听闻你们的英勇事迹。想必有人会出大笔黄金，来赎回你们于我的地牢之中。”

column1: His story about the evil Templars reminds $ChosenOneName of your dreams and prophecies. The Franciscan takes these quite seriously. "You are embarked on a quest of dire importance. If it helps, they said something about going from a Monastery $Direction2 of $LocName2 to a 'Sabbat' on $SabbatTime, $SabbatLocation."
column2: 他讲述的邪恶圣殿骑士的故事，令 $ChosenOneName 想起了你的梦境与预言。那方济各会士对此十分重视。“你正在踏上一场极其重要的探索之旅。若有所助，他们提到要从 $LocName2 $Direction2 的一座修道院，前往 $SabbatTime、$SabbatLocation 举行的‘萨巴特’。”

column1: Holding $his arms outstretched in prayer, $ChosenOneName intones words of praise and supplication to $NamedOneName. The saint answers, and you are each gripped by an invisible force which lifts you safely and swiftly over the city walls.
column2: $ChosenOneName 张开双臂祈祷，向 $NamedOneName 吟诵赞美与祈求之词。圣徒回应了你们，一股无形之力攫住你们，将你们安全而迅速地托举过高过城墙。

column1: Holding $his arms outstretched in prayer, $ChosenOneName intones words of praise and supplication to $NamedOneName. The saint does not answer, and you are forced to rethink your plan.
column2: $ChosenOneName 张开双臂祈祷，向 $NamedOneName 吟诵赞美与祈求之词。圣徒没有回应，你们不得不重新考虑计划。

column1: Holding $his arms outstretched in prayer, $ChosenOneName intones words of praise and supplication to Saint Reinold. The saint answers, and you find yourselves able to skim your way up, clinging to the surface even in spots where the wall is blank stone.
column2: $ChosenOneName 张开双臂祈祷，向圣莱诺尔德吟诵赞美与祈求之词。圣徒回应了，你们发现自己竟能贴着墙面向上滑行，即便在光秃秃的石壁处也能附着其上。

column1: Holding your armor over your heads, you carefully pick your way across the blood, drifts of hail, and patches of raw fire. Despite your care, you are all hurt a little by the fire and frozen a bit by the sleet and hail. However, your armor bears the brunt of the assault, as you see when you check it out on the other side of the cavern. It has been significantly reduced in quality.
column2: 你们举着盔甲护住头顶，小心翼翼地穿过血泊、冰雹堆和裸露的火焰。尽管如此，你们仍被火焰灼伤，又被冷雨和冰雹冻得发凉。不过，盔甲替你们挡下了大部分攻击，这一点在穿过洞穴后检查时便一目了然——它的品质已大为降低。

column1: Holding your breath as long as you can, you try to swim under the flames. But it is too far, too hard. You are forced to surface briefly amidst the flames and are all burned. Unable to see the far shore through the leaping fire, you turn around and are soon back where you began.
column2: 尽你所能屏住呼吸，试图潜游于火焰之下。然而路途太远，太过艰难。你被迫在火海中短暂浮出水面，全身被灼伤。透过跳跃的火焰，你无法看清对岸，只得转身，不久便回到了原点。

column1: Holding your breath for an unconscionably long time, you push forward under the flames. When you finally surface, gasping for air, you find yourselves near the opposite shore, and away from any flames. You climb out of the water and proceed.
column2: 你屏息良久，终于在火焰之下奋力前行。待你终于浮出水面、大口喘息时，发现自己已近对岸，远离了烈焰。你爬上岸，继续前行。

column1: Holding your breath for an unconscionably long time, you swim under the flames. When you finally surface, gasping for air, you find yourselves near the opposite shore. Unfortunately, poor $ChosenOneName was unable to hold $his breath the whole way, and was badly burned when $he surfaced for air, part way across. You climb out of the water and proceed.
column2: 你屏住呼吸，在火焰下潜游了极长一段时间。当你终于浮出水面大口喘气时，你们已靠近对岸。可惜，可怜的 $ChosenOneName 未能全程屏住呼吸，在半途浮出水面换气时被严重灼伤。你爬出水面，继续前进。

column1: Hollowly, the specter shrieks. "The robber knight $NamedTwoName is the bringer of woe. He slew my hounds. He slew my maidservant. He slew my manservant. He slew my new bride. He slew ME!"
column2: 幽幽地，鬼影尖啸道：“劫匪骑士$NamedTwoName乃灾祸之源。他屠我猎犬，屠我侍女，屠我仆从，屠我新妇，亦屠我身！”

column1: Holy $NamedOneName shines rays of light upon the dragon. Baffled, it wriggles into the sky and flies away. Heaven has saved you.
column2: 圣光$NamedOneName洒下光芒，照耀巨龙。它困惑地扭动身躯，飞向天空。天佑于你。

column1: Holy $NamedThreeName, patron saint of huntsmen, preserves you by suddenly filling your bodies with energy. You begin to race at top speed through the woods, and though the Wild Hunt continues its pursuit, you effortlessly continue your pace. You run for hours, but never become tired. Even trees and brush do not impede your journey, and seem to veritably melt away before you. Suddenly a great light appears in the east -- it is the dawn. With the sunrise, the Wild Hunt turns to mist, and you are saved.
column2: 圣$NamedThreeName，狩猎者的守护圣徒，以突如其来的能量充盈汝身，庇佑于汝。汝疾驰于林间，虽狂野之猎仍在追击，然步伐轻捷，毫不迟滞。汝奔行数时，终不觉疲乏。树木荆棘亦难阻汝途，仿佛在汝前悄然消融。忽而东方现一道大光——黎明已至。随日出，狂野之猎化作轻雾，汝得救矣。

column1: Hours later you awaken in intense pain. The green mist is gone, but everyone's eyes and lungs have suffered from the horrid stuff.
column2: 数小时后，你于剧痛中醒来。那团绿色雾气已消散，但众人的双眼与肺腑皆饱受其害。

column1: Hours later you awaken, bruised and bloody. Near you are the bodies of the guardsmen, as well as some trampled citizens. Everyone is stripped of arms, armor and obvious valuables. The rebel leaders are gone, of course.
column2: 数小时后，你醒来，遍体鳞伤，血迹斑斑。身旁是卫兵的尸体，还有一些被践踏的平民。众人皆被夺去武器、护甲及显眼的财物。叛首自然已不知所踪。

column1: Hours later, pain brings you back to consciousness. The villains seem to have botched the job and left you alive -- barely. Painfully, you bind up your wounds, slipping in and out of delerium the while.
column2: 数小时后，疼痛将你唤醒。歹徒似乎失手，只留下你苟延残喘。你强忍剧痛包扎伤口，其间时而清醒，时而昏迷。

column1: Hours later, pain brings you back to consciousness. You are still alive, but barely. Painfully, you bind up your wounds, slipping in and out of delerium the while.
column2: 数小时后，疼痛将你唤醒。你尚存一线生机，却已奄奄一息。你强忍剧痛包扎伤口，其间时而清醒，时而陷入谵妄。

column1: Hours later, you awaken in a midden heap. Coughing from the stench, you find everyone has been stripped of their arms, armor and obvious valuables. But you count yourselves lucky to be alive.
column2: 数小时后，你在一堆垃圾堆中醒来。因恶臭而咳嗽不止，你发现众人已被剥去武器、护甲及显眼的贵重物品。但你们仍庆幸自己尚存一线生机。

column1: Hours later, you hear a single set of feet approaching your door. A voice whispers, "Flee quickly!" and you hear the sound of a key turning in the lock. Then there is a rapidly diminishing patter of feet. If this is a trap, it is still your best chance. You leave quickly.
column2: 数小时后，你听见一阵脚步声朝你的房门靠近。一个声音低语道：“快逃！”随即传来钥匙转动锁孔的声音。接着是渐行渐远的急促脚步声。若这是陷阱，这仍是你最好的机会。你迅速离去。

column1: However, $ChosenOneName wisely says, "Our real enemy is the dragon, not the local folk, who have merely responded to that threat."
column2: 然而，$ChosenOneName明智地说道：“我们的真正敌人是那条龙，而非那些不过是对那威胁作出反应的当地百姓。”

column1: However, $NamedOneName is charming and charismatic. It takes you the rest of the hour to extricate yourselves from the conversation and take your leave.
column2: 然而，$NamedOneName 魅力非凡，风度翩翩。你们费尽余下的整小时，方得脱身告辞。

column1: However, everyone in your group takes a little damage from the sheets of fire still wafting over the ground and a bit frozen (numbing their agility) by the frigid winds that blow through this chamber.
column2: 然而，你们队伍中的每个人仍会因地面上飘荡的火舌而受到些许伤害，并被这间密室中呼啸的寒风冻得僵硬（削弱了他们的灵活）。

column1: However, people are bothered by travel difficulties and the rise in prices. "I wish those armies would finish the fight quickly," says one merchant, "unless travel and trade start up soon, my business will suffer."
column2: 然而，人们为出行困难与物价上涨所困扰。“但愿那些军队能早日结束战事，”一位商人说道，“若出行与贸易不能尽快恢复，我的生意就要受损了。”

column1: However, she seems steadfast in her repentance. You urge her to go to $NearestCity, and there seek out either a priest or abbess and ask for penance. She promises this once more. The next day you part, each on separate paths. You feel a lift to your spirits, a sense of favor and well being from a task well done.
column2: 然而，她似乎对自己的悔过坚定不移。你劝她前往$NearestCity，在那里寻访神父或女修道院院长，请求忏悔。她再次许诺如此。翌日，你们分道扬镳，各奔前程。你顿觉心旷神怡，仿佛因善事得成而蒙天眷顾，身心安泰。

column1: However, the bandits misjudged your constitution. That night, you awaken to the horrible pain of broken bones. You and the rest of the survivors lie tangled up among some dead trees on a steep slope. Extricating yourselves from the branches, you bind up the worst wounds and crawl away.
column2: 然而，匪徒低估了你的体质。那一夜，你被断骨之痛惊醒。你与其余幸存者纠缠在陡坡上的几株枯树之间。挣脱枝桠后，你们包扎好最严重的伤口，匍匐离去。

column1: However, the potion does produce one effect. A group of ragged but determined bandits leap from cover and charge, swinging weapons and screaming.
column2: 然而，药水确实产生了一种效果。一群衣衫褴褛却意志坚定的强盗从掩体中跃出，挥舞着武器，发出阵阵喊叫。

column1: However, the potion does produce one effect. A party of well-equipped soldiers springs from ambush and charges you, yelling the dread battle-cry of a private war: "Fehde!"
column2: 然而，这药水确实产生了一种效果。一队装备精良的士兵从伏击中跃出，向你冲锋，高喊着私战的可怕战吼：“Fehde！”

column1: However, the potion does produce one effect: a group of dirty but well-armed bandits leap from cover, give a wild battle-cry, and charge forward.
column2: 然而，药水确实产生了一种效果：一群肮脏却装备精良的匪徒从掩体中跃出，发出狂野的战吼，向前冲去。

column1: However, the witches hear the evocation. They draw weapons and rush towards you, determined to slay anyone who dares to interfere.
column2: 然而，女巫们听到了召唤之声。她们拔出武器，向你疾冲而来，誓要诛杀任何胆敢干涉之人。

column1: However, you are worried about those who did not escape. You wait until night, then creep back to the vicinity of the hut, looking for them. Unfortunately, there is no trace. Fate has dealt you a bitter blow.
column2: 然而，你仍为那些未能逃脱之人忧心。待夜幕降临，你悄然潜回小屋附近，寻觅他们的踪迹。可惜，一无所获。命运已对你施以沉重打击。

column1: However, you do feel that your reputation with the Hansa has improved ever so slightly.
column2: 然而，你确实感到自己在汉萨同盟中的声誉略有提升。

column1: However, you feel that you might learn something if you keep trying.
column2: 然而，你仍觉得若继续尝试，或许能有所收获。

column1: However, you now risk confrontations with hired thugs from the other side. Since you're associated with a cause, the only way to avoid this danger is to leave $PlaceName until the current political confusion is resolved in favor of one side or the other.
column2: 然而，如今你或将与对方雇佣的打手发生冲突。既已与某方势力相系，唯有暂离$PlaceName，待时局纷乱尘埃落定、胜负分明，方可免此险厄。

column1: Howling, the outlaws yell, "No surrender! No surrender!" and rain blows upon your defeated forms until they are convinced you are dead. They steal your food, ignore your money, and scamper into the wilderness.
column2: 哭嚎着，歹徒们喊道：“绝不投降！绝不投降！”并对你等败军之将痛下杀手，直至确信你们已死。他们掠走你的食物，无视你的钱财，随即窜入荒野。

column1: Howls echo through the night air. Wolves! And it sounds like they're on your trail!
column2: 夜空中回荡着狼嚎。狼群！而且听起来它们正在追踪你！

column1: Huffing and puffing, you labor along the ground while the gargoyles seem to veritably skim through the air. Soon they are diving on you -- there is no choice but to fight.
column2: 喘息着，你在地面上艰难前行，而石像鬼却仿佛在空中轻盈滑翔。很快，它们便俯冲而下——你别无选择，只能迎战。

column1: Humbly you request that the proud prelate instruct you in the history and lore of $NamedOneName, the cathedral's patron. He questions you for a few minutes, and finally states, "Your religious training and background are insufficient to properly understand the mysteries of $NamedOneName. I must deny your request. Be on your way."
column2: 你谦恭地请求这位傲慢的主教为你讲解$NamedOneName——这座大教堂的守护神——的历史与传说。他询问了你数分钟，最终说道：“你的宗教修养与背景尚不足以真正理解$NamedOneName的奥秘。我不得不拒绝你的请求。请离去吧。”

column1: Hunched-over shapes loom out of the shade. You have pushed the dwarf too far. You draw weapons and he claps a red hat over his head and vanishes. His minions charge forward and attack!
column2: 蜷缩的身影从阴影中浮现。你已将矮人逼至绝境。你拔出武器，他戴上一顶红帽，瞬间消失。他的爪牙冲上前，发动攻击！

column1: Hurling a Black Cloud potion, $ChosenOneName chooses $his target well. The peasants are engulfed by its fumes. They remain lost in the cloud just long enough for you to rescue the girl.
column2: 投掷一瓶黑云药剂，$ChosenOneName 精准选中 你的 个目标。农民们被其烟雾笼罩。他们被困在云中，恰好足够你救出那名少女。

column1: Hurling a Noxious Aroma potion, $ChosenOneName chooses $his target well. The peasants reel back, coughing and clutching at their stomachs. The horrendous odor devastates them just long enough for you to rescue the girl.
column2: 投掷一瓶恶臭药剂，$ChosenOneName 准确选中 你的 个目标。农民们踉跄后退，咳嗽着捂住肚子。那股恶臭令他们痛苦不堪，恰好为你争取到营救少女的时间。

column1: Hurling a Sunburst potion, $ChosenOneName chooses $his target well. The peasants reel back, stunned and blinded. The shock devastates them just long enough for you to rescue the girl.
column2: 投掷一瓶太阳爆裂药剂，$ChosenOneName 精准地选中了 你的 个目标。农民们踉跄后退，目眩神迷。这股冲击力使他们瘫痪片刻，恰好让你救出了少女。

column1: Hurling an Eyeburn potion, $ChosenOneName chooses $his target well. The peasants reel back, crying in pain and holding their hands over their eyes. The temporary blindness devastates them just long enough for you to rescue the girl.
column2: 投掷一瓶灼目药剂，$ChosenOneName精准地选中了你的目标。农民们踉跄后退，捂着眼睛痛苦地尖叫。短暂的失明使他们措手不及，恰好为你赢得了营救少女的时间。

column1: Hurriedly, you turn your backs and try to get away, but as you climb up the stones, the monster belches forth a huge sheet of flame, and you are all scorched. But then you are free, safe in the open air.
column2: 你们匆忙转身欲逃，却在攀爬石块时被怪物喷出的烈焰灼伤。然而，终得脱身，重获自由，置身于开阔的天地之间。

column1: I
column2: I

column1: I now rule $PlaceName, acting for the $CityLordName and the Emperor. You have been freed from misguided, heretical rulers. True Catholic priests are present once more. The Hussite heresy will not be tolerated. Preaching by anyone other than an ordained priest of the One True Church will not be tolerated. Long live truth, justice and the One True Church!
column2: 我如今统治着$PlaceName，代行$CityLordName与皇帝之权。汝等已从误入歧途、异端邪说的统治者手中获释。真正的天主教神父再度降临。胡斯派异端绝不容忍。除正统教会之神职人员外，任何人不得布道。真理、正义与唯一真教会万岁！

column1: IN
column2: 在

column1: INVESTIGATOR REQUIRED
column2: 需要调查员

column1: If this is true, and you find some proof, you could put the knowledge to good use.
column2: 若此事属实，且你寻得确凿证据，便可善加利用此知。

column1: Ignominiously, you turn over $ChosenOneName to the wicked villagers. In this way, you avoid a fight, but at what a cost! They chuckle and drag off $ChosenOneName.
column2: 你羞愧地将$ChosenOneName交给了邪恶的村民。如此一来，虽避开了争斗，却付出了何等代价！他们窃笑着，拖走了$ChosenOneName。

column1: Impatient, $ChosenOneName says, "Well, are we going to do anything about these bandits?"
column2: 不耐烦地，$ChosenOneName说道：“那么，我们打算对这些强盗做些什么吗？”

column1: Imperial mint, at night.
column2: 帝国铸币厂，夜色中。

column1: Imperial mint, in the daytime.
column2: 帝国铸币厂，白日。

column1: Impessed by this kind offer, you thank both the master and the guild, then leave.
column2: 感于此善举，你谢过主人与公会，随即离去。

column1: Impressed by the repute, charisma, and speaking skills of $ChosenOneName, the crowd melts away. Embarassed, the rebel leaders also depart.
column2: 为$ChosenOneName的声望、魅力与口才所折服，人群渐散。羞愧之下，叛军首领亦离去。

column1: Impressed with your offering, the priest says, "This will indeed aid us greatly."
column2: 牧师对你的供奉颇为赞赏，道：“此物确能助我等大忙。”

column1: Impressed, the sergeant of the guard says, "Of course you are an exception. Please use this sally port here." He leads you through a small passage in the gate tower to the outside.
column2: 卫兵长见状赞许道：“你自是例外。请由此侧门出城。”他引你穿过城楼中的小径，至外。

column1: In a bubbling confusion, your alchemical mixing goes badly wrong. A vast stink clouds the room.
column2: 在一片沸腾的混乱中，你的炼金调和出了差错。浓烈的恶臭弥漫全室。

column1: In a clear voice, $ChosenTwoName prays. Soon, a warm light engulfs the scene. Awed, everyone looks up to see a heavenly choir singing in beautiful tones. Gradually, the angels drift to earth, each leading a group of people away by a different path. As they leave, the sound and light fade, until the street is almost empty and normal.
column2: $ChosenTwoName 以清朗之声祈祷。须臾，暖光笼罩全场。众人惊愕仰望，只见天界圣歌悠扬。天使渐次降临，各领一众离去。歌声与光芒渐渐消散，街市几近空寂如常。

column1: In a convincing speech, $ChosenOneName promises the rebels a fair trial and no harm to their family or property.
column2: $ChosenOneName 以诚挚之辞向叛军承诺，必予公审，且不伤其家产。

column1: In a low, misty valley, what appeared from afar to be a monastery is actually a decrepit manor house beside a small lake. You decide to...
column2: 在幽深雾霭的谷地，远望似修道院者，实乃湖畔破败庄宅。你决定……

column1: In a matter of seconds, the party is reunited.
column2: 片刻之间，众人重聚。

column1: In a nearby clearing, you see an an old wooden shrine sheltering a cut stone altar. The roof and walls are weathered but sturdy. Fresh flowers adorn the statue of St. Mary within. From the shrine, a well-worn path leads to a small sod hut. An aged monk in a threadbare habit hobbles up the path to greet you.
column2: 近旁林间，一座木制旧祠庇护着石砌祭坛。屋瓦墙垣虽经风霜，却仍坚固。圣母像前鲜花簇拥。祠旁小径通向草庐。一位衣衫褴褛的老僧蹒跚迎上。

column1: In a ringing and eloquent speech, $ChosenOneName soon has the crowd chanting revolutionary slogans. With a dramatic swing of $his $VarString2, he leaps from the cart and starts the crowd moving toward the $VarString1. $NamedOneName falls in beside $him.
column2: $ChosenOneName 以铿锵雄辩之辞，旋即令群情激昂，齐声高呼革命口号。他挥动 你的 $VarString2，纵身跃下马车，率众奔向 $VarString1。$NamedOneName 走至 你 旁。

column1: In a ringing voice, $ChosenTwoName prays. The prayers become a kind of speech, and the nearby mob begins to listen. Soon the entire crowd is listening, rapt, as $ChosenTwoName prays for wisdom and forebearance. Soon the guard sergeant can begin to gently push forward. The crowd parts; you pass through peacefully.
column2: $ChosenTwoName 声若洪钟，祷告化作演说，围观者渐次倾听。不久，满场肃然，皆聆 $ChosenTwoName 祈求智慧与忍耐。卫兵长遂缓缓推进，人群让路，安然通过。

column1: In a short time you find the rector's office, where you can enroll for classes in literacy, Latin, alchemy and philosophy.
column2: 不久便寻得教务处，可报名参加识字、拉丁文、炼金术及哲学课程。

column1: In a stirring and rousing address to the crowd, $ChosenOneName inspires them to fashion battering rams. With you in the lead, the crowd surges forward across the $citySquare to the main doors of the $councilHall. Crossbow quarrels whistle by, but your brave example brings the rams crashing against the doors, which splinter on the second blow.
column2: $ChosenOneName 动人心魄之辞激励众人打造攻城槌。你率众越过 $citySquare，直抵 $councilHall 正门。弩箭呼啸而过，然你英勇之举终使槌击破门，二度轰开。

column1: In addition, it is said that $NamedThreeName will now be ruled by $NamedOneName, as part of the peace agreement.
column2: 此外，据闻作为和平协议的一部分，$NamedThreeName 将由 $NamedOneName 统治。

column1: In an impressive display of agility and climbing, $ChosenOneName reaches the top of the wall. $He throws down the rope and helps the rest of you climb up. In minutes, you're quietly running down an interior stairway into a narrow side street of $PlaceName.
column2: $ChosenOneName 以矫健身手攀上城墙。你 抛下绳索，助众人登顶。顷刻间，悄然沿内梯潜入 $PlaceName 的窄巷。

column1: In an instant it is all over. The girl is dead and neither you nor the villagers retain a reason to fight. You go your way, disgusted.
column2: 一时之间，一切已毕。少女殒命，汝与村民再无战意。愤然离去。

column1: In answer, the rebels defiantly hurl a potion from the upper story window. The vial explodes harmlessly in the street, but you note that they either have the aid of an alchemist, or are uncommonly well-equipped.
column2: 叛军针锋相对，从楼上掷下一瓶药剂。瓶碎街头，无害，然可见其或有炼金师相助，或装备非凡。

column1: In fact, many people expect the government to be overthrown.
column2: 实则，众皆盼政府倾覆。

column1: In fact, you are all substantially better. Any residual hurts will soon disappear. Furthermore, the servants are holding your arms and armor! You have no choice but to quietly leave, receiving your weaponry at the door.
column2: 实则，诸君状况大为好转。余痛亦将消散。更甚者，仆役已收缴汝等甲胄！别无他途，只得静默离场，于门外取回兵器。

column1: In fact, you suspect the Captain was irritated by your request, and irritating him too frequently could be bad for you here in $PlaceName!
column2: 实则，汝疑队长因汝之请而心生不悦，频惹其怒恐非善策，尤在此地 $PlaceName。

column1: In further conversation, you discover this so-called dragon is rampaging to the $Direction.
column2: 进一步交谈后，汝知所谓“龙”正向 $Direction 肆虐。

column1: In less than a minute, you are shoved ignominiously out a back door.
column2: 不到一瞬，汝被羞辱般推搡出后门。

column1: In minutes an angry innkeeper arrives. "Unholy scum!" he screams, "you stink of Satan!"
column2: 片刻，暴怒的客栈主人赶到。“亵渎之徒！”他怒吼，“尔等浑身散发撒旦之气！”

column1: In minutes you are stripped to nothing more than your clothes. Triumphantly the friar and his party continue on. You wait until they are safely out of sight, then consider what to do next.
column2: 片刻，汝仅存衣衫。修士一行得意前行。汝待其远去，方思下一步。

column1: In minutes, $ChosenOneName is devoured by the beasts. However, they are so preoccupied with their feast that the rest of you manage to escape.
column2: 片刻，$ChosenOneName 遭野兽吞噬。然诸兽贪食，汝等得以脱身。

column1: In minutes, $ChosenTwoName realizes that $NamedOneName is a complete idiot. Any treatment recommended by this fool is as likely to do damage as it is to cure.
column2: 不过片刻，$ChosenTwoName 便觉 $NamedOneName 实乃愚不可及。此等蠢物所荐之方，弊多于利，难保无害。

column1: In minutes, the door is battered in and the people surge into the building. Then wild cheering breaks out as some burly citizens drag the now-bloodied rebel leaders from the building and dump them at your feet.
column2: 片刻，大门被撞破，众人涌入。随即欢呼四起，壮士将血迹斑斑的叛首拖出，弃于汝足下。

column1: In minutes, the street is empty.
column2: 片刻，街市空无一人。

column1: In minutes, you are devoured by the beasts.
column2: 片刻，汝遭野兽吞食。

column1: In moments you're ushered into the city by a worshipful gateman.
column2: 片刻，虔诚的守门人引领汝入城。

column1: In ominous stillness, a bare-chested, black-hooded executioner waits stolidly atop a wooden stand in the city square. He bears a long and heavy headsman's sword. A large crowd has gathered to watch the action.
column2: 寂静之中，赤膊黑袍刽子手稳立市集木台之上，手执沉重斩首刀。围观者云集，静候行刑。

column1: In ominous stillness, a bare-chested, black-hooded executioner waits stolidly atop a wooden stand in the city square. He bears a long, heavy headsman's sword. A large crowd has gathered to watch the action.
column2: 寂静之中，赤膊黑袍刽子手稳立市集木台之上，手执沉重斩首刀。围观者云集，静候行刑。

column1: In response, you draw your weapons.
column2: 作为回应，汝拔剑相向。

column1: In silence you watch as he packs up his goods and sets forth.
column2: 默然注视其收拾行囊，启程而去。

column1: In the blink of an eye, you're in the street, flat on your backs.
column2: 瞬息之间，汝等倒卧街头。

column1: In the case of $NamedOneName, this person has been found guilty of high crimes punishable by death. Sentence was carried out at dawn today in the city dungeon. Justice was and shall be done.
column2: 至于 $NamedOneName，此人罪证确凿，判处死刑。今晨于城狱执行。正义已然伸张，亦将永续。

column1: In the clouds you see a terrifying apparition: a monstrous hunter riding a chariot. In seconds, the vast vehicle is overhead. The hunter leaps down and raises a huge spear to strike you!
column2: 云中现骇人幻影：巨猎驾御战车。转瞬，巨车凌空。猎人跃下，举巨矛欲击汝！

column1: In the darkness $ChosenThreeName disappears. $He never reappears, except in your prayers for the final peace and rest of $his brave soul.
column2: 黑暗中，$ChosenThreeName 消失。你 再未现身，唯存于汝祈求 你的 英灵安息之念。

column1: In the darkness and confusion, the soldiers weren't even sure whom they were fighting, and they assume that everyone in your group was killed. They drag your bodies safely out of the way and leave you there.
column2: 黑暗与纷乱中，士兵不知所战何人，误以为汝等尽殁。遂将汝等移至安全处，弃置于此。

column1: In the dead of night you approach the closed gate. A night watchman walks from window to window in the gatetower. On the walls to the left and right you see the dim forms of guards patrolling the battlements.
column2: 夜半时分，汝抵闭门之前。守夜人于城楼巡窗。左右墙上隐约可见巡逻的卫兵身影。

column1: In the depths of the night, you sneak up on the rear of the $councilHall. $ChosenOneName adroitly pries open a shutter. With a crash, you smash through the window and jump into the building, weapons ready.
column2: 夜深之时，汝潜至 $councilHall 后部。$ChosenOneName 巧妙撬开一扇百叶窗。一声巨响，汝等破窗而入，持械待发。

column1: In the depths of the night, you sneak up on the rear of the $councilHall. Unfortunately, $ChosenOneName is unable to pry off a shutter without making lots of noise. Before you're finished, the guards are alerted.
column2: 夜深之时，汝潜至 $councilHall 后部。惜 $ChosenOneName 无法无声撬窗。未竟事毕，警报已鸣。

column1: In the depths of the night, you sneak up on the rear of the $councilHall. Unfortunately, somebody makes too much noise and the guards are alerted.
column2: 夜深之时，汝潜至 $councilHall 后部。不幸的是，有人弄出声响，惊动守卫。

column1: In the distance you see what looks like a huge scab on the soil. Soon you are close enough to see it is a burnt-out forest. Foot-deep ashes make travel difficult; choking cinders fill the air. After an hour of toil, you pass through it.
column2: 远处可见地面似一大片疮疤。近观方知乃烧毁之林。脚深灰烬难行，呛人烟尘弥漫。历经一小时跋涉，方得穿越。

column1: In the distance, moving along the road, you see a large army.
column2: 远方，沿路行进者，乃一支大军。

column1: In the distance, off the path, you see a party of monks in white robes grouped around a stake. You look more closely, and discover their robes have a red cross.
column2: 远处小径旁，见白衣僧侣围桩而立。细察之下，其衣绣红十字。

column1: In the distance, well off the beaten path, you see a modest sod hut. There seems to be something sinister about it. You...
column2: 远离大道之处，见一简陋草庐。似有不祥之兆。汝……

column1: In the dream, the saint speaks of unholy sabbats that further the power of the witch cult. You hear that the horrible ritual will next be on $SabbatTime, $SabbatLocation.
column2: 梦中，圣人言及助长女巫势力的邪异安息日。汝闻其恶俗仪式将于 $SabbatTime、$SabbatLocation 举行。

column1: In the end, the girl is freed. Those who were convinced by your speech pack up and emigrate, hoping to return some day. The others are sullen.
column2: 最终，少女获释。受汝演说感召者收拾行装，迁居他乡，冀他日重返。其余则闷闷不乐。

column1: In the middle of the gathering is a large stone slab, with what appears to be dried blood on top of it. The witches are preparing an altar for summoning a foul demon of Hell!
column2: 集会中央有一巨石板，表面似干涸血迹。女巫正设坛，欲召地狱恶魔！

column1: In the morning, the night's dusting of snow melts, turning your beds to mud. Slowly, stiff with cold, you crawl out, brush off the worst of the dirt and dead leaves, and greet the day.
column2: 清晨，昨夜积雪融化，汝床化作泥泞。汝僵冷爬起，拂去污垢枯叶，迎接新日。

column1: In the name of the $CityLordName:
column2: 以$CityLordName之名：

column1: In the office of the Fuggers, the greatest banking house in Germany, the guards grip their weapons and watch you carefully. Eventually a junior clerk sniffs and asks your business, which is to...
column2: 在德国最大的银行——富格尔家族的办公室里，卫兵紧握武器，仔细打量着你。不久，一名低级职员嗅了嗅鼻子，问你有何贵干，而你的来意是……

column1: In the office of the Fuggers, the greatest banking house in Germany, you discuss your business with a senior clerk and...
column2: 在德国最大的银行——富格尔家族的办公室里，你与一位高级职员商谈正事，并……

column1: In the office of the Medici, the greatest banking house in the world, you respectfully discuss your business with a senior clerk. You...
column2: 在世界最大的银行——美第奇家族的办公室里，你恭敬地与一位高级职员商议正事。你……

column1: In the office of the greatest banking house in the world, guards grip their weapons and watch you carefully. Eventually a junior clerk sniffs and asks your business, which is to...
column2: 在世界最大的银行办公室里，卫兵紧握武器，仔细观察着你。不久，一名低级职员嗅了嗅鼻子，问你有何贵干，而你的来意是……

column1: In the quiet darkness, $ChosenOneName suddenly realizes that someone is kneeling beside her. She sees it is a handsome man in silk pants. Costly jewels gleam on his bare chest.
column2: 在静谧的黑暗中，$ChosenOneName忽然发觉有人跪在她身旁。她看见那是一位身着丝裤的俊美男子，裸露的胸膛上闪烁着昂贵的珠宝。

column1: In the quiet darkness, $ChosenOneName suddenly realizes that someone is kneeling beside him. It is a beautiful woman in a costly ermine cape. The cape falls open, revealing that she wears nothing beneath.
column2: 在静谧的黑暗中，$ChosenOneName忽然发觉有人跪在他身旁。那是一位披着昂贵貂皮斗篷的丽人，斗篷微敞，露出其下空无一物。

column1: In the quiet moonlight, you find an especially dark, soft area beneath some bushes. In minutes you are all asleep...
column2: 在幽静的月色下，你在灌木丛下找到一处格外阴暗柔软之地。片刻之间，你们皆已沉睡……

column1: In the rich, wood-paneled offices of the Hanseatic League, a deferential junior clerk inquires about your business. You...
column2: 在汉萨同盟富丽堂皇的木饰办公室里，一位恭谨的低级职员询问你的来意。你……

column1: In the rich, wood-paneled offices of the Hanseatic League, a snotty junior clerk pointedly ignores you for over an hour. But finally you...
column2: 在汉萨同盟富丽堂皇的木饰办公室里，一位傲慢的低级职员刻意无视你逾一小时。但最终你……

column1: In the shadow of the wall, $ChosenOneName utters a quiet prayer to Saint Reinold.
column2: 在城墙阴影下，$ChosenOneName低声向圣莱诺德祈祷。

column1: In the shadow of the wall, $ChosenOneName utters a quiet prayer to Saint Zita.
column2: 在城墙阴影下，$ChosenOneName低声向圣齐塔祈祷。

column1: In the shadow of the wall, $ChosenOneName utters a quiet prayer to St. Reinold.
column2: 在城墙阴影下，$ChosenOneName低声向圣莱诺德祈祷。

column1: In the shadow of the wall, $ChosenOneName utters a quiet prayer to St. Zita.
column2: 在城墙阴影下，$ChosenOneName低声向圣齐塔祈祷。

column1: In the shadows you look carefully for the night watch, then start doing your job -- posting the political handbills.
column2: 在暗影中，你仔细搜寻夜巡队，随后开始执行任务——张贴政治传单。

column1: In their swinish rage, the boars rampage through your goods, trampling you all with their sharp hooves, and driving away the horses. Eventually they leave, and you gradually return to consciousness.
column2: 在猪一般的狂怒中，野猪肆虐你的货物，用锋利的蹄子践踏众人，并驱散马匹。最终它们离去，你们渐渐恢复知觉。

column1: In their swinish rage, the boars rampage through your goods, trampling you all with their sharp hooves. Eventually they leave, and you gradually return to consciousness.
column2: 在猪一般的狂怒中，野猪肆虐你的货物，用锋利的蹄子践踏众人。最终它们离去，你们渐渐恢复知觉。

column1: In this "search", the people were not spared. Their whitening bones lie everywhere.
column2: 在这场“搜捕”中，百姓未能幸免。他们苍白的骸骨遍地横陈。

column1: In truth, her hut is poor, her possessions few. A crucifix hangs in a small, clean alcove in the corner. Even her blonde hair is turning white. She is certainly no witch, and no threat to anyone.
column2: 实际上，她的茅屋简陋，家当寥寥。角落里一间洁净的小壁龛悬挂着十字架。连她那头金发也已渐白。她绝非女巫，亦对任何人毫无威胁。

column1: In vain you look for the chance to buy or sell goods. This small domain is self-sufficient but poor; they have nothing to sell, and no coin with which to buy anything.
column2: 你徒劳地寻找买卖货物的机会。这片小领地自给自足却贫瘠，既无货可售，亦无银钱可购。

column1: In your mind's eye, you see clearly that the innocent victims have been moved by the saint to a nearby village where they will be safe. However, this quickly becomes the least of your worries. Your prayer was quite obvious, and Reinhard screams, "Slay the unbelievers!"
column2: 在脑海中，你清晰地看到无辜的受害者已被圣人迁至邻村，安然无恙。然而，这很快便成了你最不需忧虑之事。你的祈祷显而易见，莱因哈德高喊道：“诛杀异教徒！”

column1: In your new cell, there is no light at all. Daily, your new and sadistic turnkey comes by with a flickering candle to check the locks, poke you with a long pole, and toss you some moldy crusts. For water, you must lick ooze off the walls. Mostly you just sit in the darkness, unable to see your hand before your face.
column2: 在你的新牢房里，一片漆黑。每日，那位新来的残暴狱卒携一盏摇曳的烛火前来检查锁具，用长杆戳弄你，并抛掷几块霉烂的面包屑。饮水则须舔舐墙上的湿气。多数时候，你只是坐在黑暗中，伸手不见五指。

column1: Initial Card for Testing Only. Party has $Money1.
column2: 初始测试卡。队伍拥有$Money1。

column1: Initially hostile, the guards soon warm to your friendly approach. The sergeant confides, "We've all been edgy the last few days. Everyone's been on constant alert." As he lets you through the gate, you ask about the toll. "No toll is being exacted now, since only essential traffic is supposed to be given passage." He winks at you, "I think we can agree that you are 'essential' enough to be allowed inside."
column2: 初时敌意的卫兵，很快便被你的友善态度所打动。军士私下说道：“近几日我们都很紧张，人人处于高度戒备之中。”当他放你通过大门时，你询问通行费。“如今并无收费，因为只允许必要交通通行。”他朝你眨了眨眼，“我想我们可以认定，你‘必要’到足以获准入内。”

column1: Inside a hidden cabinet, you find a small leather-covered box with the leader's name on it.
column2: 在一处隐蔽柜中，你发现一只小巧的皮面盒，上面刻有首领之名。

column1: Inside is a small, child-size, silver-plated human skull; a few other bones that look suspiciously human; a closed jar full of a noxious potion; a blackened, wooden amulet with a different demonic symbol on each side; and a scrap of paper that has the date $SabbatTime marked on it.
column2: 盒内有一颗儿童大小的镀银人颅，几块看似可疑的人骨，一瓶装满毒药的密闭罐，一枚两面各刻不同恶魔符号的焦黑木制护身符，以及一张标注着日期$SabbatTime的纸片。

column1: Inside is a special ledger listing the leader's source of supply for goods, what he paid, and what he was paid for each. His sources were NOT guild workmen, but peasants from distant farmsteads. With this ledger, you have damning evidence against the guild leader.
column2: 盒内还有一本特殊账簿，记录首领的物资来源、支付价款及所得报酬。他的供货者并非公会工匠，而是远乡农夫。凭借此账簿，你掌握了足以定罪公会会长的铁证。

column1: Inside the $VarString1 the crowd celebrates their victory, now that the old $CityLordTitle is safely in the dungeon, along with his surviving henchmen. Soon trumpets blare and the $CityLordName arrives with his retainers. From the highest window of the $VarString1 he makes a stirring speech, pledging to the citizens an honest government and firm protection from all threats. He names $NamedOneName as his $CityLordTitle for $PlaceName. This announcement is met with loud cheers and more celebration.
column2: 在$VarString1内，人群欢庆胜利，旧$CityLordTitle及其残存爪牙已被安全囚禁于地牢。不久，号角齐鸣，$CityLordName率随从抵达。他自$VarString1最高处窗口发表激昂演说，向市民承诺廉洁政府与坚实庇护，抵御一切威胁。他任命$NamedOneName为自己的$CityLordTitle，负责$PlaceName事务。此宣告引来雷鸣般的欢呼与更盛的庆祝。

column1: Inside the $VarString1 the crowd celebrates their victory, now that the old $CityLordTitle is safely in the dungeon, along with his surviving henchmen. The leaders of the rebellion then sit in council and decide $PlaceName should be ruled by a $CityLordTitle for the $CityLordName. $NamedOneName is named the first $CityLordTitle by acclaimation. Then the celebrations continue.
column2: 在$VarString1内，人群欢庆胜利，旧$CityLordTitle及其残存爪牙已被安全囚禁于地牢。叛乱领袖随即召开会议，决定由一位$CityLordTitle代$CityLordName治理$PlaceName。$NamedOneName经一致推举成为首任$CityLordTitle。庆典随之延续。

column1: Inside, the courtyard is bustling with wagons, crated and baled goods, workmen, and monks overseeing everything. After an hour's wait, you are ushered into a busy business office, where the abbot's clerk directs operations from a large desk.
column2: 庭院内车马喧嚣，箱笼捆包堆积，工匠穿梭其间，僧侣 overseeing一切。等待一小时后，你被引入繁忙的办公区，方丈的书记员端坐大案前统筹全局。

column1: Inside, the courtyard is clean. A few monks and nuns saunter about in rich, velvet robes, talking and laughing. As you wait for an audience, you find the scene reminds you of a noble's court.
column2: 庭院整洁，几位僧尼身着华贵天鹅绒袍服，闲步谈笑。等候觐见之际，你恍若置身贵族府邸。

column1: Inside, the courtyards are peaceful and quiet. A novice monk leads you down quiet corridors to the abbot's clerk.
column2: 庭院宁静安详，一名初学僧引领你穿过幽静走廊，前往方丈的书记员处。

column1: Inside, you are very polite, as alchemists are famous for their arrogance. You ask about...
column2: 你甚为谦恭，因炼金术士素以傲慢闻名。你询问关于……

column1: Inside, you find crude sleeping pallets and various piles of trash. On a high ledge are several precious objects, including the $NamedOneName which you seek. As you take that down and secure it, you hear a voice behind you...
column2: 内部仅有简陋的卧榻与杂物堆。高处岩架上陈列数件珍品，其中包括你所寻的$NamedOneName。当你取下并妥善保管时，忽闻身后传来一声……

column1: Inspired by your daring victories over the guardsmen, the crowd takes heart and overwhelms the rest. Now you lead the cheering throng toward $VarString1.
column2: 受你勇挫守卫的激励，众人振奋，一举击溃余敌。此刻，你率众欢呼，直奔$VarString1。

column1: Inspired to a demonic frenzy, the fighting ability of the villagers is too much for you, and you are knocked unconscious. When you awaken, it is dark. You are tied up and a huge bonfire is raging.
column2: 村民们被恶魔般的狂热激发，战斗力令你难以招架，遂被击昏。醒来时天色已暗，你已被缚，篝火熊熊燃烧。

column1: Instantly all doors shut, leaving you outside. You fade back into the shadows, trying to escape before the night watch appears...
column2: 顷刻间诸门尽闭，将你拒之门外。你悄然退回暗影，欲趁夜巡未至之前逃离……

column1: Instantly recognizing you, the officer smiles.
column2: 官员一眼认出你，微微一笑。

column1: Instantly you dash away down a side street...
column2: 你旋即沿侧街疾驰而去……

column1: Instinctively you look up when the sun briefly darkens. To your horror, a winged monster flaps ponderously overhead, writhing in a particularly hideous way. It is the dragon that has wrought the havoc all around here.
column2: 当阳光骤然黯淡时，你本能地抬头。惊恐之下，只见一只翼状巨兽沉重拍翅，姿态尤为狰狞。正是那条四处作祟的恶龙。

column1: Invoking hymns of praise and adoration to the angels in heaven, $ChosenOneName attempts to goad the demon into making an appearance.
column2: 吟诵赞颂天使的圣歌，$ChosenOneName试图诱使恶魔现身。

column1: It doesn't take long for $ChosenOneName to convince the gullible thieves that you, too, are "minstrels of the sword and purse."  After exchanging a few lies and tall tales, they go off, searching for "good pickings" elsewhere.
column2: 不久，$ChosenOneName便说服了这些轻信的窃贼，称你也属“剑与囊之吟游者”。一番谎言与夸大之后，他们便四散而去，另觅“肥差”。

column1: It has been a brisk fight, but you have won. Unfortunately, you have the feeling you have not seen the last of the Hunt. Hellish hunting horns echo faintly behind you on the night wind.

column1: Life here in $PlaceName has been dull and uninteresting. Things seem so boring, you can't image how the citizens stay awake from one day to the next.
column2: 此地之生，$PlaceName 乏味无趣。万事如此沉闷，令人难解百姓何以日复一日不眠不休。

column1: Lifting $his voice, $ChosenOneName invokes the divine $NamedOneName. Beams of light shine down from the sky into the bosom of each attacking soldier. Feeling the peaceful spirit, they throw down their weapons and turn to one another in joy. While they are engaged in brotherly camaraderie, you try to climb the wall, but fail repeatedly. Giving up, you retreat from the city before the saint's effect fades.
column2: 抬起你的声音，$ChosenOneName祈请神圣的$NamedOneName。天际光芒倾泻而下，洒入每位进攻士兵的心怀。感受着这祥和之气，他们纷纷弃械，彼此欢欣相拥。正当他们沉浸在兄弟般的温情之中时，你试图攀上城墙，却屡屡失败。无奈之下，你在圣者之力消散之前撤离了城池。

column1: Lighted potion in hand, $ChosenOneName races to the front door and deposits $his deadly charge. $He dives under a cart as the potion goes off, blowing the door from its hinges. Instantly you are all up again, charging through the smoking hole into the $councilHall.

column1: Limping and winded, you still feel great satisfaction at the carnage around you. These evil man-wolves richly deserved this fate.

column2: 他紧张地回头望了一眼，城堡领主说道：“恐怖正徘徊于乡野。我亲眼见一整群牛被剖开肚腹，尽数毙命。另一处，一群羊已腐烂不堪。一股令人作呕的霉臭自其中升起，是我从未闻过的。”

They tie you up, then carry you bodily to the top of a nearby hill, where they build a huge fire and begin chanting hideous paeans of praise to entities of the underworld. By midnight, they have worked themselves up to a frenzy of bloodlust.

column1: Making your choice most carefully, you pick out a local girl who seems very attractive. To your surprise, she bursts into tears and falls to her knees in despair. "You have chosen well," says the village Schulz. "We could have done no better." Then, turning to the girl, he says, "Alas, my dear, tears will do no good. It is for your people and your family we do this."

column1: Near midnight, as the full moon disappears behind the clouds, you see a dark, cloaked figure appear on the roof of the guildhouse. Its arms outstretch like bat wings, and the person begins to rise into the sky. Suddenly the moon reappears and you recognize the figure as the guild leader himself! He is a witch, flying to one of their dreaded sabbats.
column2: 午夜将近，满月隐于云后，你见一黑袍身影现身于公会馆之顶。其双臂如蝙蝠翼般张开，缓缓升入天际。忽而月光重现，你认出此人正是公会会长！他乃巫师，正飞往那令人畏惧的巫术集会。

He is a witch, flying to one of their dreaded sabbats.

column1: Near the stream at the south end of the field, there is a satanic mockery of baptism. To the west, witches are riding broomsticks into the sky. To the north, cooks are preparing a feast for the assemblage, and to the east a large altar is being pieced together. You wander toward...
column2: 在田野南端的小溪旁，有一处对洗礼的邪恶亵渎。向西，女巫骑着扫帚升入天空。向北，厨子们正为集会准备盛宴，向东则有一座巨大的祭坛正在搭建。你漫步向...

column1: Needless to say, this isn't going to do your reputation or your cause very much good.
column2: 不消说，这对你名声和事业并无益处。

column1: Neighing in terror, your steeds break into a gallop. $ChosenOneName falls steadily behind. Suddenly, the dragon lunges with a gibbering howl. $ChosenOneName turns to fight but a vicious blow knocks $him down, armor rattling.
column2: 你的坐骑因恐惧而嘶鸣，撒蹄狂奔。$ChosenOneName 渐渐落在后面。突然，巨龙嚎叫着猛扑而来。$ChosenOneName 转身迎战，却被一记凶狠的攻击打倒，甲胄哐当作响。

column1: Nerving $himself, $ChosenOneName leaps up and holds a blade to the raubritter's throat. "$NamedOneName," $he cries, "in the name of the people you oppress, you are our prisoner!"
column2: Nerving 你自己, $ChosenOneName 跃起，刀锋抵住 raubritter 的咽喉。"$NamedOneName," 你 喊道，"以你所压迫之民的名义，你已被我们俘虏！"

column1: Nervously the Schulz whispers, "A fearful thing has happened. A village not a day's travel from here has been destroyed, its folk and buildings burnt to charcoal. Not even the goats escaped. We know not what horror is awakened in the land, but pray that heaven may preserve us."
column2: 舒尔茨紧张地低语道：“可怕的事发生了。离此不过一日路程的村庄已被摧毁，村民与房屋尽成焦炭。连山羊也未能幸免。我们不知何等恐怖已在世间苏醒，只祈求上天庇佑。”

column1: Nervously the Schulz whispers, "Wondrous and frightening things have happened. Beasts flee the forest in crowds, their eyes white with panic. Dogs howl at midday. At night, the sky is red-lit. Those who investigate these marvels vanish, not to be seen again. We pray that heaven may preserve us from these dread marvels."
column2: 舒尔茨紧张地低语道：“奇事骇人，纷纷而至。野兽成群逃离森林，眼中尽是惊恐之白。正午时分，犬吠不止。夜幕降临，天际染红。凡探其究竟者，皆杳无音讯。唯愿上天庇佑，免此诸般可怖异象。”

column1: Nervously the schulz whispers. "Two days ago I visited an outlying farm. The house was burst asunder, scattered across the land. Gouts of blood spattered the soil. A musty stink filled the air. Though dead corpses littered the countryside, no ravens or kites feasted on them. I fear that the terror may come to our village."
column2: 舒尔茨紧张地低语道：“两日前，我曾造访一处偏僻的农舍。房屋已支离破碎，散落于田野之上。鲜血四溅，染红了泥土。空气中弥漫着一股霉臭之气。尽管死尸遍布乡野，却不见乌鸦或秃鹫啄食。我担心这恐怖终将降临吾村。”

column1: Never despairing, you decide to ...
column2: 永不绝望，你决定去……

column1: Nevertheless, it is done. The witches' power over the innocents is ended: they cannot be killed once they are baptized.
column2: 然而，此事已成定局。女巫对无辜者的掌控已然终结：一旦受洗，他们便不可被杀。

column1: Nevertheless, it is done. The witches' power over them is ended; you know they are now safe.
column2: 然而，此事已了。女巫对他们的掌控已然终结；你知他们如今无虞。

column1: Next you consider the attitudes of clergy and the people in general.
column2: 接下来，你考量教士与民众之态度。

column1: Next you untie the friar, who had been forgotten in all the excitement. He is very grateful, and says, "Your faith and bravery rescued us all."
column2: 接着你解开了修士的绳索，他在一片喧嚣中被遗忘了。他十分感激，说道：“你的信仰与勇气救了我们所有人。”

column1: No answer is forthcoming in response to $ChosenOneName's plea for assistance.
column2: 对于$ChosenOneName的求助，未见任何回应。

column1: No matter how $he prays and elaborates upon religious formulae, $ChosenOneName can't hit upon the right formula to bring forth the demon. You decide to try something else.
column2: 无论你如何祈祷并详述宗教仪轨，$ChosenOneName仍无法寻得召唤恶魔的正法。你决定另辟蹊径。

column1: No matter how hard you run, the Wild Hunt's pack keeps gaining on you. Finally, you turn to fight, but you feel as though you would rather collapse from exhaustion.
column2: 无论你如何奔逃，狂猎的追兵仍在步步逼近。最终，你只得转身迎战，却只觉疲惫至极，几欲倒下。

column1: No matter how loud and long $ChosenOneName prays, the holy saint does not answer. The peasants stand back with amazement when $he begins his chant, but soon wink at each other and mock $him when nothing happens.
column2: 无论$ChosenOneName如何大声而长久地祈祷，圣徒亦不回应。当你开始吟唱时，农夫们惊异地退后观望，但很快便互相使眼色，嘲笑你，因毫无异象发生。

column1: No matter what you say to them, the peasants refuse to listen to you. "Fine words," one says. "But our homes and lives are endangered. What is the life of one strange woman to that?"
column2: 无论你对他们说什么，农民们都不愿听从。“好听的话，”一人道，“可我们的家园与性命危在旦夕。一个陌生女子的性命又算得了什么？”

column1: No slouch, $ChosenTwoName wields the $NamedTwoName with speed, versatility, and accuracy, striking the chosen target repeatedly.
column2: 不愧是$ChosenTwoName，挥舞着$NamedTwoName，迅捷、多变且精准，屡屡击中选定之敌。

column1: Nobody seems to remember $NamedOneName very well. "Oh, he was executed, you say?" is the usual remark.
column2: 似乎无人记得$NamedOneName甚详。“哦，你说他被处决了？”便是常见的回应。

column1: Nodding his head in agreement, the Schulz says, "Certainly I will help you. I will join your party so that I can assist you in times of trouble. My cousin is respected enough to take over my job, and I was thinking of retiring soon in any case."
column2: 点头表示同意，舒尔茨说道：“当然，我愿意帮助你。我会加入你的队伍，在危难之时助你一臂之力。我的堂兄足以胜任我的职务，况且我本就打算不久后退休。”

column1: Nodding solemnly, $NamedOneName says, "And now, for your well-earned reward." He hands you a weighty purse. Inside you find $Money1, as promised.
column2: $NamedOneName 沉重地点了点头，说道：“如今，是时候给你那应得的报酬了。”他递给你一只沉甸甸的钱袋。里面果然如约装着$Money1。

column1: Nodding, the priest says, "I will do what I can. Justice should never rob mercy." He leaves, and you feel sure he will do what he can to lessen your sentence.
column2: 神父点头道：“我自当尽力。正义不应夺去慈悲。”他离去，你确信他会尽力减轻你的刑罚。

column1: Nonchalantly, you stroll up to the gate while the guards are busy inspecting a wagonload of squealing pigs. Unfortunately, one guard looks up at the wrong time. Instantly, his fellows are on the alert, crossbows leveled and swords drawn.
column2: 你漫不经心地踱步至城门，而守卫们正忙着查验一车吱吱作响的猪只。不幸的是，一名守卫在不合时宜之际抬头望来。霎时间，他的同伴们警觉起来，弩箭上弦，刀剑出鞘。

column1: Nonchalantly, you stroll up to the gate while the guards are busy inspecting a wagonload of squealing pigs. Unfortunately, one of the guards looks up at a critical moment. Crossbows are leveled and swords drawn. The sergeant rumbles, "Halt!" You stop, abashed. "$PlaceName is at war," he hisses. "we have no need of useless mouths to feed. Begone!"
column2: 你漫不经心地踱步至城门前，而守卫们正忙着查验一车吱吱作响的猪只。不幸的是，一名守卫在关键时刻抬头望来。弩箭齐射，刀剑出鞘。军曹低吼道：“站住！”你尴尬地停下脚步。“$PlaceName已陷于战乱，”他嘶声道，“我们无需再添无用之口。滚开！”

column1: Normally, the most important man in $PlaceName is $NamedOneName, Captain of the City Guard. Almost equal to him are the wealthy burghers, led by $NamedTwoName and the $CityLordTitle, $CityLordName. The various merchants of $PlaceName are fairly wealthy, and almost as powerful.
column2: 通常，$PlaceName中最重要的人物是$NamedOneName，即城卫队长。与他几乎平起平坐的还有富有的市民，由$NamedTwoName及$CityLordTitle、$CityLordName所领导。$PlaceName中的各色商人亦颇为富有，权势几可与之匹敌。

column1: Norway and the Atlantic Ocean.
column2: 挪威与大西洋。

column1: Not enough gold and silver can be found in your purse: you don't have enough money for passage. You realize that you've automatically retraced your steps while pondering this misfortune...
column2: 你的钱袋中金银不足：你没有足够的旅费。你意识到，在思索这桩不幸时，自己已不自觉地原路返回……

column1: Notices and gossip in the city square, at night.
column2: 夜晚，城中广场上的告示与闲谈。

column1: Notices and gossip in the city square, daytime.
column2: 城市广场上的告示与闲谈，白日。

column1: Now close to the cross, $ChosenTwoName realizes that the priest derives his magical strength and apparent immunity to damage from it.
column2: 如今靠近十字架，$ChosenTwoName 意识到牧师的魔力与看似无伤之身皆源自于此。

column1: Now that the guards are out of action, you decide ...
column2: 如今守卫已无能为力，你决定……

column1: Now that the villagers have run away, you can take stock of the situation. This hamlet will not soon forget your action, and you must be wary of them in the future.
column2: 村民既已逃散，汝可审视局势。此村不久将铭记汝之行，日后须防之。

column1: Now that the witches have been thwarted, their evil spell is canceled. The dragon, for all its horror, is not under the witches' direct control. But you are given little time to gloat. With a crack like thunder, the side of the cavern splits open and the dragon $NamedTwoName itself thrusts its hideous head within!
column2: 如今女巫已被挫败，其邪恶咒术已然解除。巨龙虽令人惊恐，却并不受女巫直接操控。然而你无暇自得。一声雷鸣般的裂响，洞穴一侧骤然崩开，巨龙$NamedTwoName竟将狰狞的头颅探入其中！

column1: Now that you have accepted their pay and received a pile of handbills, you are unavoidably obliged to post them. This isn't hard: you'll do it as you move about the city.
column2: 既然你已收下酬金，并得了一叠传单，便不得不将它们张贴出去。此事不难：你可在城中行走时顺手为之。

column1: Now that you've been seen with the friends of $NamedTwoName, loyal supporters of the $CityLordTitle avoid you. Discovering the name and address of this aristocrat will require more work.
column2: 如今，你已与$NamedTwoName的友人同出同入，$CityLordTitle的忠实支持者纷纷避而远之。欲探得此贵族之名址，尚需费一番周折。

column1: Now the villagers are dancing, enacting obscene rites. Soon you will be sacrificed to their dark deity.
column2: 如今，村民们正在跳舞，举行着淫秽的仪式。很快，你将被献祭给他们的黑暗神祇。

column1: Now unarmed, you immediately begin fashioning crude clubs from deadfall.
column2: 如今手无寸铁，你立刻开始用倒下的树木制作简陋的棍棒。

column1: Now weaponless, $ChosenOneName ponders this unexpected and unattractive turn of fate's wheel.
column2: 如今手无寸铁，$ChosenOneName 思忖这命运之轮出乎意料且令人不悦的转折。

column1: Now you are before the city's monastery. Brown-clad monks potter about the grounds, tending small gardens, hurrying to the chapel for prayer, and just strolling about.
column2: 如今你立于城中修道院之前。身着褐袍的修士们在院中忙碌，或侍弄小园，或匆匆赶往小教堂祈祷，或只是悠然漫步。

column1: Now you arrive at the city hospice, in the daytime. Here nuns, physicians, and lay healers tend the sick and afflicted.
column2: 如今你于白日抵达城中施疗所。此处修女、医师与俗世医者照料病患与受苦之人。

column1: Now you have the blonde witch at your mercy. Trembling with fear, in return for her life she offers to...
column2: 如今你已将金发女巫置于掌下。她因恐惧而颤抖，为求一命，她愿...

column1: Now you stand alone on their hilltop. Here is their unhallowed place of worship. If you destroy it, the evil will be forced to depart.
column2: 如今你孤身立于他们的山顶。此处乃其亵渎之祭坛。若将其毁去，邪祟必将退散。

column1: Now your only recourse is to stand and fight.
column2: 如今你唯有挺身而战。

column1: Now, Baphomet creates a great magic and a huge glowing star falls into the lake. He says, "The star is Wormwood, that all the water shall become bitter, and everyone who drinks of the water shall die."
column2: 如今，巴佛墨特施下大法术，一颗巨大炽亮之星坠入湖中。他道：“此星名曰苦艾，凡饮其水者皆将变苦，饮者必死。”

column1: O,  HE  SAW  FOUR  STARS  IN  HEAVEN  SINGING  ALLELUIA
column2: 哦，他见天上四星齐唱哈利路亚。

column1: ONE HEAD INVARIABLY SPEAKS TRUTH.
column2: 其一恒言真。

column2: 其一恒言假。

column2: 其一：铜不可开此门。

column1: Obsequious clerks put you next on the list, and within an hour you are ushered into the council chamber. The $CityLordTitle is impressed.
column2: 阿谀奉承的书吏将你列于首位，不过一小时，便引你入议事厅。$CityLordTitle为之动容。

column2: 显然，你的恶名使你成为不速之客。你决定……

column2: 果然！立方体！你按下正确数字，门滑然而开。前路已通。一名矮小身影拦住去路，似欲与你交谈。

column2: 果然！斐波那契数列（后项为前两项之和）！你答对，铁门豁然洞开。一矮小身影走出，与你交谈。
