column2: 果然！你悟得问题即线索！你答对，铁门豁然洞开。一矮小身影走出，与你交谈。

column1: Of course, proof would be the ruin of this person. Pondering this, you realize that threatening to reveal the secret might be quite handy!
column2: 果然，证据反会害了此人。思及于此，你觉威胁揭密或许大有用处！

column1: Of course, sometimes they ignore even your proof. In such a case, revealing their shame may cause their replacement. Unfortunately, there's no way to predict the opinions of the new leader.
column2: 果然，有时他们连你的证据也置若罔闻。如此，揭露其耻辱或能促其更替。可惜，新主之见难测。

column1: Offering some refreshment to you, he begins by saying, "Let us reason together."
column2: 他为你奉上茶点，开口道：“且共论之。”

column1: Ogre: "I am not Hoder."
column2: 巨魔：“吾非霍德尔。”

column1: Ominously, the villagers produce weapons. Furious, you curse them. "It is simple, noble sirs," says the Schulz. "We give fair maids to the rapacious dragon $NamedTwoName. In return, it refrains from destroying our village. Neighboring hamlets, too squeamish for such measures, are now gone. Your opportune arrival has spared one of our women, for which we thank you."
column2: 村民阴沉地取出武器。你怒斥众人。“诸位贵人，此事甚明，”舒尔茨道，“我等献贞女于贪婪巨龙$NamedTwoName，彼则免毁我村。邻近村落因不堪此举，尽已覆灭。幸尔等及时赶到，救下一女，谨此致谢。”

column1: On a small side street, behind a tall gate, you all listen quietly. The thugs have lost track of you. Quickly you slip away down the back streets.
column2: 在一条僻巷深处，高墙之后，你们静静聆听。歹徒已失踪迹。你们迅速沿后街悄然离去。

column1: On patrol, $ChosenOneName spots a party of soldiers headed toward the camp. Alas, someone has discovered your presence here. You...
column2: 巡逻时，$ChosenOneName发现一队士兵正朝营地而来。唉，有人已察觉你们在此。你……

column1: On the door are a group of knobs, each labeled with a letter. Which knob should you press? The wrong conclusion may release a dwarf trap! You consider carefully, then answer...
column2: 门上一组旋钮，各标一字。当按何钮？误判恐触发矮人陷阱！你细思后答……

column1: On the door are different plates, each with numbers. Which should you touch? The wrong choice could release a terrible doom trap! You consider carefully, then touch...
column2: 门上各有数字牌。当触何牌？选错恐引致命机关！你慎思后触……

column1: On the door are embossed four statements:
column2: 门上镌刻四句：

column2: 门上浮雕着六句箴言：

column1: On the door are six knobs, each embossed with a name. Which knob opens the door? Desperately you try to remember the ancient Scriptures before you press...
column2: 门上刻着六个名字的旋钮。究竟哪个旋钮能打开这扇门？你拼命回想古老的经文，然后才敢按下……

column1: On the door are three metal faces: lead, gold, silver. As you ponder, the lead face speaks, "Pape mimer aleppe."
column2: 门上三金属面：铅、金、银。你思索间，铅面开口：“帕佩米默阿莱佩。”

column1: On the floor are six statements and three metal knobs, each of a different metal. The statements are:
column2: 地上六句，配三金属旋钮，各色不同。句曰：

column1: On the fourth day, $he says, "I believe the army is now past. We can continue safely."
column2: 第四日，你道：“想必大军已过，可安然前行。”

column1: On the next day the abbess visits you once, nods, and leaves.
column2: 次日，修女院长来访一次，颔首而去。

column1: On the road, you see a splendidly-dressed man. He accosts you, saying, "I am $NamedOneName, royal messenger to his majesty the Holy Roman Emperor and King of all the Germans. I must ride to $PlaceName at once, but my escort was tardy. You look like worthy folk. Please accompany me until I find a more suitable escort."
column2: 路上，你遇一华服男子。他上前道：“吾乃$NamedOneName，神圣罗马皇帝兼德意志诸王之使者。须即赴$PlaceName，然随从迟到。观汝等气度不凡，愿同行至寻得更适随从。”

column1: Once again you are in the chamber with the rune-throne. The dwarf is standing on the seat, arms crossed. He looks extremely angry.
column2: 再次置身符文宝座之室。矮人立于座上，双臂交叉，神色极怒。

column1: Once inside the confessional, $ChosenOneName speaks to the village priest, and tells him all $his sins. But the priest asks $him to do very peculiar acts as penance, saying, "To simulate the passion of our Lord, you must slowly kill a small animal. Then you must recite ten prayers backwards! Finally, in celebration of your remission of sin, you must drink so much sacramental wine that you fall unconscious. I can provide the wine."
column2: 进入告解室后，$ChosenOneName向村牧坦白所有你的罪孽。然牧师却命你行怪异之忏悔：“为效仿吾主受难，汝须缓缓杀一小兽，再倒背十祷文！末了，为庆赦罪，须饮圣酒至昏厥。酒由我提供。”

column1: Once more you see a short entity step up. But this time it is clearly no dwarf! Its sinewy form and gross tusks mark it as a kobold, one of the sinister mine goblins. It gibbers to you,
column2: 又见一矮小身影上前。然此次绝非矮人！其筋骨毕露，獠牙粗壮，分明是矿坑妖精——地精之一。它对你叽咕，

column1: Once more you see a short entity step up. But this time it is clearly no dwarf! Its sinewy form and gross tusks mark it as a kobold, one of the sinister mine goblins. It glibbers to you,
column2: 又见一矮小身影上前。然此次绝非矮人！其筋骨毕露，獠牙粗壮，分明是矿坑妖精——地精之一。它对你喋喋，

column1: Once safely in your room, you wait until the tower quiets down, then go to the door and listen. You hear two guards talking.
column2: 安抵房内，待塔楼寂静，遂至门侧倾听。闻两守卫低语。

column1: Once the brutish peasants have fled, you can take stock of the situation. Their attempt to kidnap $ChosenOneName was deadly in its intent. However, you should not forget that your real enemy is the dragon, not the local folk, who have merely responded in an unacceptable manner to the true threat.
column2: 待暴民逃去，方可审视局势。彼等劫持$ChosenOneName之举意在夺命。然勿忘，汝之敌实为巨龙，而非仅以不当方式应对真危的乡民。

column1: Once through the gate, you see a gigantic lake before you. You must swim across it to get to the other side. While you are considering what to do, suddenly the water's surface bursts into flames. Patches of flame run back and forth over the surface of the water. You look on with horror, then decide you must ...
column2: 入门后，眼前一片浩渺湖泊。须泅渡方达彼岸。正踌躇间，水面忽燃烈焰，火斑纵横。汝惊骇之余，决意……

column1: Once you are beaten, the Wild Hunter arrives to gloat. "My hounds must have supper. I believe I shall give them $ChosenOneName!" The monstrous dogs pounce upon and hideously devour $him while the Hunter roars with laughter. Once the evil feast is done, he chortles, "I have $ChosenOneName's life and soul. My task is complete for now."
column2: 汝被击败后，狂猎者前来嘲弄。“吾犬须饱餐。吾拟赐其$ChosenOneName！”恶犬扑上，惨烈吞食你，猎者狂笑不止。盛宴既毕，他狞笑道：“吾已得$ChosenOneName之性命与灵魂，任务暂告一段落。”

column1: Once you are defeated, the alchemist immediately searches you all and takes any remaining alchemical components and potions. You are then driven away by his guards.
column2: 一旦你被击败，炼金术士便会立即搜查你们所有人，并夺走所有剩余的炼金材料与药剂。随后，他便会让卫兵将你驱逐。

column1: Once you reach the top of the hill, you see a blackened stone altar that is clearly a place of devotion to the demons of Hell. You should purge it. If you succeed, the cycle of evil which holds the area in thrall will be broken.
column2: 抵达山顶后，你看见一座已被熏黑的石祭坛，显然是供奉地狱恶魔之所。你应当将其净化。若成功，则束缚此地的邪恶轮回将被打破。

column1: One calls out "We'll need help if we're to finish for the ceremony tomorrow." Another spies you watching, and trots over.
column2: 一人喊道：“若要赶在明日仪式前完工，还需人手相助。”另一人发现你在旁观望，便小跑过来。

column1: One guard guffaws at this spectacle, but the sergeant's face suddenly lights up.
column2: 一名守卫见此情景不禁大笑，但军曹的脸色却骤然一亮。

column1: One last task remains: there upon the altar is a large book, bound by a seal of red cloth. The legends say that before you may confront the Ultimate Evil, the seals must be broken. This tome bears the first.
column2: 还有一项任务尚未完成：祭坛之上摆放着一本巨册，以红布封缄。传说称，在与终极之恶对决之前，须先破除这些封印。此书便是第一道封印。

column1: One man smiles at the mention of the name $NamedOneName. "Every town has one," he says. "A crazy man whose father gave him too much money. Ours is harmless enough, and his fears earn florins for others, so no one complains. He's afraid of his own shadow, and is constantly hiring people to protect him for a day or so."
column2: 一人闻及$NamedOneName之名，微微一笑。“每座城镇皆有此人，”他说，“一个父亲给了他太多钱财的疯子。我们这里的还算无害，他的恐惧反倒为他人赚得金币，故无人抱怨。他唯恐影踪，终日雇人护卫一二日。”

column1: One member of your party keeps the strangers busy while $ChosenOneName quietly invokes heavenly aid. A beam of light breaks through the cloud cover above, and the man in red is suddenly much more friendly.
column2: 队伍中一人引开陌生人，而$ChosenOneName则悄然祈求天佑。一道光束穿透云层，那身着红衣之人顿时和颜悦色。

column1: One of the guild masters receives you, saying, "I am asked to extend the guild's hand of friendship to such impressive travellers. If you desire, I am available to tutuor you in $Text1 at $Money1 per day. If you will take up residence at the inn, $Inn, I will be available every day as a trainer."
column2: 一位公会首领接见你们，说道：“谨代表公会向诸位卓绝的旅人伸出友谊之手。若有需要，我愿每日教授$Text1，收费$Money1。若诸位下榻于客栈$Inn，我每日皆可担任导师。”

column1: One of the prelates deigns to speak with you. "Our great $cathedral is famed throughout the land. Our chapel is specially dedicated to the wondrous $NamedTwoName, but we hoard no holy relics here."
column2: 一位主教纡尊降贵与你交谈：“吾等宏伟的$cathedral享誉四方。吾等礼拜堂专祀奇迹般的$NamedTwoName，然此处并无圣物珍藏。”

column1: One of the prelates deigns to speak with you. "Our great $cathedral is famed throughout the land. The entire building is specially dedicated to and blessed by the wondrous $NamedTwoName. In addition, we are honored by our possession of the sacred $NamedOneName here, which is brought out at special sacraments and celebrations."
column2: 一位主教纡尊降贵与你交谈：“吾等宏伟的$cathedral享誉四方。整座建筑皆专祀并蒙$NamedTwoName赐福。此外，吾等亦因珍藏圣物$NamedOneName而倍感荣耀，每逢特殊圣礼与庆典方予取出。”

column1: One of the prelates deigns to speak with you. "Our great $cathedral is famed throughout the land. We have a chapel dedicated to the wondrous $NamedTwoName. And of course, we have many holy relics, including the sacred $NamedOneName, brought out on special sacraments and celebrations."
column2: 一位主教纡尊降贵与你交谈：“吾等宏伟的$cathedral享誉四方。设有专祀$NamedTwoName的礼拜堂，且拥有多处圣物，其中包括每逢特殊圣礼与庆典方出的圣物$NamedOneName。”

column1: One of the prelates deigns to speak with you. "Our great $cathedral is famed throughout the land. We honor many saints, but emphasize none. As testament to our greatness, we have many holy relics, including the sacred $NamedOneName. It is brought out only at special sacraments and celebrations."
column2: 一位主教纡尊降贵与你交谈：“吾等宏伟的$cathedral享誉四方。吾等敬奉众圣，然未偏重任何一位。作为吾等伟业之证，吾等拥有多处圣物，其中即有圣物$NamedOneName，仅于特殊圣礼与庆典时取出。”

column1: One of the prelates deigns to speak with you. "Our great $cathedral is famed throughout the land. We honor many saints, but emphasize none. Nor do we hoard holy relics. The building itself is sacred enough."
column2: 一位主教纡尊降贵与你交谈：“吾等宏伟的$cathedral享誉四方。吾等敬奉众圣，然未偏重任何一位。亦无圣物珍藏。建筑本身已足为圣地。”

column1: One of the prelates deigns to speak with you. "Our great $cathedral is famed throughout the land. We honor many saints, but place none over any other. We are especially honored by the fact that we have the sacred $NamedOneName here, which is brought out at special sacraments and celebrations."
column2: 一位主教纡尊降贵与你交谈：“吾等宏伟的$cathedral享誉四方。吾等敬奉众圣，然未凌驾于任何一位之上。吾等尤为荣幸，因珍藏圣物$NamedOneName，每逢特殊圣礼与庆典方予取出。”

And of course, as one of the most important cathedrals anywhere, it is only fitting that we have more than one holy relic. We are especially proud of our possession of the sacred $NamedOneName, which is brought out only for special sacrements and celebrations."

column1: One of the rebels emerges under a flag of truce. After a discussion of terms, they agree to let you escort them to the $VarString1, where they will be held until the trial.
column2: 一名叛军打着休战旗号现身。经一番商议，他们同意让你护送至$VarString1，在那里等待审判。

column1: One of the travellers, a woman, says, "A pity Klaus is ill."
column2: 一名女旅客说道：“可惜克劳斯病了。”

column1: Only one of you is agile enough to avoid the blast of flame from the dragon. The monster withdraws after venting its rage, and you take stock of the situation.
column2: 众人之中，唯有你身手敏捷，堪避龙焰之袭。怪物发泄怒气后退去，你遂审视局势。

column1: Only one statement is wholly true. Only one knob opens the door. Which?
column2: 唯有一语全真，唯有一钮可开此门。是何？

column1: Only then do you realize the truth. The person you have rescued is a nude woman! You look at her in surprise and liquid brown eyes look back. She smiles and perfect white teeth flash in the shadows.
column2: 此时你方始惊觉真相：你所救者乃一裸女！你诧异地望向她，一双盈盈褐色眸子回视。她嫣然一笑，洁白齿露于暗影之中。

column1: Ooo, ooo, aaah? Is this some type of dwarf joke? In any case, five metal knobs are on the door, each bearing a number. Pressing the wrong knob may spring a trap! You ponder, then press...
column2: 哦哦，啊？这是矮人的玩笑吗？无论如何，门上共有五枚金属旋钮，各标数字。按错旋钮恐触发机关！你沉思片刻，然后按下……

column1: Opening the chest, you expose a carefully-wrapped stone crucifix of great size, carved in the style of old. It is far too heavy to lift without breaking, and you briefly wonder how it got here.
column2: 打开宝箱，露出一块硕大的石制十字架，包扎严实，雕工古朴。其重无比，徒手难举，你不禁思索它如何至此。

column1: Opening the gate, you see a large banquet hall. A weird buzzing noise fills the air. Suddenly, a fist-sized creature whirs through the air and lands on the wall nearby. You inspect it closely, your gorge rising. It has a grasshopper-like body, but possesses a scorpion-like sting. Its head looks like a human woman's, with long flowing hair. It gibbers in a tiny voice. Its thorax and abdomen are protected by miniature brass armor. In horror, you crush the monster beneath your boot. In response, the buzzing sound intensifies and swarms of the demon-locusts rise to the attack.
column2: 推开大门，映入眼帘的是一座宏大的宴会厅。空气中弥漫着诡异的嗡鸣。忽有一只拳头大小的生物呼啸而过，落在近旁墙上。你细察之下，顿生厌恶：其躯似蚱蜢，尾端却如蝎刺。头部宛如女子，长发飘逸。它以细弱之声叽喳，胸腹覆以铜甲。你惊惧之下，一脚踏碎此怪。随之，嗡鸣愈烈，群蝗蜂拥而至。

column1: Ordering weapons to be brought forth, the lord eagerly organizes the upcoming demonstration. $ChosenOneName is brought a good-quality $NamedOneName, and $ChosenTwoName is brought a $NamedTwoName.
column2: 命令取来兵器，领主迫不及待地筹备即将举行的比武。$ChosenOneName被赐予一柄上好的$NamedOneName，而$ChosenTwoName则被赐予一把$NamedTwoName。

column1: Outdistancing the schrats is impossible when you have such poor agility. You must fight your way through undergrowth that the schrats simply crush. Seeing that escape is impossible, you...
column2: 凡尔特速度如此迟缓，欲甩开妖精绝无可能。你只得披荆斩棘，而妖精却能轻易碾压灌木。见逃无可遁，你……

column1: Outdistancing the spiders is difficult. Small bits of black vine are everywhere, clinging to you, slowing you down. Quickly the spiders gain on you, until you must turn and fight.
column2: 蜘蛛速度极快，四周尽是黑色藤蔓，缠绕不休，令你步履维艰。蜘蛛转瞬逼近，你只得转身迎战。

column1: Outrage purples the lord's face. "What!" he bellows. "You dare accuse me of mismanagement? My peasants must be ruled firmly, strongly, else they become lying traitors like you."
column2: 怒火使领主面色紫涨。“什么！”他咆哮道，“竟敢指斥我管理不善？我的农奴必须严加管束，否则便会如你般撒谎叛逆。”

column1: Outraged and disgusted by your cowardice, $NamedTwoName screams, "The $CityLordName will hear of this."
column2: 对你的怯懦愤慨不已，$NamedTwoName厉声喝道：“$CityLordName必将知晓此事。”

column1: Outraged by your betrayal, $NamedTwoName screams, "All of $PlaceName shall remember your cowardice!"
column2: 对你的背叛义愤填膺，$NamedTwoName高呼：“全$PlaceName都将铭记你的懦弱！”

column1: Outraged by your betrayal, $NamedTwoName screams, "The $CityLordName shall hear of your cowardice!" and runs off.
column2: 对你的背叛义愤填膺，$NamedTwoName高呼：“$CityLordName必将听闻你的懦弱！”随即离去。

column1: Outraged by your betrayal, the sergeant shouts, "Your craven cowardice will be remembered here!"
column2: 对你的背叛义愤难平，军曹怒吼：“你的卑劣懦弱将在此永志不忘！”

column1: Outraged, the guard growls, "What, do you take me for a poxy swine like you?"
column2: 守卫愤然低吼：“你以为我是像你一样的卑鄙之徒吗？”

column1: Outraged, you grab a cloaked man sneaking down a lane.
column2: 愤怒之下，你抓住一名潜行于巷中的披风男子。

column1: Outside a laundry-room, you hear...
column2: 在洗衣房外，你听见……

column1: Outside the city, near the shrine, the friar and the pilgrims thank your for your aid and protection. You say farewell, feeling happy with the spirit of true giving.
column2: 城外，神祠附近，修士与朝圣者感谢你的援助与庇护。你依依作别，心中满溢奉献之乐。

column1: Outside, you count the money. The Hansards have given you $Money1, a worthwhile sum.
column2: 外面，你清点所得。汉萨商人赠你$Money1，数目可观。

column1: Overall, the balance of opinion aligned with your side greatly outweighs that aligned with the opposition. Therefore,
column2: 总体而言，支持你一方的民意远胜反对派。因此，

column1: Overall, this suggests that the people of $PlaceName $Support the rebel cause. You begin discussing what this means....
column2: 总体看来，这表明$PlaceName民众$Support叛军事业。你开始商讨此举之意……

column1: Overall, you believe the citizens of $PlaceName $Support1 change in the city government.
column2: 总而言之，你认为$PlaceName $Support1的市民支持市政府变革。

column1: PASS  BY  PRESSING  THE  REALM  THAT  BELONGS  NOT.
column2: 绕过不属于此界之域即可通行。

column2: 携下一号码通行

column2: 按下一面必言之脸，方可开门。

column1: PRESS ONE OF THE FACES TO OPEN THE DOOR.
column2: 按下其中一面即可开门。

column1: PRESS THE MISSING NAME
column2: 按下缺失的名字

column1: PRESS THE RIGHT KNOB TO OPEN THE DOOR.
column2: 按下正确旋钮方可开门。

column1: PUSH  A  STATUE  TO  PASS.
column2: 推动雕像方可通行。

column1: PUSH GYMER'S FACE TO OPEN THE DOOR.
column2: 按盖默之面可开此门。

column1: Painfully you swing there for hours, bleeding. Finally, $ChosenOneName manages to swing up and untie $his bonds while the guard sleeps. Quickly he knocks out the guard, takes his weapons, and helps the rest of you escape into the woods.
column2: 你痛苦地悬挂其上数小时，鲜血淋漓。终于，$ChosenOneName奋力荡起，趁守卫熟睡之际解开了你的绳索。他迅速击昏守卫，夺取其武器，助众人逃入林间。

column1: Painfully you swing there for hours, bleeding. Finally, a stablehand takes pity and cuts you down while the guard is off relieving himself.
column2: 痛苦地在那儿悬挂了数小时，鲜血淋漓。终于，一名马厩侍从见状心生怜悯，在守卫去解手之际将你解下。

column1: Painfully, you collect everyone, bind up the worst wounds, and go down to the valley floor where you can bury the dead.
column2: 你强忍痛楚，召集众人，包扎重伤，然后下到谷底，为死者安葬。

column1: Painstakingly manipulating $his picks, $ChosenOneName at last loosens the catch and the cell door swings open. Ahead is the guardroom. You have no choice but to sneak up and attack them.
column2: 费尽心力地拨弄着你的根铁丝，$ChosenOneName终于松开了门闩，牢门缓缓开启。前方是守卫室。你别无选择，只能悄然潜近，发动突袭。

column1: Painstakingly setting tinder against a wooden interior wall, $ChosenOneName starts it burning with $his flint and steel. Then you let yourselves out of a window with all haste.
column2: 费力地将引火物贴在木制内墙上，$ChosenOneName用你的燧石与钢片将其点燃。随后你们急忙从窗户逃出。

column1: Painstakingly you copy the symbol onto the paper, though you cannot quite match the intricate sworls of the original. Hopefully there is someone somewhere to whom you can show this copy; perhaps they will be able to tell you what it is.
column2: 你费力地将符号誊写在纸上，却终究无法完全摹仿原作那繁复的纹路。但愿世上有人能见得此副本；或许他们能告诉你这究竟是何物。

column1: Painstakingly you copy the symbol onto the paper. As the final stroke is made, the symbol glows with silver fire. Words appears on the remaining papers: the secret formulas to several alchemical potions. $ChosenOneName reads them, and smiles.
column2: 你小心翼翼地将符号誊写在纸上。最后一笔落下，符号便燃起银色的火焰。剩余的纸张上浮现出文字：几份炼金药剂的秘密配方。$ChosenOneName阅之，莞尔一笑。

column1: Panting, you finally stop running when you reach the forest. Pursuing guardsmen are lost in the gloom. Slowly, quietly, you move deeper into the wood, to gain safety before the dawn.
column2: 气喘吁吁，你终于在抵达森林时停下脚步。追击的卫兵已在幽暗中迷失。你缓缓、静静地向林中深处行去，以求在黎明前获得安全。

column1: Panting, you finally stop running when you reach the forest. The pursuing guardsmen are lost in the gloom. Slowly, quietly, you move deeper into the wood, to gain safety before the dawn.
column2: 气喘吁吁，你终于在抵达森林时停下脚步。追击的卫兵已在幽暗中迷失。你缓缓、静静地向林中深处行去，以求在黎明前获得安全。

column1: Panting, you realize that this is an unfamiliar part of town. It will take you a while to find your way back to familiar territory...
column2: 气喘吁吁，你意识到这是城中一片陌生的区域。要找到回熟悉地带的路，还需时日……

column1: Parceled out among you, the lone Firewall potion gives you enough protection from the fire that as you face amidst the flames, you suffer no injury. However, the freezing rain still chills your bones, numbing you and costing you agility.
column2: 分配给你们的唯一防火药剂，使你在烈焰中免受伤害。然而，冰冷的雨仍刺骨，令你麻木，失去敏捷。

column1: Passing the first gate, you enter an immense stinking cavern. Gouts of blood, thick with clots, ooze across the stones. From the roof falls hail mingled with fire. Blasts of heat, alternating with freezing cold, waft over you. You cannot see the other side of the cavern.
column2: 通过第一道门，你进入一个巨大而恶臭的洞穴。浓稠的血块四处渗流，石面上满是血迹。屋顶上倾泻着夹杂火焰的冰雹。阵阵热浪与刺骨寒风交替袭来，令人难辨洞穴的另一端。

column1: Pay him and board the boat.
column2: 付钱上船。

column1: Peering down the narrow streets, dimly lit with lamplight, you can barely see murky picture signs of various guilds and crafts. You go to...
column2: 俯瞰狭窄的街道，昏暗的灯光下，依稀可见各公会与工匠的污浊招牌。你前往……

column1: People are moving about constantly, but during each lull you take your plan one step further: you plant bits of Scripture under the stone, and put pure white sand instead of charcoal in the centers of the pentagrams. You are about to place a holy symbol beneath the altar when the foreman appears from nowhere to inspect your work.
column2: 众人往来不息，然每遇间隙，汝便推进一策：于石下埋经文，以纯白之沙代炭于五芒星之中。方欲将圣徽置祭坛之下，监工忽自虚无现身，稽汝之功。

column1: People are moving about constantly, but during each lull you take your plan one step further: you plant bits of Scripture under the stone, and put pure white sand instead of charcoal into the centers of the pentagrams. You place holy symbols at the four corners of the altar, and mutter small prayers of purification all about the area.
column2: 人群川流不息，但每当稍有空隙，你便将计划推进一步：在石块下埋入经文片断，并用纯白细沙取代木炭置于五芒星中央。你在祭坛四角安放圣物符号，于周遭低声诵念净化祷词。

column1: People are reluctant to talk about the $NamedOneName, to the $Direction. Most say to you, "It's an evil place. No honest person goes there."
column2: 人们不愿谈及$NamedOneName，那片$Direction。多数人对你说：“那是邪恶之地，正直之人绝不去那里。”

column1: People are talking about the Michaelmas festival, which starts about September 9th. Especially big celebrations are expected this year in Leipzig, Prag, B|rglitz, Kuttenberg, Br|nn, Marienburg and Thorn.
column2: 人们正在谈论米迦勒节，该节日大约在九月九日开始。今年莱比锡、布拉格、B|rglitz、库滕贝格、Br|nn、马里恩堡和托恩等地预计将举行盛大的庆祝活动。

column1: People aren't saying much about affairs. It doesn't take much genius to see they are followers of Huss. They resent the Emperor's victories, and obviously dislike German rule of their city.
column2: 人们对于时局三缄其口。不需多大智慧便能看出，他们是胡斯派的信徒。他们对皇帝的胜利心怀怨恨，显然也不喜德意志人统治他们的城市。

column1: People around you stop and stare as $ChosenOneName raises $his arms and cries out to Saint Lutgardis. As a bright glow engulfs your party there is an awed silence at the busy gate. Slowly you rise; the guards are dumbstruck as you sail over the battlements and are deposited gently on a city street. People cry in awe, one even falls to the street in prayer as you calmly walk away.
column2: 周围的人纷纷驻足凝视，只见$ChosenOneName高举你的双臂，向圣卢特加迪斯呼喊。一道耀眼的光芒笼罩众人，喧闹的城门前顿时一片肃静。你缓缓升空，守卫们目瞪口呆，只见你轻盈地越过垛口，稳稳落在城街上。众人惊呼不已，甚至有人跪倒在地，虔诚祈祷，而你则从容离去。

column1: People around you stop and stare as $ChosenOneName raises $his arms and cries out to Saint Lutgardis. As a bright glow engulfs your party, there is an awed silence at the busy gate. Slowly you rise; the guards are dumbstruck as you sail over the battlements and are deposited gently on a city street. People cry in awe; one even falls to his knees in prayer as you calmly walk away.
column2: 你周遭的人们停下脚步，注视着$ChosenOneName举起你的双臂，向圣卢特加迪斯呼喊。一道耀眼的光芒笼罩了你们一行，在繁忙的城门前一片肃穆。你缓缓升起；守卫们目瞪口呆，只见你越过城垛，轻柔地落在城街上。人们惊呼不已，甚至有人跪下祈祷，而你则从容离去。

column1: People have heard from travellers about...
column2: 人们从旅人处听闻关于……

column1: People stop and stare as $ChosenOneName begins a hymn in praise of Saint Milburga. With a loud cry $he clasps a crufix to $his chest. Silence falls on the crowd as a glow engulfs your party. You slowly rise in the air, then sail over the wall and land gently on the city street. The crowd and guards first stand in awe, then gradually edge away from you, clearly terrified of your powers.
column2: 人们驻足凝视，$ChosenOneName 开始吟唱赞美圣米尔伯加的圣歌。伴随着一声高呼，你 将十字架紧贴于 你的 的胸膛。人群顿时寂静，一道光芒将你们笼罩。你们缓缓升空，越过城墙，轻盈地落在城街上。人群与守卫先是惊愕不已，随后渐渐退散，显然对你们的力量心生畏惧。

column1: People stop and stare as $ChosenOneName begins a loud hymn in praise of Saint Milburga. With a loud cry $he clasps a crufix to $his chest. Silence falls on the crowd as a glow engulfs your party. You slowly rise in the air, then gently sail over the wall and land gently on the city street. The crowd and guards first stand in awe, then gradually edge away from you, clearly terrified of your powers.
column2: 众人驻足凝视，$ChosenOneName高声吟唱赞美圣米尔伯加的圣歌。你一声大喝，将十字架紧紧按在你的胸前。人群顿时寂静，一道光芒笼罩你们一行。你们缓缓升空，轻盈地越过城墙，稳稳降落在城中街道上。围观者与守卫先是惊愕不已，继而渐渐退散，显然对你们的力量心生畏惧。

column1: People who spend a lot of time at the $marketplace prove your best source of information. They opine that:
column2: 在$marketplace逗留良久之人，乃你最佳之消息来源。彼等谓：

column1: Perhaps divine inspiration helps $ChosenOneName to cleverly improvise a makeshift block which keeps the walls from closing. The walls strain, threatening to snap $his simple prop. But before this happens, you writhe up and out of the trap.
column2: 或许神灵的启示助$ChosenOneName巧妙地即兴搭建了一道临时的挡板，使墙壁不再合拢。墙壁紧绷，险些压断你的这根简陋的支撑物。但在这之前，你已奋力挣脱，逃出了陷阱。

column1: Perplexed but obedient, the knight backs off and you continue onward.
column2: 困惑却顺从，骑士退后，你继续前行。

column1: Pharmacists in the main marketplace, at night.
column2: 夜晚，主集市上的药剂师。

column1: Picking the right moment, you slip through an unwatched door and hide yourself in a room's shadows.
column2: 抓住良机，你悄然穿过无人把守的门扉，隐于室中阴影。

column1: Piously, $NamedOneName takes the ragged garment.
column2: 虔诚地，$NamedOneName接过那件破旧的衣衫。

column1: Pitifully, $ChosenOneName cries for help until the bubbling muck closes over $his head. You regret $his death, but you feel there was nothing you could do to save $him.
column2: 可怜的$ChosenOneName呼救着，直到翻滚的泥浆没过你的头顶。你为你的死感到惋惜，却也深知自己无力相救你。

column1: Placing the potion carefully, $ChosenOneName leads you behind a rock. There is a loud explosion, but when you return, all you see is some additional bits of stone scattered about.
column2: 小心地放置药剂后，$ChosenOneName 带你躲到一块岩石后。只听一声巨响，但当你返回时，只见周围散落着些许碎石。

column1: Placing your feet atop one another's shoulders with great care, you form the human pyramid. The hapless folk at the bottom grunt and complain under the strain but $ChosenOneName, at the top, is just barely able to reach the lip of the pit. $He scrambles out, then reaches down and helps the rest of you up. Soon you are free.
column2: 你小心翼翼地将双脚搭在彼此的肩上，组成一座人梯。底层的倒霉鬼们在重压下哼哼唧唧、怨声载道，但$ChosenOneName在顶端却勉强够到了坑沿。你率先爬了出去，然后伸手拉其余的人上来。很快，你们便脱困而出。

column1: Placing your feet atop one another's shoulders with great care, you form the human pyramid. The hapless folk at the bottom grunt and complain under the strain. Suddenly $ChosenOneName, at the top, slips. $His arms windmill frantically, but slowly, with inexorable majesty, $he topples backwards, bringing the rest of the pyramid down with $him. With a crash, you all lie in a heap at the bottom of the pit. Your ludicrous escape attempt has failed.
column2: 你小心翼翼地将双脚搭在彼此的肩上，组成一座人形金字塔。底层的倒霉鬼们在重压下呻吟抱怨。突然，$ChosenOneName在顶端滑倒了。你的手臂疯狂挥舞，但你却以不可阻挡的威严缓缓向后倾倒，连带着整个金字塔一同倒塌，你也随之坠落。砰的一声，你们全都摔成一团，躺在坑底。这场荒唐的逃亡尝试失败了。

column1: Plans in place, you all quietly slip out the back door and spread out among the side streets of $PlaceName.
column2: 计划已定，你们悄然从后门溜出，分散在$PlaceName的侧街之中。

column1: Pleading with the villagers for clemency, you beg them to let you go free. They scorn your words, and beat you soundly. Then their leader steps up. She says, "Let them go. Such folk as these are clearly no threat to us, and I misdoubt me whether Hell would accept them as a suitable sacrifice. They are neither hot nor cold, but lukewarm!"
column2: 你向村民恳求宽恕，哀求他们放你一马。他们嗤之以鼻，将你痛打一顿。随后，他们的首领走上前去。她说道：“放了他们吧。这样的人显然对我们构不成威胁，我甚至怀疑地狱是否愿意接纳他们作为祭品。他们既不炽热，也不冰冷，只是温吞而已！”

column1: Pleased to be invited, $ChosenOneName immediately collects $his few belongings and joins you.
column2: 得邀欣喜，$ChosenOneName即刻收拾 你的 几件行囊，随你同行。

column1: Plucking the cork from the bottle of Eater Water, $ChosenOneName gently pours the bottle's contents over the ropes keeping $him bound, but is careful not to let any touch $his hand. As the dance carries the cultists down the hill, $he frees you all, and you take back your weapons, stacked neatly nearby.
column2: 从“食水”瓶中拔出软木塞，$ChosenOneName轻轻地将瓶中之物洒在束缚着你绳索上，但小心翼翼地不让任何一滴沾到你的手。随着舞蹈将教徒们带下山丘，你解开了你们所有人的枷锁，你们重新拿回了整齐堆放在一旁的武器。

column1: Pointing to himself, the Schulz says, "I myself will come, if this is acceptable."
column2: 指着自己，舒尔茨说道：“若可允准，我自会亲至。”

column1: Poland and the Ordensstaat.
column2: 波兰与条顿骑士团国。

column1: Politics is on everyone's minds. Apparently various agitators and leaflets are circulating. These complain of bad laws, unfair taxes, and bungling by the $CityLordTitle. However, it seems more people are worried about the possibility of violence in the streets than these claims.
column2: 政治牵动人心。显然，各种煽动者与传单正在流传。它们抱怨恶法、苛税以及$CityLordTitle的无能。然而，似乎更多人担忧的是街头可能发生的暴力，而非这些指控。

column1: Pondering the situation, $ChosenOneName uses $his knowledge of religious lore to understand and explain exactly which parts of the altar must be destroyed to purge the evil. In a few hours you are finished. The altar is thoroughly ruined. Though the sky has been overcast, at the exact moment you finish, the clouds part. This place has been purified.
column2: 沉思良久，$ChosenOneName 凭借对宗教典故的 你的 知识，详尽阐明并解释了祭坛上哪些部分必须毁去，方能祛除邪祟。数刻之后，一切毕矣。祭坛已彻底毁坏。虽天色阴霾，然你功成之瞬，云开雾散。此地终得净化。

column1: Potion in hand, $ChosenOneName sneaks forward toward the gate. But a few seconds later there is a loud thump and a soft curse. The night watch in the tower shines a lantern upon $ChosenOneName, who is rubbing a badly twisted ankle. Beside $him the potion's pot lies broken, its contents seeping harmlessly into the earth.
column2: 手持药剂，$ChosenOneName 悄悄向城门潜行。然而数秒后，一声巨响，随之而来的是一声轻咒。塔楼上的夜巡者将灯笼照向 $ChosenOneName，只见他正揉着扭伤的脚踝。在 你 旁，药剂罐已碎裂，其内容物无声地渗入泥土之中。

column1: Potion in hand, $ChosenOneName sneaks up to a sally door set in the gate and carefully pours the potion on its hinges and locks. In minutes these are eaten away. $He lowers the door to the ground and you creep inside.
column2: 手持药剂，$ChosenOneName 悄悄潜至城门上的小门，小心翼翼地将药剂倾注于其铰链与锁上。片刻之间，这些便被腐蚀殆尽。你 将小门放至地面，你们悄然潜入其中。

column1: Pound as you would, you cannot break through the chest's sturdy sides. Your weapons have suffered severely from the abuse. Surely you cannot fail forever. Perhaps you should try again, possibly with different weapons.
column2: 纵使你全力捶打，也无法击破宝箱坚固的箱壁。你的武器已因过度使用而严重受损。你总不能永远失败吧。或许该再试一次，也许换些不同的武器。

column1: Poured carefully upon the sally port, the acid hisses loudly as it erodes away the metal of the lock. It takes time to work, though, and by the time it is through, you can see some soldiers wandering your way. Before they can spot you in the night, you sneak through the sally port into the city and are gone.
column2: 酸液被小心翼翼地倾倒在月门上，嘶嘶作响，腐蚀着锁的金属。然而这需要时间，待其完全溶解时，你已看见几名士兵朝这边走来。在他们于夜色中发现你之前，你悄然穿过月门，遁入城中，消失无踪。

column1: Powerful $NamedOneName and his minions finally force you to yield. $NamedOneName reappears, calls off his monsters and, excited beyond reason, capers around the room. He cries,
column2: 强大的$NamedOneName及其爪牙终迫使你屈服。$NamedOneName重现，召回其魔物，欣喜若狂，在室中雀跃。他哭喊道，

column1: Prancing with fury, $NamedOneName gibbers with rage. You can barely comprehend his words.
column2: $NamedOneName 激怒地跳跃，口中胡言乱语。你几乎听不懂他说的话。

column1: Pray as you might, the heavens do not respond.
column2: 无论你如何祈祷，天穹亦无回应。

column1: Pray for saintly aid to surmount the walls.
column2: 祈求圣徒庇佑，以逾越城墙。

column1: Praying diligently for hours, you feel as though heaven smiles upon you.
column2: 默祷数时，但觉天恩垂顾。

column1: Praying for heaven's intervention, $ChosenOneName brings divine power to bear on the witches' evil ceremony. Heavenly trumpets are heard, and intangible curtains of light pass over the scene. The witches scream in baffled rage and fall over, their spell spoiled.
column2: 祈求天启降临，$ChosenOneName将神力施加于女巫的邪恶仪式之上。天际传来号角之声，无形的光幕掠过现场。女巫们惊怒交加，咒术失效，纷纷倒地。

column1: Praying loudly to Saint Reinold, suddenly you see a gleam flash off of the wall. When you investigate, you cannot tell whether the wall is horizontal or vertical. $ChosenOneName boldly ventures onto the wall, and finds that $he can walk vertically up its surface as easily as if $he were strolling down a city street. All of you follow suit, and soon you are within the city.
column2: 大声向圣莱诺德祈祷，忽见墙上闪过一道光芒。你上前查看，却分不清那面墙是横的还是竖的。$ChosenOneName大胆地踏上墙面，发现你竟可如在城中漫步般轻松地垂直而上。众人纷纷效仿，不久便已进入城内。

column1: Praying quickly, $ChosenTwoName looks up to see a dramatic sight. The lieutenant of the guard halts his men and withdraws them to side streets. When you look closely, you can see someone in white robes beside the lieutenant.
column2: 匆匆祈祷，$ChosenTwoName抬头望见一幕惊心动魄的景象。卫队长勒令部下止步，退至侧街。细看之下，只见卫队长身旁立着一位身披白袍之人。

column1: Praying to Saint Gertrude of Nivelles has an immediate response. Swirling mists from the sky envelop you, and you feel yourself being rapidly carried through the air. When the mists vanish, you have been miraculously transported to a nearby village. You are safe from the Wild Hunt.
column2: 向尼韦勒的圣格特鲁德祈祷，即刻得到回应。天际间旋起浓雾，将你包裹，只觉身在空中疾驰。雾散之时，你已被神迹般地传送至附近村庄。你已脱离狂猎之厄。

column1: Predictably, the daughter refuses to believe a word.
column2: 毫无疑问，女儿一个字也不信。

column1: Preparing $himself for prayer, $ChosenOneName raises $his arms to the sky, but the heavens remain silent. $His supplications prove completely futile. Finally you give up, rest and reconsider your options...
column2: 准备你自己祈祷，$ChosenOneName举起你的双手向天，然苍穹依旧寂然无声。你的祈求竟全然无用。终至放弃，稍作休憩，再思对策……

column1: Preparing for the exhibition, the lord has a $NamedOneName brought to $ChosenOneName and a $NamedTwoName brought to $ChosenTwoName.
column2: 为筹备展览，领主命人将$NamedOneName运至$ChosenOneName，并将$NamedTwoName运至$ChosenTwoName。

column1: Pressing RETURN will take back to the card that got you here.
column2: 按下回车键将返回带你至此的卡片。

column1: Producing $NamedOneName's treasure, you offer to return it. "But first," says $ChosenOneName. "Swear, in front of Heaven, saints, and us as witnesses that you will abandon this mine forever."
column2: 生产出$NamedOneName的宝藏，你提出归还它。“但首先，”$ChosenOneName说道，“在上天、圣徒以及我们这些见证者面前发誓，你将永远放弃这座矿坑。”

column1: Promptly answering your questions, the priest bursts out, "Our village is in dire need. Please, talk to the Schulz. It is his place to speak of our troubles, not mine."
column2: 神父迅速回答你的问题，随即说道：“我们的村庄正处于危急之中。请去与舒尔茨交谈吧。谈论我们的困境是他的职责，而非我的。”

column1: Protesting, $NamedOneName pleads, "You can't go now. If you do, your example will ruin us. Everybody will doubt our cause and leave!"
column2: 抗议着，$NamedOneName哀求道：“你现在不能走。如果你走了，你的榜样会毁了我们。所有人都会怀疑我们的事业并离去！”

column1: Protesting, $NamedOneName pleads, "You can't go now. They will see you're gone, lose heart, and also leave!"
column2: 抗议着，$NamedOneName哀求道：“你现在不能走。他们一发现你不在，就会丧失斗志，也会离开！”

column1: Proudly you stand over the defeated forms of the hapless guards. Turning your backs on them, you walk off into the deserted city streets.
column2: 你傲然立于那群倒霉守卫的败亡之躯之上。背弃他们，你步履坚定地走入空寂的城街。

column1: Pulling a small vial from $his pouch, $ChosenOneName calls out, "Here, catch." Then $he tosses the vial.
column2: 从你的囊袋中取出一个小瓶，$ChosenOneName喊道：“接住。”随后你将小瓶抛了过去。

column1: Pulling your mounts up sharply, you wheel around and gallop away from the peasants.
column2: 猛然勒住坐骑，你掉头疾驰，远离那些农夫。

column1: Pushing and prying at the gate with all your might, you cannot get it to budge. A disembodied voice whispers to you, "The Fourth Seal is unbroken. The Fourth Gate cannot unlock." You leave.
column2: 你用尽全力推撬城门，却纹丝不动。一个无形的声音低语道：“第四封印未破，第四城门无法开启。”你只得离去。

column1: Pushing at the gate, you cannot get it to open. Suddenly a voice hisses in your ear, "The Third Seal is unbroken. The Third Gate is safe." In frustration, you turn away.
column2: 推动城门，却无法开启。忽闻耳边一声嘶语：“第三封印未破，第三城门无虞。”你愤然转身离去。

column1: Pushing strongly against the current, you race across the water, and are only scorched a little by the flames because of your swift passage.
column2: 你奋力逆流而上，飞速掠过水面，因行进迅速，仅被火焰微微灼伤。

column1: Quaking with laughter, the demon states, "Fools to quibble legal points with a devil -- father to all lawyers." It seizes $ChosenTwoName in a talon, shrinks your companion to pocket-size, and puts its prey in a leather purse.
column2: 恶魔咯咯笑着说道：“与魔鬼——所有律师之父——纠缠法律细节，真是愚蠢。”它用利爪抓住$ChosenTwoName，将你的同伴缩小至可放入口袋的大小，并将其装入皮囊之中。

column1: Qualified parties wishing to solve certain non-technical mining difficulties should present themselves to the officers of the Fugger Bank, during daylight and in person, as quickly as possible.
column2: 有资格者若欲解决某些非技术性采矿难题，应于白昼亲自前往富格银行，尽快呈报。

column1: Quickly $ChosenOneName climbs onto a cart and starts speaking. The mob barely listens, then starts shouting insults. Soon they are pelting $him with garbage. $He jumps down and you reconsider your plans...
column2: $ChosenOneName迅速爬上一辆马车，开始讲话。人群几乎不听，随即开始高声辱骂。很快，他们便向你投掷垃圾。你跳了下来，你重新考虑自己的计划……

column1: Quickly $ChosenOneName strips down to rags, so $his costume resembles those of the foul witches. Then $he joins the witches and tries to emulate their mad dance.
column2: 很快，$ChosenOneName 就被剥得只剩破衣烂衫，于是 你的 的装扮便与那些邪恶女巫无异。随后，你 加入了女巫之列，试图模仿她们疯狂的舞蹈。

column1: Quickly $ChosenOneName strips down to rags, so $his costume resembles those of the foul witches. Then $he sneaks over and dances alongside them. When the other witches are not looking $his way, $he does $his level best to break up their ceremony, kicking over black candles and stealing the witches' athame (ritual dagger).
column2: $ChosenOneName 迅速脱得只剩破布，使 $his 装束与那些邪恶女巫相似。随后 $he 悄悄靠近，与她们一同起舞。趁其他女巫未留意 $he，$he 竭尽全力破坏她们的仪式，踢翻黑蜡烛，偷走女巫的 athame（仪式匕首）。

column1: Quickly $ChosenTwoName hurls the vial into the crowd. There is commotion and confusion, but no real effect.
column2: 迅速地，$ChosenTwoName 将药瓶掷入人群。虽有骚动与混乱，却无实际效用。

column1: Quickly a group of rebels strips you of all weapons, armor and money, then beats you nearly senseless. They pile you on a cart with other wounded and dead defenders of the government, wheel you out the nearest gate, and dump you in a midden.
column2: 一群叛军迅速夺走你所有的武器、盔甲和钱财，随后将你打得几乎不省人事。他们把你与其他受伤及阵亡的政府守卫一同堆上一辆马车，推至最近的城门，然后将你倾倒在垃圾堆中。

column1: Quickly all is confusion, with fire-fighters running in all directions. You join the crowd and hurry through the open gates. But as you enter the tower, the guards spot you.
column2: 顷刻间一片混乱，消防员四散奔走。你混入人群，匆匆穿过敞开的大门。然而当你踏入塔楼时，守卫发现了你。

column1: Quickly and quietly, you all fade away down a side street. From the deep shadows you see the watchmen increase their vigilance in the marketplace. An alert night watch was NOT what you wanted!
column2: 你们众人迅速而悄然地隐入一条侧街。从幽深的阴影中，你们看见守卫在集市上愈发警觉。这绝非你们所愿！

column1: Quickly the family of $NamedOneName cleans up after the battle, erasing all signs of the struggle.
column2: $NamedOneName一家迅速清理战场，抹去一切争斗的痕迹。

column1: Quickly turning and running into a nearby copse of trees, you briefly evade your tormentors. But soon the angry peasants are combing the brush for you. Your leader, $ChosenTwoName, using $his knowledge of woodland lore, conceals your tracks, and places everyone in the best hiding places. The peasants search for hours, but find no trace of you.
column2: 你迅速转身，奔入附近的一片树林，暂时躲过了追捕者。然而，愤怒的农民很快便在灌木丛中搜寻你的踪迹。你的首领$ChosenTwoName凭借对林间秘术的你的了解，掩盖了你们的足迹，并将众人安置在最佳的藏身之处。农民们搜寻了数小时，却始终未能发现你的踪影。

column1: Quickly you are bound and taken to the dungeon, where you are expertly disarmed of all arms, armor and valuables, with a few gratuitous kicks in the process.
column2: 你很快被绑住，押入地牢，在那里你身上的武器、盔甲和贵重物品被尽数搜走，还挨了几脚。

column1: Quickly you dash down a side alley, make five fast turns, leap a fence and a gate, then scramble over a low wall into yet another side street. As you pause to catch your breath, you hear the sounds of frustrated pursuit heading away in the wrong direction.
column2: 你疾速奔入一条侧巷，连转五弯，跃过一道栅栏与一扇门扉，又攀越一堵矮墙，窜入另一条小街。稍作喘息，便听见追兵恼怒的呼喝声渐行渐远，朝错的方向而去。

column1: Quickly you dodge and weave, leading the cutthroats on a long and merry chase. Unfortunately, they have greater speed.
column2: 你迅速闪避腾挪，引得那些亡命之徒展开一场漫长而欢快的追逐。不幸的是，他们速度更快。

column1: Quickly you outdistance the huge but ungainly schrats. Frustrated, they give low, groaning howls, shake their shaggy arms, and return to the trees.
column2: 你迅速甩开了那些体型庞大却笨拙的斯克拉茨。它们恼怒地发出低沉的哀嚎，挥舞着毛茸茸的臂膀，又退回了树林之中。

column1: Quickly you outdistance the spiders, nimbly avoiding the bits of dark vine littering the ground. When you break out into more open country, the spiders give up the chase and return to their nest.
column2: 你迅速甩开蜘蛛，灵巧地避开散落于地的黑色藤蔓。待你冲入开阔地带，蜘蛛便放弃追逐，退回巢穴。

column1: Quickly you produce the great seed you scavenged from Gate One and hurl it into the midst of the flames. A glowing tree springs into being at once and its leaves suck up the evil rain, quenching the fire and ending the threat. Baphomet mutters, "So you have the seed of the Tree of Life. Howbeit I have six plagues more. The loss of the rain of ice and fire is paltry compared to them."
column2: 你迅速取出从第一道门中搜得的圣种，将其掷入火海之中。刹那间，一棵灼灼生辉的神树拔地而起，其叶吸纳恶雨，扑灭烈焰，化解危难。巴佛墨特低语道：“原来你已得生命之树的种子。然而我尚有六重灾厄。失去冰火之雨，于诸祸中不过微不足道。”

column1: Quickly you rendezvous with $NamedTwoName, who is busily cutting $NamedOneName from his bonds.
column2: 你迅速与$NamedTwoName会合，他正忙着割断自己的$NamedOneName。

column1: Quickly you slip away down a side street, before anyone comes to investigate.
column2: 你迅速溜进一条侧街，以免有人前来查探。

column1: Quickly your horses outdistance the cutthroats, who gesture obscenely in your wake.
column2: 你的马匹迅速甩开了那些歹徒，他们还在你身后做出猥亵的手势。

column1: Quickly, $ChosenOneName calls upon $NamedOneName, a patron of lawyers and philosophy. And $NamedOneName himself shows up in person! The holy saint, clad in simple garb but with a halo round his head, steps up to the demon, who says, "Begone, sainted one. These folk are mine!"
column2: 迅速地，$ChosenOneName 呼唤 $NamedOneName，一位律师与哲学的庇护者。而 $NamedOneName 亲自现身！这位身着素衣、头戴光环的圣徒，走向那恶魔，恶魔道：“退去吧，圣者。这些人乃吾之所有！”

column1: Quickly, $ChosenOneName closes $his eyes and prays.
column2: 迅速地，$ChosenOneName闭上你的眼睛，祈祷。

column1: Quickly, $ChosenOneName collects everybody and everything on deck, then intones a prayer to the saint. Filled with divine confidence, $he leads you off the deck and onto the harbor waters. Miraculously, you are standing on top of the water, rather than sinking into it.
column2: 迅速地，$ChosenOneName 将众人与物事尽数召集于甲板之上，随即向圣者诵念祷词。满怀神恩之信心，你 引领你步出甲板，踏上港湾之水。奇迹般地，你立于水面之上，而非沉入其中。

column1: Quickly, $ChosenOneName enters the mouth of the cave and returns to indicate that nothing appears amiss.
column2: 迅速地，$ChosenOneName进入洞口，并返回示意并无异状。

column1: Quickly, $ChosenOneName evokes holy $NamedOneName and the boars stop in mid-charge. Suddenly they start rooting peacefully in nearby bushes. They do not object to you, and you find yourselves able to walk right up to them and stroke their bristles in safety. Of course, you realize the least hostile move might provoke them. Finally, after an hour or so, the swine wander off, still tame and friendly.
column2: 迅速地，$ChosenOneName 召唤神圣的 $NamedOneName，野猪在冲锋途中骤然停步。忽而它们开始在附近的灌木丛中安然拱食。它们对你并无敌意，你们得以安然走近，抚其鬃毛。当然，你们也明白，最温和的举动仍可能激怒它们。终于，约过一小时，这群野猪悠然离去，依旧温顺友善。

column1: Quickly, $ChosenOneName holds up the gold cup you retrieved from the thief. The dragon nearly chokes on its flames, as it suddenly is forced to stifle an incipient fire burst. Clearly, $NamedTwoName is unwilling to harm its precious treasure!
column2: 迅速地，$ChosenOneName 举起你从盗贼手中夺回的金杯。巨龙几乎被自己的火焰呛住，因为它不得不强行压下即将喷出的火浪。显然，$NamedTwoName 不愿损伤它那珍贵的宝物！

column1: Quickly, $ChosenOneName kneels in the path of the bear and prays to $NamedOneName. Although he shows deep faith, the bear does not cease its angry charge. White fangs gleam as the bear goes for the neck of $ChosenOneName. As quickly as possible you rise to $his defense.
column2: 迅速地，$ChosenOneName 在熊的去路上跪下，向 $NamedOneName 祈祷。虽显虔诚，熊却未止怒冲之势。白牙闪亮，直扑 $ChosenOneName 的颈项。你即刻起身，为 你的 护驾。

column1: Quickly, $ChosenOneName prays. Then $he prays again, harder.
column2: 迅速地，$ChosenOneName 祈祷。随后 你 再次祈祷，更为虔诚。

column1: Quickly, $ChosenOneName prays. You all watch $his closed eyes.
column2: 迅速地，$ChosenOneName 祈祷。你们皆注视着 你的 闭合的双眼。

column1: Quickly, $ChosenOneName rises to speak.
column2: 迅速地，$ChosenOneName起身发言。

column1: Quickly, $ChosenOneName utters a brief prayer to Saint Apollinarius, saying, "As you saved the 12th Legion from destruction, so save us!"
column2: 迅速地，$ChosenOneName向圣阿波利纳里乌斯低声祈祷道：“如你曾救第十二军团于覆灭，亦请救我们！”

column1: Quickly, $ChosenOneName utters a loud prayer to Saint Apollinarius, then leads you all down the hillside, toward the battle.
column2: 迅速地，$ChosenOneName向圣阿波利纳里乌斯高声祈祷，随即引领众人下山，奔赴战场。

column1: Quickly, $ChosenTwoName hurls the vial into the middle of the crowd. There is commotion and confusion, then a roar of anger. Groups of people break off and charge toward you from all directions. If you don't stop them, the whole mob might charge and overwhelm you!
column2: 迅速地，$ChosenTwoName 将药瓶掷向人群中央。顿时骚动四起，继而怒吼震天。众人分作数股，自四面八方朝你冲来。若不将其拦下，恐将群起围攻，将你压倒！

column1: Quickly, $he steals back to $his own cell, worried about exactly whom $he has dallied with! Fortunately, the rest of the party remains asleep, unaware of $his indiscretion.
column2: 匆匆间，你 悄悄溜回 你的 的牢房，心中忧虑着究竟与何人调情！幸而，众人仍酣睡未醒，不知 你的 的轻率之举。

column1: Quickly, he and his men relieve you of all your money and weapons.
column2: 迅速地，他与手下夺走了你所有的钱财与武器。

column1: Quickly, the sergeant and his men draw steel. You have no choice but to defend yourselves.
column2: 顿时，军士与麾下士兵拔剑出鞘。你别无选择，唯有自卫。

column1: Quickly, they relieve you of all your money and weapons.
column2: 迅速地，他们夺走了你所有的钱财与武器。

column1: Quickly, you dash out the door and down a side alley. Running quickly through the back streets of $PlaceName, you put plenty of distance between yourself and any possible pursuit.
column2: 你迅速冲出门，奔入一条侧巷。沿着$PlaceName的后街疾驰，与任何可能的追兵拉开了距离。

column1: Quickly, you move through the forest, before they return.
column2: 匆匆穿过林间，以免他们归来。

column1: Quickly, you race from the hilltop into a small wood, seeking cover. But the trees around you come alive. They are actually great, shaggy man-like beings with huge clubs!
column2: 你飞速从山顶奔入一片小树林，寻求掩护。然而，周围的树木竟活了过来。它们竟是些巨大的、毛发蓬乱的人形生物，手持巨棒！

column1: Quickly, you race from the hilltop into a small wood, seeking cover. Only then, between the thunder crashes, do you hear the wolf-howls. In seconds the first of the dark forms leaps upon you!
column2: 你飞速从山顶奔入一片小树林，寻求掩护。唯有在雷鸣间隙，方闻狼嚎阵阵。转瞬之间，第一道黑影已扑向你！

column1: Quickly, you race from the hilltop into a small wood, seeking cover. Only then, between the thunder crashes, you see dark, dangerous forms rushing toward you!
column2: 你飞速从山顶奔入一片小树林，寻求掩护。唯有在雷鸣间隙，方见黑暗而凶险的身形向你疾驰而来！

column1: Quiet cheers echo in the small room.
column2: 小室中回荡着轻声的欢呼。

column1: Quietly scaling the wall, $ChosenOneName throws down the rope so the rest of you can follow quickly. In minutes you're sliding down to a side street inside $PlaceName.
column2: 默默攀上城墙，$ChosenOneName抛下绳索，让你们其余人迅速跟上。片刻之间，你们已滑至$PlaceName内的一条侧街。

column1: Quietly stepping out the back entrance, you creep through the graveyard, hiding behind tombs and headstones. Soon you get to the graveyard's edge, vault the wall, and disappear into the city.
column2: 悄然自后门而出，你潜行于墓园之中，藏身于冢墓与碑石之后。不久便至墓园之畔，跃过墙垣，隐入城中。

column1: Quietly you consign the dead enemies to the flames of the destroyed desk, then continue on your way.
column2: 你悄然将死去的敌人付诸被毁书桌的烈焰，然后继续前行。

column1: Quietly, $ChosenOneName beseeches Saint Gregory for aid, but nothing seems to happen.
column2: 静静地，$ChosenOneName 向圣格里高利祈求援助，却似乎毫无动静。

column1: Quietly, $ChosenOneName returns to reveal that a large, brown bear is sleeping in the cave; but even more interesting, a locked and bound chest is stored in the cave -- most likely the stash of one of the cutthroats notorious for hiding out in the Alps.
column2: 静静地，$ChosenOneName 返回，发现洞中正有一头棕熊酣睡；更引人注目的是，洞内还存放着一只锁紧缚牢的宝箱——极有可能是那些以藏身阿尔卑斯山闻名的亡命之徒的赃物。

column1: Quietly, $ChosenTwoName follows $ChosenOneName through the dark water, and finally up onto dry land again. In the cool air, they silently exchange looks of satisfaction, then glance back at $PlaceName. Then they begin checking their possessions, to see what was lost to the river!
column2: 静静地，$ChosenTwoName 跟随 $ChosenOneName 穿过幽暗的水面，终于再次踏上陆地。在清凉的空气中，他们默默交换着满意的目光，又回首望向 $PlaceName。随后，他们开始清点随身之物，查看哪些已为河流所夺！

column1: Quietly, $ChosenTwoName utters a brief prayer to Saint Valentine.
column2: 静静地，$ChosenTwoName 向圣瓦伦丁祈祷了一番。

column1: Quietly, the priest comes and stands before you until you notice him. Then he states, "I feel that you have remained with us long enough. Should you not go away?"
column2: 静静地，牧师来到你面前，直到你注意到他。然后他说：“我觉得你已在此停留良久。难道不该离去吗？”

column1: Quite abashed, he recounts. "Since boyhood I'd heard tales of $NamedTwoName asleep under Worm's Hill, doomed to wake at the Last Trump to join the armies of Gog and Magog.
column2: 他颇为羞赧地述说：“自幼便听闻关于$NamedTwoName的传说，沉睡于蠕虫山下，注定在末日号角吹响之时苏醒，加入歌革与玛各的军阵。”

column1: REWARD !
column2: 奖励！

column1: REWARD FOR SERVICES
column2: 服务酬劳

column1: RHYTHM.
column2: 节奏。

column1: Racing down a side street to safety, you see the crowd behind breaking up also. The victorious guardsmen attack the crowd, striking anyone within reach. Screaming in terror, the people flee in all directions.
column2: 你沿着一条小巷飞奔，寻求庇护，只见身后的民众也四散而逃。胜利的卫兵向人群发起攻击，见人便打。人们惊恐地尖叫着，四处奔逃。

column1: Ragged bandits surround you, muttering, "Blood or gold, blood or gold." Soon they have stripped you of all obvious items of value, including weapons and armor. Fortunately, their search is inexpert, and certain small items remain unnoticed.
column2: 衣衫褴褛的强盗将你团团围住，低声咒骂：“要血还是要金，要血还是要金。”不久，他们便搜刮了你身上所有显而易见的贵重之物，连武器与甲胄亦不放过。幸而他们搜查粗疏，仍有几件细小之物未被察觉。

column1: Ragged but determined bandits leap from ambush positions, swinging weapons and screaming, "Blood or gold!"
column2: 衣衫褴褛却意志坚定的强盗从伏击点跃出，挥舞着武器，高喊：“血与金！”

column1: Raising $his voice, $ChosenOneName invokes the divine $NamedOneName. Beams of light shine down from the sky into the bosom of each attacking soldier. Feeling the peaceful spirit, they throw down their weapons and turn to one another in joy. While they are engaged in brotherly camaraderie, your party climbs into the city. The soldiers do not even notice your passing.
column2: 抬高你的声音，$ChosenOneName召唤神圣的$NamedOneName。天际垂下光束，洒落在每位进攻士兵的胸膛。感受到祥和之气，他们纷纷弃械，欢欣地彼此相拥。当他们沉浸在兄弟般的友爱之中时，你的队伍悄然攀入城中。士兵们竟未察觉你们的经过。

column1: Raising your hands in surrender, you succumb to the guards. They cheerfully steal your possessions, then march you off to the dungeon, there to await the good pleasure of the city fathers.
column2: 你举手投降，屈服于卫兵。他们兴高采烈地掠夺你的财物，然后押你前往地牢，等待城中权贵的处置。

column1: Rapidly you explain who you are and why you are here. The gathered group promises to take care of the poor innocents and see that no harm comes to them; before the gathering becomes too suspicious, you depart.
column2: 你迅速说明了自己的身份与来意。众人承诺会照顾这些无辜之人，确保他们安然无恙；在众人起疑之前，你便悄然离去。

column1: Rapidly you explain who you are and why you are here. The group promises to take care of the innocent ones and see that no harm comes to them; before the gathering becomes too suspicious, you depart.
column2: 你迅速说明了自己的身份与来意。众人承诺会照顾无辜之人，确保他们安然无恙；在众人起疑之前，你便悄然离去。

column1: Rather than interfere with the guards' momentum, $ChosenOneName points further down the street and yells, "That's right, boys! The guys you want just ran around the corner. Go get 'em!" The guards, encouraged, run on past you. Their sergeant chases them, expostulating futilely. Before he convinces his squad of their error, you have escaped into the maze of city streets.
column2: 与其阻挠卫兵的势头，$ChosenOneName 指向街尾高声喊道：“没错，伙计们！你们要找的人刚转过拐角。快去追！”卫兵们受此鼓舞，从你身旁疾驰而过。他们的军曹在后徒劳地呼喝劝阻。待他使队伍信服其误时，你已遁入城中纵横交错的街巷迷宫。

column1: Reacting as if stung, the Templars immediately draw their weapons and charge into you. There is barely enough time to draw weapons and defend yourselves.
column2: 仿佛被蜇一般，圣殿骑士们立刻拔出武器向你们冲来。你们几乎来不及拔剑自卫。

column1: Reading book after book, $ChosenOneName learns a great deal about the nature and philosophy of religion, and about the spiritual world. $He also learns several new terms and phrases of vulgate Latin, as used by the church.
column2: 逐卷研读，$ChosenOneName 深知宗教之本质与哲理，亦洞悉灵界奥秘。你 更习得教会所用通俗拉丁语之数词句。

column1: Regal in his gorgeous apparel, the high lord makes you feel very humble. "Word has reached my ear," says the lord, "That you possess abilities surpassing those of normal men and women. Kindly show me those abilities. Now."
column2: 身着华服，高贵的领主令你倍感谦卑。“有消息传入我耳，”领主言道，“汝之能力远超常人。请即刻示我。”

column1: Regretfully you say, "Thank you, $ChosenOneName, for your loyal support. Unfortunately, we feel the time has come to part ways. We wish you good fortune and good luck."
column2: 你遗憾地说道：“感谢你，$ChosenOneName，一直以来的忠诚支持。可惜，我们觉得是时候各奔前程了。祝你福运亨通，万事如意。”

column1: Regretfully, $NamedOneName informs you that he has none for sale, but hints that he is prepared to offer a handsome reward for a certain special task...
column2: 遗憾的是，$NamedOneName告知你他并无出售之物，却暗示若能完成某项特殊任务，将给予丰厚报酬……

column1: Reinold's holy power descends, and you are all able to climb the sheer wall of the pit effortlessly, as if it were horizontal rather than vertical.
column2: 雷诺德的圣力降临，你们皆能毫不费力地攀上深坑的陡壁，仿佛那是一段水平而非垂直的路。

column1: Reluctantly the innkeeper accepts your money. Your reputation has suffered here, but your ability to pay has mollified their feelings somewhat.
column2: 酒馆老板勉强收下了你的钱。你的名声在此地受损，但你的支付能力多少缓和了他们的不满。

column1: Reluctantly you release the man, who quickly hobbles away. The shutter closes.
column2: 你勉强放开了那人，他匆匆一瘸一拐地走了。窗板关上了。

column1: Reluctantly, you talk $NamedOneName into providing you with a few new materials that improve your philosopher's stone to quality $Number1. Considering the difficulty of finding such materials, you consider this well worth the $Money1 spent.
column2: 你勉强说服$NamedOneName，让他提供几样能将你的哲人石品质提升至$Number1的新材料。鉴于此类材料难觅，你认为这番花费的$Money1颇值。

column1: Reserved for special result after praying for insight.
column2: 祈祷洞察后，留作特殊结果之用。

column1: Reserved for special result after talking to farmers.
column2: 与农民交谈后，留作特殊结果之用。

column1: Resigned to your intrusion, the woman says, "This is all I have in the world. My husband is dead, my sons and daughters gone. I must live as best I can here, gardening and making friends with the animals."
column2: 她无奈地接受了你的打扰，说道：“这便是我在这世上的一切。丈夫已逝，儿女皆去。我只得在此尽力而为，耕种园圃，与禽兽为友。”

column1: Respectfully, the altar boy explains that the next Mass will not be sung until $NamedOneName.
column2: 小侍者恭敬地解释道，下一场弥撒要到$NamedOneName才会举行。

column1: Retiring to concealment, you don the cloaks and red robe of your erstwhile companions. Then you stride toward the wolves.
column2: 隐身退去，你披上昔日同伴的斗篷与红袍。随即大步走向狼群。

column1: Retreating to an alley, you realize that you could have been trying to stop this, if you had remained loyal to your employer. Now you just watch and wonder about the outcome. Meanwhile, it is clearly impossible to use the main street. You retreat to a side street and reconsider your destination...
column2: 退入一条小巷，你意识到若当初忠于雇主，本可阻止这一切。如今只得旁观，静待结局。与此同时，主街显然已无法通行。你转入一条侧街，重新思量去向……

column1: Reverently, $NamedOneName takes the crown and gently places it upon a velvet cushion.
column2: 虔诚地，$NamedOneName 接过王冠，轻轻置于天鹅绒垫上。

column1: Reverently, $NamedOneName takes the helm and gently places it upon a velvet pillow.
column2: 虔诚地，$NamedOneName接过舵柄，轻轻置于天鹅绒枕上。

column1: Reverently, $NamedOneName takes the weapon and gently places it in a special rack obviously designed to hold that specific item.
column2: 虔诚地，$NamedOneName接过武器，轻轻将其置于一个显然专为该物品设计的特殊架上。

column1: Rich and powerful masters of the clothmakers' guild invite you to discuss the current situation in $PlaceName. Although the conversation is pleasantly banal, the mere invitation increases your standing and prestige throughout the city.
column2: 富有而权势的布商公会首领邀请你商讨$PlaceName的时局。虽则谈话平淡无奇，然此邀已令你在全城声望与地位俱增。

column1: Riding like fury, $ChosenOneName, because of $his horse's quality and $his own riding skill, outpaces the rest of you and brings the thief to ground. Surrounded by your unfriendly faces, the thief offers no resistance. He fact, he breaks into tears and collapses.
column2: 风驰电掣，$ChosenOneName凭借你的良驹与自身骑术，遥遥领先众人，将盗贼掀翻在地。面对你们冷峻的目光，盗贼毫无反抗之意，反而泪流满面，瘫倒在地。

column1: Right now, their words ring true, as blind fear rules your actions...
column2: 如今，他们的话语字字珠玑，盲目之惧主宰着你的行止……

column1: Ringing metal echoes
column2: 金属的回响

column1: Road of the Herbalists and Surgeon-Barbers.
column2: 草药师与外科理发师之路。

column1: Roaring its anger, $NamedTwoName opens its maw and belches forth a sheet of flame, engulfing the hapless $NamedThreeName. The priest screams in his final agony, "Holy angels, receive my spirit!" Then only blackened bones remain.
column2: $NamedTwoName 愤怒地咆哮，张开巨口喷出一片火焰，将不幸的 $NamedThreeName 焚为灰烬。祭司在最后的痛苦中嘶喊道：“圣洁的天使啊，请接纳我的灵魂！”随后只余焦黑的骸骨。

column1: Roaring its anger, the dragon $NamedTwoName breathes forth gusts of flame that engulf you all. Your clothes burning, you tumble over and over to the bottom of the slope. You lie stunned for some time, but fortunately the fall extinguished the fire.
column2: 龙怒吼着，$NamedTwoName喷出阵阵火焰，将你们尽数吞没。衣衫燃尽，你们翻滚着坠至坡底。一时昏厥，所幸坠落扑灭了火焰。

column1: Roaring its fury, the dragon shrieks. "I am the only begotten! Worship me!"
column2: 龙怒吼着，发出尖啸：“我是独生子！崇拜我吧！”

column1: Rostock
column2: 罗斯托克

column1: Rough stone slabs circle a grassy hillock. In the center a rude table-stone rests on top of a smaller rock. This is most certainly a pagan altar.
column2: 粗糙的石板环绕着一座青草覆盖的小丘。中央，一块简陋的石桌稳立于较小的岩石之上。这无疑是一座异教祭坛。

column1: Rough stone slabs stand in a circle, guarding a grassy hillock. In the center a rude table-stone rests on top of a smaller rock. Yes, this is the pagan altar you sought. Beneath the altar, in a hollow, you see the $NamedOneName.
column2: 粗糙的石板围成一圈，守护着一座青草覆盖的小丘。中央一块简陋的石桌立于较小的岩石之上。是的，这正是你所寻的异教祭坛。在祭坛下方的凹处，你看见了$NamedOneName。

column1: Ruminating before answering, the village priest finally says, "I fear there is little of worth that I can tell you. I hold Mass for the village every day at Prime, and every Sunday at Prime and Vespers. The nearest city is $NearestCity."
column2: 村里的神父沉吟良久，方道：“我恐无甚要事可告于君。每日晨祷为村民举行弥撒，每逢主日则于晨祷与晚祷之时举行。最近之城邑乃$NearestCity。”

column1: Rumor has it that $NamedOneName is trying to hire a few reliable, stalwart adventurers to recover a certain object.
column2: 传闻$NamedOneName正试图招募几位可靠、坚毅的冒险者，以寻回某件物品。

column1: Rumors are abuzz concerning strange and horrible events in the countryside. Houses have been blasted to bits, hillsides raked into deep furrows, women carried off. No one seems to know the full story, however.
column2: 乡间传闻四起，皆言怪异骇人之事。房屋被炸得粉碎，山坡犁出深沟，妇人被掳走。然则，无人知晓全貌。

column1: Rumors are abuzz concerning strange and horrible events in the countryside. People have vanished, pigs been killed, and farms burned. The old lady repeats those rumors she remembers, but gets them mixed up. In the end, she advises you to talk to the village schulz.
column2: 乡间传闻四起，皆言怪异可怖之事。有人失踪，猪只遭戮，农舍尽焚。老妪复述她所记之传言，却多有混淆。终而劝君去寻村长一谈。

column1: Rumors say someone with serious money is hiring for an unusual job. You can't determine if it's one of the merchants in the central market, a wealthy priest or bishop, or possibly the leader of the city. It is clear that the person is desperate. You need to act quickly, before they find someone else!
column2: 谣言称，有位腰缠万贯之人正在招募人手，从事一项非同寻常的差事。你无法断定此人是中央市场的商贾、富有的神父或主教，抑或是城中之首。显而易见，此人已到了山穷水尽的地步。你须当机立断，莫要迟疑，免得他另觅他人！

column1: Running for what seems like forever, you finally outlast the guards. Panting and coughing, you lean against a building and try to catch your breath. You have seen a lot of $PlaceName 's back ways in the last while -- too bad there was no time to appreciate the tour!
column2: 仿佛奔跑了许久，你终于甩开了守卫。气喘吁吁、咳嗽不止，你倚靠在一栋建筑上，努力平复呼吸。这段时间里，你已见识了不少$PlaceName的后巷——可惜当时无暇欣赏这趟“游览”！

column1: Running hard, you finally manage to elude the pursuing cutthroats.
column2: 拼命奔跑，你终于摆脱了追击的歹徒。

column1: Running hard, you scramble through the rocks and trees until the lake is far behind you. You light a fire and wait through the night, trembling. You hope against hope that more survived, but none join your campfire in the night. This seems a high price for the $NamedOneName, but you cannot undo deeds now done.
column2: 你奋力奔跑，穿过岩石与树林，直至湖泊远在身后。你燃起篝火，瑟瑟发抖地熬过一夜。你心怀一线希望，盼着还有幸存者，但夜色中无人前来你的营火旁。这似乎为$NamedOneName付出了高昂代价，然而事已至此，无法挽回。

column1: Running hard, you scramble through the rocks and trees until the lake is far behind you. You light a fire and wait through the night, trembling. You thank the heavens that no one was killed.
column2: 你奋力奔跑，穿过岩石与树林，直至湖泊远在身后。你点燃篝火，瑟瑟发抖地度过一夜。你庆幸无人丧命。

column1: Running through the underbrush, you miraculously manage to keep ahead of the Wild Hunt until morning, when your pursuers fade back into mist. You are saved!
column2: 穿梭于灌木丛中，你奇迹般地始终领先于狂野狩猎队，直至晨曦时分，追兵渐隐于雾霭之中。你得救了！

column1: Rustling noises alert you. Then, a split second later, cutthroat thieves leap from ambush!
column2: 咔嚓作响的声响惊动了你。随即，片刻之后，凶狠的盗贼从伏击中跃出！

column1: S.
column2: S.

column1: SAW
column2: 看见

column1: SIDE STREET A - ERROR!!!
column2: 侧街A - 错误！！！

column1: SIDE STREET B - ERROR!
column2: 侧街B - 错误！

column1: SILVER: At least one of we three is a liar.
column2: 银：我们三人中至少有一个在撒谎。

column1: SILVER: Nenn is not gold. The son of Elt is Krocht.
column2: 白银：嫩恩非金。埃尔特之子乃克罗赫特。

column1: SILVER: That is true. Gold is indeed Aubyn.
column2: 银：确实如此。黄金确为奥宾。

column1: SINGING
column2: 歌唱

column1: SIX: Black is white. Copper opens the door.
column2: 六：黑即白。铜开其门。

column1: SIX: I am Hansu.
column2: 六：我是汉苏。

column1: SIX: Lead cannot open the door.
column2: 六：铅无法打开这扇门。

column1: STARS
column2: 星辰

column1: STEPHEN.
column2: 斯蒂芬。

column1: STUBBLE.
column2: 麦茬。

column1: SWITZERLAND
column2: 瑞士

column1: Sad but determined, $ChosenOneName has decided to take $his leave.
column2: 悲伤却坚定，$ChosenOneName 决定告别 你的。

column1: Sadly, you all agree.
column2: 可悲的是，你们都同意了。

column1: Sadly, you are forced to agree with him. After this, the rebel cause will lose much of its support.
column2: 可悲的是，你不得不与他达成一致。此后，叛军的事业将失去大部分支持。

column1: Sadly, you bury $ChosenOneName and pray for $his soul.
column2: 可悲的是，你埋葬了$ChosenOneName，并为你的灵魂祈祷。

column1: Sadly, you walk down and bury the dead. It's the least you can do.
column2: 可悲的是，你只得走下山去，埋葬死者。这已是你能做的最少之事。

column1: Safe atop a hillock, you spend a cold, miserable day waiting for the waters to recede. "At least we saved everything," comments $ChosenOneName.
column2: 安然立于小丘之上，你度过了一日的寒冷与困苦，静待水势退去。“至少我们保住了所有东西，”$ChosenOneName说道。

column1: Saint Bathildis certainly operates in a peculiar way. A mysterious nun appears and hands your turnkey a sum of money. Somehow you know the money is your own. The turnkey, walking in a daze, opens your door and you are led out. Each time guards are met, the strange nun gives them money, and they seem to forget about your presence. Soon you are outside. When you try to thank the nun, she is gone.
column2: 圣巴蒂尔迪斯行事果然奇特。一位神秘修女现身，将一笔银钱交予狱卒。不知为何，你确信这笔钱正是你的。狱卒恍惚间打开牢门，引你出狱。每遇守卫，那修女便施以金钱，他们竟皆忘却你的存在。不久，你已置身户外。欲向修女致谢，她却已杳然无踪。

column1: Saint Cecilia gives you all the ability to survive underwater without any need for air. You calmly swim under the flaming waves, ignoring the holocaust above. When you reach the other side, you climb out, wring out your clothing, and proceed.
column2: 圣塞西莉亚赐予你无需呼吸即可在水下生存之能。你从容游过烈焰翻腾的波涛，无视上方的浩劫。抵达彼岸后，你攀出水面，拧干衣衫，继续前行。

column1: Saint Day is November 6
column2: 圣日为十一月六日

column1: Saint Jude hears your plea, and an earthquake shudders through the jail. One side of the building splits open, and you walk out. The other prisoners and guards moan in terror.
column2: 圣朱德听到了你的祈求，一场地震撼动了牢狱。建筑的一侧裂开，你走了出去。其余的囚犯与守卫惊恐地哀嚎。

column1: Saint Lucy hears your pleas. A divine ray shines into the dark cell, giving you light to see by. When the jailor comes by, Lucy's light fades, so he never knows of its existence.
column2: 圣露西听到了你的祈求。一道神圣的光芒射入黑暗的牢房，为你带来光明。当狱卒经过时，露西的光芒便消逝，因此他从未察觉它的存在。

column1: Saint Lucy's light at last fades. You are returned to the darkness.
column2: 圣露西娅的光芒终于消逝。你被送回黑暗之中。

column1: Saint Reinold's name is invoked by $ChosenOneName and he responds with power. The windowless height of a nearby building suddenly gleams with light. $ChosenOneName leads you to the building. Lightly you step from the ground onto the masonry. Defying gravity, each of you walks up the wall, your body parallel to the ground beneath.
column2: 圣莱诺德之名被$ChosenOneName唤起，他以神力回应。附近一幢无窗的高楼陡然光芒大盛。$ChosenOneName引领你们前往那座建筑。你们轻盈地自地面跃上石墙。无视重力，你们皆沿墙面而行，身体与下方地面平行。

column1: Saintly aid is not to be yours this time; you must decide on your own what path to follow.
column2: 这一次，圣者的庇佑将不再属于你；你必须自行抉择前行之路。

column1: Saintly aid is not to be yours; you must decide on your own what path to follow.
column2: 圣洁的援助不属于你；你必须自行决定前行的道路。

column1: Satisfied with $NamedOneName's oath, you give him the treasure. He glares at you.
column2: 满意于$NamedOneName的誓言，你将宝物交予他。他怒视着你。

column1: Satisfied with $NamedOneName's oath, you hand back his red cap. He glares at you.
column2: 满意于$NamedOneName的誓言，你将他的红帽递还。他怒视着你。

column1: Satisfied, you all climb down as you ascended, reaching the bottom safely.
column2: 满意地，你们如上山般下山，安全抵达谷底。

column1: Satisfied, you nod once to him and resume your travels.
column2: 满意地，你向他点了点头，继续踏上旅途。

column1: Satisified, you turn around and see the captain of the city guard watching you. "Good work," he says, "couldn't have done better myself!"
column2: 满意地，你转身看见城卫队长正注视着你。“干得好，”他说，“我自己也做不到更好了！”

column1: Say out loud the name on the stone.
column2: 大声念出石碑上的名字。

column1: Saying fond farewells, you wish $ChosenOneName good luck here in $PlaceName.
column2: 说着依依惜别的话，你祝$ChosenOneName在$PlaceName好运。

column1: Scattered about you are the remains of last night's ceremony: shreds of clothing, charred spots on the ground, and many sleeping worshippers. Painfully, you climb to your feet as you hear the clang of bells announcing the feast; since that seems to be the main activity of the day, you move in that direction.
column2: 你周围散落着昨夜仪式的残迹：衣衫褴褛、地面上焦黑斑驳，还有许多熟睡的信徒。你忍痛站起身来，耳边传来宣告盛宴的钟声；既然那似乎是今日的主要活动，你便朝那个方向走去。

column1: Schleswig.
column2: 石勒苏益格。

column1: Scoffing at your weakness, Baphomet utters a word of power. Suddenly a rain of ice and fire falls from the sky. Baphomet cackles, "All the world's plants shall be destroyed! Great famine shall stalk the Earth!"
column2: 巴佛墨特嗤笑你的孱弱，念出一句咒语。顿时，冰火交织的暴雨自天而降。巴佛墨特狞笑道：“天下草木皆当尽毁！大饥馑将席卷大地！”

column1: Scouts of the army, hidden in the brush on a hillside, stand up and wave you past. They have obviously gotten the word that you are friends, not enemies.
column2: 隐于山坡灌木丛中的军队斥候站起身来，向你挥手示意通过。显然，他们已得知你是友非敌。

column1: Scraping away, $ChosenOneName manages to weaken $his ropes to the point where $he can snap them. $He creeps over to the pile of your captured weapons and retrieves. Soon you are all armed and untied. Then the cultists at last turn from their revels to notice you. Slavering with anger, they assault you at once.
column2: 费力挣扎，$ChosenOneName终于将你的根绳索磨断至可被你挣脱的程度。你悄悄摸到你被缴获的武器堆旁，取回了它们。不久，你们皆已武装并解开束缚。这时，邪教徒们方才从狂欢中回过神来，注意到你们。他们怒吼着，立刻向你们发起攻击。

column1: Screaming imprecations, a wild-eyed holy man traipses across the ravaged countryside. He shouts, "I am $NamedThreeName. Whose side serve ye?"
column2: 号啕咒骂着，一位双眼狂乱的圣人踉跄行过满目疮痍的乡野。他高呼：“吾乃$NamedThreeName。汝等效忠何方？”

column1: Searching for hours, you cannot find the thief's hidey-hole.
column2: 寻觅多时，仍不得贼之藏身之处。

column1: Second, you could set a roadside ambush for the raubritter's men.
column2: 其次，你可在路边设伏，袭击那名劫匪骑士的部下。

column1: Seconds later, a crippled old woman is beside you, tapping $ChosenOneName on the shoulder.
column2: 片刻之后，一位跛足的老妇人来到你身旁，轻拍着$ChosenOneName的肩膀。

column1: Seconds later, a scullery woman is beside you, tapping $ChosenOneName on the shoulder.
column2: 几秒后，一名厨房女仆来到你身旁，轻拍$ChosenOneName的肩膀。

column1: Seeing your surrender, the guard captain gives a wicked grin. "Well, we should a collect a little for ourselves too, for our trouble!" His men rumble in agreement.
column2: 见你屈服，守卫队长露出一抹阴险的笑。“嗯，我们总得为自己辛苦赚点好处！”他的手下也随声附和。

column1: Seeing your surrender, the knight gives a wicked grin. "Well, boys, let's collect a little extra for our trouble!" His men rumble in agreement.
column2: 见你屈服，骑士露出阴险的笑容。“好啦，伙计们，咱们再捞点好处！”他的手下齐声附和。

column1: Senses suddenly sharp, $ChosenOneName smells something evil and dangerous lurking in the cave, its odor as rancid as decaying flesh. Unfortunately, $he also senses that the $NamedOneName can be found within.
column2: 感官骤然敏锐，$ChosenOneName闻到洞穴中潜伏着邪恶而危险的气息，其臭味如腐肉般腥臭。不幸的是，你也察觉到$NamedOneName就在其中。

column1: Sensing weakness, the demon bores in, "Ignorance is no excuse. And when has 'fairness' been a legal consideration? You are mine!"
column2: 感知到你的软弱，恶魔钻了进来：“无知不是借口。况且，‘公平’何时成为过法律的考量？你是我的！”

column1: Set into the door are five knobs, labeled A, E, I, O, and U. Which knob should you press? The wrong one may release a dwarf trap! You ponder, then press ...
column2: 门上镶嵌着五个旋钮，分别标有A、E、I、O和U。你该按哪一个？按错可能会触发矮人机关！你沉思片刻，然后按下……

column1: Shaking his head slowly, $NamedOneName sadly agrees.
column2: 摇了摇头，$NamedOneName 悲伤地同意了。

column1: Shaking his head, $NamedOneName replies, "I'm sorry, I have no need for additional medicines, and do not wish to sell any either."
column2: 摇了摇头，$NamedOneName 回答道：“抱歉，我并不需要额外的药物，也不想出售任何药物。”

column1: Shaking his head, $NamedOneName says, "I must be honest; your abilities are beyond my own. I cannot provide you with any improvements in your philosopher's stone."
column2: 摇了摇头，$NamedOneName说道：“我必须坦诚；你的造诣远在我之上。我无法在你的哲人石上为你带来任何提升。”

column1: Shaking his head, the monk says, "I'm sorry, we cannot help you tonight. Please return tomorrow morning, and perhaps something could be done."
column2: 僧侣摇摇头，说道：“抱歉，今晚我们无法助你一臂之力。请明日清晨再来，或许尚有可为。”

column1: Shamefaced, you realize she is right. It was foolish to betray a winning cause. When the city guards get through with the rebels, whose cause seems hopeless, they will come after you next. In a panic, you collect your possessions and seek the best way to leave $PlaceName...
column2: 你羞愧地意识到她说得对。背叛必胜之局，实属愚蠢。待城卫军处置完那些看似无望的叛徒后，下一个目标便是你。惊慌之下，你收拾行囊，寻觅离开$PlaceName的最佳途径……

column1: Shamefaced, you realize she is right. Worse, you realize that the rebels are likely fight off this government attack, and will certainly come looking for you! All you can think of is the vengeance they will take. Quickly, you collect things and begin running...
column2: 你羞愧地意识到她说得没错。更糟的是，你明白叛军很可能会击退这次政府的进攻，并且一定会来找你！你满脑子都是他们将施加的报复。你匆忙收拾好东西，开始奔跑……

column1: Shamefaced, you realize that she is right. Now both the government and the rebels will hate you, so it really doesn't matter who wins.
column2: 你羞愧地意识到她说得对。如今无论是政府还是叛军都会憎恨你，所以谁赢都已无关紧要。

column1: She answers promptly, "My son-in-law raises horses on his farm. I'm sure he would be happy to deal with you." He lives only a few yards from the old woman, and soon you are there, looking over his animals.
column2: 她爽快地答道：“我的女婿在自家农场养马。他定会乐意与你打交道。”他家离老妇人不过数步之遥，不一会儿你就到了那里，打量着他的牲畜。

column1: She bows her head and begins. "There are five High Sabbats each year where witches and witch-priests meet to worship Satan in the form of a demon. The next is on $SabbatTime, $SabbatLocation."
column2: 她低垂螓首，缓缓道来：“每年有五个大安息日，女巫与巫师齐聚一堂，以恶魔之形祭拜撒旦。下一次将在$SabbatTime、$SabbatLocation。”

column1: She continues, "Now their power is strong enough. They plan to unleash the Apocalypse upon the world: the seven plagues of the New Testament. Here in this castle they have imprisoned the Seven Keys which can stop their terrible plan. You must find the keys and use them against Baphomet's wicked magic. But do not be fooled. Here is one of the keys."
column2: 她继续道：“如今他们的力量已足够强大。他们欲向世间降下启示录：新约中的七大灾祸。在此城堡之中，他们囚禁着七把钥匙，足以阻止其邪恶之计。汝须寻得诸钥，并以其对抗巴佛墨特之邪术。然勿被蒙蔽。此乃其中一钥。”

column1: She does as asked, making and demonstrating the use of each potion in turn. Satisfied, you let her go with a stern warning to spurn Satan's temptations and return to the ways of the Lord.
column2: 她依言行事，逐一配制并演示每种药剂的用法。你满意地放她离去，并严词告诫她远离撒旦的诱惑，重返主之道。

column1: She falls silent.
column2: 她沉默了。

column1: She gives you a suspicious look and wanders away muttering "...take up my valuable time ...."
column2: 她用怀疑的目光看着你，一边嘀咕着“……浪费我宝贵的时间……”一边走开了。

column1: She hands you a glass globe filled with water, inside of which swims a live trout. Its scales glisten. She tells you, "Do not lose this."
column2: 她递予汝一玻璃球，内盛清水，一鳟鱼游弋其中，鳞光熠熠。她告诫汝：“切勿遗失此物。”

column1: She hesitates, then replies, "I make sure that certain birth documents are never found. These documents show him to be the son of a peasant serf, and therefore an illegal resident of $PlaceName !"
column2: 她犹豫了一下，然后答道：“我确保某些出生文书永远无法被发现。这些文书显示他是农奴之子，因此是$PlaceName的非法居民！”

column1: She hesitates, then replies, "I provided him with a certain poison. Very slow, but very deadly, many years ago. Shortly after that, his predecessor died, and he was elected master and leader." She continues, telling you about the stains the poison once made on his leg when he spilled it.
column2: 她犹豫片刻，答道：“多年前，我曾为他提供了一种毒药。毒性极缓，却极为致命。不久之后，他的前任便去世了，而他被推举为大师与领袖。”她继续说道，向你讲述那毒药曾因倾洒而在他腿上留下的斑痕。

column1: She is true to her word, carefully copying out three formulas for each of you, while you stand guard over her. $ChosenOneName examines the work carefully, then asks her to demonstrate the formulas.
column2: 她信守承诺，为你们每人精心抄录三份配方，而你则在一旁守护。$ChosenOneName 仔细查验她的作品，随后命她演示这些配方。

column1: She looks at you and shakes her head. "I am sad. Do you think I have not given you everything in my power? I cannot say how short or long your route may be. If you feel unprepared, husband your strengh, skills and riches, and then try again."
column2: 她望向你，摇了摇头。“我很伤心。你以为我没有倾尽全力吗？我无法预知你的旅途是短是长。若觉未备，便且积蓄力量、技艺与财富，再行尝试吧。”

column1: She looks up. "There, my half is completed, now let me go." Reluctantly, you do so, while urging her to be repentant, to return to God, and to spurn the dark blandishments of heretics.
column2: 她抬眸望向你：“如此，我的半程已毕，如今请放我离去。”你虽不情愿，却仍依言放她离去，并劝诫她痛悔归正，重返上帝怀抱，摒弃异端的黑暗诱惑。

column1: She looks very sad. "I'm sorry, nothing more is clear to me. It is now entirely in your hands. Do what you can, and pray that it is enough."
column2: 她显得十分忧伤。“抱歉，我已无计可施。如今一切尽在你手中。尽力而为吧，祈求这足以扭转乾坤。”

column1: She nods with a neutral expression. "My arts say that you have not yet been successful. Alas, I can offer no additional aid. When your efforts have been crowned by victory, then I can spy more. Until then, all I see is the Apocalypse approaching, like a fast horse coming down through the years of the future, toward the present. But in your lifetimes there is still time to influence these things." She dismisses you.
column2: 她面无表情地点了点头。“我的术法显示，你尚未成功。唉，我无法再予助力。待你功成之时，我方可窥得更多。在此之前，我所见唯有末日将至，如疾驰的骏马自未来岁月奔腾而来，直逼今朝。然在汝等有生之年，尚可扭转乾坤。”她挥手示意你退下。

column1: She opens the door, glancing at the guards all around. You decide the only feasible course is to leave, now.
column2: 她打开门，环视四周的守卫。你认定唯一可行之策便是即刻离开。

column1: She replies calmly, "It is simple. I once performed a valuable service for him, and now he pays me regularly."
column2: 她平静地回答：“很简单。我曾为他做过一件有益的事，如今他定期酬谢于我。”

column1: She returns in a white samite, a paper crown on her head. Dancing peasants precede her. But then, the celebration turns sour. She is grabbed and dragged to a large stake in a nearby field.
column2: 她身着白色锦缎归来，头戴纸冠。舞动的农夫在她前方引路。然而，庆典却陡转阴霾。她被抓住，拖至附近田野中的一根大木桩前。

column1: She shakes her head and looks at you. "A Great Seal is intact, so a route that seems open, is in reality closed. Seek the High Sabbat, the evil convocation of Satan's worshippers."
column2: 她摇了摇头，望向你。“一枚大印完好无损，看似通途，实则已闭。去寻那高 Sabbat，撒旦信徒的邪恶集会。”

column1: She shakes her head and looks at you. "The Great Seal is intact. You must return to the Templar monastery and reach it. Yes, I know the route seems open, but in reality it is closed. The Templar Seal is a lock that you must break."
column2: 她摇了摇头，望向你。“大印完好无损。汝须重返圣殿骑士修道院，抵达彼处。诚然，路径看似通达，实则闭塞。圣殿之印乃一锁，汝须破之。”

column1: She shows you the door, cunningly hidden. You wait and one hour later it clicks open. You quietly slip through into the tower.
column2: 她为你指引那扇巧妙隐藏的门。你静候片刻，一小时后，门悄然开启。你悄然潜入塔楼。

column1: She smiles. "Well met once more. No, say nothing, please, just listen to my visions. Then leave and choose your own course. Additional questions are, alas, futile. My arts are limited. I can provide nothing beyond this..."
column2: 她微笑。“再会。且慢开口，请静听吾之幻象。尔后离去，自择前路。余问徒劳，吾术有限，仅能至此……”

column1: She stands up and you get another shock! Though a woman, she is no human! She is covered with soft silky hair, except for her face, hands, feet, and breasts. She is a holzfrau, a wild woman, usually seen only once in a lifetime and then from afar!
column2: 她起身，汝又惊！虽为女身，却非凡人！除面、手、足及双乳外，遍覆柔密绒毛。此乃木妇，野性之女，一生难遇，且多远观而不见其真容！

column1: She stares directly at you. "But alas, your power is not great enough for this task. Go forth, train, seek experience, adventure and fame. Until you do, my vision is clouded. Then return and I will have more."
column2: 她直视于汝。“惜哉，汝之力尚不足以胜任此任。去吧，历练，求经验，觅冒险与威名。未至之时，吾之见犹朦胧。届时归来，吾当有更多启示。”

column1: She swears to leave witchcraft, to resist the temptations of Satan, and return to proper ways and observances. You spend the rest of the day instructing her as best you can, then take her to your camp, to watch over her during the dangerous nighttime hours.
column2: 她发誓弃绝巫术，抵御撒旦的诱惑，重归正道与虔诚之礼。你尽己所能地教导她一整天，随后将她带回营地，在那危险的夜半时分守护她。

column1: She then points to the back of the boat, where you see a huge book, like the one you found in the Knights Templar's fortress-monastery. She says, "This book is bound with the Third, Fourth, Fifth, and Sixth Seals of the Apocalypse, which prevent you from finding the other Keys." She spreads forth her hands and prays to the Virgin Mary. Suddenly the four seals burst open wide. "I have long prayed to Heaven for the power to thus destroy Baphomet's works. Go and prosper."
column2: 她随即指向船尾，只见一本巨册，与你在圣殿骑士团的堡垒修道院中所见者无异。她言道：“此书以《启示录》之第三、第四、第五、第六封印封缄，使汝难觅其余钥。”她双掌摊开，向圣母玛利亚祈祷。忽而，四封尽皆裂开。“吾久祈天恩，得破巴佛墨特之邪术。去罢，愿汝顺遂。”

column1: Sheathing $his weapons, $ChosenOneName walks over to the lieutenant of the guardsmen. $He tries to convince the officer that it is neither in his own best interest, nor the best interest of $PlaceName, that the guardsmen attack their own citizens. However, the lieutenant points out that the citizens are accompanied by foreign troops, the mercenaries.
column2: 收起你的武器，$ChosenOneName走向卫兵的副官。你试图说服这位军官，无论是对他自己还是对$PlaceName而言，卫兵攻击自己的市民都非明智之举。然而，副官指出，这些市民还携带着外国军队——雇佣兵。

column1: Sheathing $his weapons, $ChosenOneName walks over to the lieutenant of the guardsmen. In a quiet conversation, $he convinces the officer that it is neither in his own best interest, nor the best interest of $PlaceName, that the guardsmen attack their own citizens.
column2: 收起你的武器，$ChosenOneName走向卫兵的副官。在一番低声交谈中，你说服了这位军官：无论是对他自己，还是对$PlaceName而言，卫兵攻击自己的百姓都非明智之举。

column1: Shocked by the potion, the thugs turn around to see you grinning, weapons drawn. Slowly they back away, then turn tail and run.
column2: 被药剂惊得目瞪口呆，歹徒们转身看见你手持武器、面露狞笑。他们缓缓后退，随即掉头逃窜。

column1: Shocked, the gate guards rush to your aid. "Quickly, help these wounded inside!" orders a monk.
column2: 惊愕中，守门的卫兵急忙上前相助。“快，将这些伤者送入内院！”一名修士下令。

column1: Shocked, the priest recoils from your suggestion. "What? You would have me violate the laws of our fair city? Avaunt!" He calls for the turnkey and tells him of your infamy. The turnkey, angered, transfers you to an inferior cell.
column2: 震惊之下，牧师对你的提议退缩。“什么？你要我违背我们这座公正之城的律法？滚开！”他唤来狱卒，告知其你的恶名。狱卒怒不可遏，将你移至一间劣质牢房。

column1: Shocked, you ...
column2: 惊愕中，你……

column1: Shortly after $ChosenOneName begins to beseech the heavens, a peculiar feeling comes over you. Suddenly you realize that you have become invisible. You wriggle loose from the ropes, stand up, recover your weapons, and simply walk away from the puzzled cultists.
column2: 不久之后，$ChosenOneName 开始向苍天祈求，一种奇异的感觉涌上心头。你猛然意识到自己已变得无形。挣脱绳索，站起身来，拾起武器，径直从困惑的教徒们身边离去。

column1: Shortly after $ChosenOneName finishes praying, the gate opens. The raubritter steps out and welcomes you. "Come inside, let us eat and drink together."
column2: $ChosenOneName 刚刚祈祷完毕，城门便开了。劫匪骑士走出，向你致意：“请进，让我们共饮同食。”

column1: Shortly after beginning to climb, $ChosenOneName struggles to continue. Halfway up, $he slips and falls with a sickening thud. $His stealth and agility aren't enough for this task.
column2: 刚开始攀登不久，$ChosenOneName便难以继续。半途而废，你滑倒，发出一声令人作呕的闷响。你的隐秘与敏捷在此任务面前仍显不足。

column1: Shouting frantically, $ChosenOneName loudly implores the heavens for aid. Many sailors pray with $him, but the storm's fury continues.
column2: 疯狂地呼喊着，$ChosenOneName 大声向苍天祈求援助。许多水手与 你 一同祈祷，但风暴的怒吼依旧不止。

column1: Showing enormous courage, $ChosenOneName steps up to speak. "Loathly $NamedTwoName, here is your golden cup. We have punished the thief who despoiled you. Cease your ravages on the land roundabout, or die!"
column2: 壮胆上前，$ChosenOneName 开口道：“可怖的 $NamedTwoName，这是你的金杯。我们已惩治了劫掠你的窃贼。若不停止对周遭土地的蹂躏，便唯有死路一条！”

column1: Showing enormous courage, $ChosenOneName steps up to speak. "Loathsome $NamedTwoName, remain in your lair. As your doom is to emerge at the Last Day, wait for the appointed time! If you defy the edicts of Heaven, you will be slain. Sleep on!"
column2: 壮胆上前，$ChosenOneName 开口道：“可憎的$NamedTwoName，留在你的巢穴中吧。既定末日将至，且待天命降临！若敢违逆天意，必遭诛戮。去吧！”
