column1: Showing enormous courage, $ChosenOneName steps up to speak. "Loathsome $NamedTwoName, the vile witches that summoned you are gone. We have driven them away. Return to Hell whence you came, or be slain!"
column2: 壮士 $ChosenOneName 慷慨陈词：“可憎的 $NamedTwoName，召唤你的恶巫已亡。我们已将她们驱逐。速归地狱，否则必死！”

column1: Showing enormous courage, $ChosenOneName steps up to speak. "Loathsome $NamedTwoName, you need no longer ravage the earth. You have come as a judgement on the land. The people are punished, and now there is no further need of you. Cease your attacks or perish!"
column2: 展现出无比的勇气，$ChosenOneName上前发言。“可憎的$NamedTwoName，你无需再蹂躏大地。你乃是降临此地的审判。百姓已受惩罚，如今不再需要你了。停止你的攻击，否则必死无疑！”

column1: Shuddering, $ChosenOneName awakes. "My friends," $he says to the rest of you, "I fear there may be great evil here. My visions tell me this lord is a heretic and devil-worshipper."
column2: 颤抖着，$ChosenOneName醒来。“诸位朋友，”你对你们众人说道，“我恐此处有大邪。吾之幻象示此主乃异端，且崇拜恶魔。”

column1: Silently whispering a brief prayer, $ChosenOneName receives no answer. You are on your own.
column2: 默默低语着简短的祷告，$ChosenOneName 却未得回应。你唯有独自前行。

column1: Silently you agree. Hiding in the bushes all night is perfectly awful.
column2: 你默然应允。整夜藏身灌木丛中，实在糟糕透顶。

column1: Silently you watch the thugs climb into the windows of the guild. You wait and watch, and eventually they climb out again. As the sky begins to lighten, they slip away down a dark alley. Inside you hear cries of alarm and anguish.
column2: 你静静地注视着那些恶徒攀上公会的窗户。你耐心等待，最终见他们又爬了出来。天色渐明时，他们悄然遁入一条幽暗的小巷。屋内传来惊恐与悲痛的呼喊声。

column1: Silently, $ChosenOneName calls upon $NamedOneName for aid. A warm feeling spreads throughout your body, and you are suffused with powerful emotion. You can barely hear the richter's words as he orders you to be tortured to force you to plead guilty or innocent. All the ministrations of the torturers make but little impression on you. You feel no pain, and the few wounds you receive bleed little.
column2: 默默地，$ChosenOneName 向 $NamedOneName 祈求援助。一股暖流遍洒全身，你被强烈的感情所充盈。你几乎听不见法官的言语，他下令对你施以酷刑，逼迫你自白或否认。所有行刑者的折磨对你几无影响。你毫无痛感，所受的些许伤痕亦鲜有流血。

column1: Silently, $ChosenOneName evokes Saint Emydius, who answers with power. Suddenly the earth shakes with a mighty rumbling. The dancing witches fall over, unable to retain their footing. With a shattering crack, the side of the cavern splits open. The witches flee in terror.
column2: 默然间，$ChosenOneName 召唤圣埃米迪乌斯，其应声而至，威能赫赫。忽地，大地震颤，轰鸣如雷。舞动的女巫失足倾倒，难保身形。洞壁骤裂，发出惊天巨响。女巫惊恐奔逃。

column1: Silently, $ChosenOneName halts the party. $He points to the brush on the hillside. You look carefully, and finally see soldiers hidden there, watching the way ahead. You...
column2: 默然间，$ChosenOneName 令众人止步。你 指向山坡上的灌木丛。你细察之下，终见隐于其间的士兵，正监视前方要道。你...

column1: Silently, $ChosenOneName prays. $He learns that the castle lord is a templar, a man of evil who traffics with witches.
column2: 默默地，$ChosenOneName 祈祷。你 得知城堡之主乃一名圣殿骑士，一个与女巫勾结的恶人。

column1: Silently, $ChosenOneName prays. In $his mind's eye, $he sees this lord suddenly flying into a rage and whipping or executing his peasants on a whim. $He sees a beautiful farmer's daughter, badly beaten, weeping in her bed after a night in the keep with the lord. $He sees crippled old men, respected grandfathers, driven into the wilderness as useless mouths.
column2: 默默地，$ChosenOneName 祈祷着。在 你的 的脑海中，你 看见这位领主忽而暴怒，随意鞭笞或处决他的农奴。你 看见一位美丽的农家少女，在与领主共度一夜后，被毒打一番，卧床哭泣。你 看见那些残废的老人，受人敬重的祖父们，被当作无用之口驱逐至荒野。

column1: Silently, $ChosenOneName prays. Slowly, he sees lines of worry and care form on the lord's face. $He looks into the lord's eyes and sees marauding armies and burning farms.
column2: 默然间，$ChosenOneName 祈祷。缓缓地，他见领主额上浮现忧虑与愁苦之纹。你 注视领主双眸，但见劫掠之师与焚毁之田。

column1: Silently, $ChosenOneName prays. Suddenly, $he has a flash of insight. This lord is an honest man, as good and just as one can be in such a hard world.
column2: 默默地，$ChosenOneName 祈祷着。忽然，你 脑海中灵光一闪。这位领主乃正直之人，在这艰难世道中，堪称善良公正。

column1: Silently, $ChosenOneName prays. Unfortunately, $he has no flash of insight, no waking dream to guide $him. Today, this prayer is not answered.
column2: 默默地，$ChosenOneName 祈祷。不幸的是，你 并无灵光乍现，亦无醒梦指引 你。今日，此祷未得应允。

column1: Silver says, "Yes, Gold is Tifsyn. But I am Gymer."
column2: 银说道：“是的，金便是提夫辛。但我乃吉默尔。”

column1: Silver: The copper head speaks the truth.
column2: 银币：铜币头颅说的是真话。

column1: Since it is still light out, you wait until dark to make your move.
column2: 因天色尚明，你待至夜深方伺机而动。

column1: Since the Hussites are on foot, you easily ride away from them. Their shouts of anger fade into the distance, but you must take a route around them, which takes time.
column2: 由于胡斯派皆徒步而行，你轻易便策马远离。他们愤怒的呼喊渐行渐远，然你仍需绕道而行，耗时颇久。

column1: Singing a brief hymn of praise to Saint Christina the Astonishing, $ChosenOneName invokes the protection of Heaven. In moments you feel yourself lifted into the air by invisible divine hands, carried a mile from the flabbergasted peasants, and deposited safely on the ground.
column2: 唱着一曲献给惊世圣克里斯蒂娜的简短赞歌，$ChosenOneName祈求天界的庇佑。顷刻间，你感到自己被无形的神之手托起，远离惊愕的农夫们一英里，安然落地。

column1: Sir $NamedOneName continues. "There was a mighty roar, and the top of the hill blew off; the monster rose into the sky. My men's arrows rattled off its iron scales.
column2: $NamedOneName大人继续说道：“一声巨响，山顶被炸飞；那怪物腾空而起。我军的箭矢击打在其铁甲之上，叮当作响。”

column1: Sir $NamedOneName's men take you captive. The arrogant knight curses. "Miscreants! You'll regret this day a long time."
column2: $NamedOneName爵士的部下将你俘虏。那名傲慢的骑士咒骂道：“恶徒！你们会为今日后悔良久。”

column1: Sitting around the table, you ponder retirement and recruitment. Those who retire will want their share of the wealth, but if you return here, they might be available to rejoin your party. Followers who leave may never be found again. You...
column2: 围坐桌旁，你思忖着退隐与招募之事。退隐者必欲分得一份财富，然若你重返此地，或可再邀其归队。离去的追随者恐再难寻觅。你...

column1: Sitting back, $NamedOneName replies thoughtfully.
column2: 坐回椅上，$NamedOneName若有所思地答道。

column1: Sitting embedded in the floor is a huge chunk of wormwood. An acrid stench emanates from it. You poke at the wood, and a piece pries loose. Inside you see a glint, and pull out a bottle filled with a sluggish liquid. Inspecting the bottle more closely, you see that the liquid is honey! No doubt the sweetness of the magic honey is curative, intended to counteract the bitter poison of the wormwood.
column2: 一块巨大的苦艾木嵌在地板上。一股刺鼻的臭味从中散发出来。你用手指戳了戳木块，一块碎片松动脱落。里面闪着微光，你抽出一只装满黏稠液体的瓶子。仔细查看后发现，那液体竟是蜂蜜！毫无疑问，这神奇蜂蜜的甜味具有疗愈之效，旨在中和苦艾的剧毒。

column1: Sitting in the middle of the floor is a small lantern. You pick it up and try the shutter. A warm glow fills the room. You inspect the lantern carefully, but cannot find any source of oil nor any candle to feed the magic flame inside. Tucking the lantern away, you depart the halls of darkness.
column2: 地面上正中放着一盏小灯笼。你拾起它，试了试灯罩。温暖的光芒顿时充盈了整个房间。你仔细端详这盏灯笼，却找不到任何油源，也寻不见能为其中魔焰供薪的蜡烛。将灯笼收好，你离开了这片黑暗的殿堂。

column1: Six brass faces suddenly speak.
column2: 六张黄铜面孔骤然开口。

column1: Sizing you up, $NamedOneName puts on the counter the $NamedTwoName.
column2: 打量着你，$NamedOneName将$NamedTwoName放在柜台上。

column1: Slowly $ChosenOneName rises to speak.
column2: 慢慢地，$ChosenOneName站起身来发言。

column1: Slowly $ChosenOneName rises.
column2: 慢慢地，$ChosenOneName升起了。

column1: Slowly $ChosenTwoName prays. Just as slowly, a fog rolls in. Within a minute, you can barely see your hands in front of your face. Then the fog dissipates. You find yourselves on the roof of the $fortress, while the guardsmen there find themselves down in the street, where you were.
column2: 慢慢地，$ChosenTwoName 祈祷着。同样缓慢地，雾气悄然弥漫。不过一瞬，你几乎看不清自己面前的手。随后，雾散去。你们发现自己身处$fortress的屋顶之上，而那里的卫兵则跌落街面，正是你们先前所在之处。

column1: Slowly a conviction grows within $ChosenOneName. This is an ancient entrance to a dwarf's home -- fabled, magical creatures said to be unpredictable and dangerous, but willing to deal with humans.
column2: $ChosenOneName心中渐渐生出一种信念。这是一处古老的矮人居所入口——传说中那些变幻莫测、凶险难测，却也愿与人类交易的神奇生灵之居。

column1: Slowly an awful stink fills the gate area. The people in line fall back in dismay and confusion as the guards begin to gag and cough. Seconds later they're on the ground, sick as dogs, along with other bystanders. Holding your breath, everyone dashes through the empty portal into $PlaceName.
column2: 慢慢地，一股恶臭弥漫了城门区域。排队的人们惊慌失措地后退，而守卫也开始干呕咳嗽。几秒后，他们和周围的旁观者一起倒在地上，痛苦不堪。屏住呼吸，众人冲过空无一人的城门，进入$PlaceName。

column1: Slowly an awful stink fills the gate area. The people in line fall back in dismay and confusion as the guards begin to gag and cough. Seconds later they're on the ground, sick as dogs, along with other bystanders. Holding your breath, you all dash through the empty portal into $PlaceName.
column2: 慢慢地，一股恶臭弥漫了城门区域。排队的人们惊慌失措地后退，而守卫也开始干呕咳嗽。几秒后，他们和周围的旁观者一起倒在地上，痛苦不堪。屏住呼吸，你们一齐冲过空无一人的城门，进入了$PlaceName。

column1: Slowly consciousness returns hours later. The bandits have bungled your murder, leaving you barely alive.
column2: 数小时后，意识缓缓回归。劫匪谋杀未遂，你仅存一线生机。

column1: Slowly consciousness returns hours later. The bandits have bungled your murder, leaving you barely alive. Alas, $ChosenOneName is not so lucky. $He lies dead.
column2: 数小时后，意识缓缓苏醒。劫匪谋杀未遂，你仅存一线生机。唉，$ChosenOneName却未能幸免。你已命丧黄泉。

column1: Slowly consciousness returns hours later. The bandits have bungled your murder, leaving you barely alive. Alas, $ChosenOneName is not so lucky. $He lies dead; neither is $ChosenTwoName, also fallen.
column2: 数小时后，意识缓缓苏醒。劫匪谋杀未遂，你仅存一线生机。唉，$ChosenOneName却未能幸免。你已死；$ChosenTwoName亦殒命。

column1: Slowly you get up and leave the monastery through the narrow doorway, receiving your weaponry as promised.
column2: 你缓缓起身，穿过狭窄的门道离开修道院，依约取回了武器。

column1: Slowly you help $ChosenOneName get out of the muck. Unfortunately, $he lost a few items in the goo. A small price for survival, everyone agrees!
column2: 你缓缓地将$ChosenOneName从泥沼中扶起。不幸的是，你在那团黏液中遗失了几件物品。大家一致认为，这是为生存付出的小小代价！

column1: Slowly, as $he prays, $ChosenOneName becomes confident of what lies within.
column2: 缓缓地，随着你祈祷，$ChosenOneName对其中所藏之事渐生信心。

column1: Slowly, carefully, you move around the hills until you can view the original valley from a different, safer direction. Below, nothing remains but a litter of bodies and the smoking hulks of a few wagons. The bandits are gone.
column2: 缓缓地，小心翼翼地，你绕过山丘，直至从另一处更为安全的方位俯瞰那片原野。下方唯余尸横遍地，几辆马车残骸仍在冒烟。匪徒已遁去。

column1: Slowly, consciousness returns. You find the bandits have left you for dead and gone back to the merchant caravan. It lies below you, in the center of the valley. The wagons are a smoking ruin, with bodies scattered about.
column2: 缓缓地，意识渐渐恢复。你发现那些强盗以为你已死，便返回了商队。商队就在你下方，山谷中央。马车化作一片焦土，尸体散落四周。

column1: Slowly, the wind and the seas drop. The rain begins to slack. The sailors crowd around $ChosenOneName, praising and thanking $him.
column2: 微风渐止，海面平静。雨势渐歇。水手们簇拥在$ChosenOneName身旁，赞颂并感谢你。

column1: Smacking her lips, she leads you to the cookpots. "Ye can prepare the meat," she says, and the way she says 'meat' sends chills down your spine.
column2: 咂咂嘴，她领你到锅灶前。“汝可料理那肉，”她说，而她那“肉”字说得令人毛骨悚然。

column1: Smiling broadly, $NamedOneName, the greatest alchemist of $PlaceName, greets you warmly.
column2: 宽笑盈面，$NamedOneName，$PlaceName最伟大的炼金术士，向你致以热忱的问候。

column1: Smiling seductively, $ChosenOneName greets the turnkey on his next visit. Soon they are close friends, and she is briefly allowed out of the cell for a private chat. After a couple of days, the turnkey, now completely smitten with $ChosenOneName, smuggles you all out of the jail.
column2: $ChosenOneName 娓娓动听地笑着，在下一次探访时向狱卒致意。不久，他们便成了密友，她也被短暂允许离开牢房，私下交谈。数日后，已对$ChosenOneName情根深种的狱卒，将你们众人悄悄送出牢狱。

column1: Smiling with pleasure, the fellow takes your groschen. Then he puts the pea under the middle shell and switches them around very quickly. You aren't quite sure, but it looks to you like the pea is still under the middle shell. Which shell should you pick?
column2: 笑容满面，那人接过你的格罗申。随后他将豌豆置于中间的贝壳下，并迅速调换贝壳的位置。你虽不太确定，但看起来豌豆似乎仍在中间的贝壳之下。你该选哪个贝壳呢？

column1: Smiling with pleasure, the fellow takes your groschen. Then he puts the pea under the middle shell and switches them around very quickly. You aren't quite sure, but it looks to you like the pea is under the left-hand shell. Which shell should you pick?
column2: 笑容满面，那人接过你的格罗申。随后他将豌豆置于中间的贝壳下，并迅速调换贝壳的位置。你虽不太确定，但看起来那颗豌豆似乎在左侧的贝壳之下。你该选哪个贝壳呢？

column1: Smiling with pleasure, the fellow takes your groschen. Then he puts the pea under the middle shell and switches them around very quickly. You aren't quite sure, but it looks to you like the pea is under the right-hand shell. Which shell should you pick?
column2: 笑容满面，那人接过你的格罗申。随后，他将豌豆置于中间的贝壳下，并迅速调换贝壳的位置。你虽不太确定，但看起来豌豆似乎在右侧的贝壳下。你该选哪个贝壳呢？

column1: Smiling, $NamedOneName holds out his hand to you in gratitude. "I thank you for the timely destruction of $NamedTwoName's depredations. $PlaceName and I will not soon forget this aid. You are a good friend."
column2: 微笑着，$NamedOneName向你伸出手以表谢意。“我感谢你及时铲除了$NamedTwoName的暴行。$PlaceName与我将永志不忘这份援助。你是位良友。”

column1: Smiling, the Captain of the Guard is pleased by your desire to train with them.
column2: 微笑着，卫队长对你渴望与他们一同训练感到欣喜。

column1: Smiling, the guild masters accept your "contribution" and promise that the guild will $Support changes in the government. You reflect that there is hardly a guildsman born who doesn't enjoy the feel of silver and gold coins.
column2: 微笑着，公会的掌事们接受了你的“贡献”，并承诺公会将支持政府的$Support变革。你暗想，世上鲜有公会中人不喜金银之感。

column1: Smiling, the merchant says, "Yes indeed, I have a special item." He invites you into a back room, where a gleaming set of $NamedOneName armor is hanging. You estimated the quality at roughly level $NamedTwoName.
column2: 商人微笑着道：“不错，我确实有一件特别的物品。”他邀你进入后室，只见一套熠熠生辉的$NamedOneName级盔甲悬挂其内。你估其品质约为$NamedTwoName级。

column1: Smiling, the merchant says, "Yes indeed, I have a special item." He invites you to view a small stable behind the marketplace, and shows you a beautiful white stallion, fast and high-spirited.
column2: 商人微笑着道：“正是，我有一件珍品。”他邀你前往集市后方的小马厩，向你展示一匹矫健灵动的白色种马。

column1: Smiling, the merchant says, "Yes indeed, I have a special item." He invites you to view a small stable behind the marketplace, and shows you a beautiful white stallion, obviously fast and high-spirited.
column2: 商人微笑着道：“不错，我确实有一件特别的物品。”他邀你前往集市后方的一处小马厩，向你展示一匹美丽的白马，显然迅捷而性情高昂。

column1: Smiling, the merchant says, "Yes, I have a special item." He invites you to view a small stable behind the marketplace, and shows you a beautiful white stallion, obviously fast and high-spirited.
column2: 商人含笑说道：“不错，我有一件奇物。”他邀你前往集市后方的一处小马厩，向你展示一匹雪白骏马，显然迅疾而性情高昂。

column1: Smiling, the raubritter comes out and welcomes you inside. "Even in our wild lands, we know of you. Please accept my hospitality."
column2: 笑容满面的劫匪骑士走出屋外，欢迎你入内。“即便在这片荒野之地，我们也听说过你的大名。请接受我的款待。”

column1: Smirking, the Schulz explains, "We must often sacrifice a maiden to the rapacious dragon $NamedTwoName, else it will pillage our homes. Other towns, more squeamish, are now burnt and gone. We will leave you beside the maid. Perhaps the dragon will eat you, too, and spare us even longer."
column2: 笑容满面的舒尔茨解释道：“我们常需向那贪婪的巨龙$NamedTwoName献祭一名少女，否则它便会掠夺我们的家园。其他更为胆怯的村镇，如今已化为灰烬。我们将你留在少女身旁。或许巨龙也会吞下你，让我们再得安宁。”

column1: Smirking, their leader says, "Unlike you, fine sirs, we know no saints who can protect against flames. We own no weapons of great quality, able to bite into the dragon's iron hide. We have no holy relics. We are unlearned in Alchemy, which might be useful in destroying this foul beast.
column2: 他们的头目冷笑一声，说道：“与诸位贵人不同，我们不知有何圣徒能护我们免受火焰之害。我们亦无利器，难破巨龙铁甲。我们更无圣物在身。至于炼金术，我们也一窍不通，难以诛此恶兽。”

column1: Snarling and snapping irritably at one another, the wolves begin to feast. Poor $ChosenOneName is eaten. While the wolves are busy fighting over $ChosenOneName, the rest of you return to consciousness and crawl away.
column2: 狼群彼此咆哮、龇牙，开始进食。可怜的$ChosenOneName被吃掉了。当狼群忙着争夺$ChosenOneName时，你们其余的人恢复了意识，爬开了。

column1: Snarling and snapping irritably at one another, the wolves begin to feast. Poor $ChosenOneName is eaten. Your mounts are either eaten or break free and run far away. While the wolves are busy dealing with the horses and fighting over $ChosenOneName, the rest of you return to consciousness and crawl away.
column2: 狼群彼此咆哮、咬噬，开始大快朵颐。可怜的$ChosenOneName被吃掉了。你的坐骑要么被吃掉，要么挣脱束缚，远远逃去。当狼群忙着对付马匹并为$ChosenOneName争斗时，你们其余的人恢复了意识，爬离现场。

column1: Snarling with fury, it says, "You have brought me forth, but you shall regret it! I shall slay you and take your souls back to Hell!"
column2: 怒吼一声，它道：“汝等唤吾出世，然必悔之！吾将屠汝辈，携汝魂归地狱！”

column1: Snarling, they attack.
column2: 咆哮着，他们发动了攻击。

column1: Sneaking through the dark corridors of $NamedOneName's fortress, you hear voices up ahead. You decide to ...
column2: 悄悄穿过$NamedOneName堡垒的黑暗走廊，前方传来人声。你决定……

column1: Sneaking up to the top of the wall, you encounter no one. As you clamber down to the bottom of the wall, only one member of the group slips and falls, but the injuries are relatively minor. Soon you stride off into the wilderness.
column2: 悄然攀至墙顶，未遇一人。众人沿墙而下，唯有一人失足跌落，所伤甚微。不久，你们便踏上了荒野之路。

column1: Sneaking up to the top of the wall, you encounter no one. Each member of the group climbs down to the bottom of the wall without mishap and you stride off into the wilderness.
column2: 悄悄攀至墙顶，未遇一人。众人安然自墙下而降，随即迈步踏入荒野。

column1: Sneaking up to the top of the wall, you encounter no one. Unfortunately, some members of the group slip while climbing down and are slightly injured. Soon you stride off into the wilderness.
column2: 悄然攀至墙顶，未遇一人。不幸的是，队伍中有人在下攀时失足，受了轻伤。不久，你们便大步踏入荒野。

column1: Snorting flame, the dragon shrieks, "Thou hast the Six Keys. I cannot refuse to fight. Die, die, die!" The battle is on.
column2: 喷吐火焰，巨龙嘶吼道：“汝已得六钥。吾岂能不战？死吧，死吧，死吧！”战斗打响。

column1: So, you must do it yourself. Not only that, but the kobold leader is a human! The dwarfs scamper off into the darkness.
column2: 于是，你只得亲自动手。不仅如此，地精的首领竟然是个人类！矮人们慌忙逃入黑暗之中。

column1: So, you must do it yourself. Not only that, but the kobold leader is a human?! The dwarfs scamper off into the darkness.
column2: 于是，你只得亲自动手。不仅如此，地精的首领竟然是人类？！矮人们慌忙逃入黑暗之中。

column1: Solemnly the priest enters your cell. The turnkey informs you that he is required to stay and listen. The priest gives him one frigid glance, and the turnkey cowers and leaves. Then the priest turns to you. "The Scriptures tell us we must visit those afflicted and in prison. What do you wish from the Holy Church?"
column2: 牧师庄重地步入你的牢房。狱卒告知他必须在场聆听。牧师冷冷地瞥了他一眼，狱卒畏缩着退下。随后，牧师转向你。“圣经教导我们当探望受苦者与囚徒。你欲从圣教会得何？”

column1: Solemnly, $ChosenOneName is led to the block. $He vows vengeance and spits on the executioner in one last show of defiance. Seconds later, $he is dead.
column2: 庄严地，$ChosenOneName 被押赴刑场。你 宣誓复仇，并在最后的抗争中朝刽子手啐了一口。数秒后，你 已死。

column1: Some activity still proceeds on the docks of $PlaceName, even in the darkness. Looking at the chunks of ice and frozen scum around the wharves, you pity any doomed soul who falls into the water. You decide to...
column2: 即使在黑暗中，$PlaceName的码头上仍有些许活动。望着码头四周的冰块与凝结的浮渣，你不禁为任何坠入水中之人感到怜悯。你决定……

column1: Some activity still proceeds on the docks of $PlaceName, even in the darkness. You decide to...
column2: 即使在黑暗中，$PlaceName的码头上仍有些许活动。你决定……

column1: Some masters receive you, saying, "Ah, worthy friends, our guild extends the hand of friendship by offering one of our journeymen, a local marksman, as a private trainer for only $Money1 per day. If you will take up residence at the inn, $Inn, he will visit you once a day to offer his services."
column2: 一些师傅接待了你，说道：“啊，尊贵的朋友们，本公会伸出友谊之手，提供一名本地枪手作为私人教练，每日仅需$Money1。若你入住客栈$Inn，他将每日前来为你授课。”

column1: Some of you are quick enough to avoid the brunt of the dragon's attack, while others are too slow. Fortunately, the monster does not pursue, but returns to its lair.
column2: 你们中有些人足够敏捷，躲过了巨龙的猛烈攻击，而另一些人则慢了一步。幸运的是，怪物并未追击，而是返回了巢穴。

column1: Some sound, some flaw in your concealment, alerts the travellers. They whirl, drawing crude weapons, fear and anger aglow in their eyes.
column2: 你的藏匿之处，或有声息，或有破绽，惊动了旅人。他们猛然转身，拔出简陋的武器，眼中燃起恐惧与愤怒。

column1: Somehow you know that this was the location of evil witch-cult rituals. They may return here in the future. You must be prepared.
column2: 不知为何，你深知此处曾是邪恶女巫教团举行仪式之地。他们或许会于未来重返此地。汝须有所防备。

column1: Somehow, you don't feel any better. Waving goodbye, you proceed on your way. The miners are already packing their few goods, in preparation for abandoning this formerly-prosperous site.
column2: 不知为何，汝仍觉不适。挥手告别后，汝继续前行。矿工们已收拾行囊，准备弃此昔日繁华之所。

column1: Someone calls, "The wait's not long!" after you, but you hurry away and they do not pursue the matter.
column2: 背后有人喊道：“等候不久矣！”然汝匆匆离去，彼等未再追问。

column1: Something is very wrong here. The land is withered and lifeless, and noxious mist curls through ruts and furrows. The trees are limbless, blasted stumps. What few blades of grass remain are seared and gray. A ruined village sits in the distance, smoke rising from its blackened shell. A wounded dog limps out of the ruined building, but when you try to help, it flees yelping.
column2: 此处大异寻常。土地枯槁无生机，恶雾缭绕于沟壑之间。树木尽成焦黑残桩，仅存几缕草叶亦已焦黄。远处一座废村，其黑影中升起缕缕青烟。一只伤犬蹒跚而出，然汝欲施援时，它却哀嚎着逃去。

column1: Sometime after midnight, you see a cloaked man steal up to the back entrance with a handcart. Very quietly the guild leader supervises its unloading.
column2: 半夜时分，汝见一披斗篷者推着手推车悄然至后门。公会会长低声监督其卸货。

column1: Soon a monk introduces you to the abbess of an associated convent.
column2: 不久，一名修士引汝拜见附属修道院之方丈。

column1: Soon after $ChosenOneName begins to pray, the heavens answer with amazing might. At the height of the diabolic ceremony, a bolt of lightning comes crashing down from the sky. It shatters the evil altar into a thousand pieces and sends the cultists tumbling away, their clothes afire.
column2: 不久之后，$ChosenOneName 刚开始祈祷，天即降下奇威。邪术祭典正酣之际，一道闪电自天而降，击碎邪坛，使教徒四散奔逃，衣衫燃起烈焰。

column1: Soon all is confusion, with fire-fighters running in all directions. You join the crowd and hurry through the open gates to the castle keep. As you enter the tower, the guards spots you.
column2: 霎时间，火场一片混乱，救火员四处奔走。汝随众涌入敞开的城门，直抵城堡主塔。甫入塔内，守卫即发现汝踪迹。

column1: Soon everyone in town has heard the news. Someone has sought refuge within a holy building! The city guard posts a watch, lest you attempt to escape.
column2: 不久，全城皆闻此事。有人竟于圣所中寻求庇护！城卫设岗警戒，以防汝逃脱。

column1: Soon he regards you as old companions. He escorts you through a small passage and opens the guardroom door to the city. Smiling, he says, "No tolls for you today." You give him a friendly slap, then stroll forth into $PlaceName.
column2: 不久，他视汝如旧友。引汝穿小径，启城门。笑曰：“今日免汝通行费。”汝轻拍其肩，遂步入 $PlaceName。

column1: Soon it is over. The monster flies off, sparing you. You regain the use of your legs and crawl away into the wilderness before the villagers return.
column2: 不久便告一段落。怪物飞去，饶了你一命。你重获行走之力，于村民归来前，匍匐逃入荒野。

column1: Soon the bandits spot your arrival. They fall back in fear, drop their weapons, and run from the sight of you.
column2: 不久，匪徒见汝来，惊惧退避，弃械而逃。

column1: Soon the bandits walk into your trap. With a silent gesture, $ChosenOneName motions for you to attack!
column2: 不久，匪徒入汝之计。$ChosenOneName 默然示意，令汝发难！

column1: Soon the cultists are ready for the sacrifice. You are led forward and untied in preparation for being cast into the flames. At that moment you seize your chance, knocking aside your guards and grabbing at their daggers. The furious villagers attack you. You have no choice but to fight.
column2: 不久，教徒已备好祭品。汝被牵至前，解缚待焚。汝趁机夺过守卫匕首，奋起反击。愤怒村民蜂拥而上，汝别无选择，只得迎战。

column1: Soon the guardsmen have the rebels trussed up. You then lead a triumphant parade of prisoners, guards and citizens to the city dungeon.
column2: 不久，守卫已将叛军捆缚。汝率囚犯、卫兵及市民凯旋入城狱。

column1: Soon the rest of the party rejoins you, set free by the huntsman after a stern warning.
column2: 不久，余党亦归队，猎人严辞警告后放其自由。

column1: Soon thereafter you take your leave, happy that he now espouses your cause.
column2: 不久之后，汝告辞而去，喜见其今已支持汝志。

column1: Soon word comes back from $NamedOneName, captain of the guard. "You are not outlaws. Go in peace."
column2: 不久，守卫队长 $NamedOneName 回信：“汝非盗匪，可安然离去。”

column1: Soon you are led to a hollow under an embankment, where you quickly drive him into the open. He is amazed you could find him, and begins to weep.
column2: 不久，汝被引至堤下空洞，迅将其逼出。彼惊汝寻得其踪，不禁落泪。

column1: Soon you are out the gate, past the fields, and into the countryside once more.
column2: 不久，汝越田而出，重归乡野。

column1: Soon you are reunited. Content, you stroll out of the $VarString1 and into the $citySquare.
column2: 不久，汝与众人重聚。心满意足，步出 $VarString1，步入 $citySquare。

column1: Soon you are travelling alone again, but now you are penniless, defenseless, and almost naked.
column2: 不久，汝独行千里，然身无分文，手无寸铁，几近赤身。

column1: Soon you awaken. Around you lingers the wreckage of battle. In the distance you hear the roar of a crowd, near $VarString1 perhaps.
column2: 不久，汝醒来。四周狼藉，远近似有喧嚣，或在 $VarString1 附近。

column1: Soon you stand among the darkened trees, pondering whether to seek revenge.
column2: 不久，汝立于幽林之中，思是否复仇。

column1: Soon you will have no friends here. Almost nobody supports the $CityLordTitle, so the revolt surely will succeed. The new government will probably arrest you because of your work for the old leaders! Meanwhile, the surviving partisans of the $CityLordTitle may seek their revenge. Instinctively you begin moving...
column2: 不久，汝在此将无友。几乎无人支持 $CityLordTitle，故叛乱必成。新政府恐因汝辅旧主而拘捕汝！幸存之 $CityLordTitle 党徒亦可能寻仇。汝本能起身……

column1: Soon your caution is rewarded. A ragged looking bandit carrying a brace of rabbits hikes down a trail, leaves his catch somewhere in the cave, then walks away. You realize this cave is surely a bandit lair.
column2: 不久，汝之谨慎终获回报。一褴褛匪徒携两兔沿径而下，将猎物藏于洞中，悄然离去。汝悟此洞乃匪巢无疑。

column1: Soon, $ChosenOneName catches up with the party. $He manages this because the bandits relieved $him or $his armor and most of $his weapons.
column2: 不久，$ChosenOneName 追上队伍。你 得以如此，盖因匪徒夺其 你 或 你的 甲胄，及大部分 你的 武器。

column1: Soon, a warm light engulfs the crowd. Awed, they look up and see a heavenly choir singing softly. Then a man in glowing white leads you through the crowd.
column2: 不久，暖光笼罩众人。众人仰望，见天界圣歌低吟。随即，白衣人引汝穿过人群。

column1: Soon, a warm light engulfs the scene. Awed, everyone looks up and sees a heavenly choir singing softly. Then someone in glowing white walks out of the crowd and leads you through the guards. The lieutenant of the guards begins to protest, but the person in white walks over, says a few words, and the lieutenant falls silent.
column2: 不久，暖光笼罩全场。众人仰望，见天界圣歌低吟。白衣人走出人群，引汝过卫兵。卫副官欲抗议，然白衣人上前数语，副官遂默。

column1: Soon, those left behind catch up with the party. They manage this because the bandits relieved them of all sorts of weighty items, including all their armor and most of their weapons.
column2: 不久，留守者追上队伍。盖因匪徒夺其重物，包括全部甲胄及多数武器。

column1: Soon, you can see the crowd becomes distracted. People take an interest in each other, or seem to act slightly drunk. At a mild suggestion from you, the sergeant of the guard enters the rebel headquarters with a few men, and comes out with the rebel leaders. They all seem engrossed in a friendly conversation. It is child's play to lead your prisoners away from the scene, but as you do, you feel the saint's powerful influence fading.
column2: 不久，众人渐生疏离。彼此相顾，或似微醺。汝稍加暗示，卫士长率数人入叛军总部，携首领而出。诸人谈笑风生，汝轻松押囚离去，然觉圣力渐消。

column1: Sorry, this option isn't working yet.
column2: 抱歉，此选项暂不可用。

column1: Sounds of work still ring from the guild courtyards this late at night. An occasional officer bustles in or out on some important errand. Glancing around, you head toward...
column2: 夜深犹闻工匠庭院中劳作之声。偶有官员出入，办理要务。汝环顾四周，遂向……进发。

column1: Speaking cogently, $ChosenOneName uses fine rhetoric, bidding the villagers to think of the life they lived before the dragon came, and reminding them of their own loved ones.
column2: $ChosenOneName 善辩雄辞，唤村民忆龙来之前之岁月，并念及亲眷。

column1: Squinting angrily, Baphomet releases the next plague. All at once, you can see nothing, not even your hand before your face. But you can still hear Baphomet. "Darkness shall cover all the world, and none shall be able to leave their homes nor find their friends. Darkness shall rule."
column2: 巴佛墨特怒目凝视，释放下一灾疫。霎时，汝眼前漆黑，连掌亦不可见。然汝仍闻其声：“黑暗将覆天下，无人能出家门，亦难觅亲友。黑暗将统治一切。”

column1: Standing by on the door are two statues: one of a dwarf, the other of a kobold. The dwarf statue says, "The statue which opens the door always lies."
column2: 门前伫立两尊石像：一为矮人，一为地精。矮人像曰：“开扉之像，恒言谎话。”

column1: Standing outside the prison you mill about among the normal street traffic. Keeping a keen eye on the entrance, you decide to...
column2: 监狱外，汝混于街市人流。紧盯入口，汝决意……

column1: Standing over the torn bodies of the raubritter's minions, you taunt him and shout out insults to the castle.
column2: 立于劫匪爪牙尸骸之上，汝嘲讽其人，向城堡高呼辱骂。

column1: Standing up from $his prayer, $ChosenOneName looks pleased, as if $he knows $he has gotten a response. Before you can ask $him what has happened, $NamedOneName responds with impressive power.
column2: $ChosenOneName 自 你的 祈祷中起身，神色欣然，似知 你 已蒙应答。汝未及询 你 所事，$NamedOneName 已以伟力回应。

column1: Staring the raubritter in the eye, $ChosenOneName demands, "Surrender yourself." The robber knight responds by shouting for help, then quickly opens a secret passage and rushes down it. You follow, but are stopped by a band of soldiers. You must fight your way through the castle to capture $NamedOneName.
column2: 直视劫匪，$ChosenOneName 呼曰：“投降！”劫匪呼救，旋开密道疾遁。汝追入，然遭兵阻。汝须破城擒拿 $NamedOneName。

column1: Stark blackness fills your eyes. You cannot see anything. You wonder if you have been struck blind, but then decide that the force of darkness is so strong here that it has overwhelmed the light. Before progressing, you stop for a moment to think, then decide to ...
column2: 眼前一片漆黑，汝无所见。汝疑己失明，然思此地黑暗之力太强，已压倒光明。汝暂止思索，决意……

column1: Stay at an inn beside the city.
column2: 住在城边的旅店。

column1: Steeling $himself to the dangerous task, $ChosenOneName leaps up and draws $his weapon. Flourishing it over the raubritter's head, $he cries, "$NamedOneName! In the name of the people you oppress, you are our prisoner!"
column2: 励 你自己 以赴险，$ChosenOneName 跃起拔 你的 兵刃。挥舞于劫匪头顶，你 喊曰：“$NamedOneName！以汝压迫之民之名，汝乃吾囚！”

column1: Stepping into the confessional, $ChosenOneName speaks to the village priest, and tells him all $his sins. $He is told to do penance for eight hours. You wait patiently until $he is finished, and $ChosenOneName is pardoned of $his sins, finding renewed virtue and favor with heaven.
column2: 进入忏悔室，$ChosenOneName 向村牧坦白 你的 罪。你 被命罚跪八时。汝静候 你 完毕，$ChosenOneName 获赦罪，重拾美德，蒙天眷。

column1: Stern word comes back from $NamedOneName, captain of the guard. "You have offended the laws of fair $PlaceName. Surrender yourselves at once to the mercy of our noble city fathers."
column2: 守卫队长 $NamedOneName 严词回函：“汝已违公正 $PlaceName 之法。速向我城贤达俯首认罪。”

column1: Stettin.
column2: 斯塞廷。

column1: Still clinging to the wall, $ChosenOneName observes $his fallen comrade. "Well," $he sighs, "I suppose I should climb down and help the injured."
column2: 仍攀墙而立，$ChosenOneName 注视 你的 坠亡战友。“罢了，”你 叹曰，“当攀下相助伤者。”

column1: Still pondering, you decide that your first step will be to...
column2: 仍在思索，汝决意第一步将为……

column1: Still trying to be polite, you continue to inquire about...
column2: 仍力求礼节，汝继续探询……

column1: Still, for your aid, they bless your name and promise to pray for you. The virtuous glow of Christian charity makes the entire world seem a better place as you journey onward.
column2: 然而，为表谢意，他们颂扬你的名，并许诺为你祈祷。基督慈善的光辉使你前行之际，觉世间更显美好。

column1: Stone crumbles and $ChosenOneName slips from the wall, landing with a thud.
column2: 石块崩落，$ChosenOneName自墙间滑落，重重落地。

column1: Stone gargoyles glower from the upper stories. A very old servant greets you at the door. "Come in, please, honored guests, you are expected." He leads you to a room where a young, beautiful woman in strange robes nods a welcome and bids you sit.
column2: 石制怪兽雕像从高楼上俯视着。一位年迈的仆人于门前迎候。“请进，尊贵的客人，你已被恭候多时。”他引领你至一室，只见一位身着奇装异服的妙龄女子颔首致意，示意你落座。

column1: Storing your gear, you sit down for a relaxing meal, then take eight hours of well-deserved sleep in your room.
column2: 收好行装，你坐下来享用一顿惬意的餐食，随后在房中安睡八个小时，以资休憩。

column1: Straining with all $his might, $ChosenOneName manages to loosen the bonds holding $him. $He quickly unties the rest of you, and when the moment is ripe, you leap up and grab your weapons, stacked neatly nearby. When the cultists turn to attack you, you are ready.
column2: 用尽你的全力，$ChosenOneName终于挣脱了束缚你绳索。你迅速解开了其余人的绑缚，时机一到，你们跃然而起，抄起了堆放在一旁的武器。当教徒们转而向你们发动攻击时，你们已严阵以待。

column1: Stralsund.
column2: 施特拉尔松德。

column1: Striking swiftly, the tatzelwurm streak from hiding, jaws agape! You whril, draw weapons and face the foe.
column2: 猝然袭击，塔策尔蠕虫自隐处疾冲而出，巨口大张！你旋身拔剑，迎战敌手。

column1: Striving mightily, you cannot open the gate. A disembodied voice states clearly, "The Fifth Seal is unbroken. The fifth gate is closed to all."
column2: 竭力而为，你仍无法开启城门。一缕空灵之声清晰道：“第五封印未破，第五道城门对众人紧闭。”

column1: Strolling among the trees, a sense of peace comes over you. Life seems both pleasant and wonderful. Meanwhile, you can see the busy splendor and active life of $PlaceName, its many citizens busy with their varied tasks.
column2: 漫步于林间，宁静之感油然而生。生活似乎既惬意又美好。与此同时，你可见$PlaceName的繁华与生机，其众市民正忙于各自不同的事务。

column1: Strolling among the trees, you find an especially soft and pleasant place, sunlit and not too windy. You settle down here, backs against sturdy oaks, and nap until nightfall.
column2: 漫步于林间，你寻得一处格外柔软宜人的所在，阳光洒落，微风不疾。你于此安坐，背倚苍劲橡树，直至夜幕降临方才小憩。

column1: Strolling back into his place of business, you ask about the service he desires. "Attend me closely," he says quietly, "here is what I need..."
column2: 你踱回店中，询问其所需之服务。“请仔细听好，”他低声说道，“我需要的是……”

column1: Strolling back to his business, you ask about the service he desires. "Attend me closely," he says quietly, "here is what I need..."
column2: 你随他漫步回铺，便问其所需之服务。“请近身侍候，”他低声言道，“我欲如此……”

column1: Strolling into the square of bowyers and gunsmiths, you see patient, careful workmen fashioning precision devices. You...
column2: 漫步于皮匠与枪匠的广场，你见耐心细致的工匠们打造精密器械。你...

column1: Strolling past townhouses displaying various arcane symbols, the experienced eye of $ChosenOneName easily spots the best alchemist in $PlaceName, $NamedOneName.
column2: 漫步于悬挂着各式神秘符咒的宅邸之间，$ChosenOneName那双老练的眼睛轻易便寻到了$PlaceName中最杰出的炼金术士——$NamedOneName。

column1: Struggling up the cliff, $ChosenOneName slips and falls. $He slides roughly down the face of the cliff, to land among the rocks and trees at the base.
column2: 艰难攀爬悬崖时，$ChosenOneName 一滑便跌落。你 粗糙地顺着崖面滑下，最终落在山脚的岩石与树木之间。

column1: Studying diligently, $ChosenOneName pores through the ancient tomes. However, the language used is too difficult for $him to make out much of the sense. After many hours of toil, $he gives up.
column2: 勤勉研读，$ChosenOneName 潜心翻阅古籍。然而，所用语言过于艰深，你 难以领会其意。历经数载苦读，你 终告放弃。

column1: Stunned and bleeding, you manage to crawl away before the watch arrives. However, many of your possessions are destroyed.
column2: 震惊且血流不止，你在守卫到来之前勉强爬走。然而，你的许多财物已被毁坏。

column1: Stunned by your audacity, the raubritter's sword drops from nerveless fingers. "Nay, spare me," he pleads. "I have gold aplenty for you. And take my lieutenant to the executioners in my stead and tell your masters it is I."
column2: 你的胆识令劫匪惊呆，他手中的剑从无力的指间滑落。“不，饶我一命吧，”他哀求道，“我有的是金子给你。再把我的副官交给刽子手代我受死，并告诉你的主子，是我。”

column1: Success! The iron door creaks open, and you are confronted by a stunted figure, who steps forward to meet you.
column2: 成功！铁门吱呀一声打开，你迎面见到一个矮小的身影，他走上前来与你相会。

column1: Success! The iron door swings wide. A stunted figure steps out to speak with you.
column2: 成功！铁门缓缓洞开。一个矮小的身影走出，与你交谈。

column1: Success! The iron door swings wide. You are amused when you realize that, though you could deduce which statue was the correct choice to open the door, you were not able to figure out which statue was the truth-teller.
column2: 成功！铁门轰然洞开。你不禁莞尔，原来虽能推断出哪尊雕像才是开启之钥，却未能识破哪尊才是真话者。

column1: Success! You correctly remembered your antediluvian patriarchs. The door slides silently open. The path is unbarred. But before you can enter, a stunted figure steps out, evidently intending to confront you.
column2: 成功！你正确记起了你的远古先祖。门悄然滑开。道路已无阻隔。但你尚未踏入，一个矮小的身影便走出，显然意图与你对峙。

column1: Success: 37        DF Remaining: 79
column2: 成功：37        剩余DF：79

column1: Suddenly $ChosenOneName's lance snaps and $he flies through the air, then crashes heavily to the ground.
column2: 突然，$ChosenOneName的长矛折断，你凌空飞去，随后重重地摔在地上。

column1: Suddenly $he is successful! Brimstone flares and a hideous, stinking monstrosity steps out of the cloud.
column2: 突然，你 成功了！硫磺烈焰腾起，一狰狞恶臭之怪物自烟云中踏出。

column1: Suddenly Baphomet, without speaking a word, launches the sixth plague -- demon lancers by the hundreds of thousands, their goblin steeds belching fire. You brandish the miniature Sword of War, and they evaporate.
column2: 突然，巴佛墨特一言不发，降下第六灾——成千上万的恶魔枪骑兵，胯下妖兽喷吐烈焰。你挥舞那柄微型战剑，他们便化作烟尘。

column1: Suddenly a night watchman rushes up to the leader of the guards here.
column2: 突然，一名夜巡兵急匆匆地跑到这里的卫队长面前。

column1: Suddenly a storm bursts. The acrid, stinging raindrops have been tainted by the evil on the land. When the rain ends, you dry off, but on cleansing your weapons, you see that they are rusted and pitted by the corrosive water.
column2: 突然，一场风暴骤起。刺鼻、灼痛的雨滴已被这片土地上的邪恶所玷污。雨停后，你虽已干透，但擦拭兵器时，却发现它们已被腐蚀性的雨水锈蚀得坑洼不平。

column1: Suddenly an earthquake shatters the wall of the lair, and the dragon $NamedTwoName itself crawls through the hole!
column2: 突然，一场地震震碎了巢穴的墙壁，巨龙$NamedTwoName竟从洞中爬出！

column1: Suddenly bat-winged gargoyles flap towards you. The dwarf must have built them as homunculi! He puts on his red cap and vanishes with a "pop!"
column2: 突然，蝙蝠翼的石像鬼扑向你。矮人一定是将它们造为小精灵！他戴上红帽，一声“啵”地消失了！

column1: Suddenly cracks open up in the pit's walls, through which molten lava glows. Soon you will be cooked alive in this furnace!
column2: 突然，坑壁裂开一道缝隙，炽热的熔岩从中透出。很快，你将在这座熔炉中活活烤熟！

column1: Suddenly the Schulz's face becomes a mask of fury. "So!" he shouts. "You have found us out! You'll not survive the knowledge!" Other villagers lurch from the shadows, wielding clubs and tools. Their intent is clear.
column2: 突然，舒尔茨的脸变成了一张愤怒的面具。“原来如此！”他怒吼道，“你们已经发现了我们的秘密！知道得太多，你们活不成了！”其他村民从阴影中踉跄而出，挥舞着棍棒和农具。他们的意图再明显不过了。

column1: Suddenly the crack in the cavern side is filled with a hideous head. It is the dragon $NamedTwoName! It breathes fire over the wretched witches, and they turn to black ash. Now the head turns toward you...
column2: 忽然，洞壁裂隙中探出一颗狰狞巨首。正是龙 $NamedTwoName！它喷吐烈焰，将那等恶徒化为焦炭。如今，巨首转向你……

column1: Suddenly the dark mists fade and you see a vision of what might be a saint or angel. You hear words.
column2: 突然，黑暗的雾气消散，你看见一个可能是圣人或天使的幻象。你听见话语。

column1: Suddenly the night watch steps out of a doorway. Their leader strides forward boldly, asking, "Who violates the curfew of $PlaceName?"
column2: 突然，夜巡者从门洞中走出。其首领大步向前，厉声问道：“何人敢违$PlaceName之宵禁？”

column1: Suddenly the thieves think twice about taking you on. Quietly, they fade into the shadows and disappear.
column2: 突然间，盗贼们打消了与你为敌的念头。他们悄然隐入阴影，消失无踪。

column1: Suddenly the villagers surround you, weeping for joy and thanking you for your great sacrifice. "Our bridge is now our own. This has saved many lives -- we no longer must take the dangerous upriver ford! Thank you. Thank you."
column2: 突然，村民们围拢上来，喜极而泣，感谢你的巨大牺牲。“我们的桥如今属于我们了。这挽救了许多生命——我们再也不必冒险走上游的浅滩了！谢谢你。谢谢你。”

column1: Suddenly the wolf stiffens as it sniffs the hand of $ChosenOneName. A low growl escapes its throat, and the fur on its back stands on end. The travellers eye you warily, and at least one hand furtively steals to a weapon.
column2: 突然，狼嗅了嗅$ChosenOneName的手，身子一僵。低沉的咆哮从它喉间逸出，背上的毛也竖了起来。旅人们警惕地望着你，至少有一只手悄悄摸向了武器。

column1: Suddenly you all hear a heavenly voice, irresistably pleading that you put aside differences and behave with Christian charity toward one another.
column2: 突然，你们皆闻天籁之声，恳求你们摒弃分歧，以基督之仁慈相待。

column1: Suddenly you are enveloped by a great, stinking fog. Coughing, unable to see, you grope for the light...
column2: 突然，你被一团浓重的恶臭雾气笼罩。你咳嗽着，眼前一片漆黑，摸索着寻找光明……

column1: Suddenly you chuckle. In your hands is a package of scented letters. They are from a love-besotten woman to the guild leader. You read snatches, and realize they describe, in detail, all of the couple's romantic liasons!
column2: 突然你轻笑一声。手中是一包散发着香气的信笺。那是位痴情女子写给公会会长的书信。你随手翻阅几页，方知其中详述了二人所有的幽会之事！

column1: Suddenly you hear city guardsmen beating on the front door.
column2: 突然，你听见城卫兵敲打着前门。

column1: Suddenly you remember that the guardsmen planned to make the big arrest today. You...
column2: 突然你想起卫兵们今日正要进行大逮捕。你...

column1: Suddenly you see ahead the pounding fury of breakers and spray. With a crash the ship grounds and shatters. You are flung into the roaring sea! However, the Captain's advice was sound. Although half-drowned, you are saved by your floating casks. Finally, the waves wash you ashore. You can barely crawl to higher ground.
column2: 突然，你前方只见惊涛拍岸，浪花飞溅。船只轰然触礁，碎裂成片。你被抛入咆哮的海中！然而，船长的忠告果然不差。虽半溺水中，却因漂浮的酒桶得以保命。最终，海浪将你冲上海滩。你勉力爬至高地。

column1: Suddenly your rest is disturbed...
column2: 突然，你的安宁被打破……

column1: Suddenly, $ChosenOneName backs away from the lock.
column2: 突然，$ChosenOneName从锁孔后退。

column1: Suddenly, $ChosenOneName is absolutely positive that the $NamedOneName can be found within the cave. Furthermore, $he is also just as sure that nothing else lurks within or nearby.
column2: 突然，$ChosenOneName 绝对确信 $NamedOneName 可在洞中寻得。此外，你 亦同样笃定洞内及附近并无他物潜伏。

column1: Suddenly, $ChosenOneName is confident that you can quickly escape this chamber out over the cliffs. Miraculously, the rock faces seem as easy to climb as steps on a building. You clamber out and up, watching the green mist pour over the lip and down the cliff face to the ground below. Easily and confidentally, you move along the cliff to safe ground.
column2: 突然间，$ChosenOneName确信你可迅速逃离此室，跃过悬崖。奇迹般地，岩壁竟如楼宇台阶般易攀。你攀援而出，见绿色雾气自崖沿倾泻而下，直落谷底。从容自信，你沿崖行至安全之地。

column1: Suddenly, $ChosenOneName motions you to a stop.
column2: 突然，$ChosenOneName示意你停下。

column1: Suddenly, $ChosenOneName realizes that these merchants look mighty suspicious. Furthermore, $he catches a glimpse of the leader's scarred, twisted face, a very mask of evil.
column2: 突然，$ChosenOneName 意识到这些商人看起来十分可疑。此外，你 一眼瞥见首领那张满是伤疤、扭曲的脸庞，分明是一副邪恶的面具。

column1: Suddenly, $ChosenOneName spots a trap door in the roof just above the throne. Quickly you pry it open and clamber up. Below, the mist has stopped pouring into the chamber. What is there flows out and down the cliff face. It does not rise through the trap door.
column2: 突然，$ChosenOneName 发现王座正上方的屋顶有一扇活板门。你迅速将其撬开，攀了上去。下方，雾气已不再涌入此室。流出之物顺着崖壁倾泻而下，并未从活板门中倒灌上来。

column1: Suddenly, $ChosenOneName starts, as if awakening from a dream. It is clear to $him that $PlaceName lives in constant danger, and that the lord is concerned about these threats.
column2: 忽然，$ChosenOneName 一震，如梦初醒。于 你 而言，显而易见，$PlaceName 生于危难之中，而领主正忧心此等威胁。

column1: Suddenly, $ChosenOneName stumbles in the dark. You all freeze as a loose cup rattles away. Unfortunately, the night watch hears it also. They quickly run in your direction...
column2: 突然，$ChosenOneName 在黑暗中绊了一跤。众人皆屏息凝神，一只松动的杯子滚落作响。不幸的是，夜巡者也听到了。他们迅速朝你们的方向奔来……

column1: Suddenly, $ChosenOneName's face and skin begin to wrinkle. Flesh sags, nostrils widen, and teeth snaggle, until $he is the ugliest person you have ever seen.
column2: 突然，$ChosenOneName的脸与肌肤开始起皱。皮肉松弛，鼻孔张大，牙齿参差不齐，直至你成为你所见过最丑之人。

column1: Suddenly, $NamedOneName, the imperial messenger, speaks, "You are slow as hedgehogs! Despite all the time we have spent, we are no nearer to $PlaceName than the last time I warned you! That is enough. I am leaving!"
column2: 突然，$NamedOneName，那位帝国使者开口道：“你们行动迟缓如刺猬！尽管我们已耗费如此多时日，却仍与上次我警告你们时一样，离$PlaceName毫无进展！够了。我要离开了！”

column1: Suddenly, $NamedTwoName, a messenger-girl used by $NamedOneName, bursts in.
column2: 突然，$NamedTwoName，一名受$NamedOneName差遣的信使女孩闯了进来。

column1: Suddenly, $NamedTwoName, a messenger-girl used by the rebels, bursts in on you.
column2: 突然，$NamedTwoName，一名叛军所用的信使女孩闯入你面前。

column1: Suddenly, a band of ragged but determined bandits leaps from ambush, yelling, "Drop your weapons or die!"
column2: 突然，一群衣衫褴褛却意志坚定的匪徒从伏击处跃出，高喊：“放下武器，否则死！”

column1: Suddenly, a cloaked figure backed by tough-looking mercenaries steps into the road in front of you. You look around and see other soldiers to each side.
column2: 突然，一名披着斗篷、身后跟着身强力壮雇佣兵的身影挡在你面前。你环顾四周，见两侧另有士兵。

column1: Suddenly, a group of soldiers leap from ambush, yelling the dreaded battle-cry of a private war: "Fehde!"
column2: 突然，一群士兵从伏击处跃起，高呼私战之凶名——“Fehde！”

column1: Suddenly, a group of very dirty bandit-soldiers leap from ambush, yelling, "Drop your weapons or die!"
column2: 突然，一群满身污秽的匪徒士兵从伏击处跃起，高喊：“放下武器，否则死！”

column1: Suddenly, a hot reptile stink fills the air as the dragon descends from the skies above. Hurricane winds from the dragon's vast wings buffet you. Acid and venom rain from its ugly form.
column2: 突然，随着巨龙自天而降，空气中弥漫起一股炽热的腥臭。巨龙双翼掀起飓风，将你掀翻。其丑陋身躯之上，酸液与毒汁如雨般倾泻。

column1: Suddenly, a huge stag appears ahead. The sky echoes with the sound of great hunting horns. Surprised and fearful of a trap, the ragged bandits leap up and run. In less than a minute, all are gone, allowing you to continue peacefully.
column2: 突然，前方出现一头硕大的雄鹿。天空回荡着宏大的猎角之声。惊疑有诈，那群衣衫褴褛的匪徒一跃而起，四散奔逃。不到一瞬，尽皆无踪，任你安然前行。

column1: Suddenly, a huge stag appears on a distant ridgeline. The sky echoes with the sound of great hunting horns. Surprised and fearful of a trap, a group of unemployed mercenaries-turned-bandits leaps from cover and immediately flees. Soon all is quiet, allowing you to continue peacefully.
column2: 突然，远处山脊上现出一头硕大的雄鹿。天空回荡着宏大的猎角之声。惊疑有诈，一群失业转为匪徒的雇佣兵自掩蔽处跃起，旋即逃遁。不久便归于寂静，任你安然前行。

column1: Suddenly, a huge stag appears on a distant ridgeline. The sky echoes with the sound of great hunting horns. Surprised and fearful of a trap, soldiers leap from their ambush positions and flee. Soon all is quiet, allowing you to continue peacefully.
column2: 突然，远处山脊上现出一头硕大的雄鹿。天空回荡着宏大的猎角之声。惊疑有诈，士兵们自伏击之处跃起，仓皇而逃。不久便归于寂静，任你安然前行。

column1: Suddenly, a huge stag appears on a distant ridgeline. The sky echoes with the sound of great hunting horns. Surprised and fearful of a trap, the soldiers leave their positions and flee. Soon all is quiet, allowing you to continue peacefully.
column2: 突然，远处山脊上现出一头硕大的雄鹿。天空回荡着宏大的猎角之声。惊疑有诈，士兵们弃阵而逃。不久便归于寂静，任你安然前行。

column1: Suddenly, a mask appears floating in the air before you. It mouths the words, "The First Seal is intact. The Castle of the Apocalypse is secure." Then it fades away. Puzzled, you keep walking towards the dark castle, but no matter how long you walk, you draw no closer. When you give up and turn around, you find yourself back where you started!
column2: 突然，一张面具悬浮于你面前。它无声地吐出：“第一封印完好，启示录之堡固若金汤。”随即消隐。你心生疑惑，仍向那座幽暗的城堡走去，然而无论走多久，始终无法靠近。待你放弃转身，竟发现自己回到了起点！

column1: Suddenly, a sounder of wild boars bursts from the undergrowth.
column2: 突然，一群野猪自灌木丛中冲出。

column1: Suddenly, armed farmers halt you, but doff their hats respectfully. "Oh, kind people," says one. "You can serve us well." You recognize them as folk from the maiden-sacrificing village and are on guard. "What is it you want?" you ask.
column2: 突然，武装农夫拦住你，却恭敬地摘帽致意。“哦，仁慈之人，”其中一人道，“你能为我们效力。”你认出他们正是献祭少女之村的村民，心中警觉。“你们欲何为？”你问道。

column1: Suddenly, bright sunlight and a heavenly chord bathes the building and surrounding streets. The crowd parts as a dazzling man in white walks silently from their midst, enters the building, and then returns, leading the rebel leaders to you.
column2: 突然，耀眼阳光与天籁和声笼罩整座建筑及周遭街巷。人群自动分开，一位白衣男子静默穿行其间，步入楼内，旋即携叛军首领而出，引至你面前。

column1: Suddenly, climbing the walls seems easy. The rough stone feels like a simple ladder. Quickly you clamber over the curtain wall and up the side of the tower keep. On an upper ledge you all draw weapons and step inside.
column2: 突然，攀爬城墙变得轻而易举。粗糙石壁宛如简易梯阶。你迅速越过外墙，沿塔楼侧壁而上。至一处高台，众人拔剑，踏入其中。

column1: Suddenly, climbing the walls seems easy. The rough stone feels like a simple ladder. Quickly you clamber over the curtain wall and up the side of the tower keep. On an upper ledge, you all draw weapons and step inside.
column2: 突然，攀爬城墙变得轻而易举。粗糙石壁宛如简易梯阶。你迅速越过外墙，沿塔楼侧壁而上。至一处高台，众人拔剑，踏入其中。

column1: Suddenly, huge monsters lurches forward -- huge gnomes commanded by the dwarf! The dwarf puts on his red cap and vanishes with a "pop!"
column2: 突然，巨大怪物蹒跚逼近——那是矮人麾下的巨矮人！矮人戴上红帽，一声“啪”，消失不见。

column1: Suddenly, ragged bandits spring out from all sides. Many of the "refugees" throw down their burdens and draw hidden weapons, while the rest scatter for cover.
column2: 突然，衣衫褴褛的匪徒四面八方涌出。不少“难民”丢下负重，亮出藏匿的武器，余者则四散寻庇。

column1: Suddenly, soldiers leap from ambush, yelling "Surrender or die!"
column2: 突然，士兵从伏击处跃起，高喊：“投降，否则死！”

column1: Suddenly, the entire area is suffused with light and the sounds of an angelic choir. Gradually it fades, and as it does, the plague victims look and feel much better.
column2: 突然，整个区域被光明与天使圣歌声浸染。光芒渐褪，瘟疫患者面貌焕然，身心亦觉舒畅。

column1: Suddenly, the friar stops in mid-sentence. He tries to speak, but no words come out. He shakes his head in confusion and tries to say something else. That comes out fine.
column2: 突然，修士话未说完，戛然而止。他试图发声，却发不出一字。困惑地摇头，再试一句，却顺畅无比。

column1: Suddenly, the ghost's form quivers and seems to fade. It screams with delight. "At last! My torment comes to an end! $NamedTwoName has paid for his crimes, and I can be freed. Freed!"
column2: 突然，鬼影颤动，似要消散。它欢欣尖叫：“终于！我的苦难终告终结！$NamedTwoName已为其罪孽付出代价，我得以解脱。解脱！”

column1: Suddenly, the guards reappear and look around for the noise. You are about the pay the penalty for being too loud...
column2: 突然，守卫现身，四下张望声响来源。你即将因喧哗而受罚……

column1: Suddenly, the lord of the castle confronts you, his sword in one hand, a crucifix in the other, saying, "Why, travellers, do you assault me? You have no quarrel with me, nor I with you. By Saint Godfrey, put up your weapons!"
column2: 突然，城堡主君手持利剑、十字架，迎面而来，喝道：“旅人啊，为何侵扰于我？汝与我无仇，我亦与汝无怨。以圣戈弗雷之名，收起兵刃！”

column1: Suddenly, the lord of the castle confronts you, sword in one hand, saying, "Why, travellers, do you assault me? You have no quarrel with me, nor I with you." He grasps the crucifix at his neck. "By Saint Genevieve, put up your weapons."
column2: 突然，城堡主君手持利剑，质问：“旅人啊，为何侵扰于我？汝与我无仇，我亦与汝无怨。”他攥紧颈间十字架。“以圣热纳维耶夫之名，收起兵刃。”

column1: Suddenly, under a small pile of rocks, you spot the $NamedOneName. You run forward to take it. Only then do you notice the huge spider web among the trees and rocks. Its strands are as thick as silken rope. You look left and right, and see that the web is actually a kind of pen; you're in the middle!
column2: 突然，在一小堆岩石之下，你发现了$NamedOneName。你疾步上前欲取之。此时才察觉树石之间结着一张巨网，丝线粗如锦绳。左右望去，方知此网实为牢笼，你正居其中！

column1: Suddenly, well-equipped soldiers charge forward from ambush positions, crying "Surrender or die!" You realize they must be scouts for a large army.
column2: 突然，装备精良的士兵自伏击点猛冲而出，高喊：“投降，否则死！”你断定，这必是一支大军的斥候。

column1: Suddenly, you all feel very light, almost weightless. Scrambling up the cliff is children's play. Soon you peer over the lip of the opening.
column2: 突然，众人顿觉身轻如燕，几近失重。攀崖之举，仿若孩童嬉戏。顷刻间，已窥见洞口边缘。

column1: Suddenly, you all seem weightless. The ground falls away and the wind whips your faces. Then you are all deposited on a small ledge, high on the side of the tower. $ChosenOneName smiles and signs a blessing of thanks. You draw weapons and step inside.
column2: 突然，众人仿佛失重。脚下虚空，狂风扑面。尔后，众人被稳稳安置于塔侧高处的一小平台。$ChosenOneName微笑施恩，众人拔剑，步入其中。

column1: Suddenly, you are moving safely through the place. Nothing happens. By the time you realize your prayer is answered, everyone is safely past the danger spot.
column2: 突然，众人安然穿行于此。一切如常。待你意识到祈祷已应，众人早已平安越过了险境。

column1: Suddenly, you are surrounded by guards. You grip your weapons firmly. There is a standoff, and the lord becomes more cautious.
column2: 忽然，汝被卫兵包围。汝紧握兵器，对峙之下，领主愈发谨慎。

column1: Suddenly, you are weightless. The ground falls away and the wind whips your face. Then you are all on a small ledge, high on the side of the tower. $ChosenOneName smiles and signs a blessing of thanks. You draw weapons and step inside.

column1: Suddenly, you understand exactly the sort of person that $NamedOneName seeks. Blessed with this understanding, it is easy to convince him that you are the ideal additions to his organization. In minutes you are hearing about the cause and your tasks in great detail...
column2: 突然，你彻底明了$NamedOneName所求之人。得此领悟，便易说服他，你正是其组织的理想人选。须臾之间，你已详聆其宗旨与任务……

column1: Suiting action to words, the dwarf rushes over and yanks a chain which protrudes from the earth. Suddenly the front of the hillside gives way under the red-hot boulder, which tumbles free. "I painstakingly mined away the rock beneath the magic stone. Now the culmination of my labors is here! Go, and seek the monster $NamedTwoName!"
column2: 言行合一，矮人疾步上前，拽动自地底伸出的铁链。陡然间，山坡前部崩塌，炽热巨石滚落。“我费心凿去魔石下方之岩。今朝，苦心终成正果！去吧，追寻巨兽$NamedTwoName！”

column1: Sulphurous fumes pour from a great scorched hole in a hillside. When you clamber in, you see a huge dragon's hoard of gold and jewels. Standing amid the hoard is a large gilt cross -- set by $NamedThreeName to tap the mystic power of the monster's lair. Suddenly $NamedThreeName himself rushes into view. "Begone, evil ones. I shall crush you!" he cries.
column2: 山坡上一道灼痕累累的大洞，硫磺烟气滚滚而出。你攀入其中，只见巨龙囤积的金银珠宝堆积如山。宝藏中央矗立一座鎏金大十字——由$NamedThreeName安设，以汲取魔窟之秘力。忽而，$NamedThreeName本人现身。“邪恶之徒，速退！吾将粉碎汝等！”他厉声喝道。

column1: Sulphurous fumes pour from a huge scorched hole in the side of a cliff. You start to climb up, but suddenly a great, loathsome head emerges from the hole. It is the dragon $NamedTwoName!
column2: 峭壁一侧灼痕累累的大洞，硫磺烟气滚滚而出。你开始攀援，忽见一个庞大可憎的头颅自洞中探出。正是巨兽$NamedTwoName！

column1: Sulphurous fumes pour from a ominous cave. Crawling inside, you see witches dancing in a circle, chanting hideously in front of an ancient underground ruin.
column2: 一处阴森洞穴，硫磺烟气弥漫。你匍匐而入，但见女巫围圈起舞，对着一处古老的地下遗迹，发出骇人的咒语。

column1: Sure enough, moments later there is a strange rumbling, gurgling noise. The stream begins to rise rapidly and then stops flowing; then it begins to run backwards!
column2: 果不其然，片刻之后，传来一阵异样的轰鸣与咕噜声。溪流骤涨，继而停流；随后竟逆向而行！

When he is not harmed, the cultists are shocked. One shouts in fear, "They are demons come to test us, and we have failed the test! Flee!"

column1: The Armorers' guild of $PlaceName $VarPhrase1 changes in the city government.
column2: $PlaceName的甲匠公会$VarPhrase1城市政局的变动。

column1: The Avenue of the Jewelers' Guild is lined with dignified, tasteful townhouses. Here you decide to...
column2: 珠宝商街两旁矗立着庄重而雅致的宅邸。你决定在此...

column1: The Captain of the Guard refuses to help train you. He is coldly polite, so you suspect that your lack of tact, or a poor local reputation, has turned him against you.
column2: 卫队长拒绝助你训练。他态度冷淡而礼貌，你怀疑自己失了分寸，或是当地名声不佳，以致招致其反感。

column1: The Captain of the Guard refuses to help train you. He is coldly polite; you suspect your lack of tact, or a poor local reputation, has turned him against you. In fact, you're now afraid that the guard will think even worse of you. Irritating the Captain or his guardsmen here in $PlaceName could make life quite unpleasant.
column2: 卫队长拒绝助你训练。他态度冷淡而礼貌；你怀疑自己失了分寸，或是当地名声不佳，以致招致其反感。事实上，你如今更担心卫队会对你愈发不满。若在此$PlaceName惹恼队长或其麾下兵士，日子恐怕难熬。

column1: The Captain of the Guard, $NamedOneName, $VarPhrase1 changes in the city government.
column2: 卫队长$NamedOneName，$VarPhrase1城市政局的变动。

column1: The Clothmakers' Street is dark and quiet, but the smell of dye and the fine dust of raw fabrics still hangs in the night air. You decide to...
column2: 布商街幽暗寂静，然染料之味与织物细尘仍弥漫夜空。你决定...

column1: The Emperor has proclaimed a successful conclusion to the Bohemian crusade against the Hussite heretics. All rebel cities have been recaptured and the one true Church renewed. Loyal citizens of the Empire and the one true Church are urged to return to their homes, their businesses, and their usual ways of life throughout Bohemia.
column2: 皇帝宣告波希米亚十字军讨伐胡斯派异端大捷告终。诸叛城尽复，一统真教会重振。帝国忠良及真教会信徒皆被敦促重返家园、生意与日常。

column1: The Franciscan blesses you for a timely rescue. "Those fiends were going to burn me as an offering to some devil they worship. Baphomet, I think they called it." He shakes his head mournfully, "I wonder how much humanity they still had in them."
column2: 方济各会修士为你及时相救而祝福。“那些恶徒本欲将我焚为祭品，献给所拜之魔神——我想是巴佛墨特。”他悲戚摇头，“不知他们尚存几分人性。”

column1: The Fugger Bank, led in $PlaceName by $NamedOneName, $VarPhrase1 changes in the city government.
column2: 富格尔银行由$NamedOneName领导，在$PlaceName$VarPhrase1城市政局的变动。

column1: The Fugger bankers $Support3 change.
column2: 富格尔银行家们$Support3变革。

column1: The Fugger representative looks harassed and upset. He says, "We own shares in a mining operation $Direction of town. Recently the miners have had trouble. You could win renown and serve your fellows by assisting the honest mining folk. And, once our mine was once again functioning, we would be happy to provide you with a nominal reward."
column2: 富格尔代表神情疲惫而忧心。他说：“我们在镇外$Direction有一处矿产。近日矿工多有困厄。汝若助诚实矿民，既可扬名，亦能济世。待矿场恢复运转，吾等自当奉上薄酬。”

column1: The Hansard, $NamedOneName, says, "We are troubled by the robber knight $NamedTwoName. He demands tribute. We finally refused, and he slew our emissary. Now he plunders our wagons and murders our merchants. We plan to send an expedition against him. You can be that expedition, if you choose."
column2: 汉萨商人$NamedOneName道：“盗骑士$NamedTwoName扰我甚久，索要贡赋。我等终拒，遂遭其手刃使臣。今劫掠我车，屠戮我商。拟遣远征讨之，汝若愿，便是此役。”

column1: The Hansards $Support2 the overthrow of the government.
column2: 汉萨商人$Support2推翻政府。

column1: The Hanseatic League $VarPhrase2 change in the government of $PlaceName.
column2: 汉萨同盟在$PlaceName的政府中$VarPhrase2变革。

column1: The Hanseatic League's representative, $NamedOneName, personally thanks you. "You have greatly assisted the League with the downfall of $NamedTwoName. All of our cities shall know of this." He hands you a purse of money.
column2: 汉萨代表$NamedOneName亲致谢意：“汝助同盟诛灭$NamedTwoName，功不可没。吾盟诸城皆知此事。”言罢递银囊一枚。

column1: The Hanseatic League, led in $PlaceName by $NamedOneName, $VarPhrase1 changes in the city government.
column2: 汉萨同盟由$NamedOneName领导，在$PlaceName$VarPhrase1城市政局的变动。

column1: The Hunt is now too close to avoid. You must fight.
column2: 追猎已近在咫尺，不得不战。

column1: The Hussite leader grows as red as his chalice embroidery. "You lying German scum! You think we Slavs are ignorant fools? The millenium is coming, and we must cleanse the earth of foul beasts such as you, those unholy Templars, and other followers of Satan!"
column2: 胡斯领袖面色涨红，如其圣杯绣纹。“尔等德国贱种！竟谓我斯拉夫人愚昧无知？千年将至，必当涤净大地污秽，扫除尔等邪魔、不洁的圣殿骑士及其他撒旦之徒！”

column1: The Hussites club down anyone still standing, then give the prone ones a few gratuitous kicks. Thinking you dead, they take armor, weapons, and items of obvious value. "Spoils of war," remarks the leader to one of his men.
column2: 胡斯党徒击倒尚存之人，又肆意踢打。误以为汝已亡，遂夺甲胄、武器及值钱之物。“战利品也。”领袖对部下一哂。

column1: The Hussites glower at you, muttering, "German scum" and, "Slavs must triumph." Suddenly, one of them shouts, "Cleanse the earth of these foul foreigners!" and they surge toward you.
column2: 胡斯党徒怒视汝，低语“德国贱种”“斯拉夫必胜”。忽一人高呼：“荡涤此方污秽！”众人齐向汝扑来。

column1: The Hussites, hearing the name of an unfamiliar saint, jump to the obvious conclusion. "Devil worshippers!" the leader screams, "you pray to no saint we know!" In a second they attack, weapons whistling in the air.
column2: 胡斯党徒闻陌生圣名，当即断定：“恶魔崇拜者！”领袖厉声喝道：“汝祷非吾等所知之圣！”旋即挥刃攻来，刀光呼啸。

column1: The Leihhaus is a new invention of the Fugger bankers. It provides loans to everyday citizens, secured by valuables those citizens give to the Leihhaus. Although many loans are never repaid, the Fuggers can still make a profit by reselling those valuables. As a result, the Leihhaus offers a wide selection of everyday goods for sale, and will give you some money for almost any of your possessions.
column2: 典当行乃富格尔银行家新创。以民众所押贵物为担保，放贷于市井百姓。虽多笔贷款终未偿还，富格尔仍可转售抵押物获利。故典当行广售日用品，几乎任何财物皆可典当换现。

column1: The Lieutenant of the Guard is pleased by your desire to train with them.
column2: 卫队长欣见汝欲与其共练。

column1: The Master Hansard of $PlaceName, $NamedOneName, greets you from his desk.
column2: $PlaceName的汉萨首领$NamedOneName于案前迎汝。

column1: The Medici representative here $VarPhrase4 change in the city government.
column2: 此地美第奇代表$VarPhrase4城市政局的变动。

column1: The Medici representatives $Support4 the rebels.
column2: 美第奇代表$Support4支持叛军。

column1: The Preceptor smiles weakly. "The gate is guarded by warding symbols," he says. "The closer you get to the castle, the further away you will be, unless the first seal is broken -- and you can get no further than the outer courtyard until the second seal is broken. And we guard the second seal. If you try to break it, you will be on the horns of a dilemma!" He laughs, then coughs wetly. The light quickly fades from his eyes.
column2: 接堂长微弱一笑：“城门设守御之符，愈近城堡，愈觉遥远，除非先破第一道封印——且第二道未解，绝难逾外庭。第二道由吾等把守。若妄图破解，汝将进退维谷！”言罢干咳一声，目光渐黯。

column1: The Schulz has little of import to tell you. The nearest big town is $NearestCity. The church holds mass every morning, and there are folk in the hamlet that are willing to take in boarders.
column2: 乡长无要事相告。最近的大镇在$NearestCity。教堂每日晨礼，村中亦有愿意收留客人的住户。

column1: The Schulz shrugs and chooses a girl on his own. You stay to watch the outcome. The weeping girl is dressed in white, escorted to the edge of town, and tied to a stake!
column2: 乡长耸肩，自行择女。汝留观其果。那哭泣少女身着白衣，被护送至镇边，缚于木桩之上！

column1: The Stone-Tar potion looks almost alive as it oozes down the side of the pit. But it is sticky enough to bear your weight as you climb out, clinging to the gluey substance with hands and knees. Soon you are all out of the pit. You wipe off your hands, and proceed on your way.
column2: 石脂药剂似活物般沿坑壁缓缓流下。然其黏稠足以承汝体重，攀援时双手双膝紧贴其上。不久，汝等皆出坑外。拭手前行。

column1: The Templars are certainly surprised by the potion exploding among them, but they are far from frightened.
column2: 圣殿骑士见药剂爆裂于己群，惊讶不已，却未惊恐。

column1: The Templars are delighted with their good fortune. "Now we can save this Franciscan for the High Sabbat at $SabbatTime, $SabbatLocation," they exclaim, "and sacrifice these warriors to Baphomet now!"
column2: 圣殿骑士喜获佳运：“今可将此方济各会修士留待$SabbatTime的高级安息日，$SabbatLocation，再将此等武士献祭巴佛墨特！”

column1: The Templars are satisfied with chasing you off, then returning to their original tasks. You mourn the poor Franciscan, doomed to a horrible fate.
column2: 圣殿骑士驱汝而去后，满意归位，继续本职。汝哀悼那可怜修士，注定罹难。

column1: The Templars are satisfied with chasing you off, then returning to their original tasks. You mourn the poor Franciscan, doomed to a horrible fate. However, your mourn those left behind in the fight, who are surely doomed to the same fate as well!
column2: 圣殿骑士驱汝而去后，满意归位，继续本职。汝哀悼那可怜修士，注定罹难。然汝亦哀逝者，彼等必同赴黄泉！

column1: The Templars are surprised by your appearance.
column2: 圣殿骑士见汝现身，颇为诧异。

column1: The Templars howl with laughter. "You expect us to foresake Baphomet for THAT trifle! Even Judas got more than that!"
column2: 圣殿骑士狂笑：“汝竟欲吾等弃巴佛墨特，只为区区小事！连犹大所得亦不止于此！”

column1: The Templars panic when the potion explodes among them. "Master, please!" they scream, running in all directions.
column2: 药剂爆裂，圣殿骑士惊慌失措：“师父救命！”四散奔逃。

column1: The Templars step back, frightened, but when nothing happens, they regain their courage and light the faggots.
column2: 圣殿骑士们吓得后退一步，但见无事发生，便重拾勇气，点燃了火把。

column1: The Vulcans surround those still in the cave, then join in a circle of fire that flows toward the center. In a flash, all within are consumed by the flame and turned to ash.
column2: 火山族围住洞中残存者，聚火成圈，火焰向中心卷去。顷刻之间，尽成灰烬。

column1: The abbess visits you, accompanied by servants and her clerk.
column2: 修女院长携仆从及书记来访。

column1: The abbot greets you warmly. "Before I explain, let me say that this task is very important. We have many ways of showing gratitude. For example, the librarian can give you a guided tour of our books, perhaps opening your eyes to many new saints. The Master of Novices could tutor you in various subjects..."
column2: 院长热情迎汝：“未言之前，先申明此任殊为重要。吾等感恩之道颇多。譬如，图书馆员可导览藏书，或令汝识诸多新圣。初阶导师亦可授汝诸学……”

column1: The abbot is curious about political affairs in the city, and would happily exchange opinions with you.
column2: 院长关心市政，乐与汝交换意见。

column1: The abbot of the $monastery and the monks $Support2 change.
column2: $monastery的院长及僧侣$Support2变革。

column1: The acid dissolves a hole in the sally port large enough for you to fit a blade through and unlatch it. Once the door is open, you race into the city, still well ahead of the guards.
column2: 酸液蚀穿突门，孔径足容刃入，遂启锁。门开，汝疾驰入城，仍领先卫队甚远。

column1: The alchemist greets you in a friendly manner. "I am trying to obtain certain potions. I would be delighted to offer you my $NamedOneName if you have something that interests me. What say you?"
column2: 化学家友好迎汝：“吾欲得若干秘药。汝若有吾所求，吾当以$NamedOneName相赠。汝意如何？”

column1: The alchemist is delighted with the trade. "I have many customers who seek this potion, as its creation is beyond my humble knowledge. Would, you, perhaps, be interested in another trade?"
column2: 炼金术士对这笔交易欣喜不已。“有许多顾客求购此药剂，然其制法非我浅学所能及。阁下可愿再作一桩交易？”

column1: The alchemist shakes his head in annoyance. He can't sell you a formula if you don't have the money to pay the price.
column2: 炼金术士恼怒地摇头。若无银两支付，他岂能将配方售予你？

column1: The alchemist shakes his head in annoyance. You wouldn't want to waste money buying a formula you already know, would you?
column2: 炼金术士恼怒地摇头。既已知配方，又何必徒费金钱购买？

column1: The altar boy bows low and shows you into the chapel. Then he runs off and joins the priest. They finish preparations for the Mass while you wait.
column2: 童仆深深一揖，引你入礼拜堂。随即奔去，与司祭会合。二人忙于弥撒前之准备，而你则静候。

column1: The altar boy only knows that the next Mass will be held at $NamedOneName. Meanwhile, all the priests are resting or asleep. He suggests you return during the daytime if you wish to make a confession or offer a tithe.
column2: 童仆仅知下一场弥撒将于$NamedOneName举行。此时诸司祭或休憩，或沉睡。若欲告解或献什一税，不妨日间再来。

column1: The altar is now complete: rough stone and black fires burning at the four corners. It resembles a place of death more than a place of worship.
column2: 祭坛已然就绪：粗石为基，四隅燃黑火。与其说是礼赞之所，毋宁说是死域。

column1: The ambush has failed. Your leader, $ChosenOneName, lacked sufficient woodcraft. Meanwhile, in the pause while everyone nervously fingers their weapons, you choose to...
column2: 伏击失败。汝之首领$ChosenOneName木工技艺不足。众人皆紧张握刃之际，汝遂选择……

column1: The ancient walled monastery of $PlaceName sits on a rocky hilltop, overlooking pastures sprinkled with well-tended flocks. As you approach, you see a few monks and peasants working in small vegetable plots. You decide to...
column2: 古老的环墙修道院$PlaceName踞于岩巅，俯瞰点缀着精心牧养羊群的牧场。近观可见数名僧侣与农人于小菜畦间劳作。汝遂决定……

column1: The animals savagely tear into your bodies. Only those with strong armor or superb constitution survive such punishment.
column2: 野兽猛噬汝身。唯甲坚体健者，方能幸免此难。

column1: The answer does not mollify the man; he begins to shriek in a high-pitched voice. With no choices left, you draw weapons and try to subdue him.
column2: 此答未能平息其怒，彼遂尖声呼号。无奈之下，汝只得拔剑，试图制伏之。

column1: The armed men are in the service of $NamedOneName, the raubritter. You choose to ...
column2: 此等武装者乃$NamedOneName麾下之劫骑士所役。汝遂选择……

column1: The armorers $Support2 change.
column2: 锻甲师$Support2更替。

column1: The armorers' guild $VarPhrase3 change in the government.
column2: 锻甲师公会$VarPhrase3于政局中更迭。

column1: The army of $NamedOneName has finally defeated his adversary, $NamedTwoName, in a major battle. Most travellers and traders are relieved. Travel will be easier, and the cities opened once more.
column2: $NamedOneName之军终在一役大胜其敌$NamedTwoName。旅人商贾无不松一口气。往来将更便捷，城邑亦重开。

column1: The artisans and tinkers $Support4 change.
column2: 工匠与杂匠$Support4更替。

column1: The assassins realize their ambush is compromised. With a yell, a strong, armored knight leads a well-equipped band of troops straight toward you! You now...
column2: 刺客察觉伏击已败露。一声呐喊，一骑甲胄雄壮之骑士率众直扑而来！汝遂……

column1: The awesome desperation of the situation lends such power to your prayers that you are hardly surprised by the intensity of the answer: there is a blinding flash of light, and when your eyes clear, the innocents have vanished.
column2: 局势之危急使祷告格外灵验，故得应如斯强烈：一道炫目白光闪过，待视线复明，无辜者已杳然。

column1: The bailiff and his guards drag you to the public square and whip you soundly. Then, you are freed, penniless and injured.
column2: 法官及其卫队将汝押赴广场，痛加鞭笞。随后放汝，身无分文，遍体鳞伤。

column1: The bailiff unlocks your manacles and you are taken to the town square, where you are released.
column2: 法官启汝镣铐，送汝至市集，释放之。

column1: The baliff is angry and insulted.
column2: 法官怒不可遏，颜面尽失。

column1: The bandit-soldiers barely stop to hear your words, then surge forward again, crying, "Gold or blood!" Unfortunately, it seems that they're seeking both. You have no choice but to fight.
column2: 盗兵几不听汝言，旋即再度进逼，高呼：“金银或血！”不幸的是，二者兼取无疑。汝别无选择，唯有迎战。

column1: The bandits barely stop to hear your attempts, then surge forward again with the cry, "Gold or blood!" Unfortunately, it seems that they're seeking both. You have no choice but to fight.
column2: 盗兵不稍停汝辩，径直冲来，厉声喝道：“金银或血！”不幸的是，二者兼取无疑。汝别无选择，唯有迎战。

column1: The bandits beat everyone to unconsciousness, then strip you of arms, armor, and obvious valuables.
column2: 盗兵将众人击昏，随即剥汝衣甲，夺汝财物。

column1: The bandits beat those left in their power until the victims appear dead, then strip them of arms, armor, and obvious valuables.
column2: 盗兵将余者尽殴至奄奄一息，继而剥汝衣甲，掠汝财物。

column1: The bandits carry you outside and pound you for some time, then leave you for dead. However, their beating was not as thorough as it might have been. You yet live.
column2: 盗兵将汝拖出，捶打良久，弃汝于荒野。然其殴打未尽全力，汝犹存一线生机。

column1: The bandits hear, then see your attack. They immediately turn about and charge toward you. Only one caravan guard is strong enough to pursue the bandits and join you in the fight. The rest can barely stand.
column2: 盗兵闻汝袭来，旋即回身扑向汝。惟一车夫甲士足以追击，助汝一战。余人几不能立。

column1: The bandits hear, then see your attack. They immediately turn about and charge toward you. The caravan guards, exhausted and wounded, are unable to come to your aid. In fact, they can barely stand.
column2: 盗兵闻汝袭来，旋即回身扑向汝。车夫疲惫受伤，无力援手。实则几不能立。

column1: The bandits propose that they take all your money and weapons, in exchange for leaving the rest of your possessions untouched and yourselves unharmed. You...
column2: 盗兵提议交出汝之金银与武器，以换得其余财物与性命无恙。汝遂……

column1: The bandits roughly and efficiently strip you of arms, armor, and all valuables.
column2: 盗兵粗暴而利落地剥汝衣甲，夺汝财物。

column1: The bandits snarl at your poor attempts to bargain.
column2: 盗兵嗤笑汝之拙劣讨价还价。

column1: The bandits strip you of arms, armor and obvious valuables. Satisfied, they disappear into the bush and hills, leaving you to tend your wounds. The one beneficial result is that they're unlikely to bother you soon, should you continue camping here.
column2: 盗兵剥汝衣甲，掠汝财物。满意之后，隐入林莽丘壑，任汝自疗伤痛。唯一之益处在于，若汝仍在此扎营，短期内恐不再遭其扰。

column1: The banker explains...
column2: 银行家解释……

column1: The banker smiles as he mentally calculates the money you have saved him. His mine is preserved, his investment is safe. He says, "You have proven yourself a friend of the Fuggers."
column2: 银行家心算汝为其省却之资，欣然一笑。其矿脉得以保全，投资安然无虞。曰：“汝诚弗格家族之友也。”

column1: The baying of spectral hounds draws ever closer at a supernatural rate. It is the Wild Hunt!
column2: 幽冥猎犬吠声以超自然之速逼近。正是狂猎！

column1: The bear lies dead at your feet.  Bear meat makes for wonderful rations.  You cook, salt and store it before you journey on.
column2: 熊伏尸于足下。熊肉堪为佳肴。汝烹煮、腌渍、贮藏，然后启程。

column1: The bear lies dead at your feet. Bear meat makes for wonderful rations.  You cook, salt and store it before you journey on. The problem of the bear solved, you attend to the mystery of the old storage chest. You pry it open to find the spoils of some unfortunate thief.
column2: 熊伏尸于足下。熊肉堪为佳肴。汝烹煮、腌渍、贮藏，然后启程。熊患既除，汝转而探究旧箱之谜。撬开箱盖，见一倒霉窃贼之赃物。

column1: The bear reaches $ChosenOneName before any weapons can strike a blow.  $ChosenOneName falls to the attack, seriously injured although still alive.
column2: 熊先至$ChosenOneName，尚未及发一击。$ChosenOneName受创倒地，虽重伤犹存。

column1: The beasts sniff at your hands, but the clothes mask your true smell: the wolves slink away. You start forward, congratulating yourselves, when a man steps from concealment and smiles thinly.
column2: 群狼嗅汝之手，然衣物掩其真味，狼遂悄然退去。汝正欲前行，自贺之时，忽有男子自暗处现身，淡然一笑。

column1: The best effort of $ChosenOneName is not enough. The bonds are just too strong.
column2: $ChosenOneName之尽力仍不足以破缚。绳索过于坚韧。

column1: The bishop himself happens to be at the cathedral. With a knowing expression, he makes you an offer.
column2: 主教亲临教堂。含笑向汝提出一议。

column1: The bishop laughs at $ChosenOneName's attempt to plead that your virtuous nature deserves special consideration.
column2: 主教哂笑$ChosenOneName之恳求，谓汝之善行理应特予优待。

column1: The bishop nods. "A wise choice, to render the Church her due." He turns to his clerk, and says, "Put that in my strongbox, there."
column2: 主教颔首：“纳圣俸，明智之举。”遂转向书记，曰：“将其收入吾之保险箱。”

column1: The bishop of the $cathedral and his followers $Support4 change.
column2: $cathedral的主教及其追随者$Support4变革。

column1: The bishop openly sneers when you ask him for the promised relic. "You actually think that, after the wrongs you have committed in my city of $PlaceName, I would reward you? Begone, foul criminals, before I call the guard!" You leave, frustrated.
column2: 当你向主教索要那件许诺的圣物时，他公然嗤笑一声。“你以为，在你于吾城$PlaceName所犯下的种种罪行之后，我还会赏赐于你吗？滚吧，你们这些卑劣的罪人，否则我就叫卫兵来！”你悻悻而去。

column1: The bishop promptly claps his mouth shut and quickly leads his party onward.
column2: 主教立刻闭上了嘴，匆匆带领随从前行。

column1: The bishop spots you, stops his party, and says, "Travellers, this path is protected by God. Surely you will pay the appropriate tithe for this service!" He examines you more closely, then decides. "For you, $Money1. Collect it, clerk."
column2: 主教发现了你，止住队伍，说道：“旅人啊，此路乃上帝庇佑。汝等当为此服务缴纳应得的什一税！”他仔细打量了你一番，随即决定：“就收你$Money1吧。去收钱，书记官。”

column1: The bishop spots you, stops his party, looks you over carefully, then remarks to his escort, "it is written in the scripture of Saint Luke that 'it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the Kingdom of Heaven.' " He laughs and concludes, "clearly, these children are ready for heaven now!" Still chuckling, they ride on.
column2: 主教发现了你，停下队伍，细细端详了一番，对随从说道：“圣卢克经上云：‘骆驼穿过针眼，比富人入天国还容易。’”他大笑一声，总结道：“看来，这些孩子如今已可升天了！”说罢，他们继续骑马前行。

column1: The bishop's guards are too tired to chase your fleeing forms through the brush. They just wave their weapons angrily and rejoin their leader.
column2: 主教的卫兵已疲惫不堪，无力追击你在灌木丛中逃窜的身影。他们只是愤怒地挥舞着武器，重新归队。

column1: The blackness and evil that surround this place make it too difficult to say the proper words. The heavens are silent for now.
column2: 此地四周弥漫的黑暗与邪恶，令人难以诵出应有的祷词。苍穹此刻寂静无声。

column1: The blackness and evil that surround this place make it too difficult to say the proper words. The heavens are silent for now. Therefore, you ...
column2: 此地四周弥漫的黑暗与邪恶，令人难以诵出应有的祷词。苍穹此刻寂静无声。因此，你……

column1: The blackness of unconsciousness hides all further events. When you awake, it is midnight. You are tied to a stake set atop a ceremonial hill, and you are surrounded by witches. Strange gurgles and howls rise into the night air as their awful worship begins. Each witch holds aloft a tiny, crude sculpture of a dragon.
column2: 失去知觉的黑暗掩盖了一切后续之事。当你醒来时，已是午夜。你被绑在一座祭坛之巅的木桩上，四周环绕着女巫。怪异的咕噜声与嚎叫声在夜空中回荡，她们可怕的祭祀仪式已然开始。每位女巫都高举着一只粗糙的小型龙形雕像。

column1: The blacksmiths $Support change.
column2: 铁匠$Support更替。

column1: The blacksmiths' guild $VarPhrase1 change in the government of $PlaceName.
column2: 铁匠公会$VarPhrase1于$PlaceName之政局中更迭。

column1: The blinding snow makes it impossible to see more than a few feet ahead of you. Still you stagger forward, struggling to the last of your strength. Only then do you collapse in the lee of a boulder, dig a snow hole, and make a cold, wet camp.
column2: 刺眼的飞雪使你无法看清前方数步之外的景象。即便如此，你仍踉跄前行，竭尽最后一丝力气。最终，你倒在一块巨石的背风处，挖了个雪洞，勉强扎营。

column1: The blizzard lasts $Number1 days. You shiver through it, gradually freezing to death as your food runs low, your cloth cracks, and your alchemical materials are ruined. Finally the snow and wind abate, allowing you to painfully stagger out and get your bearings.
column2: 暴风雪持续$Number1日。你在寒风中瑟瑟发抖，随着食物耗尽、衣物破损、炼金材料毁坏，逐渐冻毙。终于，风雪渐息，你才艰难地走出营地，辨明方向。

column1: The boat captain is pathetically grateful for your single-handed defense of the camp against the pirates. You tactfully overlook the fact that he, the crew, and the passengers all hid while you fought it out!
column2: 船长对你独自抵御海盗的行为感激涕零。你巧妙地忽略了这样一个事实：在他、船员和乘客们躲藏之时，唯有你奋战到底！

column1: The bodyguards of $NamedOneName stand behind you with levelled and cocked crossbows. You decide to leave now.
column2: $NamedOneName的侍卫手持搭箭上弦的弩，立于你身后。你决定即刻离开。

column1: The bottle shatters, and the potion damages the tough wood and metal of the sally port, but it does not weaken it enough to permit you entry. The potion has failed. Another might complete the job -- or perhaps you had better look to other options.
column2: 瓶子碎裂，药剂虽损及哨门的坚木与铁质，却未能使其足够脆弱以供你闯入。药剂失效了。或许另有良方能成此事——抑或你该另寻他途。

column1: The bowyers and gunsmiths $Support3 changes.
column2: 弓匠与枪匠$Support3更替。

column1: The bowyers' and gunsmiths' guild $VarPhrase4 change in the city government.
column2: 弓匠与枪匠公会$VarPhrase4于市政中更迭。

column1: The bright explosion of the potion almost blinds you. As your vision clears, you see bits of sticky black vine everywhere, while dark multi-legged shapes dash away.
column2: 药剂的耀眼爆炸几乎令你失明。视线渐清，只见四处皆是黏稠的黑色藤蔓碎片，而漆黑的多足生物正四散奔逃。

column1: The bright explosion of the potion almost blinds you. As your vision clears, you see huge snakelike creatures with two front legs dashing away into the brush.
column2: 药剂的耀眼爆炸几乎令你失明。视线渐清，只见巨大的蛇形生物拖着两条前腿，疾速遁入灌木丛中。

column1: The bright explosion of the potion almost blinds you. Bits of leaves and grass rain down, smoldering. The schrats are already running madly in the opposite direction, frightened witless by your alchemy.
column2: 药剂的耀眼爆炸几乎令你失明。树叶与草屑纷纷落下，仍在冒烟。那些小妖早已惊恐万状，疯狂朝相反方向奔逃。

column1: The busy traffic for the city fair has the streets clogged with carts and porters. Amid the chaos, you look for picture signs portraying various guilds and crafts. You turn toward...
column2: 城市集市的繁忙交通使街道挤满了车舆与搬运工。混乱之中，你寻找描绘各公会与手工艺的标志。你转向……

column1: The captain sails his boat near the shore, among the reeds. You jump overboard with only your personal gear. After a brief swim, you wade to shore, wet and cold. You dry off and look toward $PlaceName...
column2: 船长将船驶近岸边，穿行于芦苇之间。你仅携随身之物跃入水中。短暂泅渡后，你湿冷地涉水上岸。稍作烘干，你望向$PlaceName……

column1: The caravan master considers your words, then adds this comment:
column2: 商队首领斟酌你的言辞，随后补充道：

column1: The caravan master is pathetically grateful for your help.
column2: 商队首领对你伸出援手感激不已。

column1: The castle lord himself is upset by the ongoing warfare.
column2: 城堡领主本人也为连绵战事忧心忡忡。

column1: The cave is dry and empty, save for a few wind-blown leaves. Perhaps someone, or something, lived here long ago. But there is no sign of recent habitation. You are a little relieved, but also a little disappointed. Either way, there is nothing more to do but go on your way.
column2: 山洞干燥空旷，唯见几片风卷落叶。或许曾有人或某物在此栖居。然并无近期居住之迹。你稍感宽慰，却又略显失望。无论如何，只得继续前行。

column1: The cave is dry and empty, save for a few wind-blown leaves. Perhaps someone, or something, lived here long ago. Then, up in a far corner, $ChosenOneName spots the $NamedOneName.
column2: 山洞干燥空旷，唯见几片风卷落叶。或许曾有人或某物在此栖居。忽见远角处，$ChosenOneName发现了$NamedOneName。

column1: The cavern shakes with the wrath of Heaven, and rocks rain down from the ceiling. $NamedOneName looks fearful. You know that Heaven is on your side, and that your chances for success are enhanced.
column2: 天堂震怒，洞穴摇撼，岩块自顶棚坠落。$NamedOneName神色惶恐。你深知天意在己，胜算大增。

column1: The cell is shut up with a thick wooden door. Iron banding strengthens it and a large bolt holds it fast. On a far wall hang keys, one of which slides the bolt open. The reunion with $ChosenOneName is brief and joyful. Quickly you are off before the escape is discovered.
column2: 牢房以厚重木门紧闭，铁箍加固，巨栓牢牢锁住。远墙上悬挂钥匙，其中一把可拨动巨栓。与$ChosenOneName重逢短暂而欢欣。你迅速离去，以免逃亡之事败露。

column1: The ceremony does not begin for another hour; you and a few other early arrivals are the only ones nearby aside from a stonemason putting finishing touches on the altar-block, and a satanic priest who seems to be examining the pentagrams with a careful eye.
column2: 礼仪尚有一时方始，四周唯有你等早至之人，以及一名正为祭坛石块收尾的石匠，还有一位似在细察五芒星的邪教司祭。

column1: The chamber is still full of the horrid green mist. Desperately, you think of what else you could do...
column2: 室内仍弥漫着恶臭的绿色雾气。你焦急思索，还能做些什么……

column1: The chapel is small, but well-kept. A tiny graveyard encircles it.
column2: 小教堂虽小，却维护得宜。周遭环以小小墓园。
