column1: The path is blocked by an iron door. Flanking it are two paintings of grotesque dwarfs. One painting animates and speaks aloud, pointing to the other:
column2: 小径为一道铁门所阻。两侧绘有两幅怪诞矮人画像。其中一幅活化，指向另一幅，开口说道：

column1: The peasants are abashed. Some cry, "$He is right! Better to abandon our farms than become murderers, helpers to the foul dragon!" Others are unrepentant, saying "Nay! Better that a stranger die than we lose all."
column2: 农民们羞愧难当。有人哭道：“你说得对！宁弃田舍，莫为恶龙帮凶！”亦有人执迷不悟，谓：“不可！宁杀外人，勿失一切。”

column1: The peasants are abashed. Some cry, "$He is right! Better we should abandon our homes and farms than become murderers, helpers to the foul dragon!" Others are unrepentant, saying "Nay! Better that she die than that we should lose all."
column2: 农民们羞愧难当。有人哭道：“你说得对！宁舍家园田亩，莫为恶龙帮凶！”亦有人执迷不悟，谓：“不可！宁杀彼女，勿失一切。”

column1: The pharmacist of $PlaceName specializes in selling herbs and rare materials to physicians, midwives, and alchemists.
column2: $PlaceName之药剂师专营草药及珍材，售予医师、助产士及炼金术士。

column1: The phial breaks in a gentle puff of powder. The demon breathes deep and grins in defiance.
column2: 药瓶轻绽，粉末飘散。恶魔深吸一口，狞笑以对。

column1: The physician examines the wounds, then says, "These wounds will heal faster with my professional treatments. I can treat you now, and since $Number1 of you suffer, the overall cost will be $Money1."
column2: 医者检视伤痕，曰：“若施吾术，愈合必速。今可疗之，且汝等$Number1人同病，总费仅为$Money1。”

column1: The physician frowns. "I'm sorry, but I am unable to take any students for tutoring and/or training."
column2: 医者蹙眉：“抱歉，吾无力收徒授业。”

column1: The physician looks you over and shakes his head.
column2: 医者审视汝身，摇头叹息。

column1: The pirates efficiently relieve all captives of their arms, armor and valuables. Then they pillage the boat and leave.
column2: 海盗利索地剥去俘虏之兵甲财货，随即劫掠船只而去。

column1: The plaque is not a plaque at all, but a secret message! "To ye who read this," it says, "take heart! The evil ones cannot read this tongue. There is a secret catch to unlock the door, hidden in the south wall." The instructions are simple, and you quickly find the lever. The seemingly impregnable door swings open without further ado.
column2: 此非铭牌，乃一封密函！“阅此者，”函云，“毋惧！恶徒不解此语。南墙暗藏机关，可启此门。”指示简明，汝迅即寻得扳机。坚不可摧之门应声而开。

column1: The plaque is not a plaque at all, but a secret message! "To ye who reads this," it says, "take heart! The evil ones cannot read this tongue. There is a secret catch to unlock the door, hidden in the south wall." The instructions are simple, and you quickly find the lever. The seemingly impregnable door swings open without further ado.
column2: 此非铭牌，乃一封密函！“阅此者，”函云，“毋惧！恶徒不解此语。南墙暗藏机关，可启此门。”指示简明，汝迅即寻得扳机。坚不可摧之门应声而开。

column1: The poor friar is overwhelmed. "Such generosity, such warmness of heart, such Christian charity!" Tears begin to roll down his cheeks. "I never thought to find such in this world." He bows low.
column2: 贫苦修士感动不已。“如此慷慨，如此仁心，如此基督之慈爱！”泪水盈眶。“此生未料世间尚存此等美善。”遂深深鞠躬。

column1: The poor wolves cannot bite through your metal armor. They content themselves with ferocious growling that drives you away.
column2: 穷困之狼噬不动汝之铁甲。唯狂吠驱汝远遁。

column1: The port area of $PlaceName is almost empty. The city army has barricades and walls along the waterfront, to protect against seaborne attack. The few piers with boats are heavily fortified. A senior officer supervises the troops and watches everything carefully. You...
column2: $PlaceName之港区几近空旷。城军沿岸设障筑垒，以防海袭。寥寥泊船之处皆严加防护。一名高级军官督阵，目不转睛。汝……

column1: The poster says that one $NamedOneName seeks "Tough crowd, not afraid to get their hands dirty." It sounds interesting challenging, and the pay looks good ( $Money1 ). You ...
column2: 海报称某$NamedOneName招募“硬汉，不怕沾泥弄脏”。任务看似有趣且具挑战，酬金亦优。汝……

column1: The poster says that one $NamedOneName seeks "brave men and women for seemingly trivial task -- but not all of us are brave." It sounds interesting, but the reward offer is only $Number1 florins. You ...
column2: 海报称某$NamedOneName招募“勇者男女，从事看似琐务——然非人人皆勇”。任务颇引人入胜，惟赏金仅$Number1弗罗林。汝……

column1: The potion bottle bursts in front of the cutthroats. While they are delayed, you dash off, easily outdistancing their pursuit.
column2: 药瓶于歹徒面前爆裂。趁其迟滞，汝疾步逃逸，轻易摆脱追击。

column1: The potion bottle flies through the air, then lands with a dull thud on the wet grass -- and fails to shatter. The swift and deadly tatzelwurms do not hesitate as they move toward their evening meal: you!
column2: 药瓶凌空飞落，沉闷落地于湿草之上——竟未碎裂。迅捷致命的塔策尔蠕虫毫不迟疑，直扑晚餐：汝也！

column1: The potion bottle rolls lazily through the air, then lands with a dull thump in the wet grass -- and fails to shatter. The large forms of the wild forest men barely hesitate as they lumber to the attack.
column2: 药瓶懒洋洋地滚落，沉闷一声落在湿草上——仍未破碎。粗壮的林野之人缓缓逼近，发动猛攻。

column1: The potion bursts with a dull pop, but only a few villagers are adversely affected. They do not seem sure as to what has happened. Perhaps a second potion would do the trick.
column2: 药瓶闷响炸裂，然仅少数村民受波及。彼等茫然不知所措。或许再服一瓶方能奏效。

column1: The potion causes a strange whirlpool in the muck, which clears a spot in the center. This helps $ChosenOneName get free of the clinging muck and slowly crawl out. $He emerges exhausted and missing a few items, but otherwise unhurt.
column2: 药瓶搅动淤泥，中央现出一片净地。此举助$ChosenOneName脱困，缓缓爬出。你疲惫而出，遗失些许物什，幸无大碍。

column1: The potion changes the muck-hole into nothing more than a dry hole. $ChosenOneName brushes $himself off and climbs up the now-solid sides to safety.
column2: 药瓶使泥坑化为干涸之穴。$ChosenOneName抖落你自己，攀上坚实之壁，安然脱险。

column1: The potion explodes among the ambushers. Immediately, a strong, armored knight leads a well-equipped band of troops straight at you! You now...
column2: 药瓶于伏兵中爆炸。顷刻间，一骑铠甲鲜明之骑士率众直扑汝来！汝如今……

column1: The potion explodes among the charging beasts, but they continue, undaunted. Obviously the animals are driven by forces more powerful than alchemy!
column2: 药瓶于奔袭之兽群中爆炸，然诸兽仍无所畏惧。显然，驱使诸兽者，非炼金之力也。

column1: The potion explodes among the nobleman's men. Their horses scream and rear, dumping riders into the mud. The nobleman's steed panics, sending him into an uncontrollable gallop away down the road.
column2: 药瓶于贵族随从间爆炸。马匹嘶鸣后仰，摔落骑手于泥泞之中。贵族坐骑惊恐失控，载主沿路狂奔而去。

column1: The potion explodes beside the bishop, right in front of the guards. Their horses scream and rear, dumping the riders in the mud.
column2: 药瓶于主教身旁爆炸，卫士眼前。马匹嘶鸣后仰，摔落骑手于泥泞之中。

column1: The potion explodes just in front of your pursuers. Their horses panic, causing enormous chaos and confusion. With this advantage, you make a clean escape.
column2: 药瓶于追兵前方爆炸。马匹惊慌失措，引发混乱。汝借此良机，从容逃脱。

column1: The potion explodes quite nicely, causing people to open their windows and leave their houses all along the street. Unfortunately, every time you try to sneak in, you run into somebody either coming or going through that door.
column2: 药剂炸得颇为壮观，引得整条街的人纷纷开窗出门。可惜每次你试图潜入时，总会遇到有人进出那扇门。

column1: The potion explodes with a most impressive effect. Up and down the street, people begin to run about, frightened and confused. You easily climb through a side window into an unoccupied room.
column2: 药剂爆发出极为惊人的效果。街道上，人们惊恐而混乱地四处奔逃。你轻而易举地从一扇侧窗攀入一间无人的房间。

column1: The potion explodes with a satisfying burst of light and noise. Suddenly the friar is terrified.
column2: 药剂伴随着令人满意的光与声炸裂开来。突然间，修士惊恐万分。

column1: The potion explodes, but the monster ignores its effects and grips $ChosenOneName. As the creature launches into flight, $ChosenOneName wriggles and falls free! The dragon vanishes, trailing smoke and stink. You all rush over to $ChosenOneName, who sits up groggily.
column2: 药剂爆炸了，但怪物无视其效果，紧紧抓住$ChosenOneName。当生物腾空而起时，$ChosenOneName挣扎着脱身！巨龙消失不见，留下烟雾与恶臭。你们纷纷奔向$ChosenOneName，他昏昏沉沉地坐了起来。

column1: The potion goes off with a bang, but when the fumes clear, you see that the box is only slightly marred. Would another potion finish the job the first began?
column2: 药剂轰然炸开，但烟雾散去后，你只见箱子仅略有损伤。另一剂药能否完成前一剂未竟之事？

column1: The potion goes off, but it is not close enough and powerful enough to really bother them. Suddenly, you are faced with just two choices:
column2: 药水生效了，但距离不够近，威力也不足以真正困扰他们。突然间，你只剩下两个选择：

column1: The potion hardens the muck until it is more like sand or dirt. $ChosenOneName can now slowly clear $his way out. $He emerges exhausted and missing a few items, but otherwise unhurt.
column2: 药水使淤泥硬化，变得更像沙土。$ChosenOneName 得以慢慢清出一条出路。$He 精疲力竭地爬了出来，丢失了几件物品，但并无大碍。

column1: The potion is hurled; a cloud of reddish smoke surrounds the demonic form. With a deep inhalation of breath, the demon smiles.
column2: 药剂被掷出；一团赤红色的烟雾笼罩着恶魔的身影。深吸一口气，恶魔微微一笑。

column1: The potion lands in front of them, fizzles, and makes a weak pop! Enraged, the Hussite leader screams, "Devil spawn!" and charges toward you. You still attempt to flee...
column2: 药剂落在他们面前，发出嘶嘶声，轻轻一响！愤怒的胡斯派首领大喊：“恶魔之子！”并朝你冲来。你仍试图逃跑……

column1: The potion lands in the mud and fizzles into nothing. The bishop makes an imperious gesture and his guards all draw weapons. In a split second, you decide to...
column2: 药水落入泥中，瞬间化为乌有。主教傲然一挥手，卫兵们纷纷拔剑。电光火石间，你决定……

column1: The potion lands in the mud and fizzles to nothing. The nobleman makes an imperious gesture and his guards all draw weapons. You have a split second to decide to...
column2: 药水落入泥中，瞬间化为乌有。那位贵族傲然一挥手，卫兵们纷纷拔出武器。你只有片刻时间来决定……

column1: The potion lands on the roof and explodes. In seconds the entire building is afire. A blonde woman charges out the front door straight for you, screaming vile curses. Meanwhile, from all around you hear the howl of wolves. You barely have time to raise your weapons!
column2: 药剂落在屋顶上，随即爆炸。顷刻间整座建筑燃起熊熊大火。一名金发女子从正门冲出，直奔你而来，口中咒骂不绝。与此同时，四周传来狼嚎声。你几乎来不及举起武器！

column1: The potion lands on the roof and explodes. In seconds the entire building is afire. The woman inside runs out and collapses at your feet, sobbing in terror.
column2: 药剂落在屋顶上，随即爆炸。顷刻间整座建筑燃起熊熊大火。屋内的女子奔出，惊恐地倒在你脚下，泣不成声。

column1: The potion lets $ChosenOneName cut and carve $his way through the clinging muck, until $he finally crawls out. $He is exhausted, and has lost a few items, but is otherwise unhurt.
column2: 药水让 $ChosenOneName 得以在黏稠的淤泥中劈砍前进，直至 $he 终于爬了出来。$He 精疲力竭，丢失了几件物品，但并无大碍。

column1: The potion makes a superb distraction. The kidnappers are roused, check their captive, then begin searching for the source of the disturbance. As they do, you race up to $ChosenOneName. But the kidnappers notice, and charge back toward you as $ChosenOneName is cut free.
column2: 这药剂是个绝佳的障眼法。绑匪们惊醒，查看他们的俘虏，随即开始搜寻骚动的源头。趁他们分心之际，你飞奔至$ChosenOneName。然而绑匪已察觉，转身朝你冲来，而$ChosenOneName正被解救。

column1: The potion produces a very dramatic effect. Shutters open and people lean out of windows all along the street. Servants open a side door and come out to investigate also.
column2: 这药剂产生了极为显著的效果。整条街的窗扉纷纷开启，众人探身窗外。仆从亦打开侧门，前来查看。

column1: The potion sails upward but misses the battlements, instead crashing against the side of a tower in a plume of smoke.
column2: 药剂向上飞去，却未击中城垛，反而在塔侧炸开，腾起一团烟雾。

column1: The potion sinks gently into the sod roof without breaking. You curse your bad luck.
column2: 药剂轻轻渗入草皮屋顶，未致破裂。你咒骂自己的倒霉运气。

column1: The potion smashes open against the sturdy sally port, but the door holds. The sound, however, attracts a patrol's attention, and soon soldiers holding torches can be seen running toward you. Annoyed, you retreat from the city and make further plans.
column2: 药剂撞碎在坚固的城门上，但门依然坚挺。然而，这声响引来了巡逻队的注意，很快便有持火把的士兵朝你奔来。恼怒之下，你退出城池，另谋对策。

column1: The potion surprises the Hussites just long enough for you to make good an escape into the brush. You watch from hiding as they set off in imagined pursuit over the hill, then step out and continue your journey.
column2: 这药剂使胡斯派措手不及，恰好为你赢得了逃入林间的时机。你藏身观望，见他们沿着山丘追去，随即走出隐蔽，继续前行。

column1: The potion's effects allow you to make good your escape. From the vicinity of the guardpost, you hear shouts of alarm as you race back to the main building.
column2: 药剂的效果使你得以顺利逃脱。从岗哨附近传来惊慌的呼喊声，你飞奔回主建筑。

column1: The prayer fills you with a buoyant feeling. Soon you realize the sensation is real: your feet no longer touch the ground! You fly over the watchfires into the open field; there are others in the air, riding atop pigs, broomsticks, and barrels, and you remember the phrase "Satan is the Lord's ape." You see now how the dark one mimics, in a corrupt way, the pure power of the Lord.
column2: 祈祷使你心中充满轻快之感。不久，你便意识到这并非虚幻：你的双脚已离地！你飞越篝火，掠过旷野；空中还有他人，或骑猪、或乘扫帚、或驾木桶，你忆起那句“撒旦乃主之猿猴”。如今方知，黑暗之主以堕落之态仿效主之纯正之力。

column1: The prayer is finished, but nothing seems to happen. $ChosenOneName paces nervously about the cell; as $he passes the south wall, $he cries out "Look!" This crack in the stone ... air coming through ... there is a secret catch here!"
column2: 祈祷已毕，却似乎毫无动静。$ChosenOneName 在牢房中焦躁地踱步；当你经过南墙时，你惊呼道：“看！”石缝之中……有风透出……此处必有机关！

column1: The prayer is finished, but nothing seems to happen. $LeaderName paces nervously about the cell; as $he passes the south wall, $he cries out "Look!" This crack in the stone ... air coming through ... there is a secret catch here!"
column2: 祈祷已毕，却似乎毫无动静。$LeaderName 在牢房中焦躁地踱步；当你 经过南墙时，你 喊道：“看！”石缝之中……有风透出……此处必有暗扣！

column1: The prayer is spoken, and a vision dances before you: one of your party investigates the bull horns, and then the party moves on. In the next room a trap is sprung, sending you all plunging down into the depths of the monastery's dungeon.
column2: 祈祷已毕，眼前幻象浮现：队伍中一人探查牛角，随后众人继续前行。下一间房内机关触发，众人坠入修道院地牢深处。

column1: The prayer is spoken, and a vision dances before you: one of your party investigates the goat horns, and then the party moves on. In the next room a trap is sprung, sending you all plunging down into the depths of the monastery's dungeon.
column2: 祈祷已毕，眼前幻象浮现：队伍中一人探查山羊角，随后众人继续前行。下一间房内机关触发，众人坠入修道院地牢深处。

column1: The prayer of $ChosenOneName gains $him no insight or understanding. Not every prayer is answered.
column2: $ChosenOneName的祈祷并未获得你洞见或理解。并非每一声祈祷都会得到回应。

column1: The prayer of $ChosenOneName is answered by a sudden parting of the clouds. Sunlight illuminates the hillock. The light becomes brighter and brighter, until the altar-stone cracks into fragments, like overheated clay. At the same time, the surrounding stones lean or fall.
column2: $ChosenOneName的祈祷得到了回应，乌云骤然散开。阳光照亮了小丘。光芒愈发明亮，直至祭坛石裂成碎片，宛如过热的陶土。与此同时，周围的石块纷纷倾斜或倒塌。

column1: The prayer of $ChosenOneName is answered!
column2: $ChosenOneName的祈祷得到了回应！

column1: The prayer of $ChosenOneName is answered! Suddenly the merchant guards fight with renewed vigor, while the bandits are now demoralized and flagging. Soon the bandits' morale breaks and they flee up the hillsides.
column2: $ChosenOneName的祈祷得到了回应！商队护卫们顿时士气大振，而强盗们则士气低落，渐渐不支。不久，强盗们的斗志崩溃，纷纷逃上山坡。

column1: The prayer of $ChosenOneName is barely finished when a sense of calm purpose and perfect safety can be felt by all. $He is convinced that these merchants are honest and trustworthy travellers.
column2: $ChosenOneName的祷告刚一结束，众人便感到一种平静的决心与无上的安全感。你确信这些商人是诚实可靠的旅人。

column1: The prayer of $ChosenOneName is hardly finished and when the wind begins to die down. Gradually the skies lighten and the snow stops. The blizzard fades away as quickly as it came.
column2: $ChosenOneName的祈祷尚未结束，风便渐渐停息。天色逐渐放亮，雪也止住了。暴风雪来得快，去得也快。

column1: The prayer of $ChosenOneName is quickly answered. $He sees into the hearts of the people, and discovers they are animals ... bandits ... predators who seek to lure in their prey with false illness.
column2: $ChosenOneName的祈祷很快得到了回应。你洞察人心，发现他们不过是些畜生……强盗……以假病为饵诱捕猎物的掠食者。

column1: The prayer of $ChosenOneName is unsuccessful. The friar finishes his chant and leads his followers away.
column2: $ChosenOneName的祈祷未获成功。修士吟唱完毕，带领信徒离去。

column1: The prayer of $ChosenOneName works! Suddenly the animals stop, breathing heavily. All the insane rage is gone from their eyes. Quickly they disappear into the brush. Overhead the storm still rages, but with less intensity. You all breath a sigh of gratitude, then quickly leave this terrible place.
column2: $ChosenOneName的祈祷奏效了！突然间，那些动物停了下来，喘着粗气。它们眼中那疯狂的怒火已消散殆尽。转眼间，它们便消失在灌木丛中。头顶上的风暴仍在肆虐，但已稍显平息。你们皆松了一口气，随即匆匆离开了这可怕之地。

column1: The prayer of $ChosenTwoName has no effect. Desperately, you try to think of another way to get $ChosenOneName out. Perhaps another prayer might work?
column2: $ChosenTwoName的祈祷毫无作用。你绝望地思索着将$ChosenOneName救出的其他办法。或许还有别的祈祷能奏效？

column1: The prayer of $ChosenTwoName is barely finished when a man in rich robes strides with a regal bearing across the $councilHall to you.
column2: $ChosenTwoName的祷告刚一结束，一位身着华服、气度不凡的男子便迈着威严的步伐穿过$councilHall向你走来。

column1: The prayer of $ChosenTwoName is barely finished when a regal man in rich, slavic robes strides across the $councilHall to you.
column2: $ChosenTwoName的祷告刚一结束，一位身着华丽斯拉夫长袍的贵人便穿过$councilHall向你走来。

column1: The prayer to Saint Emydius is barely finished (drawing a few suspicious glances) when the very earth begins to sway beneath your feet, accompanied by a loud roar. The force of the earthquake knocks you and the people around you to the ground; the river leaps from its bed and, when the shaking is over, now can be seen running directly into a gaping hole in the ground. The man in black mutters oaths and sends the assemblage away. There will be no more initiations this day.
column2: 对圣埃米迪乌斯的祈祷刚一结束（引来几道怀疑的目光），大地便在你脚下开始摇晃，伴随着一声巨响。地震之力将你和周围的人掀翻在地；河水冲出河床，待震动平息，只见它径直涌入地面裂开的巨大洞穴之中。黑衣男子低声咒骂着，遣散了众人。今日再无任何入会仪式。

column1: The prayers lighten your heart somewhat, and as you rise from your devotions, you spy a bright white rabbit amidst the dull blackness of the surroundings. Filled with peace, you move toward the rabbit; it does not shy away.
column2: 祈祷使你的心稍觉轻快，起身时，你瞥见周遭黯淡的黑影中有一只雪白的兔子。心怀宁静，你向它走去；它并不避让。

column1: The prayers of $ChosenOneName are answered. Everyone suddenly feels lighter, and lighter, until you are rising into the air above the flooded marsh. Now the rainy wind blows you inland, until you float into the side of a grassy hillock that stands out above the dark waters.
column2: $ChosenOneName的祈祷得到了回应。众人顿觉身轻如燕，直至飘浮于被洪水淹没的沼泽之上。此刻，风雨将你吹向内陆，最终停落在一片高出黑暗水面的青草小丘旁。

column1: The prayers of $ChosenOneName fade into the heights. Nothing happens.
column2: $ChosenOneName的祈祷消散于高空。毫无动静。

column1: The prayers of $ChosenOneName fade into the quiet forest, but there is no sign they are heard on high.
column2: $ChosenOneName的祈祷声消散在寂静的森林中，却不见天听。

column1: The prayers of $ChosenOneName have no effect. The night watch leader looks at $him, shrugs, and says, "Oh come now, it isn't that bad. The only penalty is a fine of $Money1."
column2: $ChosenOneName的祈祷毫无作用。夜巡队长看着你，耸了耸肩，说道：“哎呀，也没那么糟。唯一的惩罚不过是$Money1的罚款。”

column1: The prayers of $ChosenOneName softly echo away into nothing.
column2: $ChosenOneName的祷告声轻轻回荡，终归于无。

column1: The prayers to Saint Boniface fill you with a holy feeling, and you all quickly move about the site, kicking healing earth over the ashes, slashing at the brambles and dark plants, shouting and beating the trees to frighten away the evil beasts.
column2: 向圣博尼法修的祈祷使你心生神圣之感，众人迅速在遗址间奔走，将治愈之土撒于灰烬之上，挥剑斩断荆棘与阴暗植物，高声呼喊并击打树木以驱逐邪兽。

column1: The prayers to Saint Emydius fill you with holy wrath. Your own trembling becomes the earth's; soon a roaring fills your ears. Quakes threaten to tumble you all to the ground as darkness and corruption are swallowed up by the earth itself.
column2: 向圣埃米迪乌斯的祈祷使你充满神圣的愤怒。你的颤抖化作大地的震颤；不久，轰鸣声充斥耳畔。地震威胁着将你们尽数掀翻在地，黑暗与腐朽被大地本身吞噬。

column1: The priest $NamedThreeName gibbers, "I have destroyed the Hellborn's home, forcing it into our world. Now we, lucky folk, share the vicissitudes of the last days! My holy cross is planted in the monster's lair, so I have stolen its might for Heaven's weal! I have all power!"
column2: 牧师$NamedThreeName喃喃道：“我已毁其地狱之巢，迫使其入吾界。今我等幸存者，共历末世之沧桑！吾圣十字植于妖魔之穴，遂窃其力以佑天国！吾掌万能！”

column1: The priest and the stonemason move away briefly; if you are going to do anything, now is your chance. You...
column2: 牧师与石匠暂且离去；若要有所行动，此刻正是良机。你...

column1: The priest calls aside $ChosenName and whispers, "We do not have the facilities to keep you here overlong, nor do we wish to offend the city fathers. Do you know yet when you are going to leave us?"
column2: 牧师把$ChosenName唤至一旁，低声说道：“我们既无长久留客之资，亦不愿冒犯城中诸公。尔已定下何时离此乎？”

column1: The priest comes and speaks with you. "You cannot stay here forever. I am must ask you to depart as soon as possible."
column2: 牧师前来与你交谈。“汝不可久居于此。吾不得不请君尽早启程。”

column1: The priest explains that the next Mass will be at $NamedOneName. You continue talking. His only news is so trivial you immediately forget it. You get the impression that all is well in $PlaceName. But then, not all priests are well-informed!
column2: 牧师说明，下一场弥撒将在$NamedOneName举行。你二人继续交谈。他所言之事琐碎至极，转瞬即忘。你只觉$PlaceName一切安好。然则，并非所有牧师皆消息灵通！

column1: The priest is happy with your offering. "I will add this to the church's coffers at once," he says. "With other like offerings, some day soon we shall be able to properly support our congregation."
column2: 牧师欣然接受你的奉献。“我当立即将此纳入教会库藏，”他说，“辅以诸般类似之馈赠，不久之后，我们终能妥善供养教众。”

column1: The priest is impressed by your reputation, fame and bearing. "I think my superior will be very interested in speaking with you about certain political issues."
column2: 牧师对你的声望、名望及仪态颇为赞赏。“我想，我的上司定会乐于与君商谈若干政事。”

column1: The priest looks at the crowd. "Meet my eyes," he says. "I shall find the guilty ones." You...
column2: 牧师环视众人。“与我对视，”他说，“我自能辨出罪人。”你...

column1: The priest says "Sanctuary is, of course, your right under canon law. You may stay here, at least until I have spoken with my superior."
column2: 牧师道：“依教会法，庇护乃汝之权利。汝可暂留于此，至少直至我与上司商议之后。”

column1: The priest speaks:
column2: 牧师开口：

column1: The priest, pleased by the unexpected offering, thanks you again and again. "Ah, $ChosenOneName," he opines. "If all men and women were as generous as you and your friends, the work of heaven would be accomplished that much sooner."
column2: 牧师因意外之馈赠而欣喜不已，再三致谢。“啊，$ChosenOneName，”他感慨道，“若世间男女皆如汝等慷慨，则天主之功业必早告成矣。”

column1: The pungent smells of tanning and dye mix with the dust from wool and flax here on Clothmakers' Street. You...
column2: 制革与染色之腥臭混杂着羊毛与亚麻的尘埃，弥漫于布商街。你...

column1: The quick prayer is answered by a vision. $ChosenOneName sees the many past and future lovers of $his visitor. This person is a hedonist, with no thought beyond immediate pleasure and gratification. There is no danger here, only the eventual agonies of purgatory that await the sinful.
column2: 快速祈祷得一幻象。$ChosenOneName见到了你的访客的诸多往昔与未来之情人。此人耽于享乐，唯图眼前欢愉，别无所思。此处并无危险，唯有罪人终将承受炼狱之苦。

column1: The quick prayer is unanswered. In the emptiness of the night, $ChosenOneName must make $his own decision: license or virtue?
column2: 快速祈祷未获回应。夜色空寂，$ChosenOneName只得由你的自行抉择：放纵抑或德行？

column1: The quick prayer of $ChosenOneName goes unanswered, while the choking mist continues to eat away at your eyes, throat and lungs!
column2: $ChosenOneName的快速祈祷依旧杳无音讯，而那令人窒息的雾气仍在侵蚀汝等的眼、喉与肺！

column1: The quick prayer of $ChosenOneName has no effect. The pirates are about to strike; you must either...
column2: $ChosenOneName的快速祈祷毫无效果。海盗即将来袭，汝等只得...

column1: The quick prayer of $ChosenTwoName has no effect. Suddenly sword-swinging guardsmen are upon you. You have no choice but to draw weapons and defend yourselves.
column2: $ChosenTwoName的快速祈祷仍无回响。忽而，挥剑的卫兵扑至面前。汝等别无选择，唯有拔剑自卫。

column1: The rabbit looks at you with nervous eyes. "Witches!" it says. "Seek for them $SabbatLocation on $SabbatTime. They must be driven away." Then the white animal flees into the darkness.
column2: 兔子怯怯地望着你。“女巫！”它说道，“去$SabbatLocation寻找她们，在$SabbatTime。务必将她们驱逐。”随即，那白兔遁入黑暗之中。

column1: The race is close for a while, but eventually the knight's superior horsemanship wins the day. Pleased, the knight welcomes you in good cheer to his camp for dinner. Obliged to your victor, you must accept. Of course, this does give you an opportunity to discuss affairs and exchange news.
column2: 比赛一时难分高下，然骑士高超的骑术终使他胜出。骑士欣然邀汝入营共进晚餐。汝等既败于其手，只得应允。当然，此举亦为汝等提供了商讨事务、互通消息之机。

column1: The race is close for a while, but eventually your superior horsemanship wins the day. Graciously, the knight promises to relate truthfully the challenge and his defeat when he reaches the tournament.
column2: 比赛一时胶着，然汝等更胜一筹，终夺桂冠。骑士慨然许诺，待归至赛场，必将如实述说挑战及其败北之因。

column1: The raubritter guffaws with glee. "While I enjoy myself killing you, my men shall go to the nearest city and demand ransom for your safe return. When they pay, we'll send you back -- piece by piece!"
column2: 海盗头目狂笑不止。“我在此尽情杀戮，麾下之人则赴近城索要赎金，以换汝等平安归来。待其偿付，吾等便将汝等——一块一块地——送返！”

column1: The rebel crowd besieges the $councilHall from across the $citySquare. $NamedOneName leads one storming attempt with his mercenaries, but heavy crossbow fire wounds him and kills many of his men.
column2: 叛军人群隔$citySquare围攻$councilHall。$NamedOneName率其雇佣兵发起一次强攻，却遭重型弩箭重创，部下亦多有伤亡。

column1: The rebel crowd, including yourselves and $NamedOneName, besieges the $councilHall from across the $citySquare. A tense day passes. Then a runner brings word from the city gates.
column2: 叛军人群，包括汝等与$NamedOneName，隔$citySquare围攻$councilHall。一日紧张对峙。忽有信使自城门传来消息。

column1: The rebel crowd, including yourselves and $NamedOneName, besieges the $fortress, the great fortress of $PlaceName. $NamedOneName leads his mercenaries in a storming attempt, and is repulsed with heavy casualties.
column2: 叛军人群，包括汝等与$NamedOneName，围攻$fortress，即$PlaceName之雄堡。$NamedOneName率其雇佣兵强攻，终被击退，伤亡惨重。

column1: The rebel crowd, including yourselves and $NamedOneName, besieges the $fortress, the great fortress of $PlaceName. A tense day passes. Then a runner brings word from the city gates.
column2: 叛军人群，包括汝等与$NamedOneName，围攻$fortress，即$PlaceName之雄堡。一日紧张对峙。忽有信使自城门传来消息。

column1: The rebels strip you of arms, armor and valuables. Then they kick you out the door, into the hands of the waiting mob. Dodging blows, kicks, rotten fruit, and rocks, you race away down the nearest side street.
column2: 叛军夺去汝等之武器、甲胄与财物，随即一脚踢出门外，任汝等落入等候的暴民手中。躲避拳脚、腐果与石块，汝等仓皇逃入最近的侧街。

column1: The red-robed figure appears to be the leader of this small band. He looks at you dubiously, saying, "You travel to the field yonder?"
column2: 红袍身影似为此小队之首。他狐疑地望着汝等，问道：“汝等欲往彼处战场乎？”

column1: The refugees are pathetically grateful. "The plague has destroyed our village. Only we survived, and then by fleeing," says their leader. You see how sick they are, and wonder if they have, indeed, survived.
column2: 难民们感激涕零。“瘟疫毁我村寨，仅余吾辈幸存，且因奔逃方得保全，”其首领言道。汝见其病容，不禁疑虑：彼等果真幸存否？

column1: The representative looks out from his office in the back.
column2: 代表从后室探出身来。

column1: The representative of the Medici Bank, $NamedOneName, $VarPhrase1 changes in the city government.
column2: 美第奇银行代表，$NamedOneName，$VarPhrase1变化于市政府之中。

column1: The reptile delicately pries her body loose of its bonds, and flaps off. She is dead and gone.
column2: 这条爬虫轻轻挣脱束缚，振翅而去。她已然殒命。

column1: The reputation, good looks and winning words of $ChosenOneName aren't enough to get any more attention than the average soldier or harlot. After waiting around a couple hours to no purpose, you decide this just isn't your day.
column2: $ChosenOneName的声望、俊美与巧舌，仍不足以令汝等超越寻常士兵或娼妓。徒候两时许，终觉今日无缘佳遇。

column1: The reputation, good looks and winning words of $ChosenOneName aren't enough to get past the apprentices and junior journeymen. After waiting around a couple hours to no purpose, you decide this just isn't your day.
column2: $ChosenOneName的声望、俊美与妙语，仍无法越过学徒与初级工匠。徒候两时许，终觉今日无缘佳遇。

column1: The rest of the ritual is a nightmare: colors and scenes move by with awesome speed, and the fear that clenches your heart also blocks your senses. There are screams, and at least one man appears to be devoured by a great black shape. Soon it is too much for your dread-drenched minds, and you all fall into a deep swoon.
column2: 剩余仪式如噩梦般残酷：色彩与景象飞速变幻，恐惧紧攥心扉，感官亦为之麻痹。尖叫声此起彼伏，更有男子疑似被一团漆黑巨影吞噬。不久，恐惧便压倒了汝等心智，众人皆陷入昏厥。

column1: The richter states, "You must pay the city $Money1 for your crimes." You protest, saying that you do not have that much cash. The richter frowns, then speaks again, "What money you have, we will take. And as punishment for your crime, you must all be flogged. Bailiff! Take the prisoners hence."
column2: 法官宣判：“汝等须向城中支付$Money1，以赎罪愆。”汝等抗辩，称身无巨款。法官皱眉，复又开口：“汝等所有钱财，悉数充公。并以鞭刑惩处。执达吏！押囚犯离场！”

column1: The ritual begins. The crowd and the priest chant harsh words as a darkness with horns and glowing red eyes rises from the altar.
column2: 仪式开始。人群与牧师齐诵厉词，只见一道长角、红眸森然的黑暗自祭坛升起。

column1: The road is blocked for now. You consider the situation, and decide to wait until a more favorable time to journey in this direction.
column2: 此路暂且不通。汝等权衡局势，决定待时再行。

column1: The robber knight himself rushes out. "Filth!" he cries. "You have ruined me, but I shall see you dead!" He charges. Half-heartedly, several of his men follow.
column2: 海盗骑士亲自冲出。“贱民！”他怒吼，“汝等害我至此，然吾必取汝性命！”他策马直冲。麾下数人勉力追随。

column1: The room is dark and dank, smelling of mold and of other, more loathsome things. Huddled in a corner of the room is an emaciated old man dressed in dirty monk's robes. Madness lights his eyes, and he regards you with suspicion and fear. You...
column2: 房间阴暗潮湿，霉味与种种恶臭交织。角落里蜷缩着一位衣衫褴褛的老僧，形销骨立。癫狂之光在其眼中闪烁，他以怀疑与畏惧注视汝等。你...

column1: The room is huge and hot, and in its center there is a great demonic form. Its eyes blaze like smithy fires, and its form is surrounded by a palpable aura of fear. Behind it, resting on a dais, is a mammoth book bound by a seal of red silk.
column2: 房间宽广而炽热，中央矗立着一个巨大的恶魔之形。其双目如炉火般灼亮，周身笼罩着浓重的恐惧气息。其后，一座高台上静置着一本以红绸封皮裹束的巨册。

column1: The ruined stable has a bit of roof, while most of the rotten straw was swept away by rains. Hardly noticing the stink, you settle down for a dinner of bread crusts, old vegetables, and one new fruit. Philosophically, you reflect that such fare teaches humility! Nobody mentions that this sort of living won't help your reputation. Finally you wrap up in cloaks and go to sleep.
column2: 废弃的马厩尚存些许屋顶，其余腐草已被雨水冲散。汝等不顾恶臭，以面包屑、陈菜与一颗新果充饥。汝等自省：此等粗食正可教人谦卑！无人提及此种生活无助于提升声望。最后，汝等披衣入眠。

column1: The saint eliminates harm from the caustic lye. You are unhurt, to the dwarf's chagrin.
column2: 圣徒消除了苛性碱液之害。汝等安然无恙，令矮人心生懊恼。

column1: The saint makes the adders your friends. They form a chain of their own snake bodies up and out of the pit, which you promptly climb to escape.
column2: 圣徒使毒蛇化友。它们以蛇身连成一链，自坑中攀出，汝等遂沿之逃生。

column1: The saint says, "The demon is right. In theory, one of your souls is forfeit. However, our discussion will take at least a century. Though I will be defeated in the end, by that time you will be dead and already in Heaven or Hell. If you are in Hell, the point is moot. If you end up in Heaven ... it is unlikely the devil will break through the pearly gates to claim you! Go your way in safety."
column2: 圣徒言道：“恶魔所言不虚。理论上，汝等之一魂确已失却。然吾等之论辩，少则百年。纵然我终将败北，届时汝等早已逝去，或升天堂，或堕地狱。若在地狱，此事已无关紧要。若得登天……恐魔鬼亦难破珍珠之门，来索汝魂！汝等可安然前行。”

column1: The saint states calmly, "I am their counsel. State your case."
column2: 圣徒平静道：“吾乃其辩护人。请陈述案情。”

column1: The schrat cannot speak, but he can show gratitude. He sloppily kisses each one of you in joy. You are embarrassed, but also pleased that you could rescue this weird forest creature from the hideous Wild Hunt.
column2: 施拉特不能言语，却能表达感激。它欣喜地胡乱亲吻汝等每人。汝等虽感尴尬，却也为能救此怪异林中生灵脱离可怖的“野猎”而欣慰。

column1: The schrat looks puzzled when you hand the fruit back to him, but shrugs and places it back in the pouch, then leaves.
column2: 当汝等将果实递还时，施拉特显得困惑，但终究耸肩，将其收入囊中，然后离去。

column1: The schrats randomly pound, pummel and stomp everyone and everything still moving. They grab whatever takes their fancy and stomp off. When all is quiet, the survivors slowly crawl away, out of this deadly forest.
column2: 施拉特随机捶打、猛击并践踏一切尚存之物。凡合意者，皆攫而远遁。待四下寂静，幸存者缓缓爬出这片致命森林。

column1: The search is long, but eventually, in a cleft cave in a rock face, you find the $NamedOneName.
column2: 寻觅良久，终于在岩壁一处裂隙洞穴中，汝等发现了$NamedOneName。

column1: The senior clerk introduces you to the Medici representative for $PlaceName, $NamedOneName, who greets you with warmth and friendliness.
column2: 资深文员引荐汝等认识美第奇银行驻$PlaceName代表，$NamedOneName，他热情友好地迎接汝等。

column1: The senior clerk introduces you to the Medici representative, $NamedOneName, who greets you with warmth and friendliness.
column2: 资深文员引荐汝等认识美第奇银行代表，$NamedOneName，他热情友好地迎接汝等。

column1: The sergeant accepts your money at a small sally port. He and his friends leave by this port while you enter the fortress. He warns you that the $CityLordTitle is protected by a loyal group of personal guards, who must be overcome.
column2: 军士在一处小型侧门处收下了你的钱。他与同伴由此离去，而你则进入要塞。他告诫你，$CityLordTitle由一群忠心耿耿的亲卫守护，必须将其击败。

column1: The sergeant accepts your money, then gives his men leave to join their friends in the crowd outside. He warns you that the $CityLordTitle is upstairs, defended by a loyal group of personal guards.
column2: 军士收下你的钱，随即让手下们去外面的人群中与同伴相聚。他警告你，$CityLordTitle在楼上，由一群忠心的贴身护卫把守。

column1: The sergeant of the city guard meets you with his men, ready to help arrest the rebels. They reluctantly surround the building, while a crowd of onlookers forms. You realize that an incorrect act could turn this situation into a disaster. Therefore you...
column2: 城市守卫的军曹率众前来，准备协助逮捕叛乱者。他们勉强包围了那座建筑，围观的人群亦已聚集。你意识到，一旦失策，局面或将酿成大祸。因此你...

column1: The sergeant of the guard is overwhelmed by your charm. He invites you into the gatehouse for a dip of water, "To wash away the travel dust."
column2: 卫兵队长被你的魅力所折服。他邀请你进入门楼，倒了一杯水，“以洗去旅途的尘埃。”

column1: The sergeant of the guard laughs. "You expect us to open the gate for you? Not tonight my friends! Now move on, before we become angry."
column2: 卫队长哈哈大笑：“你们竟指望我们为你们开城门？今夜休想，诸位！快些离开吧，免得惹怒了我们。”

column1: The sergeant of the guard screams "Traitors!" as you disappear into the crowd. Seconds later, he and his men are overwhelmed. The rebel leaders are freed, hoisted onto triumphant shoulders, and carried off.
column2: 卫兵队长见你隐入人群，厉声喝道：“叛徒！”顷刻之间，他与部下便被汹涌的人潮淹没。叛首们得以脱困，被高举于众肩之上，扬长而去。

column1: The sergeant of the guard sees you and signals you to join him. You realize  there are just two choices now:
column2: 卫队长见你，示意你上前。你意识到如今只有两个选择：

column1: The sergeant of the guard suddenly recognizes you and unexpectedly grins. "Guten tag, friends! I and my men welcome you to fair $PlaceName." he shouts, and eagerly beckons you into the city.
column2: 卫队的军曹突然认出了你，出乎意料地咧嘴一笑。“日安，诸位！我和我的部下欢迎你们来到美丽的$PlaceName。”他高声喊道，并热切地招手示意你们入城。

column1: The sergeant of the guard suddenly recognizes you and unexpectedly grins. "Guten tag, friends! My men and I welcome you to fair $PlaceName." You are ushered into the city.
column2: 卫队的军士突然认出了你，出乎意料地咧嘴一笑。“日安，诸位！我和我的部下欢迎你们来到美丽的$PlaceName。”你们被引入城中。

column1: The sergeant of the guard, bloodied and limping, looks at you and spits, "I'll have vengeance for this!" You realize your reputation here is ruined.
column2: 血迹斑斑、一瘸一拐的卫兵队长望向你，啐道：“此仇必报！”你方知在此已身败名裂。

column1: The sergeant rumbles, "Halt!" You stop, abashed. "$PlaceName is at war," he hisses. "We have no need for useless mouths to feed. Begone!"
column2: 军士低吼道：“站住！”你羞愧地停下脚步。“$PlaceName正处战时，”他嘶声道，“我们无需养活无用之口。滚开！”

column1: The seven-fold path holds frightening terrors: huge demon locusts, a ravaged land, a burning and poisoned sea, darkness, and Hell's horsemen galloping toward you. Looming over all is a giant demon head. Suddenly these seven paths expand, until it seems that the entire world is being destroyed by famine, fire, storms, poison, darkness and war. It is a satanic vision of the Apocalypse, the end of the world.
column2: 七重之路潜伏着骇人的恐怖：巨大的恶魔蝗虫、满目疮痍的大地、燃烧且充满毒液的海洋、无尽的黑暗，以及地狱的骑士向你疾驰而来。一切之上，一座巨兽般的恶魔之首巍然耸立。忽然间，这七条道路骤然扩张，仿佛整个世界正被饥荒、烈火、风暴、毒害、黑暗与战争所吞噬。这是撒旦式的启示录景象，世界的末日。

column1: The seven-headed, ten-horned dragon addresses you. "So! You have seen my greatness and have come to worship before me. I accept your obedience. Kneel now and pray to me."
column2: 七头十角的巨龙向你致辞：“汝等已见吾之威严，特来朝拜。吾纳尔等之臣服。速跪下，向吾祷告。”

column1: The shopkeepers and workers are horrified by your allegations. However, when you give them the evidence, they promise to hold a special meeting to investigate the situation. It is clear that the meeting will produce a new leader.
column2: 商人与工人们对你的指控感到震惊。然而，当你出示证据时，他们承诺召开一次特别会议以调查此事。显然，这次会议将产生一位新的领袖。

column2: $PlaceName的侧街熙熙攘攘，但你仍能从每个人的脸上看出猜疑与恐惧。你转向...

column2: $PlaceName的侧街挤满了前来赶集的人。你穿行于人群之中，转向……

column2: $PlaceName的侧街里挤满了人、狗、猫、猪，偶尔还有马车。你穿过人群，转向……

column1: The silent prayer asks $NamedOneName for strength to withstand the gaze of the satanic priest. The comfort of heaven floods through you, and you do not flinch. Finally the evil priest looks away and shakes his head.
column2: 默祷祈求$NamedOneName赐予力量，以抵御那恶魔祭司的凝视。天恩如潮水般涌入心间，你岿然不动。终于，那邪恶祭司移开了目光，摇了摇头。

column1: The silver knob.
column2: 银色的旋钮。

column1: The six names are each on a raised knob. Clearly, you are supposed to press one of the knobs. If you press the wrong knob, no doubt a trap will be released! You cogitate, then press ...
column2: 这六个名字各刻在一个凸起的旋钮上。显然，你应当按下其中一个旋钮。若按错，定会触发机关！你沉思片刻，然后按下……

column1: The skeletal remains are animated by some infernal magic! The creature is not physically threatening you, but its eyes blaze with unholy fire, and the jaw moves up and down. A hollow scream emanates from it.
column2: 骨骼残骸被某种地狱魔法所唤醒！这怪物并未对你构成直接威胁，但其双目燃着不洁之火，下颚上下开合。一声空洞的惨叫自其中传出。

column1: The skeleton backs away with a rattle of bone when you address it. "Fleshly ones, you make me hungry!" it screams. "Find me my bone -- I know it is somewhere near the cemetery! Then I will talk with you."
column2: 当你与它交谈时，骷髅发出骨节的响声后退。“血肉之躯，你们让我饥肠辘辘！”它尖叫道，“帮我找到我的骨头——我知道它就在墓地附近！那时我才会与你们交谈。”

column1: The skeletons ignore your surrender and continue swinging. In seconds, nobody is left standing.
column2: 骷髅无视你的投降，继续挥舞着武器。转眼间，无人幸存。

column1: The small chest appears and $Money1 are carefully counted out.
column2: 小箱子出现，$Money1被仔细数出。

column1: The smallest one says, "Now we shall slit all their throats."
column2: 最小的一个说：“如今我们要割断他们所有的喉咙。”

column1: The smashing impact breaks bones and knocks everyone unconscious for hours. Slowly the pain wakes those who lived through the ordeal.
column2: 撞击之力碎骨断筋，众人皆昏厥数时。疼痛渐醒幸存者之魂。

column1: The soil is filled with broken bones. Some horror dug its way into a graveyard, then feasted on the corpses!
column2: 土壤中满是碎骨。某种恐怖之物破土而出，闯入墓地，以尸身为食！

column1: The soldiers are closing in fast. Looking around frantically, you see a small sally port in the wall, but it is barred. Soon you will be trapped.
column2: 士兵们正迅速逼近。你惊慌地四下张望，只见墙边有一道小侧门，却被木栅封住。很快你将无处可逃。

column1: The soldiers are closing in fast. Looking around frantically, you see nowhere to hide. The sheer stone of the wall looms overhead. Soon you will be trapped.
column2: 士兵们正迅速逼近。你惊慌四顾，却无处藏身。高耸的石墙在头顶压下。很快你将被围困。

column1: The soldiers barely stop to hear your words, then surge forward again, crying, "Fehde! Death!" You have no choice but to fight.
column2: 士兵们几乎不听你说话，便再次冲上前去，高喊：“复仇！死亡！”你别无选择，只能迎战。

column1: The soldiers barely stop to hear your words, then surge forward, crying, "Surrender or die!" You have no choice but to fight.
column2: 士兵们几乎不听你说话，便高呼着“投降或死！”向前冲来。你别无选择，只能迎战。

column1: The soldiers ignore this and surge forward, crying, "Surrender or die!" Your choices now are to...
column2: 士兵们置之不理，高呼“投降或死！”向前猛冲。你现在可以选择……

column1: The sound of your battle must have alerted others nearby, though none have come to reinforce the battle.
column2: 你的战斗之声必定惊动了附近之人，然无人前来增援。

column2: 锤击钢铁之声与磨刀轮的尖鸣充盈于铸剑巷。你决定……

column1: The spider trusses $ChosenOneName in its webs, scuttles up a rock cliff, and hauls its prize up after it. Your companion is lost to a horrible fate. The price for the $NamedOneName seems too high, but you cannot undo what was done. Dejected, you leave.
column2: 蜘蛛在其蛛网上编织着$ChosenOneName，沿着岩壁飞快攀爬，并将猎物拖曳而上。你的同伴已遭逢惨烈之命运。为$NamedOneName所付出的代价似乎过于沉重，然既成之事，无可挽回。你黯然离去。

column1: The spirt of $NamedOneName fills the air. $ChosenOneName feels a subtle tug leading $him toward the thief. The hapless criminal cannot escape, for a holy spirit senses the villain's evil and draws you to him.
column2: $NamedOneName之灵充盈于空气之中。$ChosenOneName感到一股微妙的牵引，将你引向那名窃贼。那不幸的罪犯无处可逃，因圣灵感知其邪恶，将你引至他身前。

column1: The square is quiet. The tinker's wagons are closed, and the guild shops are shuttered and locked. Everyone seems comfortably asleep. You...
column2: 广场寂静无声。修理工的马车已停，公会店铺也紧闭门窗。众人皆安然入梦。你...

column1: The square of bowyers and gunsmiths is silent. The guildsmen and their families are safely asleep in the upper stories, while the doors below are locked tight. You...
column2: 弓匠与枪匠之广场寂静无声。公会成员及其家眷安眠于楼阁之上，楼下门户紧闭。你...

column1: The stableboy assures you that the inn's stables will take care of any mounts or other animals. The fee is part of the inn's regular charge to customers.
column2: 马童向你保证，旅店的马厩会照料好所有的坐骑及其他牲畜。这笔费用已包含在旅店对客人的常规收费之中。

column1: The storm rages for endless hours, and a number of sailors are washed overboard. Finally, the wind abates, the sky clears, and the captain regains his original course.
column2: 暴风雨肆虐了无尽的时光，许多水手被卷入海中。终于，风势渐息，天际放晴，船长重掌航向。

column1: The storm's savage fury rises and rises, driving the helpless ship toward shore. The captain orders everyone to abandon their armor and weighty possessions, then tie themselves to something that floats, like a spar or cask.
column2: 暴风雨的狂怒愈演愈烈，将无助的船只推向岸边。船长命令众人弃下盔甲与沉重的财物，然后把自己绑在浮木或酒桶上。

column1: The storm's savage fury rises ever higher, driving the helpless ship toward shore. Suddenly, breakers loom out of the rain, pounding against a hidden reef. Desperately you grab for something as the ship grounds and shatters. A huge wave sweeps over the ship, carrying you to a watery grave.
column2: 风暴的狂暴怒火愈演愈烈，将无助之船推向岸边。骤然间，雨幕中巨浪浮现，猛击隐匿之礁石。你拼命抓住某物，却见船已搁浅、碎裂。巨浪席卷全船，将你卷入水底坟墓。

column2: 街道昏暗而寂静，但你偶尔会看见鬼鬼祟祟的身影在屋舍间出没。并非人人都愿将自己的伤痛与病疾公之于众！你……

column1: The street is full of citizens who support your cause. $NamedOneName has just finished addressing them when suddenly squads of city guards charge out from various side streets with a wild battle cry!
column2: 街道上满是支持你事业的市民。$NamedOneName刚向他们发表完演说，突然间，一队队城卫军从各条小巷中狂吼着冲了出来！

column1: The street is full of small shops and push-cart vendors, all crowded with soldiers and camp-followers. Here you decide to...
column2: 街道上满是小店铺与推车摊贩，皆挤满了士兵与随营之人。你在此决定……

column1: The stunned night watch stands there with mouths agape, watching you calmly walk away. As you move out of sight, the sunlight fades too, leaving the awestruck watchmen in darkness once more.
column2: 震惊的夜巡者张口结舌，静静地看着你从容离去。待你消失于视线之外，阳光也随之消退，让那些敬畏不已的守卫再次陷入黑暗之中。

column1: The surviving villagers assume either God or Satan has visited his wrath upon them; they appreciate whatever aid you can offer, never suspecting you are the cause.
column2: 幸存的村民以为是上帝或撒旦降下天罚；他们感激你所能提供的任何帮助，却从未怀疑你才是祸首。

column1: The swordsmiths $Support1 change.
column2: 锻剑师们$Support1更替。

column2: 哥特式教堂的高耸尖塔直刺苍穹。你心生敬意，环顾四周，便...

column1: The tatzelwurm immediately tear apart $ChosenOneName. After feasting upon the choicest parts, $his body is dragged off into the brush.
column2: 塔采尔蠕虫立即将$ChosenOneName撕裂。饱餐佳肴之后，你的尸身被拖入灌木丛中。

column1: The terrible robber knight $NamedOneName lies bleeding out his life before you. Demoralized, his men throw down their weapons.
column2: 可怖的强盗骑士$NamedOneName正血流不止，濒死于你面前。士气尽丧，其部下纷纷弃械。

column1: The thief, overcome with emotion, collapses. Falling to his hands and knees, he bursts into tears.
column2: 小偷情绪难抑，颓然倒地。跪伏于地，泪如雨下。

column1: The thieves grin wickedly when you submit, and quickly relieve you of all items of obvious value, including your money, arms, and good armor. You are left with just a few small items and hidden coins.
column2: 小偷见你屈服，狞笑不已，旋即搜去所有显而易见之贵重物什，包括钱财、兵刃与良甲。仅余些许细物与暗藏之币。

column1: The thieves lie motionless at your feet. You feel strangely content, as if a higher power intended them to meet such a fate.
column2: 小偷们静卧于足下。你心中竟生莫名之慰，仿佛天命使然，令其归于此途。

column1: The thing cackles with glee, "You have gone too far in your petty attempts to block the intrigues of Hell. There is no resisting me -- so die, inept mortals!"
column2: 那物狂笑不止：“汝等妄图阻我地狱阴谋，实属徒劳。吾不可抗拒——尔等凡夫俗子，受死吧！”

column1: The three men whirl around as a noise betrays your presence. They cast aside their cloaks, revealing gleaming armor and deadly weapons. Then they attack.
column2: 三人闻声回身，弃斗篷露铠甲，亮利刃，随即发难。

column1: The top of the hill is crowded with fallen stones and mere traces of walls. Some stones have half-erased Christian symbols. Perhaps, long ago, this was a church?  A brief search, however, reveals nothing.
column2: 山巅碎石遍地，残垣断壁依稀可见。部分石块上犹存半蚀之基督教符号。昔日此处或曾为教堂？然细察之下，却无所获。

column1: The top of the hill is crowded with fallen stones and mere traces of walls. Some stones have half-erased Christian symbols. Perhaps, long ago, this was a church? A few floor stones have cracked, showing a yawning blackness below. You...

column1: The tower keep of $PlaceName looms against the moonlit sky. Occasional gleams show through the windows. You decide whether to attack, and how....
column2: $PlaceName的塔楼在月色下巍然矗立。窗间偶有微光透出。你权衡是否出击，以及如何出手....

column1: The townhouse of $NamedOneName, said to be a political organizer for $CityLordTitle, was all but destroyed in a raid. Some say this is a sign of the government's powerlessness against the rebels.
column2: 据称乃$CityLordTitle政治组织者的$NamedOneName宅邸，几近毁于劫掠。有人谓此乃政府无力对抗叛军之明证。

column1: The townhouses of the Jewelers' Avenue are dark and quiet. The night watch walks the cobblestoned street frequently, guarding the city's wealthiest guild. You...
column2: 宝石街的宅邸幽暗宁静。夜巡者常行于石板街道，守护城中最富之公会。你...

column1: The travellers lead you to an area of the field where many men and women bustle about large cookpots, ovens, and fires.
column2: 旅人引你至田间一处，众人围绕大锅、烤炉与火堆忙碌不休。

column1: The trip to $NearestCity is slow and laborious with the aged pilgrims, taking $Number1 days. Fortunately it is an uneventful trip, with no more excitement than bandaging a sprained ankle.
column2: 与年迈朝圣者同行，前往$NearestCity之路缓慢艰辛，耗时$Number1日。幸而一路平安无事，不过为扭伤脚踝包扎而已。

column1: The tunnel is $Number1 % done.
column2: 隧道已完成$Number1%。

column1: The turnkey scoffs at $ChosenOneName's meager charms.
column2: 看守轻蔑一笑，不屑于$ChosenOneName之微薄魅力。

column1: The turnkey takes one look at you and laughs. "Hah, more maggot food, I'll wager!"
column2: 看守瞥你一眼，放声大笑：“哈哈，又添蛆虫食料了！”

column1: The various artisan guilds $VarPhrase1 change here.
