column1: The vast figure plunges its spear again and again into $ChosenOneName. From the bloody wreckage of what was once a human being, it recovers a gory trophy. Remounting its chariot, the apparition thunders up into the sky, black clouds and tearing winds following it.
column2: 那巨影挥矛再三，刺穿$ChosenOneName。自那曾经为人之血肉残骸中，它取走一件染血战利品。复骑战车，幻影轰鸣升空，黑云与狂风随之而去。

column1: The vial makes a graceful arc across the sky, and lands with a soft fizzle! in a mud puddle. No bright flash. No loud bang.
column2: 小瓶划过长空，轻响一声，落入泥潭！无耀眼光芒，亦无巨响。

column1: The victorious guards don't distinguish between the unconscious and the dead. They just strip the bodies of obviously useful gear and dump them in a neighboring forest.
column2: 胜利之卫不分昏迷与死亡，只剥去尸体明显可用之物，弃于邻林。

column1: The victorious guards don't distinguish between unconscious and dead. They just strip the bodies of obviously useful gear and dump them in a neighboring forest.
column2: 胜利之卫不分昏迷与死亡，只剥去尸体明显可用之物，弃于邻林。

column1: The village Schulz chooses a girl who nearly swoons, presumably from the honor. She is titled $NamedOneName Queen and dressed in white. She seems to weep with joy. But then you realize -- those are not tears of joy, but of terror! This is some dastardly plot!
column2: 村长择一少女，几近晕厥，想必因荣耀所致。她被封为$NamedOneName女王，身着素白。似喜极而泣。然你忽觉——那非喜悦之泪，而是惊恐之泪！此乃恶毒之计！

column1: The village Schulz, $NamedOneName, pleads. "The robber knight, $NamedTwoName, has almost destroyed our village. His armored men come every harvest and demand over half our crop. He carries off our children for slaves. Please end his reign of terror."
column2: 村长$NamedOneName恳求：“强盗骑士$NamedTwoName几乎毁我村庄。每逢收获，其甲士必来，索我半数粮草。更掳我孩童为奴。请止其暴政。”

column1: The village elder bows low and asks $ChosenOneName to be the $NamedOneName Queen. She accepts graciously and is taken away to be outfitted.
column2: 村老深深鞠躬，请$ChosenOneName为$NamedOneName女王。她欣然应允，随即被迎去妆扮。

column1: The village has a new Schulz! Fortunately, he is as agreeable as the old one. Bowing and congratulating you profusely, he says, "Thank you forever for your help. Our village will be grateful always."
column2: 村落新任村长已就！幸甚，其性情与旧任相仿。他频频鞠躬致谢，言道：“永感君恩。吾村永铭君德。”

column1: The village is nothing but a blasted ruin. Its buildings are a charred wreckage of timbers and broken bricks. In a few places weeds are growing, but elsewhere you see the bleached white of bones.
column2: 村落只剩一片焦土。屋舍皆为焦木与碎砖之残骸。杂草零星生长，而骨骸则白骨森森。

column1: The village priest, flabbergasted by the size of your offering, falls to his knees and thanks heaven. "With this, I can feed our village for days. Thank you, most gracious folk."
column2: 村牧见汝馈赠之厚，叩首谢天：“凭此，可养全村数日。多谢诸位慷慨。”

column1: The villagers fight like men possessed. You are forced to flee back into the clean, open air of the countryside.
column2: 村民奋勇抗敌，你只得退返乡野清旷之地。

column1: The villagers rush up. "Thank you! Thank you!" they shout. "You are our saviors! Many lives will be saved, now that we need no longer use the dangerous upriver ford. Thank you! Thank you!"
column2: 村民蜂拥而至：“感谢！感谢！”他们呼喊，“汝乃吾等救星！今不必再涉险上游渡口，性命得保。感谢！感谢！”

column1: The villagers stop chasing $ChosenTwoName when they hear a dreadful screech overhead and look up to see the furious dragon landing upon them. It is enraged by the absence of its accustomed sacrifice. The hapless villagers run for cover as the monster vomits poison and fire onto them. You, too, head for the hills.
column2: 村民见空中传来凄厉尖叫，抬头望见怒龙扑下，遂停追$ChosenTwoName。龙因未获惯常祭品而暴怒。村民仓皇奔逃，怪物喷毒吐焰。你也急赴山丘避难。

column1: The villagers tie the $NamedOneName Queen to a pole and flee. Suddenly a dragon flaps down from above. The maiden screams and faints, and it feasts on her.
column2: 村民将$NamedOneName女王绑于木桩，四散奔逃。忽有巨龙自天而降。少女惊叫昏厥，龙遂饱餐其肉。

column1: The walls and floor begin to shake. It is as though an invisible hand had swept across the altar: flakes of dried blood fly everywhere; the darkness of curruption is lifted from the room; the torches begin to burn with a clear yellow light.
column2: 四壁与地面开始震颤。恍若无形之手拂过祭坛：干涸血迹四处飞溅；污秽尽除，室内豁然清明；火炬燃起明亮黄光。

column1: The war between $NamedOneName and $NamedTwoName is a common topic of discussion. Nobody seems to know whose army is larger, which cities are likely to be threatened, or who will ultimately win. The only point of agreement is that travel in $NamedThreeName will be dangerous until someone is victorious.
column2: $NamedOneName与$NamedTwoName之战，街谈巷议。无人知谁兵势更盛，何城将危，亦不知孰胜孰负。唯一共识是：在胜负未分之前，行走于$NamedThreeName将险象环生。

column1: The water is refreshing and clear. There seems to be nothing unusual about the fountain.
column2: 水质甘冽清澈。喷泉并无异状。

column1: The way is clear; you travel on onward.
column2: 前路坦荡，你继续前行。

column1: The wealthy burghers, who run the city council of $PlaceName, $VarPhrase1 changes in the city government. Their attitude is more flexible now that
column2: 掌管$PlaceName市政议会之富户，$VarPhrase1城市政府的变革。如今态度更为灵活，盖因

column1: The wealthy burghers, who run the city council of $PlaceName, are totally and inalterably opposed to any change in the city government. Their leader, $NamedOneName, speaks passionately against overturning traditions that have served so well.
column2: 掌管$PlaceName市政议会之富户，对任何城市政府变革均持坚决反对之态。其领袖$NamedOneName力陈传统之益，不容颠覆。

column1: The wharfmaster looks at you and immediately signals for his guards.
column2: 码头主管望你一眼，即刻示意卫兵。

column1: The whores glance once and ignore you. The paupers and beggars view you with fear. Mistaking you for thugs or thieves, the natural rulers here, they point out posters and answer questions with trembling honesty.
column2: 妓女瞥你一眼，不予理会。贫民与乞丐则心怀畏惧。误以为你是恶棍或窃贼——此间天然之主——遂指点告示，并战战兢兢作答。

column1: The witches are not sure what is going on, but realize that their spell is failing. Their dance becomes more and more frenzied, but at last they give up and shamefacedly leave the cavern. You have kept them from controlling the dragon!
column2: 巫女们不知所措，却察觉到法术已失效。她们的舞步愈发狂乱，终至无奈放弃，羞愧地离开了洞窟。你阻止了她们操控巨龙！

column1: The witches are sowing their evil seeds through the storm! Wherever a seed hits the earth, a grotesque demon appears in a burst of smoke and flame.
column2: 巫女们借风暴播撒邪恶之种！凡种子落地之处，便有狰狞妖魔于烟焰中骤然现身。

column1: The witches circle lower and watch the demons advance. You decide to ...
column2: 巫女们盘旋而下，注视着妖魔步步逼近。你决定……

column1: The witches rise to the attack.
column2: 巫女们发起攻势。

column1: The witches' power over the innocents is now ended: once baptized, they cannot come to harm.
column2: 巫女对无辜者的掌控已然终结：一经洗礼，他们便再无灾厄。

column1: The wolf begins sniffing hands as $ChosenOneName prays. It stiffens as it sniffs $his hand, and backs away. The travellers eye you suspiciously, but since the wolf seems uninclined to attack, so do they. Finally the wolf relaxes and returns to the fire. One of the travellers lets out a pent-up breath and removes his hand from the hilt of his dagger.
column2: 狼开始嗅闻双手，而$ChosenOneName正在祈祷。它嗅到你的手时猛然一僵，随即退后。旅人们疑虑地望着你，但见狼并无攻击之意，他们也放松下来。最终，狼舒缓下来，回到火边。一名旅人长出一口气，从匕首柄上移开了手。

column1: The woman is true to her word: one hour later you quietly slip in through a small, unlocked, ivy-covered door.
column2: 那女子信守诺言：一小时后，你悄然从一扇被常春藤覆盖的小门溜了进去，那门并未上锁。

column1: The woman's eyes seem to cloud over. "You are ready," she says.
column2: 女子的目光似乎蒙上了一层薄雾。“你已准备就绪，”她说道。

column1: The words are on raised knobs. Which word should you press? A wrong one may spring a trap! You ponder, then press...
column2: 字母刻在凸起的钮头上。该按哪个字母？按下错误之键，恐触发机关！你沉思片刻，然后按下……

column1: The words of the prayer rip out of $ChosenOneName's mouth like an inspirational sermon. For a moment you are all falling; then, you are hanging miraculously in the air, hovering above the deadly abyss. Carefully, hand over hand down the wall, you make your way to the other end of the corridor.
column2: 祈祷之词如激昂布道般自$ChosenOneName口中喷涌而出。刹那间，你们仿佛坠落；旋即，竟奇迹般悬于空中，漂浮在致命深渊之上。小心翼翼地沿壁攀援，你们缓缓抵达走廊尽头。

column1: The words of the prayer stumble upon your lips, and at that moment the guard realizes what you are doing. His eyes widen in fear and hatred. "Attack the unbelievers!" he cries.
column2: 祈祷之词刚一脱口，卫兵便察觉你的意图。他眼中满是惊惧与憎恨。“杀光异教徒！”他高喊。

column1: The work is messy and it takes much time, but you have the satisfaction of knowing that you have prevented an abomination. When the master cook is satisfied, he sends you on your way.
column2: 工作杂乱且耗时良久，但你心知已阻止了一场亵渎。待主厨满意，便遣你离去。

column1: The work is messy and takes much time, but you have the satisfaction of knowing that you have prevented an abomination. When the master cook is satisfied, he sends you on your way.
column2: 工作杂乱且耗时良久，但你心知已阻止了一场亵渎。待主厨满意，便遣你离去。

column1: The wrong face probably triggers a trap. After careful calculation, you press...
column2: 错误的面孔或许会触动陷阱。经过缜密推算，你按下……

column1: Their leaders gone, the crowd begins to melt away. With a cheer, you and the guardsmen charge for the fortress door. The remaining mob scatters in all directions before you.
column2: 首领既去，人群渐次散去。欢呼一声，你与卫兵齐冲堡垒大门。残余暴民在你面前四散奔逃。

column1: Their power over the innocents is ended: the witches cannot harm them once they are baptized.
column2: 他们对无辜者的掌控至此终结：一旦受洗，女巫便再难加害。

column1: Their superior agility tells here, also. Within a minute they reach striking range. To avoid being cut down from behind, you must stand and fight.
column2: 他们的敏捷在此尽显。转瞬之间，他们已近身可击。若不想遭背后砍杀，唯有迎战。

column1: Their twisted leader sneers and swings his weapon once more. All goes black.
column2: 他们那扭曲的首领狞笑着再度挥舞武器。眼前一片漆黑。

column1: Then $NamedOneName fixes you all with a piercing look. "I thank you for your aid, with all my heart. Now let me explain the details..."
column2: 随后$NamedOneName目光如炬，扫视众人。“我由衷感谢诸位相助。如今容我详述……”

column1: Then $NamedOneName sits back and continues, "But perhaps the most important issue is that eliminating such evils brings the light of purity and the sweet scent of reason to this land, making life better for all."
column2: 随后$NamedOneName靠回椅背，继续说道：“然则，最为紧要者，莫过于铲除此类恶行，使纯净之光与理性之香普照此地，令众生皆得福祉。”

column1: Then a shadow  passes between you and the sun, and the odor of burning sulphur fills the air. Overhead you see the fearful yet magnificent shape of a dragon in flight. Luckily, it is fixated upon the hapless wretch ahead, and not you.
column2: 忽有阴影掠过，遮蔽日光，空气中弥漫着硫磺灼烧之味。头顶之上，一只飞龙的身影既可怖又壮丽。幸而，它只盯住前方那不幸之人，并未留意你。

column1: Then a startled look comes to his face. His nose contorts as though it had a life of its own. Then a huge blasting sneeze wracks the demon, ripping through the room like a typhoon. Weakened and angered, the demon prince leaps to the attack.
column2: 他的脸上骤现惊色，鼻翼似有生命般扭曲。随即，一声巨嚏震天动地，如飓风席卷全场。恶魔王子虚弱而愤怒，跃然而起，扑向你。

column1: Then he deducts $Money2 from the pile. "This is the service charge," he announces. "Thank you for your patronage." He pours the remainder into the purse and hands it to you.
column2: 随后他从钱堆中抽出$Money2。“这是服务费，”他宣布，“感谢惠顾。”余款悉数倒入钱袋，递予你。

column1: Then he deducts $Money2 from the pile. "This is the service charge," he explains. "Thank you for your patronage."
column2: 随后他从钱堆中抽出$Money2。“这是服务费，”他解释道，“感谢惠顾。”

column1: Then he departs. You realize that you've come this way before.
column2: 随后他离去。你恍然大悟，自己曾来过此处。

column1: Then he leaves with his hunt. $ChosenOneName is gone, but the Wild Hunt is, too. Your curse is over.
column2: 随后他带着猎队离开。$ChosenOneName已去，野性猎队亦随之消散。你的诅咒终告解除。

column1: Then he shouts, "Ho, enemies at the gate!" Quickly the fortress awakens, forcing you to fade into the dark forest before they recognize you. Quietly, you discuss the best course of action until daybreak.
column2: 随后他高呼：“敌袭城门！”堡垒迅速警醒，迫使你在他们认出你之前隐入幽林。你们静默商议至破晓，谋划对策。

column1: Then he whacks you with the flat of his sword. "Now run off, like good little girls!" Weaponless, you decide to comply and run away.
column2: 随后他用剑刃拍打你。“快滚吧，乖女孩！”你手无寸铁，只得顺从，转身逃去。

column1: Then she vanishes as mysteriously as she came.
column2: 随后她如来时般神秘地消失了。

column1: Then the box is closed and locked. "Now, let me explain our difficulty..."
column2: 随后匣子合上并锁好。“如今，容我说明困境……”

column1: Then the guard corporal leans out the door and hisses, "Scum like you aren't welcome here!"
column2: 随后卫兵班长探出身来，低声喝道：“像你这等渣滓，休想入内！”

column1: Then the light fades away. Rocks begin to crack from the wall of the cavern, and a hideous claw breaks through the wall, followed by a terribly huge head. Its fanged jaws part and flames wash over the fleeing witches, turning them to cinders. The huge form wriggles forward further and faces you.
column2: 随后光线渐暗。洞壁裂开，一只狰狞的利爪破壁而出，继而是一颗硕大无比的头颅。其獠牙大张，火焰席卷逃窜的女巫，将她们化为灰烬。巨躯蠕动向前，直面你。

column1: Then the person you've rescued stands up and you realize he is no human! He is over seven feet tall, and covered with shaggy green hair. He grins, and huge discolored teeth flash in the shadows. You stand back in dismay as he bobs up and down happily.
column2: 随后你所救之人站起身来，你方觉他非人类！身高逾七尺，浑身披覆蓬松绿毛。他咧嘴一笑，阴影中露出巨大的黄褐牙齿。你惊愕后退，只见他欢快地上下跳动。

column1: Then the voices drop to a low murmur, and you can hear no more.
column2: 随后众声低语，再也听不见。

column1: Then you are before the $McGuffin . $ChosenOneName reaches down and takes it, and the ghost howls and vanishes. You quickly return to the church.
column2: 随后你来到$McGuffin前。$ChosenOneName俯身取走它，鬼魂嚎叫一声，倏忽消散。你匆匆返回教堂。

column1: Then you climb up the evil hill which holds their monstrous altar. There you might break the cycle of wickedness which holds the village in bondage. If you can destroy the altar, their hellish cult must dissipate.
column2: 随后你攀上那座邪山，山上矗立着他们那座巨兽般的祭坛。在那里，你或能打破束缚村庄的邪恶轮回。若毁掉祭坛，他们的地狱式邪教必将瓦解。

column1: Then you come to one cave that seems swept clean, except for some fine black dust or dirt on the floor. You edge inside and see the $NamedOneName. Just as you grab it, great flames illuminate the natural cavern. Liquid, burning earth flows out of the walls and forms before your eyes: Vulcans!
column2: 随后你来到一处洞穴，看似清扫干净，唯地板上残留些许细黑尘土。你悄然入内，望见$NamedOneName。正欲伸手取之，洞窟骤然被烈焰照亮。熔岩自壁间涌出，在你眼前凝结成形：火山神！

column1: Then you discover a hidden lock that opens a hidden compartment. The note inside says: "$SabbatLocation to $Direction." You recognize this is a wild place of evil reputation. You wonder what unholy rites occur there.
column2: 随后你发现一处暗锁，开启了一个隐秘隔间。内藏纸条，写道：“从$SabbatLocation至$Direction。”你认出此地乃恶名昭彰之地。你不禁猜想，那里究竟举行何种邪秽仪式？

column1: Then, a few feet away, a tree starts shaking. Then the ground explodes and $ChosenOneName crawls forth, covered with muck, but otherwise unhurt.
column2: 随后，数步之外，一棵树开始摇晃。地面随即炸裂，$ChosenOneName爬出，浑身泥泞，却毫发无伤。

column1: Then, as if waking from a dream, he thanks you again and excuses himself. You bow and depart.
column2: 随后，他如梦初醒，再次致谢，告辞而去。你躬身施礼，转身离去。

column1: Then, from behind, you hear the roar of adult bears. You turn, and find yourself confronting two of them -- and they're charging toward you!
column2: 随后，身后传来熊吼。你回首，正对两只成年熊——它们正朝你猛冲而来！

column1: Then, to your horror, you see that the blood is eating away the floor of the cave! Soon the dragon's body is dissolved in the alkali of its own effluent, and, alas, most of the gold disappears in the liquid. Only a fraction of the monster's hoard is left, but that fraction is enough to make you all wealthy.
column2: 更令你惊骇的是，洞底已被鲜血侵蚀！不久，龙尸便在自身排泄物的碱性溶液中溶解，可惜，大部分黄金也随之消融。仅剩的一点宝藏，亦足以让你等人富甲一方。

column1: There are five gravestones with names you can read. The names are $NamedOneName, $NamedTwoName, $NamedThreeName, $NamedFourName, and $NamedFiveName. You...
column2: 有五块墓碑，碑文可辨。分别是$NamedOneName、$NamedTwoName、$NamedThreeName、$NamedFourName和$NamedFiveName。你……

column1: There are frowns and dark looks at the mention of $NamedOneName. One man spits on the ground, then says "Not wantin' any trouble, I'll not be tellin' tales. Let's just say that his enemies are my friends." Others nod.
column2: 提及$NamedOneName时，众人眉头紧锁，目光阴沉。一人啐了一口，道：“惹不起，我也不多话。只说一句，他的仇人便是我的朋友。”余人点头附和。

column1: There are mutters of fear, and many of the gathered witches flee the site. You join them.
column2: 惊恐之声四起，许多聚集的女巫纷纷逃离现场。你也随众人而去。

column1: There are reports of something ravaging the countryside $Direction from here. Some even talk of a dragon being seen in the skies.
column2: 据报，距此$Direction处，乡野间有怪兽肆虐。甚至有人称曾在天空中见到飞龙。

column1: There are reports of unrest in $LocName ,  which lies to the $Direction .
column2: 据报，位于$Direction方向的$LocName动荡不安。

column1: There are rumors about $VarString2. Some people whisper that he is really the son of a common serf, a bastard unsuitable for his high position.
column2: 关于$VarString2，传言四起。有人窃语，他实乃庶民之子，私生子，不堪高位。

column1: There are rumors about $VarString2. Some people whisper that there is an uncontrolled love affair with some paramour, who has a dread disease. Any proof of this would, of course, case instant ruin.
column2: 关于$VarString2，传言四起。有人窃语，他与某情妇私通，而彼女身染恶疾。若有确证，自当招致灭顶之灾。

column1: There are rumors about $VarString2. Some people whisper that this leader sells guild products which are anything but guild work. Unsuspecting customers may have ended up with shoddy, cheap, second-rate items.
column2: 关于$VarString2，传言四起。有人窃语，此领袖兜售的公会产品并非公会之作。无知顾客或已购得粗劣廉价之品。

column1: There are rumors about $VarString2. Some people whisper that this person has dealings with foreign enmies of $PlaceName, receiving florins in exchange for betraying the city.
column2: 关于$VarString2，传言四起。有人窃语，此人与$PlaceName的外敌勾结，收受佛罗林，以背叛城池为代价。

column1: There are rumors about $VarString2. Some people whisper that this person is a secret worshipper in a dark cult that worships demons or the devil.
column2: 关于$VarString2，传言四起。有人窃语，此人为暗夜邪教的潜伏信徒，崇拜恶魔或魔鬼。

column1: There are rumors about $VarString2. Some people whisper that this person's predecessor didn't die by chance, but instead was poisoned. Revealing proof of this advancement by murder would, of course, cause an instant scandal, and undoubtedly the leader's downfall.
column2: 有关于$VarString2的传言。有人窃窃私语，说此人的前任并非死于意外，而是遭人毒害。若能揭露其谋杀上位的铁证，自会引发轩然大波，领袖必将垮台。

column1: There are rumors that $NamedOneName is a close personal friend of the $CityLordTitle, ruler of this city!
column2: 有传言称，$NamedOneName乃本市统治者$CityLordTitle之至交！

column1: There are rumors that a rebellion against the $CityLordTitle of $PlaceName was put down. Although some still doubt the stability of the government, most feel the ruler is stronger than ever.
column2: 有传言称，针对$PlaceName之$CityLordTitle的叛乱已被镇压。虽仍有疑虑，但多数人认为政权稳固如初。

column1: There are widely-believed rumors that within a few days the rebels will muster their forces and march on the
column2: 盛传数日内，叛军将集结兵力，进逼城池。

column1: There are widely-believed rumors that within a few days the the city guard will be sent to arrest all the rebel ringleaders as traitors.
column2: 盛传数日内，城卫将奉命逮捕所有叛首，以叛国罪论处。

column1: There comes a bellow of demonic fury from a twisted black form that looms above the shattered altar. "You will pay for this outrage!" it screams, voice cracked with pain.
column2: 一道恶魔般的怒吼自扭曲的黑影中迸发，那黑影高悬于破碎的祭坛之上。“尔等必偿此滔天之罪！”它嘶声裂帛，痛楚难抑。

column1: There has been a man following you for some time now, a darkly dressed man with a broad-brimmed cap pulled low over his face. You noticed him only peripherally at first, but now he steps up to you.
column2: 有一男子已尾随汝多时，身着黑衣，宽檐帽低垂遮面。起初汝仅觉其身影恍惚，如今他却径直趋前。

column1: There is a bold check-mark beside this. Could this be the rebel master plan?
column2: 此处画有一道醒目的勾。莫非这便是叛军的全盘计划？

column1: There is a curious, dull feeling in the air as the sergeant smiles grimly. "Everyone calls upon some saint or another when they come here," he says wryly. "Heaven has stopped answering the pleas of criminals. And nobody but a criminal would be a friend of the scum we have here!"
column2: 警长阴沉一笑，空气中弥漫着一股奇异的沉闷。“凡至此者，皆祈求诸圣。”他冷笑道，“天庭已不再回应罪人的哀告。而唯有罪人，方与吾等所收之人同伍！”

column1: There is a deep silence, as though the oppressive darkness had reached all the way to Heaven.
column2: 四野寂然，仿佛那压抑的黑暗已直抵苍穹。

column1: There is a great roaring wind, and you hear, "You have found the secret to send me away. This incarnation of my Hunt is destroyed, but I shall return. When I do, your precious $Text1 will be of no avail against me. Beware!" Then he is gone, swirling away on the night wind. You have won!
column2: 风声呼啸，汝闻得：“汝已寻得驱我之秘。吾猎之化身既灭，然吾终将归来。届时，汝之珍宝$Text1亦难挡吾锋芒。慎之！”旋即，他随夜风而去。汝胜矣！

column1: There is a loud thump as $ChosenOneName bangs $his head into an unseen shelf. Surprised, $he gives a loud curse. From across the hall you hear the night watch call, "Who goes there?"
column2: 只见$ChosenOneName猛力一撞，将你的头撞向无形之架。你惊呼一声，咒骂连连。隔厅传来夜巡之声：“何人在此？”

column1: There is a rumbling hiss from somewhere deep beneath the ground. Then the water of the fountain begins to run clear. Whatever power there once was here is gone. The water is now just water.
column2: 地底深处传来阵阵低鸣。随即，喷泉之水渐复清澈。昔日之力已然消散，水仍归水。

column1: There is a shout of alarm. "Enemies at the gate!" yells the sergeant of the guard. Bystanders scatter as guardsmen charge toward you.
column2: 忽闻警报：“敌袭城门！”卫队长厉声喝令。旁观者四散，卫士疾奔而来。

column1: There is an unhappy look on $ChosenFourName's face. "Don't we need fine armor and good weapons? Maybe the sale of one or two valuable items would give us the funds to help everyone here. I am loathe to venture into the dangerous countryside without good equipment."
column2: $ChosenFourName面露愁容：“岂非需良甲利器？或许变卖一二贵物，便可筹得资财，济众人于危难。无备而入险地，实非所愿。”

column1: There is great rejoicing. Everyone has been miraculously cured. Their blessings echo in your ears as you continue onward.
column2: 举城欢腾。众人皆获神迹般痊愈。汝前行之际，耳畔犹回荡着他们的祝福。

column1: There is news that the $CityLordTitle of $PlaceName was overthrown in $Text1. Now the city is ruled by a $CityLordTitle for the $CityLordName. The disturbances hardly interrupted trade.
column2: 传闻$PlaceName之$CityLordTitle已于$Text1被推翻。今城由$CityLordName之$CityLordTitle主政。骚乱几未扰及商旅。

column1: There is no answer to your prayers. After a time, bowing your heads in sadness, you leave the room.
column2: 祈祷杳无回音。久候之后，汝等黯然低头，悄然退去。

column1: There is no clear idea of their opinion or political inclinations.
column2: 其人之立场与政见，尚无定论。

column1: There is no effect. The Templars try harder, literally beating the faggots with the brand, and you scream, "The salvation of God is upon us! Now strike down these demons!"
column2: 无济于事。骑士团愈加用力，以火钳狠击木桩，汝则高呼：“上帝救赎临身！速斩此魔！”

column1: There is no time for discussion. Fighting desperately, you kill all the snakes, but not before you have been bitten.
column2: 无暇争辩。汝拼死搏斗，尽屠群蛇，然已为蛇所噬。

column1: There is no time to disarm a trap once it is sprung! You all fall into a dark chute that sends you plunging into the depths of the monastery's dungeon. The long fall ends in a dark chamber.
column2: 陷阱一旦触发，已无解拆之机！汝等坠入幽暗滑道，直堕修道院深牢。漫长的坠落止于漆黑密室。

column1: There is only darkness ... small pulses of light, like a heartbeat ... leering faces, cackling laughs. You feel yourself lifted, and crude hands fumble among your possessions. Then there are intonations that echo like the pealing of a bell.
column2: 唯余黑暗……微光点点，似心跳脉动……狞笑浮面，怪声咯咯。汝感身被托起，粗手翻检财物。继而，耳畔响起钟鸣般的诵念。

column1: There is silence in the face of this awesome cry. The red-eyed figure on the altar vanishes like so much autumn smoke.
column2: 面对这骇人之呼喊，天地俱寂。祭坛上红眸之影，如秋烟般消散无踪。

column1: There is so much confusion, the plan works: by pretending to be one of the masses, you manage to slip into the Sabbat site.
column2: 混乱之中，计策奏效：汝佯装众民之一，悄然潜入安息之所。

column1: There is such confusion that the plan works: by pretending to be one of the masses, you manage to slip into the site of the Sabbat.
column2: 混乱之际，计策生效：汝假扮平民，潜入安息之地。

column1: There is sudden burst of a horrible, rotten smell, which causes $ChosenOneName to stumble over a dead tree. Then you hear a sibilant "Hiss." Huge, snakelike creatures with two front legs streak from the brush straight at you! In the split second before they strike, you...
column2: 突然一阵恶臭扑鼻，$ChosenOneName踉跄撞上枯木。随即，耳畔响起嘶嘶之声。巨蛇状异兽，双足挺立，自草丛中直扑而来！电光火石间，汝……

column1: There lies the dragon, on a bed of golden treasure! It rattles its claws ominously, but tilts its head to one side. It seems intelligent, willing to listen. The creature's power is restrained, temporarily.
column2: 龙卧金堆之上！爪击作响，却侧首倾听。似通灵性，愿纳忠言。其力暂被束缚。

column1: There's a frantic scrabbling, then a hard thud as $ChosenOneName falls off the wall.
column2: 急促扒抓之后，$ChosenOneName重重跌落墙下。

column1: There, a few argue you should be saved for the High Sabbat on $SabbatTime, $SabbatLocation. However, the majority feel you must be sacrificed now, at midnight.
column2: 数人主张留汝至$SabbatTime之夜，献于$SabbatLocation之高安息。然多数人以为，汝须于子夜献祭。

column1: They accept your payment with a smile, then urge you to get off the street as quickly as possible. You step into a dark alleyway and wait for them to depart before continuing.
column2: 他们含笑收汝之酬，催汝速离街巷。汝步入幽暗小巷，静待其离去，再行续程。

column1: They are wondering whether to use this knowledge to gain influence over him, or to urge the $CityLordTitle to arrest him.
column2: 他们踌躇，不知该以此情报影响此人，抑或促$CityLordTitle将其缉拿。

column1: They attack immediately.
column2: 彼等即刻发动袭击。

column1: They bedeck the girl in fancy clothes and jewelry. Then they take her to the outskirts of town and tie her to a stake!
column2: 彼等为少女盛装华服，佩饰珠玉。遂携其至城郊，缚于木桩之上！

column1: They finger their weapons menacingly, and you notice crossbows aimed at you from a corner window. You decide to take their advice and step back into the street.
column2: 彼等握刃示威，汝察见角窗中弩箭指向自己。汝依其劝，退回街头。

column1: They help you up and escort you to the village, where you are surrounded by grateful friends.
column2: 彼等扶汝起身，护送至村中，汝为感恩之友环绕。

column1: They help you up and into the village, where you are surrounded by grateful friends.
column2: 彼等扶汝起身，护送至村中，汝为感恩之友环绕。

column1: They laugh uproariously as you kneel and slowly cram handfuls of paper into your mouth and chew.
column2: 彼等哄然大笑，汝跪地，缓缓将纸张塞入口中，细细咀嚼。

column1: They plan to sacrifice $ChosenOneName to the evil dragon!
column2: 彼等欲将$ChosenOneName献祭于邪龙！

column1: They start beating you savagely with kicks and clubs, but some city guards appear and chase them off. You to stagger away, bloodied but thankful that you weren't beaten to death.
column2: 彼等挥拳踢棒，肆意殴打汝，然城卫现身，将其驱散。汝蹒跚而走，虽血迹斑斑，却庆幸未遭毙命。

column1: They strip you of all obvious weapons, armor and possessions, then drive you from the cave with barbed whips.
column2: 彼等剥汝衣甲武具，驱汝出洞，以带刺鞭挞。

column1: They strip you of armor, weapons, and other significant possessions. Soon the city guard arrives takes you down a side street, where your possessions are returned.
column2: 彼等剥汝衣甲武具，不久城卫至，押汝至侧街，归还汝物。

column1: They strip you of armor, weapons, and other significant possessions. The city guard arrives and drags you to the dungeon, where you await trial for housebreaking, theft, and attempted assassination.
column2: 彼等剥汝衣甲武具，城卫至，押汝入狱，候审破门、盗窃及谋杀未遂之罪。

column1: Thinking carefully over $his religious lore, $ChosenOneName explains which parts of the altar must be destroyed to purge the evil. You start chipping away, but soon there is a flash of sallow light and a choking stench. When your eyes clear, you see a hideous figure -- a demon!
column2: $ChosenOneName细研你的宗教典故，阐明祭坛何处当毁，方可祛邪。汝始凿削，忽见黄光一闪，恶臭熏喉。目明之时，只见狰狞之影——恶魔！

column1: Thinking carefully, $ChosenOneName remarks, "We defeated them, but they seem like scouts for a larger army. We should be careful of other patrols."
column2: $ChosenOneName沉思道：“吾等虽败之，然其似大军前哨。宜防其余巡逻。”

column1: Thinking carefully, $ChosenOneName remarks, "We defeated this group of soldiers, but how many more are roaming nearby, fighting for one side or another in this private war?"
column2: $ChosenOneName沉思道：“吾等虽歼此部兵卒，然附近尚有多少游骑，各为其主，鏖战不止？”

column1: Thinking fast, $ChosenOneName slips back into the shadow of a tree; the rest of you confront the man.
column2: $ChosenOneName 眼疾手快，悄悄退回树影之中；其余的人则直面那男子。

column1: Thinking over your request, the Schulz reaches into his purse. "It is little enough for such famed folk as you, but I can do my part. Please accept this florin on our behalf." He drops a florin into your hand.
column2: Schulz 细想你的请求，将手伸入钱袋。“对您这样的名士而言，这实在微薄，但我也能略尽绵薄之力。请代表我们收下这枚弗罗林。”他将一枚弗罗林放入你手中。

column1: Thinking quickly, $ChosenOneName cries "Only one choice! Go in! In! Blend with the crowd as best you can!"
column2: $ChosenOneName急中生智，高呼：“别无选择！入内！入内！尽力混入人群！”

column1: This band of mercenaries-turned-bandits will trouble Germany no more. Satisfied, you resume your journey.
column2: 这帮由雇佣兵变成的盗匪，再也不会给德意志添麻烦了。你心满意足，重新踏上旅程。

column1: This caravan is travelling to $NearestCity, and expects to arrive in $Number1 days. Meanwhile, after some discussion, they are satisfied that you are sufficiently trustworthy to be good travelling companions.
column2: 这支商队正前往 $NearestCity，预计 $Number1 天后抵达。经过一番商议，他们认为你们足以信赖，可做一同赶路的好伙伴。

column1: This card (CityGateWarPrepNight) is not done.
column2: 这张卡（CityGateWarPrepNight）尚未完成。

column1: This card describes options as you look down the main streets of the city. It's the main "going to places" menu.
column2: 这张卡描述你俯瞰城市主街时列出的选项，即主要的“前往各地”菜单。

column1: This door is solid oak, with a rusty iron grating in the center. There is a small prison cell behind the door, but it is currently empty. A quick search of the cell reveals nothing of interest.
column2: 这扇门是实心橡木门，中央嵌着一块锈迹斑斑的铁格栅。门后是一间狭小的牢房，但此刻空无一人。你快速搜查牢房，未发现任何有价值之物。

column1: This is a High Sabbat, a great meeting of witch cultists from all over the country. Their objective is to enact evil deeds (including foul initiation rites, flying on unholy steeds, and feasting on unbaptized innocents) that will give power to someone called only "The Master."
column2: 这是一场盛大的萨巴特，来自全国的女巫信徒齐聚一堂。其目的是施行种种恶行（包括污秽的入门仪式、骑乘邪物飞天、啖食未受洗礼的婴孩），以赋予那位仅被称为“主”的人力量。

column1: This is a High Sabbat, a great meeting of witch-cultists from all over the country. Their objective is to enact evil deeds (including foul initiation rites, flying on unholy steeds, and feasting on unbaptized innocents) that will give power to someone called only "The Master." From what you can tell, The Master is guarded by powerful charms that can only be broken in a place called a fortress monastery, where the Knights Templar train satanic priests. There is to be a great ceremony on the second day of the Sabbat; surely there will be a priest there.
column2: 这是一场盛大的萨巴特，来自全国的女巫信徒齐聚一堂。其目的乃施行种种恶行（包括污秽的入门仪式、骑乘邪物飞天、啖食未受洗礼的婴孩），以助那位仅被称为“主”的人获取力量。据你所知，“主”身负强力护符，唯有在一处名为堡垒修道院之地方方可破解；此地乃圣殿骑士训练撒旦祭司之所。萨巴特第二日将举行盛大仪式，届时必有祭司现身。

column1: This is a temp card.
column2: 这是一张临时卡。

column1: This is an empty chest. One small bloodstain is its only decoration.
column2: 这是一只空匣，仅有一抹细小的血迹点缀其上。

column1: This is the RecoveryCamp card.
column2: 这是恢复营地卡。

column1: This is the city stables, at night. It isn't finished yet.
column2: 这是城中的马厩，夜色深沉。尚未竣工。

column1: This is the city stables, in daytime. It isn't done.
column2: 这是城中的马厩，白日时分。尚未完工。

column1: This is the gunsmith at night.
column2: 这是夜间的枪匠。

column1: This is the gunsmith in the daytime.
column2: 这是白日里的枪匠。

column1: This is the poorhouse at night. It isn't done yet.
column2: 这是夜间的贫民院。尚未完工。

column1: This is the poorhouse in daytime. It isn't done yet.
column2: 这是白日里的贫民院。尚未完工。

column1: This is the slum at night. It isn't done yet.
column2: 这是夜间的贫民窟。尚未完工。

column1: This room contains a large altar, dark and foreboding. It is surrounded by smoking torches, and in the flickering light spatters of something dark can be seen decorating its top.
column2: 此室设有一座巨大祭坛，阴森可怖。四周火把烟熏，微光摇曳间，可见其上斑斑点点，似有暗物点缀。

column1: This schrat is grateful. You have saved his life, and he wishes to reward you.
column2: 此精灵心怀感激。你救了他的性命，他愿报以厚礼。

column1: This seems significant, so you remember it. Then, looking around, you see a nearby hill, topped by a ring of stones. It is clearly some sort of diabolic worship site. You hike up to it.
column2: 这似乎意义非凡，你便记住了它。随后环顾四周，见不远处有一座小丘，顶上环绕着一圈石阵。显然，此处乃某种邪教祭祀之地。你徒步登临其上。

column1: This seems to be just what the strangers hoped you'd say! They smile and greet you politely, asking what city you hie from and other trivialities. Carefully neutral in your responses, you accompany them on their way to the field.
column2: 这似乎正是那几位异客所期望你所说的话！他们微笑着，彬彬有礼地向你问候，询问你来自何城，以及一些琐碎之事。你答辞谨慎而中立，随他们一同前往那片田野。

column1: This spot is beautiful and peaceful, but you find nothing of interest or value. The lean-to is half filled with dried leaves, beneath which you cannot even find a scrap of cloth. Even the small fire circle, once uncovered, reveals nothing more than a handful of old ashes and some cracked stones.
column2: 此地幽美而静谧，然无物可取。简陋棚屋半覆枯叶，其下竟觅不得寸布。昔日火圈，掘之亦仅余残灰数撮，碎石几枚。

column1: This time, the kidnappers aren't so friendly. "Take $him," says their leader, gesturing to $ChosenOneName, "and kill the rest!" Weapons descend and all is darkness.
column2: 这回，绑匪们可不那么友善了。“带走你，”他们的头目指着$ChosenOneName说道，“其余的统统杀掉！”刀剑齐下，眼前一片黑暗。

column1: This time, you are in luck: the sounds fade and you remain undiscovered. But no doubt it will catch you soon.
column2: 这回你运气不错：那些声响渐渐消散，你仍未被发现。但无疑它很快便会寻到你。

column1: This village has been destroyed by some great catastrophe. The homes are all burned, the fields ravaged, even the animals killed. Only ruins remain, mixed with the bones of those who failed to escape. There is nothing you can do here.
column2: 此村已被大灾所毁。屋舍尽焚，田地荒芜，连牲畜亦遭屠戮。唯余断壁残垣，与未能逃生者之骸骨相杂。此处已无可为。

column1: This village has been destroyed by some great catastrophe. The homes are all burned, the fields ravaged, even the animals killed. Only ruins remains, mixed with the bones of those who failed to escape. There is nothing you can do here.
column2: 此村已遭大劫，房屋尽焚，田地荒芜，牲畜亦死。唯余断壁残垣，杂以未及逃生者之骸骨。此处无事可为。

column1: Those who successfully negotiated the cliff clamber down to aid those who fell.
column2: 成功渡过悬崖者，下山援助坠落之人。

column1: Though $ChosenOneName's plea is heartfelt, bringing tears to your eyes, and to some of the guards as well, the alchemist himself is not impressed. He says, "If you will not take silver for your goods, perhaps you'll take steel!" and orders his guards to attack. Grim-faced, and showing signs of alchemical enhancement, they advance.
column2: 尽管$ChosenOneName的恳求情真意切，令你乃至部分卫兵潸然泪下，但炼金术士本人却不为所动。他道：“若汝不愿以银易物，或可取钢代之！”遂命其卫兵进击。彼等面色阴沉，显有炼金术加持，步步逼近。

column1: Though $he gives it $his best, $ChosenOneName's prayers receive no response from on high.
column2: 尽管 $he 竭尽全力，$ChosenOneName 的祈祷未得上天回应。

column1: Though $he saws away for what seems like forever, $ChosenOneName cannot break the ropes. When the cultists see what you are trying to do, they are furious. They quickly retie your bonds, and the burliest one kicks you in a frenzy of anger.
column2: 尽管你锯了许久，$ChosenOneName仍无法挣断绳索。当教徒们发现你在做什么时，怒不可遏。他们迅速重新绑紧你的手脚，最强壮的那个更是愤怒地猛踢你一脚。

column1: Though activity continues all through the night, you settle down in a quiet corner of the field. You know that you must not allow the satanic ceremony (or the equally hideous feast which follows) to be completed.
column2: 尽管整夜活动不息，你仍于营地一角安顿下来。你深知绝不能让那场撒旦仪式（或其后同样骇人的盛宴）得以完成。

column1: Though no warriors, your foes fought with amazing ferocity. They leave you half-conscious by the side of the path, and run off shouting a warning to the other pilgrims converging on the area. It is all you can do to drag yourselves into hiding before they come back with reinforcements.
column2: 虽非战士，敌手却以惊人之凶猛奋战。他们将你击至半昏半醒，弃于路旁，随即奔逃而去，向正汇聚于此的其他朝圣者发出警讯。你仅能勉力拖身入隐，以防其携援兵而返。

column1: Though no warriors, your foes fought with amazing ferocity. They leave you half-conscious by the side of the path, and run off shouting a warning to the other travellers. It is all you can do to drag yourselves into hiding before they come back with reinforcements.
column2: 虽非战士，敌手却以惊人之凶猛作战。他们将你击至半昏半醒，弃于路旁，随即呼啸而去，向其他旅人发出警讯。你仅能勉力拖身入隐，以防其携援兵而返。

column1: Though powerful, your foes were no match for your prowess.
column2: 尽管强敌环伺，却难敌尔之勇武。

column1: Though you exert your wills toward activating the relic's power, no one among you, not even $ChosenOneName, is virtuous enough to use it to destroy the evil that is here.
column2: 尽管你们竭力欲催动圣物之力，然汝等之中，纵使是$ChosenOneName，亦未有德足以凭此物灭此地之邪。

column1: Though you have beaten the Wild Hunt's attempt to capture you, your victory seems curiously hollow. You know that the Hunt will be back, and that you will eventually succumb unless you can find the secret to drive it away.
column2: 尽管你击退了野猎队的擒拿之谋，这胜利却显得格外空洞。你知道野猎队终将卷土重来，若不能寻得驱逐之秘，终究难逃其手。

column1: Though you have lost your main chance to destroy the Sabbat, you might still learn vital information or gain redemption by confronting the remaining witches. You decide to...
column2: 尽管你已失去摧毁撒巴特的良机，但或许仍能通过直面余下的女巫，获知关键情报或寻求救赎。你决定……

column1: Though you race at your fastest, the thief is faster yet, no doubt because of his terror. You cannot catch him and eventually lose sight of him entirely.
column2: 尽管你以最快的速度追赶，那贼却更快，想必是因恐惧所致。你无法追上他，最终彻底失去了他的踪影。

column1: Though you strive with all your strength, the gate will not open. A mysterious voice murmurs, "The Sixth Seal is not opened. The sixth gate cannot be opened."
column2: 尽管你竭尽全力，城门仍无法开启。一神秘之声低语道：“第六封印未启，第六之门不可开。”

column1: Though you strive with all your strength, the gate will not open. Perhaps you lack something.
column2: 尽管你竭尽全力，城门仍无法开启。或许你还缺少些什么。

column1: Though you've lost your main chance to destroy the Sabbat, you might still learn vital information and gain redemption by confronting the witches. You decide to...
column2: 尽管你已失去摧毁撒巴特的良机，但或许仍能通过直面女巫，获知关键情报并寻求救赎。你决定……

column1: Though your words do not have the effect you had hoped, the demon prince howls in agony; it is as though a thousand damned souls cried out at once. The scream echoes on, driving into your minds like a knife. When silence finally falls, the demon prince leaps wildly to the attack.

column2: 不幸的是，没有圣徒回应你的祈求。魔鬼笑道：“连我在天堂的敌人都明白我事业的正义！”

column1: Unfortunately, none of you can read well enough to understand any of the notices. In the daytime you could find somebody to read them to you, but at night this is impossible. You go away, frustrated.
column2: 不幸的是，你们中无人识文断字，无法读懂任何告示。白日里尚可寻人代读，然夜深则不可得。你们悻悻而归。

column1: Unfortunately, none of you knows enough about alchemy. You spend hours visiting shops, but they are either useless fortune-tellers or raving lunatics. You realize that finding a true alchemist requires more knowledge.
column2: 不幸的是，你们无人精通炼金术。你们花费数小时走访各店，却发现他们要么是毫无用处的算命者，要么是癫狂的疯子。你们意识到，寻得真正的炼金术士还需更多学识。

column1: Unfortunately, now that you've talked to people about the aristocrat $NamedTwoName, you find that nobody will talk further about this "enemy" of the $CityLordTitle.
column2: 不幸的是，既然你已与众人谈及那位$NamedTwoName贵族，便发现无人愿再谈论这位$CityLordTitle的“敌人”。

column1: Unfortunately, the fight with the guards allowed the bishop and his clerk to escape. $ChosenOneName shakes $his head. "No good will come of assaulting this party, no matter how deserving they were. Our reputation nearby is now ruined. Furthermore, consider our virtue and favor: we have paid for this act in a higher court than man's."
column2: 不幸的是，与守卫的交战使主教及其书记得以逃脱。$ChosenOneName 摇了摇 你的 的头。“无论他们多么罪有应得，袭击此行也无益处。我们在此地的名声已毁。况且，请思量我们的德行与恩宠：此行之代价已在高于人间的法庭上偿还。”

column1: Unfortunately, the footing here is extremely difficult. You don't go far before $ChosenOneName slips and falls off.
column2: 不幸的是，此处的地面极为难行。你尚未走远，$ChosenOneName便滑倒摔落。

column1: Unfortunately, the potion has no effect. You wonder whether to try a potion once more, or consider something else...
column2: 不幸的是，药剂毫无效果。你思索着是否再试一次药剂，抑或另寻他法……

column1: Unfortunately, the prayer of $ChosenOneName has no effect.
column2: 不幸的是，$ChosenOneName的祈祷毫无效果。

column1: Unfortunately, the prayer of $ChosenOneName is not answered.
column2: 不幸的是，$ChosenOneName的祈祷并未得到回应。

column1: Unfortunately, the prayers of $ChosenTwoName are not answered. The crowd remains ugly, so your remaining options are...
column2: 不幸的是，$ChosenTwoName的祈祷并未得到回应。人群依旧丑陋，因此你剩下的选择是……

column1: Unfortunately, the ropes are too strong for any of you, even $ChosenOneName, to break.
column2: 不幸的是，绳索过于坚韧，即便是$ChosenOneName也无法挣断。

column1: Unfortunately, the saint does not see fit to answer your plea.
column2: 不幸的是，圣人并未应允你的祈求。

column1: Unfortunately, the witches prove too tough. You ponder how to defeat them, were you to return.
column2: 不幸的是，女巫们过于强大。你思索着，若要再次归来，该如何击败她们。

column1: Unfortunately, there are very few promising candidates among the current guardsmen. Those that exist are content with the quiet, orderly life here at the $cityBarracks. They have no interest in joining your party.
column2: 不幸的是，现任卫兵中鲜有可堪大任者。少数几人安于$cityBarracks的宁静有序生活，无意加入你的队伍。

column1: Unfortunately, there is no answer to $ChosenOneName's prayer. The rain continues coming down, and the water continues to rise! You...
column2: 不幸的是，$ChosenOneName的祈祷没有得到回应。雨仍在倾盆而下，水位持续上涨！你...

column1: Unfortunately, you are driven away, forced to abandon $ChosenOneName to the vile villagers. You hide nearby, hoping for an opportunity to see what happens to her.
column2: 不幸的是，你被驱逐，被迫将$ChosenOneName留给那些卑劣的村民。你藏在附近，希望能有机会看看她会怎样。

column1: Unfortunately, you are driven off by the raubritter's men.
column2: 不幸的是，你被劫匪的部下驱逐了。

column1: Unfortunately, you are not very adept at keeping out of sight. Within an hour...
column2: 不幸的是，你并不擅长隐匿身形。不过一小时之内……

column1: Unfortunately, you fail to rescue the girl. As you are driven back by the villagers, the sky suddenly darkens with the dragon's arrival. A hideous reptile stench fills the air, the girl screams, and the dragon snatches her up. You feel both anger and regret. As you leave for the wilderness, you silently vow to prevent any other innocents from suffering.
column2: 不幸的是，你未能救出少女。正当你被村民逼退之际，天空骤然因巨龙的降临而暗沉。空气中弥漫着令人作呕的爬虫气息，少女惊声尖叫，巨龙将她掳走。你既愤怒又懊悔。当你踏上荒野之时，心中默默发誓，绝不再让无辜之人受苦。

column1: Unfortunately, you neither hear nor sense any response to your prayers. You wonder whether to rely upon your own judgement, or try again...
column2: 不幸的是，你既未听见也未感受到任何回应。你犹豫着是该依靠自己的判断，还是再试一次……

column1: Unfortunately, you stumble and fall almost as soon as you leave the camp. With a cry of triumph, the pirates leap at you. There are only two choices now:
column2: 不幸的是，你刚一离开营地便踉跄跌倒。海盗们欢呼着扑向你。如今只剩下两个选择：

column1: Unfortunately, your bold words, insulting tone and overbearing manner don't help your case. The guardsmen jeer you away.
column2: 不幸的是，你那大胆的言辞、侮辱性的语气和傲慢的态度并未帮上忙。卫兵们嗤笑着将你赶走。

column1: Unfortunately, your enemies have good mounts and handle them well. They quickly gain on you. Soon your choices are limited...
column2: 不幸的是，你的敌人骑术高超，坐骑也十分矫健。他们很快便追上了你。不久，你的选择便寥寥无几了……

column1: Unfortunately, your over-bold words, insulting tone and overbearing manner make the sergeant too nervous. Your efforts end in failure.
column2: 不幸的是，你过于大胆的言辞、侮辱性的语气和傲慢的态度让军曹过于紧张。你的努力以失败告终。

column1: Unfortunately, your wood-wise tracking abilities aren't up to the challenge. You are unable to find the trail of the kidnappers. $ChosenOneName is truly gone.
column2: 不幸的是，你那精通林野的追踪本领也无能为力。你无法寻得绑匪的踪迹。$ChosenOneName 真的已不知所踪。

column1: Unhappily, $ChosenOneName is still stuck in the bog. $He is no longer sinking, but you haven't got $him out yet either. You decide to...
column2: 不幸的是，$ChosenOneName仍陷在沼泽中。你不再下沉了，但你仍未将你救出。你决定……

column1: Uninclined to be generous in victory, $NamedThreeName froths at the mouth and shrieks unintelligibly. At last he gestures to his demon disciples. They seize you and drag you from the dragon's lair, beating you mercilessly all the while.
column2: 胜利之时不肯慷慨，$NamedThreeName 口吐白沫，尖叫着语无伦次。终于，他向麾下的恶魔弟子示意。他们抓住你，将你从龙穴中拖出，一路上无情地鞭打。

column1: Unsatisfied, but unable to get more, you thank her and depart.
column2: 不满，却无法再得更多，你谢过她便离去。

column1: Unsure as to how to best assail the altar, you finally decide just to attack it with your weapons. Suddenly, a fuming black cloud oozes out. Your eyes sting and a vast stink turns your stomach. To your horror, the cloud coalesces into a hideous demon, come to defend its altar.
column2: 不知如何最佳攻击祭坛，你最终决定仅以武器猛击之。忽而，一团浓烟滚滚而出。双眼刺痛，恶臭熏得你作呕。骇然间，黑烟凝聚成一狰狞恶魔，前来守护其祭坛。

column1: Unsure as to how to proceed, you work for hours on the altar, chipping away at its horrible sculptures and toppling it onto its side. But when you are finished, you feel you have failed to destroy the evil. All you have accomplished is a bit of vandalism. The evil that infects the site still retains its strength.
column2: 不知如何是好，你在祭坛上苦干数小时，凿去其丑陋雕像，并将其推倒侧卧。然完工后，你自觉未能摧毁邪祟。所成不过些许破坏而已。此地之邪气依旧强盛。

column1: Until further notice, all excess food in the city must be offered for sale to the $CityLord at the official prices, to permit fair and equitable distribution to the needy.
column2: 未经另行通知，城中所有多余食物须按官方价格售予$CityLord，以利公平公正地分发于贫民。

column1: Unwilling to harm the fellow, you release him. When he is a hundred yards away, he reaches into his shirt and pulls out a gleaming gold object. Cackling, he gloats, "I still have IT! I alone could steal IT from $NamedTwoName the dragon! No one can have IT but I!" You run after him, but he is gone.
column2: 不忍加害此人，你遂将其释放。待其行至百码之外，他伸手入怀，取出一物金光灿灿。咯咯怪笑，得意道：“我仍持有它！唯有我能自$NamedTwoName龙处窃得此物！除我之外，无人可得！”你追上前去，却已不见其踪影。

column1: Up ahead, $NamedOneName crosses your path. "Well met!" he says. "Since I am to blame for the dragon's release, I must end its reign. Surely thus I can gain forgiveness."
column2: 前方，$NamedOneName 与你相遇。“幸会！”他说，“既是我放出了那条巨龙，便当亲手终结它的暴政。如此方能求得宽恕。”

column1: Up ahead, some girls are lined up in a village square. When the villagers spot you, the Schulz rushes over. "Oh kind sirs," he says. "We cannot decide. Who is the loveliest maiden here?" You feel honored, and agree to choose for him.
column2: 前方，村中广场上排着几位少女。村民见你，舒尔茨急忙奔来。“哦，仁慈的先生们，”他说，“我们难以决断。哪位才是此间最娇美的姑娘？”你深感荣幸，便应允为他择选。

column1: Up ahead, you spy some villagers tying a screaming maiden to a pole. You sneak up, to observe the scene more closely.
column2: 前方，你瞥见几名村民正将一名尖叫的少女绑在木桩上。你悄然靠近，以便更仔细地观察这一幕。

column1: Upon closer examination, the object on the wall turns out to be a diploma or certificate of some kind, written in Latin. You ...
column2: 细察之下，墙上的物件竟是某种文凭或证书，以拉丁文书就。你 ...

column2: 细察之下，墙上之物乃一纸文凭或证书，以拉丁文书就。汝...

column1: Upon the door are five numbered knobs. Clearly, you are supposed to press one of the knobs. But which is next in the sequence. The wrong choice may release a horrible trap! You cogitate, then press...
column2: 门上设有五个编号的旋钮。显然，你应当按下其中一个。但序列中的下一个究竟是哪一个？选错恐将触发可怕的机关！你沉思片刻，然后按下……

column1: Upon the door are four metal knobs. You touch...
column2: 门上镶嵌着四个金属旋钮。你触碰……

column1: Upstairs, someone throws open and window, peers out with a lantern, and yells, "Thieves at the door! Thieves at the door!"
column2: 楼上，有人猛地推开窗户，举着灯笼向外张望，大喊道：“门口有贼！门口有贼！”

column1: Urgently whispering to a nearby cultist, you offer her $Money1 (all the money you have) in return for her help in escaping. She guffaws loudly, "What a puny plan! You think I would trade the great and bloody sacrifice for a few pfennigs?"
column2: 急切地向身旁的信徒低语，你许以她$Money1（你所有的钱财）作为逃脱的帮助。她放声大笑：“何等渺小的计策！你以为我会用那伟大而血腥的祭献，换取区区几枚便尼吗？”

column1: Urging your horses on, you gallop away and easily outdistance the boars who, though fast over a short stretch, lack endurance.
column2: 你催马疾驰，轻松甩开了野猪——它们虽在短程内迅捷，却缺乏耐力。

column1: Urging your horses onward, you gallop away. The wolves give chase but you steadily outdistance them. Finally they give up, howling in dismay. You have escaped.
column2: 你催马前行，飞驰而去。狼群紧追不舍，但你渐渐将它们甩开。最终它们放弃，发出沮丧的嚎叫。你已脱险。

column1: Use alchemical potions to force an entrance.
column2: 使用炼金药水强行闯入。

column1: Use an alchemical potion.
column2: 使用炼金药剂。

column1: Use your skill to read the plaque.
column2: 运用你的技能，读取此牌匾。

column1: Using $his great muscle power and dexterity, $ChosenOneName breaks open the sewer grate and you escape the city for the great outdoors.
column2: 凭借你的巨大力量与灵巧身手，$ChosenOneName撬开下水道井盖，你们逃离城市，重获自由。

column1: Using $his premixed materials, $ChosenOneName sets up $his alchemical equipment to perform a spiritual transformation, rather than a physical one.
column2: 使用你的预调制的材料，$ChosenOneName架设你的炼金设备，进行精神上的转化，而非物质上的。

column1: Using a rope, $ChosenOneName climbs up the wall, then lowers the rope to the rest of the party. Soon all of you are deep within $PlaceName.
column2: 用绳索，$ChosenOneName攀上墙头，随后将绳索放下给其余众人。不久，你们皆已深入$PlaceName。

column1: Using all your charm and speaking skill, you show them new ways to consider and understand the situation. Impressed, they change their minds a bit. Now they say the guild members will $Support changes in the city government.
column2: 运用你的全部魅力与口才，你向他们展示了审视与理解局势的新视角。众人深受触动，心意稍有转变。如今他们表示，公会成员将$Support市政府的变革。

column1: Using both your woods and crafts skills, you cut up a rope to lash together a makeshift reed raft, then put your equipment on it. Half pushing, half swimming, you navigate through the rising waters to a higher ground.
column2: 凭借你的伐木与工艺技能，你将绳索裁断，捆扎成一叶临时的芦苇筏，随后将装备置于其上。半推半游，你穿行于渐涨的水患之中，抵达一处高地。

column1: Using peasants as slave workers, the raubritter has constructed a rude fort. With piles of stone for walls, looks crude, but serves well enough. You ...
column2: 以农奴为奴工，劫匪骑士筑起一座简陋的堡垒。石块堆砌成墙，虽显粗陋，却也足够实用。你...

column1: Using the improvised rope, $ChosenOneName can slowly haul $himself out of the muck. Unfortunately, $he lost a few items in the goo. A small price for survival, everyone agrees!
column2: 利用临时制作的绳索，$ChosenOneName可以缓缓将你自己从泥沼中拉出。不幸的是，你在黏液中遗失了几件物品。大家一致认为，这是为生存付出的一点小小代价！

column1: Uttering a brief prayer, $ChosenOneName is staggered. Instead of a peaceful caravan, $he suddenly sees a band of bloodthirsty thieves, swords dripping blood, led by an evil being with an inhumanly twisted face.
column2: 念诵一段简短的祷词，$ChosenOneName 惊愕不已。眼前并非安宁的商队，你 突然看见一伙嗜血的盗贼，刀剑滴血，由一个面容扭曲、非人般的恶者率领。

column1: Uttering a quick prayer, $ChosenOneName walks toward them, saying, "Come, we are truly all brothers, why do you seek to harm or rob us? This is not what Our Lord intended."
column2: 念诵一段简短的祷文，$ChosenOneName走向他们，说道：“来吧，我们本是兄弟，何故欲加害或掠夺？这并非吾主之意。”

column1: Valiantly trying to reach the top of the wall, $ChosenOneName suddenly slips and falls. Landing with an audible "oof!", $he sits up and glares at the wall. Perhaps it is a tougher climb than it first appeared.
column2: 勇敢地试图攀上城墙，$ChosenOneName 突然滑落。重重摔在地上，发出一声“哎哟！”你 挣坐起来，怒视着城墙。或许这比初看起来还要艰难。

column1: Vapor flows out of $ChosenOneName's vial and turns the cobblestones into a sucking goo. The guards, dismayed, are glued like flies on a web. Laughing at their struggles, you calmly stroll away down a side alley.
column2: 蒸气从$ChosenOneName的药瓶中逸出，将石板路化作一片吸人的黏液。惊慌失措的卫兵们如飞虫般被牢牢粘住。你嘲笑他们的挣扎，从容地沿着一条侧巷离去。

column1: Various artisan guilds $VarPhrase5 change in the city government.
column2: 各种工匠公会$VarPhrase5在市政府中发生变动。

column1: Various foreign traders $VarPhrase6 change in the city.
column2: 各地商贾 $VarPhrase6 在城中更迭。

column1: Various guildsmen, brandishing improvised clubs, cheer your success in chasing away the thugs.
column2: 各公会的工匠挥舞着临时制作的棍棒，为你驱逐恶徒的成功而欢呼。

column1: Veterans of many combats, these particular guards are too tough for you. Seeking to save yourselves, you flee back to the fields outside the city.
column2: 多战老兵，此等卫士非尔等所能敌。为保性命，汝等仓皇逃回城外原野。

column1: Victorious over the hapless soldiers, you look around and see many more coming to the attack. You do not want to take on the whole army of $PlaceName, so you run away, back to the wilderness.
column2: 战胜了那些倒霉的士兵，你环顾四周，发现还有更多敌人正向你袭来。你不愿与$PlaceName的整支军队交锋，于是转身逃回荒野。

column1: Victorious, you proudly carry the $NamedOneName out of the valley.
column2: 胜利者，你自豪地将$NamedOneName带出山谷。

column1: Victorious, you rush past the fallen guards. In minutes, you break to the outside and leave the dungeon behind. But you hear a shout, and more guards rush after you.
column2: 胜利在握，你冲过倒下的守卫。片刻之间，你奔出洞外，将地牢抛诸身后。但你听见一声呼喊，更多的守卫追了上来。

column1: Victorious, you watch proudly as the last vestiges of the dragon's form evaporate on the stones before you. The way is clear to the final confrontation.
column2: 胜利在望，你自豪地注视着龙形的最后残影在你面前的石板上消散。通往最终对决的道路已然畅通。

column1: Victory is yours! You rush to the wall, but cannot climb up before more soldiers appear. Rather than fight the entire army, you flee to the edge of the wilderness to rethink your plans.
column2: 胜利属于你！你冲向城墙，却来不及攀爬，更多士兵已蜂拥而至。与其与整支军队交战，你逃至荒野边缘，重新谋划。

column1: Vigorously fight, you break away from the hellish thing. Running hard, you make it into the wilderness. Behind you, you can see the village, a sulfurous light emanating from the evil hilltop. Suddenly the light winks and goes out. The demon has returned to its lurking place.
column2: 拼力厮杀，你挣脱了那地狱般的怪物。奋力奔逃，终于闯入荒野。身后，村庄隐约可见，邪恶的山顶散发着硫磺般的光芒。忽地，光芒一瞬即逝。恶魔已潜回其藏身之处。

column2: 弗丁堡

column2: 序列中的下一个字母是什么？

column2: 序列中的第八个字母是什么？

column1: Wait for someone to come.
column2: 等待有人前来。

column1: Wait patiently for someone to come.
column2: 耐心等候来人。

column1: Waiting until the guards are distracted elsewhere, $ChosenOneName carefully sneaks up to the door and pours $his potion over the hinges and locks. At $his signal, the rest of you run for the door, which suddenly falls over with a crash. You all leap inside, weapons ready.
column2: 待守卫分心他顾之时，$ChosenOneName 巧妙潜至门前，将 你的 药剂倾于门铰与锁上。见 你的 信号，众人奔向大门，刹那间轰然倒地。尔等持械跃入其中。

column1: Walking along the dark streets, you peer down each one, trying to catch a glimpse of a sign in the flickering lamplight. Eventually you turn toward...
column2: 沿着幽暗的街道漫步，你向每一条小巷张望，试图在摇曳的灯光中捕捉到一丝招牌的影子。最终，你转向...

column1: Walking along, you post a few more handbills. Suddenly, a group of thugs steps out from an alley. Their leader rips off a poster you placed, glances at it, and throws it away.
column2: 沿途，你又张贴了几张传单。突然，一伙恶徒从巷子里走出来。为首的撕下你贴的海报，瞥了一眼，便随手扔掉。

column1: Walking softly into the chapel, each in turn steps into the confessional. Transgressions are recited and penances are assigned for $Number1 hours. Carefully you say the prayers of penance. A sense of favor and cleanliness comes over you all.
column2: 轻步走入小教堂，众人依次步入忏悔室。罪过被一一诉说，罚期定为$Number1小时。你虔诚诵念忏悔祷文。众人皆感恩宠与洁净。

column1: Walking toward the common districts, you select a street leading to...
column2: 徒步前往平民区，你选了一条通往……的街道。

column1: Wandering among the streets and alleys of the arms-makers, you finally find...
column2: 徘徊于兵器匠的街巷之间，你终寻得……

column1: Watching carefully, you observe a furtive group of well-armed men approach the building. They try various doors and shutters, then set about picking a lock. You decide to...
column2: 你仔细观察，见一队全副武装的男子鬼鬼祟祟地靠近那座建筑。他们试了试各扇门和百叶窗，随后开始撬锁。你决定……

column1: Water begins pouring into the pit through previously-unseen holes. It is rising rapidly.
column2: 水从先前未见的孔洞中涌入坑内，水位迅速上升。

column1: Waving his arms frantically, he unleashes more magic, then disappears in a blinding cloud of sulphurous smoke. You are horrified. How can a lunatic have such might?
column2: 他疯狂挥舞双臂，施展出更多法术，随即在一片刺目的硫磺烟雾中消失。你惊恐不已。一个疯子怎会有如此神力？

column1: Weapons in hand, you charge up to the house front and crash through the downstairs shutters!
column2: 手持武器，你冲至屋前，撞破楼下百叶窗！

column1: Well, it wouldn't hurt to see who among the opposition has some embarrassing secret. Sometimes just claiming to know about it is enough, other times you need proof.
column2: 倒也不妨看看反对派中谁藏有不堪的秘密。有时仅凭声称知晓便已足够，有时则需确凿证据。

column1: What could he mean? The golden face translates, "Lead said he always lies." The silver face cries, "Do not believe Gold! HE is the liar!" Which face speaks truth? You think, then touch...
column2: 他此言何意？金色面庞译道：“铅说他一向撒谎。”银色面庞哭喊：“勿信金！他是骗子！”究竟哪张面孔说的是真话？你思索片刻，伸手触碰……

column1: What does he mean by mentioning the kobolds? Before you can ask him more, dwarfs pour out of the cave walls. You are under attack!
column2: 他提及地精，意欲何为？尚未及细问，岩壁间涌出矮人，你遭袭击！

column1: What is the answer? The wrong conclusion may release a dwarf trap! You consider carefully, then answer ...
column2: 答案为何？若结论有误，恐触发矮人陷阱！你慎重思量，然后作答……

column1: When $ChosenOneName addresses the crowd, they listen. Soon $he delivers a ringing call for action and the people respond with a roar of approval.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName向众人致辞时，他们洗耳恭听。不久，你振臂疾呼，民众轰然响应。

column1: When $ChosenOneName brings forth the power of the divine realm, a strange peaceful feeling comes over everyone present. The peasants fall to their knees and weep with shame when they realize their wickedness. Some of them implore your forgiveness. You go your way in peace.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName引动神圣之力时，一股奇异的宁静笼罩在场诸人。农夫们跪倒在地，羞愧落泪，方知自身罪孽。有人恳求你的宽恕。你安然离去。

column1: When $ChosenOneName completes $his prayer for truth and honesty in clerics, a strange look comes over the friar's face.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName完成你的祈求教士诚实正直之祷时，修士面上浮现出异样的神情。

column1: When $ChosenOneName finishes $his prayer, a bright light suffuses the entire area. The knight and his troops stagger back, hands covering their eyes.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName结束你的祈祷后，一道明光照彻全场。骑士及其部众踉跄后退，双手遮目。

column1: When $ChosenOneName is actually bending $his neck to the block, a well-dressed cleric comes bustling forward. "His excellency, the abbot, has decreed that these people are not subject to civil law, but fall within the purview of the Holy Church. He orders that they now be released into his care." The bailiff grumbles, but dares not go against the abbot's orders, and you are freed.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName正将你的颈项置于铡刀之下时，一名衣着考究的教士匆匆上前。“尊贵的修道院院长裁定：此等人不受世俗法律管辖，归圣教会统辖。命即刻交予其照管。”执事虽心怀不满，却不敢违抗院长之令，你得以获释。
