"His excellency, the abbot, has decreed that these people are not subject to civil law, but fall within the purview of the holy church. He orders that they now be released into his care." The bailiff grumbles, but dares not go against the abbot's orders, and you are freed.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName正将你的颈项置于铡刀之下时，一名衣着考究的教士匆匆上前。“尊贵的修道院院长裁定：此等人不受世俗法律管辖，归圣教会统辖。命即刻交予其照管。”执事虽心怀不满，却不敢违抗院长之令，你得以获释。

column1: When $ChosenOneName lays down the reliquary on the altar, a white dove flutters down from the top of the cathedral dome and lands upon it. All fall upon their knees and worship.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName将圣物匣安放于祭坛上时，一只白鸽自大教堂穹顶翩然飞下，栖于其上。众人皆俯首膜拜。

column1: When $ChosenOneName loudly invokes the name of Saint Dominic, the friar suddenly begins shaking all over. With a trembling finger, he points to $ChosenOneName, saying, "Oh, blessed Dominic, forgive me for my greed, please!"
column2: 当$ChosenOneName高声呼唤圣多明各之名时，修士猛然全身颤抖。他颤指指向$ChosenOneName，泣曰：“哦，蒙福的多明各啊，请赦我贪婪之罪！”

column1: When $ChosenOneName prays, $he gets an overwhelming sensation of peace and goodness. In $his mind's eye, $he sees an old hermit living here, enjoying a simple life with the small alpine creatures.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName祈祷时，你心中涌起难以言喻的安宁与良善。在你的脑海中，你看见一位老隐士在此安居，与山间小兽共度简朴岁月。

column1: When $ChosenOneName prays, $he gets an overwhelming sensation of peace and goodness. In $his mind's eye, $he sees an old hermit living here, enjoying a simple life with the small woodland creatures.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName祈祷时，你心中涌起难以言喻的安宁与良善。在你的脑海中，你看见一位老隐士在此安居，与林间小兽共度简朴岁月。

column1: When $ChosenOneName pulls out the reliquary of $NamedOneName, the prelate and gathered priests are astounded. As you slowly walk up to the altar, a soft glow gathers around the reliquary. Fluttering wings are heard in the distance, and faint notes of a heavenly choir. When $ChosenOneName lays down the reliquary on the altar, a white dove flutters down from the top of the cathedral dome and lands upon it. All fall upon their knees and worship.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName取出$NamedOneName的圣物匣时，主教与诸司祭无不震惊。你缓步走向祭坛，圣物匣周围渐生柔和光晕。远处传来扑翅之声，隐约可闻天籁合唱。当$ChosenOneName将圣物匣安放于祭坛上时，一只白鸽自大教堂穹顶翩然飞下，栖于其上。众人皆俯首膜拜。

column1: When $ChosenOneName reveals the reliquary of $NamedOneName, the prelate and gathered priests are astounded. As you slowly walk up to the altar, a soft glow gathers around the reliquary. Fluttering wings are heard in the distance, and faint notes of a heavenly choir.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName展示$NamedOneName的圣物匣时，主教与诸司祭无不震惊。你缓步走向祭坛，圣物匣周围渐生柔和光晕。远处传来扑翅之声，隐约可闻天籁合唱。

column1: When $ChosenOneName says the name of $NamedOneName, the Templars suddenly cringe. A haunted look comes over their faces, then terror, and soon they are fleeing.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName念及$NamedOneName之名时，圣殿骑士骤然畏缩。他们脸上先现幽魂般的神色，继而惊恐万状，旋即四散奔逃。

column1: When $ChosenOneName tosses the potion bottle, it explodes with a loud "pop!" and the guards are temporarily blinded. You easily evade their flailing weapons and slip down a side alley.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName掷出药瓶时，只听“砰”然巨响，守卫一时失明。你轻松避开他们乱舞的兵刃，溜入侧巷。

column1: When $ChosenOneName touches the $NamedOneName , there is a trembling in the crypt. Dust cascades from the pillars, and in the distance you hear strange clacks and rattles. You look at each other, wondering how easy it will be to escape these catacombs.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName触碰$NamedOneName时，地下墓室微微震颤。石柱上尘土簌簌而落，远处传来阵阵异响。你相顾愕然，不知能否轻易脱身。

column1: When $ChosenOneName utters a quick prayer, a funny look comes over the nobleman's face.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName低声祈祷时，贵族面上浮现出一丝怪异之色。

column1: When $ChosenOneName utters a quick prayer, an odd look comes over the bishop's face.
column2: 当$ChosenOneName低声祈祷时，主教面上浮现出一抹异样神情。

column1: When $ChosenTwoName finishes the prayer, you all make one more try. Now, suddenly, you manage to get $ChosenOneName out of the muck. You notice $he has lost a few items in the goo. A small price for survival, everyone agrees!
column2: 当$ChosenTwoName祈祷完毕后，你们再试一回。此刻，你们竟奇迹般将$ChosenOneName从泥淖中救出。众人发现你在黏液中遗失了几件物品。为求生存，这点代价算不得什么，大家一致认为！

column1: When $he finishes the prayer, $ChosenOneName has a familiar, uneasy sense about the manor. $He is also convinced that you will discover nothing new or useful here.
column2: 当你祈祷完毕后，$ChosenOneName对庄园隐隐不安。你亦深信，此处难觅新知或有用之物。

column1: When $he finishes the prayer, $ChosenOneName is uneasy about the manor. It is clearly an unholy place, but yet it has none of the evil, horrible feeling of Satan's works.
column2: 当你祈祷完毕后，$ChosenOneName对庄园心存疑虑。此地分明不洁，却并无撒旦之作那般邪恶可怖之感。

column1: When $he finishes, the lord is duly impressed. He applauds the tale and praises you all.
column2: 当你讲毕，领主颇为赞赏。他拍手称好，并褒奖众人。

column1: When $he reaches a ledge just below the top, $ChosenOneName throws down the rope and the rest of you climb up. Then you all climb over the ledge and peer inside.
column2: 当你攀至顶端下方的平台时，$ChosenOneName抛下绳索，其余人依次攀上。随后众人翻过平台，探头窥视内部。

column1: When he hears your names, the nobleman turns quite pale.
column2: 当贵族听到你们的名字时，脸色骤然苍白。

column1: When he sees you, $NamedOneName smiles and nods.
column2: 当他见到你们时，$NamedOneName微笑颔首。

column1: When it gets dark, you sneak over and try to climb a wall. Unfortunately, you clumsily scrape against the stone and are overheard. When you hear the gate open, you drop down off the wall and turn to fight the raubritter's men.
column2: 夜幕降临，你们潜行至墙边，试图攀爬。不幸的是，你不慎擦过石壁，被守卫听见。待门扉开启，你们跃下城墙，转身迎战劫匪。

column1: When the Templars see you free and ready to fight, their spirit breaks. Slowly they back away, then turn and run for their lives.
column2: 当圣殿骑士见你们挣脱束缚、准备战斗时，士气尽丧。他们缓缓后退，继而掉头逃命。

column1: When the Wild Hunt catches scent of the wounded doe, bloodlust overcomes its desire to chase you, and it is off after the hapless deer. Though the deer is soon caught, you have used the time to give yourself a good lead. Before the Hunt can catch up with you, dawn breaks, and it melts away until another evening.
column2: 当狂猎嗅到受伤牝鹿的气息时，嗜血之心盖过追击之意，转而追逐那可怜的鹿。鹿虽很快被捕，但你们已借此拉开距离。狂猎尚未追上，天已破晓，它遂消融于晨光之中，直至夜幕再度降临。

column1: When the dragon arrives, it roars its fury at the lack of the accustomed sacrifice. It circles the villagers, turning many into human bonfires, then leaves.
column2: 当巨龙现身时，它因未能如期献祭而怒吼。它盘旋于村民之上，将多人化作活火，随后离去。

column1: When the dust clears, the enraged innkeeper demands $Money1 for the damages. You reply...
column2: 尘埃落定，愤怒的酒馆老板索要$Money1赔偿损失。你答道……

column1: When the guard looks away, a small bottle sails through the air and fragments on the battlement beside him. As he turns toward the sound, a yellowish-green vapor engulfs him and he slumps down.
column2: 当守卫转眼之际，一小瓶飞越空中，在他身旁的垛口上碎裂。他闻声回首，只见黄绿色烟雾弥漫，随即瘫倒在地。

column1: When the guard's back is turned, $ChosenOneName throws a small pouch which sails over the battlements and lands softly near the guard. He doubles up, choking and coughing. The way is clear...
column2: 当守卫背过身去时，$ChosenOneName投下一小袋，越过垛口，轻落在守卫身旁。他弯腰捂喉，咳嗽不止。道路畅通……

column1: When the hounds are done, he departs on the wind.
column2: 当猎犬搜寻完毕，它们随风而去。

column1: When the night watch sees your naked steel, they gasp, drop their lanterns and flee in all directions.
column2: 当夜巡者瞥见你们裸露的刀锋时，惊呼一声，丢下灯笼，四散奔逃。

column1: When the potion explodes, the night watch cries out in surprise. Unfortunately, as you turn to escape, $ChosenOneName stumbles and falls. By the time $he gets up, the watch has recovered and is running toward you.
column2: 当药剂爆炸时，夜巡者惊叫连连。不幸的是，当你转身逃离时，$ChosenOneName不慎跌倒。待你起身，巡者已回过神来，朝你逼近。

column1: When the prayer is done, the Hussite leader rises and says, "Beautiful, beautiful. Only a true brother in the Church could pray like that. Pass in peace."
column2: 当祈祷完毕后，胡斯派领袖站起，说道：“美妙，美妙。唯有教会中的真兄弟方能如此祈祷。请平安离去。”

column1: When the two guards walk down the hall, you sneak out of your room. If a guard sees you now, it is open conflict.
column2: 当两名守卫沿走廊下行时，你悄然离开房间。若此时被守卫发现，必成正面冲突。

column1: When they are just out of earshot, he leans over and says, quietly, "You realize, of course, that I'm planning to have you all killed."
column2: 待二人远去，他俯身低语：“你当然明白，我正谋划将你们尽数除之。”

column1: When they reach the fork in the trail the hounds hesitate momentarily, then start up again, now after you. $ChosenOneName uses expert woodcraft to confound your pursuers. Before the hounds can reach you, it is morning, and the Hunt departs.
column2: 当猎犬行至岔路，略作迟疑，随即重新追踪，目标仍是你们。$ChosenOneName凭借精湛的林间技艺，使追兵迷失方向。猎犬尚未追及，天已破晓，狂猎散去。

column1: When you $Text1 , there is a terrible crash of thunder. A lightning bolt blasts a smoking hole in the ground nearby.
column2: 当你$Text1时，雷鸣震天。一道闪电在附近地面炸出一个冒烟的窟窿。

column1: When you $Text1 , there is a terrible crash of thunder. A lightning bolt blasts a smoking hole nearby.
column2: 当你$Text1时，雷鸣震天。一道闪电在附近炸出一个冒烟的窟窿。

column1: When you $Text1 , there is a terrible crash of thunder. A lightning bolt explodes a small pine tree just outside the stone circle.
column2: 当你$Text1时，雷鸣震天。一道闪电炸毁了石圈外的一棵小松树。

column1: When you $Text1 , there is a terrible crash of thunder. Lightning bolts flash and the thunder becomes continuous. You flee.
column2: 当你$Text1时，雷鸣震天。闪电接连划破长空，雷声不绝于耳。你们仓皇逃离。

column1: When you are assured he is no longer at death's door, you continue on.
column2: 当你确信他已脱离生命危险时，便继续前行。

column1: When you arrive at the Hanseatic League's offices, your friend leaves you, his job done. His master, $NamedOneName, thanks you personally. "You have greatly assisted the League with the downfall of $NamedTwoName. All of our cities shall know of this." He hands you a purse of money.
column2: 抵达汉萨同盟办事处时，你的友人功成身退，悄然离去。其主 $NamedOneName 亲自向你致谢：“汝助同盟铲除 $NamedTwoName，厥功甚伟。吾等诸城皆当知之。”随即将一囊银钱交予汝。

column1: When you ask about this, many people are perplexed. $NamedTwoName is neither a rich burgher nor influential guildsman. All you can discover is that his family has long felt wronged by the $CityLordTitle, ruler of $PlaceName.
column2: 询及此事，众人皆感困惑。$NamedTwoName 既非富商，亦非显赫公会领袖。所知仅限于其家族久受 $CityLordTitle——$PlaceName 之主——之冤屈。

column1: When you ask the priest about Holy Communion, he says, "We hold Mass every morning at Prime and on Sunday, at Prime and Vespers. We would be honored to have you present at that time."
column2: 问及圣餐礼，司祭答曰：“吾等每日晨祷及周日晨祷、晚祷均举行弥撒。若蒙莅临，幸甚。”

column1: When you awaken, it is in a dank dungeon cell. Your companions are morose over their defeat, and over the loss of most of their possessions.
column2: 醒来时，置身阴湿的地牢囚室。同伴因败北及财物尽失而郁郁寡欢。

column1: When you awaken, it is midnight. You are tied up, and a bonfire rages before you. The demon is gone, but the demon-worshipping villagers have you as their captives.
column2: 醒来时，已是子夜。汝被缚，眼前篝火熊熊。恶魔已去，崇拜恶魔的村民却将汝等俘为囚徒。

column1: When you awaken, it is morning. You must have been unconscious throughout the night!
column2: 醒来时，天已破晓。汝必整夜昏迷无疑！

column1: When you awaken, the demon is gone. You are tied up, prisoners of the devil-worshipping villagers. It is midnight and they have prepared a great bonfire -- for you!
column2: 醒来时，恶魔已遁。汝等被缚，沦为崇拜恶魔之村民的阶下囚。时值子夜，村民已备大火——专为汝等而设！

column1: When you awaken, you all lie bleeding in a briar thicket. Arms, armor, valuables -- all are gone. The bishop's men were quite thorough.
column2: 醒来时，汝等血流满地，伏于荆棘丛中。兵甲、辎重、珍宝——悉数无存。主教麾下之人搜掠极尽。

column1: When you awaken, you are bound and before a blazing fire. Around you witches dance with delight, uttering inhuman cries to a blazing wicker statue of a dragon, now subsiding into the flames.
column2: 醒来时，汝被缚，立于烈焰之前。四周女巫狂舞，发出非人之嚎，围绕一座燃烧的龙形木雕起舞，那木雕渐入火海。

column1: When you awaken, you find yourselves bereft of arms, armor, and most obvious valuables.
column2: 醒来时，汝等兵甲、辎重及显贵之物尽失。

column1: When you awaken, you lie bleeding in a briar thicket. Arms, armor, valuables, all are gone. The guards were quite thorough.
column2: 醒来时，汝等血染荆棘丛。兵甲、辎重、珍宝，一无所存。守卫搜查极为彻底。

column1: When you climb out of the pit, the dwarf, panicked by your escape, runs off down the hall screaming and soon is lost to view.
column2: 当汝自坑中攀出时，矮人见汝逃脱，惊惶奔逃，沿廊道疾呼而去，转瞬不见踪影。

column1: When you compare notes, you learn that she said exactly the same thing to each of you. "Learn of $Text1. This will protect you from the Wild Hunt."
column2: 对照彼此所述，汝方知彼女对汝等皆言如是：“习得 $Text1，便可免于野猎之害。”

column1: When you deliver your challenge, a voice calls forth, "I obey no requests of such slaves as you. Begone!" Suddenly the gate opens, and soldiers charge out.
column2: 当汝提出挑战时，忽闻一声喝道：“尔等奴隶之求，吾岂奉命？速退！”旋即城门洞开，士兵蜂拥而出。

column1: When you disappear into the brush, the alchemist orders his guards to return, pack his tent and move on. He is probably worried that you may call out the local lord against him.
column2: 当汝隐入林间时，炼金术士命卫士收营，卷帐而行。盖恐汝召地方领主讨伐也。

column1: When you hand over the potions, $NamedOneName gets gradually more and more excited until he is dancing a little jig. When you are through handing over the potions, he exults,
column2: 当汝交付药剂时，$NamedOneName 越发兴奋，几至手舞足蹈。药剂尽数交毕，他欣喜若狂，

column1: When you invoke $Text1, the pursuing hounds suddenly burst like bubbles, while the Hunter struggles forward against a magic wind. Finally the Hunter can come no further and stops.
column2: 当汝念诵 $Text1 时，追击之犬骤然消散如泡，而猎手则逆魔风奋力前行。终至力竭，再难寸进。

column1: When you leap from the undergrowth to attack the hounds, you get a good look at their intended prey. She is a woman, but no human! Silky fur covers her naked body except for her face, hands, feet, and breasts. She is a holzfrau, a wild woman. These forest creatures are rarely seen. As the hounds turn to attack you, she smiles shyly and flits into the forest, safe at last. You suspect you may see her again, if you survive.
column2: 当汝自灌木跃出，欲攻群犬时，得以细观其猎物。乃一女子，然非人类！其裸身覆以柔滑之毛，唯面、手、足及双乳未蔽。此乃林中女妖，罕得一见。犬群转而扑汝，她却羞然一笑，翩然遁入林中，终得脱险。汝心疑若能存活，或可再逢其踪。

column1: When you leap out of the trees to fight the hounds, their prey dashes behind you for protection. When you look at him, you get a shock.
column2: 当汝自树上跃下，与犬群搏斗时，其猎物急趋汝后，以求庇护。汝一瞥之下，不禁愕然。

column1: When you raise your hands in surrender, the guards are both pleased and puzzled. One asks the sergeant, "Should we kill them?"
column2: 当汝举手投降时，守卫既喜且惑。一人问军曹：“当杀之乎？”

column1: When you recover your shattered wits, you realize that staying here will be extremely dangerous. Someone is sure to investigate soon.
column2: 当汝神志稍复时，方觉留此危殆万分。不久必有人前来查究。

column1: When you start across the bridge, you take but a step before a grotesque demon appears in a puff of stinking smoke. "Welcome!" it shrieks. "Twenty years I have waited. Brace yourself, my morsel. This is going to hurt, and keep on hurting for a long, long time!"
column2: 当汝踏上桥头，甫行一步，便有狰狞恶魔自恶臭烟雾中现身。“欢迎！”其厉声尖叫，“吾等二十年矣。备好罢，吾之食粮。此痛绵绵，永无止息！”

column1: When you step into the hamlet, you see that it has been abandoned. High atop a nearby hill, you see the remnants of some sort of pagan or diabolic worship site. You recognize the place as a spot that you yourselves have cleansed from satanic practices. Those inhabitants that were innocent have emigrated to cleanlier surroundings. Those inhabitants that were guilty have either been killed or fled the area.
column2: 当汝步入村落时，但见其已荒废。近旁高丘之上，残存某种异教或邪教祭祀遗迹。汝认得此地，正是汝等曾清除邪祟之所。无辜之民已迁往清净之地，有罪者或死或逃。

column1: When you step into the hamlet, you see that it has been abandoned. High atop a nearby hill, you see the remnants of some sort of pagan or diabolic worship site. You recognize the place as a spot that you yourselves have cleansed of satanic practices. Those inhabitants that were innocent have long since emigrated to cleaner surroundings. Those inhabitants that were guilty have either been killed or fled the area.
column2: 当汝步入村落时，但见其已荒废。近旁高丘之上，残存某种异教或邪教祭祀遗迹。汝认得此地，正是汝等曾清除邪祟之所。无辜之民早已迁居净地，有罪者或死或逃。

column1: When you surrender to the monsters from Hell, you feel icy fingers grab at your hearts. You know you have disappointed all that is virtuous, but what else was possible? The monsters take your goods and gear, then leave.
column2: 当汝向地狱之兽投降时，只觉寒冰之指攫汝心魂。汝知已负善道，然别无他途。兽取汝之财货，随即离去。

column1: When you surrender, the soldiers take your weapons and valuables. A panting officer runs up. "Take these spies to the dungeon." he says. "They may be questioned later." You are led off by a knot of men-at-arms.
column2: 当汝投降时，士兵夺汝兵甲、珍宝。喘息军官疾步而来：“将此等间谍押入地牢。日后或可审讯。”汝遂被一众甲士押走。

column1: When you turn about and gallop off, the Bishop yells, "Guard, after them!" In seconds, the troopers' warhorses are thundering after you. Soon they are gaining on you. Unable to escape, your only choices are...
column2: 当汝回身策马疾驰时，主教大喝：“卫士，追之！”顷刻间，骑兵战马轰鸣追击。不久即迫近汝身。无路可逃，唯有……

column1: When you turn about and gallop off, the Bishop yells, "Guard, after them!" In seconds, the troopers' warhorses are thundering after you. You lead them a merry chase across the countryside, until their tiring horses finally fall behind.
column2: 当汝回身策马疾驰时，主教大喝：“卫士，追之！”顷刻间，骑兵战马轰鸣追击。汝率众驰骋乡野，直至其战马疲乏，终落于后。

column1: When you turn about and gallop off, the knight and some men pursue. You lead them a merry chase across the countryside, until their tiring horses finally fall behind.
column2: 当汝回身策马疾驰时，骑士率众追击。汝率众驰骋乡野，直至其战马疲乏，终落于后。

column1: When you turn about and gallop off, the nobleman yells, "Pursue them!" In seconds, they thunder after you. Soon they are gaining. Unable to escape, your only choices are...
column2: 当汝回身策马疾驰时，贵族大喝：“追之！”顷刻间，骑兵轰鸣追击。不久即迫近汝身。无路可逃，唯有……

column1: When you unexpectedly step out of the brush, the raubritter's men reach for their weapons. You quickly bark out an order.
column2: 当汝猝然自林间现身时，劫匪手下纷纷拔剑。汝迅即厉声下令。

column1: When you unveil the reliquary, he almost drools with delight. When you open it, he begins praying immediately. When you give it to him, the mere touch of it almost causes him to faint.
column2: 当汝揭开圣器匣时，他几乎垂涎三尺。开封之际，即刻祈祷。交付之时，仅触其边，几至晕厥。

column1: When you vanquish the unclean spirit, the altar suddenly breaks in two with a thunderous crack. The demon is gone and this place of evil has been cleansed of its unholy taint.
column2: 当汝驱逐邪灵时，祭坛骤然裂为两半，震响如雷。恶魔已去，此邪恶之地终得涤净。

column1: Which face opens the door? You cogitate, then press...
column2: 哪扇门开启？汝沉思片刻，然后按下……

column1: Which is Gymer? A false choice may release a trap! You think carefully, then press ...
column2: 谁是吉默？误选或触发机关！汝慎思熟虑，然后按下……

column1: Which is Krocht? The order of names and fathers is clearly irrelevant. You touch...
column2: 谁是克罗赫特？姓名与父名之序无关紧要。汝轻触……

column1: Which is the correct choice? A mistake could release a trap! You think carefully, then touch...
column2: 正确之选为何？误触或触发机关！汝慎思熟虑，然后轻触……

column1: Which statue should you push? A mistake could release a trap! You think carefully, then press ...
column2: 应推何雕像？误推或触发机关！汝慎思熟虑，然后按下……

column1: While $ChosenOneName 's expertise is not in question, try as you might, you can find no convenient forest animals to sacrifice to the Wild Hunt's blood lust. In the midst of your searching, the Hunt comes upon you, and you must fight.
column2: 尽管 $ChosenOneName 技艺无虞，然无论汝如何寻觅，终难觅适宜之林中生灵，以餍野猎之血欲。正苦寻之际，猎队突至，汝只得迎战。

column1: While here, you decide to...
column2: 在此期间，汝决定……

column1: While hiding in a closet, you listen to two women walking down the hall.
column2: 藏身壁橱时，汝听闻两名女子自走廊走过。

column1: While pondering this misfortune, you realize you've retraced your steps...
column2: 思量此厄运时，汝方觉已重回旧径……

column1: While praying, you feel a sense of calm happiness return to your soul.
column2: 祈祷之际，汝心渐归宁静安乐。

column1: While running along at top speed, $ChosenOneName tries to pull out an alchemical vial. He fumbles and drops it onto the street, where it bounces without breaking and rolls under a wagon. You have no time to retrieve it -- the guards are much too close. Cursing, you run onward.
column2: 全速奔跑时，$ChosenOneName 试图取出一瓶炼金药剂。不慎失手，跌落街头，弹跳而不碎，滚入车底。汝无暇拾取——守卫已近在咫尺。咒骂之余，汝继续奔逃。

column1: While sneaking towards the city's wall, $ChosenOneName slips and a muffled oath escapes $his lips. Luck is not with you -- a patrol is nearby and hears you. "Spies near the wall!" cries a sergeant, "Stop them!" The soldiers fan out and come toward you at a dead run.
column2: 悄悄逼近城墙时，$ChosenOneName 失足，你的 嘴角低吟一声。运气不佳——巡逻队近在耳畔，闻声而动。“墙边有间谍！”军曹高呼，“拦住他们！”士兵四散奔袭而来。

column1: While they wait for the meal, the witches converse among themselves. Listening carefully, you strain to hear any sort of useful information.
column2: 待餐之际，女巫低声交谈。汝侧耳倾听，冀获有用信息。

column1: While traveling through the wilderness, you spot some armed men ahead of you. Using $his woodcraft, $ChosenOneName quietly gets everyone under cover and concealed.
column2: 野外行进时，汝见前方有武装之人。借助 你的 之林中技艺，$ChosenOneName 迅速使众人隐蔽藏身。

column1: While traveling, you are stopped by armed men with weapons drawn.
column2: 行旅途中，汝遭持械之徒拦阻。

column1: While trying to sneak out past the guards, $ChosenOneName gets angry when an urchin tries to pick $his pocket, and forgets $himself so far as to shout. Instantly, the guards' attention is drawn toward your party.
column2: 趁守卫不备偷溜出去时，一个顽童试图扒 $ChosenOneName 的口袋，$he 怒不可遏，竟忘了形迹大喊出声。守卫的注意力立刻被引向你们一行。

column1: While waiting, you discuss the necessarity of staying at the $Inn, and from there selecting which activities each of you will do each day.
column2: 等待之时，你商议着留在$Inn的必要性，并由此决定每日各自所行之事。

column1: While wandering through the destroyed land, you meet a handsomely equipped knight leading a troop of soldiers. "Hold!" he cries. "What be your purpose?"
column2: 徜徉于废墟之中，你遇一骑士，甲胄鲜明，率众兵而行。“且慢！”他喝道，“汝意欲何为？”

column1: While you dispatch the guardsmen before you, the mercenaries engage the rest, and the crowd streams forward, down the street toward the $VarString1.
column2: 你击溃眼前的卫兵，雇佣兵则与其余敌人交战，人群沿着街道向前涌动，直奔$VarString1。

column1: Whirling through the air, the tiny bottle smashes open and a flare of light, brighter than the Sun, blinds the guards and passers-by. Quickly you dash through the confusion and out the gate. Soon you're far away from press of the city.
column2: 小瓶在空中旋转，骤然碎裂，一道比太阳更耀眼的光芒刺得守卫与路人目不能视。你趁乱疾步穿过混乱，冲出城门。不久，你已远离城市的喧嚣。

column1: Whispering $his prayer, $ChosenOneName is surprised to see the Templars suddenly transformed into bone-white demons, marked with a cross of fresh blood. They seem to leap and caper about the Franciscan, who appears to have a halo around his head.
column2: 低声念诵着你的祷文，$ChosenOneName惊讶地看到圣殿骑士们突然化作骨白的恶魔，额上烙着一道鲜红的十字。他们似乎在方济各会修士周围跳跃嬉戏，而那修士的头顶仿佛笼罩着一圈光环。

column1: Whispering to the nearest cultist, you promise her $Money1 (all of your money) if she will help you escape. She thinks about it, her little eyes glinting greedily, then nods rapidly. When the dance carries the body of cultists away from you, she pulls out a small knife, crouches behind you, and saws away at your bonds. When she finishes, you hand over all the cash you have, then grab your weapons, stacked neatly nearby.
column2: 你低声对身旁的祭司许诺，若她助你脱身，便赠予她 $Money1（你所有的钱财）。她思忖片刻，小眼中闪过贪婪之光，随即连连点头。当舞步将众祭司引离你时，她抽出一把匕首，伏身于你身后，奋力割断你的绳索。待她完工，你将所有现金交付于她，随即拾起一旁整齐堆放的武器。

column1: Whispering, the visitor says, "Remember me, perhaps we will meet at $SabbatLocation , $Direction2 of $NearestCity ," then departs. The choice of place is very strange, and probably important. $ChosenOneName sleeps with peaceful dreams and a sense of rightness in $his soul.
column2: 来访者低声说道：“记住我，或许我们会在 $SabbatLocation、$NearestCity $Direction2 相见。”随后离去。地点的选择十分古怪，且可能意义重大。$ChosenOneName 带着安宁的梦境与心中的正念入睡。

column1: Whistling the $NamedOneName around $his head, $ChosenOneName demonstrates great skill and expertise with this weapon. In practice combat, $he readily defeats two of the lord's guards.
column2: 吹着口哨，将$NamedOneName绕着你的头挥舞，$ChosenOneName展示了对此武器的高超技艺与精湛造诣。在实战中，你轻松击败了领主的两名侍卫。

column1: Whoosh! A slab of stone pivots under your feet and you slide down into a pit! You are left below, to await whatever hideous doom the dwarfs devise. Will they bake you to death? Dissolve you in quicklime? Drop deadly adders into the pit?
column2: 咆哮！脚下石板一转，你滑入深坑之中！你被留在坑底，等待矮人们设下的种种恐怖厄运。他们会把你烤死吗？用生石灰把你溶化？还是往坑里投下致命的毒蛇？

column1: Wincing at the creature's doggerel, you think over what he has said, and reply that you plan to ...
column2: 听着那生物的打油诗，你思索着他的话，答道你打算……

column1: Wincing at the creature's doggerel, you think over what he has said, and reply that you plan to...
column2: 听着那生物的打油诗，你思索着他的话，答道你打算……

column1: Winded but still moving, you flee the cave and sneak away through the wilderness. You carefully confuse your trail by travelling on rocks and through streams, then finally hide in a thicket of dense brush where you spend the night.
column2: 气喘吁吁却仍不停步，你逃离洞穴，悄然穿过荒野。你小心翼翼地在岩石与溪流间行走，混淆踪迹，最终藏身于一片茂密的灌木丛中，度过一夜。

column1: Wisely, you decide your business must wait until dawn.
column2: 智者自知，须待黎明方行其事。

column1: Wismar.
column2: 维斯马。

column1: With $Money1, bribe a guard to let you inside.
column2: 用 $Money1 贿赂一名守卫，让他放你进去。

column1: With a commanding bellow, $ChosenOneName shouts, "What's going on here!" $He succeeds in convincing the soldiers you are actually on their side, and gets directions to the main camp. $He leads you off in that direction until the soldiers are out of sight. Then you return to your original course!
column2: 随着一声威严的怒吼，$ChosenOneName 喝道：“这里发生了何事！” 你 成功说服士兵们你确为己方，并问得通往主营的方向。你 引你朝此方向行去，直至士兵身影尽没。随后，你们便重回原路！

column1: With a crash $ChosenOneName stumbles over a small table in the hallway. As doors open and shouting begins, you dash into a storeroom and bar the door.
column2: 伴随着一声巨响，$ChosenOneName 在走廊里绊倒了一张小桌。随着房门打开、喊声四起，你飞奔进储藏室并闩上了门。

column1: With a crash and a curse, $ChosenOneName stumbles while trying to sneak up to the fortress gate. The potion slips from $his hand and spills across the ground.
column2: 伴随着一声巨响与咒骂，$ChosenOneName 在试图潜近要塞大门时失足跌倒。药剂从 你的 手中滑落，洒满地面。

column1: With a cry of triumph, $ChosenOneName hurls $his vial to the ground. The thugs back away as a large cloud of smoke erupts between them and you. You take this opportunity to quietly slip around the corner, before they realize the cloud contains nothing more dangerous than sulphrous fumes!
column2: 随着一声胜利的呼喊，$ChosenOneName 将 你的 瓶掷于地上。暴徒们退后，只见一团浓烟在你与他们之间腾起。趁此机会，你在他们察觉到这团烟雾不过只是硫磺气息之前，悄然绕过拐角！

column1: With a flash, the ghost vanishes, off to Heaven or Hell. You have freed the bonds that tied it to Earth.
column2: 一道闪光闪过，幽灵消逝，或升天堂，或堕地狱。你已解脱其束缚，使其脱离尘世。

column1: With a great bellow, $ChosenOneName shouts "What's going on here?" Then, in a virtuoso display of commanding presence, $he succeeds in completely intimidating the bandit-soldiers, until they feel lucky to be allowed to leave before you consign them to some unimaginably horrible fate.
column2: 随着一声巨吼，$ChosenOneName高喊道：“这里发生了何事？”随后，你以无与伦比的威严震慑全场，令那些匪兵无不胆战心惊，只求能侥幸离去，以免遭受你施加的难以想象之酷刑。

column1: With a great bellow, $ChosenOneName shouts, "What's going on here?" Then, in a virtuoso display of commanding presence, $he succeeds in completely intimidating the bandit-soldiers until they feel lucky to be allowed to leave before you consign them to some unimaginably horrible fate.
column2: 随着一声巨吼，$ChosenOneName 喝道：“这里发生了何事？”随即，你 以无与伦比的威严震慑群贼，令其惶恐不已，只求能侥幸离去，免遭你施加那难以想象之酷刑。

column1: With a jovial cry, $ChosenOneName says, "Ah, brother! It is good you have come. We are having trouble summoning this demon; perhaps you can help."
column2: 伴随着一声欢快的呼喊，$ChosenOneName说道：“啊，兄弟！你来得正好。我们正为召唤这只恶魔而烦恼；或许你能帮上忙。”

column1: With a little extra effort, you convince her to give you some of the love letters she has received, which she just happens to have with her!
column2: 稍加努力，你便说服她将随身携带的情书交予你！

column1: With a little extra effort, you convince her to give you some of the love letters she has received.
column2: 稍加努力，你便说服她将收到的情书交予你。

column1: With a little extra effort, you convince her to go inside and get some of the love letters she has received from him, and give them to you.
column2: 稍加努力，你便说服她入内，取来他寄给她的几封情书，交予你。

column1: With a loud "bang" a cloud of pungent black smoke fills the gate area. People flee screaming as the guards flail blindly in the fog. You slip past the groping guards and move quickly into the city. Behind you hear cries of "To Arms! Wizard Attack!".
column2: 随着一声巨响，一股刺鼻的黑烟弥漫于城门区域。人们惊叫着四散奔逃，卫兵在浓雾中盲目挥舞。你趁机从摸索的卫兵身旁溜过，迅速进入城内。身后传来“备战！巫师来袭！”的呼喊声。

column1: With a loud "bang" a cloud of pungent black smoke fills the gate area. People flee screaming as the guards flail blindly in the fog. You slip past the groping guards and move quickly into the city. Behind you, you hear cries of "To arms! Wizard attack!"
column2: 随着一声巨响，一股刺鼻的黑烟弥漫于城门区域。人们惊叫着四散奔逃，守卫在浓雾中盲目挥舞。你趁机从摸索的守卫身旁溜过，迅速进入城内。身后传来“备战！巫师来袭！”的呼喊声。

column1: With a loud "pop" your alchemical apparatus crumbles, spilling noxious sludge across the floor. As you choke and gag, the sludge begins dripping through the floorboards and tainting all of your equipment.
column2: 随着一声巨响，你的炼金器具崩塌，恶臭的污泥倾泻一地。你咳嗽不止，污泥开始渗过地板，污染了你所有的装备。

column1: With a loud cheer, everyone else stands up and shouts their agreement. Finally, your leader rises.
column2: 众人齐声欢呼，纷纷起立表示赞同。终于，你的领袖站了起来。

column1: With a loud command $NamedOneName has the mercenaries get into ranks. They begin marching toward $VarString1, and the crowd follows them.
column2: 随着一声洪亮的号令，$NamedOneName让雇佣兵们列队整齐。他们开始向$VarString1进发，人群也随之跟上。

column1: With a loud pop, the street becomes far brighter than normal daylight. Amid cries and exclamations you try to slip in a side door. Unfortunately, a party of apprentices is coming out through the same door. In a comic collision, everybody ends up in a heap. By the time you get up, the door is closed again.
column2: 随着一声巨响，街道变得比寻常日光还要明亮。在一片惊呼与叫喊声中，你试图溜进一扇侧门。不幸的是，一群学徒正从同一扇门出来。一场滑稽的碰撞后，众人狼狈地堆作一团。等你爬起来时，那扇门已经再次关上了。

column1: With a loud pop, the street becomes far brighter than normal daylight. Amid cries of astonishment you try to slip in a side door. Unfortunately, a party of apprentices is coming out through the same door. In a comic collision, everybody ends up in a heap. By the time you get up, the door is closed again.
column2: 随着一声巨响，街道变得比寻常日光还要明亮。惊呼声中，你试图溜进一扇侧门。不幸的是，一群学徒正从同一扇门出来。在一场滑稽的碰撞后，众人狼狈地堆作一团。等你爬起来时，那扇门已经再次关上了。

column1: With a loud pop, the street becomes far brighter than normal daylight. Amid cries of astonishment, you try to slip in a side door. Unfortunately, a party of apprentices is coming out through the same door. In a comic collision, everybody ends up in a heap. By the time you get up, the door is closed again.
column2: 伴随着一声巨响，街道变得比寻常日光还要明亮。惊呼声中，你试图溜进一扇侧门。不幸的是，一群学徒正从同一扇门出来。在一场滑稽的碰撞后，众人狼狈地堆作一团。等你爬起来时，那扇门已再次关上。

column1: With a loud pop, the street becomes far brighter than normal daylight. Amid exclamations of surprise, you try to slip in a side door. Unfortunately, a party of apprentices is coming out through the same door. In a comic collision, everybody ends up in a heap. By the time you get up, the door is closed again.
column2: 伴随着一声巨响，街道变得比寻常日光还要明亮。在一片惊呼声中，你试图溜进一扇侧门。不幸的是，一群学徒正从同一扇门出来。一场滑稽的碰撞后，众人狼狈地堆作一团。等你爬起来时，那扇门已经再次关上了。

column1: With a loud pop, the street becomes far brighter than normal daylight. Amid the outcry, you try to slip in a side door. Unfortunately, a party of apprentices is coming out through the same door. In a comic collision, everybody ends up in a heap. By the time you get up, the door is closed again.
column2: 伴随着一声巨响，街道变得比寻常日光还要明亮。在一片喧哗声中，你试图溜进一扇侧门。不幸的是，一群学徒正从同一扇门出来。一场滑稽的碰撞后，众人狼狈地堆成一团。等你爬起来时，那扇门已经再次关上了。

column1: With a mighty heave, $ChosenOneName pulls a loose bar aside. You crawl through the narrow culvert under the wall, barely keeping your head above the awful liquid.
column2: 一声猛力，$ChosenOneName 将一根松动的横梁拨到一旁。你匍匐穿过城墙下的狭窄暗渠，勉强让头顶高出那令人作呕的液体。

column1: With a mighty heave, $ChosenOneName snaps the bonds that hold you. Before the amazed Templars can react, you grab your weapons and flee. The evil Templars give only a short chase, then return to their original business with the unfortunate friar.
column2: 一声巨吼，$ChosenOneName挣断了束缚你的锁链。惊愕的圣殿骑士尚未反应过来，你已拾起武器，拔腿而逃。邪恶的圣殿骑士只追了一阵，便返回去继续他们对那位不幸修士的勾当。

column1: With a mighty roar, your alchemical works blow up in a ball of fire, igniting the roof of the inn. In frantic haste you all escape the inferno, but in minutes a stiff breeze has carried the flames to surrounding buildings. You watch in horror as the village burns to the ground.
column2: 随着一声巨响，你的炼金术作品在火球中炸裂，点燃了旅店的屋顶。你们慌忙逃离火海，但转瞬之间，凛冽的风已将火焰吹向四周的房屋。你惊恐地目睹村庄化为灰烬。

column1: With a mighty throw, $ChosenTwoName hurls the vial into the middle of the crowd. The effect is instant: people flee in all directions. In the confusion, you force your way through the mob.
column2: 一声猛掷，$ChosenTwoName 将药瓶抛入人群中央。效果立竿见影：众人四散奔逃。趁乱之际，你奋力挤过人群。

column1: With a muffled whimper, $ChosenOneName loses $his grip and falls from the wall.
column2: 随着一声闷哼，$ChosenOneName失去了你的抓握，从墙上坠落。

column1: With a peal of thunder, an immense stroke of lightning hits the earth between you and the onrushing monsters. They reel back in dismay while you complete your escape.
column2: 随着一声雷鸣，一道巨大的闪电击中了你与汹涌而来的怪物之间的大地。它们惊慌失措地退后，而你则完成了逃脱。

column1: With a quick motion, $ChosenOneName flings the powder into the thugs' faces. They scream in pain and claw at their eyes; you dash away down the side streets.
column2: 以迅捷之势，$ChosenOneName 将粉末扬向歹徒的面庞。他们痛呼着，双手乱抓双眼；你则沿着侧街疾奔而去。

column1: With a quickness you can hardly believe, the knight and his men draw weapons. You must make a split-second choice to...
column2: 你几乎难以置信地迅速，骑士及其部下拔出了武器。你必须在电光火石之间做出抉择……

column1: With a quickness you could hardly believe possible, the bishop's guard draws weapons. You must make a split-second choice to...
column2: 以你几乎难以置信的迅捷，主教的卫兵拔出了武器。你必须在电光火石之间做出抉择……

column1: With a remarkable display of stealth, $ChosenOneName creeps up to the sally door set in the main gate. $He gets out a narrow-necked pot and, using a glass tube, pours various amounts of its contents onto the door hinges, locks and bars. There is a quiet hissing, then a soft thump as $ChosenOneName lowers the unattached door to the ground. You all softly slink through the open doorway into the city.
column2: 以非凡的潜行之术，$ChosenOneName 悄然潜至主城门上的小门旁。你 取出一只细颈瓶，用玻璃管将瓶中物依量滴于门铰、锁与门闩之上。只听细微的嘶嘶声，继而轻轻一响，$ChosenOneName 将那扇未固之门缓缓放落于地。尔等皆悄然穿入门隙，潜入城中。

column1: With a ringing bellow, $ChosenOneName shouts, "What's going on here?" Then, in a virtuoso display of commanding presence, $he succeeds in completely intimidating the bandits, until they feel lucky to be allowed to leave before you consign them to some unimaginably horrible fate.
column2: 随着一声震耳欲聋的吼叫，$ChosenOneName 喝道：“这里发生了什么事？”随后，你 以高超的威严震慑住了匪徒，使他们庆幸自己还能活着离开，免于遭受难以想象的可怕命运。

column1: With a roar, the guards draw weapons and rush forward.
column2: 一声怒吼，卫兵拔剑冲来。

column1: With a shattering crack, the box splits open. Inside you find five objects, each carefully wrapped in salamander wool. There is a golden ring, a silver dagger, a copper orb (much like those held by kings), an iron scepter, and a lead crown. Hmm. Could these be the crown jewels of $NamedOneName?
column2: 随着一声震裂的巨响，箱子应声而开。箱内有五件物品，每一件都用火蜥蜴羊毛精心包裹。有一枚金戒指、一把银匕首、一个铜球（颇似国王所持之物）、一根铁权杖和一顶铅制王冠。嗯。这些莫非是$NamedOneName的王室珠宝？

column1: With a single blow, you end the life of this dreadful man. A darkness lifts from your soul as he dies.
column2: 一击之下，你终结了此等恶人的性命。他一死，你心头的阴霾尽散。

column1: With a swift stroke, $ChosenOneName diverts the bear.  The battle is joined.
column2: 一挥而就，$ChosenOneName 引开熊群。战斗已然打响。

column1: With a tremendous roar, fragments of the door explode into the hallway. You jump through the choking smoke into the room and search frantically. $ChosenOneName quickly spots the $NamedOneName and you race out of the building and down a side street. The guard shouts in alarm and pursues.
column2: 伴随着一声巨响，门的碎片四散飞入走廊。你跃过呛人的浓烟冲进房间，焦急地四处搜寻。$ChosenOneName迅速发现了$NamedOneName，你们飞奔出大楼，拐上一条小巷。守卫惊呼着追了上来。

column1: With a tremendous roar, fragments of the door explode into the hallway. You jump through the choking smoke into the room and search frantically. $ChosenOneName quickly spots the $NamedOneName, but before you can escape, you hear the sound of guardsmen running toward you.
column2: 随着一声巨响，门的碎片炸入走廊。你跃过呛人的浓烟冲进房间，疯狂地搜寻。$ChosenOneName很快发现了$NamedOneName，但还没来得及逃脱，便听见卫兵奔来的脚步声。

column1: With a tremendous roar, fragments of the door explode into the hallway. You jump through the choking smoke into the room and search frantically. Unfortunately, before you find anything interesting, you hear the pounding feet of guardsmen approaching. You must give up the search and draw your weapons!
column2: 随着一声巨响，门的碎片四散飞入走廊。你冲过浓烟闯入房间，疯狂地搜寻。不幸的是，在你找到任何有价值的东西之前，便听见卫兵的脚步声逼近。你不得不放弃搜索，拔出武器！

column1: With a tremendous roar, fragments of the door explode into the hallway. You jump through the choking smoke into the room and search frantically. Unfortunately, there is nothing but smoldering papers and torn-apart ledgers in the rubble. Frustrated, you quickly race out a side entrance as the guard shouts in alarm and runs after you.
column2: 伴随着一声巨响，门的碎片炸裂飞溅至走廊。你跃入弥漫的浓烟中，疯狂地搜寻着。遗憾的是，废墟中只有仍在冒烟的纸张与被撕碎的账本。恼怒之下，你迅速从侧门冲出，而守卫惊呼着追了上来。

column1: With a wink, the thugs take your money and divide it among themselves.
column2: 贼眉鼠眼的恶徒接过你的钱，将其瓜分。

column1: With amazing skill and silence you all scale the wall, sneak across the battlements, and scurry down into a dark side street.
column2: 你们以惊人的技艺与无声无息地攀上城墙，悄然穿过垛口，迅速溜入一条幽暗的侧街。

column1: With an amazing display of acrobatics, you manage to get the entire party to the other end of the corridor. Behind you, the floor has opened, revealing a dark, foul-smelling pit.
column2: 你以惊人的杂技技艺，带领全队抵达走廊另一端。身后地面裂开，露出一口黑暗、恶臭的深坑。

column1: With an ear-shattering explosion, the potion smashes open the sally port, and you rush through into the city.
column2: 随着一声震耳欲聋的爆炸，药剂炸开了突门，你冲进城中。

column1: With an enigmatic smile, $NamedOneName says, "Now that $NamedTwoName is destroyed, our projects will continue much more smoothly. We fondly remember those who advance our plans."
column2: 带着神秘的微笑，$NamedOneName说道：“如今$NamedTwoName已毁，我们的计划将更加顺利地推进。我们怀念那些助力我们谋划之人。”

column1: With care and precision the nuns and surgeons tend to your wounds. After a day in the hospice, you feel much better, and cheerfully pay the fee.
column2: 尼姑与外科医师悉心为你疗伤。在施疗院住上一日，你觉身心大好，欣然付讫诊金。

column1: With energy and devotion, $ChosenOneName prays for divine intercession.
column2: 以虔诚与热忱，$ChosenOneName 祈求神明的庇佑。

column1: With glaring light, the Sunburst explodes. Many guards are incapacitated, but several are unaffected. Weapons drawn, they close in.
column2: 伴随着刺眼的光芒，日晕骤然爆发。许多守卫被击倒，但仍有数人毫发无损。他们拔出武器，步步逼近。

column1: With great effort, you raise your head from the cool, comfortable ground, to see your foe grinning above you. Your companions lie strewn about the battlefield; you can't tell if they are dead or alive. You're not so sure about yourself.
column2: 费尽全力，你从清凉舒适的地面抬起头来，只见敌人在你上方狞笑。同伴们横七竖八地倒在战场上；你分不清他们是死是活。你自己也拿不准。

column1: With great skill and stealth, you sneak through a back window and surprise the blonde woman -- by holding a sharp blade at her throat!
column2: 你以高超的技艺与隐秘之术，从后窗潜入，猝然袭击那金发女子——锋刃抵其喉间！

column1: With great stealth $ChosenOneName creeps up to a sally door set in the main gate. $He attaches a fused pot to the hinges, lights it, and ducks around the corner. Seconds later a loud crash sends door splinters in all directions. You rush forward into the $fortress to find the city guards have fled, but the personal guards of the $CityLordTitle remain.
column2: 以极高的潜行之技，$ChosenOneName 悄然逼近主城门上的一道突袭小门。你 将一枚引信火罐缚于门枢，点燃后迅速退至转角处。数秒后，一声巨响，门板四散飞裂。你疾冲入 $fortress，只见城卫已溃逃，唯 $CityLordTitle 的亲卫尚在。

column1: With great stealth, $ChosenOneName creeps to the sally door set in the main gate. $He carefully attaches a fused pot to the hinges, lights it, and ducks around the corner. Seconds later a burst of light and a loud crash send door splinters in all directions. As the dazed guards sound the alarm, you scurry through the wreckage and down a side street leading into the city.
column2: 以极高的潜行技巧，$ChosenOneName 悄悄潜至主城门上的突袭门旁。你 小心翼翼地将一枚引信陶罐缚于铰链之上，点燃后迅速躲至拐角处。数秒后，一道强光与巨响齐发，门板四散飞溅。守卫惊愕间鸣响警报，你趁机穿过残骸，沿一条通往城内的侧街疾驰而去。

column1: With grim determination the party begins to sift through the ashes and charcoal residue. Despite your best efforts, everyone is quickly coated with a thin film of greasy black soot. You...
column2: 众人怀着坚毅的决心，开始在灰烬与木炭残渣中细细搜寻。尽管你们竭尽全力，每个人很快便被一层薄薄的油黑煤灰所覆盖。你...

column1: With grim determination, you set fire to the desk, tearing apart the stubborn wood and watching with satisfaction as the satanic papers are cleansed by the flame.
column2: 你怀着坚定的决心，点燃了书桌，撕裂那顽固的木头，满意地看着那些邪恶的纸张在火焰中被净化。

column1: With his help, over the next two hours you manage to change the opinion of the guild. Now they $Support changes in the city government.
column2: 在他的帮助下，接下来的两个小时里，你成功改变了公会的看法。如今他们$Support市政府的变革。

column1: With hushed voices, people discuss the strange lights and weird shapes in the sky near a place named $NamedOneName. Even more distressing are tales of unbaptized innocents missing from villages nearby. The common advice is, "It's a place of ancient evil. Stay away." You recall this place is $Direction2 of here.
column2: 人们低声议论着，那片名为$NamedOneName的天空中出现了奇异的光芒与怪异的形状。更令人不安的是，附近村庄里竟有未受洗礼的孩童失踪。众人的劝告是：“那是古老邪恶之地，切勿靠近。”你忆起此地在此处的$Direction2方向。

column1: With just the few drops of the potion, the tombs suddenly change. Their tops elongate and close, until every one has a beautiful stone lid. The crypt seems brighter, the air fresher, and small beams of sunlight filter through from above.
column2: 仅凭几滴药水，墓冢骤然变化。其顶部拉长并合拢，直至每座皆覆以精美的石盖。地穴似乎更为明亮，空气也更清新，缕缕阳光自上方洒落。

column1: With mere seconds remaining before the beasts arrive, you...
column2: 仅剩数秒，野兽将至，你...

column1: With mightly heaves and grunts, $ChosenOneName pulls and pushes to no avail. The sewer bars are too strong for $him. Everyone breathes a sigh of relief. Crawling through that awful sludge would have been most unpleasant!
column2: 伴随着有力的喘息与哼哧声，$ChosenOneName 拼命拉拽推搡，却毫无成效。下水道的铁栅栏对 你 而言过于坚固。众人皆松了一口气。若要钻过那污秽不堪的淤泥，实为苦不堪言！

column1: With no one around to interfere, you perform a quick baptism rite; this breaks the power of the witches over their victims, saving them from a horrible fate.
column2: 四下无人，你迅速行洗礼之礼；此举破除了女巫对受害者的魔咒，使他们免于惨祸。

column1: With nothing further to bar your way, you take the $McGuffin and return to the church.
column2: 无物再阻你前行，你取下$McGuffin，返回教堂。

column1: With practically the whole Sabbat gathered around, you realize the fight will be long and hard.
column2: 几乎整个安息日的众人齐聚一堂，你意识到这场战斗将漫长而艰苦。

column1: With practically the whole Sabbat nearby, you realize the fight will be long and hard.
column2: 几乎整个萨巴特都在附近，你意识到这场战斗将漫长而艰难。

column1: With reverence, $ChosenTwoName prays for aid.
column2: 怀着敬畏之心，$ChosenTwoName 祈求援助。

column1: With teamwork and strength, you manage to move enough rubble to make an entrance hole.
column2: 凭借团队协作与力量，你们终于移开足够的瓦砾，开辟出一道入口。

column1: With that, he departs from your party.
column2: 于是，他离开了你们的队伍。

column1: With that, he opens a door and ushers you onto the street.
column2: 于是，他打开一扇门，引领你走上街头。

column1: With that, the demon vanishes, leaving you to face the angry throng.
column2: 于是，恶魔消失不见，只留下你面对愤怒的人群。

column1: With the attack destroyed, you can journey onward in peace, satisfied that there is one less evil in the world.
column2: 攻势既已击溃，你可安心前行，欣慰于世间又少了一分邪恶。

column1: With the bandits disposed of, you resume your journey.
column2: 随着匪徒被消灭，你继续前行。

column1: With the breaking of the seal, you commit yourselves to the destruction of the entire witch cult.
column2: 随着封印的破裂，你们决心摧毁整个女巫教团。

column1: With the quickly improvised rope, you prevent $ChosenOneName from sinking further, but cannot manage to get $him out. You must do something else as well, or else leave $him to $his fate.
column2: 用这根仓促编成的绳索，你阻止了 $ChosenOneName 继续下沉，却无法将 $he 拉上来。你还须另想办法，否则只能听天由命。

column1: With the thugs disposed of, you can resume your activities. Perhaps next time they'll think twice before attacking you.
column2: 恶徒既除，汝可继续行事。或许下次他们再行劫掠时，会三思而后行。

column1: With unerring accuracy, $ChosenOneName hurls the potion into the exposed gears of the trap, wrecking the mechanism. The floor stops its tilt, allowing the party to continue carefully down the corridor.
column2: $ChosenOneName 准确无误地将药剂掷入陷阱裸露的齿轮之中，摧毁了机关。地面停止倾斜，众人得以小心翼翼地继续前行。

column1: With unerring aim, $ChosenOneName hurls the potion directly into the middle of the ambush. Surprised bandits flee screaming. $ChosenOneName bows briefly to the rest of the party, grinning from ear to ear.
column2: $ChosenOneName 准确无误地将药剂掷向伏击的正中央。惊愕的匪徒尖叫着四散奔逃。$ChosenOneName 向同伴们微微一礼，笑容满面。

column1: With unerring aim, $ChosenOneName hurls the potion directly into the middle of the ambush. Surprised men flee screaming; they look like extremely dirty soldiers -- unemployed mercenaries, you guess.
column2: $ChosenOneName 准确无误地将药剂掷向伏击的正中央。惊愕之人尖叫着四散奔逃；他们看起来像是极其肮脏的士兵——你猜是些失业的雇佣兵。

column1: With winning words, you explain your business, and are admitted for an interview with $NamedOneName.
column2: 你以得体之言说明来意，获准与$NamedOneName面谈。

column1: Within moments you see $ChosenOneName running at top speed out of the cave, pursued by a large, brown bear. Quickly you bring your weapons to readiness and the battle is at hand.
column2: 片刻之间，你见$ChosenOneName全速奔出洞穴，身后紧追着一头棕熊。你迅速备好武器，战斗一触即发。

column1: Within the lean-to, your searching is rewarded. Half buried by old leaves, you find the $NamedOneName.
column2: 在棚屋内，你的搜寻有了回报。半埋在枯叶之下，你找到了$NamedOneName。

column1: Without further ado, the bailiffs and his guard drag you to the town square, give you all a sound beating with hard leather whips, and leave you, bleeding, on the ground.
column2: 不多言，法警及其卫队将你拖至镇广场，用硬皮鞭狠狠抽打一番，任你血流满地，弃之而去。

column1: Wolves suddenly race towards you, tamed by the dwarf to work his sinister will. The dwarf puts on his red cap, and vanishes with a "pop!"
column2: 狼群骤然向你奔来，被矮人驯服，为其邪恶的意志效劳。矮人戴上红帽，一声“砰”地消失不见。

column1: Working as fast as $he can, $ChosenOneName sets a small fire against a wooden interior wall. Then you escape out a window. You wait and wait, but there is no sign of trouble from within the fortress. Either someone found your fire, or it fizzled out before setting the wall alight.
column2: 你 尽快行动，$ChosenOneName 在木制内墙上点燃一小堆火。随后你从窗户逃出。你等待再等待，但堡垒内并无异状。要么有人发现了你的火，要么火在点燃墙壁之前就熄灭了。

column1: Working desperately, you manage to carve out a channel in the side of the pit leading upwards. You knock out handholds in the sides, and within a few hours, you have all climbed up and out.
column2: 你拼命劳作，在矿坑侧壁凿出一条向上延伸的通道。你在两侧敲出扶手，数小时内，众人皆攀援而出。

column1: Working fast, you help $ChosenOneName perform the baptism. Nervous, you stumble over the words. You notice many suspicious glances from the witches.
column2: 你动作迅速，协助$ChosenOneName完成洗礼。紧张之下，你口齿不清。你注意到女巫们投来许多怀疑的目光。

column1: Working fast, you help $ChosenOneName perform the baptisms. Nervous and frightened, you stumble over the words, and the ceremony is completed only with difficulty. You notice many suspicious glances from the witches.
column2: 工作迅速，你协助$ChosenOneName完成洗礼。紧张惶恐，你口齿不清，仪式几经周折方告完成。你察觉女巫们投来诸多疑虑的目光。

column1: Working faster than you've ever worked, you help $ChosenOneName perform the baptism. It is done so quickly and quietly that none of the witches realizes what has occurred.
column2: 工作比以往任何时刻都快，你协助$ChosenOneName完成洗礼。一切悄然疾速，女巫竟无一人觉察。

column1: Working faster than you've ever worked, you help $ChosenOneName perform the baptisms. It is done so quickly and quietly that none of the witches notice what has occurred.
column2: 工作比以往任何时刻都快，你协助$ChosenOneName完成洗礼。一切悄然疾速，女巫竟无一人察觉。

column1: Working quickly, $ChosenOneName lays tinder against a wooden interior wall. Using flint and steel, $he starts a fire. Then you let yourselves out of a window with all haste.
column2: 工作迅速，$ChosenOneName于木墙内侧铺上引火物。以燧石与钢片点火，你燃起火焰。尔后，你们急匆匆自窗而出。

column1: Working quickly, you break the sacred seal on the mammoth book. A rushing wind fills the room, and a feeling of foreboding comes over you. Suddenly you know that your ultimate fate lies $LastCastleLocation.
column2: 工作迅速，你破开巨书之圣印。狂风骤至，满室皆盈，不祥之感袭来。忽而，你知自身终命系于$LastCastleLocation。

column1: Working quickly, you conceal yourselves by the side of the path, hoping that the thin cover of brambles is enough to conceal you. Soon the cloaked travellers pull abreast of you: there are four of them, one a minor noble dressed in fancy red robes. You...
column2: 你们迅速行动，藏身于小径旁，祈盼那稀疏的荆棘足以掩护你们。不久，披斗篷的旅人与你们擦肩而过：共有四人，其中一人乃身着华美红袍之小贵族。你们...

column1: Working your way quickly but quietly down the hill, you arrive at the path ahead of a group of cloaked pilgrims coming up from the south. You then...
column2: 你迅速而悄然地沿着山坡下行，赶在一群从南方上来的披风朝圣者之前抵达小径。随后……

column1: Worried, $ChosenOneName gapes, "But we didn't sign the contract. It's not fair!"
column2: $ChosenOneName 惶恐地张大了嘴，“可我们并未签署契约。这太不公平了！”

column1: X (some powerful guy outside the political heirarchy)
column2: X（政治体系之外的某位权势人物）

column1: Yelling angrily, tattered ruffians leap from ambush. They were once farmers and townsfolk, but in this ruined land they are reduced to savage banditry.
column2: 怒吼着，衣衫褴褛的恶徒从伏击中跃出。他们曾是农夫与市民，但在这片废土上，却沦为凶残的盗匪。

column1: You ...

You accept her offer. $ChosenOneName is the first to eagerly eat the strange roots she gives $him. In seconds, $he leaps up elated. "I feel like a mighty hero!" $He grasps a tree and heaves with all $his might. Then $he stiffens, shudders, and falls dead, blood pouring from $his mouth, nose and ears.
column2: 你接受了她的提议。$ChosenOneName 是第一个迫不及待地吃下她递你奇异根茎的人。顷刻之间，你欣喜若狂地跳了起来。“我感觉自己像个伟大的英雄！”你抓住一棵树，用尽你的全力一拉。随后你身体僵直，颤抖着倒下，鲜血从你的口、鼻和耳中涌出。

column1: You admire the moonlight sparkling amid the trees and playing off the roofs, all the while staying out of sight of the city guard. The hour passes quickly.
column2: 你欣赏着月光在林间闪烁，映照屋顶，同时隐匿于城卫的视线之外。时光飞逝。

column1: You agree most heartily, and immediately head for...
column2: 你欣然应允，随即启程前往……

column1: You all agree. In fact, this embarrassing failure by the city guard may well aid your cause. You agree to meet again soon, to compare notes about the new attitude in the city.
column2: 你们皆同意。事实上，城卫队的这番尴尬失职或许反而有助于你们的事业。你们约定不久后再次会面，商讨城中新近转变的态度。

column1: You all agree. In fact, this embarrassing failure by the guard may well aid your cause. $NamedOneName asks you to visit his headquarters soon, to re-examine the situation and make new plans.
column2: 你们都同意。事实上，守卫的这次尴尬失败或许反而有助于你们的计划。$NamedOneName请你们尽快前往他的总部，重新审视局势并制定新方案。

column1: You all attempt to step forward, ignoring the ghost, to take the $McGuffin . However, $ChosenOneName quails and backs away. "This ghost is too powerful for us!" $he cries. "Our souls shall suffer if we continue!"
column2: You all attempt to step forward, ignoring the ghost, to take the $McGuffin . However, $ChosenOneName quails and backs away. "This ghost is too powerful for us!" 你 cries. "Our souls shall suffer if we continue!"

column1: You all awaken from the dream in the early morning sunlight. There is no doubt that you have been called. The only question is, what should you do now? As in most dreams, there is no clear path of action, only premonitions.
column2: 你们皆在清晨的阳光中自梦中醒来。毫无疑问，你们已被召唤。唯一的问题是，如今当如何行事？正如大多数梦境一般，无明确之路径，唯有预兆相伴。

column1: You all discuss this possibility, but finally $NamedOneName says, "I don't think we should try it right now. Our spies think the opposition is already planning an important move in the next few days. First we must concentrate on stopping their plan."
column2: 众人商议此事，但最终$NamedOneName说道：“我认为现在不宜轻举妄动。我方探子称，敌对势力近日正筹划要事。我们当先全力阻其图谋。”

column1: You all enter the field. "Be sure to attend an initiation at some point during the Sabbat," the man says, speaking the word witches use to describe their unholy festivals.
column2: 你们皆步入此地。“务必在萨巴特期间参加一次入门仪式，”那人说道，用的是女巫们称呼其邪教集会的词汇。

column1: You all feel chastened and humble. Ashamed, the thugs slink away to contemplate their crimes, allowing you to continue on your way.
column2: 你们皆感自省而谦卑。羞愧之下，恶徒悄然退去，反思其罪行，任由你们继续前行。

column1: You all find the footing soft and strangely unstable, but continue. Suddenly, the ground beneath you gives way and you fall into a stinking pool of chest-deep muck. You try to kick and pull yourself out, but only sink deeper. Alone, with nobody on solid ground, you are doomed to sink and drown unless...
column2: 你们皆觉脚下松软，异常不稳，却仍继续前行。忽地，身下地面塌陷，你们坠入一片齐胸深的恶臭泥潭。你们奋力挣扎欲脱困，却愈陷愈深。孤身一人，无人在坚实之地，若无……，唯有沉沦溺亡。

column1: You all heave and tug, but each new opening you create caves in. You can't figure out how to get into the crypt. Maybe the only entrances are beneath those blocks that are too huge to move. Or perhaps you need more skill in artifice.
column2: 你们齐心协力，奋力拉拽，但每开辟一处新口便即刻坍塌。你们始终无法找到进入墓室的途径。或许唯一的入口就在那些巨石之下，而这些巨石重得难以撼动。抑或，你们还需更精妙的机关术。

column1: You all make it to a ledge just before the top. Then, together, you crawl over the lip and peer inside.
column2: 你们众人在抵达顶端之前，勉强攀上一处岩架。随后，你们一同翻过边缘，向内窥视。

column1: You all nod together, listening as the herbalist explains...
column2: 你们齐齐点头，听那草药师娓娓道来……

column1: You all ponder whether this portends some greater evil, or simply a loss of morals.
column2: 你们皆在思索，这究竟是更大的邪恶之兆，抑或只是道德的沦丧。

column1: You all pray for a while, but no enlightenment comes. Your plea goes unanswered for the moment.
column2: 你们皆虔诚祈祷，然未得启示。此刻祈求仍无回应。

column1: You all scramble up the wall, even $ChosenOneName. Quietly you slip across the battlements and down a stairway into the back alleys of $PlaceName.
column2: 你们全都攀上城墙，连$ChosenOneName也不例外。你们悄然穿过城垛，沿着楼梯溜进$PlaceName的后巷。

column1: You all slip out quietly, unnoticed and unsuspected. Everyone casually strolls away, smiling.
column2: 你们悄然离去，无人察觉，亦无丝毫怀疑。众人悠然散去，面带微笑。

column1: You all stand up. Grinning happily, $ChosenOneName begins a flashy weapons routine with $his $NamedOneName. Unfortunately, $his skill isn't up to the task and $he drops it!
column2: 你们都站了起来。$ChosenOneName 满面笑容地与 你的 $NamedOneName 展开了一场华丽的武器表演。不幸的是，你的 的技艺尚不足以胜任，你 竟将它掉落了！

column1: You all stand up. Grinning happily, $ChosenOneName spins $his $NamedOneName in a flashy display of weapons skill.
column2: 你们都站了起来。$ChosenOneName 满面笑容地将 你的 $NamedOneName 转得飞快，炫耀着精湛的武艺。

column1: You all watch the cave carefully for three hours, but all seems quiet and peaceful. If anything lurks within, it is a very patient hunter!
column2: 你们众人在洞穴外仔细守候了三个时辰，却只见一片宁静祥和。若真有生灵潜伏其中，那定是位极有耐心的猎手！

column1: You also hear that the Fuggers might be involved, but it's not clear whether they're part of the problem, or part of the solution.
column2: 你也听说富格家族可能牵涉其中，但尚不清楚他们是问题的一部分，还是解决方案的一部分。

column1: You also hear them argue about whether now is the appropriate time, or $SabbatTime, $SabbatLocation. They settle on now, but you remember this information -- in could be important.
column2: 你也听见他们争论现在是否是恰当的时机，或是$SabbatTime、$SabbatLocation。他们最终决定就在此刻，但你记住了这条信息——这或许很重要。

column1: You and $NamedOneName organize the nervous crowd and begin moving peacefully toward $VarString1. The guardsmen watch you depart.
column2: 你与$NamedOneName安抚惊慌的人群，开始平静地向$VarString1行进。卫兵目送你们离去。

column1: You and your new-found companions follow the path toward one of the many watchfires circling the great field. The four strangers walk confidently toward a dangerous-looking wolf standing by the fire. One by one they extend their hands to the wolf's snout. It sniffs each in turn, but does not react in any way. You...
column2: 你与新结识的同伴循着通往那片广袤原野的路径前行，四周环绕着无数烽火。四名陌生人昂然步向火旁一只形貌凶险的狼。他们逐一将手伸至狼鼻前，它依次嗅闻，却毫无异动。而你……

column1: You answer politely, "We come to end the ruin of the land."
column2: 你有礼地答道：“我们前来终结这片土地的劫难。”

column1: You answer that Krott is a ...
column2: 你回答说，克罗特是一个……

column1: You approach an aging crone wearing a cook's cap.
column2: 你走近一位头戴厨帽的老妪。

column1: You approach the gathering, and note a line of people waiting to ride each of the unholy steeds. There are pigs, barrels, branches of yew and ash, broomsticks, and even a severed human leg. Each person in turn rubs his or her body with a strange ointment before selecting a mount. Then they chant arcane phrases and soar into the air. This is clearly a vicious mockery of certain saintly powers. You...
column2: 你走近那群人，见一列人正排队骑上那些不洁的坐骑。有猪、木桶、紫杉与白蜡树枝、扫帚柄，甚至还有一只被斩下的断腿。每人依次用一种奇异的药膏涂抹全身，然后挑选坐骑。接着他们诵念着神秘的咒语，腾空而起。这显然是对某些圣洁力量的恶毒嘲弄。你...

column1: You approach the merchants and begin a friendly chat with their hooded leader. Suddenly, the leader flips back his hood to reveal a horribly scarred face with a terrifying grin.
column2: 你走近商人们，与他们那名戴兜帽的首领攀谈起来。忽然，首领掀开兜帽，露出一张满是骇人伤疤的脸庞，嘴角挂着令人胆寒的狞笑。

column1: You approach the stream and note a small line of people waiting for a man dressed in dirty black robes; he is dunking each participant in turn. Over the sound of the running water, you can hear the dark words the man is speaking, and hear the giggling of the participants. It is clear that this is a satanic mockery of a holy ritual. You...
column2: 你走近溪流，见一队小人正排队等候一位身着污黑长袍的男子；他正逐一将众人浸入水中。流水声中，你能听见那男子低语的阴森咒语，以及众人的窃笑声。显然，这是一场对神圣仪式的撒旦式嘲弄。你...

column1: You are abandoned in the wilderness.
column2: 你被遗弃于荒野之中。

column1: You are at a riverboat landing stage on the Donau River, called the Danube by some. While considering the best route, you discover the boat fare will be $Money1. Therefore, you decide to take...
column2: 你身处多瑙河畔的一处渡口，有人称其为“丹努比”。思索良策之际，方知船费需$Money1。于是，你决定乘...

column1: You are at a riverboat landing stage on the Maas River, trying to decide whether to take a boat into Burgundy and the Kingdom of France. The boat fare will be $Money1, so you decide to take...
column2: 你正位于马斯河的渡口，正犹豫是否乘船前往勃艮第与法兰西王国。船费为$Money1，于是你决定乘坐……

column1: You are at a riverboat landing stage on the Weichsel River, trying to decide on the best route. The boat fare will be $Money1, so you decide to take...
column2: 你在维斯瓦河的渡船码头，正犹豫该选择哪条路线。船费是$Money1，于是你决定乘坐……

column1: You are at the execution but you rescue your friend.
column2: 你在行刑现场，却救下了你的朋友。

column1: You are at the home of an elderly woman, who gladly takes in strangers. She is cheerful, and welcomes you with a toothless grin. "Guests use the bed, I sleep in the kitchen," is her common saying.
column2: 你来到一位老妇人的家中，她乐于收留陌生人。她性情开朗，用满是牙床的笑容欢迎你。“客人睡床，我睡厨房”，这是她的口头禅。

column1: You are at the wall near an old sally port. High above, a soldier walks his lonely circuit. You decide to ...
column2: 你立于城墙旁，近一古旧的出城门。高处，一名士兵踽踽巡行。你决定……

column1: You are atop the hill, surrounded by leaping, gibbering cultists. Soon they plan to murder you, and use you as a sacrifice to their foul lord. The ropes they have tied you with seem stout, but surely there is something you can do.
column2: 你立于山巅，四周环绕着跳跃、喋喋不休的邪教徒。他们不久便要将你杀害，以你为祭品献给其污秽之主。缚住你的绳索看似结实，但你定能有所作为。

column1: You are awakened by the pain of ravens picking at your wounds in the twilight. Somehow, the bandits' killing strokes weren't strong enough. Alas, poor $ChosenOneName wasn't so lucky. $His body is pale and cold.
column2: 黎明时分，乌鸦啄食你伤口的痛楚将你唤醒。不知为何，劫匪的致命一击终究未能得逞。唉，可怜的$ChosenOneName却未有这般幸运。你的身躯苍白而冰冷。

column1: You are bound together around the stake, in place of the poor friar. You realize that you have little time before your fate is sealed as a human sacrifice to Baphomet! You...
column2: 你们被绑在桩上，取代了那位可怜的修士。你们意识到，在成为巴佛梅特的人祭之前，时间所剩无几！你...

column1: You are defeated and surrender.
column2: 你战败并投降。

column1: You are escorted by $NamedOneName from the chambers of the $CityLordTitle to the stables, where the stablemaster gives $ChosenOneName a beautiful stallion who promises to be both fast and strong.
column2: 你由$NamedOneName护送，自$CityLordTitle的寝宫前往马厩，厩主赠予$ChosenOneName一匹骏马，既迅疾又强健。

column1: You are escorted by $NamedOneName to the central armory. Here the armorer quickly outfits you with a very impressive suit of plate armor. You can see it is of exceptionally high quality, and virtually new.
column2: 你由$NamedOneName护送至中央兵器库。此处盔甲匠迅速为你装配一套华美板甲，品质卓绝，几近全新。

column1: You are escorted from the chambers of the $CityLordTitle by $NamedOneName, who again thanks you. Content, you stroll out of the $VarString1 and into the $citySquare.
column2: 你由$NamedOneName自$CityLordTitle的寝宫护送出行，他再次向你致谢。心满意足，你步出$VarString1，步入$citySquare。

column1: You are escorted into the office of $NamedOneName, the Medici representative here.
column2: 你被引入$NamedOneName——此地美第奇家族代表——的办公室。

column1: You are feeling a little more sanguine. You have beaten Baphomet twice.
column2: 你稍觉乐观。你已两度击败巴佛墨特。

column1: You are forced back off the bridge in retreat. The demon shouts after you, "The issue is still unresolved! I shall remain here for another soul!" Then he disappears with a clap of thunder. Glumly, you resume your journey, taking the long way around like the rest of the villagers.
column2: 你被迫撤退，退回桥上。恶魔追声喝道：“此事尚未了结！我仍在此，等候另一魂魄！”随即雷鸣般消失。你黯然续行，如众村民般绕道而行。

column1: You are happy to rescue this weird forest creature from the hideous Wild Hunt. This is an occasion to savor and tell your grandchildren about.
column2: 你欣然救下这怪异林间生灵，使其脱离可怖的野猎队。此乃值得珍藏、传与子孙之事。

column1: You are held incommunicado in an oubliette, a nitre-encrusted well too deep to climb or dig out. The only exit is a narrow hole at the top, blocked by a hinged metal plate. Occasionally the deformed turnkey remembers to toss an armful of garbage down, and you must fight for this "food" with rats and insects.
column2: 你在隐牢中与世隔绝，那是一口硝垢斑驳、深不可攀的枯井。出口仅顶部一狭孔，覆以铰链铁板。偶有畸形狱卒记起投下一捧秽物，你须与鼠虫争食。

column1: You are helpless, clinging to the cliffside below. The dragon rumbles, preparing to belch fire down upon you.
column2: 你无助地紧 clinging 岩壁之下。巨龙低吼，蓄势喷火。

column1: You are left to weep over the pieces of your fallen comrade.
column2: 你只能为亡友遗骸痛哭。

column1: You are near the great outer wall of $PlaceName.
column2: 你已近$PlaceName的高大外垣。

column1: You are on the path leading toward one of the many watchfires circling the great field. As you approach, you spy three wolves standing by the fire, looking for all the world like sentries on duty. They haven't seen you yet. You...
column2: 你正行往环绕旷野的众多烽火之一。临近时，见三狼立于火旁，俨若守夜之哨。它们尚未察觉。你……

column1: You are outdoors again. Before you, on a stained stone wall oozing with snails, hangs a huge bearded head. It is Baphomet, the evil prophet of the Knights Templar. The head speaks in a thin evil voice, "You have fulfilled my plans. You have brought the Apocalypse. Now, the powers of Hell shall destroy the world, all due to you."
column2: 你重归户外。眼前污痕斑驳的石墙上，悬挂一颗硕大的胡须首级。那是巴佛墨特，圣殿骑士团的邪教先知。首级以尖细恶声道：“汝已成全吾计。汝已引启末日。今，地狱之力将毁世间，皆因汝也。”

column1: You are relieved that their arrest did not require bloodshed.
column2: 你庆幸其逮捕未致流血。

column1: You are relieved to discover that all is well here in $PlaceName. The residents seem happy, and the lord just.
column2: 你欣慰地发现$PlaceName一切安好。居民欢悦，领主公正。

column1: You are roughly marched out of the dungeon and left in the town square.
column2: 你被粗暴押出地牢，弃于镇中广场。

column1: You are satisfied with this victory. There is one less evil in the world.
column2: 你对这场胜利心满意足。世间少了一分邪恶。

column1: You are satisfied with this, especially since he is sure to exaggerate your abilities to explain his defeat.
column2: 你对此颇为满意，尤其因他定会夸大你的本领，以掩饰自身败绩。

column1: You are shown into a small conference room. A wealthy, imposing man with a feral expression strides in quickly.
column2: 你被引入一间小会议室。一位富态威严、神情凶狠的男子疾步而入。

column1: You are shown to some small, damp, unused cells.
column2: 你被带至几间阴湿闲置的囚室。

column1: You are stripped and cast out, half-naked and penniless, into the wilderness. But you are free and alive.
column2: 你被剥衣驱逐，半裸身无分文，流落荒野。然你终得自由，尚存生机。

column1: You are stripped, bound and hung by your heels from the upstairs balcony. When the crowd sees you, their champions, defeated, they lose heart.
column2: 你被剥衣缚足，倒悬于楼上阳台。众人见汝等败北，士气顿挫。

column1: You are surprised by a party of soldiers, led by a stern woodsman. "I am the J
column2: 你突遭一队士兵拦截，为首者乃一名严厉的林夫。“吾乃J

column1: You are surprised to encounter a group of well-armed peasants, with a red chalice embroided on their tunics and hoods -- the symbol of the Hussite rebellion. You suspect they are fleeing from $LocName, a nearby Imperial city.
column2: 你惊见一群武装农民，其衣帽绣有红色圣杯——胡斯派叛乱之徽记。你疑其正逃离邻近的帝国城$LocName。

column1: You are surprised to encounter a group of well-armed peasants, with a red chalice embroided on their tunics and hoods -- the symbol of the Hussite rebellion. You suspect they are from $LocName, the nearby rebel city.
column2: 你惊见一群武装农民，其衣帽绣有红色圣杯——胡斯派叛乱之徽记。你疑其来自邻近的叛城$LocName。

column1: You are surprised to see a holzfrau, woodwife of the schrats. She seems worried and motions for you to keep silent. Then she whispers, "The Wild Hunt is ahead. Turn aside lest you meet it unprepared. Make haste. You must learn the secret. You cannot save yourself from the Wild Hunt unless you can invoke $Text1. Only this is permanent in its effects."
column2: 你忽见一木妇，精灵之妻。她神色忧虑，示意汝噤声。继而低语：“前方有野猎队。速避，免遭猝击。急行。汝须习得秘法。若不能召来$Text1，则难逃野猎。唯有此法方能永保平安。”

column1: You are thrilled. The horses appear to be in excellent condition, and of good stock.
column2: 你欣喜不已。诸马状貌极佳，血统纯良。

column1: You are told in no uncertain terms that the relic is the property of the $cathedral. It is a sacred gift from heaven; your hands will not be permitted to profane it.
column2: 你被郑重告知，此圣物乃$cathedral之物。天赐圣礼，汝手不得亵渎。

column1: You are told, "Come back tomorrow, in the daylight."
column2: 人告汝：“明日白日再来。”

column1: You are untied, and allowed to cool your heels while the magistrate's representative goes to $VarStringOne and confiscates all your money there. Then you are freed.
column2: 你被解缚，任其静候，而法官代表赴$VarStringOne，悉数没收汝之资财。随后汝获释。

column1: You are untied, and allowed to cool your heels while the magistrate's representative goes to the bank and confiscates all your money there. Then you are freed.
column2: 你被解缚，任其静候，而法官代表赴银行，悉数没收汝之资财。随后汝获释。

column1: You are used to the gray skies and periodic rain of the marshes and wetlands along the coast. Another rainstorm seems like nothing until the water all around you begins rising faster and faster!
column2: 你早已习惯沿海沼泽湿地的灰霾与时雨。又一场骤雨本不足惧，直至周遭积水愈涨愈快！

column1: You arrive at the door of $NamedOneName, the famous physician of $PlaceName. Unfortunately, your reputation has preceded you. No matter how hard you knock, or how loudly you entreat him, the door does not open.
column2: 你抵达$NamedOneName——$PlaceName名医——府邸门前。不幸的是，汝之名声已先一步传开。无论汝如何叩门，如何恳求，门终不开。

column1: You ask about news, and what you get is jokes:
column2: 你探问消息，所获却只是笑谈：

column1: You ask about the service he desires. "Attend me closely," he says quietly, "here is what I need..."
column2: 你询其所需之侍奉。“贴身服侍，”他低声言，“吾所需如下……”

column1: You ask for...
column2: 你询……

column1: You ask her for details, but she can offer no additional advice. "I only see a path with signposts. Details are obscure, unreliable. You must rely upon yourselves, not upon me."
column2: 你再问详情，她却无法多言。“吾只见路标指引，细节模糊难凭。汝当自力，而非倚我。”

column1: You ask him to ...
column2: 你请他……

column1: You ask if some of these good works might aid your cause, and he shrugs. You realize that your bribe was spent in vain.
column2: 你问此举是否有助汝事，他 лишь 耸肩。汝方知贿赂徒劳。

column1: You ask just the right questions, then listen a lot. This encourages the revelation that the guild leader is involved in passing poor, low quality goods as guild products.
column2: 你发问恰到好处，继而静听。此举促其吐露：公会会长竟将劣质品伪作公会出品。

column1: You ask just the right questions, then listen a lot. This reveals that the street leader is involved in passing poor, low quality goods as guild products.
column2: 你发问恰到好处，继而静听。此举揭示：街坊首领竟将劣质品伪作公会出品。

column1: You ask just the right questions, then listen a lot. You discover that the guild leader may have been an illegitimate child whose father was a peasant serf, rather than a guildsman. This would make his position of guild leader illegal.
column2: 你发问恰到好处，继而静听。汝发现，该公会会长或为私生子，父乃农奴而非公会成员。如此，则其会长之位非法。

column1: You ask just the right questions, then listen a lot. You discover that the guild leader may have been an illegitimate child whose father was a peasant serf, rather than a guildsman. This would make his position of guild leader illegal. However, to prove this you must acquiring conclusive proof.
column2: 你发问恰到好处，继而静听。汝发现，该公会会长或为私生子，父乃农奴而非公会成员。如此，则其会长之位非法。然欲证实，尚需确凿证据。

column1: You ask just the right questions, then listen a lot. You discover that the leader may have been an illegitimate child whose father was a peasant serf, rather than a guildsman. This would make his position illegal.
column2: 你发问恰到好处，继而静听。汝发现，该领袖或为私生子，父乃农奴而非公会成员。如此，则其职位非法。

column1: You ask just the right questions, then listen a lot. Your behavior encourages the revelation that the guild leader is involved in passing off poor, low-quality goods as guild products.
column2: 你发问恰到好处，继而静听。汝之举促使对方吐露：公会会长竟将劣质品伪作公会出品。

column1: You ask just the right questions, then listen a lot. Your informant reveals that the guild leader is involved in passing off poor, low quality goods as guild products.
column2: 你发问恰到好处，继而静听。汝之线人披露：公会会长竟将劣质品伪作公会出品。

column1: You ask just the right questions, then listen a lot. Your informant reveals that the guild leader is involved in passing off poor, low-quality goods as guild products.
column2: 你发问恰到好处，继而静听。汝之线人披露：公会会长竟将劣质品伪作公会出品。

column1: You ask just the right questions, then listen a lot. Your source reveals that the guild leader is involved in passing off poor, low quality goods as guild products.
column2: 你发问恰到好处，继而静听。汝之消息来源披露：公会会长竟将劣质品伪作公会出品。

column1: You ask just the right questions, then listen a lot. Your source reveals that the guild leader is involved in passing poor, low quality goods as guild products.
column2: 你问对了问题，随后静心聆听。消息来源透露，公会会长正参与将劣质商品伪作公会产品出售之事。

column1: You ask the dwarf, "We want you to leave the mines to the humans now. We helped you win, now you must help us." Grudgingly the dwarf replies,
column2: 你对矮人道：“如今我们希望你将矿井交还给人类。我们助你取胜，如今你也须助我们。”矮人勉强答道，

column1: You ask the priest to help you escape. He smiles, and says, "Your ties to the Holy Church are deep. I will do what I can." He departs.
column2: 你请求神父助你脱身。他微笑道：“汝与圣教会渊源深厚，吾当尽力。”言罢离去。

column1: You assure him that you are law-abiding, and can be found at the inn.
column2: 你向他保证自己守法，并可在旅店寻得。

column1: You attempt the confession, but none of you knows the proper words. The man smiles grimly. "Thank you for your attempt," he says, bitter disappointment etched on his features. "Go in peace." He turns his face to the wall and speaks no more.
column2: 你尝试告解，却无人知正确祷词。那人苦笑道：“多谢汝等之诚心，”失望之情溢于言表，“愿汝平安。”遂转面倚墙，再不言语。

column1: You attempt to make a quick getaway through the window, but more of the mob is outside: they corner you, brandishing clubs and tools. You have no choice but to fight back.
column2: 你欲从窗间速逃，然门外更多暴徒，手持棍棒与工具将你围困。你别无选择，只得反击。

column1: You avoid saying anything and try to look innocuous.
column2: 你避而不言，装作无害模样。

column1: You awaken $Number1 hours later. You all feel refreshed and awake, as if you'd had a regular night's sleep. Of course, you're a bit dirtier, too.
column2: 你于$Number1小时后醒来。众人精神焕发，仿佛一夜安眠。当然，也更显污秽。

column1: You awaken amid the rocky ruins, outside but without the $NamedOneName. You can feel the evil of the catacombs beneath you. You decide to...
column2: 你于岩石废墟中醒来，身处室外，却不见$NamedOneName。你能感知脚下地下墓穴之邪气。你决定……

column1: You awaken in a foul-smelling midden, with a concerned housewife asking, "Are you all right?"
column2: 你于恶臭粪坑中醒来，一位忧心忡忡的主妇问道：“汝等可安好否？”

column1: You awaken in a gully, stripped of arms, armor and all obvious valuables. However, the bandit-soldiers failed to find a few small items. You bind up the worst wounds with scraps of cloth.
column2: 你于沟壑中醒来，武器、甲胄及一切显眼财物尽被夺去。然盗兵未搜出几件细物。你以碎布包扎重伤之处。

column1: You awaken in a gully, stripped of arms, armor and all obvious valuables. However, the bandits failed to find a few small items. You bind up the worst wounds with scraps of cloth.
column2: 你于沟壑中醒来，武器、甲胄及一切显眼财物尽被夺去。然盗贼未搜出几件细物。你以碎布包扎重伤之处。

column1: You awaken in a muddy gully, stripped of arms, armor, and all obvious valuables. You bind up the worst wounds with scraps of cloth.
column2: 你于泥泞沟壑中醒来，武器、甲胄及一切显眼财物尽被夺去。你以碎布包扎重伤之处。

column1: You awaken the next morning refreshed and ready for the day. To your surprise, each of you has had the same dream during the night. You must be careful today, and keep your ears open.
column2: 次日清晨，你精神抖擞，准备迎接新一日。令你惊讶的是，诸位昨夜皆做同一噩梦。今日务必谨慎，留心耳目。

column1: You awaken to a twilight of pain, and the stink of death. Grievously wounded and almost bled to death, you are lucky to regain consciousness. Alas, poor $ChosenOneName wasn't so lucky. $His body now lies stiff and cold.
column2: 你于疼痛与尸臭交织的暮色中醒来。伤势沉重，几近失血而亡，能苏醒实属万幸。可惜，可怜的$ChosenOneName未能如此。你的躯已僵冷。

column1: You awaken to find yourselves on a "dead cart," bouncing along toward the paupers' graveyard. As the cart works through an especially crowded lane, you roll off and crawl into a dark alleyway.
column2: 你醒来时身在“死车”之上，颠簸驶向贫民墓地。车行至一处拥挤巷道，你滚落车下，爬入幽暗小巷。

column1: You barely begin moving toward the dwarf when he leaps up and screams in a high, cracking voice:
column2: 你刚欲向矮人靠近，他便跃起，尖声嘶叫：

column1: You barely have time to draw and raise weapons before the witches are upon you.
column2: 你尚未来得及拔剑举盾，女巫已扑至眼前。

column1: You barely have time to rise and draw weapons before the witches are upon you.
column2: 你尚未来得及起身拔剑，女巫已扑至眼前。

column1: You beg the priest for a private discussion about matters of vital importance to $PlaceName.
column2: 你恳求神父就关乎$PlaceName之要事私谈。

column1: You begin moving through the crowd, jostling some, knocking over a few. Someone screams and points, and the priest smiles.
column2: 你穿行人群，推搡数人，撞倒几人。有人惊呼指认，神父微笑。

column1: You begin the pleasant task of picking through the castle's treasury, while reflecting that for years to come, travelers will bless your name when they ride these roads in safety.
column2: 你开始愉悦地清点城堡库藏，心中默念：往后多年，行经此路之人必因汝等安泰而赞颂汝名。

column1: You begin the tedious work of digging out, but it proves much harder than you'd expected. Your lack of skill in the art of working stone and dirt does not help, either. Long before you reach the top, you hear a ghastly giggle overhead. It is too late. The dwarf who dug the pit is here!
column2: 你着手艰难的挖掘工作，却远超预期之难。拙于石土之技亦无助力。未及掘至顶端，头顶忽闻阴森笑声。为时已晚。挖坑之矮人现身！

column1: You begin to find evidence that this is the site of some horrid witch-ritual. They have been here many times in the past, and will surely return again.
column2: 你渐见此处曾为骇人女巫仪式之所。彼辈往昔屡至，今必复来。

column1: You begin to laugh at him -- then, suddenly, everyone feels weaker. His curse has real power over you! The least virtuous among you suffer the most.
column2: 你始笑其荒唐——忽觉众人皆乏力。其诅咒竟真有灵验！品行最劣者受害尤甚。

column1: You begin to sneak away, but before you get far, the cultists notice your absence, and come howling after you.
column2: 你悄然溜走，然未及远行，教徒即察觉，嚎叫追来。

column1: You begin to speak about the Lord, and about the evil of Satan and witchcraft. At first, those around you are hostile and prepared to attack, but soon your words strike home. Several guilty glances are exchanged.
column2: 你开始宣讲主名，斥撒旦与巫术之恶。起初周遭敌意汹汹，似欲出手，然不久汝言击中要害。众人互递愧疚之瞥。

column1: You begin to speak about the Lord, and about the evil of Satan and witchcraft. Those around you are hostile and prepared to attack, and you see with dismay that your words are having no effect upon them.
column2: 你开始宣讲主名，斥撒旦与巫术之恶。周遭敌意汹汹，欲发攻击，汝见言辞竟无半分效力，不禁沮丧。

column1: You begin to speak about the Lord, and the evil of Satan and of witchcraft. At first those around you are hostile, but gradually they begin to hear your words. Guilty glances are exchanged, and even the evil priest Reinhard kneels and begs forgiveness!
column2: 你开始宣讲主名，斥撒旦与巫术之恶。起初周遭敌意，然渐闻汝言。众人互递愧疚之瞥，连邪恶神父莱因哈德亦跪地乞恕！

column1: You begin to speak about the Lord, and the evil of Satan and of witchcraft. Those around you are hostile and prepared to attack, and you see with dismay that your words are having no effect on them. Finally one old man cries out, "Unbelievers! Slay them!" The group rushes you.
column2: 你开始宣讲主名，斥撒旦与巫术之恶。周遭敌意汹汹，欲发攻击，汝见言辞毫无作用，终有一老者高呼：“异端！杀之！”众人一拥而上。

column2: 你开始宣讲主名，斥撒旦与巫术之恶。周遭敌意，汝见言辞无效。终至邪恶神父莱因哈德高呼：“异端！杀之！”众人一拥而上。

column2: 你开始宣讲主名，斥撒旦与巫术之恶。起初周遭敌意，欲发攻击，然渐闻汝言。众人互递愧疚之瞥，一老妪跪地痛哭乞恕！

column1: You bind his wounds and he begins to talk. "Certes, I thought not that any monster could be so strong against good Christian knights. Fire scourged us. Poison smothered us. Iron scales turned our blades." He clutches your sleeve. "Good sirs," he begs. "Go not against it without good magic. The monster is too fell for mortal man."
column2: 你为其包扎伤口，他开口道：“诚然，我未曾料到有何妖魔能强横至此，足以抗衡虔诚骑士。烈火灼我，毒雾窒息，铁甲鳞片折断我刃。”他紧握汝袖。“诸位善士，”他哀求，“切莫无良法对抗。此魔过于凶险，非凡人所能敌。”

column1: You bitterly regret that your purse lacks enough money for everyone to receive the treatment.
column2: 你深感遗憾，囊中银两不足，难为众人施治。

column1: You bow and back out the door before the guards throw you out.
column2: 你在卫兵驱逐前鞠躬退门。

column1: You break through their ranks.
column2: 你冲破了他们的阵列。

column1: You breathe a sigh of relief as you all pass through the gates into the $VarString1. Inside, you are met by a grateful $NamedOneName, who thanks you most profusely. Meanwhile the rebel leaders are escorted to the dungeons below.
column2: 你们安然通过城门，进入$VarString1，无不松一口气。城内，感恩的$NamedOneName热情致谢。与此同时，叛首已被押送入地牢。

column1: You call softly through the sally port until the sergeant of the guard answers. You offer him a stiff bribe to be permitted into the city, and greedily he begins to count holds shines onto your faces, and when he looks up, he suddenly squints and recognizes you. "Oh, ho! You! Enemies of $PlaceName." he says. "I might be corrupt, but I'm not THAT corrupt!" He calls for reinforcements and guards rush to help you. You are forced to run away, back to the fields at the city's edge from whence you must plan your next move.
column2: 你轻叩侧门，直至守备队长应声。你奉上厚礼，求其放行入城，他贪婪地反复清点金币。忽抬头，骤然眯眼，认出汝等。“哦，呵！汝等！$PlaceName之敌！”他道，“吾虽贪腐，却未至于此！”遂召援兵，卫队蜂拥而来。汝等只得仓皇逃离，退回城郊田野，另谋出路。

column1: You call softly through the sally port until the sergeant of the guard answers. You offer him a stiff bribe to be permitted into the city, and greedily he counts the proffered money again and again. At last he is convinced of your good faith, and opens the sally port, ushering you within.
column2: 你轻叩侧门，直至守备队长应声。你奉上厚礼，求其放行入城，他贪婪地反复清点馈赠。终信汝诚意，开侧门，引汝入城。

column1: You camp as best you can in the awful conditions. Fortunately, you have enough energy to construct a useful shelter in the snow. Here you wait out the blizzard for $Number1 days. Food runs low, and it's hard to protect against frostbite. Finally the blizzard abates.
column2: 你在恶劣环境中勉力扎营。幸而体力尚足，在雪中搭起简易庇所。于此熬过暴风雪$Number1日。粮草渐尽，防冻亦艰。终至风雪稍歇。

column1: You cannot forget the evil thoughts that temporarily ruled your brains, and you feel polluted. You must labor to regain heaven's favor and your own virtue.
column2: 你难以忘怀那短暂支配心智的邪念，自觉污秽。须竭力重获天恩与自身德性。

column1: You cannot resist his orders. Blades are sheathed and you stand there, feeling sheepish.
column2: 你无法违抗其命。刀剑入鞘，伫立其间，羞愧难当。

column1: You cannot resist his suggestion. You sheathe your blades and stand there, feeling sheepish.
column2: 你无法违抗其劝。刀剑入鞘，伫立其间，羞愧难当。

column1: You cannot succeed without a missile weapon.
column2: 若无投射兵器，则难成事。

column1: You carefully explain to the guard sergeant that he has made a mistake, that you are not the people he is looking for. You point out the many obvious differences between your group and the criminals he seeks. Unfortunately, he is having none of it.
column2: 你郑重向守备队长说明其误判，称汝等并非其所寻之人。你指出汝等与通缉罪犯之间诸多明显差异。无奈，他全然不信。

column1: You carefully lay an ambush along a narrow trail, to prevent the bandits from using their superior numbers.
column2: 你沿窄径精心设伏，以防匪徒恃众来袭。

column1: You carefully lay an ambush along a narrow trail. Unfortunately, as they approach your trap, $ChosenOneName adjusts $his position, loses $his balance, and stumbles with a crash into a bush. Alerted, the bandits grab their weapons and rush $him. You have no choice but to spring to $his aid.
column2: 你沿窄径精心设伏。不幸的是，当他们逼近陷阱时，$ChosenOneName调整你的位置，失却平衡，扑入灌木丛中。匪徒闻声持械奔向你。你别无选择，只得挺身相救。

column1: You carefully select which items to leave with the innkeeper. You wrap them all, then seal the wrappings with wax. He locks them in a sub-basement for safekeeping.
column2: 你谨慎挑选寄存于店主之物。悉皆包裹，蜡封其口。店主锁于地下室妥善保管。

column1: You carefully select which items to leave with the innkeeper. You wrap them and seal the wrappings with candle wax. He locks them in a sub-basement for safekeeping.
column2: 你谨慎挑选寄存于店主之物。包裹后蜡封其口。店主锁于地下室妥善保管。

column1: You carefully select which items to leave with the old woman. You wrap them all carefully, then seal the wrappings with candle wax. She locks them in a large trunk for safekeeping.
column2: 你谨慎挑选寄存于老妪之物。悉皆包妥，蜡封其口。她锁于大箱妥善保管。

column1: You carefully sneak out of the $marketplace, but as you round the corner to the street, a dog in a courtyard begins barking!
column2: 你悄然潜出$marketplace，转角处一犬吠叫！

column1: You carry the chest quietly past the sleeping bear, and through the cave. Outside the cave, you open the chest and each of you exclaim at the contents! You congratulate each other on your boldness and the spoils rewarded you!
column2: 你携箱静过眠熊，穿洞而出。洞外开箱，众人惊呼其内所藏！共贺胆识与战利品。
