column1: You catch your breath after the fight and reflect. The fate of these outlaws saddens you. Had their land not been ruined, they would never have become men of evil.
column2: 战罢喘息，默思良久。此等亡命之徒命运令你悲戚。若非故土凋零，岂会堕恶？

column1: You charge through the shattered gate and into the evil robber knight's castle. "$NamedOneName, we have come for you!" you shout. The fight is on.
column2: 你冲破残门，直入恶骑士堡寨。“$NamedOneName，吾等来取汝首！”你高声喝道。厮杀即起。

column1: You chase a mongrel dog out of a ruined chicken coop, brush away the worst of the garbage, and settle down for a dismal meal: thin soup with a few vegetables, plus some half-rotten fruit scavenged from a small market. Nobody says anything, but you all realize that such living won't improve your reputation at all.
column2: 你驱逐废鸡舍野犬，拂去秽物，草草进餐：稀汤杂蔬，兼拾小市半腐果腹。无人言语，然皆知此生难振名望。

column1: You clamber out of the deadly trap and flee down the knoll as if all the devils of hell were in pursuit.
column2: 你脱险逃下丘陵，如蹈鬼域追索。

column1: You clamber out of the deadly trap and flee down the knoll as if all the devils of hell were in pursuit. Only later, when you catch your breath, do you consider the horrible fate of those left behind -- and not even a Christian burial!
column2: 你脱险逃下丘陵，如蹈鬼域追索。及至歇息，方念身后遗骸——竟无基督安葬！

column1: You cogitate. Fifteen different types of potions! Perhaps it would be easier to simply drive the dwarf out of the mines by combat, rather than paying extortion.
column2: 你沉吟良久。十五种药剂！或许与其纳贡，不如武力驱逐矿工。

column1: You come across a Dominican friar with a small crowd of followers. "Hail, good Christians," he says, "I bear blessed news."
column2: 你遇多明我会修士，随众簇拥。“善哉，诸位基督徒，”他言，“我传福音。”

column1: You come to $cityChurch, the church of $PlaceName. It is dark. The priests seem to have gone to bed, but the altar boy is still pottering around.
column2: 你抵$cityChurch，$PlaceName之堂。堂内幽暗，司祭已寝，惟童仆尚忙。

column1: You come to the $cityChurch, the church of $PlaceName. A beggar sits outside, asking for alms. Within the chapel, you hear a priest intoning Mass.
column2: 你抵$cityChurch，$PlaceName之堂。门外乞丐求施，堂内司祭诵弥撒。

column1: You come upon a small glade in the forest. Here, a clear, sweet spring feeds a small brook. Nearby, an old oak shelters a small lean-to. The clearing looks quiet, peaceful, and deserted.
column2: 你见林间小坪，清泉汇流成溪。旁有老橡庇荫，搭一小棚。四野寂静，空无人迹。

column1: You come upon the hapless knight $NamedOneName, drenched in blood. His men lie dead, torn apart by a mighty force.
column2: 你遇不幸骑士$NamedOneName，浑身浴血。其麾下将士皆亡，惨遭巨力撕裂。

column1: You completely defeat the guards, but more rush to the attack. You cannot expect to get over the wall this way. You flee, successfully hiding from the guards in a grove of trees.
column2: 你尽歼守卒，然援兵踵至。此路难逾墙垣。你遁入林间，幸免追捕。

column1: You conclude the guild leader must be a devil-worshipper, perhaps a witch. Carefully wrapping the box, you take it as evidence. You also remember the date, which you suspect could be quite important.
column2: 你断定公会会长必为邪教徒，或巫师。盒裹严实，携作证物。并记日期，料其甚要。

column1: You confer together, then ...
column2: 你商议既毕，乃……

column1: You confidently walk up to the ruined stones and safely recover the $NamedOneName.
column2: 你自信趋近残石，安然取回$NamedOneName。

column1: You confront a weird horseman on an emaciated steed. The man looks as though he had starved for years. His teeth and breath are rotten, and his eyes sunken into their sockets. He holds a balance in one hand. In a thin eerie voice, he whispers, "A measure of wheat for a florin and three measures of barley for a florin."
column2: 你遇怪异骑手，瘦马羸弱。其人似经年饥馑，齿朽气腐，目陷眶中。一手持秤，细声低语：“小麦一斗换佛罗林一枚，大麦三斗亦同。”

column1: You confront a weird horseman on an emaciated steed. The man looks as though he has starved for years. His teeth and breath are rotten, and his eyes sunken into their sockets. He holds a balance in one hand. In a thin eerie voice, he whispers, "A measure of wheat for a florin and three measures of barley for a florin."
column2: 你遇怪异骑手，瘦马羸弱。其人似经年饥馑，齿朽气腐，目陷眶中。一手持秤，细声低语：“小麦一斗换佛罗林一枚，大麦三斗亦同。”

column1: You consider how best to open the box. It is far too heavy to carry with you -- the stone alone must weigh over 500 lbs! Finally, you decide to...
column2: 你筹思开盒之策。石重逾五百磅，难以携带。终决议……

column1: You consider this carefully. The reward and gratitude seem worthy, but the task is hard. The raubritters (robber knights) of Germany are hard men, served by tough warriors.
column2: 你深思熟虑。酬赏与谢意诚可嘉，然任务艰险。德意志盗骑凶悍，麾下勇士亦强。

column1: You consider this. A dragon would explain the great destruction here. But is someone worshiping it?
column2: 你思忖。巨龙或可解此地浩劫。然有人奉之乎？

column1: You consult with one another, then ...
column2: 你相商既毕，乃……

column1: You continue running for a while, hide for the rest of the day and camp without a fire that night, just to make sure they don't find you.
column2: 你疾行一阵，余日潜匿，夜宿无火，以防被寻。

column1: You continue running for a while, hide for the rest of the day and have a cold camp that night, just to make sure they don't find you.
column2: 你疾行一阵，余日潜匿，夜宿寒凉，以防被寻。

column1: You continue the conversation, and it is clear that the poor man was frightened out of his wits by this vision. He is also quite accomodating, and more than willing to support your cause enthusiastically. You leave on exceptionally good terms.
column2: 你续谈，可知贫者因幻象惊恐失措。彼亦通情达理，愿鼎力支持汝志。临别交谊甚笃。

column1: You creep into a concealed position overlooking the way ahead and wait. Eventually you see a little motion.
column2: 你潜伏俯瞰前方，静候。终见微动。

column1: You creep into a concealed position overlooking the way ahead. The trees seem to move in peculiar ways. Then you realize that these 'moving trees' are really green, hairy giants.
column2: 你潜伏俯瞰前方。树影摇曳，似有异状。细察乃绿毛巨形。

column1: You creep into a concealed position overlooking the way ahead. You see dark vines around the trees and rocks, with dark dog-sized shapes creeping among them. "A nest of giant spiders," says $ChosenOneName, "possibly poisonous."
column2: 你潜伏俯瞰前方。树石之间黑藤缠绕，其间蠕动犬般黑影。“巨蛛巢穴，”$ChosenOneName言，“或有毒。”

column1: You creep up to a spot that overlooks the road and see a band of ragged but professional soldiers deployed on both sides, in the brush -- probably mercenaries turned brigand. You decide to...
column2: 你潜至路口，见两侧灌木丛中布阵，衣衫褴褛却训练有素——或为变节佣兵。你决意……

column1: You creep up to a spot that overlooks the road and see a group of dirty, ragged bandits. You decide to...
column2: 你潜至路口，见污秽匪徒一群。你决意……

column1: You creep up to a spot that overlooks the road and see a well-drilled group of professional soldiers deployed along the road, in the brush. You decide to...
column2: 你潜至路口，见专业士兵列阵于路边灌木间。你决意……

column1: You creep up to the sally port and carefully apply the Eater Water to hinges and lock bars. There is a soft hissing, then you catch the door as it gradually topples forward. Quietly you all creep into the city.
column2: 你潜至城门，将食钉水轻抹铰链与锁杠。微响之后，门徐徐倾倒。尔等悄然入城。

column1: You cut down the sleeping guard first. His dying gurgle alerts the rest, who jump up from their sleep. In a split second they are on you, weapons swinging.
column2: 你先斩睡卫。其临终喉鸣惊醒同伙，旋即持刃扑上。

column1: You cut up a rope and try to lash together a raft, but fail. Desperate, you try to find higher ground. As the water rises, you must discard more and more equipment. Finally, almost swimming, you discover a hillock and crawl to safety.
column2: 你割绳结筏，终不成。绝望之际觅高地。水涨弃装愈多。终涉水攀丘，得脱。

column1: You cut your way through the cordon of guards, but cannot climb the wall before reinforcements arrive. Rather than be trapped like rats, you run away and make new plans.
column2: 你突袭守军，然援兵未至，难越墙垣。为免困死，你撤退另谋良策。

column1: You dash around a corner down an alley, pouring the potion behind you. The first pursuer pounds after you, then falls flat when the gooey mess glues his feet to the cobblestones.
column2: 你拐入巷尾，泼洒药剂于后。追兵紧逼，甫至便被黏液粘足，仆倒在地。

column1: You dash away, quickly eluding the night watch. It takes only a couple of fast detours to regain your original route and destination.
column2: 你疾驰而去，迅避夜巡。几番捷径，复归原途。

column1: You dash for the nearest door, weapons in hand, pushing aside alarmed guildsmen. Cries of "Thief, thief!" follow you down a back alley.
column2: 你持械奔向近门，推搡惊惶公会成员。背后“贼子，贼子！”之声不绝。

column1: You dash forward through the gate into a city street, before more guards appear. Meanwhile frightened merchants and peasants are scattering in all directions.
column2: 你冲入门内，入城街前，援兵未至。商贾百姓四散奔逃。

column1: You dash forward through the gate into a city street, before more guards appear. Meanwhile, frightened merchants and peasants are scattering in all directions.
column2: 你冲入门内，入城街前，援兵未至。商贾百姓四散奔逃。

column1: You dash through the gate away from the city before more guards appear.
column2: 你冲出门外，离城之前，援兵未至。

column1: You decide that either you picked the wrong time, or you just aren't sneaky enough. Perhaps you'll have better luck another day, after people calm down.
column2: 你断定或时机不当，或隐匿不足。或待人心稍定，再试不迟。

column1: You decide that the person who will learn this formula is...
column2: 你断定习得此法之人乃……

column1: You decide to concentrate on other things.
column2: 你决定专务他事。

column1: You decide to either seek something else, or come back another day when, perhaps, the staff will be more helpful.
column2: 你决定要么另寻他处，要么改日再来，或许那时店员会更乐于助人。

column1: You decide to invest some time discovering...
column2: 你决定花些时间去探寻……

column1: You decline their offer, saying your route lies elsewhere. The merchants nod their understanding, but the guards eye you suspiciously. The caravan moves off, leaving you alone once more.
column2: 你谢绝了他们的邀请，称你的行程另有安排。商人们点头表示理解，但卫兵却对你投以怀疑的目光。商队启程离去，你再次孤身一人。

column1: You defeat the guards utterly. Turning your backs on their bleeding bodies, you go about your business.
column2: 你彻底击溃了卫兵。背弃他们血泊中的躯体，继续前行。

column1: You descend the cliff carefully, regaining the bottom with only your pride injured.
column2: 你小心翼翼地攀下悬崖，仅损了些许自尊便重返谷底。

column1: You did it! The iron door slowly creaks open. When you enter, you are confronted with a stunted figure, who speaks.
column2: 你成功了！铁门缓缓开启。踏入其中，迎面而见一矮小身影，开口说道。

column1: You dig industriously, uncovering a rotting coffin filled with shreds of leathery flesh and dusky bones. Disturbing the dead's rest is never a good idea; in this place, it now seems doubly unwise.
column2: 你辛勤挖掘，发现一口腐朽的棺椁，内藏皮肉残片与灰暗骸骨。扰动亡者安息从非善举；在此地，此举尤显不智。

column1: You discover him to be a spy from a neighboring principality. The envelop contains details maps of $PlaceName's defenses, and a letter from the guild leader that clearly reveals his treason to all.
column2: 你识破此人乃邻国密探。信封内藏$PlaceName防御详图，以及一封公会首领来信，其叛逆之举尽皆昭然若揭。

column1: You discover she is a beautiful widow wearing nothing but a transparent nightgown under the cloak! In her shame, she tells all.
column2: 你发现她是一位美丽寡妇，斗篷之下唯着一件透明睡袍！羞怯之下，她和盘托出。

column1: You discover she is a beautiful widow wearing nothing but a transparent nightgown under the cloak! Nervous and afraid, she brings you into her home and tells all.
column2: 你发现她是一位美丽寡妇，斗篷之下唯着一件透明睡袍！惊慌失措中，她引你入室，倾诉一切。

column1: You discover she is a beautiful widow wearing nothing but a transparent nightgown under the cloak! She loses her nerve when confronted.
column2: 你发现她是一位美丽寡妇，斗篷之下唯着一件透明睡袍！面对质问，她终于坦白。

column1: You discover she is a beautiful widow with nothing but a transparent nightgown under the cloak! She tells all when confronted with naked steel.
column2: 你发现她是一位美丽寡妇，斗篷之下唯着一件透明睡袍！直面锋刃，她吐露真相。

column1: You discover she is a nun from the convent associated with the $monastery. The appearance of cold steel encourages her to tell all she knows.
column2: 你发现她是与$monastery相连修道院的修女。冷冽钢刀令她知无不言。

column1: You discover that $PlaceName is full of discontent. Some people critize the city council and talk about forcing free elections. Others support the council, saying the critics are hostile infiltrators trying to take control of the city.
column2: 你察觉$PlaceName民心不满。有人抨击市政议会，欲强行推行自由选举；亦有人力挺议会，斥责反对者为敌对渗透者，意夺城权。

column1: You discover that the Blacksmiths' guild $VarPhrase1 changes in the government of $PlaceName.
column2: 你得知铁匠公会$VarPhrase1支持$PlaceName政府变革。

column1: You discover that the Boyers' and Gunsmiths' guilds $VarPhrase1 changes in the government of $PlaceName.
column2: 你得知木匠与枪匠公会$VarPhrase1支持$PlaceName政府变革。

column1: You discover that the Clothmakers' guild $VarPhrase1 changes in the city government.
column2: 你得知织工公会$VarPhrase1支持市政府变革。

column1: You discover, to your horror, that the salt water has ruined many alchemical ingredients, and damaged a number of other items. Everyone carefully checks their possessions.
column2: 你骇然发现，咸水已毁坏诸多炼金原料，并损及多件物品。众人皆仔细清点随身之物。

column1: You discuss it further, and it is clear that $he will leave as soon as you can't pay, or when the thirty days are up, whichever comes first.
column2: 你进一步商议，可知你一旦无资可付，或三十日届满，即刻离去，以先到者为准。

column1: You discuss the current situation in $PlaceName, and discover that the cleric and his followers $Support the idea of a change in the government. You...
column2: 你讨论$PlaceName现状，得知教士及其追随者$Support反对政府变革。你……

column1: You discuss the current situation in $PlaceName. Currently he and his followers $Support any change in the government of $PlaceName. You...
column2: 你讨论$PlaceName现状。目前他及其追随者$Support反对$PlaceName政府变革。你……

column1: You discuss the match, and agree that the usual forfeit (the loser's armor and horse) does not apply in friendly contests such as this. However, the knight promises to speak truly of this encounter. You appreciate this gesture, for in explaining his defeat, he will no doubt exaggerate the abilities of $ChosenOneName.
column2: 你商讨比武，约定寻常罚则（败者甲胄与战马）于此等友好较量中不适用。然骑士允诺如实述说此役。你感其诚意，因他必将在解释败因时夸大$ChosenOneName之能。

column1: You discuss the matter, and discover the $NamedTwoName is indeed a reward for a certain task. You listen as $NamedOneName explains...
column2: 你商议此事，得知$NamedTwoName实为某项任务之酬劳。你聆听$NamedOneName解说……

column1: You discuss things in a light but pleasant matter for a while, and it is clear that he and his followers now $Support changes in the government.
column2: 你与他闲谈片刻，气氛轻松愉悦，可见其及追随者如今$Support支持政府变革。

column1: You discuss your dreams and prophecies with him, which he takes quite seriously. "You are embarked on a quest of dire importance. If it helps any, they said something about going from the Monastery, $Direction2 of $LocName2, to the Sabbat on $SabbatTime, $SabbatLocation."
column2: 你与他共论梦境与预言，彼甚为重视。“汝正踏上一段至关重要的征程。若有所助，彼曾言须自修道院，$Direction2之$LocName2，赴$SabbatTime之$SabbatLocation的萨巴特。”

column1: You dispatch your assailants quickly, but others from around the field are running in your direction, and other travellers are coming up the path. Escape seems impossible.
column2: 你迅速击退来犯者，然四野之人奔向此处，沿途亦有旅人逼近。逃遁几无可能。

column1: You do not impress the priests sufficiently to gain an audience with their superior, the master of this cathedral. "Perhaps some other day," they suggest.
column2: 你未能打动诸僧，难获大殿主事者的接见。“或可择日再访，”彼等建议。

column1: You do so, but once you're out of sight, you...
column2: 你依言行事，然一俟隐匿视线，你……

column1: You do so. The cantor and a few assistants perform the Mass alone. The chapel is dusty, and it seems strange to you that so few monks are here. However, the Mass seems as beautiful as ever.
column2: 你依言行事。唱经师偕数名助手独自主持弥撒。礼拜堂尘埃弥漫，寥寥僧侣令你倍感异样。然弥撒之美一如往昔。

column1: You do so; he grabs the money, then leaves the door open as promised. Minutes later you're strolling along a small side street.
column2: 你依言行事；彼接过银两，随即依约留门敞开。数分钟后，你漫步于一条僻巷。

column1: You dodge into an alley and watch. You could have been leading this, if you had remained loyal to the cause. Now you can only wonder about the outcome. Meanwhile, it is impossible to use the main street. You retreat to a side street and reconsider your destination...
column2: 你闪入小巷观望。若当初忠于本职，今日或可主导局势。如今唯有遥想结局。与此同时，主街已不可通行。你退至侧街，重新斟酌去向……

column1: You dodge into an alley and watch. You could have been trying to stop this, if you had remained loyal to your employer. Now you can only wonder about the outcome. Meanwhile, it is impossible to use the main street. You retreat to a side street and reconsider your destination...
column2: 你闪入小巷观望。若当初忠于雇主，今日或可设法阻止此事。如今唯有遥想结局。与此同时，主街已不可通行。你退至侧街，重新斟酌去向……

column1: You dodge into an alley and watch. You realize that involvement for or against this cause would have provided great opportunities for advancement and fame. Now you can only wonder about the outcome. Meanwhile, it is impossible to use the main street. You retreat to a side street and reconsider your destination...
column2: 你闪入小巷观望。你意识到，无论投身此役与否，皆可成就功名。如今唯有遥想结局。与此同时，主街已不可通行。你退至侧街，重新斟酌去向……

column1: You don't even look. The sound of four voices bawling in fear is enough to make your blood run cold. "Took 'em afore they was baptized," the woman cackles. "All right, get to work." She leaves.
column2: 你连看都不看一眼。四声恐惧的嚎叫已足以令你毛骨悚然。“还没来得及受洗就被掳走了，”那妇人咯咯笑道，“好了，干活去吧。”她转身离去。

column1: You don't like the land you're walking over. It looks sere and dry, and you feel a sort of mental oppression. Suddenly, you hear a harsh caw, and turn to see gray, twisted shapes flapping toward you. They look like some sort of gargoylish hellspawn!
column2: 你厌恶脚下的土地。荒芜干涸，心中顿生压抑。忽闻一声厉鸣，回首只见灰黑扭曲之物扑面而来。形如某种石像鬼般的恶灵！

column1: You don't want to find out. So, you ...
column2: 你不欲深究。于是，你……

column1: You double back over a low hill and move through a series of stream valleys, taking the long way around the place. Near evening, you finally return to the trail and reorient yourselves. Tomorrow you can resume your journey. In camp that night you mourn those left behind, now carried off and eaten by the spiders.
column2: 你绕过低丘，穿行溪谷，迂回绕行该地。近黄昏时，终重返旧径，重新定位。明日可续行程。夜宿营中，悼念那些被蜘蛛掳走吞食的同伴。

column1: You double back over a low hill and move through a series of stream valleys, taking the long way around the place. Near evening, you finally return to the trail and reorient yourselves. Tomorrow you can resume your journey. In camp you rejoice when those you had left behind for dead stagger in to the firelight, still alive!
column2: 你绕过低丘，穿行溪谷，迂回绕行该地。近黄昏时，终重返旧径，重新定位。明日可续行程。夜宿营中，欢庆那些本以为已死的同伴踉跄入火光，尚存生机！

column1: You draw weapons and prepare for a fight.
column2: 你拔剑备战。

column1: You duck into the brush, move through a series of gullies, and finally work you way around the site. Near evening, you creep out onto a hillside and reorient yourselves. Tomorrow you can resume your journey.
column2: 你钻入灌丛，穿越沟壑，终绕过此地。近黄昏时，悄然登上山坡，重新定位。明日可续行程。

column1: You duck into the brush, move through a series of gullies, and finally work you way around the site. Near evening, you creep out onto a hillside and reorient yourselves. Tomorrow you can resume your journey. In camp that night you mourn those left behind, now eaten by the tatzelwurm.
column2: 你钻入灌丛，穿越沟壑，终绕过此地。近黄昏时，悄然登上山坡，重新定位。明日可续行程。夜宿营中，悼念那些被塔策尔蠕虫吞噬的同伴。

column1: You each dip a finger in the ointment, and smear it across your face. The witches, fearful and uncertain, give your leader just enough time to chant the proper words. Using your weapons as "steeds," you rise into the air and soar away to freedom.
column2: 你每人蘸指涂药，遍抹面庞。女巫们惶恐不安，仅给领队些许时间诵咒。借武器为“坐骑”，腾空而去，重获自由。

column1: You each dip a finger in the vial, and smear the ointment across your face. The witches, fearful and uncertain, give your leader just enough time to chant the proper words. Using your weapons as "steeds," you rise into the air and soar away.
column2: 你每人蘸指涂药，遍抹面庞。女巫们惶恐不安，仅给领队些许时间诵咒。借武器为“坐骑”，腾空而去。

column1: You each dip a finger in the vial, and smear the ointment across your face. The witches, fearful and uncertain, give your leader just enough time to chant the words; using your weapons as "steeds," you rise into the air and soar away to freedom.
column2: 你每人蘸指涂药，遍抹面庞。女巫们惶恐不安，仅给领队足够时间诵咒；借武器为“坐骑”，腾空而去，重获自由。

column1: You each dip a finger in the vial. The witches, fearful and uncertain, give $ChosenOneName just enough time to chant the proper words. Using your weapons as "steeds," you rise into the air and soar away to freedom.
column2: 你每人蘸指涂药。女巫们惶恐不安，仅给$ChosenOneName足够时间诵咒。借武器为“坐骑”，腾空而去，重获自由。

column1: You each submit in turn to the soaking and the harsh words of the man in the black robes. Though you are dipped in water, you come away feeling more unclean than when you started. Once the ceremony is over, you hurry away.
column2: 你们依次接受黑袍男子的浸洗与严词训诫。虽经水洗，归来时却觉污秽更深。仪式既毕，匆匆离去。

column1: You eagerly agree, since this is the cheapest possible way to get knowledge of a new formula.
column2: 你欣然应允，因这是获取新方剂知识最廉价之途。

column1: You elude the bandits, but realize that it's now too dangerous to camp in this area. You must move on.
column2: 你避过匪徒，却深知此地已不宜扎营。只得继续前行。

column1: You elude the bandits, but realize that it's now too dangerous to camp in this area. You must move one.
column2: 你避过匪徒，却深知此地已不宜扎营。只得迁徙。

column1: You emerge behind the wall, stinking and dripping foul sludge. Even after careful bathing and cleaning, the smell will accompany you for days.
column2: 你从墙后现身，浑身恶臭，泥浆淋漓。纵经仔细沐浴清洗，异味仍将伴随数日。

column1: You encounter a small group of refugees. Men and women trudge along with all their clothes and household goods on their backs. Some are staggering from sickness, a few are on litters. Even the children struggle along wearily.
column2: 你遇見一小群難民。男女背負著衣物與家當，步履蹣跚。有人因病虛弱不堪，幾人臥於擔架之上。連孩童亦疲憊地勉力前行。

column1: You encounter the burnt-out ruin of a castle keep. The heat of the fire destroyed the doors, gates, and various floor supports, so it is now just an empty shell inhabited by mice, squirrels and birds.
column2: 你遇見一座城堡主塔的焦燼廢墟。烈火焚毀了門戶、城門及各層樑柱，如今只剩空殼，為鼠、松鼠與鳥雀所居。

column1: You encounter the burnt-out ruin of a castle keep. The heat of the fire destroyed the doors, gates, and various floor supports, so it is now just an empty shell, inhabited by mice, squirrels and birds.
column2: 你遇見一座城堡主塔的焦燼廢墟。烈火焚毀了門戶、城門及各層樑柱，如今只剩空殼，為鼠、松鼠與鳥雀所居。

column1: You enter the guard's chamber, and examine a writing desk strewn with papers. Among them is a list of passwords ("Beelzebub forever!" and "Captain Satan" are today's). Other papers mention that this, the fortress monastery of $PlaceName, is the first line of defense between the evil humans and the 'Master.' You shudder to think who or what this might be.
column2: 你步入守衛室，細察一張堆滿文紙的書案。其間有密碼清單（「別西卜永存！」與「撒旦上尉」乃今日之用）。另有文書記載，此處——$PlaceName號要塞修道院——乃邪惡人類與「主宰」之間的第一道防線。你不禁顫慄，思忖此「主宰」究為何物。

column1: You escape the battle, but that leaves the thugs to pursue their nefarious designs against the guild.
column2: 你脫離戰場，然暴徒仍得遂其陰謀，加害於公會。

column1: You examine the guard's desk, including a list of passwords ("Beelzebub forever!" and "Captain Satan" are today's). Other papers mention that this fortress monastery is the first line of defense between the evil humans and the 'glorious leader.'  You shudder to think what this must be.
column2: 你查看守卫的书桌，桌上有一份密码清单（“别西卜万岁！”和“撒旦队长”是今日之密）。其他纸张提到，这座堡垒修道院是邪恶人类与“荣耀领袖”之间的第一道防线。想到这必定是什么，你不寒而栗。

column1: You examine the horns more closely, pushing and poking, twisting and turning. As you twist the horns in just the right way, there is a metallic noise and an audible sigh. Further investigation of the other horns yields nothing new.
column2: 你仔细端详那对号角，推拉、戳弄、扭动、翻转。当你以恰到好处的角度扭动号角时，发出一声金属的响声，随之是一声隐约的叹息。进一步检查其他号角，并无新发现。

column1: You explain gently to the man that he is mistaken, but he will have none of it. "I know what I see," he mutters, moving off. You go your own way, but you know that you must be more careful: your suspicious activities have not gone unnoticed.
column2: 你温和地向那人解释他弄错了，但他丝毫不为所动。“我亲眼所见，”他嘟囔着，转身离去。你继续前行，却深知必须更加谨慎：你的可疑行径已被人察觉。

column1: You explain who you are and why you are here. The group promises to disperse, and to engage in witchcraft no more!
column2: 你说明了自己的身份与来意。众人承诺解散，不再从事巫术！

column1: You face the demonic form, weapons at the ready.
column2: 你面对着恶魔的化身，武器已蓄势待发。

column1: You fail to conceal yourself properly. In $NamedOneName hours you see the city watch approaching with torches and lanterns. You are forced to abandon your hiding place and slip away down the side streets.
column2: 你未能妥善藏身。$NamedOneName小时后，你见城卫持火把与灯笼逼近。你被迫弃匿身处，悄然遁入侧街。

column1: You fall back across the hillside, out of sight. As you depart, the sound of battle fades away.
column2: 你退至山坡后方，隐于视线之外。随着你的离去，战鼓之声渐息。

column1: You fall back around a corner, sheath your weapons, and vault over a low wall into an old garden. From there you retreat down a series of small alleys, eventually outdistancing the pursuing watchmen. Finally you pause to rest and get your bearings.
column2: 你拐过一个街角，收起武器，跃过一道矮墙，进入一座古老的花园。随后沿着一连串的小巷撤退，最终甩开了追来的守卫。最后你停下脚步，稍作休息，辨明方向。

column1: You fall back over the hillside, at first pursued by the bandits -- but then they break off the chase. You hide in the brush until you're sure they're gone.
column2: 你跌落山坡，起初被匪徒追赶——但随后他们放弃了追击。你在灌木丛中藏身，直到确信他们已离去。

column1: You feel ashamed at leaving the poor Franciscan to his fate at the hands of the unholy monks.
column2: 你因将那可怜的方济各会修士弃之于不洁僧侣之手而深感羞愧。

column1: You feel ashamed for wreaking such destruction on a defenseless widow. She refuses all offers of compensation, saying, "Money doesn't buy peace."
column2: 你为对一位手无寸铁的寡妇施下如此毁灭而感到羞愧。她拒绝一切赔偿，说道：“金钱买不来安宁。”

column1: You feel much more confident, and continue your travels.
column2: 你倍感自信，继续踏上旅程。

column1: You feel sad that the Hussite rebels consider you such, but then, you expected as much from these Czech zealots.
column2: 你为胡斯派叛军如此看待自己而感到悲伤，但转念一想，你也早已料到这些捷克狂热分子会如此。

column1: You fight heroically, and actually kill one lancer and a couple of goblin-beasts. In the end, you are all badly wounded, but you know you have fought well. One of the lancers says, "You have shown valor. We relinquish the Sword of War, but know that its effect is grim. Your wounds shall never heal."
column2: 你英勇奋战，竟杀了一名长枪兵与数只地精兽。最终，你们皆身负重伤，却知己身已竭尽全力。一名长枪兵言道：“汝等显赫勇武。吾等愿交出战之剑，然须知其效甚惨。汝等之伤，永难愈合。”

column1: You fight heroically, but are overcome in the end. The uninjured lancers says firmly, "You have shown valor, but not skill. Know that your wounds shall never heal."
column2: 你英勇奋战，终被击败。未受伤的枪骑兵坚定地说：“汝已显勇武，却无技艺。须知汝之伤永不愈合。”

column1: You finally decide to ...
column2: 你终于决定……

column1: You find a corner out of the wind, wrap yourselves in your cloaks, and let the time pass.
column2: 你寻得一处避风的角落，裹紧斗篷，任时光流逝。

column1: You find a decrepit, half-ruined townhouse occupied by beggars, dim-witted paupers, and a crazy old man. You settle into an upstairs room with a broken ceiling, boil some vegetable into a soup for dinner, and curl up for a good sleep. Nobody says anything, but you all realize that such living won't improve your reputation at all.
column2: 你发现一座破败半毁的宅邸，住着乞丐、愚钝的贫民与一位疯癫的老者。你在一间天花板破损的楼上房间安顿下来，煮了些蔬菜熬成汤当晚餐，便蜷缩着安然入睡。无人言语，但你们都明白，如此生活绝难提升声望。

column1: You find a hollow concealed by brush and make a cold camp. You make no fire, eat quietly and rest. Each day $ChosenOneName sneaks out to check on the army's progress.
column2: 你寻得一处灌木掩映的洞穴，扎下寒营。不燃篝火，悄然进食，静待休憩。每日$ChosenOneName悄然外出，探查大军行迹。

column1: You find a locked cabinet that looks promising, but $ChosenOneName cannot get it open. Eventually the lock jams completely. Unfortunately, the cabinet's materials are quite resistant to alchemical potions. This appears to be a dead end.
column2: 你发现一只看似颇有希望的锁柜，但$ChosenOneName无法将其打开。最终，锁彻底卡死。不幸的是，柜体材质对炼金药剂颇具抵抗力。看来此路不通。

column1: You find a secret, locked chest. $ChosenOneName quickly and skillfully opens it.
column2: 你发现一只秘藏的锁箱。$ChosenOneName 迅速而娴熟地将其开启。

column1: You find an old friend, $ChosenOneName, who has serious debt problems. $He explains $his situation.
column2: 你遇见了一位老友，$ChosenOneName，他正为沉重的债务所困。你 解释了 你的 的情况。

column1: You find that $PlaceName is full of discontent. Many critize the decisions of $CityLordName, the $CityLordTitle. They talk about marching on the $Fortress and creating a new government. Others loudly support $CityLordName. They claim all rebels are dupes of foreign agents who seek to install a usper.
column2: 你发现$PlaceName内满是不满。许多人指责$CityLordName，即$CityLordTitle的决策。他们谈论着进军$Fortress，建立新政府。另一些人则高声支持$CityLordName，声称所有叛乱者都是外国特务的傀儡，意图扶植暴君。

column1: You find that guards with cocked crossbows have surrounded you. In minutes you are escorted to the door.
column2: 你发现持弩的卫兵已将你团团围住。片刻之间，你便被押送至门前。

column1: You find that the city guardsmen have already deserted, but the personal guards of the $CityLordTitle remain, guarding their master.
column2: 你发现城里的卫兵已然逃散，但$CityLordTitle的亲卫仍在，守护着他们的主人。

column1: You find the footing soft and strangely unstable, but continue. Suddenly, the ground beneath $ChosenOneName gives way and $he falls into a stinking pool of muck up to $his chest. A peat bog!
column2: 你发现脚下松软而莫名不稳，但仍继续前行。突然，$ChosenOneName 脚下的地面塌陷，$he 跌入一潭臭气熏天的淤泥，直没至腰。是泥炭沼！

column1: You find the lord here rules with an iron fist. The peasants and servants creep about in fear of punishment. So do the lord's retainers, except when they are alone with their juniors, whom they bully unmercifully. You suspect $PlaceName is not a happy place.
column2: 你发现此地的领主以铁腕统治。农奴与仆从因惧惩罚而战战兢兢。领主的家臣亦然，唯独在独处时欺凌下属，毫不留情。你怀疑$PlaceName并非乐土。

column1: You finish the prayer and hear one of the cooks shriek in dismay.
column2: 你念完祷文，听见其中一名厨子惊恐地尖叫。

column1: You finish the prayer, and hear one of the cooks shriek in dismay.
column2: 你念完祷文，听见其中一名厨子惊恐地尖叫。

column1: You finish your prayer and wait patiently. Nothing. The guards patrol as before. Finally, $ChosenOneName remarks on the obvious.
column2: 你诵完祷文，耐心等待。毫无动静。守卫依旧如常巡逻。终于，$ChosenOneName指出了显而易见的事实。

column1: You flash a few silver pieces, but the night watchman just laughs in your face.
column2: 你亮出几枚银币，但夜巡者只是当面嘲笑你。

column1: You flee in panic.
column2: 你惊慌失措地逃窜。

column1: You flee the peasants with alacrity, but they mount fast steeds and, after a long and tiring chase, catch up with you. You are forced to pull up and prepare to fight. They dismount, draw weapons, and advance on you.
column2: 你迅速逃离农夫们，但他们骑着快马，在一场漫长而疲惫的追逐后追上了你。你被迫勒马，准备迎战。他们下马，拔出武器，向你逼近。

column1: You flow along with the crowd, entering the city unnoticed.
column2: 你随人流而行，悄然入城。

column1: You follow him, while clerks and guards bow as if he were the King of Bohemia. He ushers you into the council chamber where, miraculously, all other business has been temporarily put aside.
column2: 你跟随其后，而文吏与卫兵皆躬身行礼，仿佛他是波希米亚之王。他引领你进入议事厅，奇迹般地，所有其他事务皆被暂时搁置。

column1: You follow him, while clerks and guards bow, as if he were the King of Bohemia. He ushers you into the audience chamber where, miraculously, all other business has been temporarily put aside.
column2: 你跟随其后，文吏与卫兵皆躬身行礼，仿佛他是波希米亚之王。他引领你进入觐见厅堂，奇迹般地，所有政务皆暂且搁置。

column1: You follow him, while clerks and guards watch. They seem transfixed by his dignity. He ushers you into the audience chamber where, miraculously, all other business has been temporarily put aside.
column2: 你跟随其后，而文吏与卫士皆在旁注视。他们似乎为其威仪所慑。他引领你进入觐见厅，奇迹般地，所有其他事务皆被暂时搁置。

column1: You follow him, while clerks and guards watch. They seem transfixed by his dignity. He ushers you into the council chamber where, miraculously, all other business has been temporarily put aside.
column2: 你跟随其后，而文吏与卫兵皆在旁注视。他们似为其威仪所慑。他引领你进入议事厅，奇迹般地，所有其他事务皆暂且搁置。

column1: You follow his instructions, praying and listening to the monastic chants.
column2: 你遵从他的指示，祈祷并聆听修道院的圣歌。

column1: You follow the directions on the poster, and soon come to a nice-looking house just off the main way. Your knock brings a rather bizarre-looking gentleman to the door; his eyes pop out of his head in an expression of perpetual surprise, and his hair is wildly tousled. He smiles and invites you in.
column2: 你循着海报上的指引，不久便来到一条主道旁的一座雅致宅邸。敲门声引来一位相貌颇为奇特的绅士；他双眼圆睁，似永远处于惊诧之状，头发更是蓬乱不堪。他微笑着邀你入内。

column1: You follow the directions on the poster, and soon come to a nice-looking house on the street of the moneylenders. A fat manservant greets you and, after hearing why you have come, ushers you into a sumptuous room. Here he bids you wait for the coming of his master, $NamedOneName.
column2: 你循着海报上的指引，不久便来到钱庄街一座气派的宅邸。一名肥胖的仆人迎上前来，听闻来意后，引你入一间华美的厅堂。他命你在此等候其主人$NamedOneName的到来。

column1: You follow the directions on the poster, through the darkened streets, until you come to a rather nice-looking house just off the main square. The same poster you saw before is hanging on the door, with a hand-scrawled note "knock." So you do.
column2: 你循着海报上的指引，穿过幽暗的街巷，直至来到一座紧邻主广场、颇为体面的宅邸。门上悬挂着先前见过的那张海报，旁有一行手书：“敲门。”于是你照做了。

column1: You follow the directions on the poster, through the darkened streets, until you come to a rather nice-looking house on the street of the moneylenders.
column2: 你循着海报上的指引，穿过昏暗的街巷，直至来到钱庄街上一座颇为体面的宅邸。

column1: You follow this secretive person, then pull her into a side alley, saying, "Tell us everything about the guild leader, and your life will be spared."
column2: 你尾随此人，随即将其拉入一条侧巷，说道：“把公会首领的一切都告诉我们，便可饶你不死。”

column1: You gather up the gleaming items, figuring their value on the open market at about a florin. As the silver is pried from the desk, an eerie moaning fills the room.
column2: 你拾起那些闪闪发光的物品，估摸着在公开市场上价值约一弗罗林。当银币从桌上被撬开时，一阵诡异的呻吟声充斥了整个房间。

column1: You gently ask him what he speaks of, and he replies, "Thief ... stole from the monster's hoard ... dragon ... crazed with greed ... cannot bear the loss of a single coin ... you must find ..." He starts to cough, and you leave off questioning. You take him to a nearby farm to heal, and move on.
column2: 你温和地问他所言为何，他答道：“盗贼……偷了怪物的宝藏……巨龙……贪婪至狂……无法忍受哪怕一枚金币的损失……你必须找到……”他开始咳嗽，你便不再追问。你将他带到附近的农庄疗伤，随后继续前行。

column1: You get a close look at his face, and it is not pleasant. Aside from being quite ugly, it is twisted with hatred.
column2: 你仔细端详他的面容，令人不悦。除了相貌丑陋之外，还满是仇恨之色。

column1: You get back onto the boat and reconsider your plans.
column2: 你重新登上小舟，重新思量自己的计划。

column1: You get the guard's attention with a handful of silver, then gesture to the sally port door. He opens a peep-hole and you give him a closer look at your coins, $Money1. He rubs his chin thoughtfully.
column2: 你以一把银币引起守卫注意，随即示意他打开侧门。他推开窥视孔，你将你的钱币递到他眼前，$Money1。他若有所思地抚着下巴。

column1: You get the watchman's attention with a handful of silver. "Go to the sally port," he asks, "I need a closer look."
column2: 你以一把银币引起守夜人的注意。“去侧门看看，”他道，“我要仔细瞧瞧。”

column1: You gingerly take it.
column2: 你小心翼翼地接过它。

column1: You gird up your loins and set forth.
column2: 你振作精神，启程前行。

column1: You glance at each other in relief, then offer a prayer of thanksgiving.
column2: 你们相视一笑，如释重负，随即献上感恩之祷。

column1: You glance at each other nervously; then $ChosenOneName speaks gently to the ghost. "Why are you here? Why do you haunt the dreams of mortal men?"
column2: 你们面面相觑，略显紧张；随后$ChosenOneName轻声对鬼魂说道：“汝为何在此？何故萦绕凡人之梦？”

column1: You glance at each other. $ChosenOneName, realizing that ghosts have limited abilities to converse with humans, says, "Are you in pain?"
column2: 你们互相对视。$ChosenOneName深知鬼魂与人交谈有限，遂问：“汝可有苦痛？”

column1: You glance through the iron grating on this solid oak door, and are delighted to see $NamedOneName inside! "The key is hanging there beside the door," $he says, and sure enough there is a rough iron key on a hook just out of reach of the prisoners.
column2: 你透过这扇坚固橡木门上的铁栅远望，欣喜地见内有$NamedOneName！“钥匙挂在门旁，”你道，果然有一把粗铁钥匙悬于囚徒触及不到的钩上。

column1: You go aboard and find your places. The boat will sail in $Number1 hours. You store your gear as you wait for it to cast off...
column2: 你登船入座。小舟将于$Number1小时后启航。你收拾好行装，静候开船……

column1: You go your way, and he goes his. Beware! Your suspicious activities have not gone unnoticed.
column2: 你各奔前路，他也如此。小心！你的可疑行径已被人察觉。

column1: You grab a few pieces of junk wood and quietly lower yourselves into the cold, murky water. Slowly and quietly you paddle, letting the currents carry you silently away from the city.
column2: 你拾起几块朽木，悄然潜入冰冷浑浊的水中。你缓缓划桨，任水流无声地将你带离城池。

column1: You grab for your weapons, but he claps on a red hat and immediately disappears. Shrugging off his threats, you continue. You think over his words ... he mentioned a "gnome fountain."
column2: 你伸手取武器，但他一戴红帽，即刻消失无踪。你置其威胁于不顾，继续前行。你细思其言——他曾提及“矮人喷泉”。

column1: You gradually recover, mourn your missing comrade, and leave before the spiders return for more!
column2: 你渐渐恢复，哀悼逝去的同伴，趁蜘蛛未归，先行离去！

column1: You groan, realizing that their mathematics is no better than their choice of gods.
column2: 你无奈叹息，方知他们的算术不及其神祇之选。

column1: You have a premonition that there is some truth in the farmer's tale, but you say nothing.
column2: 你预感农夫之言或有几分真意，却默然不语。

column1: You have a sense of missing something.
column2: 你总觉得少了些什么。

column1: You have accomplished that most heroic and difficult of tasks. You have slain the dragon $NamedTwoName! As it collapses in death, the ground begins to shake. Amid choking clouds of brimstone, a huge crevasse opens in the cavern. The dragon's body, the ancient ruins, and most of the golden horde fall into the pit. Only a fraction of the monster's hoard is left for you to take, but that fraction is enough to make you all wealthy.
column2: 你完成了那最为英勇而艰难的壮举。你已斩杀巨龙$NamedTwoName！当它倒地毙命，大地随之震颤。硫磺浓烟弥漫之际，洞窟裂开一道巨缝。巨龙尸身、古迹废墟及大半金库尽坠深渊。仅余残金供你取用，却已足使众人富甲一方。

column1: You have accomplished that most heroic and difficult of tasks. You have slain the dragon $NamedTwoName! As it collapses, you suddenly hear the angry roaring of demons. Hell has been foiled by the death of its champion. The monster's body explodes. When the smoke clears, the dragon is gone and the cavern in a ruin of collapsed stone. Only a fraction of the monster's hoard is left, but that is enough to make you all wealthy.
column2: 你完成了那最为英勇而艰难的壮举。你已斩杀巨龙$NamedTwoName！当它倒下，忽闻恶魔怒吼。地狱因麾下猛将之死而功亏一篑。巨龙尸身轰然炸裂。烟消云散，巨龙不见，洞窟尽成碎石废墟。仅余残金，却已足使众人富甲一方。

column1: You have accomplished that most heroic and difficult of tasks. You have slain the dragon $NamedTwoName! As it sinks back in death, its boiling-hot blood pours over the cavern floor. You jump back from the hideous black pool.
column2: 你完成了那最为英勇而艰难的壮举。你已斩杀巨龙$NamedTwoName！当它垂死沉落，滚烫热血倾泻洞底。你惊惧退避，远离那黑浊血池。

column1: You have accomplished that most heroic and difficult of tasks. You have slain the dragon $NamedTwoName! As it thrashes in its final agony, its tail and claws rip huge holes in the cave floor. Suddenly, you are horrified to see that molten lava is seeping through the cracks in the floor -- either the monster's lair was atop a volcano, or Hell is trying to reclaim its own! Soon the creeping lava flow engulfs the carcass and, alas, most of the gold. Only a fraction of the monster's hoard is left, but that fraction is enough to make you all wealthy.
column2: 你完成了那最为英勇而艰难的壮举。你已斩杀巨龙$NamedTwoName！当它临终挣扎，尾爪撕裂洞底巨穴。忽见熔岩自裂缝渗出——或此巢乃火山之巅，或地狱欲夺回旧物！顷刻间，熔岩吞没龙骸，连同大半黄金。仅余残金，却已足使众人富甲一方。

column1: You have bought yourselves a little more time, but you must be careful: your suspicious activities have not gone unnoticed.
column2: 你为自己争取了些许时日，但须谨慎：你的可疑行径已被人察觉。

column1: You have come to your senses just in time. Down the street, beggars are busily stripping the wounded and dead. Fortunately, they haven't reached you yet.
column2: 你及时回神。街角乞丐正忙于搜刮伤者与死者。幸而他们尚未波及你。

column1: You have escaped the immediate doom of the crazed villagers' onslaught. Looking around to get your bearings, you look up to the top of a nearby hill, where you see a huge bonfire surrounded by dancing figures. In their ecstasy, not all of the figures even appear human.
column2: 你侥幸逃过狂民暴击之劫。环顾四周，辨明方位，仰望近山之巅，见篝火熊熊，舞影憧憧。其狂欢之中，身影竟难辨人形。

column1: You have fled, but the wolves pursue. For an hour you think you have lost them, but then ...
column2: 你已逃离，然狼群紧追不舍。一时以为甩脱，却又……

column1: You have healed the land for the moment -- but it is clear that unholy witches have used this site for their rituals. They may return one day.
column2: 你暂且治愈了这片土地——然显而易见，邪巫曾于此设坛施法。彼等或有朝一日重返。

column1: You have met up with some horrible monster dredged from the slim churning in the bottom of Arnold and Sandy's depraved synapses.  What will you do?
column2: 你邂逅了一只自阿诺德与桑迪堕落神经元深处翻搅而出的狰狞怪物。汝将如何处置？

column1: You have met up with some horrible monster dredged from the slime churning in the bottom of Arnold and Sandy's depraved synapses.  What will you do?
column2: 你邂逅了一只自阿诺德与桑迪堕落神经元深处翻搅而出的狰狞怪物。汝将如何处置？

column1: You have no choice but to leave, by...
column2: 你别无选择，唯有离去，经由……

column1: You have no choice but to listen silently and let him assume your support.
column2: 你唯有静听，任其认定你支持。

column1: You have no choice but to listen silently.
column2: 你唯有静听。

column1: You have now entered combat.  You fight it out and the result is...
column2: 你现已进入战斗。双方厮杀，结果是……

column1: You have somehow called a card that has been deleted. Something is very wrong. Do not pass GO. Do not collect $200.
column2: 你不慎抽中一张已被删除的卡片。事态严重。切勿通过起点，亦勿领取$200。

column1: You have sought sanctuary within the sacred precincts. Watchful guards pace outside.
column2: 你已遁入圣地庇护。警戒的守卫在外巡弋。

column1: You have the impression that some citizens of $PlaceName are nerving themselves for a general uprising against the government.
column2: 你隐约觉察，$PlaceName的部分市民正蓄势发动反政府起义。

column1: You hear a loud grating noise and the pit walls start to move together, threatening to crush you!
column2: 你听见刺耳的摩擦之声，坑壁渐次合拢，似要将你碾碎！

column1: You hear a shout. "Intruders, sir! We're covering the exits, then we'll sweep the building."
column2: 你听见一声呼喝：“有闯入者！我们封锁出口，随即清剿全楼！”

column1: You hear a strange sound coming from the main street. Curious, you walk toward it and meet $NamedTwoName, a messenger-girl used by $NamedOneName, your employer.
column2: 你听见主街传来异响。好奇之下，你循声而去，遇见$NamedTwoName，一名受雇于$NamedOneName的信使姑娘。

column1: You hear a strange sound, something like cheering or chanting, coming from the main street. Curious, you walk toward it, and by chance bump into a messenger-girl commonly used by your rebel friends.
column2: 你听见街上传来欢呼或吟唱之声。出于好奇，你沿街而行，偶遇一位常为叛友所用的信使姑娘。

column1: You hear cheering above you!
column2: 你听见头顶传来欢呼！

column1: You hear cheering and chanting. Suddenly, from around the corner, a great mass of citizens come marching along, shouting revolutionary slogans.
column2: 你听见欢呼与呐喊。忽从转角涌出大批市民，高呼革命口号。

column1: You hear cheering and chanting. Suddenly, from around the corner, a great mass of citizens marches toward you, shouting revolutionary slogans.
column2: 你听见欢呼与呐喊。忽从转角涌出大批市民，向你进发，高呼革命口号。

column1: You hear cheering and chanting. Suddenly, from around the corner, a mass of citizens march toward you, shouting revolutionary slogans.
column2: 你听见欢呼与呐喊。忽从转角涌出大批市民，向你进发，高呼革命口号。

column1: You hear little else of interest. Then the head cook steps forward and raps on the table. "Your attention please," he shouts. The gathered throng falls silent.
column2: 你再未听见什么特别之事。随后主厨上前敲击桌面：“诸位请注意！”聚集的人群顿时安静下来。

column1: You hear nothing dramatically out of the ordinary...
column2: 你未闻任何异常动静……

column1: You hear shouts below. You race down the stairs and reach an exit just ahead of the guards, who immediately pursue.
column2: 你听见楼下喧哗。你飞奔下楼，抢在守卫之前抵达出口，后者随即追来。

column1: You hear that $NamedOneName is hiring armed couriers for a special task. However, this employer only deals with reputable people.
column2: 你听说$NamedOneName正招募武装信使，执行一项特殊任务。然该雇主只与信誉卓著之人合作。

column1: You hear that $NamedOneName is hiring some bodyguards, and that the work involves a journey of some sort. However, the employer cannot afford more than five people, and they must have an extremely good reputation.
column2: 你听说$NamedOneName正在招募保镖，工作需外出奔波。然雇主仅能负担五人，且须声誉极佳。

column1: You hear that after a long imprisonment, $NamedOneName was finally tried, convicted and executed in $NamedTwoName . It is a sad end for a brave comrade.
column2: 你听说，$NamedOneName在长期囚禁之后，终于在$NamedTwoName受审、定罪并处决。这是位英勇战友的悲惨结局。

column1: You hear the dulcet tones of an angelic chant, and listen transfixed. As the soul-stirring sound fades away, you see the thugs were similarly affected, and are now wandering away, quietly discussing their experience. They have forgotten entirely about their original mission.
column2: 你听见天使般悠扬的吟唱，为之倾心。那撼人心魄的乐声渐息，只见那些恶徒亦受其感召，悄然离去，低声谈论着方才的体验。他们已全然忘却了原本的使命。

column1: You hear the man scream out in despair, "No, $NamedTwoName, no! I took it not! Spare me!" But the monster plucks him up off his horse, carrying him screaming into the sky. You flee the dreadful scene.
column2: 你听见那人绝望地惨叫：“不，$NamedTwoName，不！我并未取之！饶我一命！”但那怪物将他从马背上一把抓起，挟着他尖叫着升入天际。你逃离这骇人的场景。

column1: You hear, "Finally, a clean and honest church. Those evil Germans will pay for promising Huss safety, then killing him. Ziska's armies will crush them, insuring our freedom forever!"
column2: 你听见：“终于，有一座清廉正直的教堂了。那些邪恶的德意志人曾许诺胡斯安全，却将他杀害。齐克萨的军队必将击溃他们，永保我等自由！”

column1: You help $ChosenOneName limp back into the covering darkness of nearby woods. The keep is thoroughly alerted and now unapproachable. You spend the rest of the night deciding what to do at dawn.
column2: 你扶着$ChosenOneName一瘸一拐地回到附近树林的黑暗之中。城堡已被彻底警觉，如今难以接近。你们在余下的夜晚里商议天明之后的对策。

column1: You help $ChosenOneName limp back into the protective darkness of the nearby woods. The castle is thoroughly alerted and now unapproachable. You spend the rest of the night in the woods, deciding what to do at dawn.
column2: 你扶着$ChosenOneName一瘸一拐地回到附近树林的掩护之下。城堡已全面警戒，如今难以接近。你在林中度过余夜，待黎明时再定夺去向。

column1: You help the stronger pilgrims mount, and fashion drag-litters for the rest. A few hours later you wave goodbye to the little party as it disappears down the road. A warmth and gladness spreads through your hearts: the happiness of true giving.
column2: 你帮助体壮的朝圣者上马，为其余的人制作拖曳担架。数小时后，你挥手告别这支小队伍，目送他们渐行渐远。一股温暖与喜悦涌上心头：这是真正给予的幸福。

column1: You hesitate, but a sudden feeling of justice overcomes your avarice. You hand over $Money1, the amount $he first paid you.
column2: 你犹豫不决，但一股正义感猛然压倒了你的贪婪。你交出了$Money1，正是你最初付给你的金额。

column1: You hesitate, but a sudden feeling of justice overcomes your avarice. You hand over the entire contents of your purse: $Money1.
column2: 你犹豫不决，但一股正义之感压倒了你的贪婪。你将钱包中的全部财物交出：$Money1。

column1: You hide immediately, then decide whether to...
column2: 你立刻藏了起来，然后决定是否……

column1: You hint at the guild leader's embarassing secret. He turns white and begins trembling.
column2: 你暗示了公会会长的尴尬秘密。他脸色苍白，开始颤抖。

column1: You hint at things, but in truth, you have nothing to show. He is not impressed, and does nothing to change the guild's viewpoint.
column2: 你有所暗示，但实则并无凭据。他并不为之所动，也未改变公会的立场。

column1: You humbly accept these gifts, saying, "We appreciate your generosity, but the greatest gift of all would be for you to remember us with fair thoughts. For us, the greatest reward of a virtuous deed is the doing of it."
column2: 你谦逊地接受这些礼物，说道：“我们感激你的慷慨，但最珍贵的馈赠莫过于你以公正之心铭记我们。于我们而言，善行本身便是最大的回报。”

column1: You hurriedly ...
column2: 你匆忙地...

column1: You ignore his remarks and head for a side street, plotting the best way to get out of the city. Behind you, other people in the crowd are already drifting away. It won't take the $CityLordTitle long to regain control. When he does, your lives won't be worth a pfennig in this city!
column2: 你无视他的言辞，径直走向一条侧街，谋划着离开此城的最佳路径。身后，人群中已有他人悄然散去。$CityLordTitle 不久便会重新掌控局面。一旦他得势，你们在这城中的性命便不值一文！

column1: You ignore this and head for the nearest side street, wondering which route is the fastest out of the city. Behind you, other people in the crowd are now drifting away. It's only a matter of hours before the $CityLordTitle retakes control and sends his guards searching for you.
column2: 你置之不理，径直走向最近的侧街，思索哪条路线能最快出城。身后，人群中的其他人也渐渐散去。再过几个时辰，$CityLordTitle便会重新掌控局面，派出卫兵搜寻你的下落。

column1: You immediately ask about the service desired, and he replies, "It is extremely dangerous and difficult, so attend me closely..."
column2: 你立刻询问所需之服务，他答道：“此事极为危险且艰难，请务必紧随我左右……”

column1: You immediately ask this service desired, and he replies, "It is extremely dangerous and difficult, so attend me closely..."
column2: 你立刻提出此服务之需求，他答道：“此事极为危险且艰难，请紧随我左右……”

column1: You immediately ask what service is desired, and he replies, "It is extremely dangerous and difficult, so attend me closely..."
column2: 你立刻询问所需之服务，他答道：“此事极为危险且艰难，请务必紧随我身……”

column1: You immediately draw forth the transparent globe holding the trout and toss it into the lake. The fire is at once extinguished. Baphomet is once more defeated, but is yet defiant. "So, the Father of Fish! The loss of the burning sea is a small matter. I have five plagues more."
column2: 你即刻取出盛着鳟鱼的透明圆球，将其掷入湖中。火焰顿时熄灭。巴佛梅特再度败北，却仍不甘示弱。“原来如此，鱼之父！失去那片火海不过是小事一桩。我尚有五重灾厄。”

column1: You immediately flee from this place, before the spiders return for more!
column2: 你立刻逃离此地，以免蜘蛛归来！

column1: You immediately tuck the letters into your pouch for safekeeping.
column2: 你立即将信件收入囊中，妥善保管。

column1: You inform him that you wish to ...
column2: 你告知他，你希望……

column1: You inquire about the whereabouts of $NamedTwoName. His castle is $Direction2 of $NearestCity, $Direction of $PlaceName.
column2: 你询问$NamedTwoName的下落。他的城堡位于$NearestCity的$Direction2，在$PlaceName的$Direction。

column1: You investigate carefully, finding snug spaces among the jumbled boulders that might make nice dens. All are empty, save for old leaves and moss. Nobody has been here for a long, long time.
column2: 你仔细探查，在杂乱的巨石间寻得几处适宜的洞穴。皆空无一物，唯有枯叶与青苔。久已无人涉足。

column1: You kneel in submission to the demon. It laughs and chortles, frolicking around you. "You have submitted to the powers of Hell!" it snickers. "Can your heaven save you now?" You are consumed with guilt, realizing what a fearful deed you have done. Suddenly, the creature waves its claw, and you fall unconscious.
column2: 你跪伏于恶魔面前，表示臣服。它哈哈大笑，围绕着你嬉戏玩闹。“你已屈从于地狱之力！”它嗤笑道，“如今你的天堂还能救你吗？”你心中充满愧疚，意识到自己犯下了何等可怕的罪行。突然，那怪物挥动利爪，你便昏厥过去。

column1: You knock again. Suddenly another upstairs window flies open and somebody hurls a chamberpot of offal down onto your heads.
column2: 你再次敲门。突然，楼上另一扇窗户猛地打开，有人将一盆脏物朝你们头上倾倒下来。

column1: You knock discreetly, but when questioned about your business, you stumble badly, stuttering and appearing most untrustworthy.
column2: 你悄然叩门，然被问及来意，却语无伦次，结结巴巴，显得极不可靠。

column1: You knock hard, and eventually an upstairs shutter cracks. An old man looks out and says, "no night visitors. Return in the morning."
column2: 你用力敲门，终于楼上的一扇窗格微微开启。一位老者探头而出，说道：“夜不迎客，明日清晨再来。”

column1: You know that if the demon is summoned, the odds of your defeating the witches decreases. But if the Sabbat is to be shattered, you must face and defeat the demon. You...
column2: 你知道，若恶魔被召来，你击败女巫的几率便会降低。然而，若要粉碎女巫集会，你必须直面并击败恶魔。你...

column1: You laugh, but he insists, "Yes, they really believe that such a mythical creature is troubling them."
column2: 你笑了，但他坚持道：“是的，他们真的相信有这样一种神话生物在困扰着他们。”

column1: You lay about you with your weapons. Not expecting the attack, the participants flee shrieking, or fall. You realize you must leave here quickly to avoid bringing the entire Sabbat down around you.
column2: 你挥舞着武器四处砍杀。众人猝不及防，或尖叫着四散奔逃，或应声倒地。你意识到必须速速离开此地，以免引来整个安息日的围剿。

column1: You lean against an old wall, enjoying the busy urban sprawl and splendor of $PlaceName. You decide to...
column2: 你倚靠在古老的墙边，欣赏着$PlaceName的繁华与壮丽。你决定……

column1: You lean forward and listen...
column2: 你俯身倾听……

column1: You learn that all the prisoners have been transferred from the $councilHall to the $fortress, the grim fortress guarding the city. The cells here are empty.
column2: 你得知所有囚犯已被从$councilHall转移至$fortress，那座守卫城池的阴森要塞。此处牢房空无一人。

column1: You learn that the Artisan guilds of $PlaceName $VarPhrase1 changes in the city government.
column2: 你得知$PlaceName $VarPhrase1的工匠公会支持市政府的变革。

column1: You learn that the best way to influence people is to talk to them! Sometimes people can be convinced by friendly conversation. However, you must remember that most people eventually make up their minds to support one side or the other. Once convinced, these people are almost impossible to sway back again.
column2: 你得知，影响人心的最佳方式莫过于与之交谈！有时，友善的对话便能令人信服。然而，你须谨记，多数人终将决意支持一方。一旦心意已定，几乎再难使其回心转意。

column1: You learn that the next high sabbat of the witches is soon -- within the next few months.
column2: 你得知女巫们的下一个盛大集会即将到来——就在接下来的几个月内。

column1: You learn that this region is extremely dangerous. A bloody feud means that marauding groups are everywhere.
column2: 你得知此地极其危险。一场血腥的世仇使得劫掠之徒遍地皆是。

column1: You leave for a few hours to let the Schulz's anger cool. Perhaps you should not return at all.
column2: 你离去数小时，让舒尔茨一家的怒火稍息。或许你根本不该再回。

column1: You leave the area and return to your wanderings about the field. Hopefully, no one saw you doing anything while you were here.
column2: 你离开此地，重返原野漫游。但愿无人见你在此有所行动。

column1: You leave the mines and return to the miners' camp. You feel relieved and purified out of the stale air of the dwarf king's realm and back among human folk. The miners come out to greet you, clearly hopeful that you have succeeded. It feels wonderful to deal spontaneously with humans instead of with the cold-blooded dwarf, whose every action seemed calculated.
column2: 你离开矿井，重返矿工营地。走出矮人王域那股沉闷的气息，重归人间，顿觉身心一爽。矿工们纷纷迎上前来，显然盼着你此行得偿所愿。与冷酷寡情、举手投足皆有算计的矮人不同，此刻能与人类坦诚相待，实乃快事。

column1: You leave the potion bottle between you and the guards. Slowly a dark haze fills the air, thickening, until a cloud of impenetrable blackness blocks their view of you.
column2: 你将药瓶置于自己与守卫之间。渐渐地，一股黑暗的雾气弥漫开来，愈发浓重，直至一团无法穿透的黑云遮蔽了他们的视线。

column1: You leave, quite satisfied that he is now a loyal, if terrified, supporter.
column2: 你离去，颇为满意他如今虽惊恐万分，却已成了忠实的盟友。

column1: You lie prostrate and helpless before the monster. It gloats, "Now you are all my prey. As a sign of my mercy, I shall accept one of you unto myself."It seizes upon $ChosenOneName and tears $him into seven pieces, then devours him avidly. It then says, "Now begone from before me!", and you all vanish in a puff of smoke, to reappear in the open wilderness, doubtless many miles away.
column2: 你匍匐于怪物面前，无助而无力。它幸灾乐祸道：“如今你们皆为吾之猎物。作为仁慈之象征，吾将接纳尔等一人。”它攫住$ChosenOneName，将你撕成七块，贪婪地吞食之。随后它喝道：“速速退去！”众人随即化作一缕青烟，消失无踪，复又现身于荒野之中，想必已远隔数里。

column1: You listen as the $CityLordTitle instructs his messengers to travel to $NamedOneName, $NameTwoName, $NamedThreeName and $NamedFourName. Each will carry a letter recommending you most highly to the ruler there, and asking him to post an enclosed handbill proclaiming your valuables services to the $CityLordName and $PlaceName.
column2: 你聆听$CityLordTitle吩咐使者前往$NamedOneName、$NameTwoName、$NamedThreeName和$NamedFourName。每位使者将携一封书信，极力向当地统治者举荐你，并请其张贴随函附上的告示，宣扬你为$CityLordName与$PlaceName提供的宝贵服务。

column1: You listen at the ceiling to the leader and his lieutenants above. Apparently they believe $NamedOneName is actually a heretic who worships demons and Satan. They are wondering how to find proof, and whether to use that to influence or remove him.
column2: 你伏于天花板之上，倾听上方首领及其副手的谈话。显然，他们认为$NamedOneName实为崇拜恶魔与撒旦的异端。他们正商议如何取证，以及是否以此影响或除掉他。

column1: You listen eagerly...
column2: 你热切地倾听……

column1: You listen further, and realize they are clearly terrified that some marauding force will overrun their farms and the protecting castle keep.
column2: 你继续倾听，发现他们显然因恐有劫掠之众将席卷其田庄与守护之堡而心生恐惧。

column1: You look around and see a party of guards running along the parapet.
column2: 你环顾四周，见一队守卫正沿女墙奔来。

column1: You look around at each other. "Now that we have a goal," $ChosenOneName remarks wryly, "how shall we achieve it?"
column2: 你们互相对视。$ChosenOneName 苛刻地说道：“既然有了目标，我们该如何达成呢？”

column1: You look at each other and shrug.
column2: 你们相视而笑，耸了耸肩。

column1: You look at each other, dumbfounded. Accepting the gift has placed you under the dwarf's power! Impelled by forces beyond your control, you silently turn and walk out of the mine. Once outside, you try to re-enter, but find you cannot. The dwarf magic is sure.
column2: 你们面面相觑，惊愕不已。接受这份礼物，已使你们落入矮人的掌控！不由自主地，你们悄然转身，走出矿井。出得门外，再欲入内，却已无法进入。矮人之术果然灵验。

column1: You look at each other, dumfounded. Your surrender has given the dwarf power over you! Impelled by forces beyond your control, you silently turn and walk out of the mine. Once outside, you try to re-enter, but find you cannot. The dwarf magic is sure.
column2: 你们面面相觑，目瞪口呆。你们的屈服，已使矮人握有对你们的支配之力！不由自主地，你们悄然转身，走出矿井。出得门外，再欲入内，却已无法进入。矮人之术果然灵验。

column1: You look over the miners' pathetic shacks. The miner's spokesman looks at you expectantly.
column2: 你俯瞰矿工们那几间可怜的窝棚。矿工的代表满怀期待地望着你。

column1: You look with regret on the unconscious and bleeding night watch.
column2: 你惋惜地望着那名昏厥且血流不止的夜班守卫。

column1: You lower yourselves into the crypt. Open tombs surround you. Down a long passage you finally find the $NamedOneName, covered with dust. You...
column2: 你们缓缓降至墓穴之中。四周皆是敞开的墓室。沿着一条长廊，终于寻得那座$NamedOneName，蒙满尘埃。你……

column1: You lower yourselves into the crypt. Open tombs surround you. Down a long passage you find the $NamedOneName, covered with dust. You...
column2: 你们缓缓降至墓穴之中。四周皆是敞开的墓室。沿着一条长廊，终见那座$NamedOneName，蒙满尘埃。你……

column1: You make your way past them quickly, grabbing the keys from a ring on the wall. In seconds, $ChosenTwoName is freed and you are all out the door.
column2: 你们迅速穿过他们，从墙上的一串钥匙中取下所需之钥。顷刻之间，$ChosenTwoName 得以解脱，众人随之出得门外。

column1: You make your way quietly through the scrub and brambles, but the keen-eyed, keen-nosed wolves are too alert for you. Quickly you find yourselves surrounded by snarling foes.
column2: 你们悄然穿行于灌木与荆棘之间，但那双敏锐的眼睛与灵敏的鼻子早已察觉。转眼间，你们已被咆哮的敌手团团围住。

column1: You march through the streets shouting revolutionary slogans. Then, up ahead, you see squads of city guardsmen, weapons ready. You...
column2: 你们高呼革命口号，沿街行进。前方，只见数队城防军持械列阵。你……

column1: You meet $NamedOneName, king of the troublesome dwarfs in this mine. He gnashes his teeth and shrieks at you.
column2: 你遇见$NamedOneName，此矿中那群惹事生非的矮人之王。他咬牙切齿，向你尖声怒吼。

column1: You misjudged the distance. The guards sniff the wind before the potion can affect them.
column2: 你低估了距离。药剂尚未生效，守卫已嗅到了风中的气息。

column1: You move away, glancing about as surreptitiously as possible. All appears to be well.
column2: 你们悄然移步，尽可能隐秘地四下张望。一切看似无虞。

column1: You move quietly, keeping to closets, unused rooms, and back corridors. But now you must decide whether to...
column2: 你们静悄悄地行动，藏身于壁橱、闲置房间与后巷。然而此刻，你们须决定是否……

column1: You move to open the manacles that hold him, but the monk speaks quietly and quite sanely: "I cannot leave this place," he says, "for I have taken a holy vow. Thank you for your kind thoughts; leave quickly, for it is dangerous here." Then his eyes glaze over with madness once again.
column2: 你上前欲解开束缚他的镣铐，但僧侣却平静而理智地说道：“我不能离开此地，”他说，“因我曾立下圣誓。多谢你的美意，速速离去吧，此处险恶。”随即，他的目光又复归癫狂。

column1: You mull over the strange being. You have heard of these alchemical creations. The kobolds fade away, still chittering to one another about their great victory. You are alone.
column2: 你沉思着这奇异之物。你曾听闻此类炼金造物。地精们渐渐远去，仍彼此叽叽喳喳，谈论着他们的大胜。你独处其间。

column1: You must surrender to the guards. They take you prisoner and parade you to the dungeon, there to await the pleasure of the magistrate.
column2: 你只得向守卫投降。他们将你囚禁，押赴地牢，静候法官发落。

column1: You must worm through vigilant guard patrols to inquire about a passage. Leaving sometime this week are a few craft with space for you all. Among them are few craft leaving today. Your choices are...
column2: 你须潜行穿越严密的守卫巡逻，探询出路。本周内将有数艘船只启航，尚余空位。其中不乏今日即行之船。你的选择是……

column1: You nod agreement and walk away.
column2: 你点头同意，转身离去。

column1: You nod and smile, understanding perfectly. If you had hired them to pray for you first -- even if you didn't need it -- things could have gone differently. Of course, the monk mentioned today, and tomorrow is a new day.
column2: 你颔首微笑，心领神会。若早先雇他们为你祈祷——即便你并不需要——局面或许迥异。当然，僧侣所言不虚，明日又是新的一天。

column1: You nod back, answering, "Right, we'll take the guardsmen while you free $NamedOneName!"
column2: 你亦点头回应：“好，我们对付守卫，你去解救$NamedOneName！”

column1: You nod, but say nothing further. He and his companions converse quietly among themselves, and you distinctly hear the words "Slay them" spoken. Several times, the robed man opens his mouth as if to ask you something. Finally he nods.
column2: 你点头，却不再多言。他与同伴低声交谈，你清晰听见“杀掉他们”数次。那名披袍之人几次欲开口询问，最终只是点了点头。

column1: You note with delight that $NamedOneName is with his men. This could be the final battle!
column2: 你欣喜地发现$NamedOneName正与其部众同在。这或许便是最后一战！

column1: You notice a party of well-armed city guardsmen on duty. 'Oops,' you say to yourself, as one turns toward you...
column2: 你留意到一队全副武装的城防军正在执勤。“糟糕，”你暗自嘀咕，恰有一人朝你转过身来……

column1: You notice motion among the trees. Suddenly $ChosenOneName stumbles on a tree root and falls to the ground. The trees seem to move. No, it's giant, hairy creatures lurching toward you among the trees. Before they arrive, you...
column2: 你见树影摇曳。忽然，$ChosenOneName 踩到树根，跌倒在地。树木仿佛在移动。不，那是巨形毛怪在林间蹒跚逼近。未及近前，你……

column1: You notice that the servants have bared your weapons, and seem quite ready to use them on you if you protest. Besides, you admit to yourselves that the clerk is right. Your request for charity could be viewed as presumptuous.
column2: 你发觉仆人们已卸下你的兵刃，若你稍有反抗，便随时可用之加诸于你。况且，你也承认书吏所言不无道理。你请求施舍，难免被视为僭越。

column1: You notice thick dark vines on both sides of your path as $ChosenOneName stumbles into one and falls to the ground. Then, with a soft rushing sound, giant spiders swing down from trees and rocks, trailing the vines, which you realize are webs! You have a split second to...
column2: 你见小径两侧缠绕着浓密的黑藤，$ChosenOneName 不慎撞上一株，摔倒在地。随即，伴随着轻柔的飒飒声，巨型蜘蛛自树上与岩间垂下蛛网般的藤蔓！你仅有片刻时间……

column1: You observe numerous comings and goings throughout the night. Many of the people are carrying away stacks of handbills. The house of $NamedOneName is clearly a political headquarters.
column2: 夜深人静，往来不断。许多人携带着成叠的传单。$NamedOneName 的宅邸显然是政治中枢。

column1: You order the people to disperse and renounce Satan; they all thank you profusely and depart. Before the gathering becomes too suspicious, you depart as well.
column2: 你命众人散去，弃绝撒旦；众人纷纷致谢，相继离去。在集会引发怀疑之前，你也匆匆离场。

column1: You order the people to disperse and renounce Satan; they thank you and depart. Before the gathering becomes too suspicious, you depart as well.
column2: 你命众人散去，弃绝撒旦；众人致谢后离去。在集会引发怀疑之前，你也匆匆离场。

column1: You overhear a loud argument in a nearby room.
column2: 你无意中听到隔壁房间传来激烈的争吵。

column1: You overhear the guardsmen and women talking, and realize that the wives came for their men. Then you notice that the guards left the main door open! Quickly you dash for the door, before the personal guards of the $CityLordTitle realize what happened and lock it once more.
column2: 你听见男女守卫的谈话，方知其妻前来探望。忽见守卫竟将大门敞开！你忙趁机冲向门口，以免$CityLordTitle 的亲随察觉并重新锁门。

column1: You overhear two apprentices on a small job discussing workmanship.
column2: 你听见两名学徒在闲聊做工之事。

column1: You overhear two citizens discussing the best way to catch and cook rats. One believes in rat stew, while the other swears by rat pie. It's easy to see that the war is having an effect on $PlaceName.
column2: 你听见两位市民讨论捕鼠与烹鼠的最佳方法。一人推崇鼠肉炖汤，另一人则笃信鼠肉馅饼。显而易见，战争已波及$PlaceName。

column1: You painfully collect what little the bandits left and huddle into the cold, hard, sorrowful night.
column2: 你艰难地收拾强盗留下的些许财物，蜷缩于寒冷、坚硬、凄凉的夜色之中。

column1: You pause in a small grove of trees, in a quiet corner of $PlaceName. Here you decide to...
column2: 你在$PlaceName 的一处幽静角落，一片小树林中稍作停留。于此，你决定……

column1: You pay the toll. The guard doesn't even notice your face -- he's too busy examining your coin and carefully putting it into the lockbox.
column2: 你缴纳过路费。守卫甚至未留意你的面容——他正忙着查验你的钱币，并小心翼翼地将其收入钱箱。

column1: You pick up the trail and watch the kidnappers hand over their captive to a new party. Moving carefully, you reach their camp after nightfall. Here you...
column2: 你循迹追踪，见绑匪将人质交予另一伙人。小心翼翼地行至夜幕降临之时，抵达对方营地。在此……

column1: You plead with the priest for aid. He silently nods, and leaves. On the morrow, he returns. When the turnkey leaves, the priest furtively slips a $NamedOneName out of his sleeve and hands it over. He whispers, "I was able to get this for you, but no more. May it serve you well." After a brief conversation, he leaves.
column2: 你恳求神父相助。他默默点头，随即离去。翌日，他再度现身。当狱卒离开之际，神父悄然从袖中取出一枚$NamedOneName递予你。他低声道：“此物我已为你备妥，然仅此而已。愿它助你一臂之力。”简短交谈后，他便告辞而去。

column1: You poke around the mines for a while to make sure the dwarf and his folk have left, and can find no trace of them. Even their traps have been dismantled. The mine is open for business again!
column2: 你在矿井里四处探查一番，确信矮人及其族人已然离去，再无半点踪迹。连他们的陷阱也已被尽数拆除。矿井重开，生意又可兴隆！

column1: You politely refuse the fruit.
column2: 你礼貌地推辞了那颗果实。

column1: You ponder her words, and start to ask questions.
column2: 你细品她的话语，开始发问。

column1: You ponder her words. She cannot provide any further advice. "This is all I see. My arts can carry me no further. The rest I must leave in your hands.
column2: 你细品她的话语。她已无法再提供建议。“我所见仅此而已，我的技艺难以为继。余事唯有仰仗阁下。”

column1: You ponder her words. She refuses to answer any questions, or provide any advice.
column2: 你细品她的话语。她拒绝回答任何问题，也不提供任何建议。

column1: You ponder his words about the kobolds and move on.
column2: 你思索她关于地精的言语，继续前行。

column1: You ponder the possibilities for honor, glory and reward, should you succeed in destroying the power of this evil man. Of course, the first step is to find patrons willing to reward you!
column2: 你盘算着若能铲除此恶人之势力，便可赢得荣誉、荣耀与酬报。当然，首要之举，便是寻得愿意犒赏你的资助者！

column1: You ponder the scorched wreckage of the boat. What could it mean? Poking through the timbers, you find a trapdoor into the hold. When you enter the hold, you meet a chained woman. She stands up and greets you. "I am $NamedOneName, and I thank you for rescuing me." You strike off her chains, and ask her, "What is this place?"
column2: 你端详着那艘被焚毁的残骸。这究竟意味着什么？拨开焦木，你发现舱底有一道活板门。步入舱内，迎面而来的是一名被锁链束缚的女子。她起身致意：“我是$NamedOneName，感谢你救我。”你为她解开了枷锁，并问道：“这是何处？”

column1: You ponder the situation and decide to...
column2: 你权衡局势，决定……

column1: You ponder this puzzle and select...
column2: 你思索此谜题，选定……

column1: You ponder this, and realize that threatening to reveal this secret might be very useful.
column2: 你沉思此事，意识到威胁揭露此秘可能大有用途。

column1: You ponder this. Vulcans are powerful and dangerous, with the ability to spit fire some distance. Few adventurers have survived encounters with them.
column2: 你沉思此事。火龙强大而凶险，能远距离喷火。鲜有冒险者能与其交锋而生还。

column1: You ponder what force could have wrought this destruction.
column2: 你思索何等巨力竟致此毁灭。

column1: You ponder your the situation and decide to...
column2: 你权衡局势，决定……

column1: You ponder, then say...
column2: 你沉吟片刻，说道……

column1: You pour your bottle of magic honey into the lake, and once more Baphomet becomes briefly morose. "So!" he hisses. "You have the cure which sweetens the waters and heals all ills. Yet it is unimportant, for there are four more plagues to come."
column2: 你将瓶中魔蜜倾入湖中，巴佛墨再度短暂愁容。“如此！”他嘶声道，“汝既有甘泉之药，可疗万疾。然此不足道也，尚有四灾将至。”

column1: You pray and pray, but no one responds. It seems hopeless.
column2: 你虔诚祷告，却无人应答。前路似已绝。

column1: You press her, asking about the service she performed...
column2: 你逼问她，询问其所行之事……

column1: You privately discuss the matter. Bankers not only offer rewards, but also have friends in many cities. However the task is not easy. The raubritters (robber knights) of Germany are hard men, served by equally hard warriors.
column2: 你私下商议此事。银行家不仅酬金丰厚，且多城皆有友朋。然此任非易，德意志之劫骑士皆悍勇之徒，麾下亦多猛士。

column1: You privately discuss the matter. The favor of the Hanseatic Leaque is valuable, but the task is not easy. The raubritters (robber knights) of Germany are hard men, served by tough warriors.
column2: 你私下商议此事。汉萨同盟之恩虽重，然此任非易。德意志之劫骑士皆悍勇之徒，麾下亦多猛士。

column1: You proceed into the village, surrounded by happy folk.
column2: 你步入村庄，周遭皆欢声笑语。

column1: You proudly refuse, saying, "This is a public road, not even the Emperor can demand tolls here!"
column2: 你傲然拒绝，言：“此乃公道，纵帝君亦无权征税！”

column1: You proudly refuse, saying, "We see no hallowed ground here, no cathedral walls. This tithe is pure extortion!"
column2: 你傲然拒绝，言：“此处并无圣土，亦无教堂之墙。此什一税纯属勒索！”

column1: You pry for rumors and information, but nobody has any travellers' tales or personal experiences of interest.
column2: 你探听传闻与消息，然无人有旅人轶事或切身经历可资。

column1: You pry open a locked desk drawer and rummage through a pile of letters. Near the bottom is one with a famous ducal crest -- that of $PlaceName's arch enemy. In the letter the Duke tells the leader he will receive 100 florins for secretly opening a sally port for the Duke's mercenary captain.
column2: 你撬开锁柜抽屉，翻检信札堆叠。近底处有一函，印有著名公爵徽章——$PlaceName之宿敌。信中公爵嘱其首领，暗启一道侧门，以迎公爵之雇佣兵长，酬以百弗罗林。

column1: You question her, and find to your horror that she is nothing more than a poor widow without family, surviving as best she can. Before you can offer amends, she flees into the wilderness she knows so well. Ashamed of your deeds, you pray for forgiveness and continue your journey.
column2: 你盘问她，惊悉其不过一贫寡妇，无亲无靠，勉强度日。未及弥补，她已遁入所熟荒野。愧疚之余，你祈求宽恕，继续前行。

column1: You question him about the Templars, and what he says reminds you of your common dream and the prophecy. He takes your experiences seriously. "You are embarked on a quest of dire importance. If it helps any, those fiends said something about going from a Monastery to a 'sabbat' on $SabbatTime, $SabbatLocation."
column2: 你询及圣殿骑士，彼之所言令你忆起共同之梦与预言。彼郑重视汝经历。“汝正踏征程，事关重大。若有所助，彼等恶徒曾言自修道院赴$SabbatTime、$SabbatLocation之‘撒巴特’。”

column1: You quickly decide to ...
column2: 你迅即决断……

column1: You quickly escape from your bonds and look around. This evil place is purified. You fall to your knees and give thanks for victory.
column2: 你挣脱束缚，环顾四周。此邪地已得净化。你跪地谢天，庆贺胜利。

column1: You quickly escape the battle by running down a side street, and notice many citizens and mercenaries fleeing with you. Soon the battlefield contains nothing but triumphant guardsmen and bloody bodies.
column2: 你沿侧街疾逃，见众市民与佣兵随你奔走。不久，战场唯余凯旋之卫士与累累尸骸。

column1: You quickly escape the battle by running down a side street. As you pause to check for pursuit (there is none), you see guardsmen wreaking bloody havoc among the crowd. People are screaming and fleeing in all directions, while many more lie unmoving in the street.
column2: 你沿侧街疾逃。驻足察追兵（无），忽见卫士于人群中肆虐，血流遍地。众人尖叫四散，更多人横卧街头，再无动静。

column1: You quickly escape the huntsman and his soldiers, who are content to chase you off. Of course, you cannot camp in this area for quite a while.
column2: 你急避猎手及其部卒，彼等仅欲驱逐于斯。自此，此地暂不可宿营。

column1: You quickly retreat from this place, before you all suffer the same fate.
column2: 你速退此地，免同归于尽。

column1: You quietly creep up behind them, then $ChosenOneName gives a polite cough.
column2: 你悄然潜至其后，$ChosenOneName轻咳一声。

column1: You quietly duck into the brush, move through a series of gullies, and finally elude the bandits entirely.
column2: 你悄然钻入草丛，穿行沟壑，终脱匪徒之追。

column1: You quietly duck into the brush, move through a series of gullies, and finally elude the bandits entirely. During the night those left behind stagger into your camp. They were stripped of arms, armor and valuables, then left for dead.
column2: 你悄然钻入草丛，穿行沟壑，终脱匪徒之追。夜半，落伍者踉跄入营，皆被夺去甲械财货，弃置待毙。

column1: You quietly duck into the brush, move through a series of gullies, and finally elude the bandits entirely. During the night, $ChosenOneName staggers into your camp. $He was stripped of arms, armor, and valuables, and then left for dead.
column2: 你悄然钻入草丛，穿行沟壑，终脱匪徒之追。夜半，$ChosenOneName踉跄入营。你被夺甲械财货，弃置待毙。

column1: You race away down a side street. The crowd converges on the guardsmen holding the rebel leaders. Instantly the guards disappear and the leaders are freed. As you watch, the mob parades their rebel heroes on their shoulders.
column2: 你沿侧街疾驰。人群涌向拘押叛首之卫士。顷刻，卫士隐匿，叛首获释。目送之下，暴民肩扛英雄游行。

column1: You race through brush and gullies, and finally elude the pursuing bandits. You hide until dusk, then move a bit further and hide for the night.
column2: 你穿行草丛与沟壑，终脱追匪。藏至黄昏，复移数步，夜宿于此。

column1: You race through brush and gullies, and finally elude the pursuing bandits. You hide until dusk, then move a bit further and hide for the night. During the night the rest of your party staggers into your camp. Stripped of arms, armor and valuables, they were left for dead by the bandits.
column2: 你穿行草丛与沟壑，终脱追匪。藏至黄昏，复移数步，夜宿于此。夜半，余党踉跄入营，皆被夺甲械财货，弃置待毙。

column1: You race through brush and gullies, and finally elude the pursuing bandits. You hide until dusk, then move a bit further and hide for the night. During the night, $ChosenOneName rejoins the party. Stripped of arms, armor and valuables, $he was left for dead by the bandits.
column2: 你穿行草丛与沟壑，终脱追匪。藏至黄昏，复移数步，夜宿于此。夜半，$ChosenOneName归队。你被夺甲械财货，弃置待毙。

column1: You race to assist $ChosenOneName, but before the battle is joined, the sun is blotted out by a huge dark shadow. The dragon is at hand! It lands with a clash of metal scales and the girl's screams are drowned out by its gloating hiss.
column2: 你疾奔驰援$ChosenOneName，然战端未启，烈日已被巨影遮蔽。巨龙临矣！金属鳞片相击落地，少女尖叫声湮没于其得意之嘶。

column1: You rattle off a quick prayer, drawing a few suspicious glances for your trouble. A breath of fresh air blows across the entire clearing, accompanied by a sound like thunder. Though no one else seems to notice, the altar now looks decidedly purer.
column2: 你匆匆诵念一祷，引数道疑虑目光。清风拂过空地，伴雷鸣之声。旁人未觉，祭坛却愈发洁净。

column1: You rattle off a quick prayer, drawing several suspicious glances. Nothing seems to happen in the heavens, and now several people are muttering among themselves, pointing at you and scowling. One member of the crowd approaches the satanic priest in a deferential manner, and speaks softly to him. Nothing else happens, but you feel very uneasy.
column2: 你匆匆诵念一祷，引来数道疑虑目光。天际无异，众人窃窃私语，指指点点，面露愠色。一人恭敬趋近邪教祭司，低语几句。别无异象，然你心甚不安。

column1: You realize $he just didn't have the strength to survive the cold water and the currents.
column2: 你知你终难抗寒水与激流。

column1: You realize that any attempt to resist or fight will simply result in you being overwhelmed, excommunicated, and then killed.
column2: 你深知，任何反抗之举皆将招致覆灭：被逐出教会，继而丧命。

column1: You realize that no matter which political group wins, you will lose. If the rebellion succeeds, the new government will remember your former activities and probably arrest you. If the government survives, $NamedOneName will certainly use his influence to seek revenge.
column2: 你悟无论何派胜出，汝皆败北。若叛乱成功，新政府必记汝往昔之举，或加逮捕。若政府幸存，$NamedOneName定会借势报复。

column1: You realize that she is half dreaming, and has mistaken you for the grim reaper. Quickly, you tell her what actions are demanded of her and her husband to avoid instant death. Never doubting, she thanks you for this opportunity to survive as you steal away.
column2: 你知彼半梦半醒，误认汝为死神。你速告其夫妇当行之事，以免立毙。彼毫不迟疑，感激汝赐生机，汝则悄然离去。

column1: You realize that successful intimidation requires not only fame and charisma, but an especially evil reputation here in $PlaceName.
column2: 你悟威慑之效，非仅凭名望与气度，更需在此$PlaceName树立极恶之名。

column1: You realize that to avoid a fight and to avoid alerting the guard, you will have to be very clever. You...
column2: 你悟为避冲突、不惊卫兵，汝须智谋过人。汝……

column1: You realize that to avoid a fight and to keep from alerting the guard, you will have to be very clever. You...
column2: 你悟为避冲突、不惊卫兵，汝须智谋过人。汝……

column1: You realize that whoever wins, you will be the loser. If the government survives, it will certainly remember your rebel activites and seek your arrest. If the rebellion is successful, $NamedOneName will surely seek revenge.
column2: 你悟无论谁胜，汝皆输家。若政府幸存，必记汝叛迹，或加逮捕。若叛乱成功，$NamedOneName定寻复仇。

column1: You realize that you have only two choices:
column2: 你悟汝唯有两途：

column1: You realize that you must go through with what you started, if you don't want to arouse overwhelming suspicion. Nervously, one by one you present your hands to the sentry wolf, who sniffs each of you in turn. It has no apparent reaction.
column2: 你悟若不招众疑，汝须坚持既定。忐忑间，汝逐一伸掌于哨狼，彼一一嗅之，毫无反应。

column1: You realize that your reputation is ruined here in $PlaceName. Both the rebels and your former employer have reason to hate you. Regardless of who wins the upcoming battle, you are the loser. Instinctively, you begin moving...
column2: 你悟汝在此$PlaceName声名扫地。叛军与旧主皆怀恨意。无论战局如何，汝皆败者。本能驱使，汝开始行动……

column1: You realize that your reputation will suffer, but not too much. After all, public sentiment strongly favors the government rather than the rebel cause. Few will blame you for abandoning $NamedOneName to his fate. However, his immediate friends (and your former comrades) might exact a terrible vengeance. Commanded by this fear, you quickly pack to leave...
column2: 你悟汝声誉受损，然不至太甚。毕竟民心偏向政府而非叛军。鲜有人责汝弃$NamedOneName于命。然其密友（汝旧侣）或施惨烈报复。惧此，汝匆忙收拾欲离……

column1: You realize the monk was politely saying that your ability to read and study Latin wasn't up to their standards. You wouldn't have had much chance to successfully learn from their books!
column2: 你悟僧侣委婉之意：汝读研拉丁文之功，不及彼辈。汝本难从其书中学得真谛！

column1: You realize the whole neighborhood has seen your embarrassment, and that your reputation hasn't improved any!
column2: 你悟邻里皆见汝窘态，汝誉更损无疑！

column1: You realize they are thanking their demonic masters for sending the dragon! Their magic brought forth the dragon. Now they are casting a new spell, to bring the dragon under their control!
column2: 你悟彼等正谢其魔主遣龙！法术召来巨龙，今又施新咒，欲控此龙！

column1: You realize this knowledge, if circulated widely with strong proof, would cause consternation and a quick replacement.
column2: 你悟此识若广传，并附确凿证据，必致朝野震动，促速换人。

column1: You realize this leader is blind to his weaknesses. You must find other way to influence him, or remove him entirely.
column2: 你意识到这位领袖对自己的弱点视而不见。你必须另寻他法来影响他，或将其彻底除去。

column1: You realize this must be the annual fair. Because you are $PlaceAttitude here, you...
column2: 你意识到这必定是年度集市。因你在此 $PlaceAttitude，你...

column1: You realize you don't have enough money for your passage. As you walk away, $ChosenOneName remarks that if you got rid of the mounts, the price would be a lot cheaper.
column2: 你意识到自己钱不够支付路费。当你离去时，$ChosenOneName 说道，若弃置坐骑，价格便会便宜许多。

column1: You reconsider your plans in light of this unwelcome news.
column2: 你因这不速之闻重新审视自己的计划。

column1: You regain consciousness later. The kidnappers have taken $ChosenOneName, and have left the rest of you for dead. Obviously $he is quite valuable, since they didn't stop to plunder your bodies, save for the contents of your purse!
column2: 你稍后恢复意识。绑匪已劫走 $ChosenOneName，将余下之人弃之不顾。显然 你 极为贵重，他们竟未搜刮你的财物，仅掠去钱袋中的钱财！

column1: You release the friar. He is extremely grateful. "Those fiends were going to sacrifice me to some devil they call Baphomet."
column2: 你放开了那位修士。他感激万分。“那些恶徒本要将我献祭给一个名为巴佛墨特的恶魔。”

column1: You remain hidden in the shadows at the far end of the room as the subject replies, "I am ready." They speak several hideous words, including the strange phrase "Retson Retap," that cause your skin to crawl. Then the men leave. You...
column2: 当那人答道：“我已准备就绪”时，你仍藏身于房间尽头的阴影之中。他们念出几段可怖的咒语，其中更有“Retson Retap”这般令你毛骨悚然的异词。随后众人离去。你……

column1: You reply that you do, and move behind the altar where fewer people can see you. Then you...
column2: 你答称确实如此，并移至祭坛后方，那里人迹罕至。接着你……

column1: You reply, "Not so. As non-signers, our usage of the bridge may be illegal, but must be punished according to law. In any case, the contract's penalties do not apply to us."
column2: 你答道：“非也。作为未签字之人，我们使用此桥虽属非法，却应依法惩处。无论如何，契约中的罚则并不适用于我们。”

column1: You reply, "We were not. We were saying the Lord's Prayer backwards."
column2: 你答道：“并非如此。我们只是倒背主祷文罢了。”

column1: You reply...
column2: 你答道……

column1: You respect $his perceptions, ($he's the best in the party for this sort of thing) and decide to...
column2: 你尊重你的感知力（你乃队伍中此类本领之翘楚），遂决定……

column1: You respond by...
column2: 你回应道……

column1: You respond, saying...
column2: 你答道……

column1: You rest for a day and a night, tended by the kindly nuns, who redress your wounds and pray for your souls.
column2: 你在慈祥修女们的照料下休养一日一夜，她们为你包扎伤口，为你的灵魂祈祷。

column1: You rest quietly. Then the abbess' clerk appears.
column2: 你静静歇息。随后，修道院院长的书记现身。

column1: You retire into the trees and reconsider your options.
column2: 你退入林间，重新权衡对策。

column1: You retire to a quiet corner of the woods near the gate, sit on an old log, and discuss your options once more.
column2: 你隐于城门旁林中一角，坐于朽木之上，再议应对之策。

column1: You retreat down a series of side alleys until you're safe. The thugs are free to continue their nefarious assault on the guild, but at least you have survived, even if your reputation has suffered.
column2: 你沿一连串小巷撤退，直至安全之地。暴徒们仍可继续其对公会的恶行，但至少你已脱险，尽管声名受损。

column1: You retreat from the lair. Clearly the priest, with his invulnerability to harm and demon-summoning abilities, is too tough for you now. You resolve to be better equipped before attempting a rematch.
column2: 你撤离巢穴。显然，那神父刀枪不入，又能召魔，此刻实难匹敌。你决心重整旗鼓，再作较量。

column1: You return to his hut, and within a few minutes he finds the $NamedOneName. You reverently take the precious object, thanking him profusely.
column2: 你重返其茅屋，不久便寻得$NamedOneName。你虔诚接过宝物，千恩万谢。

column1: You return to the feast preparation area to see what you have wrought. A new cook is there, gnashing his teeth in frustraion.
column2: 你回到宴席准备区，查看自己的成果。一名新厨正咬牙切齿，满心懊恼。
