column1: You return to the feast preparation area to see what you have wrought. A new cook is there, gnashing his teeth in frustration.
column2: 你回到宴席准备区，查看自己的成果。一名新厨正咬牙切齿，满心懊恼。

column1: You return to the miners' camp. The miners greet you, hopeful that you have succeeded. It feels wonderful to deal with humans instead of with the cold-blooded dwarf.
column2: 你回到矿工营地。矿工们满怀希冀地迎接你，盼你有所斩获。与冷酷的矮人打交道之后，与人类相处果然令人舒畅。

column1: You run and run, but can't seem to outdistance the guards. Inexorably, if somewhat slowly, they are gaining on you. Finally you turn to fight. You are at bay. Let the guards beware.
column2: 你拼命奔逃，却始终甩不掉追兵。他们虽慢，却步步逼近。最终你只得转身迎战。你已无路可退。追兵小心了！

column1: You run down the street, turn a corner, and then quickly press yourselves against the wall, drawing your weapons and facing the avenue. Unfortunately, you've all made one tiny error in your calculations: the guards arrive from the opposite direction! The intended ambush is a big flop, and soon you are hotly engaged in combat just the same.
column2: 你沿街疾跑，转过街角，随即紧贴墙边，拔出武器，面向大道。可惜你们都算错了一点：追兵竟从反方向杀来！伏击计划彻底落空，很快你们便陷入激战。

column1: You run down the street, turn a corner, and then quickly press yourselves against the wall, drawing your weapons. When the guards come running past, you hurl yourselves upon them. Surprise is complete.
column2: 你沿街疾跑，转过街角，随即紧贴墙边，拔出武器。待追兵飞驰而过，你猛然扑上。出其不意，大获全胜。

column1: You run from the diabolic visitation, but they have spotted you. They reach into flapping cloaks, pull out fistfuls of large spiked seeds, and hurl them downward.
column2: 你逃离那场魔鬼般的侵袭，但他们已发现你踪迹。只见他们探入宽大的斗篷，掏出一把把带刺的硕大种子，朝你掷下。

column1: You run into the nearby woods and try to hide from your pursuers, but their skills in woodland lore clearly exceed those of your leader, $ChosenTwoName. Without trouble, they track you down and surround you. You have no more choices: you draw your weapons and prepare for battle.
column2: 你奔入近旁林中，试图躲避追兵，然而对方的林野追踪之术远胜你的首领$ChosenTwoName。他们轻易追踪到你，将你团团围住。别无选择，你只得拔剑备战。

column1: You run toward the nearest street, a small, dark lane leading into the heart of the city...
column2: 你奔向最近的街道——一条通往城心的小巷……

column1: You rush through the gate before reinforcements arrive. You had better watch yourself while within $PlaceName. The soldiers will not soon forget this humiliation.
column2: 你在援军赶到前冲过城门。身处$PlaceName之内，务必谨慎。士兵们绝不会轻易忘却这番屈辱。

column1: You say soothingly, "Fear not, we were only singing."
column2: 你温言道：“莫怕，我们只是在唱歌罢了。”

column1: You see a grim cairn and realize you are now in the territory of the robber knight (raubritter) $NamedOneName. Within his domain, your lives aren't worth a wooden pfennig!
column2: 你望见一座阴森的石冢，这才意识到自己已踏入劫匪骑士$NamedOneName的领地。在其治下，你等性命不过值一枚木制芬尼！

column1: You see a large group of citizens assembling in the streets. Many carry simple weapons. Men you recognize as the traitorous rebel leaders are speaking, urging them to march on $VarString1 and chase out the $CityLordTitle. Thinking quickly, you...
column2: 你见街上聚集着一大群市民，许多人手持简陋兵器。你认得那些叛首正在煽动众人，催促他们进军$VarString1，驱逐$CityLordTitle。你灵机一动……

column1: You see groups of common people along the main street. They are watching a party of guardsmen, who carefully move down the center of the street. The guardsmen have arrested the rebel leaders and are trying to reach the $VarString1. The citizens are forming an ugly mob to stop them.
column2: 你见大街两旁聚着许多平民。他们围观一队卫兵，后者正小心翼翼地沿街中央前行。卫兵已拘捕叛首，欲前往$VarString1。市民们则集结成众，意图阻拦。

column1: You see heads nodding in agreement. Finally, your leader at the end of the table says, "I agree" in a loud voice, then stands up.
column2: 你见众人纷纷点头赞同。终于，桌尾的首领高声说道：“我同意”，随即站起身来。

column1: You see nothing but a blonde woman puttering around the yard. She says something to a couple of very large dogs, or perhaps wolves, then goes inside and starts cooking. Finally, just before dusk, you decide to...
column2: 你只见到一位金发女子在院中忙碌。她对两只体型硕大的犬——抑或狼——说了些什么，随后入内烹调。暮色将至，你终于决定……

column1: You see several men and women carrying various items, such as small candles and sprigs of plants you don't recognize. One even holds a live cockerel.
column2: 你见数名男女携带着各式物品，如小蜡烛与你不识的枝叶，甚至有人手握一只活鸡。

column1: You see that the cliff opening is a sort of audience chamber. In the shadows sits a large rune-covered throne. Sprawled comfortably in the throne's seat is short, dark-skinned dwarf, who says
column2: 你发现崖洞实为一处觐见厅。阴影中端坐着一张刻满符文的大座。矮小黝黑的矮人安坐其上，开口说道：

column1: You select a likely back door, but $ChosenOneName can't seem to open it. As you start to discreetly move away, an upstairs window flies open.
column2: 你选中一道看似可行的后门，但$ChosenOneName竟无法开启。正当你悄然退去之际，楼上一扇窗骤然洞开。

column1: You set down in the field with a whispered prayer of thanks.
column2: 你轻声祈祷，随后安然落地。

column1: You set up camp just beyond bowshot and begin the wait.
column2: 你于弓箭射程之外扎营，静候时机。

column1: You settle down in the shadows and take a quick nap. It seems that the three hours pass in but an instant.
column2: 你潜入阴影，小憩片刻。三小时仿佛弹指即逝。

column1: You shake your head, then ...
column2: 你摇了摇头，继而……

column1: You shake your heads knowingly.
column2: 你默契地点了点头。

column1: You share a farewell drink and part on reasonably good terms.
column2: 你们共饮饯别之酒，分道扬镳，尚算相安无事。

column1: You share stories about the saints, but discover that he knows none who are truly new to you. Still, the experience was both enlightening and uplifting.
column2: 你们互谈圣贤事迹，却发现他所知并无一人是你未曾听闻。即便如此，这段时光仍令你受益匪浅，倍感振奋。

column1: You shrink back as the graveyard rumbles. You are appalled to see hideous forms rising from the soil. Living corpses have come to enact the witch's curse!
column2: 墓园轰鸣，你不禁后退。只见可怖的形影自泥土中升起。活尸竟为施行女巫之咒而来！

column1: You shrug. He then seems to shake himself, as if dismissing the subject, and says, "Is there anything I can help you with?"
column2: 你耸了耸肩。他似将此事抛诸脑后，淡淡说道：“还有什么能帮你的吗？”

column1: You shudder at the 'blessing,' but pass within.
column2: 你对那‘祝福’心生寒意，却还是走了进去。

column1: You sidle up to the guards and try to engage them in friendly conversation. Unfortunately, they aren't having any of it. Glaring, they grip their weapons tightly and order you away. "Move along, riff-raff," one guard grunts. "We have work to do."
column2: 你凑近卫兵，试图与其攀谈。无奈对方毫不理会。他们怒目而视，紧握武器，喝令你离开。“滚开，贱民！”一名卫兵低吼道，“我们还有正事要做。”

column1: You sit around the campfire in the evening, eating your meal. Suddenly wild screams erupt around you! Dirty bandits leap forward from all directions. You have just enough time to grab your weapons.
column2: 夜幕降临，你围坐在篝火旁用餐。忽闻四周狂呼乱叫！四面八方窜出一伙歹徒。你仓促抓起武器，勉强来得及。

column1: You sit back, finishing the ale and digesting this news. Suddenly the $Inn door bursts open. A squad of city guardsmen leap into the common room!
column2: 你靠在椅背上，饮尽杯中麦酒，细细思量这则消息。忽地，$Inn的门被猛地撞开。一队城卫兵跃入大厅！

column1: You sit back, finishing your ale and digesting this news. Suddenly the lanterns flicker and the fire roars as the $Inn door bursts open. A squad of city guardsmen dash into the room!
column2: 你靠坐下来，饮尽杯中麦酒，细细思量这则消息。忽地，灯笼摇曳，炉火轰然作响，$Inn的门猛然洞开。一队城卫兵疾步闯入室内！

column1: You sit by the comfortable fire at a well-known inn, the $Inn, in the city of $PlaceName. It is time, you think, to seek out your old friends, your blood-brothers. Your thirst for honor and glory, your desire to seek good and defeat evil, is too much for one person.
column2: 你坐在一座闻名遐迩的客栈——$Inn——的暖炉旁，身处$PlaceName城。你心想，是时候去寻访那些旧友，你的血兄弟了。你对荣誉与荣耀的渴求，以及匡扶正义、降伏邪恶的志向，已非一人所能承受。

column1: You sit down and spend some time analyzing the current situation with $NamedOneName. Among other things, you discuss...
column2: 你坐下，与$NamedOneName一同分析当前局势。你们讨论了……

column1: You skillfully wait in a side alley for just the right moment, then quietly slip through a doorway while a junior apprentice is too busy to notice.
column2: 你巧妙地在侧巷中静候良机，待一名学徒忙于事务之际，悄然穿过一道门扉。

column1: You slip away with the grateful girl and advise her to stay with distant relatives, which she promises to do.
column2: 你与感激的少女悄然离去，并劝她投奔远方的亲戚，她允诺照办。

column1: You smile, accept gracefully, and continue onward. Such are the benefits of reputation and fame.
column2: 你微笑，优雅地接受，继续前行。这便是名声与声誉带来的好处。

column1: You snatch it from his trembling hands and triumphantly bear it off.
column2: 你从他颤抖的手中夺过它，得意地将其带走。

column1: You sneak out. As you walk away, you hear a rumble of stones. When you turn, the entrance to the dragon's lair is gone. Your task is accomplished.
column2: 你悄然离去。当你走远时，听见石块的轰鸣声。回头望去，龙穴的入口已不复存在。你的任务已完成。

column1: You sneak through the brush while their guard nods sleepily near the campfire. It's a matter of moments to cut $ChosenOneName free. Now your choices are to...
column2: 你悄然穿过灌木丛，而他们的守卫在篝火旁昏昏欲睡。片刻之间便能将$ChosenOneName解救出来。如今你的选择是……

column1: You sneak up to their camp, but as you're cutting $ChosenOneName free, somebody steps on a twig that makes a loud snap.
column2: 你悄悄潜至他们的营地，但当你正要割断$ChosenOneName时，有人踩到了一根树枝，发出一声清脆的响声。

column1: You so swear, and are soon on your way, albeit with much lighter burdens.
column2: 你如此发誓，不久便踏上征程，虽负重已轻。

column1: You sort through the various goods. You're satisfied that everything is here, although a few items have deteriorated with age to the point of uselessness.
column2: 你仔细清点着各类货物。虽有几件因年久失修已至无用，但总体而言，一切尽在掌握。

column1: You sort through the various goods. You're satisfied that everything is here, although a few items have deteriorated with age.
column2: 你仔细清点各类货物。虽有几件因年久而损毁，但总体尚可。

column1: You sort through the various goods. You're satisfied that everything is here, although some have deteriorated with age and are now worthless.
column2: 你仔细清点各类货物。虽有几件因年久失修已成废品，但总体尚可。

column1: You sort through various papers and ledgers, look in drawers, cabinets and chests. Nobody finds anything incriminating. You have a sense that in some unexamined place is just the right item, but you can't imagine where. You're just not perceptive enough, at least not today.
column2: 你翻阅各类文书与账册，查看抽屉、柜子与箱匣。无人发现任何罪证。你隐约觉得，在某个未曾细查之处，正藏着那件关键之物，却难以揣测其所在。只怪你今日不够敏锐。

column1: You speedily make the decision to...
column2: 你迅速做出决定，去……

column1: You spend $Number1 hours looking up and talking to likely people here in $PlaceName. This includes discussing their earlier life experiences...
column2: 你在$PlaceName花费$Number1小时，四处张望并与可能的人交谈。这包括讨论他们早年的经历……

column1: You spend a miserable night without a campfire, hiding in a thicket. The next day you creep back to the ambush sight. There is no sign of $ChosenOneName but you do find your other friends a short distance from the battlefield, stripped and left for dead.
column2: 你度过了一个凄惨的夜晚，没有篝火，藏身于灌木丛中。翌日，你悄然返回伏击地点。不见$ChosenOneName踪影，却在战场不远处发现了你的同伴们，他们衣衫褴褛，被弃置于此，奄奄一息。

column1: You spend a miserable night without a campfire, hiding in a thicket. The next day you creep back to the ambush sight. There is no sign of $ChosenOneName.
column2: 你度过了一个凄苦的夜晚，没有篝火，藏身于灌木丛中。翌日，你悄然返回伏击之地。$ChosenOneName踪迹全无。

column1: You spend an entire night in the area, watching nothing but the rats and mice. As the sun rises, everybody is yawning and stiff.
column2: 你在该地度过整整一夜，只见鼠辈出没。旭日东升时，众人皆打哈欠，筋骨僵硬。

column1: You spend an entire night strolling around the guild, watching nothing but the rats and mice. As the sun rises, everybody is yawning and stiff.
column2: 你整夜在公会中漫步，所见唯有鼠辈。旭日初升，众人皆打着哈欠，浑身僵硬。

column1: You spend an hour trying to converse pleasantly with the clerks, but they are clearly bored with your prattle. Eventually you graciously withdraw, having accomplished nothing.
column2: 你费时一小时，试图与书吏们谈笑风生，然其显然厌倦于你的闲言。终而礼退，一事无成。

column1: You spend hours looking for a chance to sneak in, but the guildsmen are too watchful and the street is too busy. Perhaps you'll have better luck another day, or perhaps you should be more stealthy and streetwise!
column2: 你苦寻良机，欲潜入其中，然公会之人戒备森严，街市亦熙攘不息。或可他日再试，抑或当更谙潜行之道，练就街头智慧！

column1: You spend hours looking for a chance to sneak in, but there are just too many people, everywhere. Perhaps you'll have better luck another day, or perhaps you should be more stealthy and streetwise!
column2: 你花费数小时寻找潜入的机会，但四处皆是人影。或许他日会有更好的运气，又或许你该更加隐秘、更谙世事！

column1: You spend quite some time in pleasant -- but ultimately useless -- conversation with the various junior clerks working in the anterooms. About all you learn is that the nearest Hanseatic city is $NamedThreeName.
column2: 你在前厅与各色低阶文吏闲聊良久，虽觉惬意，却终究无甚收获。所知不过最近的汉萨同盟城市乃$NamedThreeName而已。

column1: You spend some hours renewing acquaintances, and find a few possible companions to round out your party. Gaining information about their attributes, skills and possessions takes more time. You invest this time to learn about...
column2: 你花数小时重叙旧谊，寻得几位可能的同伴以充实队伍。了解他们的属性、技能与财物则需更长时间。你投入此时间以探知……

column1: You spend some time learning the political leanings of...
column2: 你花了一些时间了解……的政治倾向。

column1: You spend time discovering the political opinions of...
column2: 你花时间探知……的政治观点。

column1: You spin around again, and find you are surrounded by guards whose sharp weapon-points are just inches away from your faces! You have no choice but to surrender.
column2: 你再次转身，发现四周已被卫兵包围，锋利的刀尖仅距你的面庞数寸！你别无选择，只得投降。

column1: You spot a small cave beneath an overhanging ledge. It looks dry and empty, but the ground in front of it is bare dirt. You decide to...
column2: 你在一处悬岩之下发现了一处小洞穴。看似干燥空旷，但洞前地面却是一片裸露的泥土。你决定……

column1: You spy a hilltop above the water, but can't get there fast enough. You are forced to abandon your heavier armor and weapons to struggle through the rising water to safety.
column2: 你望见水面上方的一座山顶，却无法及时抵达。你被迫弃下沉重的甲胄与武器，挣扎着穿过渐涨的洪水，逃向安全之地。

column1: You spy a holzfrau, woodwife of the schrats. She prances with joy, then whispers, "You have everything you need to protect yourselves. When next the Wild Hunt attempts to catch you, simply pray to $Text1. Then the Hunt will go away and attack you no more."
column2: 你望见一位木妇，乃精灵之妻。她雀跃欢欣，低语道：“尔等已备齐护身之物。待下回狂猎来袭，只需向$Text1祈祷。届时狂猎将退散，不再加害于汝。”

column1: You spy a holzfrau, woodwife of the schrats. She seems delighted, whispering, "You now know of $Text1 and can evoke this saint when needed. You are protected from the Hunt." With that, she vanishes.
column2: 你瞥见一位木妇，即树精的女伴。她似乎欣喜若狂，低语道：“汝已知晓$Text1，且可在需时召此圣者。汝已受猎团庇护。”言毕，她便消逝无踪。

column1: You spy a holzfrau, woodwife of the schrats. She smiles, nods, and vanishes.
column2: 你瞥见一位木妇，地精的女仆。她微笑颔首，随即消失不见。

column1: You stand at the end of a row of dank cells. The burly guards aren't happy to have their card game interupted. Gruffly the sergeant asks your business.
column2: 你伫立于一排阴冷牢房的尽头。魁梧的卫兵们对被打断的牌局颇为不满。军曹粗声问道，你有何贵干。

column1: You stand in the middle of the field, viewing the activities taking place here.
column2: 你伫立于田野中央，观望着此间发生的种种。

column1: You stand in the middle of the field. Near the stream, the satanic baptism is taking place. To the west, witches are riding broomsticks into the sky. Due north of you, cooks are preparing a feast for the assemblage; to the east is a large altar. You wander...
column2: 你伫立于田野中央。溪畔，邪教的洗礼正在举行。西面，女巫骑着扫帚升入天际。正北，厨子们为众人筹备盛宴；东侧则是一座巨大的祭坛。你漫步……

column1: You stand on line with the witches. Listening carefully, you overhear one ask another if she will be attending the Sabbat $SabbatLocation. You cannot hear the other's reply.
column2: 你与女巫们并肩而立。仔细聆听，你隐约听见一人询问另一人是否将出席$SabbatLocation的安息日。对方的答语却听不真切。

column1: You stand on line with the witches. Listening carefully, you overhear one ask the other if she will be attending the Sabbat $SabbatLocation. The other replies that she is not free to travel on $SabbatTime.
column2: 你与女巫们并肩而立。细听之下，你听见一人问另一人是否将出席$SabbatLocation的萨巴特。对方答曰，她于$SabbatTime无暇出行。

column1: You stand over the rebel leaders, quickly tie them up, and then order the guardsmen to drag them away while following you. You need to keep your weapon-hands free, in case the crowd tries to interfere.
column2: 你立于叛首之上，迅疾将其缚住，随即命卫士押之随行。汝须留手以备不测，以防众民作梗。

column1: You stand, confronted by four innocent ones who have only you to protect them from the horror of the witches. You...
column2: 你站立着，面对四位无辜之人，他们唯有你一人能护其免受女巫之恐怖。你...

column1: You stare back into the eyes of the satanic priest with utter calm. Though it feels as if his gaze lingers on you, finally he looks away and shakes his head.
column2: 你以无比的平静凝视着那名撒旦祭司的眼睛。尽管他的目光仿佛久久停留在你身上，最终他还是移开了视线，摇了摇头。

column1: You stare glumly at the least-guarded section of $PlaceName's walls. The only real options in daytime are...
column2: 你阴郁地凝视着$PlaceName城墙守备最松的一段。白日里唯一可行的途径是……

column1: You stare into the eyes of the satanic priest, but the comfort of the saint is not with you. You feel panic, and that is your undoing: the eyes of the priest are riveted upon you.
column2: 你凝视着那名撒旦祭司的眼睛，但圣者的庇佑已离你而去。你感到恐慌，而这正是你的败因：祭司的目光牢牢锁定于你身上。

column1: You stare into the eyes of the satanic priest. Sweat trickles down the side of your face. $ChosenOneName coughs and looks down, and the eyes of the priest are suddenly riveted upon you.
column2: 你凝视着那名撒旦祭司的眼睛。汗水顺着你的脸颊缓缓滑落。$ChosenOneName咳嗽一声，低头望去，祭司的目光骤然锁定在你身上。

column1: You start to run to help $ChosenOneName, but before you reach her, the reptile stretches forth its neck to her. With two quick snaps of its jaws, it is all over. The beast delicately pries her body loose of its bonds, and flaps off.
column2: 你开始奔向 $ChosenOneName 拯救她，但尚未赶到，那条爬虫已伸长脖颈扑向她。两记迅猛的咬合，一切便已终结。巨兽轻巧地将她的身躯从束缚中剥离，振翅而去。

column1: You stealthily creep toward the wall, but an alert guard spots you. "Stop!" he shouts. But you have already vanished back into the slums of $PlaceName. When next you look at the wall, you see that the guards are now nervous and watchful, looking around for other attempts at illicit exit.
column2: 你悄然潜行至墙边，却被警觉的守卫发现。“站住！”他喝道。然而你已遁入$PlaceName的贫民窟。再回首望向那堵墙时，只见守卫们神色紧张，四处张望，防备着他人再次试图非法越境。

column1: You stealthily creep up to the wall, and climb it, taking advantage of every nook in the masonry to hide yourselves. When you reach the top, you quickly tie a rope around one of the crenellations and let yourselves down. Unfortunately, you have no way of getting the rope down after you, so you leave it hanging behind.
column2: 你悄然潜至墙边，攀上城墙，利用砖石间的每一处凹陷掩藏身形。登顶后，你迅速将绳索系于垛口之一，缓缓垂下。可惜绳索无法收回，只得任其悬挂在身后。

column1: You step back and reconsider your options.
column2: 你退后一步，重新思量对策。

column1: You step forward swiftly, trying to be as casual as possible as you plant bits of Scripture in the centers of the pentagrams and place holy symbols beneath the altar-block, while muttering small prayers of purification all about the area.
column2: 你疾步上前，尽量装作若无其事，在五芒星中央撒下经文碎片，并在祭坛石块下置放圣物，同时低声诵念净化祷文，遍及四周。

column1: You step forward swiftly, trying to be as casual as possible as you plant bits of Scripture in the centers of the pentagrams, and place holy symbols beneath the altar-block, while muttering small prayers of purification all about the area.
column2: 你疾步上前，尽量装作若无其事，在五芒星中央撒下经文碎片，并在祭坛石块下置放圣物，同时低声诵念净化祷文，遍及四周。

column1: You step out of the offices, back into the marketplace.
column2: 你走出办公室，重返集市。

column1: You step through the doorway into the sumptuous paneled anteroom of the Hanseatic League, the most powerful mercantile combine in Northern Europe.
column2: 你穿过大门，步入汉萨同盟那富丽堂皇、镶板环绕的前厅——北欧最强大的商团。

column1: You step within the robber knight's tower.
column2: 你踏入强盗骑士的塔楼。

column1: You stop and consider various options.
column2: 你停下脚步，思索对策。

column1: You stop bleeding after a time, but all attempts at bandaging your injuries fail. You will never be the same.
column2: 良久之后，血止住了，但包扎伤口皆告失败。你再难如初。

column1: You stride forward, weapons ready, as the boars close for the final, deadly fight.
column2: 你持械前行，野猪逼近，决战一触即发。

column1: You stroll nonchalantly away from the stream; no one pays much notice to you as you wander about the field.
column2: 你漫不经心地离开溪流；无人留意你在田野间徘徊。

column1: You struggle to your feet and look around.
column2: 你挣扎着站起，环顾四周。

column1: You struggle up a low hillock just in time. The water stops rising just below your feet! You spend a cold, miserable day waiting for the water to recede again.
column2: 你奋力爬上一座低丘，恰逢其时。水势停涨，仅在足下一线！你度过寒冷凄苦的一日，静候水退。

column1: You stumble and trip frequently moving through the back alleys, and more than one wrong turn slows your progress.
column2: 穿行于后巷，常有跌撞，误入歧途更延缓行程。

column1: You suggest to the leader that you all...
column2: 你向首领建议，众人……

column1: You survey the fallen bandits with satisfaction. A few less vermin to bother honest travellers!
column2: 你满意地审视倒下的匪徒。少了几只害人虫，正直旅人得以安宁！

column1: You survey the ruin about you. The crypt still seems oppressive, evil. Quickly you scramble up with the $NamedOneName. Outside, the gray sky is turning black. You move off as fast as possible, before anything worse happens.
column2: 你打量周遭废墟。墓穴依旧阴森可怖。你匆匆携$NamedOneName攀出。外头灰云压城，天色渐黑。你尽快离去，以免生变。

column1: You suspect this encounter might have been different if you carried more money.
column2: 你怀疑若携带更多钱财，此番遭遇或许不同。

column1: You suspect this is the time and date for their move against the rebel leaders.
column2: 你猜测这正是他们对叛首动手之时。

column1: You take advantage of the confusion to dash around them and their flailing weapons. Soon you leave them behind. Everyone offers a brief prayer of thanksgiving.
column2: 你趁乱绕过敌手及其挥舞的兵刃。不久便将其甩在身后。众人皆默念感恩祷文。

column1: You take advantage of this confusion to move past them in safety.
column2: 你借此时机安全越过彼等。

column1: You take his advice and continue your journey.
column2: 你听从其言，继续前行。

column1: You take stock of the situation and discuss what to do next.
column2: 你权衡局势，商议下一步。

column1: You take this to mean that you lack sufficient fame, reputation, virtue and/or charisma. Disappointed, you consider what to do next...
column2: 你由此认定自己名望、声望、德行及/或魅力不足。失望之余，思索何去何从……

column1: You take your leave, satisfied that your bribe was quite effective.
column2: 你辞别而去，确信贿赂颇见成效。

column1: You take your leave, satisfied that your bribe was useful.
column2: 你辞别而去，确信贿赂颇有裨益。

column1: You talk it over, then ...
column2: 你商议一番，然后……

column1: You talk with the priest. Using your knowledge of canon law and its Latin sources, you to bring forth jurisdictional points that oblige him to nod in agreement. Finally he agrees that you have the right to stay at least one more day.
column2: 你与神父交谈。凭借对教会法及其拉丁文典籍的熟知，你援引相关条文，令其频频颔首。最终他承认你至少有权再留一日。

column1: You tally up the attitudes of various guilds, wealthy groups, and church leaders, then factor in the feelings of the common people. You estimate that $Number1 or more groups support the rebel cause, and $Number2 or more groups oppose it.
column2: 你统计各公会、富户及教界领袖的态度，并参酌平民之感。估得支持叛军者约有$Number1个团体以上，反对者则达$Number2个以上。

column1: You tell him ...
column2: 你对他说……

column1: You tell him...
column2: 你对他说……

column1: You tell the dwarf, "We want you to leave the mines to the humans now. We helped you win, now you must help us." Grudgingly the dwarf replies,
column2: 你对矮人道：“如今矿井归人类所有。我们助汝取胜，汝亦当助我。”矮人勉强答曰：

column1: You thank $ChosenTwoName for the prayer that caused this miraculous intercession.
column2: 你感谢$ChosenTwoName的祈祷，促成这场奇迹般的庇佑。

column1: You thank him and quickly disappear down a side street.
column2: 你谢过他，旋即转入侧街。

column1: You thank him for his generosity.
column2: 你感谢他的慷慨。

column1: You thank him for this information.
column2: 你感谢此讯。

column1: You thank him, then part upon your separate paths.
column2: 你谢别后，各自分道扬镳。

column1: You thank the clerk and monks for their generous hospitality.
column2: 你感谢书吏与僧侣的盛情款待。

column1: You thank them for their kindness and leave.
column2: 你谢过他们的善意，随即离去。

column1: You then ...
column2: 你随后……

column1: You then spend the next hour straightening out accounts. In addition to $his personal possessions right now, $ChosenOneName receives a full 20% share of the party's entire wealth, including any wealth stored elsewhere or contained in a bank note.
column2: 你接下来花一小时理清账目。除目前拥有的你的件私人物品外，$ChosenOneName还将分得全队财富的整整两成，包括存于他处或银行票据中的资产。

column1: You think about it, but not too deeply. For now, it is enough to drink the good German beer and sing a lusty drinking song with your companions.
column2: 你稍加思量，却未深究。眼下且畅饮美酒，与同伴共唱豪迈酒歌。

column1: You think about it. The gratitude of the Fuggers is nothing to dismiss. Perhaps you had better talk to the miners in person to see what is going on.
column2: 你细细思量。富格家族的感激不容轻视。或许该亲自与矿工一谈，探明究竟。

column1: You think it over, then agree to do what you can.
column2: 你斟酌一番，遂允尽力而为。

column1: You think it over. The village needs help, but the task is not easy. The raubritters (robber knights) of Germany are hard men, served by strong warriors.
column2: 你反复权衡。村庄亟需援助，然任务非易。德意志的raubritters（劫掠骑士）皆是悍勇之士，麾下武士亦骁勇善战。

column1: You think over his parting words.
column2: 你回味他临别之言。

column1: You throw a few rocks over a warehouse, trying to distract the guards from the wharf. They disappear behind the building and you start coming ashore. Unfortunately, the sound of your boots on the wharf echos unpleasantly along the waterfront.
column2: 你朝仓库投掷几块石子，试图转移码头守卫注意力。他们绕至屋后，你开始登陆。可惜靴声沿岸回响，甚是刺耳。

column1: You throw down your weapons and surrender.
column2: 你弃械投降。

column1: You throw down your weapons, and throw yourselves on their mercy. The leader steps up to $ChosenOneName, and with a well-placed stroke, beheads $him! With a motion from their leader, the ambushers close in, death in their eyes.
column2: 你弃械，乞求宽恕。首领上前，对准$ChosenOneName，一击斩首你！首领示意，伏兵逼近，杀意凛然。

column1: You throw down your weapons, and throw yourselves on their mercy. With a motion from their leader, the ambushers close in, death in their eyes.
column2: 你弃械，乞求宽恕。首领示意，伏兵逼近，杀意凛然。

column1: You touch...
column2: 你触碰...

column1: You travel onward. Behind you, Sir $NamedOneName groans while his minions patch his wounds. He will not be eager to fight you again.
column2: 你继续前行。身后，$NamedOneName爵士呻吟着，他的爪牙正在为他包扎伤口。他不会再急于与你交锋了。

column1: You try to ...
column2: 你试图...

column1: You try to escape, but the soldiers are fast, and easily detect your hiding places. All too soon, you are forced to turn and fight.
column2: 你试图逃脱，但士兵行动迅速，轻易便发现了你的藏身之处。很快，你被迫转身迎战。

column1: You try to leap up, but your senses reel; you feel woozy; your legs buckle. The wine was drugged! The Schulz disarms you.
column2: 你试图跃起，却觉天旋地转；头晕目眩；双腿发软。酒中下了药！舒尔茨缴了你的械。

column1: You try to mutter prayers, but the strangers glance at you with such hostility that $ChosenOneName thinks it a better idea to stop.
column2: 你试图低声祈祷，但陌生人投来的敌意让$ChosenOneName觉得还是停止为好。

column1: You try to sneak away, but the cultists spot you and come running, gibbering with rage.
column2: 你试图悄悄溜走，却被教徒发现，他们怒吼着追来。

column1: You turn and leave.
column2: 你转身离去。

column1: You turn and run as $ChosenOneName casts down the vial behind you. Unfortunately, the nimble thugs see the vial coming. They cover and dodge for a second, then continue their pursuit.
column2: 你转身逃跑，$ChosenOneName在身后掷下药瓶。不幸的是，那些身手敏捷的恶徒看到了药瓶飞来。他们掩护躲闪了一瞬，随即继续追击。

column1: You turn and run, but quickly you realize that the thugs are gaining on $ChosenOneName. Unwilling to abandon $him, you stand and fight.
column2: 你转身奔逃，却很快发现恶徒正逼近$ChosenOneName。不愿舍弃你，你毅然站定迎战。

column1: You turn to leave, but before you go, $NamedOneName talks briefly to the city's delegates and calls you back. "To show you that the gratitude of His Highness the Emperor is not to be despised, I have arranged for these fellows to give you each a fine horse."
column2: 你转身欲去，临行前，$NamedOneName与城中代表简短交谈后唤你回道：“为表皇上的恩宠不可轻慢，我已安排这些人赠你每人一匹良驹。”

column1: You turn toward a major landmark and set your path for...
column2: 你转向一处地标，定下前行之路。

column1: You uncork the potion and leave it in the guards' favorite resting spot. As they gather there, they begin rubbing their eyes. Quietly, you slip past them.
column2: 你启开药瓶，将其置于守卫常憩之地。待他们聚集于此，纷纷揉眼之际，你悄然绕过。

column1: You understand quite well that you lack sufficient charisma or reputation to interest the Medici in your services!
column2: 你深知自己声望不足，难以令美第奇家族青睐！

column1: You urge your steeds to a gallop, but are not quite fast enough. Some of the boars get in among your horses. You are forced to stop, lest your steeds trip over the wild swine. Then you immediately dismount, before the boars disembowel your mounts with their slashing tusks.
column2: 你催马疾驰，却仍嫌不够快。几头野猪闯入马群，你只得勒缰止步，以免爱马被野猪绊倒。随即翻身下马，以防野猪獠牙剖开坐骑。

column1: You urge your steeds to a gallop, but they are not quite fast enough. Some of the wolves are able to run around you and get ahead. Your horses rear and plunge, frightened by the predators' proximity. You are forced to dismount and fight.
column2: 你催马疾驰，但终究不及狼群迅捷。狼群绕至你前方，马匹受惊而仰蹄狂奔。你不得不下马应战。

column1: You use your best stealth skills to slink away down a dark alley at just the right time. Once out of sight, you run hard for the back streets.
column2: 你凭借高超潜行之技，在恰当时机潜入幽暗小巷。隐于视线之外，你奋力奔向后街。

column1: You wait as the clerk inquires. He returns and says, "If you will wait, $NamedOneName will have some time soon."
column2: 你静候书记官查问。他复返道：“若稍候，$NamedOneName不久便可抽身。”

column1: You wait for an especially busy moment. Then, in an impressive display of street smarts and agility, you slip past the guards and blend in with a group that has already paid.
column2: 你择其最忙之时，凭街头智慧与敏捷，悄然绕过守卫，混入已缴费人群。

column1: You wait patiently in the darkness. Finally their guard nods off to sleep. Minutes later, $ChosenOneName drops the ropes (which $he had apparently untied) and begins crawling away. You signal and $he crawls toward you. A few minutes later you're reunited. Quickly, you disappear into the darkness.
column2: 你在黑暗中耐心守候。终于，守卫昏然入睡。数分钟后，$ChosenOneName放下绳索（显然是你所解），开始匍匐撤离。你示意，你亦向你爬来。片刻后，你们重聚，随即隐入夜色。

column1: You wait quietly until $ChosenTwoName attacks from the opposite side of their camp. Once the kidnappers are roused and moving toward the attack, you break cover and rush for $ChosenOneName. You reach $him and are cutting the bonds just as the kidnappers realize the ruse!
column2: 你静静等待，直至$ChosenTwoName自营地另一侧发动袭击。绑匪惊醒，扑向目标时，你即刻现身，直奔$ChosenOneName。你甫抵你，正割断绳索，绑匪方觉有诈！

column1: You wait quite a while, but eventually the clerk returns and leads you to the well-appointed office of $NamedOneName, the manager of Fugger banking in this city.
column2: 你久候，终见书记官引你至$NamedOneName——本城富格银行经理——那间陈设考究的办公室。

column1: You wait until all is quiet behind a certain back door. $ChosenOneName uses $his artifice skill to slip the bolt, and you all quietly steal inside.
column2: 你待至某后门寂静无声。$ChosenOneName以你的潜行术拨动门栓，众人悄然潜入。

column1: You wait until nightfall. The activity around the city doesn't cease, but it does slow down. Near midnight, you approach the main gate.
column2: 你静候夜幕降临。城中喧嚣未歇，却渐趋平缓。近午夜时分，你靠近城门。

column1: You wait until the guards gather together with the cleaning woman. As they exchange news and rough jokes, the potion bottle suddenly shatters among them. They reach for their swords, but it's far too late. In moments they are all dead. You drag the bodies to a dark corner, but it's obvious that come morning, there will be a hue and cry throughout $PlaceName.
column2: 你待至守卫与清洁妇齐聚。他们谈笑间，药瓶猝然碎裂于其间。守卫拔剑，却已迟矣。顷刻间，皆已毙命。你将尸首拖至暗处，然清晨必会惊动全$PlaceName。

column1: You wait until the witches have performed most of the ceremony. The evil power is almost overwhelming, but you hold out.
column2: 你待至女巫仪式大半结束。邪力几近压顶，你仍勉力支撑。

column1: You wait, and wonder what will occur.
column2: 你静候，思忖变局。

column1: You wait, but aside from bird songs and the rustle of squirrels, you see nothing.
column2: 你静候，除鸟鸣与松鼠窸窣外，别无动静。

column1: You wait, listening to the rustle of the wind and the occasional chirp of the birds. A small doe comes to the lakeside, drinks, and walks off into the forest. All is quiet.
column2: 你静听风声与偶闻鸟啼。一只小鹿来到湖畔，饮水后遁入林中。四下寂然。

column1: You wait, weapons ready. All is silent. Your horses are either lost or eaten -- but at least you survived this encounter.
column2: 你持械静待。万籁俱寂。马匹或失或食，幸而你独存。

column1: You wait. The wind moans among the rocks and through the trees. Nothing happens.
column2: 你静候。风啸岩间，穿行林梢。并无异状。

column1: You wake up in a back alley near the guild, without your weapons or armor. A quick check reveals that your belt purses are also gone, but not your better-hidden money. From the distant cries of anguish, it is obvious that the thugs accomplished their designs.
column2: 你在公会附近的小巷醒来，武器甲胄尽失。细查之下，腰带钱袋亦不见，唯贴身财物尚存。远处悲号昭示，恶徒已然得逞。

column1: You walk into the chapel. Soon the priest and his altar boy begin; the Mass is sung and everyone takes communion. You all feel a spiritual uplift, but those who understood some of the Latin and followed the Liturgy are especially moved.
column2: 你步入教堂。祭司与辅祭随即开唱弥撒，众人领圣餐。心灵顿感升华，尤以通晓拉丁、随礼之人更为触动。

column1: You walk into the chapel. The priest is preparing the Mass. When the Mass is sung, simple as it is, you feel a spiritual uplift, as though you have found favor with heaven.
column2: 你步入教堂。祭司正准备弥撒。弥撒虽简，却令你心生向上之力，仿佛蒙天眷顾。

column1: You watch and observe, but see nothing. Suddenly your nose is assaulted by the powerful smell of brimstone. Halfway around the lake, yellow smoke is pouring from a crack in the cliffs.
column2: 你凝视观察，却无所见。忽闻硫磺浓烈之气扑鼻。湖畔半途，崖缝中喷涌黄烟。

column1: You watch and observe, but see nothing. Suddenly your nose is assaulted by the powerful smell of brimstone. Halfway around the lake, yellow smoke is pouring from a crack in the cliffs. You are mystified as to the cause of this.
column2: 你凝视观察，却无所见。忽闻硫磺浓烈之气扑鼻。湖畔半途，崖缝中喷涌黄烟。你对缘由 perplexed。

column1: You watch from a distant doorway, well concealed. The sergeant of the guard looks around desperately for you, then loudly curses you all. At that instant, the crowd surges forward and buries the guardsmen in a sea of angry humanity. Terrified of a similar fate, you quick disappear down an alley.
column2: 你远眺门内，隐蔽身形。守备队长四处寻你，继而高声咒骂。刹那间，人群涌上，将守卫淹没于愤怒人海之中。你惧遭同命运，急退入巷。

column1: You watch from a distant doorway, well concealed. The sergeant of the guard looks around for you and curses. Then he steps forward to address the crowd.
column2: 你远眺门内，隐蔽身形。守备队长寻你不获，遂破口大骂。继而上前向众演说。

column1: You watch from a vantage point and see that they don't move. They are scouts, guarding the flank of some larger force still out of sight. You...
column2: 你居高俯瞰，见其不动。乃哨兵，护卫着尚未露面的大军侧翼。你...

column1: You watch from an alley and realize that your involvement for or against this cause would have provided opportunities for fame and advancement. Now it is too late. Meanwhile, it is impossible to go anywhere using the main streets. You retreat to a side street and reconsider your destination...
column2: 你立于巷中，方悟若曾参与此事，无论支持与否，皆可博取功名。如今已晚。且主街难行，你退入支路，重新斟酌去向...

column1: You watch the caravan continue on its journey and disappear into the distance.
column2: 你目送商队远去，渐隐于天际。

column1: You watch the proceedings carefully. "Now?" you hiss.
column2: 你细观事态。“现在？”你低声道。

column1: You watch with bated breath as the pirates stumble around, somehow avoiding everyone and everything. Finally they just shrug and leave. Then you give thanks, softly, for this miraculous deliverance.
column2: 你屏息注视，海盗踉跄而行，竟避开了所有人与物。最终只得耸肩离去。你默默感恩这番奇迹般的脱险。

column1: You watch, dazed, as the rebels dash back into the city, to join the crowd converging on $VarString1. Behind them, you see plumes of smoke rising from burning buildings. $PlaceName is in the grip of total madness now.
column2: 你茫然注视，叛军奔回城中，汇入涌向$VarString1的人潮。身后，燃烧建筑腾起浓烟。$PlaceName已陷入癫狂。

column1: You win a decisive victory.
column2: 你赢得一场决定性胜利。

column1: You wisely take this letter for safe-keeping.
column2: 你明智地将此信妥善保管。

column1: You wonder how you ever could have thought that this village was satanic. Innocent babies cry, peasants laugh at their work, and life is everywhere. Everything seems normal, healthy, and happy. Your suspicions were clearly unfounded.
column2: 你不禁疑惑，何以曾疑此村为邪祟之所？婴孩啼哭，农夫劳作欢笑，生机盎然。一切如常，健康而喜乐。你的疑虑显然无据。

column1: You yell, "You violate your own contract! You must seize the 'first' person across the bridge! $ChosenTwoName was not the first!"
column2: 你喝道：“你违约在先！须擒渡桥第一人！$ChosenTwoName并非首人！”

column1: You're amazed, but everybody makes it to the top of the wall intact. Carefully stepping around the downed guards, you climb down an interior ladder to street level, then move quickly down a back alley.
column2: 你虽惊诧，众人却皆安然登至墙顶。小心翼翼绕过倒下的守卫，你沿内侧梯子攀下至街面，随即疾步转入一条后巷。

column1: You've evaded the thugs for now, but they'll probably find you again, as long as you remain in $PlaceName during its political troubles.
column2: 此刻你已避过暴徒，然若你在$PlaceName政局动荡之际逗留，他们恐将再度寻到你。

column1: You've hardly begun to search when you realize the poisonous mist is literally eating away your eyes and lungs. Half-blinded, staggering, and coughing desperately, you...
column2: 刚刚搜寻未几，你便觉毒雾正侵蚀双眼与肺腑。半盲踉跄，拼命咳嗽，你……

column1: You've learned what you can.
column2: 你已尽得所学。

column1: Your abilities aren't sufficient to overcome their suspicion and distrust. They decide you're really a bunch of scum. What's worse -- by now you're virtually surrounded!
column2: 你的才智不足以消解他们的猜疑与不信。他们认定你等不过一伙败类。更糟的是——此刻你已被重重围困！

column1: Your attempt failed. The king, furious, waves a hand and the door behind you vanishes into blank stone. You cannot run!
column2: 你的尝试失败了。国王震怒，挥手之间，身后的门化作一片空石。你无路可逃！

column1: Your attempt fails. The dwarf king, enraged, waves a hand and the door behind you vanishes into blank stone. You cannot run!
column2: 你的尝试失败了。矮人王大怒，挥手之间，身后的门化作一片空石。你无路可逃！

column1: Your attempt fails. The dwarf king, red with anger, waves a hand and the door behind you vanishes into blank stone. You cannot run!
column2: 你的尝试失败了。矮人王怒火中烧，挥手之间，身后的门化作一片空石。你无路可逃！

column1: Your blockade has lasted some time now, and the raubritter is running short on food. Few robber knights keep large stocks on hand.
column2: 你的封锁已持续多时，劫匪骑士粮草渐尽。鲜有劫匪骑士常备厚储。

column1: Your boat approaches $PlaceName, $PlaceDesc. It is ruled by the $CityLordTitle. You see the wharf is well patrolled, and decide to...
column2: 你的舟船驶近$PlaceName，$PlaceDesc。此地由$CityLordTitle统治。见码头戒备森严，你决定……

column1: Your companion's aim is good, knocking the red cap from $NamedOneName's fingers. The dwarf's eyes bulge with fear as you snatch up the cap. He gibbers with terror,
column2: 你的同伴箭术精准，将红帽自$NamedOneName指间击落。矮人惊惧瞪目，你迅即夺帽。他瑟瑟发抖，满面惊惶，

column1: Your companions laugh wickedly, sharing some sinister private joke. The red-robed noble waves a hand at the wolf, which growls but slinks away.
column2: 你的同伴阴恻恻一笑，似在分享某个险恶的私密笑谈。红袍贵族挥手示意，狼虽低吼，终悄然退去。

column1: Your demands for an explanation go unanswered. The caustic lye burns your skin, and you are terrified lest it get in your eyes. You scrape frantically, washing off the thickest clots with water. Finally, the pain ends.
column2: 你索要解释，却无人回应。苛性碱灼伤肌肤，你唯恐其入眼，忙不迭刮擦，以清水冲去浓稠污物。终于，痛楚止息。

column1: Your duties here are too important for you to be able to leave, but you help the maiden disguise the innocent ones, escort her to the edge of the great field, and see her safely on her way. Miraculously, none of the witches takes notice of these events!
column2: 你在此职责重大，难以抽身，遂助少女掩护无辜者，护送她至旷野边缘，平安送行。奇迹般地，众女巫竟未察觉此事！

column1: Your duties here are too important for you to be able to leave. So you help the maiden disguise the innocents, escort her to the edge of the field and see her safely on her way. Miraculously, none of the witches takes notice of these events!
column2: 你在此职责重大，难以抽身。于是助少女掩护无辜者，护送她至旷野边缘，平安送行。奇迹般地，众女巫竟未察觉此事！

column1: Your escape is only temporary. All too soon, a new wave of enemies breaks from cover, charging toward you. You must stand, fight and win to survive!
column2: 你的逃脱只是暂时。不久，新一轮敌军破阵而出，向你猛扑而来。唯有挺身迎战，方能存活！

column1: Your escape is only temporary. Soon you hear the rumbling of the great chariot. Once more the great hunter is looming over you, raising its spear to strike! You realize there is no escape from this nemesis. You must conquer or die.
column2: 你的逃脱只是暂时。旋即，巨辇隆隆逼近。那猎手再次凌驾于你之上，高举长矛欲击！你深知此宿敌无可遁逃。要么征服，要么殒命。

column1: Your eye is caught by a sleek-skulled little man with three walnut half-shells and a dried pea. "Come, play the game," he cajoles. "Only a groschen!"
column2: 你目光被一名秃首小人吸引，他手持三枚核桃壳与一颗干豌豆。“来，玩一把吧，”他诱道，“只需一枚格罗申。”

column1: Your fair words earn entrance into the tower of $PlaceName. In due time, you are taken before the local lord, who extends the hospitality of his domain for the night, in return for the latest news. You can only accept.
column2: 你言辞得体，获准入塔，进入$PlaceName之塔。稍后，你被引见当地领主，他以领地款待你一夜，作为交换，你需奉上最新消息。你只得应允。

column1: Your fervent prayers are answered by a freshening wind and a faint rumbling from beneath the earth. As the words of the prayer finish, the sounds die away. You look and see that, though none of the witches appears to notice, the stone of the altar has taken on a decidedly cleaner look. You slip away quickly.
column2: 你虔诚祷告，终得风起云涌，地下隐隐雷鸣。祷文甫毕，声息渐歇。你细看之下，虽无女巫察觉，祭坛之石却已焕然一新。你悄然离去。

column1: Your fervent prayers are given extra power by the need of the subjects. As you finish, a small dark figure steps into your midst -- speaking Latin!
column2: 你虔诚祷告，因臣民之需而倍增神力。祷毕，一黑影悄然现身——操拉丁之语！

column1: Your fervent prayers are given extra power by the need of the subjects. As you finish, a small dark figure steps into your midst, speaking Latin!
column2: 你虔诚祷告，因臣民之需而倍增神力。祷毕，一黑影悄然现身，操拉丁之语！

column1: Your foes were vicious and satanic, experienced witches all. Only the power of your righteousness allowed you to triumph.
column2: 你的敌手凶狠如魔，皆为老练女巫。惟凭正义之力，方能胜之。

column1: Your followers have also lost heart. Most have run, but some have surrendered like you. The city guards quickly disarm everyone and take you to the dungeon.
column2: 你的追随者亦已心灰意冷。多数奔逃，少数如你般投降。城卫迅速缴械，将众人押入地牢。

column1: Your friend $ChosenOneName who was already in prison now joins you.
column2: 你的友人$ChosenOneName，本已在狱，如今亦与你同囚。

column1: Your glib explanations, and your reputation in $PlaceName, convince their suspicious leader. "Pass friends, in the name of the one Lord, the cup, and our brotherhood," he says. "But be warned, we have proof that evil German monks plot the end of the world, the apocalypse of Revelations. The millenium will come!"
column2: 你的巧舌如簧，加之你在$PlaceName之名望，终使多疑首领信服。“以独一真主之名，以杯为证，以兄弟情谊相许，放诸友通行，”他说。“但须谨记，我们确有证据，邪恶德僧正图谋世界末日，即启示录之天启。千年将至！”

column1: Your hail echoes off distant hills. There is no response. Well, you know that whatever is there, they aren't after your possessions or money.
column2: 你的呼喊回荡远山，杳无回应。你心知，无论彼处何人，皆非觊觎财物或金银。

column1: Your impressive bearing and reputation impress the guild leaders. They slightly adjust their position, so they now $Support changes in the city government.
column2: 你气度非凡，声名远播，令公会领袖为之折服。他们稍作调整，转而$Support支持市政变革。

column1: Your informant continues, "The devil obligingly built us this excellent bridge. It is enchanted, and cannot be destroyed by flood nor lightning."
column2: 你的线人续道：“那恶魔欣然为我们建起这座良桥。桥身受法术加持，洪水雷电皆不能毁。”

column1: Your last thought is that the monster's superhuman strength, agility, and powers are too much for your merely mortal forms.
column2: 你最后的念头是：怪物之超凡力量、敏捷与神通，远非凡躯所能抗衡。

column1: Your leader, $ChosenOneName, smiles and looks pleased. "Very good, sergeant. You have passed this test by spotting myself and my men, costumed as wanted thugs. I shall speak favorably of you to your officer."
column2: 你的首领$ChosenOneName含笑称许：“甚好，军士。你已通过考验，识破我与部下伪装成通缉暴徒。我将为你向长官美言。”

column1: Your leader, $NamedOneName, explains the plan once more:
column2: 你的首领$NamedOneName复述计划一次：

column1: Your looming presence over the suddenly awakened wife and children of the guild leader has a powerful effect -- as does your less-than-sterling reputation in $PlaceName.
column2: 你赫然现身，惊醒公会首领之妻儿，震慑颇深——加之你在$PlaceName之不佳名声，更添威势。

column1: Your looming presence over the suddenly awakened wife and children of the guild leader has no effect.
column2: 你赫然现身，惊醒公会首领之妻儿，却毫无影响。

column1: Your money is accepted gratefully. A older monk escorts you to a small chapel, where a senior monk leads you in various prayers. Meanwhile, the cantor promises to add prayers for you in the high mass being sung in the main chapel.
column2: 你的馈赠欣然受纳。一老僧引你至小堂，资深僧侣引领你诵经祈祷。与此同时，唱诗班承诺于主堂弥撒中为你加祷。

column1: Your money is counted carefully by the clerk. He motions for a monk, who leads you into a gallery overlooking the main chapel.
column2: 你的钱款由书记员仔细清点。他示意一僧侣，引你至俯瞰主堂之画廊。

column1: Your most dextrous locksmith examines the heavy door and then, breathing heavily, begins a series of contortions wondrous to behold. After an agonizing half hour, the door opens with an ominous clang. You quickly exit.
column2: 你最娴熟的锁匠审视厚重铁门，随后喘息连连，开始一系列令人叹为观止的腾挪。苦熬半时许，铁门轰然开启。你速速退出。

column1: Your most dextrous locksmith examines the lock and then, breathing heavily, begins a series of contortions wondrous to behold. After an agonizing half-hour, the door opens with an ominous clang. You quickly exit.
column2: 你最娴熟的锁匠审视门锁，随后喘息连连，开始一系列令人叹为观止的腾挪。苦熬半时许，铁门轰然开启。你速速退出。

column1: Your mounts gallop forward in terror. The tatzelwurm almost catches you, but cannot maintain your fast pace. You ride on until your mounts are blown. At last you pull up, rest the animals, and congratulate yourselves on a fortunate escape.
column2: 你的坐骑惊骇狂奔。塔采尔蠕虫几近追及，却难继快步。你一路疾驰，直至马匹力竭。终停蹄歇息，抚慰牲畜，庆幸侥幸脱身。

column1: Your mounts rear in terror, dumping $ChosenOneName from the saddle. You stop and guard $him, letting your mounts bolt. In less than a second a tatzelwurm leaps straight at you. It's time to fight or die!
column2: 你的坐骑惊恐前跃，将$ChosenOneName甩落鞍下。你勒马守护你，任马四散奔逃。顷刻间，塔采尔蠕虫直扑而来。生死存亡，只在瞬息！

column1: Your mounts rear in terror, dumping $ChosenOneName from the saddle. You stop and guard $him, letting your mounts bolt. To your surprise, the tatzelwurm streak after the bolting animals. Shortly, in the distance, you hear thrashing and screams of animal pain.
column2: 马匹惊恐仰蹄，将$ChosenOneName甩落鞍下。你止步守护你，任马奔逃。出乎意料，塔采尔蠕虫竟追袭奔马。不久，远处传来动物挣扎与哀嚎。

column1: Your mumbled prayers seem to agitate the monk, who looks at you with suspicion and mistrust. Nothing else seems to happen.
column2: 你喃喃祷告，似惹僧侣疑虑，他投以审视与不信。此后再无异象。

column1: Your names have sufficient repute in these parts to interest the knight. His squire rides up to discuss the terms.
column2: 你的名望足以引起骑士兴趣。其侍从策马前来商议条件。

column1: Your party splits up and combs the land for clues as to what has taken place here. Slowly but surely you find the evidence: a severed finger, a stone knife with dried blood on the blade, goats' hooves and horns; all these things point to the possibility of foul witchcraft.
column2: 你们分头搜寻，试图查明此地究竟发生了何事。循序渐进，终觅得线索：断指一枚、刃上凝血之石刀、羊蹄与羊角——种种迹象指向邪秽巫术。

column1: Your party splits up and combs the land for clues as to what has taken place here. You find fire-blackened stones, and no evidence of battle, but otherwise your investigations are fruitless.
column2: 你们分头搜寻，试图查明此地究竟发生了何事。只见焦痕累累之石，却不见厮杀痕迹，余则一无所获。

column1: Your path is blocked by a grim iron door. Embossed onto it is the legend:
column2: 前路被一道阴森铁门阻隔。门上镌刻铭文：

column1: Your patience is rewarded when you see a dark, multi-legged form suddenly swing out from one of the crags, leap to a treetop, and scuttle down into the forest.
column2: 你的耐心终得回报：忽见一黑影多足，自岩壁跃出，轻盈跳上树梢，迅疾潜入林间。

column1: Your patron, $NamedOneName, is delighted by the demise of $NamedTwoName.
column2: 你的恩主$NamedOneName对$NamedTwoName之覆灭欣喜不已。

column1: Your pleas fall on deaf ears. $He is convinced that you are useless. In minutes your party is one fewer in strength.
column2: 你的哀求石沉大海。你认定你无用。转瞬之间，队伍又少一人。

column1: Your pleas for help go answered. Desperately you try to scramble up the closing walls. $ChosenOneName is too slow. $He is crushed horribly as the rest of you barely escape a similar tragedy.
column2: 你的求救无人理睬。你拼力攀爬合拢的墙壁。$ChosenOneName动作迟缓。你惨遭碾压，其余勉强幸免于难。

column1: Your power is too much for the satanic being. With a scream of pure rage, it begins to fragment.
column2: 你的威力远胜邪灵。它一声怒吼，随即碎裂崩解。

column1: Your prayers are dampened in this place; so much so that you can hardly speak the words necessary for success. Try as you might, there is nothing you can do before the demon prince leaps to the attack.
column2: 在此地，你的祷告几近窒熄，连成功所需之词亦难出口。纵使竭力，也无力阻挡恶魔王子的突袭。

column1: Your prayers are interrupted by a small old man dressed in filthy rags. "What's that you're saying?" he asks in a creaky voice, a fearful look in his eye. You...
column2: 你的祷告被一位身着污秽褴褛的小老头打断。“你在说什么？”他用沙哑的声音问道，眼中满是惊惧。你...

column1: Your prayers are muffled and uninspiring in this place.
column2: 在此地，你的祷告显得沉闷而乏味。

column1: Your prayers fill you with a sense of well being, and the terrible visages of the wolves no longer frighten you. You advance upon them; they take one look at you and flee into the wilderness where they belong. The way lies clear.
column2: 你的祷告使你心生安宁，狼群那狰狞的面目也不再令你畏惧。你迎上前去；它们望你一眼，便逃入荒野，归于其本处。前路已通。

column1: Your prayers fill you with a sense of well-being, and along with it great weariness. As one, you lie down for a brief rest. As you sleep, you dream.
column2: 你的祷告使你心生安泰，随之而来的是无尽的疲倦。众人一同躺下，稍作歇息。睡梦中，你见一梦。

column1: Your prayers, though urgent, are not answered, and the dragon breathes a sheet of flame over you all. You fall, scorched and blackened, to the bottom of the slope. Amazed to be alive, you take stock of your situation.
column2: 你的祷告虽急切，却未得回应，巨龙喷出一道火舌，将你们尽数吞没。你们焦黑倒地，滚落坡底。惊魂未定，你审视自身处境。

column1: Your quiet patience is rewarded in a few hours. Two large bears amble out of the trees and down to the water. Any attempt to investigate the lake may provoke them to attack.
column2: 数小时后，你的耐心终得回报。两头巨熊从林间缓步走出，踱至水边。任何试图探查湖面的举动都可能招致它们的袭击。

column1: Your reputation and charming manner eventually get you an interview with $NamedOneName, who turns around, smiles, and remarks, "Ah, bold heroes at last!"
column2: 你的声望与风度终使你得见$NamedOneName，他转身一笑，道：“啊，终于有勇敢的英雄来访了！”

column1: Your reputation and fame precede you. Obsequious clerks put you next on the list, and within an hour you are ushered into the council chamber. The $CityLordTitle is impressed by your presence.
column2: 你的名望早已传至彼处。谄媚的书吏将你排在名单之首，不过一小时，你便被引入议事厅。$CityLordTitle对你的气度颇为赞赏。

column1: Your response brings dubious looks from your travelling companions. "Has your town no cult officiate sent from the Fortress?" asks one.
column2: 你的回答令同行伙伴面露疑色。“贵镇难道无来自要塞的祭司吗？”一人问道。

column1: Your riverboat moors for the night, before attempting a difficult passage in the clear light of day. Everyone takes this traditional opportunity to sleep ashore.
column2: 夜幕降临，你的河船泊岸歇息，待翌日天明再行险途。众人借此良机登岸安寝。

column1: Your screams and pleas go unanswered. Desperate, you pull yourselves up over the red-hot stone walls. Poor $ChosenOneName cannot take the heat. $He falls back into the pit and is quickly covered with molten lava. The rest of you reach the top safely.
column2: 你们的呼喊与哀求无人应答。情急之下，你们奋力攀上炽热的石壁。可怜的$ChosenOneName难耐酷热，你坠回火坑，旋即被熔岩吞没。余者安然登顶。

column1: Your ship bravely battles the cold, blustery winds of the North Sea. The flat, marshy coastline of the Holy Roman Empire (Germany) is just visible on the horizon. All you can do is wait as the ship sails toward...
column2: 你的船只迎战北海凛冽狂风，神圣罗马帝国（德意志）平坦的沼泽海岸隐约可见于天际。唯有静候船行至……

column1: Your supper is a bakery's leavings and some old fruit bought for a pittance. Nobody says anything, but you all realize that such living won't improve your reputation at all. Finally you curl up in cloaks and go to sleep.
column2: 你的晚餐不过是面包店的残羹与贱价购得的陈果。无人言语，但皆知此般清苦绝难提升声望。最终裹衣而眠。

column1: Your supplications bear fruit. The nuns agree to tend you at no cost, as if you were just another pauper in need of help. Of course, they cannot afford the best medicines possible, but after a day in their capable hands, you feel much better off.
column2: 你的恳求终获回应。修女们不取分文，悉心照料，视你如寻常贫病之人。虽无力提供上乘药剂，经其调理一日，你已觉大有起色。

column1: Your vigil is fruitless. Nothing enters or leaves the opening. Frustrated, you reconsider the situation.
column2: 你的守候徒劳无功。洞口始终寂然无声。无奈之下，你重新审视局势。

column1: Your way is blocked by a dark iron door. Carved above it are the words:
column2: 前路被一道黝黑铁门阻断。门楣之上镌刻着：

column1: Your way is blocked by an iron door. Carved above it are the words:
column2: 前路被一道铁门阻断。门楣之上镌刻着：

column1: Your way is blocked by an iron door. Carved on it are the words, "All faces speak truth. The faces are named Narm, Nenn, and Krocht. Their fathers are Hod, Elt and Mot. Touch Krocht to open this door."
column2: 前路被一道铁门阻断。门上镌刻着：“诸面皆言真话。三面名为纳尔姆、嫩恩与克罗赫特。其父分别为霍德、埃尔特与莫特。触碰克罗赫特即可开此门。”

column1: Your weapons and armor are taken, but you are freed.
column2: 你的兵甲虽被收缴，却得以释放。

column1: Your winning ways induce them to reveal just enough information for you to suspect that the guild master may be passing counterfit coins. Of course, you'll need to find the coin mold-blanks to prove this.
column2: 你的善诱使他们吐露些许线索，令你怀疑公会首领或许私铸伪币。当然，还需寻得铸币模具方能证实。

column1: Zwolle.
column2: 兹沃勒。

column1: a certain well-placed personage is hiring freelancers.
column2: 某位显要正在招募自由职业者。

column2: 一条通往$fortress的街巷，那座位于$PlaceName的要塞。

column1: a dark side street to another district in the city.
column2: 一条通向城中另一区的幽暗小巷。

column2: 一名猎户。

column1: a lane where the signs have alchemical symbols.
column2: 一条招牌绘有炼金符号的小巷。

column2: 城墙一处巡防稀疏的地段。

column1: a mercenary soldier.

column2: 忽然间，追兵骤然而至，发出一声尖叫。

column1: a quiet side-street; at the last minute you decide a break-in isn't a good idea right now.
column2: 一条僻静的侧街；临行前你决定暂不宜入室行窃。

column1: a secluded spot where you can pray.
column2: 一处可静心祈祷的隐秘之所。

column1: a shady grove, to waste some time.
column2: 一片树荫浓密的林地，聊作消磨时光之地。

column2: 一名潜行盗贼。

column2: 一所特定的宅邸。

column2: 一条汇聚诸般工匠与公会的街道。

column2: 一位可聘之师。

column2: 一条通向城中别处的出路。

column1: a window that leads to a roof that leads to a side street.
column2: 一扇窗户，通向屋顶，再通向侧街。

column1: a young, bold alchemist.
column2: 一名年轻而大胆的炼金术士。

column2: 抛下马匹，自下水道爬出。

column2: 抛弃马匹，让$ChosenOneName上去为你放下绳索。

column1: abandon the horses, break open a sewer grate, and sneak in.
column2: 抛弃马匹，撬开下水道井盖，潜入其中。

column1: accept a relic as reward for your services.
