column1: Patron Saint of soldiers and butchers, he was a pagan officer who converted to Christianity and suffered horrible tortures before his death. He increases Charisma and Endurance (healing only) by a modest amount, and greatly increases all weapon skills.
column2: 士兵与屠夫的守护圣人。他原是异教军官，皈依基督教后在死前遭受了可怕的酷刑。他适度提升魅力与耐力（仅限疗伤），并大幅提升所有武器技能。

column1: Patron Saint of bells and nurses, she was subjected to many tortures during the Roman persecutions. Depictions in art works led to the practice of blessing bread on her holy day. She increases Charisma and Endurance (healing only) by a modest amount; females gain a large amount of Endurance.
column2: 钟与护士的守护圣人。在罗马的迫害中她遭受了种种酷刑。艺术作品中的描绘使"圣日祝福面包"成为习俗。她适度提升魅力与耐力（仅限疗伤）；女性队员可大量提升耐力。

column1: A great Christian symbol of virginity and innocence, Agnes grants no benefits unless the party contains at least one female. She increases local reputation and Charisma by a good amount.
column2: 童贞与纯洁的伟大基督教象征。除非队伍中至少有一名女性，阿格妮丝不赐予任何恩惠。她大幅提升当地声望与魅力。

column1: An Irish saint (also known as Maedoc) known for his miraculous fasts and prayers, Aidan is also known for his kindness and love of animals. He increases Woodwise by a very great amount, and may allow the party to communicate with or control wild animals.
column2: 爱尔兰圣人（又称 Maedoc），以奇迹般的斋戒与祈祷闻名，也以仁慈和爱护动物著称。他极大提升林地知识，并可能让队伍与野生动物交流或加以控制。

column1: Patron Saint of learning, he increases Alchemy by a very great amount, greatly increases Speak Latin and Read/Write, and provides a modest increase to Intelligence and Perception.
column2: 学识的守护圣人。他极大提升炼金术，大幅提升拉丁语与读写，并适度提升智力与感知。

column1: A passionate devotee of both elementary and higher education, Alcuin was made advisor to Charlemagne in 781. He provides a very great increase to Latin and Read/Write, and a modest increase to Intelligence. He also makes nobility more favorable toward the party.
column2: 热忱献身初等与高等教育，781 年成为查理曼的顾问。他极大提升拉丁语与读写，适度提升智力。他还使贵族对队伍更具好感。

column1: Patron Saint of beggars, Alexis was famous for his vows of extreme poverty, living anonymously for seventeen years as a beggar in his own home. He increases local reputation by a good amount, and Charisma by a modest amount. He also grants the party money if they become impoverished.
column2: 乞丐的守护圣人。他以极端贫穷的誓愿闻名，在自己的家中匿名行乞十七年。他大幅提升当地声望，适度提升魅力。若队伍陷入贫困，他还会赐予金钱。

column1: Patron Saint of Scotland, Russia and fishermen, Andrew was one of the twelve apostles. He improves Endurance and Charisma by a modest amount. He gives a good increase to location reputation in Scotland or Russia.
column2: 苏格兰、俄罗斯与渔夫的守护圣人，十二使徒之一。他适度提升耐力与魅力。在苏格兰或俄罗斯，他大幅提升当地声望。

column1: A tribune in the Roman army, Andrew called upon Christ and was granted a victory. He and his men converted, and were arrested and slain. He greatly increases skill with Edged, Impact, Pole, Thrown and Bow weapons.
column2: 罗马军队的护民官。安德烈呼求基督而获得胜利，他与部下皈依后被捕遇害。他大幅提升刀剑、钝击、长杆、投掷与弓弩武器技能。

column1: Patron Saint of skin disease, domestic animals and basket makers, Anthony was renowned for his acetism and devotion to God. He grants a small increase to Strength and Endurance (healing only) and to Charisma. He increases Speak Common and Latin by a good amount, and Read/Write by a a very great amount. He can also be called upon to banish demons.
column2: 皮肤病、家畜与制篮匠的守护圣人，以苦修与对上帝的虔诚闻名。他少量提升力量、耐力（仅限疗伤）与魅力。他大幅提升通用语与拉丁语，极大提升读写。也可呼求他驱逐恶魔。

column1: Patron Saint of the poor, Portugal, lost articles and harvest, Anthony of Padua was known for his fiery sermons and ability to make converts. He provides a small increase to Strength, a modest increase to Perception, a good increase to Impact Weapons and Latin, and a large increase to Charisma and Speak Common.
column2: 穷人、葡萄牙、失物与收获的守护圣人，以激昂的布道与感化众人的能力闻名。他少量提升力量，适度提升感知，大幅提升钝击武器与拉丁语，大量提升魅力与通用语。

column1: Of noble birth, Arnulf was a warrior and was very influential in affairs of state in the early 600's. He provides a small increase to Strength and Intelligence, a modest increase to Read/Write, Latin, Streetwise, Riding and Perception, and a good increase to all weapon skills.
column2: 出身贵族，是一名战士，在 600 年代初的国事中极具影响力。他少量提升力量与智力，适度提升读写、拉丁语、街头门路、骑术与感知，并大幅提升所有武器技能。

column1: Famous for his teachings and writings; called "The Apologist" for the Apologia of Christianity he wrote to a Roman emperor. Invoked in combat, he can cause enemies to desist or run away. He can also heal a small amount of lost Strength and a fair amount of lost Endurance.
column2: 以教导与著述闻名；因写给罗马皇帝的《基督教辩护书》而被称为"护教士"。在战斗中呼求他，可使敌人停止进攻或逃跑。他还能治疗少量失去的力量和相当多失去的耐力。

column1: Patron Saint of gunners, miners, builders and artillery. Betrayed by her own father, she became a virgin martyr for her faith. She greatly increases Artifice, and provides a very great increase to Mechanical Missile skill. She also prevents death from wounds for a period (strength never goes below 1).
column2: 炮手、矿工、建筑者与炮兵的守护圣人。被亲生父亲出卖后，她为信仰成为童贞殉道者。她大幅提升技艺，并极大提升机械投射技能。她还能在一段时间内防止因伤死亡（力量永不低于 1）。

column1: Also known as Bathild; she was a slave girl given to the mayor of the imperial palace under King Clovis of France. In 649 he married her; after his death she ruled as regent, enacting many great works. She increases Intelligence and Perception by a small amount, and can be invoked to free the party from imprisonment.
column2: 又称 Bathild。她原是法王克洛维时期被送给宫相的奴仆。649 年宫相娶她为妻；他死后她以摄政身份治国，推行了许多伟大事业。她少量提升智力与感知，可呼求她使队伍脱离囚禁。

column1: A successful teacher and preacher known for the destruction of the Oak of Thor, an object of pagan worship. He provides a modest increase to Charisma, all Weapon skills, and Speak Common. He can be invoked to destroy pagan sites and to purify defiled areas, and to protect the party against pagan and satanic beings.
column2: 成功的教师与传教士，以摧毁异教崇拜之物"托尔橡树"闻名。他适度提升魅力、所有武器技能与通用语。可呼求他摧毁异教圣地、净化被亵渎之地，并保护队伍免受异教与撒旦存在之害。

column1: Patron of philosophers, preachers, students, librarians, and maidens, Catherine is one of the Fourteen Holy Helpers and is known for her faith and conversions. She provides a small increase to Intelligence, a good increase to Charisma, and a tremendous increase to Speak Common.
column2: 哲学家、传教士、学生、图书馆员与少女的守护圣人，十四圣助者之一，以信仰与感化闻名。她少量提升智力，大幅提升魅力，并巨大提升通用语。

column1: Patron Saint of Italy and one of the most powerful Christian mystics of her time, Catherine is noted for her devotion to healing the sick. She provides a good but variable increase to Perception and Charisma, and a large increase to Speak Common; she can also help the invoker sense evil or have prophetic dreams.
column2: 意大利的守护圣人，也是她那个时代最有力量的基督教神秘主义者之一，以悉心救治病人著称。她大幅但不稳定地提升感知与魅力，大量提升通用语；她还能帮助祈求者感知邪恶或得到预言之梦。

column1: Patron Saint of music, she was forced into marriage but converted her husband. Condemned for her faith, she was miraculously saved from her sentence of death-by-suffocation. She increases Charisma by a small amount, and enhances local reputation greatly if the person has a musical instrument. She can also save the party from suffocation.
column2: 音乐的守护圣人。她被迫成婚，却使丈夫皈依。因信仰被判罪，却奇迹般地从窒息死刑中获救。她少量提升魅力；若祈求者持有乐器，则大幅提升当地声望。她还能使队伍免于窒息。

column1: Former king of Northumbria, Ceolwulf was not a great leader, though he was praised for his piety. His tomb was the site of many miracles. He provides a small increase to Intelligence and Perception, and a modest increase to Strength, Latin, and all weapon skills.
column2: 诺森布里亚的前国王。他算不上伟大的领袖，却以虔诚著称，墓前曾发生许多奇迹。他少量提升智力与感知，适度提升力量、拉丁语与所有武器技能。

column1: One of the ten daughters of Wisdom, when the ancient Romans put her in a furnace, she emerged unscathed. She can improve everyone's resistance to flame as well as greatly improving the resistance of one chosen person; she also heals a small amount of Endurance.
column2: 智慧十女之一。古罗马人把她投入火炉，她却毫发无伤地走出。她可提升所有人的抗火能力，并大幅提升一名指定者的抗火能力；她还能治疗少量耐力。

column1: At the age of 21, Christina apparently died of an epileptic fit. During her mass, she suddenly awoke and flew to the roof of the church. Many levitations (translations) were attributed to her. She provides a small but variable increase to Charisma and a modest increase to Agility; she may sometimes translate the party away from difficulties.
column2: 21 岁时，克里斯蒂娜看似因癫痫发作而死。在她的弥撒中，她突然苏醒并飞上教堂屋顶。许多次悬浮（移位）都被归功于她。她少量但不稳定地提升魅力，适度提升敏捷；有时能让队伍移位脱离困境。

column1: Patron Saint of travellers and pilgrims, who carried travellers across rivers. He survived many tortures and attacks for the sake of Christ. He improves travel speeds, restores a small amount of Strength and a modest amount of Endurance, and improves bow weapons and Streetwise by a good amount, and Woodwise and Riding by a very great amount.
column2: 旅人与朝圣者的守护圣人，曾背旅人渡河。为基督之故，他熬过许多酷刑与攻击。他提升旅行速度，恢复少量力量与适度耐力，大幅提升弓弩武器与街头门路，极大提升林地知识与骑术。

column1: Known for extreme piety and vows of severe poverty, Clare was instrumental in the spread of Fransicanism and the defense of Assisi. She can restore strength and endurance losses, and cause satanic foes to rout from battle.
column2: 以极度的虔诚与严守贫穷誓愿著称。克莱尔对方济各主义的传播与阿西西的防卫起了关键作用。她能恢复失去的力量与耐力，并使撒旦之敌从战斗中溃逃。

column1: Married Clovis, King of the Franks, in 492, and was credited with saving one of his armies in battle. After his death, she devoted her life to helping the sick. She increases Charisma by a modest amount and Healing by a good amount. She also heals a small amount of Strength and a good amount of Endurance.
column2: 492 年嫁给法兰克国王克洛维，据说曾在战斗中救下他的一支军队。他死后，她献身救助病人。她适度提升魅力，大幅提升疗伤。她还能治疗少量力量与大量耐力。

column1: Patron of Cloyne, Ireland, Colman was a poet and later the royal bard of Cashel. He provides a modest increase to Charisma and Latin, a good increase to Read/Write, and a very great increase to Speak Common.
column2: 爱尔兰克洛伊内的守护圣人，曾是诗人，后为卡舍尔的宫廷吟游诗人。他适度提升魅力与拉丁语，大幅提升读写，极大提升通用语。

column1: A powerful figure in Ireland, Columba did evangelical work among the picts of Scotland as penance for causing a battle between two monasteries. He provides a small increase to Charisma, a modest increase to Endurance and Strength, and a good increase to all melee weapon skills. He causes a small temporary loss to Perception.
column2: 爱尔兰的强权人物。因挑起两所修道院之间的战斗，他前往苏格兰在皮克特人中传教作为苦修。他少量提升魅力，适度提升耐力与力量，大幅提升所有近战武器技能。他会造成少量暂时的感知损失。

column1: Patron Saint of barbers and physicians, Cosmas was twin brother to Damian; the two performed many miracles both before and after their deaths. Cosmas enhances Perception by a small amount, and healing by a tremendous amount; he also heals a small amount of Strength and Endurance, and gives knowledge of St. Damian.
column2: 理发师与医师的守护圣人，达米安的双生兄弟；两人生前死后都行过许多奇迹。科斯马斯少量提升感知，巨大提升疗伤；他还治疗少量力量与耐力，并赐予对圣达米安的知识。

column1: Patron Saint (along with his brother Crispinian) of cobblers, leatherworkers, and shoemakers. Crispin was a shoemaker by trade who made many converts. The quality of all non-metal armor in may be enhanced.
column2: 补鞋匠、皮革匠与制鞋匠的守护圣人（与其兄弟克里斯皮尼安同列）。克里斯平以制鞋为业，感化了很多人。所有非金属护甲的质量都可能被提升。

column1: A sorceror and black magician who attempted to win the love of a Christian girl through magical means. Her faith was stronger than his magic; he renounced his evil ways and converted. He enhances Intelligence and Alchemy by a small amount, and causes satanic magic to fail 50% of the time.
column2: 一名巫师与黑魔法师，曾试图以魔法赢得一位基督徒女子的爱。她的信仰强过他的法术；他弃绝邪道并皈依。他少量提升智力与炼金术，并使撒旦魔法有 50% 的几率失败。

column1: Patron Saint of barbers and physicians, Damian was twin brother to Cosmas; the two performed many miracles both before and after their deaths. Damian restores all lost Endurance and a good amount of lost Strength; he also brings automatic knowledge of St. Cosmas.
column2: 理发师与医师的守护圣人，科斯马斯的双生兄弟；两人生前死后都行过许多奇迹。达米安恢复全部失去的耐力与大量失去的力量；他还自动赐予对圣科斯马斯的知识。

column1: Patron of Wales and an English baron who became King of Scotland; he warred unsuccessfully for the English throne. Known for his charities, pieties, and justice. Grants a small increase to Charisma and Intelligence, and a modest increase to Perception, weapons skills and Riding.
column2: 威尔士的守护圣人，也是成为苏格兰国王的英格兰男爵；他曾为英格兰王位征战而未成功。以慈善、虔诚与公正著称。少量提升魅力与智力，适度提升感知、武器技能与骑术。

column1: Patron of Paris and France, beheaded because of his success in making converts. His followers rescued his body from the Seine. Restores a great amount of lost Strength and a small amount of Endurance; greatly enhances Charisma and Speak Common and can enhance local reputation in Paris and France.
column2: 巴黎与法兰西的守护圣人，因感化众人有成而被斩首。他的追随者从塞纳河中救回了他的遗体。恢复大量失去的力量与少量耐力；大幅提升魅力与通用语，并可提升巴黎与法兰西的当地声望。

column1: In early life a soldier who may have fought by the side of King Arthur; later, miracles were attributed to his wooden statue. Provides a small increase to Strength, heals a modest amount of Endurance, and provides a very great increase to all weapons skills.
column2: 早年是名士兵，可能曾在亚瑟王麾下作战；后来他的木雕像被传有奇迹。少量提升力量，治疗适度耐力，并极大提升所有武器技能。

column1: Patron of Monaco and Corsica, Devota was a young Christian girl who was racked to death for her faith. She can restore all lost Endurance and some Strength, and aid the party in withstanding or escaping torture. Greatly enhances Charisma and may enhance local reputation in Corsica and Monaco.
column2: 摩纳哥与科西嘉的守护圣人。德沃塔是年轻的基督徒少女，因信仰被拷打至死。她能恢复全部失去的耐力与部分力量，并帮助队伍忍受或逃脱酷刑。大幅提升魅力，并可能提升科西嘉与摩纳哥的当地声望。

column1: Patron of thieves and condemned criminals, Dismas is thought to be the thief crucified with Christ. He increases Agility, Woodwise and Stealth (for the entire party) by a good amount, and Streetwise and Artifice by a very great amount. He increases Charisma and Speak Common, and may allow escape attempts from prison.
column2: 盗贼与死囚的守护圣人。狄斯玛斯被认为是与基督同钉十字架的那名盗贼。他大幅提升敏捷、林地知识与潜行（对全队有效），并极大提升街头门路与技艺。他还提升魅力与通用语，并可能让队伍尝试越狱。

column1: Patron Saint of astronomers and founder of the Dominican order, Dominic also travelled widely in Spain. He enhances Intelligence, Speak Common, Latin, and Read/Write by a good amount. He may also cause members of the inquisition to treat the party with respect and deference.
column2: 天文学家的守护圣人，多明我会的创立者，曾在西班牙各地广泛游历。他大幅提升智力、通用语、拉丁语与读写。他还可能使宗教裁判所的成员对队伍恭敬有礼。

column1: Patron Saint of Prussia, a gentle and humble pilgrim who tamed a violent father, the swordsmith Albrecht of Danzig. She can sense evil, especially in Germans, and improves Charisma and Healing by a good amount, and Perception by a modest amount. She may even provide a wondrous longsword to the needy.
column2: 普鲁士的守护圣人。她是温和谦卑的朝圣者，感化了暴烈的父亲——但泽的铸剑师阿尔布雷希特。她能感知邪恶，尤其是德国人身上的邪恶；她大幅提升魅力与疗伤，适度提升感知。她甚至可能赐予有需要者一把神异的长剑。

column1: Patron Saint of shepherds, he was a pilgrim, shepherd and hermit himself. He increases Perception by a modest amount, Healing by a good amount, and Woodwise by a very great amount. He also increases the party speed, but not the frequency of encounters.
column2: 牧羊人的守护圣人，他本人也是朝圣者、牧羊人与隐修士。他适度提升感知，大幅提升疗伤，极大提升林地知识。他还能提升队伍的行进速度，但不增加遭遇的频率。

column1: Patron Saint of blacksmiths, armorers, goldsmiths, locksmiths, and jewelers, Dunstan enhances Perception, weapons skill, Alchemy and Streetwise by a modest amount, and Artifice by a very great amount. In addition, the quality of all metal armor in the party may be enhanced.
column2: 铁匠、甲匠、金匠、锁匠与珠宝匠的守护圣人。他适度提升感知、武器技能、炼金术与街头门路，极大提升技艺。此外，队伍中所有金属护甲的质量都可能被提升。

column1: Patron Saint of epileptics, the mentally ill, and those possessed by devils, Dymphna was killed by her father when she refused his incestuous advances. She heals a good amount of Endurance, and provides an increase to Agility and Healing, and a large increase to Stealth; invoking her can cure various ills and may cause satanic beings to flee.
column2: 癫痫病人、精神病人与附魔者的守护圣人。狄姆芙娜因拒绝父亲的乱伦要求而被杀。她大量治疗耐力，提升敏捷与疗伤，并大量提升潜行；呼求她可治愈各种病痛，并可能使撒旦存在逃离。

column1: A King of England before William, he founded Westminster Abbey. When invoked he insures that all party members have a virtue of at least 20, but at great cost in wealth. He may aid in seeing evil in nobility, improve Intelligence, Perception, all weapons skills and Riding by a modest amount, and heals a small amount of Endurance.
column2: 威廉之前的英格兰国王，威斯敏斯特教堂的创建者。呼求他可保证所有队员的美德至少为 20，但需付出大量钱财。他可能帮助看出贵族身上的邪恶，适度提升智力、感知、所有武器技能与骑术，并治疗少量耐力。

column1: Patron Saint of metalworkers and goldsmiths, Eligius was known for his beautiful craftwork and charitable donations. He enhances Artifice by a very great amount, Alchemy by a modest amount, and may improve edged weapons, hammers, maces, halberds, crossbows and handguns.
column2: 金属匠人与金匠的守护圣人，以精美的工艺与慷慨的施舍闻名。他极大提升技艺，适度提升炼金术，并可能提升刀剑、锤、钉锤、戟、弩与手炮。

column1: Patron against earthquakes, Emydius was a pagan knight who converted to Christianty and then successfully converted others. He provides a very great increase to Charisma and Speak Common, and can allow the party to protect an area against earthquake,or to call an earthquake to destroy a pagan or satanic site.
column2: 防震的守护圣人。埃米迪乌斯原是异教骑士，皈依基督教后成功感化了很多人。他极大提升魅力与通用语，并能让队伍保护某地免受地震，或召来地震摧毁异教或撒旦的场所。

column1: A traveller, crusader, and politician, Engelbert once took up arms against Otto IV and was excommunicated; this was lifted after he joined the Albigensian Crusade. He increases Charisma and Speak Common by a modest amount, and Woodwise and Riding by a good amount. He also allows the party to travel on rivers as if they were land.
column2: 旅行者、十字军战士与政治家。恩格尔贝特曾对奥托四世举兵而被绝罚，参加阿尔比十字军后解禁。他适度提升魅力与通用语，大幅提升林地知识与骑术。他还能让队伍在河上如履平地般行进。

column1: Patron Saint of sailors, and one of the Fourteen Holy Helpers, he is also known as St. Elmo, and was saved by an angel from being burned alive. He enhances Agility and Perception by a modest amount, and makes sailors and seamen friendly. He also increases the party's defense against lightning and fire.
column2: 水手的守护圣人，十四圣助者之一，又称圣埃尔莫，曾被天使从火刑中救出。他适度提升敏捷与感知，并使水手与船夫对队伍友善。他还提升队伍对闪电与火焰的防御。

column1: Patron Saint of Sweden, and king of Sweden until rebelling nobles had him beheaded. He provides a small increase to Charisma, a modest increase to Strength, Riding and Speak Common, and a large increase to weapon skills. He also causes nobility (especially evil nobility) to reveal information, and can increase local reputation in Sweden.
column2: 瑞典的守护圣人，曾是瑞典国王，后被叛乱的贵族斩首。他少量提升魅力，适度提升力量、骑术与通用语，大量提升武器技能。他还能使贵族（尤其是邪恶的贵族）吐露情报，并可提升瑞典的当地声望。

column1: Patron Saint of hunters and escapes, and one of the Fourteen Holy Helpers, Eustace converted after seeing a stag with the sign of Christ between its horns. He provides a good increase to Riding, a large increase to all weapon skills except impact and flail, and a tremendous increase to Woodwise. He may speed travel through woods.
column2: 猎人与逃脱的守护圣人，十四圣助者之一。尤斯塔斯因看见一头鹿的双角间现出基督的记号而皈依。他大幅提升骑术，大量提升除钝击与连枷之外的所有武器技能，并巨大提升林地知识。他可能加快穿越林地的行进。

column1: Assistant to a bishop and arrested in his stead after the bishop fled during a persecution, Felix was delivered from his prison by an angel. He provides a modest increase to Agility, a good increase to Woodwise and a tremendous increase to Stealth. If imprisoned, a character may make a miraculous escape once in a lifetime.
column2: 主教的助手。迫害期间主教逃走，他代其被捕，后由天使救出牢狱。他适度提升敏捷，大幅提升林地知识，并巨大提升潜行。若被囚禁，角色一生中可有一次奇迹般的逃脱。

column1: Preacher, hermit and founder of monasteries, the sun did not set for two weeks after Finbar's death. He provides a modest increase to Charisma and Perception, and a good increase to Latin; upon his invocation, the party is provided with light for one full day.
column2: 传教士、隐修士与修道院的创立者。芬巴尔死后，太阳连续两周未曾落下。他适度提升魅力与感知，大幅提升拉丁语；呼求他后，队伍可得到持续一整天的光明。

column1: Known for his feud with St. Columba, and for extravagant miracles (including moving a river). He provides a small increase to Streetwise, and a modest increase to Charisma, Agility, Speak Common and Read/Write. While he is invoked, the party may travel on water as though it were land for a period of one day.
column2: 以与圣科伦巴的宿怨和种种惊人的奇迹（包括移走一条河）闻名。他少量提升街头门路，适度提升魅力、敏捷、通用语与读写。在他受呼求期间，队伍可如履平地般在水上行进一天。

column1: Patron of Poland, Austria, and of those in danger from water, Florian was killed by being thrown in a river with a rock around his neck. He enhances all weapon skills and Riding by a modest amount, and may add to local reputation in Poland and Austria. He also allows the party to travel on water as if it were land.
column2: 波兰、奥地利与溺水者的守护圣人。弗洛里安被人在脖子上挂上石块投入河中而死。他适度提升所有武器技能与骑术，并可能提升波兰与奥地利的当地声望。他还能让队伍在河上如履平地般行进。

column1: A wealthy noble who experienced visions, renounced his wealth, and became the most influential Christian teacher of his time. Provides a modest increase to Endurance and Perception, a good increase to Charisma and Speak Common, and a very great increase to Virtue. The party may lose 10% of its cash when he is invoked.
column2: 出身富贵的贵族，经历异象后弃绝家产，成为他那个时代最有影响力的基督教导师。他适度提升耐力与感知，大幅提升魅力与通用语，极大提升美德。呼求他时，队伍可能失去 10% 的现金。

column1: God's angel, who brought the message of the birth of Christ to Mary. He provides a good increase to Intelligence and Perception, and can give divine messages to the party as well as help them discern true motives and gain extra information. In combat, he sounds a horn that may cause enemies to flee in terror.
column2: 上帝的天使，曾向玛利亚传达基督降生之讯。他大幅提升智力与感知，能赐予队伍神启，帮助他们看清他人的真实动机、获得额外情报。战斗中他吹响号角，可能使敌人惊恐逃散。

column1: Patron Saint of disaster, drought, rain, and fever, she is known to have saved Paris from many disasters. She heals a small amount of Strength and a modest amount of Endurance, and prevents enemies from initiating combat until the party attacks; if she is invoked in combat, enemies might flee.
column2: 灾难、旱灾、雨水与热病的守护圣人，据说曾多次拯救巴黎于灾难之中。她治疗少量力量与适度耐力，并使敌人在队伍出手前不会主动进攻；若在战斗中呼求她，敌人可能逃散。

column1: Patron Saint of Knighthood and Crusaders. Famous for saving a maiden while killing a dragon with his lance. He may improve the quality of weapons and armor, provide a small increase to Agility, a good increase to Strength, and a very great increase to all weapon skills and Riding.
column2: 骑士与十字军的守护圣人。以持矛屠龙、救出少女而闻名。他可能提升武器与护甲的质量，少量提升敏捷，大幅提升力量，并极大提升所有武器技能与骑术。

column1: A former soldier who nursed the sick and spent seven years doing penance for the sins of his youth. He provides a modest increase to Charisma, a good increase to all weapons skills, and a very great increase to Healing. He also heals a good amount of Strength and Endurance.
column2: 昔日的士兵，此后照料病人，并以七年苦修为年轻时的罪愆赎罪。他适度提升魅力，大幅提升所有武器技能，极大提升疗伤。他还治疗大量力量与耐力。

column1: Patron Saint of travellers and gardeners, she is known for her hospitality and visions. She improves Riding by a small amount, Woodwise and Latin by a large amount, and Read/Write by a very great amount. She allows instant travel to the nearest town or city, and can bring prophetic visions of the future.
column2: 旅行者与园丁的守护圣人，以好客与异象著称。她少量提升骑术，大量提升林地知识与拉丁语，极大提升读写。她能让队伍瞬间抵达最近的城镇或城市，并能带来预示未来的异象。

column1: Patron Saint of cripples and beggars, and a friend to animals. He provides a small increase to Streetwise, a very great increase to Stealth, and a tremendous increase to Woodwise; he also provides money if needed, and can heal a small amount of Strength and a large amount of Endurance. He causes a loss to agility and weapon skills.
column2: 跛者与乞丐的守护圣人，也是动物的朋友。他少量提升街头门路，极大提升潜行，并巨大提升林地知识；他还可在需要时赐予钱财，治疗少量力量与大量耐力。但他会造成敏捷与武器技能的损失。

column1: A former black magician who renounced his black arts and suffered diabolical attacks until he was saved by a vision of our Lady. He provides a small increase to Intelligence, a good increase to Artifice, a large increase to Perception, and a very great increase to Alchemy. Invoking Giles causes a wound, and a loss of virtue.
column2: 昔日的黑魔法师，弃绝邪术后屡遭魔鬼侵袭，直到因圣母显现而得救。他少量提升智力，大幅提升技艺，大量提升感知，极大提升炼金术。呼求他会带来一道伤口，并损失美德。

column1: A strict disciplinarian who travelled extensively to reform several monasteries. He rose steadily through the church ranks due to his discipline and drive. He increases Read/Write and Latin by a very great amount, heals a good amount of Endurance, and can prevent travel disasters such as avalanches and blizzards.
column2: 纪律严明的改革者，为整顿多所修道院而四处奔走。凭借自律与魄力，他在教会中稳步升迁。他极大提升读写与拉丁语，大量治疗耐力，并能避免雪崩、暴风雪等旅途灾难。

column1: Raised in an Abbey, his strict discipline and insistence on clerical celibacy was very controversial. He provides a good increase to Artifice, a large increase to Speak Common, heals a modest amount of Endurance, and may sense evil in monks and clerics. If invoked before combat he prevents the enemy from attacking.
column2: 在修道院长大，以严苛的纪律与坚持教士独身而备受争议。他大幅提升技艺，大量提升通用语，治疗适度耐力，并可能感知修士与教士身上的邪恶。若在战斗前呼求他，敌人将无法进攻。

column1: Prince of the Wends, active in war and conversion, he greatly increases all weapon skills, and local reputation in Wendish Germany (includes Bremen, Hamburg, Luneberg, Lubeck, Wismar, Rostock and Schleswig).
column2: 文德人的亲王，积极征战并推动皈依。他大幅提升所有武器技能，并提升文德地区德国（包括不来梅、汉堡、吕讷堡、吕贝克、维斯马、罗斯托克与石勒苏益格）的当地声望。

column1: Patron Saint of desperate situations, earthquakes and floods. He provides a modest increase to Charisma, a good increase to Alchemy and Speak Common, and a very great increase to Artifice. His miracles may help in uncommon situations, and may temporarily improve your luck.
column2: 绝境、地震与洪水的守护圣人。他适度提升魅力，大幅提升炼金术与通用语，极大提升技艺。他的奇迹可在不寻常的处境中相助，并可能暂时提升你的运气。

column1: Patron of Silesia, she married the Duke of Silesia and was active in war, politics, and tending the poor. She provides a large increase to Healing and local reputation in Silesia. She also heals a modest amount of Strength and Endurance. When confronting nobles, they will tend to reveal information.
column2: 西里西亚的守护圣人。她嫁给西里西亚公爵，活跃于战事、政务与救济穷人。她大量提升疗伤与西里西亚的当地声望，还治疗适度力量与耐力。与贵族交涉时，他们往往更愿吐露情报。

column1: A former Holy Roman Emperor, known for his abilities and piety. He provides a modest increase to Intelligence and a good increase to all weapon skills, and will improve local reputation when dealing with any high noble.
column2: 前任神圣罗马帝国皇帝，以才干与虔诚著称。他适度提升智力，大幅提升所有武器技能，并在与任何高等贵族交涉时提升当地声望。

column1: An active peacemaker devoted to the poor, he is known for ending a severe drought by praying for rain. He increases Strength by a small amount, and increases Charisma by a good amount, or a large amount when dealing with farmers. He can also sense evil in farmers and peasants.
column2: 积极奔走于调停的和平使者，心系穷人，曾以祈雨终结一场严重旱灾。他少量提升力量，大幅提升魅力（与农夫交涉时改为大量提升）。他还能感知农夫与乡民身上的邪恶。

column1: Born blind, he nevertheless founded a monastery and remained until his death, where he was venerated for his miracles and holiness. He provides a large increase to Perception and can sense evil in people.
column2: 天生失明，却创建了一所修道院并终老于此，因奇迹与圣德而受人敬奉。他大量提升感知，并能感知他人身上的邪恶。

column1: A great nun who founded convents and was famous for her visions, earning her the nickname "Sibyl of the Rhine." St.Hildegard may provide useful visions, especially if near the Rhine River. She also improves Perception by a very great amount, and sometimes your local reputation.
column2: 创建多所女修道院的伟大修女，以异象闻名，获"莱茵女先知"之称。圣希尔德加德可能赐予有用的异象，尤其在莱茵河附近时。她还能极大提升感知，有时也提升你的当地声望。

column1: Patron Saint of hunters for his vision of a crucifix between the horns of a stag. He provides a large increase to pole, thrown and bow weapons skills, a good increase to mechanical missile weapons, a very good increase to Stealth, and a tremendous increase to woodwise. He can aid the party in woodland encounters.
column2: 猎人的守护圣人，因看见一头鹿的双角间现出十字架而皈依。他大量提升长杆、投掷与弓弩武器技能，大幅提升机械投射武器，相当多地提升潜行，并巨大提升林地知识。他能在林地遭遇中助队伍一臂之力。

column1: A warrior and later monk who was charged for a time with guarding the Holy Grail. Some say Sir Galahad is modelled upon him. He provides a small increase to Riding, a good increase to weapon skills and Speak Common, and a large increase to Charisma.
column2: 先为战士、后为修士，曾一度受命守护圣杯。有人说加拉哈德爵士的形象取自于他。他少量提升骑术，大幅提升武器技能与通用语，大量提升魅力。

column1: Patron Saint of farmers and of Madrid, he was a hired hand to a Spanish noble, where he lived a life of great devotion and poverty. He provides a small increase to Speak Common, a modest increase to Charisma, and a good increase to Streetwise. He may enhance local reputation in Madrid and Spain, and increase Charisma.
column2: 农夫与马德里的守护圣人。他受雇于一位西班牙贵族，过着极为虔诚而贫穷的生活。他少量提升通用语，适度提升魅力，大幅提升街头门路。他可能提升马德里与西班牙的当地声望，并提升魅力。

column1: Also known as Deirdre and Mida, she performed many miracles of healing, including reuniting a severed head with its body. She adds a modest amount of Charisma and a very good amount of Healing; she can restore all of a character's lost Strength and a large amount of lost Endurance.
column2: 又称 Deirdre 与 Mida，行过许多治愈奇迹，包括把被斩下的头颅与身体重新接合。她适度提升魅力，相当多地提升疗伤；她能恢复角色全部失去的力量与大量失去的耐力。

column1: Patron of Spain, and the first apostle to be martyred, by Herod Agrippa. Provides a small increase to Strength, Endurance, and Charisma, and a good increase to Virtue. Causes a temporary loss of a small amount of Intelligence, and can enhance local reputation in Spain.
column2: 西班牙的守护圣人，也是第一位殉道的使徒，被希律·亚基帕所杀。他少量提升力量、耐力与魅力，大幅提升美德。但会造成少量暂时的智力损失，并可提升西班牙的当地声望。

column1: A bishop thrown to the wild beasts by Diocletian; the beasts refused to attack. Januarius's blood is contained in a vial that is said to liquefy on his feast days. Invoking Januarius can cause wild beasts to cease attacking; in combination with his relic, no foe can withstand Januarius.
column2: 戴克里先将他投入野兽群，野兽却拒绝攻击。雅努阿略的血盛在小瓶中，据说会在他的圣日化为液态。呼求雅努阿略可使野兽停止攻击；若配合他的圣髑，任何敌人都无法抵挡雅努阿略。

column1: Patron Saint of women in difficult labor, he was also known as John Thwing and was famous for his piety and honesty. He enhances Strength and Endurance by a small amount, for women only, and can heal both attributes, more so for women than for men.
column2: 难产妇女的守护圣人，又称约翰·斯温，以虔诚与诚实闻名。他少量提升力量与耐力，且仅对女性有效；他能治疗这两项属性，对女性效果更强于男性。

column1: Patron Saint of preachers, he was famed for his homilies, which earned him the name Chrysostom, meaning "Golden Mouthed." He provides a modest increase to Charisma, and a very great increase to Speak Common and Latin, but causes a small loss to Perception. He may ignore prayers on festival days, due to his distaste for extravagance.
column2: 传教士的守护圣人，以讲道闻名，因而得名"金口"。他适度提升魅力，极大提升通用语与拉丁语，但会造成少量感知损失。由于厌恶铺张，他可能在节日期间无视祈祷。

column1: Also known as John Scholasticus, famous as the author of "Scala Paradisi," which described the 30 steps necessary to attain religious perfection. Enhances ALL skills by a small amount plus one for every five points of virtue the invoker possesses.
column2: 又称约翰·斯科拉斯提库斯，以所著《天堂阶梯》闻名，书中描述了达到宗教完满所需的三十级台阶。他少量提升**所有**技能，祈求者每有 5 点美德便再多加 1 点。

column1: Nemesis of King Wenceslaus IV, finally tortured and killed by him. Increases Streetwise by a small amount, Charisma and Intelligence by a modest amount, and Speak Common by a very great amount. Can enhance local reputation in Prag and Bohemia.
column2: 国王瓦茨拉夫四世的死敌，最终被他拷打致死。他少量提升街头门路，适度提升魅力与智力，极大提升通用语。他可提升布拉格与波希米亚的当地声望。

column1: The husband of Mary and 'father' of Jesus, Joseph is also the Patron Saint of carpenters, woodworkers, travellers, and house hunting. He provides a good increase to Streetwise, a very good increase to Artifice and, inside a city, a modest increase to Charisma.
column2: 玛利亚的丈夫、耶稣的"父亲"，也是木匠、木工、旅人与寻屋者的守护圣人。他大幅提升街头门路，相当多地提升技艺，在城中时还适度提升魅力。

column1: Patron Saint of hopeless situations, and one of the twelve apostles. He improves every attribute by a small amount, and every skill by a modest amount. He may also provide special aid in hopeless or extremely desperate situations.
column2: 绝境的守护圣人，十二使徒之一。他少量提升所有属性，适度提升所有技能。在毫无希望或极其危急的处境中，他还可能给予特别援助。

column1: Patron Saint of travellers, hotel keepers, and boatmen, he was punished for his sins but forgiven when he offered his bed to a leper. He increases Riding by a modest amount, and Woodwise by a very great amount; he can also allow free passage across bridges, fords, and ferries.
column2: 旅人、旅店主人与船夫的守护圣人。他因罪受罚，却因把床铺让给一名麻风病人而获宽恕。他适度提升骑术，极大提升林地知识；他还能让队伍免费通过桥梁、浅滩与渡口。

column1: Son of a king of Ireland, he was known for his ability to gain converts and his miraculous powers. He provides a small increase to Riding, a modest increase to Charisma, a good increase to Healing, and a large increase to Speak Common. He can also heal a small amount of Strength and a good amount of Endurance.
column2: 爱尔兰国王之子，以感化他人的本领与奇迹之力闻名。他少量提升骑术，适度提升魅力，大幅提升疗伤，大量提升通用语。他还能治疗少量力量与大量耐力。

column1: A King of Hungary, known for his zealous defense of that country, and for his piety and prowess. He provides a small increase to Strength and Agility, a modest increase to Speak Common, and a good increase to Riding and all weapon skills.
column2: 匈牙利国王，以奋勇保卫国土、虔诚与武艺著称。他少量提升力量与敏捷，适度提升通用语，大幅提升骑术与所有武器技能。

column1: Martyred in Rome, he bore his torture with such equanimity that he is credited with ending paganism in that city. He provides a good increase to Charisma, Streetwise, and Speak Common; he can restore all lost endurance to a character, and help the party withstand or escape torture.
column2: 在罗马殉道。他从容忍受酷刑，因而被认为终结了该城的异教信仰。他大幅提升魅力、街头门路与通用语；他能恢复角色全部失去的耐力，并帮助队伍忍受或逃脱酷刑。

column1: A friend of Jesus, raised from the dead after four days in the tomb. Invoking Lazarus can restore a good amount of lost Endurance, and all of a character's lost Strength, unless the character is already dead.
column2: 耶稣的朋友，在墓中四天后复活。呼求拉撒路可恢复大量失去的耐力，以及角色全部失去的力量——除非该角色已经死亡。

column1: The Roman Centurion at the crucifixion who acknowledged Christ as the son of God. He was converted, and later martyred, whereupon the governor who had ordered his death was converted. He enhances all weapon skills by a modest amount and may increase the quality of one character's weapons.
column2: 钉十字架时承认基督为神之子的罗马百夫长。他皈依后殉道，而下令处死他的总督也因此皈依。他适度提升所有武器技能，并可能提升某一名角色武器的品质。

column1: Santa Lucia, famous for having her eyes torn out and then miraculously restoring them; her name means "light." She enhances Perception by a modest amount, can restore one character's Strength and Endurance to maximum, and provides light for one day.
column2: 圣露西亚，以双眼被剜出后又奇迹般复明而闻名；她的名字意为"光"。她适度提升感知，可将某一名角色的力量与耐力恢复至上限，并提供一天的光明。

column1: Patron Saint of physicians and painters, author of the third gospel and the Acts of the Apostles. He was himself a physician and enhances Healing by a very great amount, and heals a good amount of Strength and a large amount of Endurance.
column2: 医师与画家的守护圣人，第三福音书与《使徒行传》的作者。他本人就是医师，极大提升疗伤，并治疗大量力量与大量耐力。

column1: Lead by a vision to be a Benedictine Nun in 1202, she lived many miraculous ecstasies and ultimately became a Cistercian. She improves Perception and Virtue by a modest amount, and Charisma by a good amount. She can sometimes levitate people over obstacles. Sharing her ecstasies in prayer costs Endurance.
column2: 1202 年因异象成为本笃会修女，一生屡有奇迹般的狂喜体验，最终转入熙笃会。她适度提升感知与美德，大幅提升魅力。她有时能使人悬浮越过障碍。在祈祷中共享她的狂喜需耗费耐力。

column1: Patron Saint of childbirth and death, she was swallowed by a dragon (actually the devil) and emerged unscathed. She restores Endurance and Strength (more for females than males). She also improves female attributes and skills by a small amount, and the flame resistance of one person's armor.
column2: 生育与死亡的守护圣人。她被一条龙（其实是魔鬼）吞下，却毫发无伤地脱身。她恢复耐力与力量（对女性效果强于男性）。她还少量提升女性的属性与技能，并提升某一人护甲的耐火性。

column1: A former noblewoman who renounced her worldly goods when her husband was killed, and devoted herself to helping the sick and needy. She provides a good increase to Speak Common and a very great increase to Healing. She also restores a large amount of Strength and all Endurance.
column2: 昔日的贵族妇女，丈夫被杀后弃绝世俗财产，专心救助病人与穷人。她大幅提升通用语，极大提升疗伤。她还恢复大量力量与全部耐力。

column1: Patron Saint of notaries, writers, Egypt, and Venice, and one of the apostles, he once was threatened with capture but wriggled out of his cloak and fled naked down the street. He enhances Agility by a good amount, and Read/Write by a large amount.
column2: 公证人、作家、埃及与威尼斯的守护圣人，十二使徒之一。他曾被追捕，却挣脱外袍、赤身逃过街道。他大幅提升敏捷，大量提升读写。

column1: Patron Saint of soldiers, horsemen, and geese. He can sense evil in some people, helps heal injuries provided the character is wearing some armor, and improves Charisma by a modest amount, Perception by a good amount, and Speak Common and Riding by a very great amount.
column2: 士兵、骑手与鹅的守护圣人。他能感知某些人身上的邪恶；只要角色穿着护甲，他就能帮助疗伤；他适度提升魅力，大幅提升感知，并极大提升通用语与骑术。

column1: Patron Saint of bankers and bookkeepers, one of the apostles and author of the first gospel. He provides a modest increase to Intelligence, a large increase to Latin, and a very great increase to Read/Write. He can also enhance local reputation with Fuggers and Medici.
column2: 银行家与账房的守护圣人，十二使徒之一，第一部福音书的作者。他适度提升智力，大量提升拉丁语，极大提升读写。他还能提升与富格尔家族和梅迪奇家族的当地声望。

column1: Patron Saint of swordsmiths, soldiers, armies, Piedmont, Savoy, and Sardinia, Maurice was a Christian legionnaire who refused to sacrifice to the gods and was killed along with his legion. He provides a good increase to Alchemy and a very great increase to Edged weapons. He may improve the quality of any edged weapons carried.
column2: 铸剑师、士兵、军队、皮埃蒙特、萨伏依与撒丁的守护圣人。莫里斯是基督徒军团兵，因拒绝向诸神献祭而与全军团一同被杀。他大幅提升炼金术，极大提升刀剑类武器。他可能提升队伍所携任何刀剑的品质。

column1: Patron Saint of battle, Brussels, and Germany, and one of the three captains of the heavenly host. Provides a small increase to all weapon skills, a good increase to Charisma, and a very great increase to Healing; in combat, he may improve the party's weapons and armor. He also improves local reputation in Germany and Brussels.
column2: 战斗、布鲁塞尔与德国的守护圣人，天军三大统领之一。他少量提升所有武器技能，大幅提升魅力，极大提升疗伤；战斗中他可能提升队伍的武器与护甲。他还提升德国与布鲁塞尔的当地声望。

column1: A famous nun and founder of convents, she is venerated for her visionary and levitational powers. She improves Charisma by a good amount, and Healing by a very good amount. St. Milburga may sometimes be willing to levitate everyone to or around obstacles.
column2: 著名的修女与女修道院创建者，因异象与悬浮之力而受敬奉。她大幅提升魅力，相当多地提升疗伤。圣米尔伯加有时愿意让所有人悬浮着越过或绕过障碍。

column1: A former slave, released due to his vicious nature, who became an outlaw. He was converted by unknown means and was famous for the extreme penances he performed. He increases  Woodwise and Streetwise by a good amount, all weapons skills by a large amount, and Stealth by a very great amount.
column2: 昔日的奴隶，因性情暴烈而被释放，此后成为绿林中人。他以不明的方式皈依，并以极端的苦修闻名。他大幅提升林地知识与街头门路，大量提升所有武器技能，极大提升潜行。

column1: Patron Saint of storm-beset sailors, Russia, Lorraine, Greece, Sicily and Apulia; his generosity led to the Santa Claus myth. He provides a modest increase to Agility, a good increase to Charisma, and a tremendous increase to Riding. He affects local reputation in areas of his patronage, and saves ships and boats from storms.
column2: 受风暴所困的水手、俄罗斯、洛林、希腊、西西里与普利亚的守护圣人；他的慷慨造就了圣诞老人的传说。他适度提升敏捷，大幅提升魅力，巨大提升骑术。他影响其庇护地区的当地声望，并能从风暴中拯救船只。

column1: Patron Saint of the blind and of Alsace, she was the blind child of an Alsatian lord. Her vision was restored at the age of twelve when she was first baptized. She provides a modest increase to Perception, and to local reputation in Alsace. She can also provide light.
column2: 盲人与阿尔萨斯的守护圣人。她原是阿尔萨斯领主的盲眼女儿，十二岁初次受洗时复明。她适度提升感知，并提升阿尔萨斯的当地声望。她还能提供光明。

column1: Active in secular as well as ecclesiastical affairs, he was with King Athelstan at the battle of Brunanburh. He increases Charisma by a small amount, all weapon skills and Speak Common by a modest amount, and Perception by a good amount.
column2: 既涉教会事务，也活跃于世俗政务，曾随阿塞尔斯坦国王参加布鲁南堡之战。他少量提升魅力，适度提升所有武器技能与通用语，大幅提升感知。

column1: Patron of Norway, Olaf was a pirate in his youth who rose to become king of Norway. His efforts to unify and Christianize Norway made him one of her great heroes. Enhances all weapon skills by a good amount, and heals a good amount of Endurance.
column2: 挪威的守护圣人。奥拉夫年轻时是海盗，后来登上挪威王位。他致力于统一挪威并推行基督教，因而成为挪威最伟大的英雄之一。他大幅提升所有武器技能，并大量治疗耐力。

column1: Patron Saint of the medical profession and one of the Fourteen Holy Helpers, he was a doctor who survived tortures before his death. He enhances Alchemy by a good amount, and Healing by a large amount. He allows armored characters to regain lost Strength and Endurance; in combat, animals and fire have less effect on the party.
column2: 医务界的守护圣人，十四圣助者之一。他生前是医生，经受了种种酷刑。他大幅提升炼金术，大量提升疗伤。他让穿着护甲的角色恢复失去的力量与耐力；战斗中，野兽与火焰对队伍的影响减弱。

column1: Patron of Ireland, he converted most of the Irish chieftans and Druids by miraculous means. He increases Strength by a good amount, greatly increases Charisma, Edged, Pole and Impact weapons, Speak Common, and Read/Write, and increases Latin by a very great amount. In combat, he may enhance armor against missile weapons.
column2: 爱尔兰的守护圣人，以奇迹般的方式感化了大多数爱尔兰酋长与德鲁伊。他大幅提升力量，大量提升魅力、刀剑、长杆与钝击武器、通用语与读写，并极大提升拉丁语。战斗中，他可能强化护甲以抵御投射武器。

column1: Patron of Malta and Greece, he was an apostle who performed many miracles. Provides a small increase to Endurance, a modest increase to Charisma, a good increase to Latin, and a very good increase to Speak Common and Read/Write. He also heals a point of Strength. Can provide escapes, and enhances local reputation in Greece and Malta.
column2: 马耳他与希腊的守护圣人，行过许多奇迹的使徒。他少量提升耐力，适度提升魅力，大幅提升拉丁语，相当多地提升通用语与读写。他还治疗 1 点力量。他能提供逃脱之法，并提升希腊与马耳他的当地声望。

column1: Childlike and naive, Paul became a disciple at age sixty, where he exhibited powers of mind-reading and healing. Restores lost Strength and Endurance, and can allow the party to discern the motives of others; when invoked, he causes a temporary loss of half the character's Intelligence.
column2: 孩童般天真单纯。保罗六十岁才成为门徒，此后展现出读心与治愈之力。他恢复失去的力量与耐力，并能让队伍看清他人的动机；呼求他时，祈求者的智力会暂时减半。

column1: Of noble birth, Perpetua was arrested for her faith; sentenced to die in the public games, she was put to the sword after the wild beasts refused to attack her. Enhances Charisma by a good amount and can cause wild animals to cease attack and flee.
column2: 出身贵族。佩尔佩图阿因信仰被捕，被判在公开竞技中处死；野兽拒绝攻击她，最终她被剑刺死。她大幅提升魅力，并能令野兽停止攻击、四散逃去。

column1: Patron Saint of fishermen, and an apostle; known for ignoring danger, he was saved from prison by an angel. Increases Strength, Speak Common, Latin, and Healing by a good amount, Charisma by a moderate amount, and Edged weapons by a large amount. Can aid in prison escapes; causes temporary loss of half the character's perception.
column2: 渔夫的守护圣人，十二使徒之一；以不惧危险著称，曾由天使救出牢狱。他大幅提升力量、通用语、拉丁语与疗伤，适度提升魅力，大量提升刀剑武器。他能协助越狱；但会使祈求者的感知暂时减半。

column1: An Armenian monk persecuted during periods of iconoclasm; he was also accused of witchcraft because of his miracles. He increases Intelligence and Perception by a modest amount, Riding and Alchemy by a good amount, and Stealth by a tremendous amount. However, the party loses a small amount of local reputation.
column2: 亚美尼亚修士，在圣像破坏运动期间遭受迫害；因其奇迹，还被控以巫术。他适度提升智力与感知，大幅提升骑术与炼金术，并巨大提升潜行。但队伍会损失少量当地声望。

column1: A devout man, at age eighty he was ordered burned to death, but the flames failed to hurt him; he was put to the spear instead. When he is invoked, regardless of whom you pray for, the entire party's resistance to flames improves.
column2: 虔诚之人。八十岁时被判处火刑，火焰却伤不了他，于是改以长矛刺死。呼求他时，无论你为谁祈祷，全队对火焰的抗性都会提升。

column1: Patron Saint of the blind, of travellers and safe journeys, and of eye disease; Raphael is one of the three archangels. Enhances Agility and Perception by a modest amount, and Healing by a tremendous amount. He restores all lost Strength and Endurance and can destroy and purify pagan/satanic worship places.
column2: 盲人、旅人与旅途平安、眼疾的守护圣人；拉斐尔是三大天使之一。他适度提升敏捷与感知，并巨大提升疗伤。他恢复全部失去的力量与耐力，并能摧毁、净化异教与撒旦的崇拜场所。

column1: Patron Saint of lawyers, known for his conversions and preaching. He provides a good increase to Intelligence, and a very good increase to Read/Write. Allows the party to travel on water as though it were land for one day, and improves local reputation with Dominicans.
column2: 律师的守护圣人，以感化众人与讲道闻名。他大幅提升智力，相当多地提升读写。他让队伍可如履平地般在水上行进一天，并提升与多明我会的当地声望。

column1: An avid missionary to Moorish lands, and a brilliant scholar and poet; he suffered many indignities and dangers while trying to convert the Moors. Provides a good increase to Intelligence, and a very great increase to Alchemy and Read/Write. If the invoker's Strength and Endurance are very low, they are raised to "9."
column2: 热忱前往摩尔人地区传教的传教士，也是出色的学者与诗人；在感化摩尔人的过程中屡遭羞辱与危险。他大幅提升智力，极大提升炼金术与读写。若祈求者的力量与耐力极低，会被提升到"9"。

column1: Patron of stonemasons, he was murdered by stonemasons jealous of his work. Prayer may allow one to see hidden doors, and to climb straight up stone. He improves Alchemy by a modest amount, Artifice by a tremendous amount, and heals a good amount of Endurance, but reduces Charisma by a modest amount.
column2: 石匠的守护圣人。他因技艺出众遭同行石匠嫉恨而被杀。祈祷可让人看见隐藏的门，并能沿石壁直上。他适度提升炼金术，巨大提升技艺，大量治疗耐力，但会适度降低魅力。

column1: Patron Saint against plague, and of prisoners, he worked to help plague victims and himself recovered from the disease. He was imprisoned as a spy and died in prison. Enhances Artifice by a modest amount, and Healing by a good amount. He can end plague in an area, and heals a modest amount of Strength and Endurance.
column2: 防疫与囚徒的守护圣人。他竭力救助瘟疫病人，自己也从疫病中康复。后来他被当作间谍囚禁，死于狱中。他适度提升技艺，大幅提升疗伤。他能终止一地的瘟疫，并治疗适度力量与耐力。

column1: A Goth converted to Christianity, he proclaimed his faith during a persecution but was left unharmed. He survived many tortures and was drowned after refusing an offer to go free. Enhances Charisma by a good amount, and restores all lost Strength and Endurance.
column2: 皈依基督教的哥特人。迫害期间他公开宣信，却未被加害。他熬过种种酷刑，最终在拒绝"只要放弃信仰便可获释"的条件后被溺死。他大幅提升魅力，并恢复全部失去的力量与耐力。

column1: Patron Saint of archers, athletes and soldiers, he was shot with arrows as execution, but survived. Provides a good increase to Riding and Agility, a very good increase to Bow weapons, and a modest increase to all other weapon skills. He can heal a small amount of Strength and Endurance, and end plague in an area.
column2: 弓手、运动员与士兵的守护圣人。他被处以乱箭之刑，却活了下来。他大幅提升骑术与敏捷，相当多地提升弓弩武器，并适度提升其他所有武器技能。他能治疗少量力量与耐力，并终止一地的瘟疫。

column1: Patron of Cracow and Poland, a sought-after advisor who was killed by King Boleslaus. Provides a modest increase to Charisma, and a very great increase to Speak Common and Latin. Heals a small amount of Strength and a modest amount of Endurance, and can increase local reputation in Poland and Cracow.
column2: 克拉科夫与波兰的守护圣人，是备受争聘的顾问，后被国王博莱斯瓦夫所杀。他适度提升魅力，极大提升通用语与拉丁语。他治疗少量力量与适度耐力，并可提升波兰与克拉科夫的当地声望。

column1: Patron of Hungary, ruler of the Magyars and then King of Hungary. He increases Intelligence, Charisma, and Speak Common by a modest amount, and Riding and all weapon skills by a good amount. He can enhance local reputation in Hungary.
column2: 匈牙利的守护圣人，马扎尔人的统治者，后为匈牙利国王。他适度提升智力、魅力与通用语，大幅提升骑术与所有武器技能。他可提升匈牙利的当地声望。

column1: A missionary to Germany who converted many with his eloquence andzeal. He enhances Charisma by a good amount, and Speak Common by a very great amount. He also heals a small amount of Strength and a modest amount of Endurance.
column2: 前往德国传教的传教士，凭雄辩与热忱感化了众多人。他大幅提升魅力，极大提升通用语。他还治疗少量力量与适度耐力。

column1: A former Roman soldier who survived many tortures during his persecution. He was thrown into the arena, but the beasts would not attack him. He enhances Charisma by a modest amount, and heals a modest amount of Strength and a good amount of Endurance. He can also cause wild animals to flee from combat.
column2: 昔日的罗马士兵，在迫害中熬过种种酷刑。他被投入竞技场，野兽却不肯攻击他。他适度提升魅力，治疗适度力量与大量耐力。他还能令野兽逃离战斗。

column1: Called the merciful because of his work with the sick and poor, his executioners were killed with him because of their compassion for him. Enhances healing by a very great amount, and heals a small amount of Strength and a modest amount of Endurance.
column2: 因照料病人与穷人而被称为"仁慈者"。他的行刑者因同情他而与他一同被处死。他极大提升疗伤，并治疗少量力量与适度耐力。

column1: A recruit in the Roman army, he refused to participate in their pagan rites and was burned to death in a furnace. Increases Charisma by a modest amount, all weapon skills by a large amount, and Riding by a very great amount.
column2: 罗马军队的新兵，因拒绝参与异教仪式而被投入火炉烧死。他适度提升魅力，大量提升所有武器技能，极大提升骑术。

column1: He was the apostle who did not believe in the resurrection of Christ until he had seen it with his own eyes, from which we get the phrase "doubting Thomas." He increases Speak Common, Strength, Endurance and Woodwise by a small amount, and Healing and Artifice by a modest amount.
column2: 这位使徒直到亲眼看见才相信基督复活，"怀疑的多马"一语即由此而来。他少量提升通用语、力量、耐力与林地知识，适度提升疗伤与技艺。

column1: Patron Saint of universities and scholars, his writings now form the basis for all of Christian theology. Provides a good increase to Intelligence and Latin, a large increase to Read/Write and a very great increase to Religion. Enhances local reputation at monasteries and universities.
column2: 大学与学者的守护圣人，其著作如今构成整个基督教神学的基础。他大幅提升智力与拉丁语，大量提升读写，极大提升宗教。他可提升修道院与大学的当地声望。

column1: Patron Saint of lovers, he was a clergyman in Rome, noted for his piety and healing skills. He provides a modest increase to Stealth and Speak Common, and a good increase to Charisma and Healing. He also heals a small amount of Strength and Endurance. Finally, invocation may provoke good fellowship with others.
column2: 恋人的守护圣人，罗马的教士，以虔诚与医术著称。他适度提升潜行与通用语，大幅提升魅力与疗伤。他还治疗少量力量与耐力。最后，呼求他还可能促成与他人的和睦交谊。

column1: Roman soldier condemned to death; he converted his guards, who were then sentenced to die with him. Enhances Charisma and all weapon skills by a modest amount, and Speak Common by a good amount. Can also restore all lost Endurance and a small amount of lost Strength.
column2: 被判死刑的罗马士兵。他感化了看守他的卫兵，卫兵也因此与他一同被处死。他适度提升魅力与所有武器技能，大幅提升通用语。他还可恢复全部失去的耐力与少量失去的力量。

column1: Patron Saint of dancers, actors, comics, and epileptics, and one of the Fourteen Holy Helpers. He provides a good increase to Charisma and Agility, and can cure epileptic seizures, dispell demons and transport the party to the nearest town/city. There is risk that the invoker will lose some Endurance.
column2: 舞者、演员、丑角与癫痫病人的守护圣人，十四圣助者之一。他大幅提升魅力与敏捷，并能治愈癫痫发作、驱逐恶魔，并把队伍送往最近的城镇或城市。祈求者有可能损失部分耐力。

column1: Patron of Bohemia; his Christian teachings and stern rule earned him many enemies. He was killed by a rebel faction led by his brother. Provides a modest increase to Strength, Perception, Intelligence, all weapon skills, and Riding. He increases local reputation with nobles, and in Bohemia.
column2: 波希米亚的守护圣人。他的基督教教义与严苛统治为他招来众多敌人，最终被弟弟领导的叛党杀害。他适度提升力量、感知、智力、所有武器技能与骑术。他提升与贵族之间以及波希米亚的当地声望。

column1: Wilfrid travelled far and wide to establish Roman order over Celtic. He was involved in power struggles within the church, and in the building of many monasteries. Enhances Charisma and Artifice by a modest amount, and Speak Common by a very great amount. He also heals a small amount of Endurance, and may double party travel speed.
column2: 威尔弗里德四处奔波，力使罗马教仪取代凯尔特教仪。他曾卷入教会内部的权力争斗，也参与兴建多所修道院。他适度提升魅力与技艺，极大提升通用语。他还治疗少量耐力，并可能使队伍行进速度加倍。

column1: An active proselytizer in western Europe, he had many run-ins with pagans bent on his death, but survived them all. Provides a modest increase to Agility, and a good increase to Woodwise and Riding. If invoked before or during battle, opponents may be surprised enough to avoid attacking you for a short period.
column2: 活跃于西欧的传教者，多次与欲置他于死地的异教徒冲突，却都安然脱身。他适度提升敏捷，大幅提升林地知识与骑术。若在战前或战中呼求他，对手可能惊愕失措，短时间内不来进攻。

column1: A great wanderer and pilgrim, he wrote the first English travel book. Provides a modest increase to Woodwise, a good increase to Charisma, and a very great increase to Speak Common.
column2: 伟大的漫游者与朝圣者，写下了第一部英格兰游记。他适度提升林地知识，大幅提升魅力，极大提升通用语。

column1: A missionary, he was so successful at converting Frieslanders that he became known as "the apostle of the Frisians." He provides a modest increase to Woodwise, a good increase to Charisma, and a very good increase to Speak Common. He can enhance local reputation in northern Germany.
column2: 传教士，感化弗里斯兰人极为成功，因而被称为"弗里斯兰人的使徒"。他适度提升林地知识，大幅提升魅力，相当多地提升通用语。他可提升德国北部的当地声望。

column1: A director of monastery schools, known for his work with the poor and also with nobility (including the Emperor). Increases Intelligence, Charisma, Woodwise, and Riding by a modest amount, and Speak Common by a very great amount. He also enhances local reputation in villages and with nobility.
column2: 修道院学校的校长，既致力于济贫，也与贵族（包括皇帝）往来。他适度提升智力、魅力、林地知识与骑术，极大提升通用语。他还提升村庄中以及与贵族之间的当地声望。

column1: Patron Saint of servants, she was known for her patience, zeal, and holiness. She was a servant in the same household for 46 years. Enhances Perception and Streetwise by a modest amount, and heals one point of Strength and a small amount of Endurance. She can also gain information from servants.
column2: 仆役的守护圣人，以耐心、热忱与圣德著称，在同一户人家做了四十六年仆役。她适度提升感知与街头门路，治疗 1 点力量与少量耐力。她还能从仆役口中获得情报。
